He gets a box of eye glass wipes at the store for $5. and they do work well. But they left kind of a sticky residue on my fingers that I didn't care for. I did a quick check online and learned microfiber cloths do a fantastic job of cleaning glasses and do so without the use of glass cleaner (liquid) or water. I immediately ordered Fiber Promot microfiber cloths and was (still am) amazed and impressed how well they clean my glasses!  And how easy are they to use? Simply wipe the lenses a few times and PRESTO! Clean glasses! That's it. That's all it takes to wipe the dirt away!  But I didn't stop with my glasses....I then wiped down the TVs, my laptop, my Kindle and my cell phone all with the same fabulous results as my glasses!  These cloths do an amazing job and best of all, they do not scratch items they are used on!  I got the 6x7 cloth size (6 cloths included) and they're the perfect size to clean everything I listed above. I put one in my purse as well. They work great, do not cause damage and leave no sticky residue as the other wipes I previously used did.  And they're cheap! Incredibly cheap! You'd think something that works as well as these cloths work and require next to no work to use them would cost  far more than these cost!  These are incredible and do a fantastic job. There is even a 1 year money back guarantee on them, though I doubt the company gets many returns because these are fabulous!  If you wear glasses, you're going to want these cloths. And don't forget, they clean other items as well!

title: Sheer Perfection! I Have Not One Negative Thing To Say About This Gorgeous Messenger Bag!
text:
In the instant I saw this vintage handmade leather messenger bag on the Amazon page, I knew I had to have it. I loved it...I loved everything about it. When it arrived, I realized the photos on the Amazon page hadn't done it justice. Because as much as I loved it in the photos, it was a whole different ballgame when I actually had the bag in my hands right in front of me and took a good, close look at it. Its simply exquisite. The bag is handcrafted. Everything about it is so precise and detailed. The leather is perfect all around. The stitching is incredibly even and strong. The bag itself is durable and sturdy, yet comfortable. The vintage design is is what attracted me to this bag in the first place and up close, in person, it didn't disappoint. The inside of the bag has 2 large pockets for the laptop as well as smaller pockets for cords, cell phone, pens. The bag is flexible, but NOT floppy and loose. The bag has 2 security straps to protect your laptop and both straps have very secure locks on them which provide exceptional protection. The bag comes with a removable shoulder strap and it is very secure. I prefer to carry my bag by the handle. That will likely change if/when I travel and need to keep my hands free to carry suitcases or my kids. lol. For now, I prefer the handle.

This laptop leather messenger bag is the third item I own made of buffalo leather. (I own a purse and duffel bag, both made by different companies) Prior to owning those, I never knew buffalo leather even existed! I'm now a HUGE fan. It holds up SO well and is just gorgeous. When traveling with my laptop, I used to just carry it or stick it in my purse. I cannot believe how stupid I was to do such a thing. I'm VERY lucky I never lost or damaged my laptop by being so careless. Now, I keep my laptop in my Leaderadjo messenger bag at all times, not only when I travel. I know my laptop is safe and secure in the vintage messenger bag. I literally have nothing negative to say about this messenger bag. Not a thing. It's that perfect. I love it.

title: Not a Perfect System, But Works Well For the Low Cost of the Stereo!
text:
I ordered this weeks ago and have been hanging on to it. I have NO clue how to begin to install a car stereo and I was not about to attempt it. My car went in for inspection (passed! YAY!) and the owner of the garage installed it for me as well.

You will not say "OMG, this is the best stereo system EVER!" when you install this in your own car. You will not brag to your family and friends about how fabulous the sound is from this stereo. You will not waste time trying to decide what CDs you want to take along on your road trip because there is no CD player...

But you WILL be impressed with all of the features that come with the Keshangda car stereo system and how well it works for under $50.00! Its not the best stereo system out there...if that's what you're looking for, this is NOT the stereo for you. But if you want something that works well and has some nice features, all for a low price, then this IS the car stereo system for you.

I'm told it was easy to install. Again, I have NO experience whatsoever with installing a car stereo so I cannot speak firsthand, only pass along what I've been told.

The camera works better than i expected which was a nice surprise. I'm a bit disappointed with the touch screen...I feel as though I have to press it harder than i should to make it work and sometimes I have to press multiple times to get it to work. Its not that doing so is a huge issue, I'm just a bit worried that it could possibly mean there is a problem with the system or that perhaps it won't last as long as it should. (The mechanic who installed it didn't think this was anything serious, however) The sound is sufficient. Bluetooth sometimes doesn't connect which can be frustrating, but most of the time it does work.

You're getting a decent amount of benefits from this stereo for a very small price. Its far from perfect, it has flaws but for me, it gets the job done. I don't spend a lot of time in my car so this stereo system is perfect for me.

title: "Must-Have" Doesn't Cut It. You NEED This Halloween Decoration!!!!!!!!!!!!!
text:
Last year, I received one of the best compliments I've EVER received in my entire life. Sadly, I am NOT making this up! The cable guy came to set up our new service. When he walked into our home, he was taken aback. He kind of stopped in his tracks for a second or two while looking all around him in amazement. He then walked into the living room, stopped and looked all around and took it all in. Then he turned to me and said, "I should bring my kids here instead of paying to take them to a haunted house!". I was THRILLED!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

I LOVE to decorate my home for holidays. To say that I "go all out" is an understatement. I go WAY overboard. But I do NOT care. I LOVE to decorate for Halloween and Christmas. And I don't just slap any old decoration up, I am FUSSY when it comes to my holiday decorations. If this wasn't sheer perfection to me, I would not use it. That's how serious I am about my holiday decorations. (I already sound wacky so I'll continue to sound that way when I tell you that I put my Halloween decorations up over Labor Day weekend and the day after Halloween, my Xmas decorations go up! A few years ago, I wasn't able to put the decorations up over Labor Day weekend, I was a week late. The following year I put them up the last weekend of August to make up for the prior year! lol. But only on the inside of the house. Outdoor decorations go up closer to the holidays. I don't want the neighbors thinking I'm weird...lololol)

Anyway, I was beyond excited when I opened the box containing the 5x7ft Durable Soft Fabric Halloween Decoration Décor Backdrop for Photography. Not only is it HUGE, its GORGEOUS. It is absolutely GORGEOUS. And the fabric is so soft! Even though it was folded numerous times while in the packaging, it wasn't the least bit wrinkled at all! I shrieked. I literally shrieked when I saw it, that is how excited I was! The coloring is excellent, the picture itself is fabulous! I already know where I will be hanging it once Labor Day weekend 2019 arrives and I cannot wait to have the kids in their costumes stand in front of it for photos!!!! And that includes our dog since he always wears a Halloween costume each year! This is beyond gorgeous. I HONESTLY could not believe the price when I saw it! I would have thought this cost at least twice that amount!

If you' decorate for Halloween, this is a MUST HAVE. It doesn't have to just be for your home, in fact, I showed it to my sister who is a 3rd grade teacher and she is ordering one for her classroom! Don't, for one second, think this directed at kids only. Kids, adults...doesn't matter. Its the PERFECT decoration for anyone who celebrates Halloween!

72 more days to go and then this will be hanging in my home, along with my other Halloween decorations!

I cannot recommend this enough. I truly cannot. Its fantastic. As gorgeous as it is, as durable as it is and as cheap as it is, it deserves far more than 5 stars but that's the highest number I can give. You will LOVE this!

title: Great organizing bag for my 4-leggeds!
text: So.. this bag is described as a nurse bag but I repurposed it as a doggie go bag. There are a LOT of slots and pockets, inside and out! It can hold a lot but so far I've got my dogs' collapsible travel water bowls, emergency food rations, treat pouches, pain and anti-anxiety medications (one of my boys doesn't travel so well), leashes, travel collars, their K9 emergency kit, identification cards, a couple of travel blankets, a few toys (because, why not? lol) and their travel water bottle in one side pocket while a backup water bottle for refills is on the other side. title: The perfect cord and charger wrangler (with NO LOGO!!)
text:
Like everyone else on the planet, I have a drawer full of miscellaneous chargers and cords that you have to poke like snakes to get to stay in the drawer so you can close it.. not to mention that fact that when you need a specific cord, you have to visually inspect the end of every one to find the one you need, only to pull out the whole lot as they have somehow entwined themselves completely into a ball of indiscernible mayhem.

I got this cable organizer from Teskyer and my cord drawer can now be described as "organized chaos". This case is double sided. The zippers work smoothly for the most part. There are multiple slots and sections of varying sizes inside. I went with the Navy Blue color and it is a little darker than depicted, but I really like it. What I like the most about this case is that no where.. on the outside, on the inside, on the zippers.. NO WHERE is there a company name or logo! So nice and refreshing to not have a logo all in-your-face the second you open the drawer!!

What was I able to fit inside? When empty.. this case comes in at about 7" wide, 10" long and 2" thick. After I filled it, it now measures about 7.25" wide, 9.5" long and 3.5" thick. Yes.. the material is a tad stretchy.

• 23 x USB charging cords of varying lengths (from 6" to 6' long)
• 10 x USB charging bricks (Samsung and Motorola brands.. AKA "the fat boys")
• and a couple of SanDisk microSD cards and adapters

All in all, a great solution, and at a very reasonable price, for organizing your cord chaos.

title: Nice to have for emergencies
text: I got this Lukasa Emergency Hand Crank Portable AM/FM/NOAA Weather Radio to have on hand for emergencies. I live in a very rural area so it is possible for us to be very out of the loop if anything major happens. Having this radio will help us stay informed, if even a little. The radio itself is easy to use, is compact enough to fit anywhere I want to store it and I appreciate the bright yellow color, making it easy to spot whether in a dark cabinet or from a distance outside. title: Great for non-gaming laptops

The cord is long enough and there are plenty of height adjustment levels so you can find the perfect angle that works for you and your desk setup. title: Thick, sturdy fast charging cables
text:
Like most households today, we have so many cables. It seems like every device needs a different type of cable, be it HDMI, USB-A, USB-C, USB-mini... it's nuts! I personally can't wait for all of our devices to be switched over to the current industry standard USB-C so I can at least reduce *some* of the clutter! But until that day comes (if ever), I am trying to at least organize our cable collection to where we can grab what we need without having to sift through a sea of black cables, examining all of the ends looking for the right one.

Enter these Avyxm USB C to C 4 foot cables. I chose the red and LOVE THEM!! They are very vibrant and bright making it stupid easy to quickly grab the correct cable for our USB-C devices!! The cables are nice and thick but still with a bit of bend allowing for maneuvering around furniture legs or nightstand lamps without putting a kink in them. And one of the biggest props? These cables FAST CHARGE everything I've connected them to. Our Samsung Galaxy S8 and S10 phones, my new Fire HD8 Plus tablet and my kids' Samsung S10 plus phones. The 4 foot length is perfect for bedside nightstands although it is a little too short to reach the couch and still use the phone or tablet in a comfortable position -- so I'll be grabbing a couple of the 6 foot cables for living room use.

Bottom line... the color is fantastic, the build quality is supreme, I don't expect they'll ever kink given their thickness, I love the braiding and feel of the fabric -- overall a high quality product that I have and will continue to, highly recommend!

title: Flawless Installation
text:
I just installed this product on my Ellipsis 8 HD and, I must say, the installation was more smooth than most other similar installations I have done on previous phones and tablets. This was not my first rodeo as I have installed my own screen protectors (both plastic and glass) on numerous devices in the past, so I had an idea of how to approach this one. That being said, I appreciated the company's installation video. Unlike other's I have seen, it is presented with clear audio and served as an easy to follow step-by-step guide.

My screen protector went on quite easily. I have an extreme case of OCD so this process took me nearly an hour (though I can see how it could take much less time for others who are not as meticulous). My result pleases me to no end! I have a crystal clear display.. no lint, no bubbles, no hazing and no rainbow effect.. and I just installed it. I am not reporting results after the mentioned 48 hour waiting period for allowing any bubbles or such to dissipate.. my results were immediate and flawless.

I am extremely pleased with this product and am glad I gave both the product and the company a second chance. I ordered this product twice.. the first order was broken/cracked upon delivery. I returned it to Amazon for a refund and ordered a second one. This one arrived in one piece, installed beautifully and should protect my tablet for quite some time. However, should it ever break or crack, the company does boast a lifetime replacement warranty so I should be covered for any mishaps in the future.

title: Acceptable
text: I work for the United States Postal Service and recently purchased the OontZ Angle 3 Plus Bluetooth speaker for use in my LLV truck on my rural mail route. The speaker performs beautifully and I wanted to protect it to, from and while at work so I purchased this case. I was mainly wanting a safe way to transport and store the speaker, but after reading the other reviews I was hoping I would be able to keep it clean in the case and still enjoy my music on my route. I received the case and used it at work yesterday. The case is extremely nice and I appreciate the interior mesh pocket and the carabiner clip. I have no need for them now, but I'm sure they will come in handy if I ever take this speaker on vacation and need to take the charging cables along and want to clip the case to my day pack. As for playback while in the case? Yeah, it was terribly muffled. It didn't work for me as it apparently has for others. Yet, the case itself is exactly what I was wanting for taking it to and from work. I like how smooth the zipper is and how heavy duty/reinforced the stitching for the zipper is. The interior is not as thickly padded as I would have expected, however it does protect the speaker. I deducted one star due to the mediocre interior padding. I hope that, if the company ever revamps this case design, they beef up the padding a bit.

title: USPS LLV Comparison: OontZ Angle 3 Plus vs Anker SoundCore
text:
First off, I am not an audiophile. This is a review from a simple person who wanted music at work.

I am a Rural Carrier for the United Stated Postal Service. I deliver mail in an LLV truck and these vehicles are basically mobile tin cans. Every panel rattles, making for quite an unpleasant environment, audio wise. I tried playing music directly off my phone, but alas my speakerphone is only so loud and is constantly drowned out by the LLV.

So, I researched Bluetooth speakers and, based on the reviews and popularity, recently purchased two:
-[[ASIN:B016XTADG2 Anker SoundCore Bluetooth Speaker with 24-Hour Playtime, 66-Foot Bluetooth Range & Built-in Mic, Dual-Driver Portable Wireless Speaker with Low Harmonic Distortion and Superior Sound - Black]]
-[[ASIN:B01LZV6TYQ OontZ Angle 3 PLUS Splashproof Bluetooth Speaker - Designed & Engineered by Cambridge SoundWorks for Richer Bass, HD Sound, and 30-Hour Playtime, 10W+ Power, Water Resistant, Portable Wireless Speaker]]

The Anker SoundCore is being returned while I am keeping the OontZ Angle 3 Plus and here is why.

I tested both speakers in my home at first. My very first impression, out of the box:
OontZ Angle 3 Plus - was nice to touch and just felt solid and very well built.
Anker SoundCore - just felt like a simple lightweight brick. It really didn't give the impression of longevity or durability.

The set-up guides were quite different from each other.
OontZ Angle 3 Plus - Extremely easy to read, follow and understand (remember, I am not a music nut lol. This was my first time ever using a Bluetooth speaker and was in completely uncharted territory.) It was all in English, and only English and the diagrams were detailed and made the entire set-up process seamless and carefree.
Anker SoundCore - This guide was very hard to follow. It is printed in darn near every language, in tiny print and the diagrams were quite small as well. I ultimately did get the speaker paired with my phone and figured out what buttons did what, but it took nearly 15 minutes to do so.

Bluetooth Pairing
With both speakers and my phone lined up on a table (well within the proximity specified in each set-up guide), both speakers paired, however:
OontZ Angle 3 Plus - MUCH faster in pairing (mere seconds!).
Anker SoundCore - took nearly two minutes to complete the pairing process.

Pause/Play Button
Since I dismount to deliver packages to a customer's door routinely on my route, I really need to have a simply way to pause my music. I really like how both speakers offer this function on directly on the units, saving me from having to handle my phone.
OontZ Angle 3 Plus - I barely press the Play/Pause button and the speaker immediately reacts. There is NO hesitation.
Anker SoundCore - I press the Play/Pause button and there is a delay of about 5 seconds.. just long enough to make me think I didn't press hard enough and reach to do it again only for the speaker to finally react.

Volume/Overall Playback Quality
OontZ Angle 3 Plus - Wow. Just wow. It is truly unbelievable to hear such full sound, and bass(!), coming from such a small unit. I found myself perfectly pleased with the output without ever reaching max volume on the speaker itself. So I am looking forward to how well it will work in my LLV during my first road test. As for now, I am thoroughly impressed!
Anker SoundCore - I maxed out the volume on my phone and the speaker and was just not impressed. If I could guess, I'd say the max output this speaker achieved was only about 25% more than my speakerphone alone (while the OontZ Angle 3 Plus blew it out of the water with close to double, if not more, output than my speakerphone alone).
I also noted some kind of distortion or interference type background sound with the Anker SoundCore at mid volume and above.

Speakerphone/Mic
I was able to answer an incoming phone call on both units as described in each set-up guide. The quality of in-call sound on each speaker differed:
OontZ Angle 3 Plus - My husband's (the caller) voice was crisp and clear, as if he was sitting talking right next to me. There was no distortion or feedback out of the speaker. Husband reported nothing but a clear voice on his phone.
Anker SoundCore - Husband's voice was clear, but echoed horribly. No matter what volume level I used. There was no distortion (I was expecting this given the distortion with the music playback) bu the continuous echoing is a major issue for me. Husband reported a slight "faded" type of echo on his phone.

Road Test (in my LLV)
OontZ Angle 3 Plus - The sound is amazing in the truck! Thinking I would need it, I maxed the volume on both the speaker and my phone then pressed play on my music. Well, I certainly don't need max volume. I reduced the volume on both the speaker and my phone and found a very happy medium output. This speaker performs perfectly in the loud, rattling setting of a USPS LLV.. even while bouncing down rural dirt two tracks and washboard gravel roads. I am extremely pleased with this tiny speaker.
Anker Soundcore - Even with maxed volume settings, I could not get this speaker to perform anywhere near as well as the OontZ Angle 3 Plus. It had volume and was loud enough to hear over the vehicle's own noise, however the distortion/interference mentioned earlier was still present and in the truck during the road test it had what I would describe as an echoing effect on the music, specifically the singers' voices. It just wasn't clear. (I hope that makes sense.)

Battery Life/Listen While Charging
OontZ Angle 3 Plus - So far, the battery life is impressive. After receiving it, I charged it overnight (as recommended). I then had it connected to my phone for about an hour of home testing. Turned it off and I next used it at work on a Saturday.. had it powered on and connected to my phone and actively playing music for about 5.5 hours. I then used it again on Monday (much longer and busier days in the USPS, FYI).. had it on, connected and active continuously for nearly 9 hours. I have yet to see the low battery light come on. I plan to see just how many days of work I can get out of a single charge.
Anker Soundcore - I have no information for this section on this speaker since I am returning it.

Exterior/Cleaning
At first, I had the OontZ Angle 3 Plus setting on the dashboard of the LLV. This didn't last more than two stops. Despite having the four rubber "feet", the speaker still slid around causing more of a distraction than I would like. I ended up setting it on top of my personal bag, in a bin by my feet with the speaker facing up. This move really helped my piece of mind, knowing it will not go anywhere. This speaker has a soft rubber exterior. It is quite nice and feels luxurious, however... this exterior attracts all dust particles within 50 feet! USPS LLVs are *not* known for being the cleanest and even though I moved the speaker from the dust-ridden dashboard to a bin, it was still slathered with dust and dirt by the end of my route. I figured it was a fair trade, sacrificing the appearance for the gain of having decent music. But.. I got home and went to clean it. I will tell you, my expectations of this working were very low. I didn't think the dust would come off that supple rubber. But with a wet paper towel and a few slow wipes, it did. So, it can be cleaned up!

Case
I did purchase the case for this speaker ([[ASIN:B01NBDY6VP [Official] OontZ Angle 3 Plus Bluetooth Portable Speaker Carry Case, Neoprene with Aluminum Carabiner, reinforced zipper, by Cambridge SoundWorks [NOT FOR OontZ Angle 3]]]). I was mainly wanting a safe way to transport and store the speaker, but after reading the other reviews I was hoping I would be able to keep it clean in the case and still enjoy my music on my route. I received the case and used it yesterday. The case is extremely nice and I appreciate the interior mesh pocket. I have no need for it now, but I'm sure it will come in handy if I ever take this speaker on vacation and need to take the charging cables along. As for playback while in the case? Yeah, it was terribly muffled. It didn't work for me as it apparently has for others. Yet, the case itself is exactly what I was wanting for taking it to and from work. It is not as thickly padded as I would have expected, however it does protect the speaker.

Overall, for my specific purpose and intended use for a Bluetooth speaker, the Anker SoundCore simply won't cut it. However, it is still a nice speaker and will perhaps fit your needs perfectly. After all, most people don't drive LLVs and have the same high demands that go along with that. For me, the OontZ Angle 3 Plus is what I'll be bopping down the road to, mailbox to mailbox.

Happy hunting! Hope this review helps you out!

title: This cable fit the bill nicely. It fits in my Kindle USB port perfectly
text: I needed a longer cord to plug my Kindle in at night in my bedroom. This cable fit the bill nicely. It fits in my Kindle USB port perfectly, no shifting side to side and my Kindle recognizes it on the spot. The extra long 6ft length serves my purposes and allows me to charge my Kindle while simultaneously reading while in bed.

title: Sticks very well to brick
text: Purchased these clips to use on my mantle. I lay a pre-lit garland on top of my mantle every year for Christmastime and the cord always hangs freely off the end down to the outlet near the floor. I always have to compensate for the weight of the dangling plug by placing other decorations on top of the garland here and there to keep it from sliding off the mantle. I ordered these clips and placed one on the brick under the ledge of the mantle, then pressed the garland's cord into the clip. Due to the angle, the cord was threatening to pop out of the clip, but never did for the near month it was on display. I had concerns that the clip's adhesive would not stick properly or for long when placed against my brick fireplace, but it held quite well and is actually still there. I tried to remove it but the adhesive began to separate from the clip when I pulled slightly so I have decided to leave it in place. As the clip is black and is tucked up under the mantle ledge, it blends in well and will be fine left there year round until I need it again next December. That is the reason for the one star reduction.. the clips appear to be a one time use. To be fair, I've only used one and on brick at that.. but if it sticks this well to a rough brick surface, I have to only assume that it will stick just as well, if not better, to smoother surfaces.. thus making them nearly impossible to move and reuse in multiple locations.

title: Perfect Replacement For M505
text: My M505 finally quit working dependably for me after nearly 3 years of dedicated service. I loved the design and how I never had to change the batteries, not even once in those 3 years. So I sought out another one only to find they are no longer made. But I did discover this M525 and after a little research I purchased. I am extremely happy with this newer version of my older mouse. It is nearly identical to my M505, so close in fact that I have yet to notice any major differences except for the color. I recommend this M525 to anyone who likes the freedom of a wireless mouse and doesn't want to bother with changing batteries!

title: No bubbles BUT lost sensitivity
text:
I purchased this protector due to the overwhelming positive reports from other verified buyers. I do not like my cell phone's screen being unprotected and now with my first Kindle I feel the same way. The HDX screen is gorgeous and I want a way to keep it as such. This screen protector seemed the answer to my predicament.

This protector is, indeed, extremely simple to 'install'. It takes more time to remove it from its packaging and throw the trash away afterwards than it does to apply the protector itself. Simply line up the cutouts on the protector film with the camera and flash at the top and center of your Kindle and you are done. I found it helpful to guide the film into place by kind of rolling the sides down, guiding them to ensure proper placement. Then just apply a little pressure (basically, run your hand around the edges) to activate the adhesive.

Only the outer black margin of the protector has adhesive to stick it to the border and outer edges of your Kindle, thus leaving the clear center which covers your Kindle's screen loose, or non-sticky. This manufacturing and design approach has both pros and one con I have noticed so far.

Pros:

It allows for lightning fast and super easy installation.

Because of the solid black border, you can accidentally touch the sticky side while installing and lining it up without any fingerprints showing through as with a normal screen protector. This was a bonus to me as these things are always so difficult to install without this happening.

The clear center portion that covers the screen is completely 100% bubble free.

Due to some micro hairs/fibers being on the screen despite having wiped it down prior to installing the protector, I learned that I could remove the protector (lifted up one corner and peeled it halfway back to do a quick swipe with the MF cloth again) and it would re-adhere to the Kindle's surface just as well as it did the first time.

The company claims that, if it should lose its stickiness, the protector can be rinsed/washed and used again. I have yet to need to go this far so I cannot comment on the credit-worthiness of this claim, however from my experiences so far, I can see the possibility of this claim holding up.

I have not noticed any blurring or the rainbow affect the company mentions on its packaging. The screen is crystal clear and appears to not even have a screen protector on it.

Con:

Since the clear center portion does not adhere to the screen, it is allowed to float just above the screen thus reducing the screen sensitivity and requiring more force from either your fingertip or your stylus.

After using my Kindle for a few hours after installation of this screen protector, I have come to the above conclusions. As bad as the con is for me and my preferences, I will leave it on for a few days to give myself a little more time and to see if anything changes. This screen protector ranks very high on my list of desirable protectors (I even searched to see if they make a version for my Droid cell phone) so I am really hoping that the sensitivity issue works itself out soon.

title: Protects but hinders the camera app
text: This case fits my new Kindle Fire HDX 8.9" very snug which satisfies my concern of whether it is protected or not. There is no chance that my Kindle will slip out of this case. The sleep/wake feature is very nice and handy in keeping the battery from draining if you forget to turn the screen off before closing the lid (which causes the Kindle to finally time out based on the time you have specified in the settings). The only complaint that I have with this case is the Kindle camera app thinks the Kindle needs to be slid upwards in order to take pictures with the rear facing camera. The 'slide up' instructions are displayed in the center of the screen when you open the camera app making it difficult to take a picture. You can still snap a picture, but you cannot see whatever is in the center of your screen. This makes for an extremely annoying experience. I should not have to remove my Kindle from its case in order to take a picture. That is ridiculous. Pure and simple. I have purchased a more professional case which also has the same issue when it comes to the camera app so I am not sure who is to blame for this problem, but it does need to be remedied soon.

title: Great case! (But read below about problems with features!)
text:
***The first part of this review is for the Red option***

I needed more than just a simple case for my Kindle as it pulls double duty serving as my tablet and my planner. I also needed something that would provide it with supreme protection as it accompanies me to and from work every day.

I purchased this case/portfolio in the red color in hopes that it would make it stand out at work. Many of my co-workers have Kindles as well and I didn't want mine to accidentally get picked up. The red is nice, but way too much for me. I have been considering exchanging it for the black and the following issues are what sent me over the edge and led to my returning the red case.

This case/portfolio worked nicely for my needs. However, I removed two stars for two reasons.
#1 The case stunk to high heaven. It was so bad that I thought a stink bug had gotten into my house. Though the "scent" did lessen over a few weeks, it was still very present after five weeks.
#2 The description claims that this case has the ability to put the Kindle to sleep when you close it up. Not true. After my battery died over night, I realized that the sleep/wake feature was not working in my case. I had to physically turn my Kindle off before closing the case (may not seem like much of a hassle, but it quickly becomes a time consuming annoyance).

There was one benefit to this case though. It is the first case I have had for my Kindle that does not have any issues with using the Camera App while still encased in the removable inner sleeve. This was a very nice feature, however not nice enough to get me to keep it.

**This is the review of the Black option**

So, I just returned the red case and opted to give the black version a shot. It arrived this evening and wow, what a difference!

It doesn't stink at all and the sleep/wake feature is functioning properly! I do, however, now have the ghastly on-screen message of needing to slide my Kindle up in its case to take a picture. But this does not bother me very much as I have not used my Kindle for taking pictures more than a handful of times in the month that I have owned it.

All in all, it is a nice, professional case/portfolio that offers the features for my Kindle that I was needing. It also has a fair amount of pockets inside, though do not expect to be able to store much bulk as you will run into two problems..
#1 If you add too many things to the pockets, you run the risk of the pockets bulging and possibly damaging your Kindle's screen.
#2 Also, if you add too much to the pockets, you will possibly not be able to close the case. And if you manage to close it, you may run the risk of stretching the zipper and ultimately damaging the case.

Personally, I keep a small stack (about 10) of my business cards, five gift certificates and a little cash in the pockets and the zippers still flow smoothly with no issues and nothing from the pocket side comes in contact with my screen. Overall, I would recommend this case, as long as you are willing to take a risk on getting one that has the features you are wanting/needing as it seems to be a completely random toss-up as to which case has which features.

On a side note, the included stylus/pen is a great idea, but it isn't executed very well here. The plastic tip leaves a lot to be desired - it takes more force than I care to apply to my screen for the Kindle to register the stylus' contact on the screen. I did some research and purchased [[ASIN:B00E0GV9IC The Friendly Swede Bundle of 6 Micro-Knit Hybrid Fiber Tip Universal Capacitive Stylus Pens 4.5" for Smart Phone Touch Pad + 6 x 15'' Elastic Tether Lanyards + Cleaning Cloth in Retail Packaging]]. These stylus' are VERY nice in appearance and easy to use without requiring much force on the screen at all.

title: The Superb Stubby!
text:
**UPDATE February 15, 2021**

Just here to update my review and report that this little Stubby is still performing as I described in my original review below. I've had this installed on my Ram 1500 for eight years now and have had countless trips through hundreds of different car wash locations, both regular and touchless, and my Stubby is still intact and in perfect, like new condition! It's been one of the best and long lasting purchases I've made for my truck! I would upload a current picture but it looks the same as my original picture.. no fading or discoloration at all. I am extremely pleased!

**ORIGINAL REVIEW: February 19, 2013**

Vehicle installed on: 2012 Ram 1500 Laramie CC

I purchased a brand new 2012 Ram Laramie 1500 Crew Cab last October and the extremely tall factory antenna drove me bonkers. I had to take it off every time I went through a car wash (which may not sound like much, but it gets to you after the first few times, trust me!) and it whipped around in the wind, even at slow, city street speeds and sometimes when the truck was just parked!

My first antenna replacement was a 14" rubber Euro style aftermarket antenna off of eBay. It ended up just annoying the hell out of me.. at 14" and plastic, it bent real bad at higher hwy speeds (65mph+) and then took more than a day to straighten back out.. so yeah it got replaced with The Stubby from Craven Speed.

I cannot express how pleased I am with this little baby! Easy 'install' (just screw on - it actually took more time to remove my Euro antenna than it did to simply screw the Stubby on) and looks superb! It's so short (3") I can't even see it from the driver's seat.. huge difference from the stock antenna for sure. And no more removing it for car washes! I read multiple reviews for this before ordering.. as far as radio reception/quality, the reviews were half and half.. some experienced a much worse to no signal at all and the others said they weren't affected. I live in the country so it does not surprise me to be one of those who has very little AM/FM signal much at all now. I listen to Sirius all the time anyway, so no problem here! All in all, a sleek way to modify your truck and give it a little touch of class!

title: Ultimate Computer Screen Cleaning Product!
text:
This is, by far, the BEST product I have used to clean my laptop screen! Extremely easy to use, small enough to fit into one of my laptop case pockets.. it is the only product I have used that doesn't leave ANY streaks behind! A clean screen, just as good as the day I purchased it, is worth it to me. I will never use anything else on my laptop screen again!

I like that the cloth can be removed and rotated to a clean section then reinserted.. and when the cloth is completely soiled, you can simply toss it in your washing machine (just don't put it in the dryer!).

For the customer who had the bottle dribbling problem.. mine did at first, but like any other pump product, you have to pump it a few times to get all the air worked out of the pump line. I pumped the bottle over my kitchen sink until the gel sprayed out evenly on the side of my sink (about 6-7 full pumps).

For the customer who had issues with the design for removing the cover.. I found that this was not an issue at all. I did not have to pinch the cover to remove it.. it is more like a 'press with your thumb and slide outward' motion. No pinching at all. It does snap into place really well which is a good thing.. not exactly something you want to just pop off all the time.

title: Affordable and effective
text: My husband and I bought two sets of these three years ago from Circuit City during their going out of business sale. We both travel quite a bit and were in need of decent headphones for longer flights (let's face it, the ear buds provided by the airlines just don't cut it). My husband accidentally left his set, in their pouch, in the seat back pocket on a flight last year and was in need of a replacement set for our trip to Germany last week. I was amazed by the price when I came onto Amazon to check - $29.99 was a steal compared to the $80 we spent a few years back! This headset is not the top of the line, but it is effective in canceling out the low aircraft drawl while in-flight. (They are also quite nice when you need to drown out the crying child in 23F. ;)) The battery life is remarkable. I have had to change the battery on my set only twice in the three years I've owned it. The only complaint that I have, which results in the four star rating instead of five, is that after wearing the set for a few hours (i.e., Amsterdam to Houston, TX), my ears begin to ache on the outside. It is almost like the headset becomes to tight over longer periods of time. I tend not to wear earrings on airplanes, so I can rule out the possibility of pinching. Other than that slight achy feeling, these are wonderful for the casual traveler and the price simply cannot be beat!

title: Amazing little card
text: I bought this card for use with my new Canon ([[ASIN:B005MTMFHU Canon SX40 HS 12.1MP Digital Camera with 35x Wide Angle Optical Image Stabilized Zoom and 2.7-Inch Vari-Angle Wide LCD]]). I traveled to Germany and Amsterdam August 17-26 and wanted to ensure I had enough space for any pictures I wanted to take. I took my laptop along to transfer pictures over for safe keeping in case I accidentally deleted while learning to use the new camera. Turned out that this card was more than enough storage! Over the course of my ten day trip, I took over 2000 pictures and the display on the camera today says I have room for 7056 more pictures still. Simply amazing. AT the time of my purchase, the item title stated that this card was a 30MB/s speed and the description stated that it was 45MB/s. I wanted the 45MB/s so I contacted live chat and the representative confirmed that the title needed to be updated to reflect the correct specifications for the item. I am glad to see that Amazon is on their game as the title has now been updated less than two weeks later. I highly recommend this card to anyone who needs a SDHC card for everyday/travel photography needs!

title: Perfect for the amateur photographer
text: I am a photography-holic. I take thousands of pictures on each trip I go on. I purchased this camera to replace my five year old Kodak Easy Share for my trip to Germany last week. Easy to operate and learn its functions. It does not come with a printed manual (the manual is on the included CD) and this did not work for me as I am one who requires a good old fashioned printed manual. Easy fix: I copied the pdf file to a USB thumb drive, took it to my local copy shop and had a printed version the next morning. The only negative thing on this purchase for me is that now, two weeks after my purchase, the price has dropped by $30. :( Would have been nice to have that extra cash in Germany.

text: I need more of these! It ends the clutter and ends the hassle of trying to get oversized plugs to not overlap the other outlets. title: Video Makes All the Difference (new rating, new reasons)
text:

When my daughter moved to Fl. and video chatting was all we have, I decided to get the Echo Show 5. The sound of the Echo Show is far richer than the Dot. At first, I did not like the fact that Alexa's voice was now muted by bass. I solved the problem with the Amazon Alexa app, where I was able to go to audio settings and adjust the bass and treble.
Any music played on the Echo Show is far superior to that of the Dot (no offense to my Echo Dot, I still love it).
REVISION: I'm 'old school' and believe in 'manuals, paper manuals' for guided instructions. I had to 'Google' how to change the settings on the Echo Show so I could access options on what would be appearing on the screen. This was after I complained to Amazon and they said they would forward my complaint about too many ads appearing. They never told me to check my settings and I had no manual to guide me. So I think I have now gotten rid of 'cooking recipes' and movie suggestions for little children. I LOVE TECHNOLOGY, but please, give accompanying manuals.

So I bought this little bundle having lost my wallet 3 times in 2 weeks.... one of the times in another state the night before my return flight! (found it thank God).

Anyway, it's super easy to use the app and was super easy to set up these 4 little items. I used the card for my purse, the tile with the key chain hole for my car key fob and the 2 little button tiles for 2 of my TV remotes.

The point of this review is: you should know that you can buy just 1 of these things and finding your phone is an added free feature! Score! I thought I'd have to attach one of those buttons to the back of my phone, but nope! So all you do is double tap the Tile logo on any tile and it will locate my phone anywhere within bluetooth range. This is so totally awesome. I don't have to log into a computer to find my phone and I don't have to stress out looking for it when my partner's not home to ring my phone from her phone. All you have to do is double tap ANY Tile you own in bluetooth range and it'll ring your phone. How great is that???!! Can't find my phone? Grab any remote and double tap the logo - BAM! Can't find my phone? Grab my purse and double tap the logo on the card Tile - BAM! Really an A+ feature that Tile should really be clearer about when advertising their products..... like first thing.

My review doesn't include how you find things when you're out of bluetooth range..... but I think there's an alert for your phone when you're about to leave your wallet somewhere, etc., or about to exit bluetooth range.... pretty sure that's how it works. Anyway, just finding my phone and things around the house will save me how many search minutes (hours) a year??? And garners a 5 star rating on that alone.

title: Shop around.
text:
I've had WD drives for decades, and the only issues I ever had were with WD Green and Black drives. Red, Red Plus, and Red Pro work where they're intended to work, as they're intended to work. So do WD Blue. Before buying a WD drive, learn what each color is intended for. The Black drives I've had fail were due to insufficient cooling. Blue are to be used in a PC with one or two drives that sees daily use. That's daily, not 24/365. Not in an array. Each level of Red drive is intended for arrays of different numbers of drives. They are not quiet desktop drives. You really want them somewhere other than next to where you sit.

More importantly than all that, carefully check prices in several places. Don't pay the absurd prices that some people want after buying their stock at retail price. They'll go back down. WD will make more.

title: It works for me
