text:
I like to listen to audiobooks as I go on long bike rides and this is the best speaker I've found for that purpose so far. I've used other speakers that sit in the water bottle cages, but the sound is muffled by my frame bag. Also, I prefer to ride with two bottles. This speaker rests on the handlebars, so it's closer to your ears and provides a superior listening experience.

The mount screws securely in place and there are plenty of spacers provided to ensure this will fit on a wide variety of bar diameters. The speaker screws into the mount in the same fashion that a camera can be affixed to a tripod. It's convenient to have both a light and a power bank mounted on your bicycle, and this speaker has a great battery life. It is highly water resistant and can handle less than ideal conditions. This is a terrific bicycle accessory.

title: Great For Virtual Learning
text:
I'm doing virtual learning with my children this school year and this laptop table helps convert any room into a classroom. The legs fold out on the bottom and provide you a stable writing space whether you're sitting on the floor or on a chair. This item even works great for road trips and it allows your kids to stay occupied with creative activities rather than be entertained by videos.

It's a lightweight table that my 6 year old can carry without any difficulty, but it's sturdy enough to support a computer. There is a storage tray that pulls out from the side where you can keep writing instruments. When you fold up the legs, it takes up minimal storage space. This is a very useful item to have around the house.

title: High Quality Item
text: This is a durably constructed power strip that comes in a bright yellow color that's easy to spot. This is an ideal item for use in your garage because you're likely to notice it from a distance and not accidentally run it over with a vehicle. The power strip has six outlets on the front and there are four mounting holes on the back so you could easily hang this from a work bench or wall. The power cable has a thick casing that won't crack or break with regular use. This is a terrific item for a workshop or anywhere around the house.

title: Compact, High-Quality Speakers
text:
These speakers are compact, look great, and provide a high-quality sound that can fill up a room. The cabinet features an attractive looking wood grain that will perfectly complement your existing decor. The convenient wall mount bracket on the back makes it easy to hang these speakers for optimal sound coverage.

The speakers come with two speaker cables, or you can use your existing speaker cables. All you have to do is hook them up and enjoy. The sound quality is very high and these speakers are a great option for a home entertainment system. Whether you want to listen to your favorite recording artist, or watch the latest Hollywood release, these speakers will greatly enhance your audio experience.

title: Never Run Out of Memory
text:
I sometimes work as a tour guide for popular destinations in South America. On those occasions, I'll usually buy a few extra SD cards to give to clients in case they fill up their memory. There is nothing worse than seeing people get halfway through the trip of a lifetime only to have to start deleting photos because they don't have enough space left over to take pictures of the primary attraction.

This is a really good card that will allow you enough memory to take all the pictures you want. At 50 MB/s, this is a very fast card that is more than adequate for most situations. If you haven't upgraded your SD card lately, this product is an excellent choice.

title: Versatile, Elegant Backpack
text:
This is a terrific backpack that is equally suitable to be used as a school bag as it is to be used as a professional briefcase. The shoulder straps fold into a compartment on the back of the bag, and there are handles both on the top and on the side. The bag has a zipper around the body that allows it to expand to a comfortably sized overnight bag. The inner compartment has a laptop sleeve as well as elastic straps to secure clothing.

The versatility of this bag makes it a perfect gift. It is suitable as an everyday bag and is also a perfect travel size. It is very durably constructed with an elegant appearance. This is a high quality product that will provide you with years of service.

title: Very Simple Out of the Box
text:
This product couldn't be any easier to use. You pull it out of the box, pull the stylus from its slot, and start drawing. There is a little switch on the back that you have to flip to unlock the screen, but other than that there's nothing to it. The lines are drawn in a pleasing green color on a black background that is very easy to see. When you're done, you push the button at the bottom to completely erase the face of the tablet.

I find that my kids are always fascinated by things like smart phones or tablets, but they are prone to dropping them or wrecking them in other ways. This product is a great, inexpensive alternative to an expensive electronic device that will keep kids busy for hours. My eldest daughter is getting into making stop motion videos, and I thought this tablet would be a nice tool for animation. Rather than using a bunch of paper for a flip book, she can draw on the tablet, take a picture, and then clear the tablet before drawing the next image.

Note that you aren't supposed to get the tablet wet just like any other electronic device. The device is very thin and easy to handle. It operates on a watch battery. I think this is a great product for taking notes, saving paper, and for encouraging your child's creativity.

title: Great Party Camera
text:
This camera is marketed for kids, but it's a fun, simple product that is also great for parties. The images print out in black and white, which is nice because it allows you to get a ton of prints off a single roll of paper. The paper is thin like a receipt you'd get at a restaurant or retail store. It comes with three rolls, and you can take a lot of pictures with what's included with the camera. Be careful when you tear off the pictures because if not enough paper is extending out of the slot, the printing can jam. It's very easy to fix however.

The camera also includes a micro USB card which records all of your images. Be sure to charge the camera when you pull it out of the box because it doesn't come with enough energy to print right away. It takes a little while to get used to the controls, but it's pretty easy once you get the hang of it. This is a really fun product for both kids and adults.

title: Great External DVD Drive
text:
This is an excellent external DVD drive which allows you to watch movies or burn CDs/DVDs. I do a lot of work with photography and I found the SD and TF slots to be very useful. I have an adapter, but now that this external drive is always plugged in I can just use the slot on that.

The drive is very small and has an attractive black casing. The connection/power cable folds into the body of the drive for convenient portability. I do wish that the cable was longer because I use this with my desktop and I'd like to have the drive on my desk rather than perched on my computer. However, for portability, I understand why the cable is short.

You do not have to install any software to run the drive, but you will need burning software and software to watch DVDs. These programs are likely already installed on your computer, and there are free versions available if you need them. If you have a computer that does not have a DVD drive, this product is an excellent choice.

title: Nice Sport Watch
text:
This sport watch is a pleasing shape and size and is easy to operate. It has two buttons on the side and a touch screen for navigation. The watch face goes black after a few seconds to help conserve battery life. The band is comfortable and has a little stretch to help ensure a snug fit. The watch has a variety of good features that allow you to monitor your fitness data as you follow an exercise program.

It's very intuitive to use this watch and it provides you with good information that helps make your physical activities more fun. It also comes with a charging cradle. This watch is a good option if you want an accessory that will help you improve your overall health.

title: Easy to Set Up and Works Great
text: I got this little webcam for video conferencing. It is very easy to set up. All you have to do is plug the USB cable into your computer. I used the camera with Skype and it was up and running with an image almost instantly. The camera has a nice little clip that allows you to mount it on a monitor. It's even got a camera mount on the bottom so you can affix it to a tripod. Good product.

title: Elegant Looking Smart Watch
text:
This is a very nice sport watch that you can use to monitor your workouts. You have to attach the wrist bands to the watch face, but it comes with a small tool to make the job easier. The clasp on the wrist band can also be adjusted for sizing with the same tool.

The watch connects easily to your phone after you download the free "Link to Health" app. I found the app on the google play store and had no difficulty installing it on my Samsung Galaxy s7. The app automatically sets the watch time. The watch has no buttons and you operate it through the touch screen. You can select between several attractive themes.

This watch and band looks very nice and is equally appropriate out on the trail or at a formal gathering. It's easy to track your workout data, and this is a useful device to help you achieve your fitness goals.

title: Durable and Attractive Backpack
text:
This backpack has comfortable padded straps that effectively distribute your load weight. In the main compartment there is a padded computer sleeve, two side pouches, and two small pockets on the front. A thick string runs through the top of the bag with a barrel style cord lock. The front straps have buckles for decoration, but it is held closed with magnetic clasps.

The pattern and color of the fabric are true to what appears in the item description. This is a stylish and practical bag that is perfect for travel or school.

title: Comfortable and Durable Backpack
text:
I am very impressed with this backpack. It has ample padding on the back and comfortable straps which distribute the weight well even when it's fully loaded. This is a perfect backpack for students who have a long walk to class, or for travelers who want a good day pack.

The straps on the front have magnetic clasps so this bag is very easy to open and close. The central compartment has a cinch string to ensure your contents are well secured. The main compartment is amply sized and has a padded laptop sleeve. There are also four small inner pockets that offer a variety of uses.

The small front pocket closes with a zipper, and there is a pocket on either side of the bag that is ideal for a water bottle or for stuffing a lightweight shirt or windbreaker. The colors are vibrant and the overall design of this backpack is very attractive. This is a practical and durable item that will provide years of use.

title: Great Educational Microscope
text:
This is well made, durable microscope that offers a variety of great features. The adjustment knob is large and easy to operate. The knob offers both coarse and fine adjustments so it's easy to get your subject into focus. The kit comes with 10X and 25X eyepieces. These slide easily into the top of the microscope. The microscope features a revolving nose piece so you can orient yourself so it's easier to place objects on the stage.

The set also includes a camera eyepiece and software on a mini CD. The camera eyepiece connects to a USB cable so you can view your subject on a computer screen. This is a wonderful feature for classrooms.

The power button on the back toggles between a lower light source and an upper light source. The upper light source is great for examining opaque items like pine leaves or tree bark. There is also a dimming adjustment wheel on the bottom so you can adjust light brightness.

All of the moving components rotate easily and snap into position. This is a highly intuitive with a lot of great features which makes it great for scientists of all ages. This item is perfect for everything from classrooms to labs.

title: Powerful and Portable Chromebook
text:
This is a very nice Chromebook with a lot of good features. You sign in with your gmail account and you can access drive, search the internet, and watch videos. The computer can be used with multiple users. This is a perfect device for travel because the Chromebook is so compact that it can fit easily into a backpack or handbag. This would also be the perfect choice for taking notes at school.

My children are seven and nine and they use Chromebooks like this for their classes. It's intuitive enough for small children, but powerful enough for adults.

On one side of the computer there is an audio jack, USB port, HDMI port, and a USB-C port for charging. There are also two lights to indicate battery and power status. The other side has a MicroSD slot and another USB port. The keyboard is full-sized and easy to operate. The keys depress and it's easy to type quickly and accurately. There is also a touch pad that works like a mouse.

The computer is a pleasing weight and has an attractive overall design. The hinges on the back are durable and provide a smooth opening action. This is a good choice as a first computer for children, or as a secondary device for professionals on the go.

title: Great Summer Item
text: This is a durable cooler that has a Bluetooth speaker in the lid. To turn the speaker on, you open up a rubber flap. Beneath the flap is an on/off switch and a USB charging port. The cooler is well constructed with a carrying handle and a drink dispensing valve at the bottom. It is easy to connect your speaker to your cell phone or other digital device. The speaker produces high quality sound. This is a fun item for social gatherings or trips to the beach.

title: Great Printer
text:
This printer makes delightful 4" by 6" photos from your cell phone camera images. The printer is small at only 11" long by 6.5" wide. It plugs into a standard outlet and you operate it with the HP Sprocket app which is free to download. If you have problems downloading the app, you might have to go into your phone's settings and choose the option to clean up your memory.

The instructions are easy to follow and are included in the app. You load up the paper in the front tray and the ink cartridge in the side panel. Note that you have to orient this printer so that it has enough clearance to allow the paper to extend from the back. The image goes through the printer several times to add the different color layers, so the printing process takes a few seconds. If you put the back side of your printer up against a wall, it could interrupt the process.

The resulting image is the same quality as a print shop 4" X 6" photo. The photo is ejected from the printer with a white space on the top and bottom of the image. There are serrated lines on the photo paper so you can easily tear the excess away. The printer only comes with a starter kit of paper, but paper and ink refills are readily available and inexpensive.

This is a great item to create a more permanent copy of treasured digital images. If you are looking for a nice gift for a grandparent, this would be a perfect choice.

title: Nice Portable DVD Player
text: This is a great little DVD player. It comes with a remote control, HDMI cable, a power cable, and an RCA cable. I use mine with a projector for outdoor movie night when I don't to risk exposing my laptop to the elements. The remote control is easy to operate and this DVD player produces a fine image. It works great!

title: Nice Little Projector With Built-In Speaker
text:
This is a nice little item for giving presentations or to use for home entertainment. The image is bright enough to use in a lighted room for things like power point presentations, but for watching a movie it is better to turn out the lights. The projector comes with a power cable, an RCA connector, an HDMI cable and a remote control. The projector hooks up easily and has a convenient dial on the side for bringing the picture into focus.

As an inexpensive projector, this item is a nice value. I give a lot of presentations, and although most of the venues where I speak have their own projectors, it's nice to bring this one along as a back-up. It fits easily in a laptop bag, and it gets the job done. The controls are easy to understand and the item works great. The built-in speaker means that you can bring this along on camping trips for outdoor movie night. It's a fun and functional projector.

title: Attractive and Durable Bag
text:
This is a nice over the shoulder bag for students, professionals, and travelers. It is made out of a durable canvas that is resistant to liquids and tears. It has leather straps and buckles down the front, but those are just decorative. The flap stays closed by magnets that make it easy and convenient to open the bag.

There is a padded computer sleeve inside, and another internal compartment. There is also a zipper compartment on the back which is useful for things like pens, change, or important documents. The shoulder strap is easily adjustable and has a comfortable pad in the center.

The bag is a good size, and will accommodate most laptops. This is is a great choice for a nice-looking, all-purpose bag.

title: Superior Sound
text:
If you decide to invest in a high quality television, it only makes sense that you would purchase a nice sound bar to amplify the audio for a true movie theater experience. This set consists of a simple sound bar and a woofer that greatly improves your audio quality. The set also includes various cables so you can hook up to a variety of different audio output sources.

Note that if you have an older television, it might not be compatible with this unit even if you have an optical audio output on your television. You need a television that can produce a digital audio output in PCM format. Older televisions don't have an option to change the digital audio output, and the result will be a buzzing sound from the speaker. This is not a sign of a defective unit, it only means the speaker is receiving a non-compatible signal. Try the auxiliary inputs instead. If your television is less than about 7 years old, you shouldn't have any issues.

This speaker creates sound that fills the room and helps provide a better cinematic experience. The sound bar is small and inconspicuous, and the woofer can be tucked away on a shelf or in a corner. You can control the volume with a small remote control that is also included, and there are additional controls on the sound bar itself. This is a perfect sound system for most living spaces.

title: Superior Design and Sound
text:
These DALI IO-6 headphones offer a superior listening experience. The sound quality is absolutely fantastic and allows you to pick up nuances in your music that you've never been able to hear before. The ear cups are large enough to fit completely over your ear and offer a nice seal. I like that there is space between the padding and the speaker which helps enhance air movement. I thought these headphones offered great replication for high, middle, and bass sounds.

The speakers charge with a USB-C cable that is included, and offer an astonishing 30 hours of battery life. The speakers also come with an audio cable, and they even have an attachment that allows you to plug the audio cable into the dual jack you find on airplanes. There is also a high quality carrying case that zips closed.

I liked that there is an actual switch on the side of the headphones to turn them off and on. I much prefer a physical switch to a button you have to press until a light shows the headphones have been activated. You can power these down after use without having to take them off and look at what you're doing. The instant power off switch also helps to preserve battery life because other headphone models stay on when connected to Bluetooth even when you aren't listening.

The right hand speaker has extremely sensitive push controls. You can push the center piece to stop, reverse, or advance your music, and you can push the top or bottom of the rim to adjust volume. I prefer the push controls to touch sensitive controls because they are more responsive. I found the push controls to be highly intuitive and easy to operate.

These headphones are comfortable to wear and offer superior sound quality. They connect instantly via Bluetooth, and have a stylish design. Even the packaging is very attractive and would make these headphones a much appreciated gift. If you're looking a superior set of headphones, these are a great choice.

title: Great Concept, Solid Execution
text:
I like to listen to audio books as I go on bike rides, so I've been looking for a product like this. When I run I use over the ear headphones, but I can't fit those on over or under my cycling helmet. These sunglasses are a great solution. There are speakers underneath the arms that broadcast music almost directly into your ears. The effect is an open ear speaker system that allows you to hear your music, but also lets you stay mindful of ambient noises.

The sunglasses have enough of a tint to be comfortable, but not so much that they are impractical in low light. The arms rest easily on your ears and the nose piece is a solid bit of plastic that does not pinch the bridge of your nose. The glasses are very light even with the battery and speaker system.

The sunglasses connect to your cell phone via Bluetooth without any issues. There is a large power button on the right arm that is easy to locate by touch. I preferred these for comfort and for sound quality to ear buds. The sound quality is about what you'd expect for tiny speakers mounted to the arms of sunglasses. It's not concert hall quality, but it gets the job done, and it's better than a lot of other speakers on the market.

These sunglasses are great for athletes who like to listen to music while they're out exercising. Also included is a case, a bag, a lens cloth, and a charging cable.

title: Rugged, Practical Backpack
text:
This is a lightweight, rugged backpack that is ideal for everything from travel to college classes. Also included is a small zip-up pouch that is big enough to hold a wallet, toiletry items, or anything else you'd like to separate from the main compartment. The top compartment has two buckle straps. You can use the buckle straps to open and close the backpack, but they also attach via a magnetized clasp. The spacious interior has a computer sleeve, a zip pouch, and two shallow pockets.

There are zip pockets on both sides on the bag's exterior that could be used for water bottles or coffee mugs. There is also a large zip compartment on the front. The straps have minimal padding, but they are wide and comfortable. There is also a chest clasp on the front and a thick hook strap at the top. The green color is attractive and combines well with the leather straps. This is a very attractive, highly functional backpack.

title: Beautiful, Rugged Backpack
text:
This is the perfect backpack if you are thinking about putting your life on hold and embarking on an adventurous trip across Europe, South America, or anywhere the spirit of travel might call you. The bag is made from a tough leather with ample storage space. There is a laptop sleeve in the inner compartment, and a hidden zipper on the back for critical documents.

All the pockets feature decorative straps and buckles, but they open and close with a magnet clasp. The shoulder straps have minimal padding, but this pack is small enough that it's not extremely heavy when full. It's a nice looking pack that will protect your gear and allow you to travel in comfort and style. This would be a great choice as a gift for a high school student or college freshman.

title: Good Camera With Lots of Accessories
text:
I am very impressed with this camera. It is a lightweight, easy to use unit that comes with a ton of great accessories. The camera has a fold out screen that you can use for viewing while filming. The hand strap makes it easy to hold the camera while you are creating video. This is a very intuitive camera to operate right out of the box.

The package comes with two batteries that slide into a compartment on the side of the camera. A 16 GB memory card is also included which allows you plenty of memory space for your first videos. There are also two batteries so you can bring a fully charged replacement battery when you're filming on the go.

I like that they also included a slot reader so you can easily take the card from your camera and insert it into a USB port on your computer. This allows you to shoot videos and quickly upload them to the internet. This camera offers a lot of good video recording features at a very economical price.

title: Great Sound Quality, Lightweight, Easy to Operate
text:
I've been using these headphones for a week and I can't get over the superior sound quality. They feature terrific high end frequency replication and offer a bass you can feel. I experimented briefly with the Bose music app, but I have enough apps on my phone already and this connects fine as a regular Bluetooth device. In the end, the comfort and sound quality are the most important and not the other features. Both are great on this product.

These headphones have a really nice, sleek design. The ear cups swivel and can be easily adjusted to fit your head. The ear cups have what seems to be a soft leather or imitation leather padding that is comfortable and helps create a seal that blocks out external noise. You can adjust the amount of noise cancellation, so these are ideal headphones for both travel and zoning out.

The headphones charge with a USB-C charging port. At this time most of my other devices require a USB Micro-B, but I'm seeing more of he C ports and cables. A charging cable is included along with an AUX cable. You also get a very nice plastic hard case that zips closed.

The headphones have a minimal design with only three buttons. The only button that's labeled is the Bluetooth button. One really cool feature is that the front half of the right ear cup can recognize taps and gestures. Instead of feeling around for a tiny button, you can just double tap the ear cup to play your music or answer a call. You can adjust volume by swiping down or swiping up. The 20 hour battery life means these are always ready to play.

I'm sure this set of headphones has more features than I'll ever use. The most important thing is that they are very comfortable, easily adjustable, and sound terrific. If you love music on the go, these headphones are a perfect choice.

title: Significantly Faster Internet
text:
There is nothing more frustrating than having dead zones in your own home where you have poor connectivity. I got this router in anticipation of my two young girls growing into teenagers. The internet is an integral part of their educational and social life, so it's imperative to have good coverage throughout the house to reduce family stress.

The system consists of a router and two satellite signal boosters that you can use to ensure great internet throughout your home. As you can see from the pictures, the router has two gigabit ethernet ports. The satellites have a power plug and a sync button.

Every component is highly compact at 4.1 by 4.1 by 2.7 inches. There is also an app that allows you to have convenient control options on your phone. You also receive a 2 meter ethernet cable and three power adapters for the router and satellites.

The router and satellites are easy to hook up and sync. You can place them strategically throughout your home to ensure you get great internet coverage everywhere. I always make everyone in my family use their wi-fi on their phone rather than a data plan, so by reducing poor connectivity zones this router will definitely be a long term savings. I also like the compact size and design of all three elements. This is a great system for getting the most out of your internet.

title: Fast and Portable Hard Drive
text: It's hard to see just how small this drive is from the promotional pictures. I didn't believe them when they said it was the size of a credit card, but except for the thickness, this drive is actually even smaller. This solid 500 GB solid state drive is perfect for making a secure back up for your digital photo album. I'm old school, and I don't completely trust the cloud with my most precious memories. Old fashioned hard drives are delicate with an internal drive that can scratch or break. You still have to be careful with your solid state drive, but it will last a lot longer and is much less susceptible to breaking than other drives. This drive connects to your computer with a USB drive and has a USB micro B super speed connection that hooks into the drive itself. This is a tiny, high-capacity expansion drive that is perfect for ensuring you won't lose any data.

title: Very Impressed With This Lightning Fast Computer
text:
This is a very fast computer that is easy to set up and operate. The computer arrives suspended in foam packaging to ensure you get your unit in proper working order. I included a photo above to show the packaging which supports the computer and ensures all the delicate components are wrapped and protected.

The unit comes with a keyboard and mouse that connect via USB cables. I found both of these accessories to be ergonomically friendly and easy to operate.

The computer has a power button on the front along with a speaker jack, a headphone jack, two USB 2.0 ports, a USB 3.1 port, and a USB 3.1 type-C port. On the back there are 2 USB 2.0 ports that are used for the keyboard and mouse. There are also 4 USB 3.1 ports, an internet port, and various monitor ports.

When in operation, the computer emits a blue light from the front. The computer measures 12.5 x 6.5 x 14.25 and fits conveniently on or beneath a desk. The Intel Core i7-9700 processor is lighting fast and great for playing video games or streaming movies. This is a great computer that is perfect for professionals, students, or anyone with computational needs.

title: Great, Fast, High Storage Capacity USB Drive
text: PNY has long been a leading manufacturer of reliable flash drives, and this unit is no exception. The 32 GB of storage provides you with plenty of memory space, and information can be transferred from your computer very fast. This flash drive has a superior plastic dust sleeve that protects the end of the device and never gets in the way. As you can see from the above pictures, the sleeve slides back and forth across the unit body so there is no cap to lose or spinning parts that can break. I like to bring a drive like this on vacation so I can make quick, portable backup copies of my photos. This device is highly portable, fast, and functional.

title: A Discrete Bag That Provides Plenty of Protection
text: This backpack is perfect for a student, a traveler, or anyone who wants extra protection for their laptop. The bag has a nice, comfortable back panel that cushions and supports your back while providing a protective enclosure for your valuable electronics. The straps, too, are very well padded and easily adjustable so you can be assured of a proper fit. The description says this is a 15 inch bag, but there is plenty of room in the storage space. I could use this bag for a weekend trip without any problem. There is also a simple front pouch that zips closed that could fit a couple paperbacks. The top has a zip pouch that is ideal for a cell phone or keys. Finally, there are water bottle pockets on each side, one with a zip compartment. This is a great backpack that is practical and effective, but isn't flashy and won't attract thieves. Everyone needs a backpack like this.

title: Great for a Shop or Office
text: This is one of the best power strips I've ever seen. It is large, durable and has plenty of outlets for all your office equipment, tools or appliances. I like how the outlets are separated so that there is plenty of room for bulky plugs. This strip has convenient wall mounts so you can fix it in place and create a highly efficient work station. With all the electronic devices we have now, it seems like there are never enough outlets. If you are looking for a power strip so you can recharge the batteries on your power tools, or protect your computer from a lighting strike, this is the product to choose.

title: Superior Reception
text:
I have used an HD antenna instead of cable television for years. With a one time purchase price, you can eliminate the ridiculous monthly fees for cable, which results in hundreds of dollars in savings per year. I got this system as an upgrade over my previous antenna and I couldn't be happier.

All you have to do is plug in the antenna, connect it to your TV, and then hang the flat end on a window or wall. The kit includes some dual sided sticky pads from 3M so you can adhere the antenna wherever you wish. I put mine high up on my window behind the curtain where it is out of sight and seems to get the best reception.

You will have to do a channel scan on your TV which takes only a few minutes. After a channel scan, I found I got 3 additional channels with this antenna that I didn't get with my previous one. An antenna like this allows you to get terrific television service at a fraction of the price. Highly recommended.

title: Loud and Clear!
text:
These are a really great set of Walkie Talkies. Our family does a lot of hiking, and it helps to motivate small children to go for a hike in the woods if you give them a Walkie Talkie. The second you hand them one, they sprint ahead of you to get far enough away to start talking.

We had to do a road trip recently with two vehicles, and it was great to use these units to communicate between cars. Cell phones would have been an option, but these units broadcast without having to push an answer button. Also, if you are traveling through poor cell phone coverage areas, they work really well.

Durable and waterproof, we found that you can get a signal from several miles away. This is a great product for camping with your family and many other physical activities.

title: I'm Very Happy with this Monitor
text:
This is a terrific monitor that is going to make my work day a lot easier. First of all at 27 inches it is huge. I included a picture to show you how much bigger the monitor is than a typical laptop screen. Also, the monitor does not have the glare that is created by my laptop screen. It's like the difference between a matte finish and a glossy finish on a paperback. The glossy finish starts to tire your eyes at the end of the day, and the matte finish keeps you fresh. I'm finding I don't have to take as many eye breaks with this new monitor.

Installation is easy. The stand is solid and goes together without any tools. The TV also locks into the stand with no tools and has both a vertical and a tilt adjustment. There is a set of control keys along the side that allow you to make adjustments to the picture. I turned down the brightness to try to match the screen of my laptop. It came with a VGA cable, an audio cable, and a power cable. There is a HDMI plug in the back, but no HDMI cable was included with the purchase price.

Note that you have to use the button on the side of the monitor to turn it on, not the switch located next to the power cable. This is a very nice monitor.

title: Not Very Good
text: I've used this, but people say it sounds like I'm far away when I talk into it. Kind of disappointing, although my phone has been acting up lately, so maybe the problem is there. Construction, etc., seem nice and the incoming sound is fine.

title: Works Great
text: I'd lost my charging plate for my Garmin Forerunner which was annoying because it meant I thought I'd have to replace the whole watch. However, this little beauty was a super inexpensive alternative. I had the cable and the plug, so I plugged it in and it was good to go. Good replacement, it might be nice buying a couple extra just to have around.

title: Work So Far
text:
These are nice, I've been trying to get earbuds to work with my kids, but they keep falling out of their ears. My kids (girls aged 5 and 3) were excited about these. They're fans of the Transformers, and these look like they're designed after Optimus Prime. Of course they fought over them at first (I was only offered one set), so I might have to get another one.

So far they've held up to kid wear and tear, which is considerable. I thought the sound was pretty good for them, but the big thing is that the kids are just willing to wear them. Works so far.

I received a free product in exchange for an honest review.

title: Fun Speaker
text:
This is a neat little speaker. It claims to be waterproof, and I think it would handle a brief rain shower, but I doubt you'd want to throw it into a swimming pool. Still, for poolside entertainment this thing is great. The ports are covered up by a rubber cover, so I think it's about as water resistant as a speaker can be. Beneath the cover is also an on/off switch. It's a tactile switch, not a button so you don't have to sit there pressing it while counting to five or anything ridiculous.

The sound of the speaker is very good for such a little item. The speaker itself is about as wide as an old VHS tape just to give you an idea of scale. There's also a flashlight on one end, which makes this a nice camping item.

Recommended!

I received a free sample in exchange for an honest review.

title: Works for me!
text:
Very good cable. I always prefer to hook my computer directly up to a modem through an ethernet cable because the internet is faster than through wi-fi (or at least it seems so to me). Also, you don't get the occasional outages you sometimes experience with wi-fi.

This is a functional cable, no faster or slower than any other cable I've owned. Works for me!

I received a free sample in exchange for an honest review.

title: Clean Up Your Work Station
text:
These are what you'd expect them to be, it's essentially a neoprene chunk of fabric with a zipper down the side. Lately I've been doing everything I can to move away from cables of any kind. When the apocalypse happens, people will look at the rolling balls of useless cables and wonder just what was wrong with our society. But this cable wrap makes things a little bit better. I'm constantly swapping out an audio cable, so it's nice to have that cable bundled (because the darn thing gets lost otherwise). These are attractive and functional.

Good product. I received a free sample in exchange for an honest review.

title: Better than the Cable Company Router--By a bit
text:
I'd been using the same router that the cable company installed when I signed my contract back in 2009. I figured that any 2016 entry level router should be a noticeable upgrade. I've had movies stall in the middle of streaming, etc.

This was a quick and easy install and yes, i'm not getting as much movie stalling...but it still happens occasionally. So I'm satisfied, but not ecstatic. I was hoping to eliminate stalling completely. Still, it does seem to be better. Maybe I should have tossed in the next $50 for the better version...I'll keep that in mind for when 2022 rolls around and it's time to upgrade again.

Unit looks really cool.

title: Works as Voice Recorder and MP3 Player
text:
For $19 this is a pretty solid deal when you consider that the voice recorder can also be used as a MP3 player. There is a little speaker down at the base, and when the volume is at full blast this little guy is surprisingly loud. My only issue is that the controls are a little tricky to work out. This is necessitated by the fact that this is a slim, tiny device (It's a little bigger than one of those old Kingston USB drives), so there's not that much space to put controls on the thing. For volume, you have a push a button, then wait for the volume indicator to flash, before toggling another button. While the MP3 player was playing at full blast, this was a little distressing...but I eventually figured it out.

The voice recorder works well too. In that case, the controls are easy, you just depress a switch above the power button and it starts to record. Playback is a little tougher, but when you plug this into your computer (USB cable included), it's easy to download the voice notes.

I had a little more trouble loading up MP3s as you couldn't put them in a folder. You have to copy and paste the actual MP3 files and paste them into the Proster folder that indicates the device.

When I played the voice notes stored on the device, there was a note from the factory in what I assume was China. It was just a few second sample of some ladies chatting in a work place, but I found that kind of interesting. This would be a good reorder to bring to meetings with people you don't trust as it records better than the voice recorder on your cell phone and it's easier to hide. Kind of a nice piece of equipment. I anticipate I'll use it running since I don't like earbuds and this blasts a lot of volume.

title: Essentially it's a $50 Computer
text: I got this on a black friday deal and have loved it so far. Essentially this is a little computer. You can connect the WI-Fi to your house link and use a word processor on Google docs. If you connect a bluetooth keyboard, you've got a laptop. I don't know why people would spend hundreds of dollars getting a laptop (or why school districts go with ipads) when you can get this for under $50. At this price, you can't afford not to have one (because when the kids demand to get on your tablet, they can beat on this instead of the $800 work issued device they want). Also, if you haven't gone kindle, you need to know that there are thousands of books available for free. This little device will keep you entertained for a long time.

title: All the Storage Space You Need
text:
This is great! I bought one for my wife and liked it so much I bought another for myself. I use a Blackberry and she has a Samsung, so both of our devices have memory slots allowing us to expand our memory for under $10. This is why we stay away from Apple. 32GB is a ton of space for videos and photos. The only downside is you have to remember to download your photos every now and then (you're never running out of space so there's no incentive). You wouldn't want to get into a position where you lose your phone and it has your only copy of baby pictures for the last 10 years. However, another positive thing is that even if you drop your phone into a lake, you can still fish it out and extract the photos from the card (solid state memory).

Very nice product.

A couple of the other reviewers mentioned that they purchased this item from secondary sellers and got a knock-off. I purchased from Amazon and got exactly the item listed.

title: Synch your Phone With your Car Audio System
text:
This is a very nice product. I spend a lot of my time listening to podcasts while I do a 1.5 hr drive to work. In the past, I used to just sit my telephone in a cradle and turn the volume up, but at freeway speeds the ambient noise was enough to make it hard to hear the sound coming from the phone's speaker.

This product charges in your cigarette lighter and allows you to connect your phone to the car radio via bluetooth. You then have to pick a radio station that is not carrying a broadcast and set the control on the bluetooth FM to the same station. All of this sounds like a lot while I'm typing it out, but it goes quickly. However, I do highly recommend that you make sure the radio is set up correctly before you start driving. There are enough accidents caused by texting, and this does represent another potential driving distraction. If you set this item up while parked, it is very useful, but if you try to do it on the roll, then it could be dangerous...fair warning.

Once you have your phone connected to your car speaker system you can listen to your own music, podcasts, etc. It is a little bit of a problem when somebody calls you, however, because the device doesn't automatically un-pair when there is a call. I found I usually had to call people back if I got a phone call. Not a huge issue really.

There is also a mini flash card slot on this device so you could play your music directly from that.

Really a good product. I received a complimentary sample in exchange for an honest review.

title: Don't Waste Your Money
text:
Mine flat out didn't work. When I turned it on, the load up time was appallingly slow. So I let it charge overnight to see if that helped things (didn't).

I plugged it in and downloaded songs, only to have them not turn up on the play menu. A podcast I downloaded played for about 15 seconds and then turned to static.

Even the font on the display screen seems cheaply done (it reminded me of what you found on handheld video games in the 80s). Honestly, by the time I was done messing with this thing for a couple hours, I wondered if the whole point of the product was to download some malware on your computer. Not a good item.

title: Awesome Storage Capacity in a Tiny Package
text:
I brought this with me to Peru in order to make a quick back-up of all the photos I'd taken (I didn't want to have the whole trip erased...or lost because my baggage got stolen). It was a big comfort to be able to throw this flash drive in my pocket and know I'd have it when I returned home.

128 GB is plenty of space to store all your images on a trip like this. You can also download all your photos just to clear out your memory cards. The download only takes a minute (depending on your computer).

It's amazing how far these mini storage devices have become. I remember when we were psyched about having 126 MB on a flash drive!

title: Functional and Elegant
text:
This is an easy to operate stand that you can have operational minutes after pulling it out of the box. Everything is quite intuitive. Your devices are held into the clips via springs, and the clamp is fixed to the table through a screw locking system (note: you don't screw anything into your desk, the stand itself screws tight). I have already placed this on several surfaces and the stand doesn't leave any scratches or other markings.

The head of the stand is adjustable so you can swing your mobile or tablet around to various angles. The head is a bit stiff, but this is necessary so that the stand doesn't move once it has been put into position. Frankly, I like this because once you get into the habit of placing your phone in the stand, you never lose it.

title: Saves me Money
text:
I got this for use at one of the few remaining drive-in theaters in the state of Wisconsin. I hook it up to a larger speaker that I connect to my cell phone with bluetooth. The radio works great, and this helps save money since I'm not using my data plan on my phone to access a radio station through an app.

The speaker on this radio is fairly effective for use in a very small room, but it works better if you hook it up to a larger speaker through the audio jack.

title: Quick Computer Back up
text:
I've had great luck with Toshiba products and this one is no different. I used it to back up my hard drive. I don't subscribe to a cloud service, instead, I periodically purchase an external hard drive and do a back up, then I store the hard drive away from my computer. I don't like to keep my back up plugged into my computer because a power surge might blow out both the computer and the back up.

At the price, it's good for peace of mind to just buy one of these, back up your computer, and then store the item in a safe deposit box (that's probably cheaper than paying $7 a month for a cloud service). You have all the pictures of your kids throughout your life on your computer, and this is the solution that most appeals to me. Love that they're so cheap these days.

title: What I was looking for
text:
I picked up a factory refurbished unit and I'm satisfied. I was looking for a point and shoot camera that didn't have an extending lens. I wanted something that I could stick in the pocket of my bicycle jersey and pull out without having to worry about destroying the camera. I did wreck one of my old cell phones by sticking it in my jersey pocket, so the waterproof component of this camera was ideal.

I paid approximately $100 for this, and it takes decent pictures. Like I mentioned before, the lens doesn't extend, so you have to be pretty close to your subject, but the images are good enough that you can use enhancement software to create the image you want from the raw material. It's not a DSLR, but this is a good accessory camera to bring along. It slips easily into your pocket and can take a bit of a beating.

I don't intend to use this for underwater shooting, so I haven't tested it for that. If it rains on me while cycling, I'm confident the camera can take it. I'm satisfied.

title: Well Made but Not Practical
text: I picked this up for a trip to Peru, but it's so unwieldy I didn't end up using it. You're better off just getting a large ziplog bag and cutting open the end opposite the top.  I resorted to the ziplock bag method and found it easier. That being said, the item itself is well made and effective enough, it just didn't strike me as very practical.

title: Perfect!
text:
I've used this backpack on two trips to Peru for the Inca Trail. It's the perfect item, large enough to hold your camera, some extra clothing, and a water bladder, but not so big to become uncomfortably heavy. I always pack light, and I wouldn't want more than this if I were planning on a 20 mile hike. Be aware that the camera padding takes up about half of the bag (you want your camera to be protected, so this isn't a complaint).

After several years, mine shows very little wear (and I've been rough on it). Very good product!

title: Works Great and Less Expensive than the Name Brand Bulb
text: This worked just as well as the Viewsonic lamp that came with the unit, and was significantly cheaper than the viewsonic replacement.

title: Constant static so you have to turn them off when not in use...
text: I get constant static with these even when they're not in use so I tried plugging them into various places/ ports to see if anything changed it and nothing worked! The colors/modes are really cool, the sound quality is decent, the speakers get plenty loud, they feel solid, and look amazing! But that static issue is a deal breaker with me, I have to turn the speakers off when not in use and it's just inconvenient to have to do. These will probably be going in the trash sadly.

title: Better than a pair of $200 bose earbuds!!
text:
I have reviewed multiple name brand earbuds and wasn't impressed by a single one of them! I now have a pile of earbuds that I hate and never use. I came across these and figured I'd try them for some reason and instantly was blown away by the clarity of phone calls with it! I have a phone that costs over $1,000 and these headphones microphones and sound are many times better than my phones built in ones! I talked to someone about it and was truly impressed for the price point and they weren't surprised and poitned out that this is a legit company that makes a lot of high end electronics. They made a bunch of those expensive tape decks/ sound systems back in the day that cost thousands of dollars! Those things still work after all these years which is a testament to this company's quality.

I absolutely stand behind these earbuds and even told some friends they need to grab a set!

title: Truly impressed with this and at that price point, will be buying more!!
text:
I installed this over a week ago and have been using it daily... I looked up the price today so I can comment on it's "value" and I am genuinely surprised at how cheap it is! I've had cameras over $100 that didn't perform half as good as this!

To set it up, all you have to do is download their app, make a login, and have the camera scan the QR code in the app and it's setup! Super quick and painless! And putting the camera up on the porch consisted of drilling 4 screws in so that was super easy! Comes with a template to help you mount it perfectly straight or whatever but I didn't use that and it still looks good.

Functionality- this thing spins all the way left and right (wont spin in circles but it does reach all the way to each side.) Then it's range of looking up and down is really good too. I posted this on a porch post out front and I can turn the camera to the left and look down to see when Amazon delivers my packages now! Truly impressive the coverage this one camera has!

Night vision has like 3 different modes- one of them I think it keeps the spotlight on (which is BRIGHT) and I can see my car in full color/crystal clear from a few feet away! Another mode is just black and white with the IR lights on. And the other mode is black and white but it switches the spot light on and goes to full color when it sense motion.

I need to see if it has a sensitivity setting because the on bit of annoyances is that as is- it catches motion of bugs and everything under the sun so I look at my phone and have 30 alerts at any given time from the camera! Hopefully I can fix that but even if not, I am happy with the camera for the price point!

Picture- it auto starts off in standard def but you click that icon and it switches it to HD which is MUCH clearer!!

Overall I'm truly amazed by this and will be buying a few more to cover my current house and the house we're remodeling. I normally go with another company's cams but this one is far more impressive and I'm a convert for sure!

title: Great stickers
text: Great variety while sticking to it's theme. I really liked these stickers, they were a good size and none were missing or damaged/miscut. I like just how many different themes you can get from this company, and they are all so unique. No repeats. The stickers themselves were good quality, being well printed and cut.

title: Great for the shower but not a great all around speaker outside the shower...
text:
So for the shower- this things great! But outside the shower I'm just not impressed with this. I've reviewed several $20 ish price range bluetooth speakers and each of them has a little more bass and oomph than this one. It's pretty weak for what it is, even my Echo dot puts out more sound. That being said, this does get decently loud and is just fine for the shower! I used the attached suction and put it in my shower and it was great not having to reach outside the shower and touch my phone with wet hands to skip songs or commercials on youtoube.

Some things I've noticed on youtube though- I'll click the next button when it has a ad up and I can skip it. It'll then just send me to the next song as well and I'll have to hit the back button if I want to return to my original song. The ad will still be out of the way at this point so it WORKS for this, just kinda adds one more step. Just a minor annoyance but still so much better than having youtube take advantage of me being in the shower and cramming 2 to 3 ads at me at once since I often don't wanna reach outta the shower to hit skip every couople of minutes.

Battery lifes decent. For the price, it's not bad at all. Again, I'd really just use this for the shower. Maybe outside around a pool even... But if you're not using it for the waterproof feature, I'd skip it- the sound quality isn't impressive at all.

title: Good sturdy little suction cup holder!
text:
I don't actually have the dashcam this goes to but with a little dremel work I trimmed this one to fit my dashcam and it holds it perfectly! Very sturdy smaller mount that seems well made and sticks to the window well. Be sure to take something like a bottle of rubbing alcohol and something like a paper towel to the spot you'll be sticking it to- these suctions don't work at all on windows that are dirty or have something on them.

It sticks perfectly on my clean window and does it's job!

title: Great value
text: Very cute stickers. I love that there are lots of different styles of art too. Definitely something for every animal lover in this pack. And there are so many, I definitely have lots extra to give away to friends. These stickers were really nice quality, and a good size as well.

title: This is the fan you need!!!
text: I recently got a similar one like this but the 2nd fan was a light. It was neat but the battery life didn't last long enough and when charging you could only use low mode. SO I get this and find out today that you can kick it into full speed while it's charging! Charge time doesn't take that long either. Both fans pump a really good amount of air out and they work great for when I've been moving around doing things that overheat me. These cool me down quickly! I often get migraines and somehow find the cool air on the top of my head feels good so I have one of the fans from this pointed at the top of my head and it does a great job keeping it nice and cool!

title: Literally says in the title that it includes the ring
text:
I'm attaching a screenshot of the current listing in case the listing gets changed but currently it says includes metal ring (mine did NOT include it.) This things worthless for me without that ring as my tablet certainly didn't come with one.

The stand itself seems cheap. I just threw it in the trash since I have no use for the thing now.

title: NEARLY perfect! The volume keys are kinda hard to press because they don't stick out far.
text: I have to kind of dig my nail into the volume key pretty much to get them to work as they're very flat. Other than that- the rest of the buttons work flawlessly and this is pretty much a clone of the original remote but with a few flatter buttons. The wheel and air mouse works perfectly. Didn't have to do any programming with my 70 inch LG 70UN7370PUC tv, it just paired with it after a couple tries and was ready to go! Considering the features on this remote, I think the price is pretty good. The volume buttons aren't a deal breaker, just could be a little more pronounced so they're easier to press is all.

title: Only thing premium here is the price point
text: These don't have a great fit and the audio level/quality isn't great. For the $100 price point, I'd 100% feel ripped off. These perform more like some $20-30 headphones. The colors are cute but it ends there really.

title: Decent quality dash cam. Has to be slid into it's holder thing to work...
text:
I got this thinking I could possibly just hang it on a lanyard as a body cam as it's much cheaper and seemingly better quality than most body cams out there. I saw it has the little eyelet on it and figured it'd be easy to hang from my neck but sadly this won't function without being slid into it's base part. It makes it a bit bulky to carry for what I needed. Not impossible but I wish there was an option to use it without the base part it slides into. If you want to carry it with you- you'll pretty much have to get an action cam mount and attach this to it.

All of that being said, the picture is pretty good on this, setup was easy, I can make out car tag numbers as they go by so it focuses pretty well. No other complaints on it other than it has to be in it's thing to work, other than that it's perfect and I love it!

title: Really cool projector but you really need to mount it for your safety
text:
This thing is amazing and produces a really cool image but if you're holding it in your hand, the fan is fast and powerful enough that it's scary. I think it'd really hurt if you got your hand in it so I don't think this is a good toy for small kids who don't know how to be safe around things. I'm afraid it might break a small hand if one got caught in this, it truly is powerful!

That being said, it makes a great image and is meant to be mounted, not held. Keep that in mind and this thing is perfect!

title: Easy to setup and use
text: This camera was easy to install since you don't run power to it. It's easy to use the app. Picture quality is fairly decent. No real complaints on this at all. Works great for places where electricity is hard to run there.

title: Plug n play, very easy to use for a first timer!
text:
The price of these seems bloated and seems like these should be a bit less but other than that, I love these! If one was on a budget then I suppose VR goggles you just slide your phone into would give you the same effect as these. These don't take up much space though and would be great for something like an airplane instead of having to have a giant laptop out the whole time and your neighbor judging you for watching a horror movie on the plane. I get bored easily and even a 2 or 3 hour flight could be made so much better by watching a movie so these little glasses are my best friend! You can plug the usb c into your phone and into these and you get instant mirroring without any apps even! I went to some VR videos and you can look up and down and turn around in a room and see all around it- it's really neat!

Honestly I don't know the full potential to use these for gaming or whatever but for streaming video, they work great and have a great picture! I've even used them in bed and they light up the room a little less than my phone screen so don't disturb my boyfriend as much.

If you're worried about someone seeing what you're watching from the front (they used see thru lenses for some reason)- I suppose you could put some sort of darkening tent or something on the outside and it'd keep people from seeing what you are watching.

I was truly blown away at how quickly I got these up and going without having read any instructions or having ever had anything like this previously. I do absolutely love them but again- the price point for what they are seems a bit insane.

title: Feel kinda ripped off for the price point honestly, smaller speakers put out more sound than this
text: I have a handful of off brand cylinder shaped bluetooth speakers that put off a good amount of sound and even the cheap ones have a decent amount of bass to them. This didn't seem to put out nearly as much sound or bass as my smaller cheaper speakers that are in the $50 price point. I don't recommend this one at all, save your money and buy a cheapo bluetooth speaker! I think half of the problem is the design of this one, it just has small sections where it lets sound out rather than letting the sound out all around it. It's just strange honestly. I wanted to love it but I'm not impressed at all.

title: Great way to make your own smart house or add computers around the house or shop easily
text:
I have a few of these little things around so I can have one in my workout room, one in my wood shop, kitchen, living room- I just put them everywhere so I always have a computer handy without lugging a laptop around. Might not make sense to some but that's my reason for loving these little things- it makes it affordable to put multiple computers in the house.

Functionality wise- this works really well and doesn't have any lag when streaming tv or anything like that. It's a great little computer for streaming/ surfing the net. It obviously doesn't have the requirements for hardcore online gaming but for other basic uses- it pretty much does it all! Love this little computer!

title: Decent for the price, some buttons you have to press more than once
text: This works ok for the price point. When typing on the keyboard a name of a movie to search, it often skips letters and I have to push them more than once. Even with that it's still a time saver so I'm not mad. Decent budget remote.

title: Nice system, comes with everything you need but a monitor!
text:
This is a decently put-together system and comes with all the cords, dvr (with hard drive), 4 cameras (you can add 4 more cameras on, can even be another brand- just has to have the same connections), and it has a mouse. All you need is a monitor and it gives you the option to connect an old school vga monitor or an hdmi one. You can often find flat panel monitors at thrift shops or the marketplace super cheap if you're trying to stick with a budget.

Setup was super easy, each camera comes with a sticker template to put onto the surface so you can line it up how you want and drill any necessary holes for the cables and such. The system is pretty plug n play, easy to setup. The cameras have like a very sturdy steel metal housing which is very nice. One complaint is that like many- they put it together on the end and the end piece (that's black) is a separate/ joined together piece. So that has the ability to open the camera up to moisture/ water leaking in. Sadly most cameras have this in some form or fashion. Ways to make your camera last longer would be to install them under a awning if you have one or if you are installing near a garage, install it in the recessed part of your garage door so it acts as a mini awning for the camera. Beware of leaky gutters outside that drip or pour a lot of water- that'll ruin about any of these cameras quick. You COULD put a small bead of silicone or even some clear outdoor rated tape along the seam on the cameras to help keep moisture out but it's something you'd have to keep up with and replace as necessary- sadly no tape or silicone will provide a permanent seal and nothing will in the elements outside. Don't be deterred by this and go with a different brand, sadly this is a flaw of all outdoor cameras I've ever tested. Just beware and plan accordingly to keep them lasting as long as possible. That being said, I love the sturdy steel housing on these cameras. The picture they provide is crisp and clear- sooo much better than any of those surveillance pictures you see that people post online asking if you've seen this person (and you can't really see them because it's terrible quality.) This system gives you a pretty clear picture and for the price point, I'm very impressed! Even it's night vision is very usable and nice. I'll be looking for some pan/tilt cameras to try and hook into this system so I can utilize all 8 slots on it. A lot of people are fine with 4 cameras of course, I just like to be extra. I also love to be able to follow someone on camera and these cameras are fixed so you can't really turn them to look at people so I'd recommend adding pan/tilt cameras to this system.

The dvr drive is very lightweight and it records your video directly to it and you can access it from the drive directly with a monitor or you can use their app and access it thru your phone from anywhere. You can also view live streams from anywhere to check on your house, pets, kids, etc. The one thing I've got to say is just like with any system- if you're a cheapskate and don't pay for the subscription service, just beware that you really need to hide your dvr somewhere and at the same time allow for ventilation so it won't overheat. (don't stuff it in a small enclosed space) You could put it in a sturdy safe and mount that to a wall or floor but heat is still an issue, you'd need to drill or cut out some ventilation holes in the top (since heat rises) and that will allow heat to escape from the safe so it doesn't overheat your dvr.

Overall for less than a $200 price point, I am very happy and impressed with what you get and the quality of the picture it provides. Highly recommend this system.

title: Works- not bad for the price at all!
text:
So it's cheaper and when you record audio- it's not going to be crystal clear and you'll hear some static probably. It's clear enough that you can make out what it's saying without difficulty though. For the price point, I honestly can't complain. The remote works perfectly, it was easy to record my own audio, and the sensor works well. Speaker gets plenty loud and has adjustable volume which is nice.

If you're planning on using this as a prank thing- FYI it has a little red light that stays on even when it's turned off. (that ones kind of dim though) But when it's tripped by motion- it has like four bright led lights on it that flash as the audio goes off so unless you knew how to open this up and remove those or you maybe painted the red face of this to cover the leds, it's gonna not work so well to be a hidden prank box.

title: Easy setup, great speeds!
text: My desktop was being laggy on the internet and I've tried EVERYTHING but a new internet card. I previously had a cat 5 cable running from my router from across the house and the cords still in perfect shape so I suspect it was my internet card on the computer and grabbed this tp link wireless thing. I plugged it in and ran it's driver and really quickly my computer showed a "Wi-Fi 2" option and said TP Link on that so I chose that option and now my internet is running much more smoothly! I think it's silly that a wireless thing is running better than a cat 5 cable connection but it absolutely is! I have gigabit internet and this thing gets the internet to my computer at the same speeds as the cable did which is really good! Very happy with this! It's smaller too so doesn't take up much space.

title: Plug n play and works well!
text: I've had some really expensive web cams but love this brand so figured I'd try this one out. For the price point, I'm very impressed! I love the physical privacy shutter in the end you can close so you know no one's watching you when you're not using it. The picture it produces is very clear and usable. Highly recommend this if this is your price range! There are some higher end cameras that will give you 4k and do a lot more but for the typical person, this webcam is more than enough!

title: Neat low profile mouse, works well! USB thing is a little too snug though...
text:
I'm using this with the Acer Vero laptop and it works perfectly. The track wheel works pretty well but it's kind of like driving an old truck with very loose-feeling steering. It works, it just spins fairly freely so it feels strange at first. I like it though! The optical on this works well, I'm using my laptop's sleeve as a mouse pad and it works great!

Taking away one star because the usb dongle on this has WAY too tight of a fit! I can't even get it into one of the laptop's usb ports and it's a matching branded Acer Vero laptop, same color and everything! But I put it in a port on the left side and had to nudge it in a bit harder than anything else and it went in. I tested it in various other usb ports around my house and in ALL of them it's a very snug fit and in some, it's hard to push it in. The dongle itself isn't bent or anything so the only thing I can think of is poor design.

Other than the dongle issue, this is one of my favorite wireless mice I've had! It has a low profile and feels very natural in my hand. I would just use the trackpad on the laptop but it doesn't have physical click buttons, you have to push the trackpad down in the corners to click- I really don't like that. So this mouse fixes that for me.

title: Easy to assemble and really nice!! You'll need power bank for selfie ring
text:
[[VIDEOID:1f63ad9bf831df9a7540879ecc1d7d0c]] I've attached a video showing what it looks like in operation. The ring light is very bright and works great (have it off in the video as my power bank died) This needs a power bank for the selfie ring, it's not included.
Set-up was super easy, screwed in the feet on the bottom - you can raise or lower each of them to level the machine. The led strip was easy to stick on and looks nice. Then you'll slide the fork part into the side and secure it with two screw things that are already attached. Then you screw on the stick that holds the selfie ring on top of that. I installed a couple of the phone holders, I put my power bank in one of the slots and connected the selfie ring light. Plugged the power into the base and plugged the leds in. That's when I powered it up and got it going like you can see in the video. The part that surprised me most is the gears on this are made of metal, not cheap plastic. Looking in my picture, you can see the huge silver metal gear, this machine wasn't made cheaply at all!

Overall, this was super easy to set up and use, I'm very happy about it! Great quality and lots of fun! Highly recommend this!

title: EASY to setup,  very professional quality screen!!
text:
FYI this thing is like 7 1/2 feet from side to side on the metal frame... It's BIG. It's not overly heavy, I have a bad back and can lift it with ease. It's very easy to setup and it's absolutely a professional quality screen that I could see people using for a business meeting. It could be portable and transport fairly easy but If you have a regular car with no folding seats that let you use the trunk, I dunno if this would fit in your car so easily. Lucky for me I have a hatchback and it'll go in there easily.

The picture quality on this is really nice, it doesn't wash out like the cheap cloth ones when the light goes thru them. You COULD use it outside but I wouldn't do so unless the air was completely still or you have a way to anchor it somehow. If I were putting it next to a building, you might put some sort of hook on your building that you could then tie a rope to and tie it to this, like a tv's strap to keep them from tipping. Otherwise, if it's in the middle of an open area you could TRY to tie rope or paracord to it and stake it down. I'd try a "V" shape and do two stakes in front attached to the bottom of the tripod and then on the back I might attach the rope halfway up the pole and stake those two down behind it. Then just be careful that no one trips over the cord. (use brightly colored rope/ cord)

This is the best projector screen I've come across! For the price, it's completely worth it! I think because of the tripod legs that a lot of people wouldn't wanna keep this up full time in their house, for that you could just attach one to the wall possibly. That being said- the tripod legs don't actually stick out too far so they don't pose a huge tripping hazard.

title: Nice laptop but read my review first-
text:
SO this has an IPS monitor which gives you higher definition and clarity than an LED monitor. But also it uses more energy and these types of monitors are known for heating up and overheating which can cause premature failure. To further add to this issue, some genius put its heat fan pointed RIGHT at the front of the monitor. I've never seen this in a laptop and don't understand why they couldn't vent it out the side or even reposition the monitor slightly so they could vent the heat out the back. I'm really hoping that the heat blowing onto the monitor that's already known for heat issues isn't gonna be an issue. Within a few short minutes of regular browsing, its fan is blowing non-stop and the bottom part of the actual computer screen is getting hot because of the exhaust fan.

Other than the screen and heat issue, the laptop seems to be nicely made. It only took a couple of minutes to setup and streams videos/ surfs the net flawlessly when paired with my gigabit internet. It's not slow at all- loads programs quickly and loads web pages quickly.

I think it's a good computer overall and they're on the right track with this one. It looks really cool and runs great! The thing that I love about it's finish is it's not glossy- those always scratch up and look junky quickly. The finish on this one will stay looking great for years I'm sure!

title: Great quality cord, works perfectly!
text: This cord looks nice and works perfectly! I can charge my phone a lot quicker than my old cord with this new one! And the fact that the end bends is really cool! Seems to be pretty good quality.

title: Really nice touchscreen, works great!

It works perfectly for that and with it being a touchscreen- I don't need a mouse. The touchscreen is very responsive and works well. The picture quality is pretty good. For the price point, I'm very happy with this!

title: Didn't work out for us, buggy

title: Works perfectly!

title: Decent turntable but there are cheaper ones that are better.

title: Absolutely love this mini pc!
text: Hooked this up in the kitchen to watch TV and do recipes and such on while in the kitchen. Mounted it on the wall and it takes up no room at all! Works perfectly to steam tv and surf the net, have had no issues with any of that! Highly recommend!

title: Decent quality pi box

title: Good budget monitor, picture is so so

title: Easy enough to setup and use, picture quality is decent
text: Picture quality is decent on this. It was easy to setup and easy to use. No complaints, just a regular dashcam. Seems decently made.

title: Great to have eyes on my dogs as they play outside!
text:
Picture quality is very usable and pretty clear. Very impressed with this cam for the price point!

I plugged this in on my back porch and now have eyes on the dogs when they're out playing in my huge yard. They play too rough and harass the neighbor sometimes by barking in his face while he's gardening so I got this so I can go out and tell them to behave when they're bugging him. It's been nice not having to get up to check on them since I got this!! I now just have the screen pulled up on my phone and watch them from there. The wyze app doesn't work on the computer typically but you can download a android emulator like Blue Stacks and it'll make it to where you can view your Wyze cams from your desktop or laptop.

title: Great priced frame, looks amazing!
text: This is a really good price for a 10" digital frame. It was easy to set up and easy to use. I added pictures with no problem and have it on display in my living room- the picture looks great! No problems with this one at all.

title: Love this digital frame!
text: This was very easy to set up and add pictures to and it absolutely looks amazing! I added my Mom's pictures to it and now I enjoy seeing her again every day! Absolutely love this frame!

title: Great digital picture frame!
text: Easy to setup, easy to add photos to. Picture looks great! No complaints at all with this one, definitely worth the asking price.

title: Great durable portable drive!

I hooked it up to a friend's tv and it worked great. Hooked it up to my projector and it worked great for that too. Definitely recommend this versatile heavy duty drive! The price point is very fair for what it is.

title: Very rugged professional portable drive
text: This is very rugged and heavy duty feeling for sure. It looks very business like too which I love.
