The price point for a durable external drive is absolutely worth it, highly recommend these!

title: BIG frame, love this!
text: This was easy to setup and it's a nice large frame. Very nice picture. All the features function like they should. Overall I'm very pleased with this digital frame and highly recommend it!

title: LOVE it!
text: I put this on the front porch to automate my Christmas lights last December and it did an amazing job! No more going out to plug in unplug lights for me! Was easy to set up the app and easy to set a schedule. I absolutely love this thing and will be buying one for each room now! No issues at all.

title: Easy enough to install. Works okay.
text: I've tried a few systems and this one was fairly easy to install compared to the others. Works as it should. Nothing super amazing but it does the job. Cameras have usable definition- you can make out faces with them. The alarm hasn't had any false alarms. Overall it's a good budget setup!

title: Paired instantly and works great!
text: Great value, well made, works perfectly! It setup instantly and paired with my phone right away. Sound thru this is flawless like I have a cord hooked directly into my car stereo- highly recommend this bluetooth adapter!

title: DRM crap, you can only use Dymo labels! Wished I'd known that before getting it...

title: Works as it should

title: Complete garbage. Barely booted up from the get go and apps close non stop.
text:
This thing froze twice on the first boot up and runs like junk afterwards. I have a policy not to get off brand tablets because they're always junk like this. Just trying to watch a YouTube video out of the box, it closes the app non stop. I did all of it's system and app updates, didn't help. I knew I was in for a ride when it arrived - they can't even spell tablet! 🤦🏻‍♂️🤦🏻‍♂️🤦🏻‍♂️ It says "Android Table" on the box. This tablet is just trash and reminded me of why I don't venture in off brand tablets. My advice is if you're looking for a good budget tablet, wait til Amazon has a sale on their Fire tablets. Then take that tablet and Google how to make it run android stuff. title: Just over a month and it's not keeping a charge at all. Replacement died in 6 months too.
text:

title: Former security person, I couldn't get this to pair or connect... This thing is ridiculous!
text:
I worked security for years and set up big cameras/ monitoring systems and a few alarms so I have experience with several brands and how to set up things like this. title: Super thin, lightweight, easy to see writing, love it!
text:
This writing tablet is very large in size which I LOVE, very thin, very lightweight. Nothing but happy with this! The writing shows up as bright green, almost neon looking! Very easy to read the writing. It has a sliding lock function that holds in place well so you don't accidentally erase your notes/ drawings. The erase button works just fine. Very easy to use, I love this thing!

The battery compartment is on the back and takes one little screw so it's not hard to access at all. Overall this is just a great writing tablet! This is like the 7th writing tablet I've gotten and by far this is my favorite!

title: Pretty good photo frame, super easy to use! Speakers are horrible and bad viewing angles.
text:
Very easy to use this- I set it up in like a minute without even reading the instructions thanks to the on screen prompts. It was very painless.

Picture quality is so so- it's decent looking but basically, you have to be standing somewhere in front of it to see full color- the image and color is distorted if you look at it from the side or any other angle. But other than that- it does look pretty good and the picture is very usable and nice looking.

Sound- it calls the speakers "loud speakers" but some videos I can BARELY hear sound, others I can hear it if everything around me is quiet and that's with the frame's volume turned up to max! Nothing "loud" about this and sadly it doesn't have bluetooth or amy sound output. I guess if you want sound, your best bet is the play music with some other device along with this.

Overall this is a fairly nice, easy-to-use frame. I loaded pictures and videos on it with ease. The speakers need major improvement. The only other complaint is the price point but these frames all seem to be higher priced than a tv which seems silly. You can get a 24 inch tv with a usb slot cheaper than this 15" screen and it'd probably have better picture. For the price, It should have much better viewing angles/ better video quality.

title: Amazing little speakers! Get really loud, extremely clear audio!
text:
These little speakers are a bit heavy because of the wood so they won't topple over like light speakers. The sound quality is phenomenal, VERY good sound. Plenty of bass and boom from them too! I have them hooked up to my jukebox and they truly upgraded my listening experience! The remote and Bluetooth functions all work perfectly!

Overall these are fantastic speakers and for the price point, I'm pretty surprised!! Didn't expect to love them this much!

title: Nearly flawless! Types very well! Holds a flawless connection to the computer, no cutting out!
text:
I'm a very fast typist so get angry when a keyboard can't keep up and quite often- a cordless keyboard can't keep up with fast-paced typing! This one can! I was very impressed by that and the fact that typing on it feels pretty natural!

The bad is that everything on the right is kind of jumbled together and there's no space around the arrows or enter key. Those keys also double as the page up and page down keys and they do work but the page scrolling that it gives is kind of jerky if you will. It jerks as it scrolls and it scrolls SLOWLY. I work from my pc and often I need to search thru hundreds of pages in a short amount of time. The included mouse works well but it's not great to scroll thru a lot of documents and my hand gets tired having to drag and drop the bar on the right... SO because of this sadly, I've gone back to my old keyboard which has the typical page up and down and it flawlessly scrolls up and down on a page VERY fast and without it jerking around while doing it. To some this might not matter and in that case- if you don't use the page up and down key then this keyboard is PERFECT. As I said the typing is natural. Very silent typing too which I LOVE.

The mouse works fairly well. I do a lot of work in bed so I use my sheet as a mousepad, the mouse has an issue with that sometimes and it's hard to get it to do what I want. I have noticed if I grab literally anything from a magazine to a pillow- it'll work as a mousepad though. Aside from that the mouse is great and works as it should!

Battery life- I've had the same set of cheap batteries in the keyboard and mouse for a week, they automatically shut off when not in use- no need to flip a switch! They seem very easy going on batteries because I use my computer for hours each day and after a month on some cheap batteries- that's impressive!

Wireless connectivity: I'm actually IMPRESSED. I have a pile of terrible wireless keyboards and as far as name brands go- Logitech has cornered the market on budget wireless keyboards it seems. That being said- I've yet to find a logitech keyboard that will keep a connection! They cut out non stop and miss key presses, it just makes the keyboards unusable! So I have a pile of their junk I need to donate... I've tried many other off brands and such and they all have the same issue, they cut out on and off and irritate me. This one triumphs over the others because the keyboard doesn't mess key presses even at a fast speed and that's certainly something!

At this price point, this set is 100% worth it! I think you'll be very impressed unless you need to use the page up and down buttons a lot!

A

title: Very impressive picture quality, microphones, speakers, and video cameras!
text:
Very impressed with all of it! The camera gives a very good clear image, the microphone picks up my voice very clearly, the speakers are very clear with no distortion, and the image quality of the monitor is fantastic! For what you get and the price point, this is actually pretty impressive! This saves a bunch of space and cleans up my area to have built in speakers, webcam, and microphone!

I used this on a zoom meeting and a skype call- worked perfectly for both of those! I'm no tech genius so don't know all of the various specs on this but I can say as a regular consumer, this thing is really nice and well built!

title: Pretty good power supply!
text: Easy to set this up and it worked great the few times we've lost power! No complaints at all, works as well as my name brand one and comes in at a cheaper price point.

title: Beautiful picture! Love this tv!
text: Put this on my dining room wall and it looks fantastic! Very good vivid image, very state of the art tv! Speakers are plenty loud- don't need a soundbar even! I can't tell you about all of the features on it but it has a ton of amazing cutting edge features and for the picture you get- the price point isn't bad at all! I highly recommend this one!

title: Easy to set up, really nice!
text: Easy to set up screen! Setup didn't take long at all and we were off to watching movies! We've used this multiple times now and love it! Very good quality item. Blower isn't too loud as you put it behind the screen away from you.

title: Great quality binoculars at a fair price
text: These are pretty good quality binoculars for the price point! I was very surprised at how nice these are! Very clear image!

title: Beautiful backdrop- makes for a nice wall mural too!
text: Really good print job on this, it isn't pixelated like some of the backdrops I've seen. The ink color is vivid and looks great! It's so beautiful I put it up and am using it as a mural in my living room! Love this!

title: HUGE screen, snapping fabric on was a bit of a nightmare and not a one person job
text:
Putting the frame together was pretty easy. It's aluminum so it's lightweight but it's very thick aluminum so it'll hold up just fine! Once I had the frame up and staked it down, I set to snapping the screen on and I'd get part of it done and then move on and then the part I just worked on would unsnap! It was a living nightmare! I eventually had to call a couple of the other campers in the group over and they helped hold it together as I snapped the rest of it. Once it was all snapped together it was pretty sturdy and looks amazing! Picture quality on this is terrific- I love it!

I definitely recommend the screen on a level surface, it'll make it go on there much better. You can then get another person to help carry it to the area in the grass or whatever that you want it in and stake it down if need be. It stands up great on it's own but if you have wind coming you'll wanna stake it.

Overall I'm happy with this! Very large and amazing!

title: Great little compact drive!
text: Blown away at how compact and lightweight this is and how much info it can carry! Very happy with this! Very well made and works perfectly! I've put a few movies on it and it stores and plays them perfectly!

title: A complex work of art!
text: I've never had a gimbal so this has been a learning experience for me! Had to learn how to use it and set it up but once I did- this things great! It's very well made and is a complex amazing little device! It does exactly what it should and it's movements are insanely smooth, I'm truly impressed with this! Definitely worth the price they're asking for it! As with any fine tuned piece of equipment- handle it with kid gloves, it's well made but like cameras, very fragile feeling too!

title: Great budget charger, works like the original
text: This works just like my original charger that came with my laptop and seems to be really well made! Charges the battery in a reasonable amount of time and then stops charging when it's charged. Does what it should!

title: Works great!
text: My last charger got eaten by the cat so I grabbed this one and it works just as good as the one that came with my Dell! Charges it up at a good amount of time and stops when it's done charging. Works as it should and seems to be well made.

title: Best budget brand batteries around!
text:
Very good quality battery kit! All of the batteries work perfectly and the charger does a great job at charging them! Highly recommend these batteries as you cannot beat them for the price!

I did a lot of research a while back before buying rechargeables to put into my expensive electronics and EBL is listed as one of the top budget rechargeable batteries so I grabbed several quite a while back and regular batteries would have died and started leaking in this amount of time but the EBL batteries just need a recharging and I've not had a single one leak or a single dud!

title: Pretty decent headphones! Great for their price range!
text:
These fit well and feel good on my head. I love that they're wireless and I am no longer bound to cords. They connect and stay connected to my computer's bluetooth, my phone, my tablet, and my tv with no problem. Audio is great for all of these devices from music to television, audio is all very clear! Noise cancellation works great on these, I love to put them on sometimes just to drown out any noise and clear my head. The bass on these is fair, it's not as booming as some more expensive headphones but it has a fair amount. Personally I don't want a lot of bass in my ears as too much of that can be bad for your hearing.

These are the most premium headphones I've owned and I love them! If you compare these to really high end headphones- you'll be disappointed all around. But if you look at the price point and what you get- you'll treasure these. For the price point you can't beat these in my opinion!

title: Great camera housing
text: This works perfectly to protect my wyze cam! No complaints at all- well made sturdy product.

title: My favorite soundbar!
text:
I've tested a few soundbars for Amazon and this by far is my favorite! I'm actually giving away my old ones and putting this one front and center with my 65" tv permanently! Very impressed!

For music- it definitely gets PLENTY loud. It has a little bit of a thump to it bass wise, about what you'd expect from a soundbar. Not going to vibrate your walls off but not extremely weak. You can feel the little speakers pumping air out if you put your hand in front of them which is pretty cool!

For tv- it had me put the headset thing on and move around the room to calibrate it. I did this and then watched a couple movies. VERY impressed with this for watching movies too!

Overall this is just a fantastic bar!! I don't want speakers all over my living room taking up space and junking up the place so I wanted one nice soundbar and this certainly fits the bill for that! It's a very sleek looking long soundbar that gets as loud as I'd ever need it to and gives me a good clear quality audio. My only room for improvement would be to offer a matte finish, I hate the glossy top as it'll show scratches later. My easy workaround? Just get a roll of good quality vinyl in your choice of color and carefully cut it to fit! We did this and now we have a neon green topped bose soundbar! Love it!

Definitely grab this soundbar and give it a try!

title: Great quality crystal ball and stand!
text: I LOVE this! The ball and the base are both glass. The lights on this make it look very magical- this makes an amazing decoration! The size of this is decent, not too large but not a tiny little one like some. I think this is a good mid sized crystal ball. LOVE it!! The only thing I'd love to see is if it had a usb power option, I hate having to buy batteries.

title: Great quality backdrop at a fair price
text: The price point on this is pretty reasonable for the quality you get, I'm super happy with this! I hung it up behind my bed as a decoration but plan on moving it to the living room for the Halloween party so we can use it as a photo backdrop for guests! We've snapped a few photos in front of it and they look great! Very happy with this backdrop!

title: Really good printing job on this backdrop!
text: They did a flawless print job on this background- no pixelation or messed up colors at all. Background is great quality and will be amazing for using as a backdrop at parties. Honestly I love it so much that I'm sewing it onto a giant blackout curtain and using this to cover the huge window in my living room. It'll block the light without making the space look any smaller. It'll be a nice improvement for my living room and double as a fun party backdrop for people to take pictures in front of! Love this!

title: Love it!!
text:
If comparing this to a $2,000 projector, no it won't match up to that of course. But if you're looking for a budget projector with really good picture- this is it! I gave it 5 stars not because it's as good as high end projectors but because it's an amazing budget projector with pretty good quality picture for the price! Very impressed with this for the price point!

Good quality projector that works really well, has built in speakers but as with any of them, I'd recommend using external speakers- you just really get a better experience. Don't have to be high end speakers, any will work. But the built in ones do a decent job if you're not needing louder audio for a group of people.

Overall I'm just really impressed with this for the price point and happy with all of it's functions and features! No problem setting it up and it works very well!

title: Good budget splitter
text: Very good price point on this splitter and it works perfectly! I hooked it to my computer so I can run 4 monitors from the one computer and it works great for that! Highly recommend!

title: Does what it should!
text: This was very easy to cut to size and cover my cords with it. Very easy to install and looks nice! I painted over it to match the wall so it didn't stand out being white. Looks fantastic and is holding up perfectly!

title: Love this little drive!
text: Works perfectly! Very portable, lightweight, and it works great with chromebooks in case you're wondering! I hooked it to mine and watch movies at work with it. Much lighter than lugging a big laptop around! Definitely recommend this!

title: Very impressed for the price!!
text:
I can see the screen just fine on this and it's features all seem to be working just fine! The RPMS and speed match up with my car just fine. They have a slight delay which makes it almost not look accurate but it catches up in like a second. I'm honestly very surprised how well this works for the price point! I have a bare bones car and it doesn't display the temp of it which I HATE because I wouldn't know it was overheating until it was too late. The temp on this shows up and seems pretty accurate! It showed 120 degrees when I started it on a 101 degree day so that seems right considering it was sitting in the sun and very hot.

Overall very happy with this. Sadly didn't include the 3M tape they were supposed to but I decided I wanted to try my luck with velcro anyways so I can remove it if I want/ need to. Now just have to figure out what to do with the cord!

title: Works as it should for my windows pc
text: Hooked it up to my desktop and it works perfectly! Had no problem storing things to it and accessing them. Very nice little drive!

title: Great adapter kit!
text: Works perfectly for keeping my arlo charged so I don't have to charge it all the time! I just wish they made one for my Arlo doorbell because I'm forever having to charge it! Definitely recommend this!

title: Decent cheaper camera
text: It works and everything on it is just ok quality. It feels like something you'd buy at the dollar store, it's so light and cheap looking. I don't expect it to last forever but if you need a cheap camera for now, it'll work.

title: Great value alarm set
text: Once it's set up it works great! There's a bit of a learning curve to it and it'll take some time setting up all of the actions and how you want it to run but it's nice having the options to set it up like what YOU want and not just having a generic programmed one that doesn't do anything you want. Once I got all of the actions set up and everything, we've been very pleased with this! No false alarms and it's behaving like it should! Very good value for what you get!

title: Where have you been all my life!
text:
I have a 2012 Nissan Versa with a cd player and a AUX inplut is all... No bluetooth for the music and I'm tied down to using a cord. So when this came today I instantly plugged it into the car, pushed it's on button, paired it, and it works flawlessly! For the size and price I didn't know what to think but I'm genuinely surprised and very happy with this! I also plugged this into the AUX port of my jukebox and now I can play songs on my jukebox thru my phone and not have to leave the phone by the jukebox like I did before with a AUX cord! Definitely a game changer!

Sound quality is flawless, no static or anything. Battery life must be just fine- I haven't had it die after a day of playing with it! It does come with a charging cord and works while being charged so my advice to you is to make sure you have a wall plug or car charger for it (depending on where you're gonna use it) and have that ready for a backup so you can keep the music going or just charge it when it needs it!

SO no complaints at all here! This is just day one so if I have any problems in the future- I'll update this review. Hope you found this helpful!

title: Great portable speaker!
text: I love that I can just hook this in the shower and listen to music in there! Volume gets PLENTY loud, clarity is good. Size is comparable to an echo dot.  Quality of this overall is great! Highly recommend this one!

title: Arlo is premium priced garbage, grab a Wyze at a fraction of the price
text:
So the picture on these cameras is AWFUL. The app is extremely slow to load and it's a crappy app- you can't record video or get video clips even without paying for a subscription. So without paying a monthly fee, literally all you can get is the ability to se a live stream. And even that is awful due to the SLOW loading app and horrible quality image.

In comparison- you can grab a Wyze at a fraction of the price and they record in amazing detail. Plus their app loads instantly, records video clips and puts them into the app (for free) AND you can put a micro sd card into them so you can record events without subscribing to their service. You can access these files from the app even- it's extremely convenient!

Even for what I pay in taxes on these Arlo cameras, I'm extremely disappointed because they're taxed at such a high rate that I could have outright bought Wyze cams and I'd have had much more usable cameras. As is I've ditched the Arlo doorbell camera and put a Wyze one in it's place. I also ordered an outdoor Wyze rechargeable camera to replace this crappy Arlo spotlight model. You couldn't pay me enough to take another Arlo camera, they're horrible!

title: Easy to install, really good picture clarity
text: Much better clarity than any bank surveillance you've ever seen- you can actually see faces and such on these! This system was very easy to setup and is very easy to use. Seems very well made and I'm very happy with it overall! No complaints at all!!

title: Batteries worked in all the generic flashlights I had around...
text: I have a pile of little LED flashlights that take the 18650 batteries and these batteries all work perfectly in them! Nice to have extra batteries and the ability to charger multiples at a time! This all works great and is totally worth the asking price! Charger feels on the cheaper side but the batteries alone are worth the asking price so if the charger ever goes, I won't be too mad.

title: Pretty happy with this!
text: I am actually very happy with this! Very easy to set up and it even has a little built in bubble level so you know you have it set up level! It's legs are kind of on the thin size but even with a bulky projector and standing it in the grass- it's pretty sturdy! This thing was a lifesaver for outdoor movie night while camping!

title: Good deal!
text: Great deal for all that you get, you get every kind of mount that you could possibly ever want! I love this kit! Everything is decent and very usable quality, I'm happy with it at the price point for sure! My only tiny complaint is more about the storage bag, it comes with foam that has cut out slots in it... The foam smells absolutely revolting and chemical like- it caused my throat to swell and start hurting, the chemicals were just overwhelming. BUT that being said, I don't even need that foam! I just pulled the foam insert out and tossed the stinky thing in the trash outside and the bag works fine without it. I'd recently got a set of foam acoustic panels that had the same kind of foam and they had the same chemical smell which had the same effect on my throat and everything so apparently they're doing something to the foam or spraying it with something. It's not good though, I'd toss the foam if I were you! Once you do, the smell goes away and everything else is fine.

title: Pretty good sound bar!
text:
This is a good sound bar for a tv that is lacking sound. If you have a tv that already produces a loud enough sound that you can hear it well- this probably isn't for you as it won't fill the room with sound like a giant surround sound system and it really doesn't compliment a tv with already good speakers. But if you want this just to music in the kitchen or for a smaller tv, yeah it'd work great for that! I got it for a big tv that I could already hear on though and thought it would add some "boom" factor like a theater but was severely mistaken. Apparently that's just all sound bars as I've tried multiple ones now. They won't give you a theater booming sound or surround sound at all... But they're ok if you don't have super high standards.

Honestly I don't get the soundbar hype and would recommend a surround sound or a pair of larger speakers.

title: Good if you have a tv with bad speakers maybe
text: So the first flatter tvs had HORRIBLE speakers and thus the soundbar was born. The newer tvs however often have great speakers, much better than the soundbars you can add to them. I have a basic $700 LG 70" tv I got here on Amazon and their built in speakers are louder and better than this soundbar. SO I ditched the soundbar pretty quickly and went right back to the built in speakers. Kind of disappointed in this for the price point honestly, I remember buying giant stereos back in the day for cheaper than this that produced a lot more sound. I'd skip this one and go with some bigger speakers maybe if you need a decent amount of sound.

title: Beautiful laptop bag!!
text: LOVE this laptop bag! Love having a lock on my bag so I can lock up my laptop at work when I have to step away from it. This is very well made and great quality! Only room for improvement would be to offer more colors like neon green but the orange is still amazing!

title: Work great and love the adapters!
text: These work amazingly well! Hold a good charge! The adapters are absolute genius and a lifesaver!

title: This tablet is the worst! Skip it!
text:
This tablet was made with cheap software taken from a cheap cellphone. It literally thinks it's a cellphone with the way it works but yet there's no way to add a sim card sadly. That aside, there's a permanent developer tab STUCK on top that won't go away. It has some strange stats that I have no clue what they mean and nope it's not the date/time/notifications, it's an annoying bar that shouldn't be showing and must be a glitch. THEN the next fun part is it maps out your swiping so if you swipe right, it will draw a line with dots along it and LEAVE that on the screen. If you watch tiktok on it, you're gonna have several red lines from swiping and they just stay there til you tap the screen and then are replaced with an annoying red dot.

Other than that it does play youtube and Netflix fine. Just annoying because if you want to hold it to watch those, it makes you hold it to where it's buttons are on the bottom where you hold it and you'll randomly either lock the screen or adjust the volume. HATE IT. Volume wise- this thing gets plenty loud which is a surprise! Audio quality is meh but it's usable and doesn't sound just awful.

Overall I don't recommend it at all, there are much better tablets out there available at this price point like the Fire ones.

title: Works great, Very nice bluetooth adapter!
text: Very easy to setup and use. Very good quality product that delivers great sound from my phone to the car. I love that it has charging ports as my car only has the one plug in the middle. Overall I absolutely love this!

title: Brought bluetooth to my jukebox!
text: My jukebox has an AUX In so I hooked this to it and plugged it into the usb port to power it. Paired it with my phone and now I run music from my phone to the jukebox! Love it! Easy to setup and provides great quality audio! Highly recommend! Feels like a very sturdy well made product too, not cheap flimsy trash.

title: Works great!
text: Got a new phone that only has the usb c port so I grabbed this to be able to plug it into my car for music and it works perfectly! Great audio quality! Well made and nice looking cord.

title: Work very well
text: These work well and are an amazing value! Not photo quality inks but they work for most basic print jobs. Definitely recommend!

title: Great hub, works very well!
text: Plug and play usb hub, nothing amazing. Works like it should and seems well made.

title: Another product I'm throwing away sadly
text:
This thing is SUPER thin and small which is awesome- I LOVE that. The buttons sit very flush with the keyboard and I thought that was nice too but I'm thinking it's also part of it's problem, maybe it doesn't have room for the proper stuff that regular keys have. Half of the keys that you press don't register on the first press. I've gone back over those keys and if I press firmly and push them one at a time- they work. SO this keyboard could work for someone who isn't a fast typist. If you hunt and peck keys and push them one at a time, you might love this! But for anyone who learned to type at a decent pace, this poor cheap thing can't keep up.

I had high hopes but the bottom line is, this things trash.

title: Good laptop bag
text: Good basic budget laptop bag. Nothing special but it's well made and durable. The inside is soft and my laptop fits perfectly inside.

title: Fantastic budget Chromebook!
text:
Definitely don't get this if you need a laptop and you are expecting a computer with a Windows Operating System. This isn't that. Aside form that if you know what a Chromebook is and are seeking one- grab this! It's a great sized one and has a beautiful UHD display on it. It's no 4k screen but for the price, it's a good HD display. Screen is NOT a touchscreen.

Boots up quickly and runs smoothly. Is amazing for surfing the net and streaming things like Netflix and Hulu. Almost 14 hours of battery life, great standby time on the battery. Dual speakers that are plenty loud, I don't need external speakers at all to listen to music and watch Netflix.

Weighs just over 3 pounds, very lightweight Chromebook that isn't bulky at all. Usable standard webcam, nothing special, slightly grainy. Dual array microphones have good sound clarity for video calls. Has a great keyboard (not backlit), a great sized track pad that works fairly well but isn't built well enough to play anything like games.

Overall it's a great little Chromebook and you'll love it if you understand the limits of a Chromebook- what it can and can't do.

title: Beautiful tv at a good price!
text:
I love this tv, it is definitely a masterpiece! Very well made and fantastic quality. Deep blacks, vivid colors, natural skin tones...

Not the thinnest tv on the market but a great tv still! Easy to set up and get going. Slim feet that slide into place with no tools- only have ONE configuration. 2 USBs, 4 HDMIs, Ethernet, optical & headphone outputs, & a mini a/v input. Operating system is Google Tv which works smoothly and has lots of apps built in. Works with Google Home and Alexa.

Has some intrusive ads on the homepage. You can go into the settings/privacy/ ads to opt out of personalized ads though. You can use your remote microphone to do voice commands on the tv. It also has the nice shortcut buttons for Youtube, Netflix, Disney+, and Prime Video.

Sound has tweeters on the side. It upscales the audio to give you a surround sound effect. Acoustic auto calibration which when you go to your sitting area with the remote and start this- it sends these crazy alien laser blaster sounds out of the speakers for a couple seconds and your remote reads them so the tv can process the information and adjust your speakers accordingly. It will then adjust the speakers so it sends sound to where you're sitting to give you the best experience possible!

The cognitive processor in this puts more emphasis into the areas of the picture that you'll be focused on- definitely makes a noticeable difference!

XR TRILUMINOS PRO technology gives you better color accuracy and depth.

XR Contrast booster gives you better contrast.

Very deep blacks with very little light blooming (meaning it has very even brightness across the screen.) The screen has PLENTY of brightness, that is definitely not an issue with this tv!

Ambient optimization option which changes your screen based on the ambient lighting in the room. Controls brightness and color tones. There are settings to optimize the screen for Netflix, Imax, Cinema, Etc that are amazing!

Motion is great, it has 120 hertz which keeps up with the action very well! You can adjust the Motionflow settings to your custom settings or just set it to auto and let it do it's thing.

Comparing it to the other top Sony models:
If you're on a budget and this is on the higher end of that, you might look into the Sony X80J- it's also a 2021 model and is 4k Ultra HD. It's not quite as nice of a picture as this Full Array but it's still a great tv! Otherwise if you can swing it- this X90J Full Array is definitely a fantastic choice! If your budget can STILL swing more though, you might even look into the X90J OLED tv, it's picture pops even more than this Full Array. Whatever your choice, you'll love any of them! I have all 3 models and we absolutely love each and every one of them- the X80 and X90 line are just fantastic tvs at a really fair price point.

title: Pretty decent quality
text: Good quality when you realize your price point. This is a very affordable starter screen. It's great for taking camping, backyard films, or just people on a budget! It's a thin white fabric screen, not a thick canvas movie screen so if that's what you need or expect- this isn't for you. But if you want a lightweight affordable movie screen that works for movies then grab this! I took it camping and it was a big hit, worked out great!

title: Definitely the biggest bang for your buck if you're looking for an OLED tv!
text:
Beautiful true blacks and insanely lifelike vivid colors make the picture pop almost like it's 3D/ real life! Very impressive features jam packed into this! Sound is amazing- you won't need a soundbar at all. Super thin screen, the thickness of a folder. Screen has a nice metal edge which helps protect it. Setup was quick and easy. Very slim lightweight remote with nice shortcut buttons to all of your favorite streaming services. Apps load quickly and run smoothly in this tv.

Feet are easy to install, no tools or screws which is amazing. They can be attached to make your tv flat on the surface or raised so you can put a soundbar down. You can also put the feet closer together and further apart. Lots of options which is nice!

Some of the features I love on this are:
*The auto light sensor- it adjusts the screen brightness based on the lighting of the room. (this feature can be turned off of course)
*Acoustic auto calibration- you sit wherever (like on your couch) and it sends these loud sound blasts that sound like alien gun blasters. The blasts reach the mic in your remote where you are sitting and then the tv records the information and auto calibrates the sound so it reaches you better based on your room and where you're sitting.
*The speakers use vibration to turn the whole display into a loudspeaker- sending sound everywhere. Small subwoofers in the back to give it an extra bump of bass. You absolutely notice this technology working- the sound is amazing and PLENTY loud. You can always add surround sound if you have to have a deep boom of bass like in the movie theater though.
*XR Motion processing- means blur-free scenes. You can really notice this on things like watching sports from football to surfing.
*Upscaling is great. HDR is fantastic too- I really notice the differences in skin tones, they look a lot more natural on this tv. The XR processor really puts noticeable light into the highlights of the picture which really helps the image pop.

The bravia core seems more like a advertising gimmick, wasn't impressed with that at all.
That aside- this tv does definitely tout a lot of tech packed into one nice looking slim package! It has a TON of settings and customizations you can play with and set it up exactly like you want it! I've never seen so many different settings in a tv! No worries, if you don't want to customize, you certainly can just choose one of the standard programmed modes and the tv still produces a gorgeous picture!

CONS:
*The only ones I have noticed that might be a deal breaker are there is no functioning VRR and it only has two hdmi 2.1 ports which might mean that you won't want this if you're a gamer.
*Has a matte anti reflective coating which really doesn't do an amazing job at keeping reflections out of the tv like the coating they put on the 90J- that one does a better job. It doesn't make it unwatchable, it's just that sometimes you might notice a reflection in the tv in settings with windows nearby or a light fixture that shines near it.

Comparing this to the 90J I notice some other things:
The 80J doesn't have the heatsink in the back that the 90J does. This might become noticeable for gamers and is a letdown. The speakers are a little less powerful in this tv than the 90J, they sound good but don't have as much power. The 80J doesn't have the backlit Sony remote that the 80J has which is crazy and a replacement remote in case you're wondering costs a whopping $80!!

At $1300 less than the 90J, the decision for me is clear! I definitely say go with this 80J because the small improvements aren't worth paying the $1300 more. BUT if price isn't an issue- go for the 90J. I can tell you for sure, you'll be happy with either that you choose, they're both fantastic devices that are well built and jam packed with the latest tech and features.

title: Well made workstation, top of it's class! Thinnest smallest workstation on the market.
text:
Very sleek looking amazing machine! Powers on very quickly and runs flawlessly smooth no matter what demanding tasks I'm doing.

Looking at the outer case you'll see a metal shell on the top and bottom with a diamond cut polished edge that results in a stunning sturdy feeling shell! On the inside you see a very classy looking carbon fiber palm rest. You'll also notice they took out the 10 key pad to make room for big speaker panels on each side of the keyboard. The panel is so large because it has a speaker on top and a subwoofer on the bottom which makes for very impressive sound! You definitely won't need to tote around external speakers with this! You can however get a 10 key pad that hooks into one of the 4 usb- c ports. Those ports are all thunderbolt 3 ports which support full native 8k resolution (this is the smallest workstation on the market that has this feature.)

The screen is a gorgeous 17" touch screen UHD+ display that has hardware enabled blue light filtering that doesn't cause that ugly dimming or yellowing that others do. This keeps your graphics looking good while reducing the strain on your eyes and you will absolutely notice the difference! It drastically helps your eyes when you have to work many hours at a time without a break.

Supports Windows Hello so you can use a pin number, fingerprint, or your face to login. The power button in the upper right is unmarked due to it doubling as the fingerprint reader. The facial recognition works thru the IR camera and it can be set to lock your computer the second you walk away from it and unlock it when you come back. Amazing for shared work spaces where you're constantly having to get up and leave your computer- never have to worry about whether you locked it or not! The camera and microphone built in are impressive- I've done Skype video calls and Zoom meetings and gotten flawless results without even needing an external microphone! The camera produces a very smooth video feed that isn't ever choppy as long as you have a good reliable internet that's high speed.

If you're wondering about the price tag, it's because this isn't a laptop- it's workstation. This is more made for things like high end video work, medical imaging, architectural work, 3D CAD, graphic design, animation, AI, and VR (this is also the smallest workstation on the market that is VR capable.) As for video editing- I'm VERY impressed. You get very smooth playback while editing 4k videos and can do it in much less time than other workstations- extremely impressive!

If you're worried about it overheating while you're running more demanding tasks and multitasking- it has metal and copper channels inside of it that help the dual output fans cool it and push hot air thru the system and out the back which keeps this thing running cool! I've yet to see mine begin to overheat while I'm running demanding programs and really pushing it.

Working from home and on the go- this is absolutely your perfect solution and the best workstation on the market in my opinion! I'm just blown away by this impressive powerhouse of a workstation! Dell really took my breath away with how well built this is and how jam packed with tech it is. I could tell you about the tech in it all day long but I'll leave the rest for you to research on your own. It suffices to say- this is a workstation that can handle quite the work load and not begin to get weighed down in the process, total game changer!! This is definitely the one you've been looking for!

title: Vivid beautiful clear picture- amazing tv for the price!
text:
Beautiful bright, sharp, vivid picture from this tv! Has very deep nice blacks which is something I always look for. Google setup on this is easy and the A frame legs are easy to put on. Tv was pretty easy to wall mount and looks beautiful on the wall!

The sound is really good, I don't even need to use a soundbar with this tv! I love the acoustic auto calibration- you sit on the couch and start it- it blasts sound in several directions thru the speakers and the mic on your remote picks it up and adjusts the sound based on where you're sitting and what kind of room you're in. Another amazing sound feature is the bluetooth they added in on this one, you can use bluetooth headphones with this!

The motion on it is pretty decent, it has enhanced motion features you can turn on for say sports and gaming but for regular tv watching, you won't want them on. This tv can adjust the brightness based on the lighting in the room which is impressive.

Tv switches between apps and thru the apps extremely smoothly! Overall I think this is an amazing tv packed in at a really modest price that won't send you to the poor house! If you have a higher budget and want top of the line, check out Sony's 90J series which is a step up from the 80J. But on a budget- this tv will certainly make you happy, it's an amazing machine!

title: Great quality cord, works perfectly!
text: This cord is made really well and works perfectly! Very good craftsmanship! Fits nice and snug into the computer and works so I definitely recommend it!

title: Pretty good projector!
text:
I have had several low end projectors and figured this was just another one that was basically a $70 range projector but without even knowing the price point I would say this could easily retail for $150-$200! I was very surprised with the features on it and the picture quality is really good!

It was very easy to set up the screen mirror from my phone and I started streaming youtube from my phone to the projector within like 2 minutes of turning the projector on the for the first time! Very good picture and it has built in speakers that are decent. It doesn't get LOUD but it's build in speakers are usable without hooking up any external speakers. If you're doing an outdoor movie for a crowd- you'd wanna set up some sort of external speakers though, it's not loud enough for a big area.

Picture is very clear, color is decent. It's color doesn't "pop" like a higher end projector would (It's slightly washed out) But in the lower end projectors you really can't get a solid crisp color with any of them so at a lower price point, I wouldn't be complaining as when you turn the lens and focus the image, it provides a sharp picture with usable color.

Overall I say yes this is a great starter projector! If you're just getting it for kids, there are ones in the $70 range that might also work for your needs but if you want to use it for movie night or whatever, this works great too! Just don't get it expecting the same results of a more expensive projector. If you need high definition in video, you always have to pay the price!

title: LOVE this company, HATE these headphones!
text:
I got these in and LOVE how small they are! They go right in my ear and I connect them to my phone pretty easily. Then I start playing music and walk one room away from my phone in the house and it starts cutting out and disconnects completely. I walked like 5 or 7 feet away when it cut out. I then connected them again and put my phone on top of my car outside and walked about the same distance and it disconnected again. It has extremely short range.

SO I started carrying my phone to listen to music but then the problem is, these headphones fall out non stop and don't stay in my ears. Just problem after problem with these and I've never had a pair so awful! I've had dollar tree headphones I loved more than these!

title: Really good for the price
text:
Great projector for the price! You won't be able to watch it with the lights on of course but get this in a dark room and you have a pretty good usable picture! The colors aren't going to be as bright and vivid as the several hundred dollar projectors but for what you're paying, they're good.

This projector seems to be of decent quality and is working out great for our needs!

title: Great projector and I love that it comes with a case!
text:
I've gotten many projectors along the way and none of them have come with a case. I love this one for that! It holds it and protects it nicely. The projector itself is very nice looking and of great quality. For the price point, it's definitely worth it! The picture quality is great, much better than those cheaper ones you see at half this price. (The ones in the $50-$75 price range that use regular little halogen light bulbs in them) Those had me thinking I would have to spend hundreds to get a projector that you could actually SEE and get a nice clear picture. This projector gives you a good higher definition picture that is very impressive!

You'll really need to use this in a dark room and have no real hope of enjoying it in a lit/ brighter room. You can see it ok with the lights on but you can see it so much better in the dark. Projects well on a light colored wall and also does well on a projector screen. Highly recommend this projector!

title: Amazing for outdoor movie nights!
text:
We've been using this on a 150" outdoor movie screen and it looks amazing even at that size! The picture is very clear, colors are vivid, just an overall amazing picture! The sound in the speakers is great but if you need it louder you can hook up your own external speaker(s) via Bluetooth or a 3.5mm audio cable. We use Bluetooth to hook it up to a tailgating speaker so we can have sound as loud as it is at the theater.

Setup was extremely easy and the size is very portable. If anyone is wondering, sure this COULD replace a tv. Personally, I wouldn't as these look best in the dark. But if you had a dark room or got darkening curtains then sure you could replace your tv with this. This won't replace a fancy ultra HD tv of course but the picture quality is fantastic still. From what I've seen, for every inch you have it away from the wall you're projecting on, you'll have nearly that in screen size. So for a 100" screen, you'll need to space the projector back about 100" (give or take a few inches.)

I've reviewed several smaller projectors and this one is by far my favorite! You won't regret buying it! If this is the price range you're looking for- grab it!!

title: Don't have to be directly in front of it which is nice
text: I sit this way off to the side of my computer and when a friend calls on skype, I'll use this microphone while multitasking and they can hear me just fine no matter where I am in the room. Very nice microphone with very clear sound. NO complaints at all, very fair price, made very well!

title: Easy to set up and work flawlessly!
text: No more coming home to chewed up cords courtesy of the cats! These work great at clearing the clutter of the cords and keeping them out of easy reach of the evil cats that love eating them. Definitely recommend these cord covers!

title: Love this bluetooth set!!!
text: I initially got this to go with my new big screen tv but then quickly realized it's not really loud enough to be used for a tv. My tv is much louder than these. That being said, these are perfect for the computer and sound great!! I have my phone paired to them too so I can stream music from my phone whenever I want. So nice to be rid of all the extra cords! Love this set!

title: Works perfectly
text: Works perfectly and performs with great speeds! I feel like the price point is a little unnecessarily high but beyond the price, this works perfectly!

title: Great dashcam
text: I drive a little hatchback and this can't see out the back that well sadly. I think it's just the design and thru the people in the car and the seats, it just has a limited view. Other than that everything works as it should and it works great! The video it captures comes out really sharp and looks great! No manufacturing flaws I can see at all. Definitely recommend this one.

title: Great cable, works well.
text: Works great, very heavy duty which is perfect for what I needed!

title: Perfect for the price! Nice little projector that won't break the bank.
text:
I love this little projector because it's not giant and bulky. It's easy to set up and use. The picture on this is really good for what you pay, just know you'll need a dark room for the full effect! If you want a projector to use with the lights on then you're looking at spending hundreds and thousands. For most people this projector is more than enough! I'm actually surprised at how clear the picture is on this- it's nice!

We take ours camping and set a screen up and it's absolutely perfect for it! We have had people from other campsites show up and come watch a movie with us, it's really fun! Definitely recommend this if you're on a budget or looking for a portable projector that won't break the bank! As a bonus, if something happens to it while camping or something- at least you're not out several hundred or thousands of dollars on a more expensive projector!

title: Amazing sound quality but the size is humongous!
text:
SO first and foremost, they have the size clearly listed- it's on me for not looking at the dimensions. I honestly had no idea they had Bluetooth pieces this big though! It's genuinely bulkier than any headset I've used in the several call centers I've worked in and the only way to be able to semi comfortably use this is to use the piece that goes over your head and makes it a headset. Great for people on the road a lot/ truckers! But for the common person, this is wayyy too bulky and goofy looking.

Bulk aside- the sound quality is great. Cancellation of background noise works really well! Battery life is great. It's an amazing Bluetooth piece if you can get past the humongous size!

title: AMAZING sound quality but not a great bar for large tvs...
text:
Pairing my phone to this- absolutely makes for some quality audio! I love to use it while cleaning around the house and playing music as it's loud enough I can hear it throughout the house clearly. The sound clarity and quality is just fantastic! I might grab a 2nd one for my home gym out in my garage it's so great.

Not a good replacement for the factory speakers on my 70" tv though... With my tv, it's either factory speakers or the external surround sound or speaker bar. So I just paired this to the tv via Bluetooth and used it to watch tv with it and it was very one-directional for what it was. The audio from my tv does a better job at spreading itself out thru the room. NOW that being said, for a smaller tv this would work perfectly I think. Even if it doesn't work out for your tv, you have a fantastic soundbar for music!

title: Great drawing tablet
text: My first drawing tablet and I love it!  Compared to the pricing of other drawing tablets- this one is really reasonably priced. Everything on it works perfectly and is very responsive. This is a lot of fun to learn to use while drawing a graphic novel! Definitely recommend this! No complaints at all!

title: BEAUTIFUL picture- works great for a decoration too
text: I put this scene over my big bedroom window and it looks absolutely beautiful in my bedroom! This scene is just amazing! Very good quality, great picture!

title: Amazing sound quality, VERY nice earphones
text: These look amazing and come in a nice carry bag. I bring them to work to drown out other people who are loud and obnoxious and it does a perfect job of it! They're big enough to let people know I can't hear them so they leave me alone while I'm working which a nice bonus. These have an amazing sound quality and the battery life is pretty good. Overall I just REALLY love these!

title: Works flawlessly!
text:
I live in an area where the wind blows or we get a rainstorm and the power starts flickering so I got this for my computer and I absolutely LOVE it. It's done a fantastic job at keeping my computer on for a bit til the power comes back on and it keeps my computer from just shutting down when the power flickers.

This works flawlessly and I have zero complaints!

title: Decent low end projector
text:
Easy to use, pretty good sharp picture! Like any of these low end projectors- this will really only work in the dark. Beyond that the picture is pretty good and I'm still impressed with the quality of the image it projects! Upon turning it on and putting it where you want it- you turn the black dial that's by the projector lens and it adjusts the focus- really easy to focus!

SO if you've seen the $2,000 projectors- they project and look better than a lot of tvs! These lower end ones won't give you as bright and vivid as a picture as that. That being said, if this is your price point/ budget then go for it- it's still a really nice quality HD picture you get out of it! We got these to project outside for Halloween props and they work fantastic for that too!

title: Pretty decent camera
text:
Pretty decent camera that has several really nice features! Seems well made and looks nice. I love that it records when it senses motions and I also love that it can alert you of things like when it hears glass breaking!

The picture quality you get from this day and night is pretty good. I'm really satisfied with this camera but my big complaint would be that price point! There are cameras out there from other companies that you can get at a fraction of the price, like a small fraction! Cameras that do all the same things and have even better picture. So knowing this- that price point is insane! If they lowered the price to compete with others then I'd say it's worth it. As is, I think I'd skip this one.

title: Powerful great sounding little wireless speakers
text:
I was skeptical at first when I got these and saw their size but I plugged them in and paired them to my phone and played a few music videos and was blown away by the audio quality and also how loud these can get! For the price point, this is a STEAL and you absolutely won't find any better wireless speakers in this price range so definitely grab these, you'll love them!!!

We tried all of the features on the speakers and remote and everything works flawlessly. These speakers are well built and look really classy on my kitchen counter. This is easily one of my favorite items I've reviewed and I absolutely am in love with them! The sound quality is fantastic and everything is crisp and clear! I could not ask for more.

title: Amazing drawing tablet
text:
For the price point this thing is absolutely fantastic! I'm working on a couple graphic novels right now and this thing is amazing for them! Previously I thought a $2,000 or more drawing tablet is the only way to go but this one actually works very well and I'm thrilled!

Pen is very touch sensitive and easy to use, picture is crisp and clear, buttons are able to be customized to what you need. Overall I'm just thrilled with this and highly recommend it!

title: Very nice quality light weight set!
text:
I love how compact this set of lights is! Makes it so much portable for me when I'm traveling! They are small but mighty lights! Very bright and I love that they are adjustable on their brightness. The different color plastic sheets slide right over these and are easy to use if you want to add a color to the lights.

Overall I'm extremely impressed with the quality and portability of these and for the price point I absolutely recommend them!

title: Very well made sturdy tv mount
text: Very sturdy and heavy duty and the price point is definitely great. Pretty easy to assemble and mount the tv. Overall this is a great tv mount I definitely recommend! Get a stud finder and make sure you mount it to the studs or you'll regret it though.

title: Great little notepad
text: I love that this one has the attached stylus so I don't lose it! As for functionality- the tablet works flawlessly. It does everything it should and looks nice, definitely recommend.

title: Very heavy duty tv mount
text: Very heavy duty and has a great range of movement which are the two main things I look for in a tv wall mount. The price point isn't bad at all. Overall I definitely say this is a great mount and I recommend it!

title: Decent projector screen, price is kinda high
text: The price point is a little high for such a thin screen in my opinion. It's a decent screen but nothing that's amazing. For your money you can find better ones out there. This isn't the worst you can get but it's not the best.

title: Great little monitor with a good picture!
text: Got this one to use for a little tabletop arcade machine and it's picture is great! Tested for many hours and works flawlessly! Have no complaints at all! A feature I love is how adjustable the base is, you can adjust the height and tilt on it. For the price point, you won't beat it!

title: Great alternative to having intercoms hardwired into the house!
text:
We LOVE these as they saved us from paying hundreds to have intercoms wired into the walls! I've had surgeries and have health problems and this allows me to talk to someone and ask them to bring me a drink or call them if I need help getting up or anything of the sort. It's an absolute lifesaver and a great value!

It's easy to use even for those who are less tech savvy!

title: Works great!
text:
Works great and was easy to setup. The only "problem" I have is more of the design of my car. I drive a small Nissan Versa hatchback and the back window is kind of small so the rear camera really doesn't catch much in the way of what's behind us.

Aside from that this camera works great for us and is easy to use!

title: Amazing tablet for the price point!
text:
For the price you absolutely cannot beat this! It's not packed with a million features like some of the really expensive drawing tablets but it has enough features for many of us and is definitely a great product even without some of the extras.

Upon using this I can say it responds well to the stylus and touch. It has great vivid colors. It functions work as they should, I love the tilt feature on it! This thing has been a lot of fun to use on the graphic novel I'm working on!

Overall this is a great drawing tablet for beginners on up! I think if this is your price point you want to be in for a tablet then this is the one you need!

title: For the money there are better mini pcs
text:
I've tried several different mini pcs, chromebits, etc and this one's a dud. Did NOT like it at all. It seriously takes about 10-15 minutes just to power up (I've never heard of such a thing) and that's right out of the box. I thought maybe it was because of the initial boot and updates but nope it's kept doing that. So if you get this, I guess plan on leaving it on at all times or plan on turning it on many minutes before you need it.

It plays Netflix decently which is mainly what I got it for. I got it for recipes and Netflix while working in the kitchen and for those things, it works decently. Not a super-fast computer but works ok. Mainly that boot up is what kills it for me- I don't want a computer I have to leave on at all times.

Final thought- for the price point, there is absolutely many better mini pcs out there.

title: Very nice thin monitor!
text:
VERY nice looking super thin monitor that gives you a really good picture! I use this with a Chromebit hooked into it and it's like having a mini pc at work. Absolutely love this thing!!!

Love that it comes in a tablet sleeve but I hate that it doesn't stay standing up so well when you go to use its stand feature. If they fixed that one little flaw this thing would be perfect all around! I love this monitor!

title: Pretty good beginner video camera, can't beat the price point
text:
SO for the price you can't beat this! Is it a professional quality video camera? Not at all! That being said this is a great video camera for beginners who are just starting to learn how to do videos and how to do editing. The microphone included of course is NOT amazing but it will work for many. It is detachable so you could track down a better microphone if you wanted. Personally I don't see much of a point of having a beginner video camera and putting a premium mic on it though.

Video quality is pretty good, again nothing professional but it's decent. I think for many people this video camera is more than enough! So for the price point I definitely say to give it a try!

title: Really nice battery holder!
text: Very durable plastic and it holds a ton of batteries! You can fill both sides with batteries and it has the built-in tester so you can know which ones are low/ dead. Definitely love this case and recommend it!

title: Decent budget screen
text: I see no benefits of it being silver honestly but that being said I get a pretty good picture out of this screen. The big complaint I have is the creases, have fun trying to get those out! It's a thin movie screen you attach to the wall and the picture quality you get out of it pretty much depends on the quality of your projector and the level of light in the room. The price point isn't bad, it's a good budget screen.

title: Pretty good backup cam for the price!
text:
Honestly I am loving this for the listed price point! Setup was pretty easy and it functions as it should. Seems to be fairly well made especially considering you didn't pay several times more like you would if you bought something like this in a store.

Overall I think this is fantastic for the price and do recommend it!

title: Decent BASIC speakers, lights don't react to sound
text:
Decent little basic speakers, clear enough audio. Not amazing for music honestly, audio is kind of bad for that even if you aren't an audiophile. I don't expect the quality of high end speakers for this price point but it still should be noted that the audio from this isn't anything great.

The lights are neat but not sound reactive so they just slowly cycle thru the colors. I love that you can switch the lights off when you don't want to see them and love the volume control on the wire. Overall I liked these well enough, just not happy with them for playing music.

title: Plug n play, works flawlessly!
text: I didn't expect much for the price point but was pleasantly surprised when I hooked this into my mini computer and it now plays dvds! All I did was plug it in and it worked instantly even on a very basic computer. I definitely say this is a great value and a great lightweight item! Its feather light which is perfect for my computer bag.

title: For the price point, YES! This is the best pc I've ever had!
text:
I love this Acer so much! To anyone thinking the specs are wimpy, I'd say to them no for the price you're not getting a super gaming machine- you have to spend big bucks for that. But for the common person to play some average games and definitely for people just wanting to surf the net, watch youtube or Netflix- YES!

I use mine for surfing the web pretty much and I've never had a solid-state drive, the things are 100 % silent. The computer has a very smooth and quiet fan located on its main board that sometimes will kick on and if the room is dead silent you can hear it barely. So sound-wise it's fantastic. From the moment I push the power button, the computer turns on as quick as my monitor does! I feel like there's a sorcerer inside of my computer who turns it on so fast because in all my many years of owning computers, never have I ever seen one boot so fast! And in a busy world, slow booting computers is NOT something I have time to play with!

So beyond the lightning-fast bootup, it runs flawlessly! I hooked up a wireless mouse and keyboard set to it instead of the nice-looking wired set that comes with it. It handles the keyboard and mouse flawlessly. Honestly, I cannot think of a single bad thing to say about this pc! My last pc cost about $1,000 and had much crazier specs than this one but for the price point of this, I wish they would have had this Acer when I got my last desktop! Definitely get it, you will not regret it! I'm thinking of purchasing a 2nd one for my garage gym now so I can have access to all my music and everything easily. For the price point, why not?

title: Love it!
text:
So much nicer than the stand that comes with my tv! The reason I need this is ridiculous but my dogs love to stand up in front of the tv when I'm watching tv in bed and now I put my tv up higher so I don't miss anything when they stand up! I have it set up on it's highest adjustment and I was afraid it'd make my tv unstable but it still sits there really nicely and doesn't wobble at all! I think the heavy base is to thank for that.

What I LOVE: the ability for it to be adjusted to whatever height you want!
What I do NOT love: nothing! I love it all! Assembly took slightly longer than I wanted at the end when it came to line the tv up and attach it to the stand but the problem you have there is this is a universal stand and every tv has the screw holes set up differently, the back curves differently, etc. So remember that when you go to mount the tv, it may take a couple of adjustments to get it set up just right but you'll get there and you'll love the overall result once you get it put together! My tv looks so fancy now!

title: Actually better than big name brand wireless keyboards!
text: SO I have large dogs that trip over and destroy my keyboard cords- I HAVE to use wireless keyboards. Thru the years I've been thru many many different models mainly from one big-name brand competitor who's seemingly cornered the market in wireless keyboards. So how does this one compare to the big name ones?  A breath of fresh air in the wireless keyboard world let me tell ya!  This thing is plug n play and it stays connected, unlike my other keyboard sets that quite often froze up and missed keys I pressed. The keys are all easy to press and are smooth/ quiet when you press them. The mouse works flawlessly as well. Overall I say this set is many times better than the overpriced competition! I did get this keyboard for free in exchange for a review but for an unbiased opinion and my unbiased opinion is I really love this set and have been using it daily since I got it. I literally threw out my name brand set because I got tired of it locking up.  Give it a shot- you'll love it.

title: Region free DVD (not bluray player)
text:
This thing is so tiny, it's about the size of an external disk drive and it's so lightweight- Something I personally love. I love that I can now buy whatever DVD is cheapest online rather than just my region's DVD. It plays DVDS and music CDS but no Blu-rays of course. If you have a problem with yours being region free, look for another vine review on here, she included the instructions to set it up.

So it works great honestly and I am pleasantly surprised with this little thing for the price point. I highly recommend it and don't think you can find anything better at this price if you tried. Mine was indeed HDMI, apparently, there is an option for HDMI or RCA cables.

title: Amazing versatile bag
text:
For the price it's amazing! The inside part where your laptop goes is an extremely soft material so if you have a glossy laptop- it won't rub it and scratch it up like a cheap duffel bag material would. This bag can be slimmer or you can unzip it, it makes more space so you can carry your laptop and a book or so.

It has an awesome feature of the USB cord in the side so you can run an external battery inside of it and hang the charger out for your phone. It has many pockets and sturdy straps. Overall this things amazing and a great value for what it is! I definitely recommend it for anyone on the go as it will keep your laptop and belongings all together and give them lots of padding in the process.

title: Nice looking frame
text:
Nice looking frame. Sadly the speaker is lacking, you can barely hear any audio. It does have a headphone jack though so you could run that to an external speaker or stereo system. The whole package altogether is very nice looking, I love the presentation as well as the product!

The downside was it was hard to figure out how to connect the picture frame to the app! You simply give it a name and then it creates an email based on that. Then you can connect it to the app. The app doesn't see Google photos on Android and Google photos doesn't let me drag photos to a folder the app can see SO I'm left with using a SD card and saving them there or connecting the frame via the USB cord.

But once you get the hang of the picture frame, it's a good quality product! I just wish they'd make the app easier to use- setup shouldn't be this difficult.

title: Very sturdy little cord!
text: Very sturdy well built hdmi cord! Works great and looks good! Perfect for what I needed! Now I don't have to keep switching the one cable to multiple devices to use them. Personally I feel like this is the sturdiest hdmi cord I've seen and it'll last for a long time! I do recommend it fully!

title: Like your senile grandpa that refuses to wear a hearing aid...
text:
We have one of these in every room of the house and in the beginning, when we got them, things were okay, they worked decently. As months went on though, the crazy things got dumber and dumber! They can barely turn lights on or off and each time we ask them to turn a light on- she decides whether or not she likes your phrasing today. Today I can say "Alexa, turn on my bedroom light" and she'll do it but tomorrow I say the EXACT same phrase and she'll be like "There are no devices called MY." So then I have to get creative and say different phrases. Sometimes she won't turn the lights on at all though.

Then I can ask her things like what temperature is it in Enid and she literally told me yesterday "In Nepal Japan the temperature is..." She can't hear me half the time and we have to scream to get her attention and when she does pay attention, she hears the weirdest things ever! It's gotten WAY worse too.

Honestly, these have gotten to be about unusable and it was the biggest waste of money to fill my house with them. I love Amazon but I'm thinking about ditching these and going to Google Home devices.

title: Yes yes yes! Get it!
text:
We've gone thru several modems before getting here and I can tell ya for the price- this is your modem! We just upgraded to gigabit internet and had to change out our old cat5 cables and modem since neither support the speed. (Be sure to switch your cables if you are doing higher speeds and they're cat5! They say on the cable itself what it is. Go for a 5e or more)

But we got this modem going with the gigabit internet and new cables and our speeds went thru the roof and stay there consistently!

The BEST feature about this modem is when the internet goes off- it randomly cycles and searches for internet! So when you have an outage you no longer have to unplug and plug it back in non stop! Loveeeee this modem!

title: Listing is the wrong item...
text: I've ordered this twice and they just send the wrong item each time. This listing is for a different phone case, not the one in the picture.

title: Seems legit! Great for the price!
text:
Ran the program called H2testw that will write data onto the card and test to see if the card has any problems with it and also tells you for sure how much space is on the card. It came back good! I got the 32 GB card and it was indeed 32 GB. That being said I bought from Amazon direct... If you buy from someone else i'd definitely run it thru a program like that so you can know that you're getting what ya paid for.

And be sure to format it before you go to use it to the Fat32! It'll run great then!

title: LOVE this thing! Great size!
text: Very portable size that doesn't take up  lot of space! I had a pile of cards laying around I needed to put together in a folder on my desktop and this made it a breeze! So much better than a junky looking thing with a cord... I used it on my desktop but I imagine it'd be perfect to put in your computer bag for your laptop too! Definitely happy with this for the price! Very nice looking device too.

title: Excellent product.  Good quality!
text: Easy to install, amazing clarity and download speed!

title: Love it!
text: Very pleased with this case. It came earlier than expected, is well made, easy to put on the phone.

title: Excellent!!
text: This little box worked like a charm.  It was much less expensive than other streaming options.  It was easy to set up, and connected fast.  This has saved us a lot of money on cable.  No more Cable!!  With internet streaming to our TV have so many options available.  Very satisfied by the product.

title: Fairly hardy, entertainment for toddler
text: Our toddler hasn't broken this one yet(knock on wood).  It keeps her occupied during commuting.

title: Works well
text: Used to hold up wedding backdrop

title: A Novelty, fun, but so-so picture quality
text: I love the novelty of a 360 picture as it makes you feel like you are there.  The picture quality isnt the best, but I think it is as good as one might do without spending 400-500 bucks on something more fancy. Battery life is atrocious.  They need to work on that.

title: Works well
text: It works as advertised.  I dont have to see my hand holding the cam in my 360 photos anymore.

title: Fits perfectly
text: Good quality case to protect such a fragile camera lense

title: holds a lot
text: Great to store all those pics on my phone

title: Typing a breeze
text: This makes typing notes for work a lot faster. Setup was easy.  Needed to charge it prior to first use.  Only thing I see is that the metallic paint finish can be scratched after a while of usage from the keyboard compnent.

title: Five Stars
text: Finally enough room to go snap happy on my camera.

title: Fit several cables together and assembly was pretty easy. A great was to to keep prying ...
text: Fit several cables together and assembly was pretty easy.  A great was to to keep prying toddler hands away as well as clean up the aesthetics.

title: Four Stars
text: Cute while the pattern lasts.  But eventually it fades off.

title: Perfect - Loud & Easy to use
text: This product is as described. The sound is startling and loud. The end of the keychain does not pull out too easily, where you may accidentally pull it. I like the SOS button feature as well as the pull option. I bought one for myself and my teen daughter.

title: A Must for Kids
text: Bought this for my 6 year old. The FreeTime for kids is perfect...she has access to games, books, and videos. The case is great. The parental controls are a nice feature as well. We are pleased with the purchase, including the price.

title: Durable but smaller than expected.
text: Item was as described, well made and durable.  Just needed a bigger bag so I returned this one.

title: Quality product.
text: I can tell a positive difference between what the cable company gave me and this cable.  For the price, you cant go wrong.

title: Excellent product/results for a fraction of the price.
text: These filters are awesome.  PLEASE NOTE, YOU CAN NOT FOCUS ON PHOTOS CLOSE UP WITH THE 10X FILTER using the 18-55 lens.  However, ALL of the filters are great.  Quality made, durable and do exactly as advertised.  I even stacked the 2X and 4X and the clarity (focus) was magnificent.  And this was with a Canon T7.  You cannot go wrong with these filters especially for the price.

title: Great product at a great price!
text: Fixed the buffering that I was dealing with on my upstairs TV, so I'm a happy customer!  :0)

title: Ok but better are available complete
text: Shipped quickly and efficiently. Sound quality not the best and external power supply not included which is not a good idea. Complete packages are available for about the same price and with better quality sound

title: Not as good as expected
text: The unit arrived as expected installation seemed simple enough until apps were loaded. Numerous problems arose with app installation numerous calls for tech support was needed and updates required caused problems with operation

title: Poor quality material  and poor sound quality
text: Found this item to not be the quality expected low volume along with poor sound quality makes this item usable as a light but not as a quality speaker for extending tv sound

title: Great product very bad seller
text: This item is a great item to have for Rv travelers. Unfortunately the seller is a problem who feels they don’t have to abide by the Amazon promise of 2 day delivery which is definitely a bed way to do business. My recommendation is to get the product but stay far away from VM Express and purchase from a reliable seller

title: Works well in southern USA
