title: EXCELLENT SET OF WIRED HEADPHONES
text:
While I tend to use wireless headphones most of the time, there are times, such as when flying that I need wired headphones and these are AWESOME.

These headphones are equipped with an iPhone Lightning Connector which is the perfect size to fit through the opening in the case on my iPhone, it snaps into place without issue and provides a stable connection.

The noise cancelling feature works really well on these headphones. Noise cancelling is a complex process where a processor must detect ambient noise, both frequency and amplitude, through the microphone and then “block it” by creating an exactly opposite noise thus cancelling out the ambient noise. Some noises are more easily cancelled than others and some processors within headphones do a better job at cancelling than others. I have to say I am thoroughly impressed with the noise cancelling these headphones achieve.

The microphone picks up perfectly on calls in my tests the other person had no issues hearing me crystal clear.

title: IMPRESSIVE ROOM MONITORING CAMERA LAMP
text:
This new video camera lamp by Panasonic is really a quality product - outstanding camera, nice lamp, and great features seen in few other systems.

Set up was very easy requiring minimal effort - I just followed the enclosed directions and what the app said and breezed through putting it together and setting it up.

The HomeHawk App is easy to use and overall quite intuitive. I’ve had no problem figuring it out as I’ve worked my way around within it. Once you get into the more complex settings it takes going to multiple areas of the app which is unnecessary.

The lamp has many settings to choose from - the preset modes are Home, Away and Basic, each with different predetermined settings or you can create your own.

The camera holds up to a 256 GB microSDXC card (Class 10, or UHS Speed Class 1 or higher) so you won’t have to worry about monthly cloud storage fees. Once the card is full it will automatically write over the oldest data. It records both audio and video data and can be set to record in a multitude of ways.

The camera records at up to 1920 x 1080 pixels, 2.0 megapixel, and 140 degrees - providing an ultra clear image of the entire room. While the lens is discreet it is visible if anyone looks at the front of the lamp. This is certainly not a hidden camera.

The lamp has three different sensors that detect presence - it detects motion, sound and temperature. In my tests I found this system to be incredibly accurate at detecting when there was a presence in the room and recording.

The base of the lamp holds eight AA batteries that act as a backup power source in the case of a power outage and will power the lamp for 1 hour.

One thing to note, while the listing says that it provides color night vision - what really happens is when the lamp detects presence it turns the lamp on in order to record in color. True night vision - in the dark - is monochrome.

While the listing states that the device or app can be connected to Dropbox for free cloud based video storage I have yet to find where it’s possible to do that and the online guides do not refer to it.

As someone who has used, reviewed and written about SmartHome products for many years I can say this is a quality product. I can see a few areas where it can be improved on. While the LED lamp provides a nice ambient light source it would be far better if colored light could be selected to match other SmartHome lighting. More shielding should be in place to prevent interference from other electronics - I assume that is the cause of the issues other reviewers have experienced. The app can use a bit of work in order to make it more straightforward in regards to the settings.

This is an extremely high quality camera system built into a nice modern lamp. It has sleek lines and will compliment most any room’s decor. The lamp provides a very pleasant ambient light while also providing video and audio surveillance and security.

This is a product that I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend.

The outer shell is a heavy duty canvas material that is definitely made to hold up to wear and tear. I love the outer black and grey color scheme.

title: WOW!  That was a HUGE disappointment.
text:
I had been anxiously waiting to try out the NETGEAR Nighthawk. I’d read over the impressive specs long before it was released, I’ve read glowing reviews touting it as the fastest, most powerful router Netgear had yet to produce... Specially made for the high demands of Smart Homes. All the hype made it sound like it was going to be AMAZING.

Now that I’ve set it up and run a full battery of tests - honestly the best thing I can say about it is it looks cool. 😕

I have been working with NETGEAR products for 25+ years so setup was not a big deal. As with most of NETGEAR’s new products don’t expect much printed material - that’s OK with me... I downloaded the Nighthawk app and followed the directions - they are fairly straightforward.

Restart your modem, plug in your Nighthawk Router, plug Ethernet Cable from modem to router, connect cell to router’s network using the ID and password provided on the sticker on top of the routers plastic cover, return to app. Here is where things began making less sense.

When I return to the Nighthawk app it goes through the process of connecting to my router and I receive an error message: ROUTER NOT SUPPORTED. Odd, but I’ve learned when installing a new router anything can happen. I exit the app and return, same message. I exit the app, restart the router, wait and restart the app and it recognizes. Great - I’m in... no big deal.

I update the Firmware, change the network name and password and start checking through the settings. I notice right away there are very few settings within the app - no security settings tab, no parental controls tab - odd, but I’ve learned NETGEAR tends to move these types of things around when they redesign their apps, so I put that concern to the side.

I plug my Ethernet cables into the 1G ports (there are 4 of them) in the back and watch the lights on front illuminate.

One of these runs to my computer and once it initialized the internet connection I ran a speed test - I’d tested with my previous router just prior to switch and was consistently benching at 210Mb/s download and 15Mb/s upload. With the Nighthawk I speed tested at 130Mb/s and 9Mb/s - definitely not what I’d hoped to see but I knew all my smart devices were working on rejoining the network so that could be slowing it down.

I decided to give it some time to let everything register on the network. In the Nighthawk app I had 42 devices and about half were still listed as unknown.

I let it work for about an hour and it recognized the majority of them... I ran another speed test - again through my laptop connected via Ethernet through the Nighthawk and this time received 154Mb/s and 11Mb/s. Still not great.

Then I went into my Nighthawk app as it has a speed test feature in there - I try that and receive an error that I must be on the network to run a speed test. I was on the network. I exit the app and go back in and receive the message ROUTER NOT SUPPORTED again. Ugh - really???

I reboot the router again and then the app recognizes it. While I’m able to control the router the speed test function does not want to work. Not a huge issue. I went through the browser on my phone and ran a speed test. The results were absolutely pathetic. This is the NIGHTHAWK - the router that is supposed to provide blazing fast speeds to WiFi devices and I received results of 5.4Mb/s download and 2.1Mb/s upload - and similar on 3 consecutive tests. At this point I’m starting to be less than impressed.

I decided to log in to the more advanced router settings via my computer. I had no problem getting in there but to my surprise there are ABSOLUTELY NO PARENTAL CONTROLS. This is the same company that has sold itself as allowing you to have complete control over every aspect of your home internet. NETGEAR Genie is no longer available and the NETGEAR Nighthawk panel doesn’t even have a section for parental controls - let alone work with Disney Circle.

While there are some advanced security features available within the NETGEAR Nighthawk Router controls on the computer they are anything but user friendly - they are hard to find, hard to set, and less than optimal.

As I was discovering all of this and researching these issues in the NETGEAR Community Forums I started receiving notifications from my smart devices that they were losing WiFi signal and then after a minute or two they would reconnect. This happened with my security cameras, LIFX lights, Wemo switches, and August door locks. After this went on for about an hour I decided my experiment with the NETGEAR NIGHTHAWK had reached its conclusion.

Unfortunately I can’t recommend this router at this time. While the hardware inside should have this out performing most any other router on the market I found it to be slow and glitchy.

title: Limited Connectivity Docking Station
text:
I had high hopes for this docking station from StarTech but, thus far, I’ve been pretty disappointed.

Like many people I like the portability of working from a laptop but when I am at my workstation I want more screen space to work on - I thought this Docking Station would be a perfect solution. Well, in theory, it would.

Inside the box you’ll find the docking station, a 3.0 USB cable, a power adapter with snap on plugs to fit various world power sources, a DVI to VGA adapter, and a CD-ROM.

Unlike many docking stations or hubs this is not Plug and Play. I’m running the most updated Windows 10 64bit and the CD-ROM is completely useless. After inserting it in my computer I received a message reading that it was not compatible with my machine. No problem, I went to the manufacturer’s website, found the product, clicked on support, downloaded the zip file containing the setup and updated drivers for my OS and continued.

I went through the installation process and it appeared to install fine. After accepting the user agreement it checked my system for compatibility - finding no issues it continued and completed installation. I went to device manager and noticed an error in USB connected devices but figured with a restart it would correct.

I restarted but the error remains. Configuration Descriptor Request Failed - Windows has stopped device. I have uninstalled and reinstalled, searched help, used Windows Update to search for a better driver - so far nothing has worked.

In regards to functionality - the USB ports (two 3.0 and four 2.0) all function without issue and the Ethernet Port works great providing me over 200Mb/s. Due to not having the correct drivers I’ve been unable to test the multiple monitor capabilities.

I have contacted tech support and as of writing I have not heard back. If they are able to help me solve these issues I will update my review to reflect my further findings.

It appears this Docking Station is outdated being developed for older operating systems and while it may work for some users, others will find it needlessly difficult.

I would look at more recently manufactured docking stations that have been developed with the current operating systems - especially if you are using Windows 10.

title: Decent idea in concept major flaws in execution.

title: An excellent tiny drive to backup your pictures and contacts on your phone!
text:
This is really a terrific little thumb drive for backing up photos and contacts from your phone.

I followed the instructions, plugged the drive into my iPhone it prompted me to download the GoDrive app, then I registered. I then recognized that I needed to format the drive with my computer which was no problem.

As soon as I plugged the drive into my phone after formatting, I opened the GoDrive app and it flawlessly backed up my photos and contacts.

This drive is an excellent solution to easily backup and transfer your pictures and contacts between your phone and computer.

This is an excellent product.

title: ABSOLUTELY AWESOME LIGHT SET!
text:
This light set is simply incredible.

First, let me say, the first shipment I received seemed to have been opened and returned to Amazon. Some of the components were missing and 2 of the lights were not in their original packaged boxes - one being significantly scuffed. I contacted the company and they could not have handled the situation any better. While they do not handle the actual shipping of items, they went far above and beyond to make the situation right. They told me to keep that set and immediately had another sent out to me. It is this kind of customer service that separates the great sellers from the good.

I could not be happier with this set of lights. There are 3 lights that measure 16.5” diagonally. They are easy to adjust through multiple controls on the reverse side. Both the brightness and the temperature of the light can be adjusted by an intuitive dial system that took me no time to figure out.

The lights can be linked via setting them on a particular channel so that when you change the settings on one, all lights on that channel adjust at the same time to the same settings.

The bracket at the base of the light allows the user to direct the light exactly where needed.

The tripods in this set are professional quality. While many manufacturers save money by including cheap, poorly made tripods, this company spared no expense. These tripods are top notch, heavy duty, light weight aluminum. They are made to hold up for years of use. They are highly adjustable going from 26” to 75”.

The set comes with plugs where it can be used anywhere power is available. Each light will run on batteries although they are not included. I am currently looking into purchasing those to see how the lights perform in outdoor night environments.

As a photographer who is picky about the equipment I choose to employ, I have to say this set has done nothing but impress me again and again. I would not hesitate to recommend both this product and this company.

title: Superb cables for those who understand the difference.
text:

I am using them to directly connect TVs to my router in order for the fastest possible streaming speeds. The quality of the cable definitely comes into play when you try to span distances over 25’ (in my experience). I have found these cables have minimal to no loss in speed at 75’.

The ends have very secure, reinforced clipping mechanisms which keep them clipped in and are easy to manipulate.

These are definitely the cables I’d recommend.

title: Excellent, Dependable Flashdrives
text:

We have had absolutely zero issues out of any of them. Each formatted without any issue and have been in daily use since I received them - we have not had a single error or issue with their use.

Our experience has shown this flash drives to be solid and dependable.

I couldn’t ask for more... I’m ordering another set.

title: AMAZING RING LIGHT SET!!!
text:
As someone who has done photography in both my professional and personal life for 25 years, I have purchased hundreds of pieces of photography equipment. This IR-45 Ring Light Set by IVISII is exceptional.

While many times the only option is to purchase high quality items a la cart or buy a lesser quality as a set I was so pleased with this set. Every piece in this set is constructed from high quality components and performs beautifully.

The light filters, a white softening filter and an orange filter, snap snuggly around the ring light and can be both attached and detached with ease.

The set is complete with a standard 1/4” camera mounting bracket, a 1/4” mini ball head mounting bracket and a universal cell phone bracket. I’ve had no problems attaching and detaching all of my equipment repeatedly.

The light performs incredibly well. Due to the size, it casts an immense amount of light. The dimmer control knob makes adjusting the light output effortless. Due to the bulbs being LED the light weighs very little, produces no radiant heat and will last a very long time.

Unlike many photography sets that include a cheap, poorly made tripod, this set is complete with an excellent, sturdy tripod that will hold up for years.

The light and all of its accessories, except the tripod, fit within a great padded, easy to carry, case. The case has padding built into both outer sides and a middle divider. It is complete with heavy duty zippers, handles and an adjustable shoulder strap.

If you are looking for a light that will take your photography to another level, look no further. This is a set you are guaranteed to love.

title: An excellent external hard drive - fast, dependable & at a good price!
text:
As with anyone reading this review, I store and backup many large files - in addition I need quick access to them and this drive delivers. The primary quality I look for in this type of product is dependability and this drive has yet to let me down.

While this external drive is not as small or portable as a laptop unit - it does require its own power supply (provided) it is perfect for everyday use plugged in to my laptop. I have yet to see a USB powered 5 TB drive that I would trust.

I use it primarily to store large photo and video files once I'm finished working on them but have never had any issue pulling a file straight from there into PhotoShop, Lightroom or Illustrator working on it and resaving.

Transfer speed is really impressive for a drive of this size. That being said, I'd definitely recommend having a filing system that makes sense to you as searching through 5 TB (actually just under due to system files) for the file you need would be daunting.

I've had my current drive for quite a while, in use everyday without a single issue, so when I realized I was down to only having 340 GB available yesterday I ordered another without hesitation.

In my experience this is an awesome external hard drive that will deliver all you need it to do.

title: I feel better knowing we're ready for an emergency
text: This emergency light/radio is awesome. We do a lot of camping in area's without cellphone reception where flash floods are common and we are moving to a tornado prone area soon; I have been wanting to add a hand crank radio to our emergency kit for awhile now and this seemed like a good excuse. The device itself is a great size, very compact so it can fit easily in any car, backpack, or emergency kit. I love that there are three options for charging the batteries, the reading light is much brighter than I was expecting, the radio works great and I love that you can just flip it right to the NOAA station, and the flashlight is super bright and I like having the three options. It also comes with an iphone adapter for the charging cord, which was a nice bonus. It comes fully charged right out of the box and does recharge really quickly with all three methods. I feel much better having this in our emergency kit and I think this would make a great gift for anyone moving into a new home or anyone who likes camping or off-roading.

title: Great camera equipment ++ case.
text:
This Case Logic backpack is very well made and adaptable to a wide variety of uses. My background has been in commercial photography and so I appreciate the thoughtfulness of design in this case from that standpoint. The most innovative feature are the 13 moveable partitions which attach to the interior of any of the multiple pockets that will allow one to highly customize the interior. Lenses, bodies, mini tripods, and light meters can all have their own padded compartments. The zippers with large handles are easy to use and don't jam. The dozen different pockets keep devices sorted and intuitively laid out. The backstraps are comfortable and the back panel has a large pad making it comfortable to wear for long periods of time.

It is also designed to hold a laptop with a very well padded pocket. The "bottom" of the case is made with rain resistant material about 1 inch tall.
So, overall, great design, quality manufacturing, easy to use, and apparently quite durable.

title: Multi-function radio
text:
The ETON FRX4 is a marvelous small "emergency" radio, one that will be quite useful in multiple situations. Yes, it has AM-FM-Weather bands and in addition it has a bright flashlight, SOS flashing red LEDs, and a plug in to charge your cell phone. The system is powered by [1] a rechargeable lithium battery, [2] alkaline batteries, [3] a handcrank generator, and [whew!] [4] a solar panel on the back. The sound quality is quite good given the size of the speaker and additionally has a headphone jack so the sound through headphones is great.

It is small, very portable, easy to carry, and will always be able to pick up local radio stations and weather, even if the batteries are dead. This is a winner.

title: Well done Belkin!
text:
WHY I BOUGHT IT: I have several computer carrying bags but Belkin make really good quality ware, so I decided to try
this backpack type carrier. Here is what I wanted to know:

COMFORT Great padding both in the shoulder straps and the back of the pack itself. Easy to wear for long excursions.

DESIGN: This is a 5 star design: well thought out, with numerous pockets in just the right places, comfortable, easy to
wear. This design makes sense. If you have a good sense of design, you will know what I'm talking about.

QUALITY: Top grade materials and well put together.

DETAILS: Many individual pockets so you can work out your own organization. We all aren't left handed and right brained!
Laptop compartment: well padded
Large "organization" storage pocket with pockets within pockets.
Cell phone compartment: on the right shoulder strap so easy to reach as needed
Place for your earbuds: magnetic so just "stick 'em on", right above your cell phone
Next to your back compartment: fairly large to be used as a security area: wallet, passport, money etc. It
would be very difficult to remove items from here when wearing the backpack; of course, won't help if someone
steals the thing!

SYNOPSIS:Easy and comfortable to wear; places for everything; well thought out; high quality of design and construction.
An easy 5 Star Rating.

title: It's okay...
text:
I have a Garmin e-trex GPS as a backup for my sailboat navigation system so my use of handheld systems has been limited to marine use only. At first I thought this Magellan Trinton 400 system would be a good handheld for marine use. Then I changed my mind.

1. Yes, this 400 is in color... but the battery life is half that of my e-trex and I would much prefer longer battery life than a color screen. This is personal bias of course and may not be of importance to you.

2. I noted the 400 was much larger than my old e-trex and seemed "clunkier".

3. However, the biggest frustration was attemping to link the 400 with my boat's navigation program on my laptop. I simply wasn't able to link and their website help page was close to worthless. Never was able to link. My e-trex links right away.

4. I should have been able to download marine charts to the 400 but after several hours on their website, I was also unable to do this.

5. Finally, it was discouraging to google "Triton 400" and find so many negative comments about the unit and Magellan's support.

For land use, other than the short battery life, it might present a decent option. But for marine use, I'll stick with my Garmin e-trex.

title: Great GPS!
text:
I have a Magellan RoadMate 1412 which I have used for the past few years, both as a stand-alone and in comparison with other units including a "built-in" in a Lexus. Both the 1412 and this 1440 model work exceedingly well and always do better than comparison units.
1. Both units have fast initiation times, that is from turn on to seeking and then de-coding information from satellites. This may seem of minor consequence but gets old after a while with a unit that's initiation time is of several minutes.
2. Both units are very intuitive and thus easy to learn and use. It just "makes sense" as one needs to go thru the menus to set up or change a function.
3. The screen displays are bright, easy to follow, and easy to use. I don't see how they could make this any better.
4. The newer 1440 has some added bells and wistles, such as being able to "go-to" a favorite place more easily, and being able to access some functions directly on screen that are menu driven on the 1412.

Summary: This 1440 model is accurate, easy to use, and has enough added features to make it slighly better than my old 1412.

please take serious heed to this issue. It will dump everything out and onto the floor or allow someone to very easily steal out of that pocket. I had to buy a small lock and lock the zippers together. That's the only way to avoid this other than using the big yellow handle to pick up bag.
I thought I lost all my electronics in the airport one day because my pocket was opened. Thank God some man was honest and stopped me to tell me about it. My heart dank for a sec when I realized what was going on.

The bag is great in every other way. Plenty of space. Plenty of durability, easy wash and clean. After 2 months of every day use there's no fraying no tears nothing to really complain about other than the laptop pocket opening and dumping. It can also hold alot of weight, with that weight it feels great on shoulders and your back. You really can't tell there 30-40 lbs of books and stuff inside.
I would for sure buy another one even with the pocket problem. 5$ for 2 small locks solve that problem and add extra security for your main use. Keeping your stuff safe.

title: Bulky but functional backpack for your camera equipment
text:
There is room for my 13" laptop, my 12.9" ipad pro, all my camera lenses and the body for my sony A7ii, snacks, water bottle, and you can attach a tripod to it.

The failure of this camera backpack (along with all others I've tried is that it looks really bulky on my short petite frame ( 5'4" woman). I think it makes me look fatter because of how wide the bag is, I tried it on my guy friend (also a photographer) who I was hanging out with and it looks much better! He really appreciated the hip and chest straps that go across the front for when he's on his motorcycle.

I would definitely use this for travel. Your expensive camera gear can only be retrieved by taking off the backpack since the zipper is next to your back which makes me feel safer. Would be great for carrying everything through the airport and sending your photography equipment through the security scanners.

The hip and shoulder straps really help to distribute the weight of the bag so it's also great for long hikes to get that perfect landscape shot in the mountains. I'm looking forward to trying it out more this summer in the rockies.

TLDR:
Pros:
- color/texture of the bag is really attractive
- has plenty of room for your favorite lenses and mirrorless camera (I don't have a DSLR so couldn't test that)
- can also fit laptop + tablet, charging cables, snacks
- comfortable shoulder straps
- comes with a waterproof bag that fits around the backpack in case you're stuck in bad weather
- camera section is modular which allows you to fit a variety of lenses, I was also able to fit my flash in here.
- GREAT bag for the price. You can't beat $44 for this.
- there are thoughtful interior flaps by your lenses that prevent water from touching them in case if rain gets in by the zipper.

Cons:
- Bulky looking
- could have more pockets instead of two laptop sections.
- If you open bag when its sitting up instead of laying down your camera will fall out
- the interior finishings arent as nice as the outside fabric
- mine was missing the black strap you see in the product photography that holds the camera in vs. having it just sit at the top of the bag.

Overall it's a great bag if you're starting out in photography for traveling and just to store all your gear in one place safely. I think you can't beat the price for this bag and the fabric on the exterior is very attractive. It does get heavy with all your gear in it so I really appreciate the hip straps to distribute the weight.

title: Convenient and so far, does everything it claims with ease.
text:
So far so good with this product. I was a bit uncertain when I first got it, because the hinge seemed really tight and I was afraid I was going to break it, but after a few uses, it loosened up enough that it no longer worries me. This case is useful for a number of different reasons. The keyboard is easy to type on and very quiet, so if you are trying to take notes in class or work without disturbing someone, it is very appropriate for that.

The keyboard lighting is awesome, giving you ten different colour options and three different settings for each colour, as well as letting you go without backlighting at all, if you choose to do so. Some of the colours are unique, like pink and aquamarine.

The different ways you can spin the ipad whilst using this make it convenient for a lot of different situations, although mostly I use it in laptop or tablet mode. The case feels relatively well built and the set up is so easy that you don't need any technical know how to do it. The instructions that came with it were simple and easy to follow and I have had no issues with is so far.

The battery life is easy to check, since there is a button just for that, and the colour of the case itself is an exact match for the rose gold of the ipad I bought.

My only real complaint, is that it is somewhat difficult to get the ipad out of the case once you have put it in, without feeling like you are either going to damage the device or the case itself. perhaps there is an easier method to do it and I just haven't discovered it yet. Otherwise, this is a great product and if it endures m abuse for a year or so, I will consider it to have been well worth the money spect on it. It certainly beats having to drag around and extra keyboard and separate stand everywhere I go when I want to work on the fly.

title: Innovative design and works flawlessly with ipad 6th gen
text:
I'm relatively happy with this pencil. It is certainly better than many of the off-brands claiming to do the same thing. There are a few things I don't love, so I will get those out of the way first. The pencil in perfectly rounded and very slick, so it is a danger that it will roll away or fall from the desk or other surface you are using it at, unlike the Logitech Crayon. As a comparison, this pencil is much more comfortable to hold than the Crayon, but it feels more breakable.

I also don't love that the extra charging piece (converter) that you get is so tiny, as is the cap, since that makes me feel like I am always in danger of losing these small parts off of the counter where they charge. (If you have kids, then you know what I mean about things sprouting legs and disappearing.)

Otherwise, I love it. This pencil is highly responsive to the touchscreen of the ipad (I'm using the 6th gen) and it works great with note taking apps, beautifully with procreate, and also as a general scrolling tool or selection pointer. The battery lasts for a decent while and I am happy that there is now a way to charge it, without having to have the pencil sticking out the bottom of the ipad, as that just seemed like a recipe for disaster.

The pencil feels like it is made of good quality materials. it is heavy, but not obtrusively so, and the points are nice. The pencil feels sturdy to the grip ad like it isn't cheaply manufactured as some of the other pencils do. This is more than just your average stylus.

Although, I admit, when I first saw the price I thought it was a bit ridiculous, after owning this product for a while, I now see the difference between it and the competitors and I do believe it was worth the investment. Plus, you can order tips for it directly from amazon for a reasonable price, which, in my opinion makes it even more worth the money. I have had a hard time finding tips for the crayon without going to the logitech site or other outside sources. I prefer to do all my shopping at once, so this works for me.

I would definitely recommend this product to other ipad users, as it has changed the way I work for the positive and sped up my productivity. It was easy to connect, the packaging is beautiful as always, and the instructions were clear and helpful. I find myself becoming more and more attached to Apple products as time goes on.

text:

Perhaps they forgot to put mine in, but there were no instructions that came with it. So I had to keep pulling and tugging at it trying to figure out how to get it apart to get the IPad into place. You can see the white stress marks in the plastic from me tugging at the bottom of it.

It also adds quite a bit of weight to the already not so light IPad 6th Gen, which makes it a bit more awkward to hold and carry that it already was. The other issue, is this thing collects every fingerprint, bit of dust or pet fur in the environment and is not the easiest thing to clean.

As far as protection goes, it does make the device seem safer to hand with respect to the idea of dropping it. The edge around the front of the screen sticks out, which makes it less likely that the screen will fracture if you drop the device. There is a good amount of rubber around the plastic encasement and that is obviously shock absorbing, so that is comforting as well. Overall, this isn’t terribly poorly designed, the camera holes fit where they should and everything looks pretty good once the case is in place, it’s just getting it in place without destroying the device or the case that I took issue with.

Instructions would have been useful.

I've been using it for a few months and have been happy with it.

title: Good product
text: This is a durable flash drive that has been working well for me for 4 months so far. I'm happy with the design of the item and the way that it slides the USB connector easily in and out without getting caught. I have had no issues with it so far and it works very well with my HP laptop. Reasonable price and good product.

title: Pretty good
text: This is a pretty good product. The case is nice and thick so it helps protect the device in case it is dropped, sat on or mostly anything else. You don't have to remove it in order to charge the device which is a benefit. It does add quite a bit of weight to the Kindle, so I usually remove it if I am going to be reading where the device is not supported. Overall I think this was a good purchase and I am happy with it.

title: Once you get used to it it's great.
text: I have a kindle fire that I bought when the Fire first came out. I love it except for the fact that the battery life isn't that great even if you are just using it to read. So I bought this one for the improved battery life. My first thought upon starting it up was that the screen looked hokey and not at all like I was expecting, but after using it for a while I kind of fell in love with it. The battery life is awesome. Even with continuous use I only have to charge it once every other week. Once you get used the the drabbish (probably not a word but oh well) display that is nothing like the fire, it grows on you. The screen is big enough to read comfortably and the pages turn quickly and evenly. It looks great in the sunlight and I like the way the titles are organized. It has many of the same functions as the fire in the respect that you can use the dictionary, highlight and make notes on-screen. I wish it had a backlight, but otherwise it is great. For anyone looking for a basic E-reader this is excellent.

title: Really like it except for the glare.
text:
This TV has excellent color and a beautiful display. I like that the features are simple to understand and yet it has a lot of features to choose from. The sound is excellent and with the addition of a home surround system it sounds just like being in a movie theater. The remote can be programmed to do multiple functions and the set up was pretty straight forward. The response time is great and Shark Week was terrifying on this TV (yes that was important.) Pretty much everything in the menu is interactive and fully adjustable for the viewer's preference. I love that it has the theater wide settings for optimal viewing as well.

The only real problem I have with this TV is that there is a screen glare issue. My living room has a giant picture window and no matter where I put the TV there is still a glare. Otherwise I think this is a great TV for the price and would highly recommend it for the movie buff.

title: some good some bad
text:
I bought this laptop because I wanted something that wasn't too heavy and could perform basic word processing and web functions. I had read product reviews for it before purchasing it and it seemed like it would suit me for what I required of it. After receiving the laptop computer I noticed two things immediately. The keyboard is made cheaply and to me, resembles something you might find on a first learning computer for a child. The keys have a cheap plastic-feel. After using the computer for two weeks, I already had to send it back to the manufacturer to have it repaired because two of the keys on the keyboard would get stuck and not produce the desired reaction when you push them.

Once I got the laptop back again, the keys were fixed but a few days later, the screen began to go black randomly and without warning. When it would come back, it would be in rainbow colors. After the second fix, it has been okay in those departments, but tends to overheat if you use it for any type of media, such as movies or music. The computer freezes a lot and has to be shut down manually at least once or twice a week.

I still think it is a bit heavier than I would like and since I have already had so many issues with it, I am actually afraid to carry it anywhere for fear that jostling it around in a carrying case might screw it all up again. The speakers on this computer are not nearly loud enough in my opinion.

What I do like about it is that it has pretty decent battery life (about 4-5 hours) depending on what you are doing at the time. I also like the colors the screen is capable of displaying when it is working correctly. I like that there are multiple USB ports for various endeavors. Overall I would say that this is a decent computer as long as you are prepared for the potential issues.

title: Great battery life...little bit of a learning curve!
text:
I bought the Samsung Chromebook with the idea in mind that it was even smaller than my laptop and would work great to read books on the go without having to drag along my kindle as well as my phone as well as...blah blah blah. Sometimes I honestly feel like all of my various devices turn me into a walking satellite receiver. The first thing I took note of when using the chromebook for the first time was how easy it was to set it up and make it personal. There is a handy one screen guide to walk you through the process. It is all pretty straight forward and if you are a user of google chrome, you pretty much have it in the bag already.

I set up the chromebook and downloaded the apps I would need to use offline and found the process simple and satisfying. Typing on the chromebook is pretty much the same as on any other keyboard with the noted exception that the keys have somewhat large spaces between them which can cause my typing to be a little awkward since I am used to my laptop where the keys are all close together.

The screen has beautiful even illumination and the apps download very quickly. It was a bit of a change to go from windows to the google operating system and took me a few days to organize things to where I could easily access them and remember where I put them.

As for battery life, this thing rocks! I have used this thing for seven hours before and still had it estimate that I had over an hour left. Mostly I use the chromebook for business applications and perusing the web for my job so I have not had to much experience playing movies on it or listening to music. I don't do much with multimedia.

So far it was a great purchase and I have been thrilled with it after a month of use. If you are looking for a lightweight, portable device to fill your basic needs, this is an excellent choice.

title: Nice for the price
text: The Kindle touch is an e ink reader and is small and lightweight and perfect for a day at the beach or when you wish to have millions of books at your fingertips while you are at a coffee shop that offers wifi. The pages turn easily and the display is superior to many of the other machines I have seen. There are things about the organization of the books I wish had been done differently and the fact that it does not have 3g is somewhat of a let down. Still, the screen is truly excellent in the sun as you can read it perfectly and the machine itself is sharp looking. The battery has a pretty impressive life. The kindle responds quickly and downloads books rapidly. I would recommend this to someone who wants to break into the world of kindle but for more advanced users, I would go for the Kindle Fire.

title: Hmm
text:
The kindle fire is a nice e reader and has a lot of bonuses such as the beautiful color displays. Still, I'm not sure it was quite what I was expecting. I'm not thrilled with the battery life as I usually can't finish a book before the battery is dead. It does not have a camera which I kind of think is lame since most devices even less expensive ones do. I'm disappointed that there is not free 3g connect like there is with the dx. Also, the Kindle Fire tends to get really heavy after you have held it for a while. It seems they could have found a way to make it as attractive and still lighter. The screen tends to have a bit of a glare when you are outdoors and sometimes it is hard to read through.

Since you have to have wifi to watch the movies and they are only free with a prime membership. This means you are responsible for paying for the internet gigs needed to use these features, which is okay if you have an unlimited internet package, but a lot of people don't.

Over all I think the fire is a good test model but there could be a lot of upgrades to make it a more practical device and get the utmost enjoyment out of it.

title: High-end quality without the high price
text:
What an amazing router at such a great price! I did a lot of research before I bought this. Because my previous router was a TP-Link router also, I was skeptical about this one at first. I was actually leaning towards a $300 Asus gaming router (I don’t game that much, I just wanted something powerful). But truth is, my previous TP-Link was just end of life—almost five years old. I’m pretty certain that WiFi tech was going out. I found an article titled something like “Best 2020 Routers” by Tom’s Guide and this was his #1 ranked router out of 10! After reading some other reviews and resources about it, I pulled the trigger. This router quadrupled my speeds (which wasn’t hard to do I suppose since my previous internet speed was so intermittent and slow).

I am extremely satisfied with this router. I’m a lv 4 IT engineer for a big company, and I can tell you that this is a quality product. You are getting the quality of these expensive gaming routers for half or quarter the cost. And the newer admin interface is very easy and simple. The setup for this router was easier than I’ve ever experienced. I have 25-30 wireless connections by the way and this thing is handling it like a champ. My other router really struggled with that.

I highly recommend this whether you’re technical or not, and whether you’re needing lots of bandwidth or just for basic internet usage.

title: High Quality iPad Case

It's very soft to the touch and has a sort of squishy feel, yet still maintains a strong, firm grip around the whole ipad. It covers iPad where it needs to. The magnet for the folding stand also works better than the Apple one I think. I also use a Tech Armor ipad air screen cover on this and it works very well with the 2 together. If you're wanting a good ipad cover but don't want to pay the $80 premium for Apple's overly expensive case, do yourself a favor and get this one now!

title: Just what I was looking for!
text:
I'm very satisfied with this product. The auto-connect feature is my favorite part. I can leave my phone in my pocket, never having taken it out and still listen to my music on my iPhone (where it left off) and take/make phone calls as well. Very easy to pair my phone with the device. When my car turns off, the device is disengaged and disconnects from my phone. When I turn my car on, it takes about 3 seconds and then I hear a small beep noise, and now I can click the button on the puck which resumes my music/media.

Like my title says, this is exactly what I wanted. I wanted complete hands-free in my car, but didn't want to use any annoying bluetooth earpieces. The sound quality is good as well. I did get some loop noise in my 2008 Mazda 3 so I did have to buy a female-to-female 3.5 mm part from RadioShack for $5 which resolved the noise problem. I already had a cable with a noise loop shield so all I needed was this part. You can also buy little filter clamps at RadioShack which you would just place right on the cable and should reduce noise. The part was only $3, I just chose to use my existing part instead which I also bought on Amazon
([[ASIN:B0031U1ATQ Kensington Reducing SmartPhone including iPhone]]

Overall, 5 stars! Great product! The price is right. I'm a happy customer. It was shipped and received sooner than I expected. I am overjoyed about this product.

title: Very well made; huge! Please read!
text: Upon opening this, I was intimidated that I couldn’t assemble it and mount the tv by myself. I am a 5’4” tall woman with okay sensibilities to assemble ikea stuff, etc. I shouldn’t have worried. A lot of hardware was included that you don’t need, sent to you as a courtesy depending on the type of tv you’re mounting. The glass base is HEAVY and made of thick, tempered black glass. The holes are pre drilled and align perfectly with the stand. It was easy to mount the tv, then move it into place on my console. This stand swivels the tv once mounted. That is a really cool feature and it works seamlessly. You also have the choice of 3 different mounting heights. There are also clips on the back that hold your cords in place so everything looks nice and tidy. Very well thought out design! Except, it TOTALLY DOMINATES the look of my room now. It’s huge, heavy and black and SCREAMS that the tv is in the console table. I don’t know what could be different though? I think it’s simply because of my interior decor, which is light and sort of boho. It  causes this item to not feel like it belongs in my house. So, please consider the visual “weight” this stand will take up. Measure your space, and know that the black base and stand are really big. But if you think , after that, it will work with your decor, you won’t be disappointed! It’s worth the money and is a top quality item.

text: I can’t get this off if the logo for the unit. It won’t connect to my phone via Bluetooth. It’s small and compact and I WANT TO LIKE IT SO MUCH. But I’m done with it hijacking my time.

title: Universal tripod
text: Super sturdy and quite easy to use. Fits my camera and fits my little mini projector. Holds it super sturdy. Not really any assembly. The legs lock into place. Happy to have this!

title: I love this purse so much
text: [[VIDEOID:8683b708da27f4db57ae79edd8297484]] This purse feels so lux to use. The cognac color is timeless, the leather is soft on the inside, sturdy on the outside, the zippers pull smoothly and there is ample room inside for a wallet, phone, brush, masks, keys, makeup. Comes with a long strap and a shorty too. Worth every 💰!

title: Perfect Gift Solution!! ❤️ 📷
text: I ❤️ my Frameo!! I initially bought one for my Dad and he loved it so much, I decided to get one for my family. It is SO MUCH FUN! And an excellent solution to “what should I do with all the pictures on my phone’s camera roll?” There isn’t really any assembly. You’ll need to install the frameo app and create an account. Frameo will hold all your photos for a lifetime too. From the app, you can select any photo off your camera roll and with a few taps, send it to your frame. You can label each pix if desired. Frameo also allows me to share my frame, via a numerical code, to anyone else after they download the app. So, my daughter at college can send pix to my frame and I can see them in seconds. The frame holds like, 20,000 photos. Each one is posted for about 20 seconds. You can easily tap and drag to scroll forwards or backwards on the frame. You also don’t need wifi to SEE pictures. You need wifi to UPLOAD additional pictures and for others to share the frame. In theory, you could set this up with your personal wifi, load it with as many pictures as you want, then have your elderly parent simply plug it in at their house. It will scroll through all the photos you loaded. You just can’t add more until it’s connected to wifi. It’s a special gift and it’s been fun for personal use too. I highly recommend!

title: I couldn’t get Co2 from these
text: I used these knock-offs in a soda stream and both canisters only produced the smallest, most pathetic amount of bubbles. No matter how many pumps I did on the soda stream. I did 25 pumps once and had close to no bubbles. I do 4 pumps on a name brand canister and have bubbles for 24 hours.  They are a subpar, inferior brand. I would caution you to stay away from them.

title: Works great, nice price
text: For the price, you can’t really beat these! They plug into a c port and come with a little zippered carrying case. Any ear bud I wear eventually makes my ears hurt. These do too, but no worse than any other one. They have a comfortable rubber tip on them that’s easy to adjust. They sound very decent.

title: great
text: I like these alot. They fit in my ear nicely and comfortably. They cancel out the noise fairly well and they dont leak sound. I have never gotten the tangled but we will continue to see about that...

title: Great for beginners!
text: This is my first telescope. It was very easy to assemble and came with a vinyl tote bag and some extra parts. The bottom is all aluminum and very lightweight. Easy to pick up and move around. The telescope pivots and moves around easily too. There is a long handle to move it so you can have a light touch. There are 3 lenses that let you dial in the clearness of the object you wish to see. We’ve had fun in the day time looking at birds and have enjoyed the full moon in the night sky. This is not a $1,000 unit. The moon still looks very far away, wavy and fuzzy. Unless you are ready to invest in a top quality tool, this is about as good as you’d expect. And honestly wonderful for children and they learn how to use it and gain confidence. It collapses down small and tidy and portable too.

title: Easy to use. Excellent picture.
text: [[VIDEOID:4b5c7c470a3160b46a5eabb0eec97c8c]] I never thought I’d need another Blu-ray player but here I am after my very old one cracked and I wanted to watch a random dvd that I couldn’t find to stream. I’m very happy with it. It’s easy to set up and very small. It’s quick to react and easily communicates with my tv. The picture is clear and crisp. Comes with an hdmi cable and a remote. It you find yourself in need of replacing or upgrading, this is a great choice.

title: Cool concept, poorly designed.
text: Hard to pair, the volume buttons are messed up and it’s literally  impossible to turn off. It just turns off automatically after it’s not been used for 20 or 30 minutes. The most confusing portable speaker I’ve ever used. I can use around my house for aubible. But I took on a river trip and it never paired or played actual music. Bummer.

title: Great quality
text: Nice banner. Thick with clear writing. Reinforced grommets and clean edges.

title: Easy to assemble and install
text: These are a standard size brush wall plate. They are easy to install and you can access the cables that you’ll run through them easily. They come in 2 pieces that fit together once assembled. The plastic is sturdy and the brush fibers are soft and hold together.

title: THE. BEST!!
text: I...LOVE this gadget!❤️ It is so easy to use and very very helpful. After initial charge, I easily connected to Bluetooth. Then, it can be unplugged and it holds a charge for weeks. My iPhone fits snug in the holder and the speaker is loud enough to easily hear podcasts and audiobooks clearly. It takes phone calls too and obviously can be used as a speaker to play music on. I’m super happy with it. I want one in my bathroom to listen to books while getting ready, and one in my kitchen to prop my phone up while looking up recipes and listening to music.

title: Awful
text: I absolutely hated this product. The sound was always off by a few seconds and it kept disconnecting every few minutes. I could hear the things around me and the noise cancellation was awful. the sound quality was grainy and glitched out sometimes. But the earphones were comfortable to wear and fit my ears nicely.

title: Surprisingly good!
text: For the price, these are a great option for replacement earbuds. Which I am always losing or breaking. They are comfortable and I can wear for a long time without irritation. They fit perfectly in my iPhone. The sound is remarkable decent! Obvs, not perfect, but for price, I’m not disappointed.

title: Cool invention!
text: These are super handy. They hold my headphones perfectly without fear of falling down.  HOWEVER, I advise using a 3M wall strip and not the sticky pad it ships with. That way, if you change your mind where you want it placed you can easily move it without ripping the paint and drywall off. Ask me how I know...

title: Sturdy cord!
text: Great little plug. Has 2 traditional 3 prong holes, 2 usb, and 2 c plugs. This is really compact too so you can easily use it for travel or for places in your home where you don’t want a bulky plug in strip. It sits flat on the surface. There are no holes on the back to mount it to wall though. We have it filled up in our office and have had no problems.

title: These have worked great.
text: These are my 12 yo boy’s favorite head phones. He uses them for school work and for gaming. He said they are comfortable and the sound is awesome. He prefers having 1 ear uncovered. It’s easier for me too because it’s easier to get his attention when he’s “immersed” in a game. I feel like this is a pretty sturdy set too. We’ve used it for a full month on a daily basis and have had no problems. They connect to Bluetooth smoothly and hold a charge for a long time.

title: Charming sounds!
text: [[VIDEOID:25eadd9d5b2ee9acadb4b980a82344ea]] This is our first ukulele. It was simple to tune and holds its tune for longer than we expected. It’s light and comfortable to hold and play. This comes with an extra set of strings, tuner and strap. Seems like a good solid instrument. Comes with a really nice little padded case. The case has backpack straps as well as a carrying handle. Also has a front, zipper closure pouch.

title: These make me happy! 🙂
text: What fun little cable protectors! They are all bright, with clear details. Each one is perfectly pliable but stiff enough to do it’s job. Each one has a thorough slice on the bottom to tuck your cord into. They fit snug and don’t shift too much. So cute!!

title: EXCELLENT PRODUCTS!!
text:
SUCH A GOOD PRODUCT! I read the reviews on past models and it seems like this company really listens to their customers. (Some annoyances included only 1 charging cable and wistful dreams of these being solar so they didn’t have to be continually recharged, as well as a clock that offered both a 12 hour format and 24 hour format) This new model took those things into consideration and they produced an even better product. Now these DO come with 2 chargers and a plug so you can charge both sensors at once. This also means you can keep main unit plugged in all the time now, even if you need to charge a sensor or doorbell. It took more than 2 hours to initially charge sensors. They come 20% charged. Their light changes from red to green when ready. After charging, I had to adjust the sensitivity levels. You’ll need to unscrew the back plate (a screwdriver is included!!) and simply move the switch from low to high or in between, whatever your needs are. After putting back plate on again they are ready to mount. The initial set is already “paired” to main unit so you can change the chime thru the main unit easily. I chose 3 different sounds so I know what zone the movement’s in. Mounting screws are included. Though 3M outdoor strips would be heavy duty enough to hold these too if you didn’t want to drill holes. My sensors are about 300+ feet from my house. There’s no problems with reception. I used the “doorbell” as more of a panic/assist button. We live on acreage and sometimes yelling for help when you’re far past the home is impossible. So I mounted the doorbell on the barn and programmed a panic-inducing chime for it. I’m sure my kids will really like that. :/
Overall, this took about 20 minutes to install. The directions are very well laid out and the product comes with a two yr warranty. This combined with what appears to be excellent customer service means these sensors are totally worth it!

title: Small but good.
text: I gave 4 stars because ear cover is teeeny. Sound is good, hook up is good. Plastic but hopefully they will stay intact.

title: Just a disc man. Won’t work w/o earbuds.
text: Even after re reading this “protable”(yes I know that’s misspelled) CD player description I still couldn’t really figure out that you MUST USE HEADPHONES OR EARBUDS to use. No sound comes out of unit itself. Essentially like a disc-man of the 90’s. Bummmmmmmerrr.

title: Winner!!
text: My boys have loved these. They have totally thrashed them and they still work. They have a radio built into them too. Might as well be Disneyland. They get a better range than any walkie's we've used in the past. Our gate is 1/4 mile from our house and the reception is clear.

title: LIFE ENRICHING DEVICE!!!
text: I LOVE THIS PRODUCT!! My Dad is 80 and refuses to use a smartphone. I ordered this hoping I could preload it with grandkid pictures and send him new ones from time to time. It was SO EASY to set up. I plugged it in, connected the picture frame to my wifi, entered a user name and time zone. Then, The I followed the prompts to use my cell phone to send pictures. I had to download the FRAMEO app on my android (and on my daughter's iphone). Then, on the pictureframe, I tapped on the "+add" icon and a numerical code popped up. I entered this number on my cell phone. You can then share pictures with a few taps from your phone. On the screen, which is just over 10 inches, a banner appears announcing "you have a new photo". You can tap on the banner and see new picture, or just wait for it to appear in the rotation. I have each picture timed for a 10 second display, but you can modify that. You can also delete pictures. I sent a short video clip too. It played the video in the rotation with the regular photos. You can tether 10 users to each picture frame.  I'm so happy to be able to share real time pictures with my Dad. His fumbling hands don't have to touch anything to get this to work and his aging eyes will be able to see the crisp screen. His granddaughters can send him pictures from their phone now as easily as a text message. EVERYBODY WINS!

title: Very comfortable
text: I'm using these for Rosetta Stone lessons. Working brillantly so far. Quite comfortable, the volume is easy to adjust and the sound is clear. USB plug in. I plug into my desktop tower and cord is long enough to reach my office chair.

title: Stopped working after 1 month.
text: Stopped working and made me have to reinstall my sound driver. My desktop still isn't working normally. Super pain in the butt.

title: Simple and sturdy.
text: These are very simple and straightforward headphones. They are comfy and have clear sound. They adjust to head size and use a jack, not a usb port. We've had no technical problems with these at all.

title: Gives me peace of mind!
text: Smaller than I expected but works just fine. I don't like when the solar panel is lifted, the light turns on but that's a minor nuisance. Everyone should have a gadget like this in 1st aid kit or bug out bag. Also, perfect for camping. Everything works as expected.

title: The best computer I've ever used.
text: I have been using this Dell All In One for about 6 weeks. It's definitely the nicest computer I've ever owned. Right out of the box it's basically ready to go; you need to register it though. The touch screen is extremely sensitive and fun to use; it's also large enough to use for movies, tv etc. The camera pops up when you want to use it and has high resolution and pops back down when not in use. The sound is boomin'. Both the mouse and keyboard are wireless and require batteries. I've had no problems with either. Right after I initially set this up, I tripped over the cord and broke it. It costs $80 to replace and I had to order on Dell sight.  (Only imitations on Amazon) I bring this up because replacement parts are expensive. It is loaded with Microsoft, so, Cortana is voice assistant. And Microsoft edge is search engine. No probs using chrome however and I've downloaded several chrome extensions. There is no disc drive. There is an HDMI port on the back so you can connect to a DVD player etc if you want. On the bottom, next to power button, there is an HDMI button that allows you to switch to hdmi mode to use a DVD player or external drive. It's light enough that I can pick it up and move it anywhere. It tilts on it's base too so when I stream my exercise workouts and I'm doing floor work, I can see so much better than my old computer. It doesn't come off base so it can't be mounted to wall or anything. I'm super happy with it and it is a joy to use everyday.

title: Lacks finesse but works fine
text: I set this up at my property entrance just over 1/4 mile from my house. I totally get the signal 100% of the time. It was easy enough to install, might work to have 2 ppl install so 1 person can align the 2nd sensor easier. The chimes are really old school chimes. Like, original cell phone chime and 7-11 store chime. They are either SUPER LOUD or quiet. The receiver is this UFO plastic piece that is really bulky and hard to place discreetly in your house. Mines in my laundry room so it's not too big an issue for me.

title: THESE ARE CRAZY GOOD
text: I've been using these almost everyday since they arrived and AM LOVING THEM!! These are the 2nd pair of Santana bluetooth I've ordered (the 1st being from the "oye" line) These are head and shoulders better than those. They are super easy to connect to bluetooth tooth. I've used both my phone and my computer as devices with ZERO problems or drops. The sound is freaking AMAZING! I started off with Soundgarden's 'Slaves and Bulldozers' and from the 1st second of that baseline it felt like I was enveloped in sound. I then listened to Lana Del Ray to hear a airy, female voice and the sound was pure and ethereal. You can hear each distinct part of the music. The bass is balanced and not overblown. I use these on my morning walks everyday so now they just play all random stuff. They are comfortable and even if I sweat in them, they wipe clean to a like-new product. The charge lasts for a solid 24 hours. The controls are ergonomically in the correct place. These headphones prove that music is indeed the best invention in the world!

title: Very fun pad!!
text: We've been using  this pad daily for over a month now and really like it. It plugs directly into our desktop and chromebook with a cord that's long enough to comfortable use it, but it's not in the way. We down loaded an app called "draw 3d" on desk top and "the animator" on the chromebook. From there, the drawing pad and stylus works like a giant mouse, but with way more precision and ease. The stylus is waaaaay more comfortable to work with then a mouse. It's grip is non-fatiguing. It's more fun then a mouse aand more like drawing with a pencil. There are plenty of replacement tips (they are all the same size) The buttons on the side of pad are "shortcut buttons" that you can hook up to change colors with the press of a button. The wheel on the side let's you zoom in and out. This is our 1st drawing pad. It's a lot of fun, easy to use. I gave 4 stars because getting used to looking at the screen versus looking at the pad whilst drawing can be challenging. It is an exta step versus say, drawing directly on a screen. BUT for the price, this little pad can't be beat. We keep it stored in the box it came in when not in use.

title: Cute design, roomy
text: This is a really cute backpack. Most appropriate for an older elementary student or middle school student,  because of the size. The zippers pull smooth everytime. Roomy enough for books and laptop.

title: Other than losing charge quickly, these are awesome
text: These lose the charge SUPER FAST. Once you figure out how to turn them on, off and connect with device, they sound amazing. I listened to Soundgarden,  Tame Impala and Led Zeppelin through them to get a feel for sound nuances, once again proving that music is literally the best invention in the world! Super comfortable to wear too so I want to use them all the time. But when I reach for them, they are always dead. Even when they had a charge left in them from previous use. I hate always leaving things on a charger, but I guess I have to with these.

title: High quality
text: Fantastic quality! These are comfortable to wear for extended periods of time. They do a pretty decent job of cancelling out outside noise. The sound quality is solid, with bass, treble, low pitched and high pitches coming in clear. They've held up perfectly to daily wearing by my 2 boys.

title: Happy to have this
text: Totally decent radio. Small. Easy to dial in a station. For the price, the sound is fine. Antenna pulls out to capture longer range. I just feel like it's smart to have one of these on hand in case of emergencies.

title: Makes organizing very easy
text: We use this base everyday in our office to store my boy's chromebook and tablet. The base is weighted and has a thin rubber lining on the bottom. The slots have ample room, even if your tablet has a thick, rubber case around it like ours does. This has never tipped over, and is easy to use. It fits phones, tablets and laptops!

title: Really sensitive, works great.
text: This motion detector is installed at the entrance to my property about 1/4 mile from my front door. There are tons of trees between the sensor and the chime. It works FLAWLESSLY! We don't get many suprise guests, as we live behind a closed gate on a country road. But with this, I can tell when the kids or our dogs leave the property. Or when my husband comes home at night. You can't see our front gate from our house, so it's definitely added an additional layer of peace of mind for me. It does go off at night occasionally due to deer or raccoons passing the sensor. I have it set to the lowest volume and the shortest chime so it doesn't bother me. I gave this 4 stars because you cannot plug anything else into the socket when this is plugged in. It's pretty big. Also, the chime choices are all really irritating. Most chime choices sound like the 7-11 store door chime or the old, old wireless phone chimes from 25 years ago. It gives it feel a slightly tacky effect. I have this in my laundry room though so I don't see it and the chime stays quieter.

title: Not leather at all, but fantastic!
text: Vegan leather is just pleather, y'all. I looked it up. I did not want to like this bag. But, I got it and had to review it. So that meant, I had to use it. And use it I did. It is a joy to use!! Suprise! There is so much room inside. And all my stuff fit and was so organized. The pockets are all roomy, the middle zippered pocket is big enough for my massive day timer and various documents. My phone, kept in the phone pouch, stays up toward the top so I can reach it along with my wallet. The bag is sturdy and doesn't slump all over. The inside vinyl part makes a scratchy, plastic noise when anything touches it. That bugs me. And to describe a vinyl purse as vegan leather is disgraceful!! But it looks classy and pretty authentic. I won't tell my husband though. He'll make fun of me. #savethecows

title: These are working for me.
text: I like these. They look a bit retro and are comfortable to wear. The volume works fine. I use them with my chromebook to watch movies. Have used for a month. No problems.

title: Works with MOST plugs, not all.
text: Works as expected but only in plugs that are vertical. If your kitchen plug is horizontal, say to match your tile, then this won't work. Keeps cord tucked away in back. Google fits snug in holder.

title: Bad product
text: Broke after 1 hour of use.

title: No problems with this compact cord
text: This thing is GREAT! Nice and heavy. The cord is long enough for it to be plugged into the wall and then this sits on a desk. Tiny in size but still has 3 usb and 2 plugs. Have been using for a month now with no probs.

title: Big hit with the girls!
text: My 6 year old daughter loves these! The sparkles don't flake off and they have soft, leather-like padding for the ear cover. She says they are comfortable and they sound decent too. They fold down a little so they don't take up too much room.

title: These work great!
text: Excellent little invention! These are stable and sturdy. No rocking or wobble when tablet or phone is set in the holder. They hold a wide variety of sizes too. The sleek, low profile design is attractive and folds up to store.

title: These are fine general use binoculars
text: These are definitely a big step up from $30 binoculars. However, they are not a top quality/german product. These are made in China and are great for casual use. Our kids have loved using them. They are lightweight and really easy to adjust. The lenses are crisp and don't fog. They magnify 10x. The eye piece pops out '3 clicks' to focus as you like. Each side of the lens has a soft plastic cover over it. These can be completely removed. Comes with a strap and a soft nylon bag that has a velcro closure.

title: Arlo keeps getting better and better
text: We have had no problems with our new system. Set up was pretty straightforward. I think the unit looks clean and modern. Comes with a free trial period of cloud access. Must purchase membership afterwards if you want to store your surveillance!

title: Works pretty good
text: These earbuds are pretty good. They tilt at an angle. Much different than previous earbuds,which stick straight out. These,  are pretty comfortable, they have a rubber ear piece and gently angle out. They sound fine. Honestly,  earbuds have to be replaced so often,  it's hard to get stoked about them.

title: Great organizer basket!
text: My printer is currently sitting on top of this basket and I love it! It's 1 solid piece, no assembly. There are 2 side baskets. One is divided for pens and pencils. The paper niche slides out and one leg adjusts so there is zero wobble! Love that I just gained some precious real estate on my desk!

title: Takes some getting used to.
text: This mouse has a few benefits over a traditional mouse. It's cool that it powers on when flexed. It's soft and comfortable. It links ok and almost all the time. Its just not the most greatest mouse ever. Takes some getting used to.

title: I am very happy with these.
text: These are in my opinion the best wireless headphones I've worn. They are so light, flexible and comfortable. I've worn them dozens of times now for hours at a time. I've had no issues with connectivity and the sound had been clear and vibrant.

title: Can take a thrashing!
text: It doesn't get much easier than this to enjoy music with no cords or wires. So nice to not have a cord to contend with!! Set up was easy and sound quality is great. Paired easily via bluetooth with iphone 7plus. So far, these have been very comfortable to wear and stay in my ears while I'm working. I ordered specifically because of the diamond coating. I work in an environment that has dust and particles flying around all the time and wanted something slightly more durable. Can take them out and put in pocket too without worries that they'll get tangled and thrashed. Well done, Anker.

title: THESE DO NOT STICK!!
text: It doesn't matter what I do, these things simply don't stick to the wall once the cord is inserted into them. I'm about to gorilla glue the back tab and see it that holds. Cool concept, just not sticky enough.

title: What a cool little tripod!!
text: For the price this tripod can't be beat. Totally works. Compact and very lightweight, absolutely maneuverable, locks into place and is balanced well. My little 10 year old has cinematic ambitions. I ordered this for him to make his stop-motion. Very cool invention!!

title: Can't get it to work
text: I cant figure out how to use this. Instructions say to insert disc to install, yet there is no disc. I spent the better part of my morning trying to figure out how to install this via the company website etc with no luck. The dongle is very wide. It potentially can cover up the usb port next to where its plugged in. The company includes a short USB cable that acts almost like an extension cord for you dongle if that over crowding is an issue for you.

title: Amazing keyboard! Perfect in every way.
text: This is without a doubt, the nicest keyboard I've ever used in my life. It's makes old school, wired keyboards look like a child's toy. The very 1st thing I noticed was the responsible packaging. Trim, low profile box with no superfluous plastic. Even the directions were printed directly on the box, so no wasted paper. The next thing I noticed was the weight of this keyboard. It weighs about 4x the amount as my other logitech wireless keyboard (the kind that takes batteries). The back side of keyboard also has a weighted pad running the entire length that angles the keyboard properly toward the user.  Then I noticed the compact shape of this k.board as well as individual key shape. Each key has an indentation on it that is quite pronounced and you can see from the picture I included of my old keyboard, how much smaller it is. I was super stoked to try it! Using the perfectly illustrated directions, linking everything took me less than 5 minutes. I even created a logitech account during that time AND figured out how to link my phone and tablet, via bluetooth, to keyboard. RAD! And so super easy. I guess that's why that option is literally named "easy switch" ha! Then, the magic happened. My fingers  FLEW on this bad boy. It's like nothing I've ever experienced. My words per minute probably increased by 10%-15%. I will never look back! Far exceeded my expectations. Keyboard will alert you with onscreen msg and red light when low on battery. This came with a C cable for charging. Well done Logitech! Perfect score.

title: So far I like this soundbar a lot
text: So far, I have only good things to say about this sound bar. I waited 2 weeks after setting up to write review. It is pretty heavy in weight. If you're planning on mounting to wall, make sure you use metal wall anchors or try to find studs. I'm using this with a 55" Vizio. My greatroom is 25" x 25". Half of that area has 15" ceilings. This soundbar fills the space up nicely without being echo-y. Good bass, rich sound. As always, your HDMI cables make a big difference in the quality of your experience. Installation was not that hard. The directions are clearly labeled. Also included is a mounting template which I thought was a nice touch. I didn't use it. Mine is just on a media table. The included remote is lightweight and easy to use. I'm sure you can spend tons more $ on a super high end sound bar. But this one doesn't suck and I love being able to have a surround sound experience.

title: Work great. Not as soft as I'm used to.
text: These have really good sound and are easy to set up. My biggest complaint is that the part that fits over your ear is quite stiff. I am used to really flexible rubber on that part. Which I find more comfortable. They hook up to blutooth flawlessly and are pretty compact to store.

title: These things are RAD!!
text: This is the 1st set of wireless headphones I've ever owned and they sound like FREEDOM! They arrived in a pretty classy box with 2 extra silicone earbud inserts and a charging cable. The earphones came in a small and suprisingly solid, snap-close carrying case that IS THE CHARGER! Meaning, you place the earbuds into the case and then plug your charging cable into the case. Very cool. I had to download the jaybird app to set up the earbuds. I had no problems and followed the prompts successfully. The sound from these little guys is freakin' amazing! You can very clearly hear distinct instruments during songs. There is no fuzziness, just very crystal clear sound. They are pretty comfortable to wear. The charge is supposed to last 6 or so hours. After wearing them a few times exercising,  I just out them back on charger. I hope they last. Very very happy with this order.

title: Priced right, works fine.
text: For the price, these are great. I am totally over spending a small fortune in headphones for my kids. They get excited or absentminded and chew or pull on cord which renders headphones useless. The sound quality on these is totally fine. They are very very light. Easy fit on their heads too.

title: At this price point, pretty good!
text: For an inexpensive and lightweight pair of headphones, these are suprisingly well made. My kids break these as the school year goes on and it's nice to have a reasonably priced set to replace them with.

title: Only has 1 ear!
text: Didnt realize these only had 1 ear bud. Bummer. I need two. Seems like a basic, light headphone though.

title: So far so good.
text: So far, these have worked great. They fit and stay put. The sound is above average. We go thru these so fast, so this price point is decent too.

title: Great way for cords to stay safe and tidy.
text: Very cool invention! Every year I am super bummed out when I put my Xmas tree in the designated corner and have to see the extension cord I have to use for the lights laying on the ground. My dogs want to chew it, the kids try and get behind the tree and end up tripping on it. This is a perfect solution! It's a 5', pretty heavy duty plastic strip. You have to turn it over and use a utility knife to cut out a place for your cord. The lines are scored for you already. Once cut, your cord tucks away nicely, out of sight and flat. It ships rolled up and the directions state to unroll it to flatten before use. It still hasn't become totally flat for me, but looks like it's headed in that direction. The plastic is easy to wipe clean. And rolls up again to store away until needed.

title: Basic fastener, nice to have around
text: This is something you often need but never have! So great to keep cables organized, use for camping and gardening projects. I'm happy with these. They are a standard 11 inch fastener. All black and as the name suggests, they stay snug!

title: HEAVY DUTY-YES!!
