I know the answer is to use the backlight, but the backlight uses up battery power and shortens the time my IPad is usable.  And, frankly, the backlight doesn’t really do a great job of illuminating the keys.  Sorry, this won’t work for me.

title: Good for 10.2IPad
text: This is a good case with keyboard combination and my only complaint is that it is heavier than others I tried.  It was easy to set up, has a more than adequate battery life and works well - it’s just not as light as others, and weight is an important factor to me.  For those who don’t mind the weight, this is a highly recommended case with keyboard.

title: This is the one!
text: Looking for a new IPad case and keyboard and this is exactly what I was hoping to find.  The keyboard illuminates in green and other colors,  which makes it very easy to see no matter what the light is.  Fits my IPad perfectly, and love the pink -or rose-gold case.  It was lighter weight than any others that I tried.  Works for me.

title: Wireless is a big plus!
text: We have enough wires to contend with for my daughter’s work at home - dual monitors and huge desk area, keyboards and other things I don’t understand!  She is so happy with this wireless mouse - so much more flexibility in using it, and no more tangled wires!  Have been using it for months on a daily basis and no change of batteries yet.  No noise  either - like clicking - which she appreciates.  This mouse was a good choice!

title: Who knew?
text: I had no idea a lens hood even existed, and that it can be used as a sun shade for a cell phone camera - it evidently reduces effects you don’t want and gives you much better pictures.  I tried it with my smartphone, and the pictures I got were so crisp and fresh - no weird lighting effects even though the sun was shining in half the picture.  Very glad to have found this for better pictures from now on!

title: Ten hours of playing time
text: We live on 12 acres, and although we’re not planning a mini-Woodstock, we will be streaming movies outside this summer for our guests.  We have a whing-ding coming up when 30 family and friends will be visiting to help us plant our first crop - they’ll be tented around the property and we’ll gather for music and movies.  What appealed to me was being able to hook up to any device - and also the claim of “mind-bending” bass!  Music makes the work go faster, so we’ll want our fields to rock!  Hoping this  wireless speaker will give us the background noise we need!  Will amend this review with the results!

title: Essential for a photograher
text: My grandson carries three  cameras when he goes on a shoot - and until he got this hard case, there wasn’t any type suitcase or duffle that could really keep his expensive cameras safe.  The foam that comes with this hard case makes it possible to cushion the cameras so that there are no worries.  There’s room for lenses and filters as well.  Very strong case - very sturdy and built to protect valuables.  Great choice!

title: Good quality photography essential...
text: This is just what my grandson needed for his photo studio when he is taking still photos of products.  This pretty much gave him everything he needed to do a professional job.  He tells me that “light is everything” so this reflector allows him to get just the kind of light he needs where he needs it.  Very sturdy and he is very pleased with the material.  Good choice!

title: Finally, some nice long cords...
text: These charging cords are top quality and are much longer than the ones we have.  With  this supply, we may finally have enough.  Car keys used to be on the top list of things that disappear, but now it’s charging cords!  We’re hoping that the distinctive, longer cord will have a better chance of being left at the charger! Cord is distinctive woven black,  really different than the majority of cords.  We’re pleased with these cords!

title: For  great effects
text: My grandson, the photographer, uses a GoPro in his work as a nature photographer, scouting out new locales for pictures.  The  change in filters gives him ideas for still photos.  The filters come in a great little padded case.  Easy to change filters to experiment with different effects.

title: An inexpensive way to upgrade an old computer
text: My grandson found this easy to install in order to bring his older computer up to the RAM standards he needed for his photography work.  Ryan got it because it was taking forever to edit his photographs.  He is very pleased with the improvement this has made - cutting his work time and making him more efficient.

title: Noise-canceling particularly good
text: These earphones came with several tips so that you can be assured of finding a comfortable experience.  The sound quality is very good.  They come in a plastic case which doesn’t stay closed very well, but after you’ve selected what works for you and eliminated the rest, the case should close!  The cord is braided - very sturdy.  No company information or instructions.  When tested, they worked well.

title: Great for a photographer!
text: Not everybody needs the hard case and all the foam padding that you can use to secure your items, but for photographers, this as an essential item to transport cameras and lenses - and a bunch of other equipment.  My grandson finally feels secure about moving his stuff around through some pretty rough territory as a nature photographer.  These are very sturdy and built to take a beating.  Great choice!

title: What a joy!
text: It starts with the outside of the phonograph - looks a bit like a Louie Vuitton case - nice fittings - very nicely done.  Inside, the “arm” sits securely held down by a clip -and you check “phonograph”.  When you put your 33 RPM on the turntable it senses 33 and turns on.  You put the needle on the record, and the sound was not stereophonic - it was just like it was back in the 50’s!  Kinda tinny until you find the perfect sound level, and then it’s pure nostalgia!  Love this phonograph that plays my favorite old LP’s just the way I remember them!

title: Everything is easier with music...
text: On the farm, some of the jobs can get a bit monotonous - especially at planting time - when we go through the same motions over and over.  Music keeps us moving, and this bluetooth speaker really delivers great sound.  We try to play music that everybody likes, and it even inspires some to break into song!  Great  spirit lifter - and we love how well this wireless speaker works!

title: Unbelievable sound quality..
text: We needed an amplifier to hook this up, but now the plans for it are fantastic.  We will be showing outdoor movies and this will allow us to have a very professional sound system.  The speakers are heavy and a visitor told us that bodes well for producing a great bass range.  The whole home theater is fine quality, well-made, and we can’t wait to get it completely set up in a permanent location.

title: Rechargeable batteries ...
text: These are nearly as good as the Nikon brand, according to my grandson, the photographer.  He can take several hundred or so pictures before a battery charge  is necessary.  Both battery life and longevity are slightly less than Nikon batteries, but the price compensates for that difference.

title: A photographer’s necessity...
text: My grandson, the photographer, uses discs to send out images to his customers, display his work, store data and images for his use, etc.  After discovering that many are not as computer literate as he would wish, he’s come to rely on good quality discs such as these to relay his work.  The quantity makes these a really good buy.

title: Great supply for a farm
text: Seems like we have so many tools, flashlights, etc, that all use AAA batteries, and buying them has been a pain.  We have a good charger, so now we’re so much more ready for any needs.  I can’t attest to the longevity for these particular batteries, but we’ve used this brand before, and were happy with how long they lasted before recharge was necessary.  Expecting the same performance from these.

title: Any job goes faster with music...
text: Wireless earbuds are perfect.  My grandson listens to his music while he works and he is so pleased with these earbuds.  The sound quality is great - they’re comfortable - and no cords!  Of course,  when I call him, he doesn’t answer, but I like to see him happy in the tough jobs he  does here at the farm!  Great  earbuds!

title: Small but mighty!
text: Very small binoculars - easy to carry in a pocket or backpack.  Power is 8X - perfect for viewing a concert.  We’re hoping that they will help us on the farm - hard to see across some expanses of pasture - so we’ll see how they work for that.  Look like good quality.  Caps to cover lenses ae provided.

title: What we’ve been looking for...
text: Our gate is 100 yards from the front door, and we can’t see the gate.  This will give us the way to see who is at the gate and give them entrance.  We get loads of mail. And many times a package is heavy and is left outside the gate -no more!  This required a contractor-friend to install, but it’s already making a huge difference for us.  Great to be able to communicate with the gate and see who is there!  Great choice!

title: This is fantastic!
text: We have a big event coming and lots of summer visitors - so our motivation in getting this projector is to be able to show movies outside during the warmer weather.  We tried it out in our two story living room on a big, white wall, and the picture quality was amazing - the way to control it with the remote was great!  We’ll have a lot of outdoor camping in tents, so we can’t wait to show this to our guests on the next warm spring evening!

title: Perfect camera case..
text: This “hard shell” camera case will give your digital camera great protection.  It is roomy, in that it has pockets for essentials, too.  It comes with an attachable wristband.  Everything you want in a camera case.

title: Half camera protection
text: There is no doubt that a half case of red leather gives the lower half of the camera protection, and the camera really looks cool, but you really aren’t accomplishing much if you are after real protection for your camera.  Not having read this offering closely, I thought I was getting real protection, so didn’t accomplish my goal!  Nice camera half case, if that will do the trick for your Leica.

title: Too complicated
text: Required signing up for an account?  We’re ‘way out in the country, and had high hopes this would work for us in getting “big city” connectivity, but we’ve had nothing but trouble even finding someone who could set it up to work.  The several attempts haven’t been successful.  My “high tech” daughter finally gave up.  Perhaps I shouldn’t blame our problems getting connected on this device alone - we’ve been through several different situations trying to get my work-at-home daughter the service she needs.

title: A white keyboard makes a difference....
text: I’m using this keyboard to write this review.  I started off when my IPad was new, with a keyboard that came with the Pro.  They were connected and when I charged one, I was charging the whole thing.  Now, with a new keyboard I find that I have to charge both separately.  Perhaps you have always had this situation - I’m just getting used to it.  I love the white keyboard - makes it so much easier to type when you can really see the keys!  I write everything on my Pro - my reviews, emails, and my memoir, so finding one that worked well for me was important.  Very pleased.

title: Essential for the nature photographer..
text: My grandson spends most oF his time out “in the wilds” photographing products in a nature setting.  We love the GoPro because he can show us where he’s been and what he’s experienced.  He likes it because he can use it as a reference for the locations he wants to revisit.  The images are clear and consistent - and it’s been very helpful in his business.

title: Two devices to charge..
text: My IPad came with a keyboard attached so my habit was to charge the whole device and keyboard with one charge cord.  When that keyboard failed, I ordered this one - and one with a white keyboard to see which would work best for me.  This one works very well - some keys are different than my Apple one.  The case has a professional appearance and once I get used to charging two devices, I’ll be completely happy!

title: Great for the professional lady!
text: My daughter works from home, but often flies to the main office, taking her computer along.  She had been using a backpack, but it really didn’t add to her professional appearance much!  This tote has a place for everything - the laptop, her IPad, and cell phone, plus files and notepads.  She is very happy with this tote, as it completely satisfies her needs. It also has a lanyard for her car keys, so can double as a purse as well.

title: You never know when you’ll need one...
text: There are many kinds of batteries these days, so the need arises for a stash of different types.  The 28A is used in cameras and medical devices - and since we have both, we have them on hand.  The Duracell has proven to be long-lasting for us, primarily in cameras.

title: Granddaughter Approved...
text: My granddaughter is the Mac book user, and she also carries it with her and works wherever she stops.  So, she asked for these blockers to give her security while she works.  She reports that they are easy to install and stay put.  Good choice!

title: What every photographer needs
text: My grandson, the nature photographer had his equipment in many different bags, which had to make getting ready for a shot a time-consuming affair.  This allows him to have a place for everything and everything in its place.  He shoots nature shots for advertising, so ventures into some pretty isolated places away from civilization.  He loves this bag for the convenience it gives him.  It looks great, is well-made, and makes him look like the professional he is!

title: Initial resistance!
text: Why is there reluctance to use these very useful trackers - that save so much time in locating the important things that always disappear??  Once we bridged that reluctance, we’re raving about how easy these are to use - one tends to forget about them until you need to use them.  So, we’ve won over the household and keys and cell phones are easily and quickly found.  Great choice once you get folks to use them!

title: Easy to do - great to see those old times!😭
text: Cleaning out a closet, we found a bunch of old VHS tapes of family times - and we kept putting off trying to figure out what to do to save the pictures on them - when we saw this, and it worked perfectly to put those great old forgotten pictures on DVDs!  Great old memories preserved!

title: A festive look for the holidays!
text: This is a great quality string of lights, and will set our farmhouse up to be a festive scene for the holidays.  We have lights all around the wraparound deck, so these are going up on the entry gates leading up the drive.  We have had another Mr. Beams string on our back deck for over a year, where we barbecue and make s’mores - and we’ve yet to replace a bulb.  It’s worked perfectly.

title: So much better than the old ones!
text: It’s a bit difficult to get used to a wireless mouse after years of dragging a cord around.  After we got it set up, it really was so much easier to work with.  Looks good on the desk, too - one less cord is appreciated!

title: Easy to install, very bright...
text: We wondered who was eating our ripe apples and leaving the cores on the ground.  This motion sensor light on the barn showed us the family of deer who were enjoying them!  Well, whatcha gonna do?  Nothing - it was too cute and after all, how many could they eat?  So we continue to share our apples with this family of four - and there are still plenty left for us!  Great to see the light come on and see the deer!

title: Perfect for our deck!
text: Our deck parties get lots of compliments especially for the Tiki torches - and this one is great!  We have 6 of them - all different, so folks actually take the time to wander around and check each of them out!  They burn a long time, are easy to light and extinguish - easy to keep clean,  Good choice!

title: They work almost better than expected!
text: My grandson is a nature photographer - sometimes combining  products with nature.  He sets up a lot of equipment, and these sandbags are just what he needed to keep things steady.  Even a gentle breeze an cause a light stand to sway, so he makes good use of these sandbags.  Just one more essential tool for his photography - he is very pleased to have them.

title: Kudos for comfort!
text: These were given five stars by all the guests over the Labor Day weekend - I guess it’s inevitable these days that guests are all going to pull out their phones and drift away from the conversation - so I was glad that we had these headphones to offer.  Many compliments on the clarity and comfort.

title: Great choice - fast charging!
text: With visitors arriving often, we never seemed to have as many charging stations as we needed - that charged fast enough!  If they charge quickly, you can get by with fewer stations - so this one really answered are needs.  Instead of charging areas on practically every flat surface, now we have one upstairs and one down - thank goodness for the reduction of clutter!  Great choice!

title: Won’t fit my IPad, but it’ll work well for another family member!
text: I have an IPad Pro 9.7, and, for some reason, this did not fit.  It was a quality case and keyboard, but it wouldn’t work for my IPad. I measured my IPad and perhaps I didn’t do it correctly.  With my huge family, this is sure to fit someone’s so we’ll see.  I wish it fit mine, because it is good-looking, and I like the way the keyboard is set up.

title: Easy to install - love the difference!
text: We finally got the help we needed to install our TV up on the wall.  It makes such a great difference to be able to have it up where everyone can see it - and to be able to turn it to a comfortable viewing setting,  Frankly, we needed the help of the men of the family to get this installed - not because it was difficult - but because of the size of our TV and the heaviness involved.  Instructions were good, and all parts were included to make this a successful installation!

title: Fill’s the bill for a college student...
text: This is the perfect backpack if you carry a 15” laptop, as it carries that and much more.  It’s a great medium-size backpack that has replaced my grandson’t larger one, which was too heavy.  This is light and loaded with places for everything.  He’s very pleased to go off to college this fall with this backpack.

title: An essential for a MacBook Pro!
text: My granddaughter with the MacBook Pro finally came to visit, so I was able to get her reaction to this Adapter.  She is quite pleased with it - gets a faster charge than usual - and rattled off a number of benefits she didn’t expect.  In her job, keeping her MacBook up to speed is essential so she is very happy to have this tool.  She is very tech savvy, so I trust her judgement - and if she says this is a good product, it is!

title: Crisp, clear sound, longer battery life!
text: These earphones are a whole level above what I’ve had.  The noise elimination is a huge plus when a lot is going on around you - that feature never worked this well for me.  Also, the sound quality is crisp and clear and for someone whom is a bit hard of hearing that is a huge benefit.  Very pleased with these earphones - longer battery life and the charging case are really a good features traveling.

title: Great results for a nature photographer...
text: My professional photographer grandson should be writing this review.  Although I don’t understand completely what this does, my grandson understands it completely and is thrilled with his results in using it.  He remarked especially about the color balance, which is difficult to achieve when one is photographing nature - which is his  specialty.  He also photographs products in a nature setting for marketing departments - and tells me that he is able to get great results since he began using this.

title: Doesn’t work in our remote area...
text: I had great hopes for this antenna, as we are having all kinds of trouble with our reception despite nearby towers.  I thought this might cut through whatever the interference is that’s causing us problems.  We live in a foothill area about 100 miles from a major city, and we obviously need an expert to set us up.  This is probably good quality - but it just doesn’t help us in this area.  We’ve given it a good try.

title: A convincer for those who are reluctant!
text: This came along at the right time and convinced this 83 year old grandma of the need.  We recently moved to a 12 acre farm, which begs to be roamed - and is such a draw for any nature-lover.  But, stepping in a gopher hole could break a leg or sprain an ankle - so we’re feeling much relieved to have this ‘guardian” that works like a charm.  At first one feels a bit funny being “tracked” - but, out of sight of the farmhouse, it’s really comforting to know that somebody knows where you are - and you can call for help.  Good choice!

title: Cute, colorful and protective!
text: I hoped that this would fit my IPad Pro, but I should have read the fine print!  All is not lost as it does fit my daughter’s IPad and she tells me that it has added a lot of convenience to her experience.  She is hard on her devices so the cover is a necessity - she likes the pattern and colors - and, she tells me she gets questions about where she got it - so she’s happy to tell them “Amazon”.  Hopefully, with this cover, this device will have a longer life!

title: Much better than the old earbuds!
text: Took a bit to get used to these earbuds - but now, with consistent use, the noise-canceling feature is truly appreciated.  Took some help from a grandson to get set up with the Bluetooth connection, and getting used to being wireless, but now, I’ve thrown my old earbuds away!  I like books on tape, so I am really enjoying them now.  This grandma is a believer - great product!

title: Carries everything you need, plus!
text: This is a great gym bag.  It has space for everything you want to bring - and the real plus is the mirror!  After carrying two or three separate bags, this really fills the bill to carry my laptop, a change of clothes, cosmetics, a towel, etc.  It’s attractive, too, and I keep getting questions about where I got it.  Great find.

title: Works well on the MacBook...
text: My granddaughter just started a new job, and her first complaint was losing privacy.  This fits her MacBook Laptop and did the trick for her.  Makes all the difference in feeling secure on the job.

title: Great idea for the disorganized!
text: Working from home with nobody looking over your shoulder makes for bad habits - like allowing the desk to be totally cluttered.  This organizer has made a difference corralling cords and putting the small stuff in handy reach.  One of the best things - it caused me to totally reorganize and get rid of stuff I didn’t use - so now, I can work without all the interruptions trying to find things!  This is a great tool - and a good choice for those who need organization!

title: Very sturdy - easy to set up and carry.
text: This was just what my grandson needed for his photography trips into remote locations.  It’s fairly lightweight and easy to set up.  He enjoys the pictures he gets setting this up to take pictures at night. - seeing animals moving  around and catching them unaware.  The tripod is very sturdy and is perfect for his use.

title: Great for the wildlife photographer!
text: My grandson is a photographer who hikes off to remote locations for highly original photos.  This has been invaluable to being able to see what lies ‘way ahead - and spotting wildlife.  Best of all, it’s lightweight and hardly adds any weight to his backpack.  This was an excellent choice for him.

title: Excellent sound quality - and we love the color!
text: One more thing to stop all conversation!  Our granddaughter loves these - first of all, the color - and then the sound quality.  It was difficult to separate her from them when it was study time, but the good thing is that she likes them enough to take care of them.  We’ve bought so many earbuds - it looks like this set may actually be around for a while.  The sound quality is excellent - we had to give them a try!

title: At last, no more neck aches!
text: Just what I have been looking for - a way to have my monitor at eye level - that might have a drawer, too!  After coping with neck aches for far too long, finally, the answer for relief is this riser.  Several levels possible - easy to set up - drawer to hold pens, markers, paper clips right at my fingertips!  It has pads on the legs so it doesn’t mar my desk.  What a difference this makes!

title: Necessary cord for my Mophie.
text: This is what I needed for my Mophie charger - it came with a cord to charge itself, but not with one to charge my IPhone or IPad.  So, this was the perfect answer for that need!

title: The Dell does not disappoint.
text: I am thrilled with this Dell computer.  I was limping along with a much inferior brand - and I really didn’t know what I was missing until I got my Dell set up and started using it.  I essentially write on the computer, so am most concerned with finding a comfortable way to create.  The Dell is very responsive, has great memory, and looks great on my desk.  The “All in one” is a real advantage when space is a problem.  Very happy with this Dell computer.

title: Better sound, lower volume.
text: My Samsung Tv’s sound was coming out the back, so now it’s in the front.  I can keep the volume lower and the sound is more crisp!  Good purchase!

title: For the serious, physically active...
text: Not being a runner myself, I can only report the reactions of my grandson to this watch.  He’s practically obsessed with it, as it gives him all the info he’s been recording in a notebook about how far, how fast, etc. in his quest for good health and strength.  He hasn’t been a watch wearer, but he wears this one now.  For the serious, active, health “nut”, this is a great gift.

title: It’s “a bomb”!
text: We hooked it up to our TV for a Seahawk’s football party, and it was proclaimed “the bomb”!  For ears younger than mine, it was proclaimed a super-great football experience.  We certainly didn’t miss a thing, and those Seahawks fans, known for their extraordinary decibels, came through very loud and clear.  For the older set, we could sit in the next room and not miss a thing!  This definitely is an enhancement for music - made a Bruno Mars concert sound like it was in our living room.  My family loves the concert quality.

title: Understated and cool...
text: This is a beautiful watch - and very “manly” for the man in the family who has not worn one since the cell phone came out!  More and more, it’s watches like this one who are bringing back the convenience of wearing a watch.  Especially one that has as many functions as this one! It takes a bit to master all the features, but the man in our family who received it, had it all figured out in no time.  How the watch looks seems to be very important these days, and our guy revolted against having a “hunk of iron” on his wrist.  This watch changed his attitude - it’s much lighter weight than those “hunks of iron”, and looks very understated and cool!  Good choice!

title: Great keyboard and battery life...
text: I really like this keyboard case, and just wish it fit my IPad!  Didn't read closely enough - and the devil is in the details - mine is an IPad Pro, and that makes a difference.  So, read carefully and make sure this one will fit your device.  What I love about it, aside from the long battery life, is the keyboard itself.  The black keys are set in a silver background, which makes them so much easier to see.  All my keyboards have been black on black, so I've had to really pay attention when typing.  This case folds up nicely and provides some safety for your IPad, too.  If it would only fit my device!  Someone in my family will have an IPad that fits, and they will be the happy receivers!

title: Makes the IPad feel new again!
text: This brightens up my beatup IPad and makes it feel new again!  Nice quality - easy to put on and take off, and provides good protection when my grandchildren borrow it!  Like the color!

title: No more painful neck!
text: Oh, my gosh, - what a difference this makes.  I'd been walking around wondering why I have a painful neck, when my daughter suggested that my hours sitting in front of the computer might be the problem.  Yes, I was looking down to the screen, which was not a good position for my neck.  Now, I'm looking straight at the screen, and it has made all the difference.  I liked that you can use fewer "feet" if you want a lower position.  My computer was perfect using all the "feet".  Great idea...

title: Like a piece of fine luggage!
text: Beautifully structured, this is perfect for the professional who travels and commutes.  What's really impressive is the number of compartments, the quality of the construction and overall appearance.  So many "backpacks" get out of shape with continued use.  The Lexington is like a piece of fine luggage, and looks as though it will retain it's shape for many years to come. I was also impressed with the light weight.  What a wonderful gift for the young professional!  And, graduations are coming up!

title: Good sound quality - completes our patio.
text: This  works beautifully to spread music around our outdoor patio.  Now if it will just stop raining, we'll be able to sit out there and enjoy it!  This wireless techno-speaker is a wonder for me.  I don't want to show my ignorance by asking the younger generation too many questions.  So, all I know is that it was easy for the family to set up, and out came the most beautiful music.  The sound quality is wonderful.  We had something before that sounded tinny.  Our dog is very curious about it, but so far has not attempted to pick it up!  This really completes our patio redo.  It's very comfortable around the firepit with the music - very relaxing, with our choice of music.  I'm very pleased with this, and look forward to many spring and summer evenings  outdoors with music.

title: A godsend to watch our 6 month-old puppy!
text: We ordered this because the home office is upstairs and the six-month old chocolate lab puppy is confined loosely downstairs.  We don't like to confine him in a kennel while we work for hours.  At this point now, we are able to keep track of what he is up to and get to him before he demolishes things!  We have more tests to come for different purposes, but, frankly, this is working so well that it will be a while before we experiment.  So far, this has been a godsend - it works great, and allows a lot more productivity while we are still able to keep an eye on him.  Highly recommend this!

title: Great film but pricey!
text: Film for the Fuji Instant camera.  Only complaint is that it costs a lot for tiny pictures.  My grandchildren had a ball taking pictures of our Thanksgiving event - they had no trouble replacing film.  Hope the price comes down.

title: Great for parties!
text:
It's easy to install the batteries and the film. I wish the instructions for taking a picture were a bit more detailed. Having five different languages makes it all very confusing. I figured it out through process of elimination and the pictures. I'm still not sure if it turns off in-between pictures - as it seemed like I had to hit the power button again, which releases the lens before snapping a second picture. This will be fun for my grandchildren - we'll turn them loose to capture our Thanksgiving Day - with their dad helping with the procedure. It's a great size - and the button to take the pictures is conveniently located. It does produce a sharp, crisp picture, even for a neophyte like me! They will be amazed that they can see the picture right away and carry it home.
Amended after Thanksgiving: How to take a picture was no problem for my five year old twins, who picked up the camera gleefully and proceeded to capture our entire festivities! Great, crisp pictures - must be very forgiving for small, shaky hands, as there was nary a blur! Great little camera - and lots of fun for the grandchildren!

title: Nothing better than Bose!
text: These headphones are already getting a workout!  My granddaughter had her heart rate in just minutes out of the box, and, after taking them on a run, she had nothing but good things to say about them.  First, she enjoys the fact that there is nothing on her head - just a wire connection lightly on her neck.  Second, the sound of her favorite music left her almost speechless to describe - clear, sharp - the best sound quality she had ever heard - and to be able to take this with her on a walk or run, was wonderful!  Third, these headphones have turned out to be a motivator - she now looks forward to the exercise, is choosing music suitable for her yoga exercises, etc.  Wow, it's great to see the smile on her face and the difference these headphones have made in her physical activity.  She reminds me that they are also great for  just "chilling out"!  I had hoped to try these out for myself, but it looks like possession is nine tenth of the law!

title: Sound quality is excellent.
text: This review will make techies squirm, I'm sure.  I chose the wireless headphones, not to connect them to eight devices - just to connect them wirelessly to my IPad so that I can watch movies and things like House of Cards on Netflix without driving the rest of the family crazy.  I need the sound up higher than the family, so I can happily see my favorites at my own sound level, noiselessly!  The sound quality is excellent.  As time goes on. I'm sure my family will show me many more ways I can enjoy these headphones,  For now, I am totally satisfied with them using them as I am!

title: Toshiba has a winner!
text:
I know just enough about computers to be considered dangerous. I'm a whiz on my desktop with Windows 8 and my IPad, which has apps that cover my needs. My needs are email, Facebook and Microsoft Word for writing, The first "aha" came when I got this lap-top up and running, got it connected to wifi (all easy for any level of expertise), and then discovered that there was no Microsoft Office containing Word. Windows 10 takes a bit to get comfortable with, but the more I work with it, I can see some definite benefits over Windows 8. Working on downloading Office,

I write, so Word Is important, along with some apps that provide writing tools. I was surprised by the apps that come with the laptop. I appreciate Amazon, but I am not a gamer (except Words with Friends and Solitaire). Dropbox will come in handy.

The laptop looks good - exudes quality and belies it's inexpensive price point. This should be ideal for children, or someone like me, who writes and likes being able to write wherever I go. I know there are features I will learn about, which I'll eventually use and appreciate. Right now, I am just glad for the quality, portability and ease of operation. We have other Toshiba devices in our family, and have always been impressed by the quality - and their customer service, when there is a question.

title: Great sound quality!
text: I was particularly pleased with the sound quality - my play list is primarily jazz and easy listening oldies, some of which were original recordings. Regardless of age, the sound comes through crisp and clear.  Very comfortable as well.  I very often use the ear buds while watching PBS shows on my IPad - perfect sound quality for me, and no nuisance for those who are not interested!

title: A great choice!
text: I love this case - it's sharp-looking, and and makes using the Fire HD a breeze.  I was looking for a case that was sturdy, and had some flair to it, too.  I get lots of compliments on the case, and many don't realize that it's a case for a device.  They think that it's a very classy-looking purse!  All in all. this was a great choice.

title: Just what I needed
text: My charger fell into a black hole somewhere,or was "borrowed" by some Kindle person in my family - so instead of having a knock down drag out inquisition to assess blame, I just ordered a new set-up.  Arrived in three days, and works like a charm.  No muss, no fuss, family relationships intact!

title: Wow - a life changer!
text: I don't know if I've found the primary use for these headphones, but they are making life great for me!  Always causing too much noise when I watch movies on my IPad, I now plug in my super comfortable headphones, and get all the sound that only I can hear, at a level that allows me to get every word of the dialogue.  When there is music, it is full and rich!  One of the best parts, too, is how generously padded these headphones are - they are really comfortable for hours of movies and music!

title: Adds a whole new dimension to life!
text: This couldn't have arrived at a better time - my granddaughter left to study in London for the spring semester, so I can attest to the fact that this hooks up easily and quickly.  We are spending so many wonderful times not only hearing from her, but seeing where she is living, seeing her and her new friends and generally being part of her "action".  As advertised the sound quality can't be beat, and the picture is clear and crisp. What a difference this makes in our lives!

title: Not using
text: Bought for my note 4 but did not plug easily into it.  I stopped using it so it didn't damage the inlet.

title: Great service. Beautiful product
text: Great service.  Beautiful product.  Thanks.

title: They have found a way to put just about everything that one could want in a small space
text: It is nice to have everything that I could possibly need in such a small convenient space. Everything seems to work well considering that I haven't had the chance to really run it through its paces. I have not had any problems and heat has not been an issue either. At the price and build quality, I'm not sure that there is anything better.

title: This worked Great! My HP ENVY is alive...ish.  :)
text: Very easy to install saving a $1,000 laptop.

title: I like it!
text: I have two Fire HD 10 Tablets so this is the second cover that I've bought. this one was about $7 less but it doesn't feel as sturdy. Other than that, I've had no issues with it. I Like It!

title: I like it a lot
text: I like it a lot! I had an idea what it was supposed to do and it has done that and more.

title: Five Stars
text: This has worked flawlessly.

title: Pretty much everything that was promised was provided
text: Pretty much everything that was promised was provided. I have Xfinity, Fire TV with 4k Ultra HD, and an Xbox 1S plugged in going out to a DR.J Projector. I haven't used the 5V power port or USB power cable as mine was not included as advertised. Other than that all is good. I'm going to ask the company why my cable wasn't sent; they seem to be honestly interested in what their customers think. Stay tuned for their reply.

title: I'm not sure if it's this card or my Fire ...
text: I'm not sure if it's this card or my Fire HD 10 that is at fault but about 30% of the time that I open my Fire it shows that my card has been removed, but it hasn't been. I haven't figured out what to do to correct this but eventually, my card is seen again.

title: Need a compact travel tripod?  Here ya go.
text:
This thing makes me laugh because I keep losing it. All of my equipment is so bulky and heavy, this little package gets lost in the shadows. That said, once you find it, you will be surprised as to how they built such a solid tripod from such small and spindly parts. Kind of a miracle.

I am easily able to bring this with me in a carry-on suitcase.... it is lightweight but surprisingly stable. Also much taller than expected for such a small package. I'd buy this over and over again.

title: Sounds Great, good quality
text: I'd buy these again in a heartbeat.  Affordable, good quality.

title: I WANT to love this... it's good, not great
text: The mounting system pushes this handle too far away from the camera.  No comfortable way to reach the camera controls from the holding position.  I know another videographer who got the same handset and feels the same way.  The quality is reasonable, unclear if the nubs will snap off if they take a hit.  I basically love all things SmallRig make (and I own a heck of a lot of SmallRig products)... this one is not my favorite for the cost.

title: Pass
text: I wanted this to be great, but it isn't.  It shows up in the footage too often.  Since it isn't connected to the camera, any time you really start to push the drone, you see the hood enter the frame.

title: BEST ON THE MARKET
text: By Far.  Nothing more to say other than you won't find any umbrella holder of any cost point that matches the quality of this.  I own six of them now.  Really, truly incredible and blows everyone elses similar product away.

title: Expensive, but worth it
text: I have to say, I get giddy every time I open my audio equipment case with this insert.  Easy to customize, but really think about it before you start cutting, you are committing yourself with your cuts.  The system is awesome, but I really think it should come with extra clips.  I own three of these inserts and each time I came up short and had to buy a pack of additional clips.

title: Pass
text: I have to admit, this product makes no sense to me.  I actually thought that I was going to be able to plug one cable in, and feed the signal to any output.  But this seems to be a product that for every one input, you get two outputs. Though that functionality changes based on which side you plug in to and whether you use a balanced or unbalanced cable.  The ports seem a bit weak, and the instructions are basically useless.  I wouldn't buy this again.  I only gave it an extra star because I purchased the wrong item, but part of why I bought the wrong item is that the description provided by HOSA isn't very good.

title: Added functionality... but for a price
text: I really like these, they add quite a bit of extra functionality to my Fresnels.  That said, I thing the price should be half what it is.  I have bought two of these kits and MIGHT buy a third.  Not because I feel like this is a great deal, but because I want to have a kit for each of my three lights and there are no better options.  I have used these kits quite a few times and they get the job done quickly.

title: BIG SURPRISE... this monitor is great.  Shockingly good for the price.
text: Of course, it is not going to compare to a $1,200 high-end monitor, but it is really truly a great little monitor and well worth twice the price.  It is very light (until you attach the battery) and is perfect for general use, lightweight rigs, gimbals, etc.  The tools (Focus, exposure, etc) are on the clunky side compared to high end monitors, but they work perfectly.  Really, I can't believe this thing.  The quality of the image is shockingly good.  Not only that, it doesn't go dead when I shoot 4k like my older Small HD monitors do.  I would buy this again and again.

title: SUPER HIGH QUALITY
text: These cables are lickable.  They are as beautiful as they are solid.  Would definitely buy again and again.  I wish I could give six stars.

title: Not Varizooms best product... flimsy and broke too quickly.
text: Wanted to love it.... but it didn't last long enough to get much past liking it.

title: Perfect bag.
text: Perfect.  Light, but solid enough to protect the bird.  Plenty of space for extras.

title: Awesome filters
text: These are great.  Just be aware that your Phantom 4 gimbal lock will not fit with one of these filters in place.... these add a few millimeters to the depth of the camera and the DJI gimbal lock doesn't have any room.  Buy the Polar Pro gimbal lock instead... perfect, small, and easy to use.

title: I want to love it... I just can't
text: I WANT to love it... but it is just a little too lightweight to perform admirably with a larger phone.  It does fit the iPhone 6, but it barely holds it up and I can't come close to trusting that it will stay attached to a metal surface with the underpowered magnets in the feet.  I'll keep it, but not for what I had intended.

title: Awesome flash... just be aware that the UV bulbs are different in color than non-UV
text: Love it, but I'm surprised at the different kelvin value of the UV light bulb.  It doesn't mix with my other PL lights so I either need to buy all UV or all non-UV bulbs.

title: Excellent... but it takes a lot of work to get it there...
text:
Beautiful image, but you have quite a few hoops to jump through to get it there. If you are satisfied with the overly-processed "Demo-Mode" look of the TV out of the box, you are good to go... unless you also play video games on the TV.. then you have a challenge and learning curve to get the TV to cooperate.

Luckily for me, I am VERY tech savvy, but even with years of experience it took me several days of tweaking to get the TV to an acceptable level of video and audio quality. I was actually very surprised at how difficult it was to get the TV to perform reasonably. Be prepared to hit google and do some searches. If the Amazon people will allow me, let me point you to rtings dot com. (yes, rtings). They have done extensive setup work on this (and dozens of other TVs) and are invaluable in helping you to get this TV looking and sounding good as quickly as possible. (I am not affiliated with this website in any way... there is no cost to get the help... they are just a review site for TVs.

Anyway, once you jump through the hoops, you will have a TV that is exceptional for TV, movies, and gaming....

title: Disappointed in the poor quality and short life span of this Amazon brand product
text: Cord separated from lightning connector end after a little more than a year of gentle use.  Disappointed in the quality and short life span of this Amazon brand product, and will keep it in mind when making future purchases of any Amazon branded product.

title: Product OK, service great
text: Had issues with this cable 6 months down the road and the seller provided a replacement at no cost.  2nd cable going strong so far. . .

title: Good
text: The watch is great, only drawback is battery life. It would be better if battery lasted more than 24hrs.

title: Loving It!!!!
text: The sound quality is amazing!

title: Awesome!
text: My granddaughter loves these headphones. The design and sound quality are AMAZING!

title: Pretty
text: They will disconnect mid conversation and reconnect.

title: Love this speaker
text:
I love these types of speakers and this one works great. It is easy to use. It pairs great without any issues and is just so easy to use. The sound quality is great and the volume gets nice and loud. I don't usually use them for the phone so I am not concerned with that function nor do I test it but am sure it works just fine.

I like these because I can still hear what is going on around me which is especially important when I am at work. They still allow me to listen to music though, perfect solution. The price is also pretty good for it. All in all very happy with this one especially since it is very light and you barely feel that it is there.

title: Very nice speaker for the shower or on the go
text:
This is a great little water proof speaker. It is super easy to use and paired within seconds. It has a suction cup holder to attach to the tiles and also a carabiner that can hook onto anything really. You can control your music that you are connected to easily from it and it is pretty much intuitive to use.

The sound quality is nice and it gets pretty loud all considering, not blasting loud but loud enough for your bathroom. The battery has a nice life too so no complaints there. All in all very happy with this.

title: Performs as advertised
text:
This is exactly the splitter I needed allowing me to use the same screen with different laptops when ever I need to. I just toggle back and forth as I need to until I get another monitor / space for it but for the time being this is working out great.

Works well without any glitches so far.

title: Great what for you pay for
text: Let's put this in perspective here. You pay $10 for a little earbud here that is for what you pay for, fantastic really. It is a tiny little earbud that fits great, stays where it is supposed to unlike some others I have tried in the past that I have to constantly adjust, has a pretty good battery life at over 10 hours, good sound quality and is super discrete. You can barely tell it is there which I like since for some purposes I just don't want it to be seen at times. I was actually looking for one just like it and this one is perfect. The one thing I would like is a case or something to keep it protected and not loose it since it is so darn small and easy to loose. Other than that there really is nothing wrong with it. Simple to use, easy and I really don't use these for phone calls so I don't need fancy functions and for that price, really don't ask for crazy extras.

title: Just what everyone needs really
text:
Why, do they make laptops with only like two, if you are lucky, USB ports these days? Let's face it, you need at least one for your mouse, but usually more for like a headset, wireless or plug in and if you need to transfer data or do anything else you need to start plugging in and out.

So with this little gadget, you plug this one in and plug everything else into it and leave it like it. Perfect solution to a failing PC industry in my eyes who is getting cheaper and cheaper by eliminating those USB ports. Having 7 USB charging ports or transfer ports if you need and 1 USB-C port is enough for me.

title: Handy little bag
text:
I really like this laptop case. It is well made and very convenient. You can keep all your essentials you carry along nice and organized with the compartments on the inside. I like that it fully opens up so you can really access everything when you want to.

The size is perfect and you can expand it if you need to carry around more things. This little bag can pack quite the punch and is fantastic in my opinion. For this price it really has everything I was looking for. It repells water but is not waterproof, but enough to protect your things when you get caught briefly in some rain. All in all couldn't be happier.

title: Great tablet cover
text:
This is a great table cover. I wasn't crazy about the color but it was the only one they had at the time so I got used to it. The cover is very well made and fits perfectly. I like that it came with the keyboard, the main reason I got it. You can remove the keyboard though if you want to and on occasion I do.

The keyboard is backlit which is great so you can see it in the dark since it is a different size than my usual ones, which at times makes me prone for typing errors. The keyboard paired easily and I had no issues with that. All in all this is great but the rose gold did take me some time to get use to but I do really like this a lot.

title: Exactly the cable I needed
text: This is a great cable to connect your laptop or tablet to an extra monitor you have to get some extra screen. These days having extra USB ports are rare so using an USB-C is a must have and most tablets often don't even have an USB port. This cable did exactly what I needed it to. It is sturdy and has a good length so even if I move around a little bit I am still good. I love the fact that I can even connect my cell phone to the monitor if I want to. Just perfect.

title: Well they are zip ties
text: Well these are zip ties, your standard zip ties that work well for your odds and end jobs that we always come across and need zip ties for. I am happy with these and glad I have some around the house since you never know when you need more of them. Work as advertised.

title: Works as promised
text: This privacy screen will protect your information when you are out in public with your laptop and protect your information on your screen from prying eyes. It is easy to put on the screen and take of when you don't need it if you choose to do so. Very happy.

title: Fits as expected
text: This lap top case fits a 13.5 inch lap top perfectly. It protects your lap top inside your bags or just when you carry it around like that. It has a cute design on it which is why I got it in the first place. It is pretty nicely made and should hold up well. It has enough room in it to keep some documents with it if you want.

title: My favorite messenger bag
text:
I love these messenger type bags. They are small enough to not be too bulky but are large enough to have room for your essentials like your wallet, phone, keys, tablet even and more. If you are out and about running errands and are picking up some things there is enough room in there to store smaller items. I like that it has various pockets in there so you can keep it organized and it makes it easy to find everything. These are especially great for traveling when you need quick access to passport or other travel papers. Even big enough for a smaller laptop!

The material is nice and sturdy and these are well made. This one should hold up well and is my go to bag whenever I really go anywhere and need to bring more than just phone and keys. Love it.

title: Fantastic speakers
text:
I really like these neck speakers. It gives you a surround sound without having to use headphones that obstruct your ears. This to me is important especially at work or when I still need to be able to hear what is around me. I can easily use the controls without seeing them, since they are very simple to use. The volume can get very loud which is great so you don't have to give that up. These paired really easily with my phone and tablet so no issues there. They last a long time too which is great so I don't have to constantly charge them.

They are lightweight and I can barely feel that they are there. I wish they were a bit more flexible to be honest. I have some other sets as well that are a bit different but these are very good and I love using them.

title: Junk, won't connect again after the first time that it worked
text:
The initial use of this camera was a success. It was easy to use and install although the camera quality was not very impressive to be honest. the quality of the picture was a bit lackluster to say the least but I figure oh well, not too bad.

Then the next time I wanted to use it for a meeting I couldn’t connect it at all and haven’t been able to since. This is junk, plain and simple and it went in the trash since I can’t keep wasting trying to connect it and get it to work.

title: Convenient, comfortable and can get really loud
text:
This is my second set of neckband speaker I have. I listen to music a lot, pretty much all the time especially when I am at work. Thankfully the environment allows me to use this neckband speakers to listen to music that way. It is actually safer to do that than having headsets on which can isolate you and could prevent you from realizing what is going on around you. That is why I like using these types of speakers or bone conducting headsets, so I can still hear what is going on around me.

This one in comparison to my other one especially is a lot lighter, I barely notice that it is there really. It is not as flexible as my other one but it forms nicely around my neck and really works and fits well that way. It has just the right amount of buttons that allows me to blindly control it without having to take out my phone to move onto the next song, change the volume, pause the music in case I have to talk to someone and really do anything I need to.

The sound quality is very nice and you can really get a good volume going with this so no worry, you will still have plenty of volume if you want to blast music into your ears. It is very easy to use and to connect to your phone. I have a Samsung S20 and had no issues at all. I get about 7 hours or so of music which gives me about a work day worth of music and charging doesn’t take that long. My other one does have more staying power and does charge a bit faster, but by having these two I can now alternate, while one is charging I can use the other one. Very happy with this one but if anything changes I will update my review.

title: Great shorter USB-C cables
text:
AGVEE makes some very nice charging cables. In this one you get 3 cables that are 1.5 feet long each. The cables are the braided types that I like the most because they are just a lot more sturdy than the regular kinds are. These are USB-C cables that are capable of fast charging and work beautifully with my Samsung S20+. You also get a little leather strap that allows you to contain your “cable mess’.

Getting 3 of these for $16 is a pretty good deal especially these really long ones. These are perfect for when you need just that extra length so you don’t run out of cable.

title: Fantastic 3-pack

There are a few times when I just don’t need or want a long USB-C charging cable. This is usually when I charge something in my car or something on my desk directly from my laptop. So I found these cables and in this pack you get 3 USB-C cables that are just 1.5 feet long. These are perfect and allow me to fast charge my Samsung S20+ when I need to. Sometimes you just don’t want all that extra cable because it just gets in the way and this is when you use this cable.

It is nice and sturdy and should hold up nicely. The braided cables tend to hold up better in my eyes and also look a lot better as well.

title: Beautiful red fast charging cable
text:
This is a very nice cable by Avyxm. This is a USB-C to USB-C straight cable in a stunning bright red. The cord itself is a nice braided cable that keeps it nice and sturdy. This one is 4 feet long. It is a fast charging cable that works very well.

This cable seems to work for fast charging as long as your phone and charging output both are cable of supporting a fast charge. This cable is on the shorter side which is exactly what I was looking for, a 4ft length. This is great for charging around the car or whenever you are fairly close to the outlet.

title: Fantastic cable
text:
This is a very nice cable. I got a USB to USB-C straight cable in gray. The cord itself is a nice braided cable that keeps it nice and sturdy. This one is 3.3feet long. It is a fast charging cable that works very well.

This cable seems to work for fast charging as long as your phone and charging output both are cable of supporting a fast charge. This cable is on the shorter side which is exactly what I was looking for, a 3.3ft length. This is great for charging around the car or whenever you are fairly close to the outlet.

title: Exactly as described
text:
This is a very nice cable. I got a USB to USB-C 90 degree angle cable. The cord itself is a nice braided cable that keeps it nice and sturdy. The reason why I am slowly switching all my cables over to this type, the 90 degree angle at the phone end is just so much better. It doesn't get in the way and is not as prone to damage as the regular straight on ending.

This cable seems to work for fast charging as long as your phone and charging output both are cable of supporting a fast charge. This cable is on the shorter side which is exactly what I was looking for, a 3.3ft length. This is great for charging around the car or whenever y ou are fairly close to the outlet. I am glad I finally got what I was asking for.

title: Great variety pack for USB-C to USB-C cable!
text:
This is a great inexpensive 3 pack for just $12. You get 1.5ft, 3.3ft and 6.6ft cable that are all very well made. I really am a fan of the braided nylon cables since these are really super sturdy and hold up well to every day use. These cables have on both ends the USB-C end and are fantastic for fast charging for all the phones and gadgets that can be fast charged.

In this variety pack you get 3 different lengths so you have the right one for what you need and let's face it, you don't need the same length all the time. At that price this is a great deal and you get quality cables for different uses. I can only recommend these.

title: Great deal - fantastic 4 pack
text:
This is a great inexpensive 4 pack for just $11. You get 1x 3ft, 2x 6ft and 1x 10ft cable that are all very well made. I love the braided cables and they feel extremely sturdy and should hold up very well over time. These cables are USB-A to USB-C cables. They work well for fast charging as long as you have a compatible phone and charger and use the wall plug in for it all. You get this variety pack so you have a cable for every application really.

The 10 feet long one is perfect for charging my phone from the wall plug in and have enough length to get to the night stand. It still gives me plenty of length that I can actually have my phone plugged in and still use my phone while laying on the bed!

At that price this is a great deal and you get quality cables for different uses. I can only recommend these.

title: Big fan of these L-shapped cables - worth every penny
text:
This is an inexpensive USB-A to USB-C cable at $4. I have to say the USB-A cable end is pretty weird and doesn't look like it usually does, it just doesn't have the housing basically. Why they make it like that I don't know. But it works like that without any issues it is just a bit tricky the first time to plug it in to get used to it.

The cable material is very nice and feels very solid and sturdy. I am a huge fan of the 90 degree angle at the plug in. I just feels it makes it easier to hold your phone when you still work with it and also seems more durable and reduces break off. That was one of the main reasons I got this one. I just hated the old regular design and wanted to give this one a try and really like it a lot. The cable is 3 feet long, so not the greatest there but it has its applications.

title: Easy to install and easy to use - very user friendly
text:
In the package you get the camera, the suction cup mount, the cable, instructions, a micro SD card and the cigarette charger. First you just have to download the app and then pair the camera to your phone. It is super easy to pair and I had no issues with that. Then you just set up the camera in your car and whenever the car starts up the camera gets power and it starts up. It then connects to your phone and it automatically starts recording.

It really couldn't get much easier than that. You don't have to do anything for this to work or remember to do anything. In the beginning it asks you to access certain aspects of your phone like GPS and you do those. Oh yeah and make sure you add the SD card to the camera as well.

You don't really have to get the paid app unless you want to. The one downside, if you want to view the videos you have to have the camera near by. It also records the route if you enable the GPS on the camera. The picture quality is pretty good during day time driving with and without sun glare as well as during the night. I haven't experienced a lot of rain yet so I can't say how it handles that but I don't think it will be too bad either. For the price and what you get this is a pretty good deal. In today's age when accidents happen easily, it is always a good idea to have a little extra protection on hand to be honest. All in all I am pretty happy with this.

title: Comfortable inexpensive mouse
text:
I like this mouse. It is fairly inexpensive and very light. It has all the buttons you expect a mouse to have. It is wireless and works very well. It connected to my laptop and installed itself without any issues whatsoever. I like how it fits in my hand and it works very well. It is very light in your hand though so some may prefer a mouse with a little bit more weight, personally I like that it is light especially when you work for longer hours this will come in handy.

The mouse looks great in my eyes and I like the design. It fits beautifully in my hand and is in that regards designed very well. It is very comfortable to use and quiet. You can also adjust the speed settings on this which is great. It only needs one AA battery which is great and has an on off button so you can preserve energy when you are not using it.

title: Perfect for your iPhone
text:
These are some pretty good in-ear headphones. They work only with iPhone so make sure that is what you are buying them for. On the cable they have a multi controller that allows you to control your phone, answer calls, end calls, repeat calls, has a microphone built in, play, pause and advance in the track. It also allows you to adjust the volume when you play your music. I wouldn't even bother with headphones anymore that don't provide these extras.

The sound quality of these is pretty good. They also came with some extra rubber covers so you can find the one that makes them fit best in your ears. The price is right for these too, so all in all a pretty good deal.

title: Fantastic lightweight portable speaker
text:
This PA System from EARISE is freaking awesome! I absolutely love this little powerhouse. It is very easy to use and quickly paired with my phone. I have a Moto Z2 force. I use it to play music in the gym during our volleyball games and it can hold the music in the gym beautifully. I don't really use the microphone but it is nice to have that option if I ever need it for a party or something, mostly for making announcements though since the quality isn't the greatest. The music quality is fantastic and loud and clear. While I am indoors I tend to keep it plugged in if I go for longer times but it is nice that the battery power can last up to over 4 hours if you blast the music on max volume.

This PA system is super light and comes with a remote control. I wish it had a little spot where you could attach the remote so you don't lose it but I am just glad it has a remote so you can adjust the volume for example from across the room if you need to.

This gets the thumbs up from me. It is cute, light and very easy to use. That makes this very versatile and you can take it with you easily to any kind of gathering to have music playing out loud. Plus you can play music from a USB Flash drive or even pick up some radio station. Incredible little find!

title: No Bluetooth capability so without a computer you can't upload any music to it!
text:
I have their regular bone conducting headset that you can use via Bluetooth to listen to music with your phone. So I thought this was an upgrade that lets you do that as well as upload 8GB worth of music so you don't have to have your phone with you at all times in order to listen to music, but I was wrong.

This one will NOT connect to your phone via Bluetooth and I was rather upset about that since I wanted to use it that way as well. This leaves you basically with an MP3 player that is in your headset, which is nice, however since this headsets don't have a display, you can't really control the songs except press next song or previous song. It is not like you can connect it to your phone and control a playlist that way for example. That is a crappy non existent feature in my eyes. You are stuck with whatever playlist is on your MP3 player forever and ever until you change what songs you have on there, and let's face it, who does that? Who wants to constantly connect their MP3 player to their computer to upload new songs so the playlist changes? I listen to music at work nonstop so this would be an issue fast. In addition work no longer allows to use my work laptop to download files from, which includes my own music, so that leaves me with no means to do it since I stopped keeping a personal computer.

They need to figure out a way to connect it via Bluetooth to your phone and use an app that allows you to control this headset, make playlists and select them and so forth.

In regards to music quality, it is similar to the other one from this brand I have. The quality is what I expect from a bone conducting headset. You get pretty good music all considering you have surrounding noise interfering. The issue I had with their other headset, it died on me after about 2 months or so. Since right now I am struggling on getting music on this and am stuck with their demo stuff only, I can't give it more than just 2 stars. It is fairly comfortable but they need to figure out a better way to control it since there is no display like other MP3 players have. They have another one that is Bluetooth enabled so they have the technology already. Combine the 2 and make and app and fix it! Until then I can' recommend it as it is right now.

title: Good headsets for the price
text:

I like that they have a volume up/down button so you don't have to get your phone out every time. I wish you could advance the song by using those buttons but if you can I haven't been able to figure out how to as of yet, and it does claim you can and so have others (I tried longer and shorter pressing of the buttons but no luck so far). They fit quite nicely in my ears so no complaints there plus they come with other inserts so you can find the ones that will fit you best.

The sound quality is not bad, not the greatest but I didn't expect that from these at all. For that I use my super noise cancelling ones. These also do not have noise cancellation but that is ok. For the price these sell for these hit the mark I would say.

title: AMAZING headset!!!!
text:
This one is my favorite headset, and I own I think 5 different noise cancelling headsets at this point. I actually also own the little baby brother the NC25 of this one which I also love. They are really close but this one I think wins because of the battery life but the other one folds up to a closer headset so for traveling it would win. A batter of 40+ hours of playtime is incredible, you just can't beat that since you don't have to charge it every day like you would have to with the other one.

This headset has other amazing features as well. It paired pretty much instantly without any issues. The volume can go up very high if you really want to destroy your hearing but it allows you really to listen to your music quietly with very good sound quality. The noise cancelling feature works very well and allows you to block out noise you don't want to hear like coworkers or noise on the air plane so you can actually hear the movie you want to watch

Not only does the battery last 40+ hours of play back, but also is the battery a fast charge, so it will charge fully in 1-2 towers. In 5 minutes you can get 2+ hours of battery life back into your headset! This is absolutely amazing. This headset will replace the one I have at work right now and will be my go to one for everything.

These headsets are super comfortable and lightweight so you barely feel they are there, just like their little baby brother. I can't say enough good things about these and can only recommend them. At $70 plus currently they have a discount of $15.

They come with a nice little carrying case, plus a charging cable, an audio cable and an airplane adapter. Just absolutely perfect!

So the NC75 pro and NC25 are very comparable. The quality in both is fantastic. The NC25 is smaller but the NC75Pro has a better battery life and is slightly more expensive, so really up to you but you can't go wrong with either really in my eyes.

title: LOVE these headphones !!!!
text:
These are fantastic headphones! What I noticed first is that they are very lightweight and you really don't feel them much on your head at all, MAJOR plus especially if you wear them a lot like I do! They are very comfortable and fit very well. They cover your ears nicely and fir just right. I had at first some issues pairing them but I think that was a user issue more than anything else.

The sound quality is very good and the volume can go up pretty high if you want to so you have quite a range there. The noise cancelling feature really brings it home though and will come in very handy if you have either some noisy coworkers or when I really like it is on the plane. It really blocks out all the annoying noise out there.

These are really cool headsets and will be my go to ones going onward I think, especially because they are just so light but also small. This will come in handy when traveling. The ones I have used to date have always been a bit heavy and bulky and used up a good amount of space when traveling. These are thinner in profile. They did come with a carrying case that is also very nice and a lot thinner than others I have had in the past. They did come with the necessary accessory cables (charging and an audio cable). You get everything you need for a pretty good price at $60 (but they do have a $15 off coupon), so not too bad and these are pretty darn good so I am not complaining since I REALLY like these. I believe these are my 4th or 5th noise cancelling set and these are in my top 2.

Only downside, I think they will "only" last like 16 hours in comparison to another one I have that will last 40+ hours from the same manufacturer, but they are also bulkier ... so you have to pick one over the other I guess ..... They are the smallest ones I have so for traveling they beat their slightly smaller brother the NC75 pro, so with that size vs battery .... tough battle

title: Receiver doesn't work from back of CPU
text:
To prevent confusion, let me call the first purchase from a few years ago Mouse A and THIS current purchase Mouse B.
Mouse A is on a Dell desktop, plugged in directly to the monitor within less than 2 feet from the mouse and it works flawlessly!

Mouse B is also on a Dell desktop, the receiver had to be plugged in to a port on the back of the CPU that sits on the floor and Mouse B is a dud. I rearranged everything, unplugged, rebooted, and all the tech whatnot's (including researching Windows 10 upgrades or whatever they're called) to see if it wasn't something I had done, considering I'm a novice. Mouse B worked for a little while, then reverted to it's persnickety ways from not responding AT ALL to randomly jumping from one side of the screen to the other. Let me just say, I was not pleased.

So, Mouse B is now using my valuable port real estate on the front of the CPU and as long as it doesn't venture more than 1-2 feet from the mouse, it's fine. I purchased Mouse B because Mouse A is wonderful and who wouldn't expect to have a similar experience with the same product? Mouse B is temperamental and selfish. I am surprised it requires such kid gloves.

The receiver is not being blocked from any interference as there are only 4 items that are wireless in this room and only 2 of them are used at one time.

IF your suggestion is to return it for an exchange, please let me know, however please note my sweet, loving husband actually recycled the packaging before asking if we needed to keep it for any reason lol! OF course he did!

Over the years, I've had many Logitech items that have gone above and beyond what was expected. Logitech is a brand I trust and seek out. I'd appreciate your recommendation in this matter as I would like to move the receiver to the back of the CPU. Thank you so much!

title: Served my purpose but had issues installing Lubuntu OS and is unstable
text:
The Lubunto OS pre-installed on the eMMC drive never worked. Atomic Pi would freeze up to a blank screen or simply loop. I tried installing Lubuntu OS (v18.04.05 as well as v22.04) flashed on to a USB drive from Lubuntu.me website, but had the same issues.
I then tried installing Lubunto v18.04.05 flashed on to a micro-SD card. This went further but aborted with a SQUASHFS error.

Finally as a last resort, I tried installing Lubuntu v22.04 flashed on to a micro-SD card. To my shock this worked !!!

So basically there were issues with the Atomic Pi that I got. I am not a computer expert but fairly computer savvy and was able to get the Atomc Pi to work. However, a computer novice may not be successful.

In addition, the Atomic Pi is unstable and freezes or reboots, especially when using Firefox.

So I will not recommend Atomic Pi as the main desktop computer or even for regular usage.

2 years ago I switched to Raspberry Pi as my main desktop computer and it has worked great.

I bought Atomic Pi as I just wanted something cheap to run this one application that required an x86 CPU and hence could not run on Raspberry Pi which has an ARM CPU.

title: Excellent product that delivers what it promises.
text:
Clear instructions. Do make sure you patiently work your way through the installation to avoid wrong assembly or damage.
I installed the antenna on the roof of my ranch-style house using the antenna mount purchased separately.

TV caught most of the channels within 75 miles at first scan :)
I get CBS, NBC, WKAR (MSU), FOX, ABC, ION.

Signal is strong and stable even in cloudy weather, rain and snow (I live in Michigan !). I installed the antenna in September 2015.
The only time the signal wavers is in strong winds that we had in fall. Not sure if this is due to antenna shake (I did fix it securely) or just an atmospheric phenomenon.

I have got rid of AT&T Uverse TV (which I was using mostly for network channels anyways).
I do watch MSU sports (go Sparty ! ), so I have internet Sling TV ($19.99 per month, no contract) to watch ESPN in the months I need it.
I need nothing else !!

In summary this product delivers what it promises.
I would recommend this product to anyone who wants to cut the cable/satellite.

As an extra bonus, the antenna looks really funky on my rooftop !

Very happy with this product :)
