title: Pretty good. But make sure you adjust tv settings correctly....
text:

Anyways, for those who say it doesn’t work. First, your tv needs to be digital, otherwise you need a converter box. Second, it didn’t work with mine either at first. I had to go deep into the menu on my tv and setup the source to “Air” and then have the channels scanned. Once it scanned it went from all snow to brilliant pictures. I was so mad at first I almost threw the thing when I was just getting all snow channels, but my dad said to mess with the settings and I wormed my way around it and figured it out. Just pressing “input” and putting it on ANT/antenna didn’t do anything. So I was frustrated.
You need to look up the manual to your tv or find it online. You’ll most likely find it’s the tv settings you need to update, and therefore isn’t the fault of the antenna.

So don’t give up at first. Mess with the settings.

Noise canceling? YES! I believe that that noise canceling feature works great. Generally, with ear phones, you can hear people talk....but not with these. And, more important to me, is that I prefer these over the ear phones, because I get tired of those little in-the-ear phones slipping off, while I am always juggling them to stay on.

Sound is wonderful! And, better, I paired this up with the Kindle Fire, and next I will try other devices. But, I wandered throughout the house, doing my chores, headphones on, and listening to good stuff. I rarely got interference of breaks....unless I got near the Desktop, then I heard breaks.

So, all around I love this set. Great sound, comfortable, long play, etc. etc.

title: Nice, strong sound on my Laptop for my YouTube Music!!

title: Cooling Laptop!  Bright resolution,  Great sound for my Music!  Downside,  about 3 hrs on battery.

I don't understand a whole lot about fancy laptops, and I will find out more, as I use it. This is great! Works fast enough for me. ONLY thing, the battery is not as productive as I would like. title: Nice metal keyboard,  fits my small hands.  Perfect sound,  Sharp Images!!
text:
I love this little Laptop/Tablet. I am a user of a Lenovo EE 2.0, Laptop and have been satisfied completely. And, I am a Kindle Table owner also. So, I have used two variations, and now have the combo, a Laptop and a Tablet.

I don’t know all the ins and outs and fancy techno terminology as some people do. I review how this works for me, and, I do know that it is a higher quality with the 4 GB.

The first thing I notice when using a combo, is the metal keyboard. I have small hands, and I can use both hands comfortably to touch type. Some people with larger hands may find the keyboard smaller to touch type. But, it fits perfect for me.

The other thing I wanted this for is YOUTUBE music. I plugged in the earphones and played music, and it was great, nice crisp loud sound. The speakers are good in the front, this way any laptop cover won’t interfer with the Dolby sound. That’s all I need, nice picture, nice sound.

I also like that there is an HDMI plug. While I work in my garage, right now I don’t have YouTube in there, so, I can plug into the HDMI and watch what I want.

I use a lot of images in my business. And, these images are just as good as my desktop. They are clear and sharp, very noticeable. What is rather important to me is the USB ports, including a card slot. Even though I have OneDrive, I sometimes need to transfer data from the desktop. The USB ports are for data only.

The battery is average good length. Charges fast. I like the feel of the 2 in 1, but find opening it is always a two hander thing. Connecting the table to the keyboard is quick, easy with a secure magnetic connection. I experienced the onscreen keyboard. My trick to learn is how to keep the keyboard on when I am using the touch. The scroll pad is large, but I have to use the Enter button to Open or Activate Menu or App. It is not like my other Lenovo, but I can get used to it.

There is more for me to work with, and I will take is slowly. it is easy for me to take to my large garage to work for my online business. I LOVE THIS LAPTOP/TABLET!!!

title: IMPRESSIVE SOFTWARE PROGRAM....EASY INTERFACE.  Great for businesses.
text:

Generally, PDF features can be easy to operate, without excessive features that one may never use. But, this is a top of the line PDF Software Program.

PDF…. What does it do? PDF stands for portable document format. What this does is transfers your regular documents into a read only document, in other words, freezing the document, so it cannot be changed by other readers. But, fear not, you can do some editing on your PDF, but for other readers, in a Read Only format, they cannot change it.

The best part of this, and most intriguing feature, is the Speak recognition. You can add a comment to your document by speaking into the computer. The info you spoke gets typed into the document. HOWEVER.... I have not figured out how to make it work, and I used a headphone set. Anyway, I will and it is a great feature!

Redacting is another helpful tool; as this means you can take personal info out of a document, to create a new PDF to share. Oftentimes, in the office, if you do proofreading, as I do, you may need to compare documents. And this is a valuable tool for publishing documents, the ability to compare one versus the other. Again, as I said, this offers a lot of features, not difficult to work with, impressive.....but in the long run, better for company than individual home set-up Excellent Program! Rizzo

text:
This is a nice protector for my Kindle Fire 8.9. It goes on little troublesome, but eventually, you settle for something. Bubbles are almost impossible to remove. And, apparently, if you push outward you may eliminate the bubbles.

This sticks nicely to the screen. It is on tight, and you get an extra one, plus a cleaning cloth.

Now, I am not one to clean my Kindle screen; it has ton of fingerprints, and when I turn it on, poof, fingerprints disappear. So, with the bubbles that will not disappear, I turn on the screen, and there are gone. You may see a faint gray circle, very light, which is a bubble, but again.... these are not distracting!!

I like these nice screen protectors!

title: Handy and portable if needed.  Stick it in your pocket
text:
I found this Mini Portable Capsule Speaker to be perfect. It works great with my Ipods and Kindle Fire. What is nice, is that it is affordable enough to add on extra speakers for greater enhancement of sound. These speakers are colorful, lightweight, and easy to snap close for portability.

The sound is loud. I can sit at my table working puzzles, and plug this into my IPOD for some nice music listening time. And, as anybody knows that Kindle Fires don't have the loudest sound around, these work great for that!

The speaker is equipped with an off/on button and of course volume control button. It comes with charging cords also. I love this speaker! Rizzo

title: I love it!  Excellent for the Ipod too!
text:
If anybody knows the range of sound from Kindle Fires....it's quite sad. The Kindle Fires are great for earphones, but to listen to music out loud, the sound is clearly lacking. You can only go so far.

With this wireless soundbar, it's like playing the music from my computer....and I use Bose! I love the portability, slip into your bag, pocket....it is that portable. It is lightweight, comes with a usb cord for charging.

Then, I tried it on the IPOD. Beautiful sound, nice, loud and clear! If you are a music lover like me, take your music around and play it loud. You can hear this from another room.

Generally, I plug this into the Kindle Fire 8.9 and watch my music videos, and play other music on the Device and from Amazon Cloud.

title: Colorful, easy to spot, lengthy!
text:
What I enjoy about this is, clearly, the length. This makes it easier for me to charge without being restricted to a tight spot. The other nice feature is that it matches my Kindle Fire Case. Nice, bright, easy to find when you need a charger.... the color speaks attention.

The feel of the cable is sturdy! Good, colorful, lengthy!

title: Best thing.....  the removable compartment insert!
text:
The most interesting thing about this bag is that the compartmentalized insert can be removed thus lending way to a versatile bag. It does not always need to be a photo trolley, if you don't need it as such.

The bag is attractive, and yes, it is lightweight, not bulky, not too high, nor wide. The hardware (zippers, wheels, straps) are quality made. Using the trolley is smooth, easy to use, easy to operate. It's important for these features to be smooth.

Whether the padding for the laptop compartment is adequate, I don't know yet. But, there seems to be enough room in case you need to add a little pad.

I took this on a short trip, packed some devices; it worked great, easy to use, light, and very very attractive. ....Rizzo

title: I took the case off!  Made it too top heavy.
text:
For the price, this is actually a good keyboard with a case. However, I had to take the CASE out and just use the keyboard. I did not like how the item became top heavy. It was not in proportion or balance. Second of all, I removed it because the hole opening for my earphones was not exactly easy to use. The case interferred slightly when I put the earjack plug in.

If you have smaller hands, you can do the keyboard just fine. It is large enough to place both hands on the board for efficient keyboarding as one is supposed to do.

The most challenging thing was the delete key. This doesn't work as the normal backspace key does, but it takes some getting used to.

Again, I use this without the case. It works fine without a case. I use this in bed a lot, or on the couch, so it is more challenging to operate it with the case.

Great little product! Rizzo

title: Lightweight, sturdy, but too slanty for ergo keyboarding
text:
Although this frame is quite sturdy, the plastic where the laptop sits is not as sturdy, but it does hold well. My laptop fits cozy, doesn't slide, and there is a good size lip on the frame to hold your laptop securely.

However, I use this for my Kindle Fire! It works beautifully, fits nice. I have a closing lid that hangs conveniently over the top of the frame.

This is not recommended for the LAPS, but, most people will ignore that and place it on the lap. It is lightweight, and fits comfortably.

The issue here, and the one displayed in the Product images at the top of the screen, is that one is typing with the hands pointing upward. That is seriously not a good way to type. It is unsafe.

Typing should be down at a slant. And this gizmo does not allow for that.... Other than that, it is fine! RIZZO

title: Fixed my prob lem!
text:
I had a minor charging issue with my [[ASIN:B008GFRE5A Kindle Fire HD 8.9", Dolby Audio, Dual-Band Wi-Fi, 16 GB - Includes Special Offers]]. It was slowly not charging to its full capacity.

The charge through the USB was simply not charging. So, I contacted Customer Service, and they provided me with the PowerFast Charger.

Worked like a charm! Rizzo

title: Bright and Tight!  Fits the Paperwhite too!
text:
This is a perfect Kindle cover, it has a nice grip, a nice feel to it. Provided is a snap magnetic closure. This flips back and snaps again, when opening and reading.

I use one for the Kindle e-reader with the 5-way controller, and it fits perfectly on the Kindle Paperwhite.

One of the reasons I select this color is because it is bright. Bright to view the Kindles in the bag or anywhere else. They are easy to spot.

Nice color, easy to handle, comfortable to use....Rizzo

title: Can't do without it!
text:
I am a late night user of the Kindle and Kindle Paperwhite. So, therefore, as I lay in bed, I prop this on my chest area and it works beautiful.

The first thing is that it is lightweight, and yet compact enough to hold the Kindle Fire 8.9, which is the largest Kindle right now. As for the Paperwhite, it fits comfortably.

The fact that this can be washed is great, because, I often throw it on the floor when I am finished. I do have to be careful that the Fire, being moderately heavy, does not slip off the side of the pillow. If one is not careful, it can slide off the side.

Sitting down on the couch, this was handy, and I prefer to leave the back end of the pillow propped up, but it will lay flat.

Nice, handy, compact, light and easy to take on a trip in the car....Rizzo

title: Yep.... roam in style!  Sound is awesome!
text:
I have dock speakers, airplay, ipods, etc., all over this large home. But frequently, I like to have carry an ipod while I roam the house doing this and that. I love the sound these earphones produce!

These are specially made for the Kindle Fire, and I use it for the Fire 8.9., the computer for ITUNES, MEDIA PLAYER, 3 IPODS and Stereo components.

The criteria for headphones is that they must feel light, and these feel very light over the head. They are not tight and are equipped with adjustable head pads. A new feature for me was the lengthy cord with a different feel. I like the length of the cord, but in my roaming, there is a need to be cautious with the cord getting caught on something.

The genuine wood look is beautiful, and with a nice feel. The set comes with an attachment plug for various other components you may want to plug in the earphones.

Excellent sound! The bass comes through perfect. Excellent feel, lightweight, attractive!..... Rizzo

title: Short, sweet and simple!
text:
I have been using this on my Kindle and it has served great. It is small, light, portable, black plastic. And, I can place the Kindle/Kindle Fire in a landscape position, or adjust it for portrait reading.

I have been carrying this while I leave the home, reading at the restaurant, killing time at the doctor's office, and it sits right up on the dash of the Lexus, not while driving of course.

Excellent stand. ....Rizzo

title: Sleek and attractive!  Works well!
text:
I like the feel and look this cover is constructed of, plus, it is easier to keep clean. But, moreso, I like the sturdiness of the grips, which leads me to believe it won't break as plastic would. It holds the Ipad securely. I also appreciate the angles you can position the cover in. I get a good solid stand either way. My concern was that it would not hold, but it does appear to stand good in positions.

There is a hole in the back for easy use of the camera without taking the case off. The auto-sleep and auto-wake are a great feature.

I always worry about the light straps, and I have a concern that with many pulls, this strap would become overstretched.

The inside felt is always a nice feature, protecting your Ipad even more. This is light, cool, attractive and easy to work with. Rizzo

title: It's doable!  Works ok !
text:
Yep, it's a very easy set-up, and to my surprise, I set this up and was recording the subject. I played that recording again; it was nice, clear, This is something I was not able to do with the Logitech C310, but I like what it did. The view appears just a tad grainy, and the voice slightly muffled, but it is workable. You also have room for adjusting the views.

What I like about is this is the ability to Record Video, and Take a Snapshot and play them out.

Like most software setups, this one doesn't take much. Stick it on top of the large screen and you have a clear shot of webcaming. I used this while my person on the other end was using the Logitech. The view I received is not as quality as Logitech, but if suffices.

I cannot imagine myself using the visual effects. I would classify them as strictly for the younger set, but that is what could entertain children and get them to use the Webcam more. The visual effects kind of pop onto the pictures you have taken. There are sound effects with voice. There is quite a bit more you can do with this webcam. Experiment. ....Rizzo

title: Lightweight, prone to show dirty!
text:
Although this is an attractive looking Ipad cover; in our family, this makes a great little stand, but I always question the elastic straps that hold the ipad secure. With much handling, these kind of loose straps loose their elasticity. Not good. I like the look of the cover, but this is a light suede feeling, and it does not clean well. So, be very careful when using it, and snacking with crumbly hands won't help. This material should be more washable.

I like that the cover is less bulky, light to the touch, slip it into tight stops in a bag, or briefcase. However, using the Ipad with the stand, you cannot feel secure that the stand will not fall. It is not quite sturdy enough to hold the Ipad with some movement to the screen. Be careful. Also, viewing with the stand is only possible with the landscape angle. Make sure your surfaces are flat and free of objects around it.

Laying the ipad cover flat back is another comfortable way to use it. Great to hold on your lap, or in your hand.

The Ipad fits comfortably and the inner cover is a suede-like material for protecting the screen. I appreciate that the corner brackets are not plastic. There is more rubber to prevent breakage. Rubber is much needed.

This is a 3rd cover I have, and my drawback is the material that is not easily cleaned. I don't like to see stains, and this has the potential for many. It could be stronger, but I like the lightweight material..... Rizzo

title: A good-looking comfortable cover
text:
The downside of this cover is the elastic bands that hold the IPAD. Elastic, when used too often, can become ineffective, loosening its grip. Although the elastic bands seem sturdy, they may not be over time. So I am cautious with the strap bands.

Folding is easy, standing upright on folds works great, no falling flat. If you do pressure keyboard motions, you must be careful not to tip the cover/IPAD. Be gentle.

I like the outer sturdy design; it is attractive, and appears well-made. This is great for the IPAD, and I cannot guarantee it be perfect for the IPAD 2. The cover works well in a briefcase, purse, or backpack. The soft felt/velvets is sufficient to protect the screen. ...Rizzo.

title: Looks good, nice material, efficient
text:
The Belkin Tri-Fold Folio with Stand keeps the Apple IPad safe while carrying places, and it provides a great stand when working on the Ipad. The coarse outer material is attractive rigid black design. Inside the cover is a nice soft velvet for protecting the screen. It is smooth and soft.

The strap, which to me is not tight enough, and I fear it may loosen up with too much use.
The other side holds the IPAD with secure edging to hold IPAD in place. The material is not plastic, but a more pliable rubber-type that holds it securely. Good that it is not plastic just in case it breaks.

Easy to work with...works good, looks good, handles well! Rizzo

title: Colorful, thin, attractive!
text:
I like the Belkin Case; and I love the color. This bright color helps me when I am looking for the Ipod! It is brightly colored. Although the plastic seems lightweight, I wonder if it will crack, but I am advised that it is sturdy protective polycarbonate base with shock-absorbing band. I am not sure what the shock=absorbing band is.

The feel is light, thin, sleek, translucent and it protects the IPOD back. The gloss is scratch resistant. Excellent protection, nice looking. .....Rizzo

title: Super convenient;  super sound!  But, it has its issues
text:
Aside from cutting out frequently, I absolutely love this gadget! This is so convenient when I want to hear my music on the lower level or upper level of the Tri-level home. I just lift it from the base and I feel as if my computer Itunes is with me wherever I go.

But, as I said, it does have its inconvenient moments.

I stream Pandora from the Iphone. Works very good, but I have not had enough experience. I prefer to play through Itunes library. And the sound is excellent. The sound permeates, and it is not as if you hear it from one corner of the room, so yes, the sound range is very good. The speaker feature is SoundRing technology. That is a very plus feature to me.

Convenience is the key here, as I take it outside for company or just working around the yard. Carry it to the bathroom for all your music while you bathe. The design is catchy, attractive and lightweight.

The speaker controls are on the ring in case you are not near the computer. This was a very easy set-up, and yes, it is convenient, compact and wireless. It operates cord and cordless, and has an aux-in jack where I can plug my MP3 and you can also connect to stereo components.

This is a treat!! .....Rizzo

title: Of of my favorite mouses/mice/meece/mices !!
text:
I have not experienced a nice, quieter, and more comfortable mouse. The first thing I noticed was the speed the mouse works. It is attractive. The scrolling feature is quiet, works smooth, and you just barely move it down or up. The scrolling operates with grace and is easy on the hands. This is a great ergonomic features, and you can lock the scrolling. The sleek contour makes a very comfortable fit for the hands, yet feeling light underneath the palm.

Set-up is easy as pie. The wireless device is very small, and battery life claims to be at 18 mo. Excellent! This is one of the best mice/meece/mouses I have ever used. Rizzo

title: Nice, cozy, comfortable and convenient!
text:
The Lowepro brand is really a favorite brand, because of the feel of the material, durable and very comfortable. It looks cool and light with weather-resistant mylon. What makes this Daypack a handy bag is that it is made for carrying your gear for the day, meaning not all of it at once, select what you need and off you go. Plus, with your day camera gear, you can store other items on top.

So, for a quick trip, pack your camera gear on the bottom, and necessities on the top. For the bottom half, there are movable dividers for various sizes of equipment.

I always like the dual compartment zippers. When you zip, there is a flap that covers the zipper for better water-proofing the zipper.

Most camera bags are meant for camera gear with little room for other non camera gear. The pack has two separate dividers, top and bottom, and extra front outside zippers for small stuff.

The mesh side pockets are tight, small, so don't try to put a water bottle in it. The inside 9" mesh pocket is good for storing papers, maps, tickets, etc.

Although, the downside is that if you want to carry a laptop, it may not fit. The top carry handle is not with that durable grip and if you have a large hand, the handle is too small. Sadly, it is just that black canvas and could use the solid grip.

Shoulder straps are adjustable, contoured, and very comfortable, while the bottom has adjustable straps that can hold a roll or a Tripod. There are 4 strap hooks in the front for attaching more items/gear.

I have used this as an out of town backpack, and the bottom holds my gadgets, phone, Ipods, camera, e-readers, etc. Very neat backpack, comfortable, convenient, cool.....Rizzo

title: Great for an extra pair of headphones!
text:
I always like to have several pair of headphones around. I plug these into the computer and get a nice sound, even for the Itunes music! But, mostly, I will watch movies or Netflix movies and shows. This way, I can do so in private.

Great for my IPOD! Although I need to turn the headphones up higher for the IPOD, I still get a nice clear sound. I like the feel on my head, not heavy and they stay in place with plenty of head movement.

Another thing I use this for is the Webcam, Logitech VideoCam. I like the way the sound is, and I can raise the sound, and mute the mic also. The mic can be used on the left or right side. I also appreciate that the mic is not too close to the mouth.

As far as the noise canceling, it is moderate. If I turn the sound too high, then of course I down out any sound outside.

I like these!......Rizzo

title: Handy, small, and very useful!
text:
This is a convenient and portable USB hub. I have taken this out of town, to another home, where there was no computer available to recharge my Ipod and phone. The ultraslim hub comes with an AC adapter. It works great for taking on a trip because it is less than 5 inches and super light. It is light, actually too light. But that is what makes it more portable. What makes it great also is that when I have company over, there are enough hubs for their devices....everybody has a device these days that needs charging.

I like that I can plug this in the front of the computer because the back ports are limited. Again, this works well when company visits and everyone needs a port....Rizzo

title: Sound is great!  REMOTE IS PATHETIC!
text:
I really enjoy this Ipod docking station, and wondered why I never got one earlier. The sound is really great, nice, clear, crisp and loud. With an AC plug, you get take it outside, for some enjoyable listening on the patio. However, if you are planning a festive party out back, be forewarned that the sound is ok for inside the home, but to make more than that would be a stretch.

The WORST part is this pathetic REMOTE... It is tiny, light, and you cannot see the lettering, it is light white on black. There are raised buttons, which provide some help, but not much. So, once you get your spyglass out, it may not work effectively. On my remote, the only thing that works is the volume control and off button. I cannot get it to work for playlist, nor anything else.

Instructions are poorly written also. It is an attractive unit, great for shelves, not too big, not small.

The speakers have a subwoofer, but if your remote does not work good, you cannot change the bass settings. So, I would advise not to mess with it much.

It took me a while to figure this out. For one, the connector where the IPOD goes was a little unsettled; if you get nothing, make sure the connection is good. I could not get sound, then after several frustrating attempts, I realized that to actually start sound, I had to press the Volume Up button. There is a power button, but no Play button. There are few buttons on top of the docking gizmo, the Source, volume controls, eject, power.

My experience has not been with the video out and line in jacks. But, all in all, I love this thing, the sound is excellent for a good sized room. And, it keeps my IPOD charged.

******* Edit: Contact Sharper Image, they did not have replacement remote, but sending me A COMPLETELY NEW UNIT! .....Rizzo

title: Light, comfortable, attractive!
text:
Generally, our family Ipad ends up bouncing all over, placed her and there, everywhere. But with this handy laplounge is wonderful. I don't use the Ipad as much, but I will watch some movies late at night. At nighttime, in bed, I place this on top of my abdomen, for viewing. It holds excellent, doesn't slide. I also have a portable DVD player and this things holds it perfectly. Now when I laugh, I don't shake the Ipad or my DVD player.

This is attractive, light colored, and with a small carrying handle. A little pocket comes for storing my glasses, earphones, piece of candy, cloth, etc. You can carry this out of the home. It's not huge, and it is lightweight, beanbag type fill. When I'm sitting, I like to adjust the tray upwards, as at times, my neck from a previous surgery hurts if I bend down uncomfortably. The Ipad fits snug into the tray. And, I prefer the landscape format, but it unsnaps to easily change to portrait if you need.

I have taken this on a trip, it's easy to find if you misplace it, and sturdy enough to throw it around. I like it! .....Rizzo

title: Play it while it lasts....... What can you expect for the price?
text:
The Archos MP3 at the low price would never be my first choice for music. I prefer the IPODS, and if you are familiar and favor IPODs, don't look at this to meet the match. This little gadget is great for an emergency music component. And sometimes I play it at night to help me fall asleep.

The earphone jack is located on the side.... Not good, as it gets in the way for easy storage into your pocket or elsewhere. The jack should be on the bottom. The MP3 is super lightweight.

The internet connection for moving music and photos is easy. I can easily check the music and photo files online. All music must be in Mp3 or Mp4 format. Right now I have about 400 songs in it. As for the videos, which are AVI format, and it does not play.

I am getting good reception from the FM radio. This is easy to work, changing the station.

Can't quite figure the RECORDER component. The function is not necessary, and it stumps me.

What I don't like about my nighttime playing is the flat, smooth interface for maneuvering. I prefer to feel the buttons for movement, rather than not feel anything, while in the dark

There is a backlite timer. The screen does not go completely off. You will get a dimmer screen when not in immediate use. The screen is good size if you use the photos and videos. I like the autoshutoff in the specified minute increments.

Lyric files? The screen is supposed to display lyric files if you desire. Huh??

To sum it up, don't expect much on this, as maneuvering throughout, does not always prove easy to manipulate. It has its quirkiness, but for an emergency, it's ok. I have three IPODs, so this one is great while it will last.....Rizzo

title: Nice, rigid, sturdy, comfortable, and easy to use.
text:
I really like this Kindle Thule protective case. What makes it work for me is that I carry the Kindle in a traveling tote to work every day. This rigid durable case is attractive design and by one of the most respected Swedish companies, Thule. Thule makes those auto top carriers.

I actually dropped this and was nervous, but the rigidity of the case saved it. What I like also is that as the Kindle thrashes around my tote, hitting a thermos, shoes, umbrella, my Kindle remains protected.

What I am not keen about is the Velcro, fearing the pull on Velcro will soon give out. So, to preserve it more, I just don't secure it all the time.

A feature I would have preferred would be one of a brighter color. Black tends to get lost in my tote. A brighter color would be great for visibility.

Slip the Kindle 3G in....note it will not fit other Kindles, and you cannot include any Kindle with those leather covers also.

This is sharp, sturdy and really looks nice! ......Rizzo

title: Attractive design, easy to use.
text:
This is a handy product for protecting your equipment. We have had some serious thunder and lightning rainstorms and I feel good plugging the electronics to this, mainly a laptop.

The Surge Protector includes an outlet, the three-prong grounded, plus a convenient USB charging port and this works well with my IPODS. You also have an indicator light that lets you know what is protected.

Although the design is attractive and solid, it will take up two slots on the outlet. But, I like the idea of another three prong outlet on the Protector.

I like to take this with me on a short trip. It's easy to pack, not excessively bulky.

The Protector comes with a $25,000 protection against your equipment. OK??? We will see, but I guess it is a solid guarantee against electronic failure.

Great little device. ......Rizzo

title: About to give this mouse to Freak the Cat!  Edit:  ***  IT BROKE ALREADY, ONE MONTH LATER
text:
Although this mouse is fanciful, sleek and attractive, I'm about to give it to Freak the Cat. His record of catches lately is lookin' pretty slim, so I'm sure he'll be tickled.

EDIT: Just over one month of usage, it is not working. The mouse takes batteries and the batteries could not be bad yet! But the mouse died, and when I press it, I see a light come on, but it will not hold!

The mouse is generally designed to curve or flatten, so as to pack it with you when you travel with your laptop, I assume. In order to take it with you, you need to take the USB receiver and there is a convenient magnetic slot to hold that USB receiver. I'm quite that is an advantage with this mouse, to carry it with you, packs flat, receiver in tow.

The key elements in this design are: curve for comfort, flatten to pack, and it operates on a click tap, flick control. Now, granted there is a lot of auto rolling that the mouse does, that's great, but not worth the wear and tear of the forefinger.

The mouse is hard plastic, designed for cradling the palm. The controls are situated on the forefront on the glossy-covered top of the mouse.

The touch to scroll design is not always a simple touch, and I find myself tapping too much just to get some action going. You are to slide your finger up and down the strip, but believe me, it doesn't do anything often.

Takes Too Much Pressure to Click! My forefinger HURTS !
Second, Clicking on the left side of the mouse takes way too much pressure from the finger. I'm not used to pressing down so hard, just to get it to work.

There is a new feature here, that when you tap on the right spot, a small circle shows on the screen and an arrow leaves that circle indicating automatic scrolling. Well, problem is you can tap several times and still cannot bring the circle up. Sometimes, it pops up when you don't want it. But if you get it working right, it does a nice up and down auto scroll.

So, all in all, I do not like this mouse, and Freak the Cat is free to enjoy the usual pounce and mutilation he does to any mouse in his domain. .....Rizzo.

title: Classy, well-made, durable, efficient....everything to make it work!
text:
There is no mistaking the Tamrac Expedition 5 photobag is of superb quality. Just by looking at the straps is one indication. The bag is not lightweight; it is very well-padded, keeps your equipment safe, and it is spacious inside, and if you do not have enough photo equipment to fill it, consider room for more stuff. Therefore, I use it for more than a photobag, and including for the padded lap top pocket that provides easy access. I have adjusted the Velcro adhesives for the many compartments, and what I like is the strength and durability of the Velcro adhesives.

The Tamrac is geared to handle the outdoors, as the rain flap covers the zippers to keep out moisture. It would be nice if it had a full rain cover, but it does not. Fortunately, with material will be safe during a nice wet hike.

The design of the straps is called Strap Accessory System, which means you can attach accessories to the strap with hooks/straps for secure and easy access. The straps are thickly-padded as is the backside.

I like the large clear mesh inside pockets that can hold a lot of odd stuff. Two large pockets hold enough small things without getting cluttered. Also, for easy access are the two side wing pockets, great for holding the smaller things.

This is considered a mid-size bag, great just to store your equipment, and keep it ready for longer shooting locations. The external dimensions are 12 ¾ wide 10 deep x 16 high. It weighs just over 4 pounds. And just like most quality bags, there are straps to securely hold a tripod. The zippers are dual sided.

Again, this an attractive, durable, well-made photo backpack. You will be sporting style when using this backpack. ....Rizzo

title: Great little compact bag!
text:
This little camera bag is perfect! There is plenty of space for a camcorder, a small one, plus if you don't have this size camcorder, you can do more with this sturdy attractive bag.

I take this on little trips, to store my cell phone and an IPOD. The pocket that holds the camcorder is spacious, plus you have space for more stuff, like batteries, etc. I like the sturdy cover, you get stuff this in any suitcase or bag, and you equipment remains intact.

What is nice is the capacity for carrying on your should, or I like the additional little hand strap. Choose either, as the long shoulder strap is detachable.

Great and quality bag, compact, and attractive.....Rizzo

title: Screen is rather small, but navigator works great!
text:
Generally I cannot compare this with a built-in model in one vehicle, but it serves a perfect portable addition to the other vehicles. Most likely, the biggest downside is that the screen could be larger than the 4 inches. Plus, I would have preferred an easy way to attach without gluing anything to the dash. I have moved this to two different vehicles and need to buy a suction holder.

The screen is easy to read, but I cannot read it from the dash. So, I carry it by my side. The voice is nice and clear, and the menu page is easy to navigate. Advancing the screen map by touch proves a little challenging. Some of the features I enjoy are the Advance Lane guide which I use frequently. I also like the time to arrive, mileage, etc., but the font is very small. I have not used the Help Me feature, but this appears to guide to important locations such as hospitals, police, etc. For an extra feature, you can select online different cartoon voices.

What I like is the lifetime updates. The points of interest feature is accessable, but I have not had the need yet. Planning a route is easy and I have chosen the female voice and one can go online for help, plus more cartoon features if you like.

Since I carry this between two vehicles that are used frequently, I like the nice compact case the navigator comes. Everything neatly stored for transporting to other vehicles......Rizzo

title: Attractive, easy to use, extra buttons, long lasting battery life
text:
This is my first wireless keyboard and I love it. The black keyboard feature is designed with the wave feature meant to guide the hands and fingers into place. This, however is not something I notice. The wave is very minimal as not to confuse the hands from your last keyboard. I like the padded wrist rest. The wrist, ergonomically, is supposed to be level with the keys. The keyboard is comfortable! The contour grip on the side of the mouse feels good and secure.

What is good is that the battery claims to have a life-span of 3-year keyboard and 2 year mouse. That is a long time so as not to be bothered. What I enjoy on the keyboard are the touch controls. Press the key with the camera and your Windows Photo files come up. You can control the ITUNES with a press of several buttons on the keyboard, louder, previous and next songs, etc. I also am impressed with the push of the calculator button and up pops the Windows calculator without having to search for it in the Windows programs.

I was leary of this wave-thing, hoping it wasn't like the old heavily structured ergo keyboards, and to my surprise it was a breeze to use. I love it, works great! ....Rizzo

title: Go ahead, try it you might like it!!
text:
I received the Logitech VideoCam and was surprised at one, how easy and quick the setup took; second, I was amazed at the quality of the picture. This is my first time at WebCam and was apprehensive at the standard of quality. But in 1,2,3 steps it was up. The voices are clear and it depends whether you use Logitech viewing or Skype, but Logitech has a more refined lip movement to voice coordination. Again...this is a perfect picture!

Surprisingly, the 3MP photo option is quite impressive. I love the shoot picture instantly. You can quickly add a friend to chat with, just enter their email address. Either at your end of the recipients end you can quickly snap a picture and that pic can be the photo of choice for the friend or family. It is easy to have several different pictures on the interface of the Webcam; I dragged a few from the desktop. My webcam sits comfortably on top of the computer. If I need to remove the camera from the top of computer to show a different view of my background, or reveal other parts of the house, I can do that easily with the 5-feet long attached cord, although it could be longer.

You can make several adjustments, and the light adjustment is automatic, the mic is noise cancelling, however, I have not the need to test that yet.

What I like is that anytime someone on your contact list is at the computer, you can have a small message pop up that lets you know they are available. My two current contacts are using Windows XP; while I am on Windows Vista.

If you are someone you know is vascillating between getting a Webcam, I encourage them to do so, especially if they have family miles away like I do. Many people do not like to be on camera, and for me, I don't either because I have to look decent an any moment a call comes in. Try it.... You may like it! ....Rizzo

title: No more slinging camera on the shoulder without protection
text:
This small version of a large camera case is perfect. I have a Nikon D70 and a few lenses, but periodically, I wish to carry the camera alone, rather than the larger bag I keep it in. This works great, never worry about the camera banging loose on my side while I am ready to take photos. It is easy to carry, easy to reach into, and comfortable without feeling bulky.

The padding is thick, providing great protection for the camera. The larger pocket is just enough for small items especially the Nikkor lenses I have. I like the color, the strap is long enough and the case feels good at my side. I like the weatherproof rugged material. Since I don't do a ton with the camera, this is just my size for carrying around the camera. .....Rizzo

title: Handy, attractive, lightweight, efficient
text:
The camera case is capable of toting many small and personal electronics. I like the softness of the weather resistant fabric called Neoprene. The soft case features a hand wrist strap, which appears to be durable enough for general activity. Also there is a belt loop plus, with a small ring hook, I attach a key holder that attaches quickly to a belt loop without using the belt strap.

The fit is comfortable around the waist. I have slipped it onto the belt loop of pants and frequently use the case for my cell phone. The smaller Ipod fits easily, plus, the outer pocket fits a small pair of reading glasses for reading the Ipod. The case holds my Nano Ipod plus the larger Ipod with a thicker skin covering. I have also used this for the small FLIP camera when I need it.

This is handy, attractive, comfortable and efficient and lightweight. The only drawback is the color black. When I put this into my bag, it is difficult to locate, to spot within the purse/bag. A bright color would be preferable. ......Rizzo

title: The key is to know how to put them on
text:
Normally, I don't like this kind of earphone, I could never get them on immediately. But since I have worked with them, I like them! You need to know how to slip them on over the ears.

The key is to take the open edge of the earhook, place it at the front of the ear and slide it to the back in place. You cannot simply just put if over/or on top of the ear; it won't work. Slide it to the back. Then, there is a small piece under the hook that allows for adjustment! This gives a nice tight and comfortable fit with the cushioned buds. This is important, to have buds that do not irritate the ear.

I worked out in the yard with these earphones, the fit was comfortable. They stayed in place; the round bud that fits in the ear is soft and hardly noticeable. On top of that, the sound is very good. Now, the box cover says 5-way adjustable earhook - This I haven't discovered yet.

For good solid, easy comfortable fit, try these......Rizzo

title: Great sound for music lovers!!
text:
Wow, I love the sound of good speakers! Granted these won't compare to my Bose on my new computer, but I have put these on an older computer. One note, don't put these on a very old computer, you won't get the sound it produces. I tried an old computer and ditched it for that reason.

The two speakers are attractive, sleek design with cords that are long enough for moving around and hooking up in all those hard to reach places if you have a computer armoire.

The only reason I use speakers is for the music! Strictly for the music, and I get the feel of the 360 degree sound. It eliminates that limited sound from a limited spot.

Raising the sound volume is great, however, maybe it applies to certain music also, but you can get a little distortion the louder the music goes. I think that has to do with the quality of music, more bass, not sure.

For better and private sound, attach to the earphones. You can hear the music instruments nice and clear. Excellent sound!

Although there is only one button for sound volume, you cannot adjust if you have too much bass in a song. Then, turn the volume down. Also, in the back of the speaker set, you have clear view to the actual speaker, feeling the vibration. Maybe to prevent excess dust or accidental damage it should have a cover.

I love these speakers!!

And, for the price, they are excellent. I can play this pretty loud and you get that all-around sound! ..... Rizzo

title: Wow! Perfect 2nd Monitor to go with PC and Full-size Monitor (and limited desk space)
text: I got my new ViewSonic VG1655 today and I just love it. Most people will use this to connect to a laptop as a second monitor, but in my case, I got it to go with my Corsair ONE PRO i200 tower PC and Dell U2520DR 25" desktop monitor. I went for the VG1655 because my current setup basically affords absolutely no more space for another full-size monitor (which I would've gotten if I did).  But no fear, this one totally fits the bill. Screen real estate is generous given it's a portable monitor and the resolution is really good. I ran into a glitch with connecting to the tower PC — this was because I thought all I had to do was connect the provided USB-C to USB-C cable to both devices, but NOPE. I was getting a "no signal" error. What I had to do was connect to an available DisplayPort on the tower PC's *graphics card* (which already has the Dell monitor connected to it). But glitch #2 was that the only other cable the VG1655 comes with is  a mini-HDMI to HDMI. I ended up running out to Best Buy and grabbing a DisplayPort to HDMI adapter.  Once I had that snapped onto the business end of provided mini-HDMI to HDMI cable and connected it to an open DisplayPort on the tower's graphics card, the connection was instantaneous. Really happy!! (See photo.) Definitely recommend.

title: Save Your Money, Buy an IPAD
text:
I bought this Nexus 7 32G at the end of January 2013 via online store and have had it since February 2013. Within about 3 or 4 weeks it became glitch, with apps crashing. But I could live with it because it allowed me to take advantage of the app store. So for months, I actually enjoyed the tablet even though the screen would not fill with pictures all the way or something else would close unexpectedly and the sound was not all that great. However, last week, Tuesday 07/09/2013 the sound stopped altogether. I had already bought a mini speaker to compensate for the poor sound quality. When I plugged that it in, I got sound from the tablet, but that was the only way I could hear anything. I called ASUS support and right away they asked had I dropped it. I had not. I promptly sent it off on the same day, Tuesday, 07/09/2013. Until today, I still haven't heard a word. I called ASUS support myself and was told that they received the tablet yesterday, 07/15/2013 and that I should received a 'repaired' tablet within 7 - 10 days from 07/15/2013 their receipt date. Mind you, they sent me the label to send the tablet back. So now, I haven't had the tablet for a week, and probably won't for another week and will now received a
'refurbished' tablet, not the brand new one I bought last then four months ago. I REGRET THIS PURCHASE and now know I should have spent the money on an IPAD. What a waste! All the other companies that offer tablets have no problem with sending out a new tablet when something like this happens. I know now I should have invested in an IPAD or KINDLE. They know how to treat their customers.

title: Pretty. I loved it. It didn't last two weeks.
text: I like this band, it's really fun, it's pretty, I like that there are a couple extra links so you can make it smaller or larger. The issue is I've been wearing it for two weeks and two of the links are already so loose that they won't stay clasped and it keeps falling off of my wrist. Unfortunately, I can't recommend this product.

title: Love that I can plug in my larger plugs and not waste an outlet
text: I was so tired of having a "regular" power strip where if you plugged something in that had a "fat" plug or a "sideways" plug you had to skip the next outlet holes so it wasted the space. This one fixes that issue. Love it so far, no problems at all.

title: I love the look but it is over-priced
text: I don't have much to add to the other reviews of this product that I have read. I just opened the package 20 minutes ago and my first thought was - I LOVE how thin and clear it is! The back-light from my keys shows right through (I had bought a colored keyboard cover originally and it blocked too much of the light, thus why I bought this one) my second thought was - For as expensive as this is it would be nice if the plastic didn't curl up on the space bar every time I use it. I actually removed it intending to return it but the thought of being able to see my back-lit keys through the cover persuaded me to put it on again. I figure I will try it for a day or two and then amend my review if need be.

title: It's better than nothing :)
text: The product does the job it is supposed to but even after having it for only three days the "color" is wearing off. I would have hoped that it would at least make it a few months. It was one of the more cheaply priced options but you get what you pay for.

title: Brought my speaker back to life.
text: I was about to spend a lot of money on a new speaker when I decided to check the price on a replacement battery. Glad I did. Brought my old speaker back to life and sounds better than the newest model. Battery last several hours. Lost count.

title: If you want to lose your Apple AirTag this is for you.
text: Does not hold the AirTag securely. If you have it on a keychain etc. it will eventually fall out.

text: After trying different keyboards and was not satisfied , I took my chances on this one. It is amazing especially if you’re using it with a MacBook. I have had it over a month and the battery is still 85% on first charge.
