Keyboard:
Overall, it's a quiet keyboard. I tend to slam on my keys, but it's a lot quieter than my Dell keyboard. I like that this is fairly compact for a full size keyboard and is very light. The appeal for me was the full sized keyboard because the other available keyboard for Windows at the time was Logitech and the round keyboard was too small and was missing quite a few keys I needed for my job. I work a lot with numbers, so the keypad was a huge plus for me.

The battery slot wasn't very intuitive, but once I figured it out it was smooth sailing. My only cons are that it doesn't have legs to prompt the keyboard up at an ergonomic angle for me. Also, I don't use most of the preset function keys, but I'm sure there's a way to change it.

Mouse:
I used to use a Microsoft Wireless 4000. It was ergonomically perfect for my long fingers, but I could not stand that it would run through a whole AA battery in 3 weeks (maybe I just work too much). This is a bit small and flat for my hands, but it works well. I just have to get used to it by either sliding my hands back more or using my entire finger instead of the finger tips to operate the mouse.

I was concerned from another review that it will burn through the battery quickly, but it has an auto-shut off feature where it'll wake up when you click the mouse key. The clicker is very quiet and the scroll makes some quiet clicks when I scroll through, but I like the control. Wish it was more ergonomic for me, but it works well.

title: Great Cheap and Affordable Solution
text: I really like how these keycaps are slightly raised higher than the blue and pink ones that I had before. I've always been a fan of high risers. I guess you could say I'm somewhat of a keyboard enthusiast. I have 2 showcased here. The Dierya 60% and the G915. I've been on the hunt for this color way as I think Dark Blue and Yellow look sick together. Glad I got these at the time that I did. I would 110% totally recommend. They look rad and feel Amazing!! Awesome for the price. Better get them before they're sold out!

title: Can Finally start Photography Stellar Product!
text: I received exactly what I order and the package came speedier than ever. Everything I ordered looked fresh out the box and I'm beyond pleased! I've always wanted a Sony Camera and the picture Quality on this bad box looks stellar. I'm so glad I made this decision 11/10 Quality!

Used with Sony A6000 as an Elgato multi-mount alternative. Haven't got the camera yet but will update post when I get it. To be used in conjunction with ball mount.

Love these things. Omg I'm so glad they exist I bought 2 because they're so handy and stay out if the way lol. I really like the 180° feature too major props for designers. My only concern is when the blue led light is going to die, but I predict atleast 2-years depending on usage.

title: Boom goes the bass! Clear sound! Lightweight! 4.5 stars
text: I have had several versions of earphones/headphones (i.e., wired, outside/inside, earbuds, etc.) over the years, but after seeing the design for the Mairdi Bone Conduction Headphones, I decided to give them a try. These headphones are unique in that they sit on the front of the ear (open ear) against the face. One size fits all. My husband uses them and finds them to be comfortable. The sound quality is decent and very clear. You can even feel the bass pulsate against your face if you are listening to bass heavy music. These are noise canceling, but I did notice you can hear some outside noise/sound if the volume is low. You can take phone calls, change the volume and control your play list, from the headset. This set is not bulky at all, very lightweight. The battery life is decent, several hours. Another great feature is that this headset is rated IP67 waterproof so sweat will not damage the unit, which means it is great for using while playing sports or working out. This set comes everything you need - a charging cable, silicone ear plugs, a velvet storage bag, and a user manual. Overall, these headphones are perfect for workouts and other activities. I give them 4.5 stars.

title: A gorgeous tote! 5+ stars!
text:
I love this Ubuntu tote. I ordered another style Ubuntu bag last year and received the wrong color (black versus mustard). I was very disappointed in the color, not necessarily the bag. So when I saw this version in the color that I initially wanted, I did not hesitate to order. Guess what? I love it! It is everything you could want in a tote.   -The COLOR - Is bright, cheerful and fun! It is the perfect blend of mustard and cream.
-The STRAPS - Are comfortable on the shoulder and well constructed.
-The CONSTRUCTION AND DESIGN - Is very fashionable and sturdy. Well made. Magnetic closure and inside zippered pocket.
-The MATERIAL - Is a durable canvas (100% cotton).
-The SIZE - Perfect for traveling and the beach. It is large enough to fit an electronic (Kindle, iPad, Surface Pro, or small laptop), a beach towel and novel.
-BONUS -Purchasing this product will support a worth cause. The women of Kenya. The Ubuntu brand is made in Kenya (Africa).

So, while some may think expensive, this product supports a worthy cause.

title: A powerful little laptop!
text:
The Dynabook Protege X30L-J1331 is great.  
It is ultra lightweight. Weighs about 2 pounds.
 It comes with a variety of ports: two usb ports, micro sd port, HDMI port, two type-c thunderbolt 4 ports, and a ethernet port. I find that most laptops today do not include a ethernet port. This is great because it is a direct connection that is sometimes faster than wifi.
 There is also a port for earphones and it is Bluetooth capable.
And I really like the super long cord. It is long enough to move around without worrying about it becoming disconnected.  
There is also a fingerprint reader located on the computer.
 One feature that takes a little getting use to is the left and right mouse buttons sit at the top of the trackpad versus at the bottom. This is a little inconvenient and will take some getting use too.
 The specs of this computer are sufficient for the average user.
It has an 11th generation intel core processor with 8GB of memory and a 256 GB  hard drive.
There is a cover that slides over the camera. A nice feature that adds some security.  The laptop itself is a dark blue and looks almost black.  The monitor/screen is clear and bright.
The operating system is Windows 10 Pro.  It also comes preloaded with Opera and I added Firefox.
 So far I have been impressed with the speed of how fast it works and how programs open quickly with no delay.  
This computer offers a lot of bang for your bucks.
It is a great computer for the home and for those (high school and college aged) students who like Windows based computers versus Mac ones.

title: Perfect for amateur or beginning photographers/videographers!
text:
If you are a budding photographer or videographer, the Wikico 4K camera is for you. Society has moved away from printing out photos, and instead turns to using their smart phones. I on the other hand love scrapbooking and assembling photo albums. Sometimes, I even print those that I take on my phone. This camera is a nice alternative. I like that it is not overly expensive and yet gives you the feel of holding a camera. For those who are beginning photographers or who want to do this as a hobby, it is perfect. It is a small investment for an easy to use camera. We own several high end cameras, both film and digital, that I could use if I wanted to go on a serious photo shoot.

In terms of value for your money, this is the perfect set. Teens and young adults can enjoy it. Of course, once you are serious about the hobby you will invest in a more expensive device. It comes with everything you need: a wide angle lens, SD card, charger, batteries, USB cable and an adapter, with the exception of a bag. The picture quality is decent. It can produce videos and photos. So if you are into YouTubing or posting videos, you’ll enjoy this too. It is pretty easy to set up, the battery life is decent and it is extremely light weight. I give it 4 stars.

title: Perfect for MacPro users!!
text:
-Easy setup.
-Portable.
-Compact.
 -Has lots of ports. The perfect intermediate for connecting to multiple electronics.
-Includes 2 USB-C ports.
 -Fits perfectly into the Mac.
 -Great investment for serious techies!

My only warning: This device must be plugged into an outlet, unlike some adapters I have owned.

title: Great for podcasts or YouTubers!
text:
Lately my son has become interested in producing YouTube videos and podcasts. So, when offered this microphone by AVudio, I grabbed it. Here is what we both found:
-This microphone is sturdy.
-It is adjustable.  -You can adjust the volume settings.
-The quality is great.
-It is easy to set up.
-It has a nice sleek design.
-It is easy to connect a headset.
-There is a convenient mute button on the front of the mic.
-You can use with a Mac computer or a PS4/5.
-Connects via USB-C.

Definitely a must have for budding YouTubers/Host.

title: Consider your electronic protected!
text: This Moko case is perfect for protecting my husband’s Surface Pro. Initially I thought I was selecting a cover for my MacPro. However, when it arrived, I realized that I was wrong. So I had to pass it on to my husband, whose work computer is a Surface Pro. This case fits his SP perfectly and protects his computer. Another great feature is that it can be adjusted to a variety of angles which are perfect for typing. Overall, this is a great case for the cost.

title: Could be better!
text: My husband works out and I recently (accidentally) washed his workout shorts with his earbuds in the pockets. Of course it was his fault for leaving them in there, but I felt some guilt, so when offered, I ordered these as a replacement. This review is based on his experiences: The Bone Conduction Sports Bluetooth headset was very comfortable (in the ear). Connecting it to a phone was very easy. It comes with everything you need: a manual, charging cable, and an extra set of earbud covers/caps for different ear sizes. You can control/adjust the volume and skip songs via a control (push button) on the earpiece. Even while running, they felt secure. And finally, his only hesitation in giving this product 5 stars is the ability to hear outside noise. He feels that this is a result of how the earbuds are designed. Unlike other headsets he has owned in the past, these sit “outside” of the ear canal/not directly in the ear, which means you do lose some sound quality. Perhaps, if these buds fit inside the ear a little deeper, or you use a headband to press the earbuds closer, the sound quality would improve. In conclusion, he believes these earbuds are not “bad,” especially at this price point ($50 on Amazon), but it could be improved. 4 stars

title: A very large nasal spray.
text: This leather messenger bag by HLC is very large and stylish. It is a rich, dark chocolate, brown. There are two options for carrying the bag, on the shoulder and in the hand. The shoulder strap detaches (can be removed) and can lay across your body or on your shoulder. Either way, it is comfortable. It has a ton of storage.  There are two large, deep, front pockets that can easily hold cell phones, keys, pens/pencils and a scientific calculator (anything really). I love the look - very modern, professional and smart looking. Because it is leather, time and use will only make it look better. The inside is sectioned and you can easily fit a laptop on one side and a bunch of other stuff (i.e., notebook, book, mouse) on the other. And finally, it snaps securely to prevent items from spilling out. Overall, this is a great bag that I’d recommend especially at this price ($85 on Amazon).

title: Great for the beach and traveling!
text:
Convenient.  Portable.  Inexpensive. Comes with everything you need: ear pods, charger and the device.  The sound is decent, not great but not bad.  There are controls for the sound, skipping tracks, etc.. Digital display. The batteries are not included.  Perfect for listening to books on CD while sunning on the beach. And yes, I know you can download books via Audible, but I’m old school and like the versatility of using a separate device that won’t drain my other devices (i.e., Amazon Kindle or cell phones).
Overall, for the price, this is an ok portable CD player.

title: A gorgeous laptop sleeve!
text: This laptop sleeve/case by Patricia Nash (Braga) is gorgeous. The outside is a delightful world map pattern. It looks very sleek and professional. This sleeve holds my 13 inch MacBook Pro perfectly, with room to spare. You can add a pad, paperback novel, agenda, charger and pens. There are several pockets inside (2 open and 1 zippered). It has a wristlet, that I wouldn’t suggest using to carry my device, but I definitely love that you can use it to open and close the pouch. Overall, this is a beautiful case that I’d highly recommend.

title: Does just what it is supposed to do!
text: I ordered this dongle for my new MacBook Pro 13”. You may not know this, but the MacBook Pro 13in has very few ports, so in order to use other equipment items like a wireless mouse, SD card, etc., you would need a dongle. I am doubly pleased that this dongle works on my new Galaxy S20fe. In conclusion, this is an inexpensive solution to a common problem for those who own MacBook. A bonus is that it can work on some cell phones. I’d recommend this dongle.

title: A tower of power and protection!
text:
I have decided to replace the traditional flat, surge protector.
This is a tower with a non-skid bottom.
There are enough spaces to charge multiple (up to 12) devices at one time.
This also offers protection from surges experienced during storms or power outages.
The cord is long, about 16 feet.
There are spaces for six USB connections/ports.
You can turn on and off certain outlets (there is one for each level) by flicking the switch.
Overall, this is a nice source of protection when charging your devices (laptop, phones, Kindle Fire and TVs).

title: A cute laptop bag.
text: I plan to purchase a MacBook Air for Christmas. My existing laptop is having issues and on those days that I work from home I need something reliable. This bag by TomToc is perfect. It is stylish and slimming. The color is perfect, yellow, but I would describe it as maize. The outside pocket is zippered, and the rear pocket is magnetic. The zippered pocket can hold all of the cords that accompany the Air or Pro.  The inside is slightly padded. It is not big enough to hold notepads or books, in addition to the laptop, so if you need to carry a lot of items, you will need to use something bigger. So, when I don’t want to take this bag, I can use one of my other bigger (backpack) ones.

title: Perfect for camping, work, school or pleasure.
text: This is a lovely, well made leather backpack by Ubant. It is rugged, smart, and professional looking. The leather is a rich brown, thick and durable. There are pockets, zippers, and snaps which are all needed to separate things and carry them safely. This bag is perfect for college students or young professionals. You can carry your electronics, books, and even a change of clothing inside easily. The straps are adjustable and comfortable on your shoulders. Men of all ages will enjoy this bag. My husband has already claimed it.

title: This bag is absolutely gorgeous.
text: This bag by Tiding is perfect for a weekend trip.  The dark brown leather is rich and buttery. This bag has comfortable shoulder straps that are adjustable.  It is very roomy. HUGE. There is a large front pocket and side pockets which can hold various items (i.e., a cell phone, keys, glasses, wallet). There are even pockets on the inside that can hold pens and other items. This bag is large enough to hold some essentials for a weekend stay. You can get at least two outfits, some pajamas, and toiletries inside. This bag can be used as a school bag or weekend one, by either sex (i.e., male or female).  My son has already stolen it.

title: A beautiful backpack.
text: This laptop backpack by Lannsyne is perfect for a college student or working professional. It fits my Dell Inspiron and my husband’s Google Chrome. It is rich dark brown in color. The leather is thick and sturdy, very durable. It will only look better with age, meaning the more beat up and distressed it becomes. It has lots of pockets, inside and out. The outside front pocket can hold keys, a cell phone, calculator, ID, cash or debit card. The shoulder straps are adjustable and comfortable when worn. The bag expands, so you can get a lot of stuff inside. I was able to get my laptop, a hardback novel, and essentials (pad, pen, lip gloss, brush, sunglasses, reading glasses, and makeup), inside comfortably with some room to spare. So, remember, while it seems stiff when you receive it, the bag should relax over time. There is also a convenient rear strap that you can use to attach this bag to your luggage. For the price, this bag is quite a find. I’d highly recommend it.

title: My world just got bigger. I finally have my wish.
text: Since childhood I’ve wanted a telescope, so when offered this telescope by Bebang, I jumped on it. I have always been amazed by the stars, space and wanted to look at them up close. How better to do that than with a telescope? This one was pretty easy to assemble.  This one comes with everything that the amateur Astronomer needs. Included are a finder scope, compass, tripod, carrying case and different eyepieces. There is even a phone adapter (for recording videos if you’d like). To be honest, I can’t wait to enjoy the next lunar eclipse, various phases of the moon, or Mars. My world just got bigger. So, for less than $100, you can get this telescope for the amateur astronomer. Perfect for the beginner!

title: Let the recording begin.
text: Recently my son has grown fond of vlogging and downloading videos to YouTube, so I thought ordering this camcorder would be nice in terms of producing nice looking videos. The Ordro 4K Camcorder comes with everything you need to create a nice video. It is sleek and very small (fits in the palm of your hand), unlike the large ones that I remember circa 1998. The lens is fixed but there is a touchscreen monitor that flips out. The kit comes with a manual, batteries, remote control, USB cable, charging cable and adapter, and card reader. There are some features that definitely make this device worth considering: (1) it isn’t very expensive (under $105 on Amazon). (2) It has night vision capability. (3) The hi-def videos are clear and colorful. (4) This device is easy to use and uploading your work is simple. (5) There is a timer feature. And (6) there is a date and time stamp feature. I’d recommend it.

title: Decent earbuds for an affordable price. 4.5 stars.
text:
The Belkin wireless earbuds can be used by android and iPhone users. This review is based on my using an android (1 plus) and my sons using their iPhone 12 and Samsung Galaxy S20 FE. Below is a summary of what we found.

PROS
- These earbuds are sleek and elegant. Super fashionable.
- They come in black versus the traditional white. Because they are black, most won’t notice them in your ear as much as they do other colors.
- Easy to pair (hold earbud button for 6 seconds). Pair under the Bluetooth setting on your phone.
- The amount of charge (i.e., percentage) shows on the phone display. Your device will signal when paired.
- The charger case is ergonomically friendly.
- Easy to change and come with USB charging cable.
- Comes with extra earbud tips.
- They are noise cancelling, so you do not hear any background noise.
- You don’t have to hold the button you just “tap” quickly (with your finger) to access controls.
- Buds fit comfortably in your ear.
-The sound quality is very good. These buds can handle bass heavy songs just as well as they handle jazz and classical music.
- Battery life is decent.

UNDECIDED/NEGATIVES
- There is a learning curve for figuring out the controls. It is a little confusing on how to control or how many “taps” are needed to pause and play music. This will take a little practice or getting used to.

title: Replacement Samsung remote.
text: This remote is perfect to replace our existing one. Years ago, our dog chewed our previous one so we needed another. It is affordable and compatible with our Samsung television. The only difference between this one and the old one is that there are a few extra buttons for services like Netflix and Prime Video. And while I couldn’t get those options to work, I like that they are available. This remote is the same size as the original one. I definitely would recommend this product.

title: Useful set for the amateur photographer. 4.5 stars
text: This light set comes with multiple, adjustable phone holders and a tripod. It has a remote to control the light. There is a power cable and an adjustable stand. This set is portable - everything fits in a bag with the exception of the stand. The ring is easy to assemble. To take a picture you can place a cell phone in the center of the ring (this piece is adjustable). The holder holds the device firmly/securely in place.  The light is very bright and is controlled by a touchscreen. You can easily adjust the brightness and warmness. It has warm and cool tone settings. Great quality when using for selfies or photo shoots needing background lighting. I’d recommend it.

title: A lovely tote. 4.5 stars
text: I am not sure what is wrong with me, but I have been obsessed with totes, purses, watches and shoes lately. So, I couldn’t let this cute tote go by without selecting it. It is very stylish and professional looking. It is also versatile. You can wear it casually or take it to the office. The grainy leather is wine colored. It appears durable and sturdy. The bag is lined with storage inside and out. It zips close. It is a nice size. You can carry a small electronic (i.e., laptop or Kindle), books, pens and notepads inside. Lovely tote. I’d recommend it.

title: Charge it up.
text: I ordered this with my son in mind. He worked really hard this holiday season to secure a PlayStation 5. I thought this Benazcap dual charging station (with dual USB C ports) would be a nice cherry on top. It is slim and compact. It doesn’t take up a ton of space on his gaming desk. There is a light that indicates when the controllers are fully charged. He likes that two controllers can be charged at the same time. Overall, this is a really nice charger that takes up very little room.

title: Just what I needed.
text:
Ironically, it took a pandemic (Covid-19) for me to finally bite the bullet and invest in a better laptop. My laptop was getting slow and having difficulties maintaining a charge. So, I ordered the Dell Inspiron laptop computer to dedicate solely to my teleworking (i.e., job). Understand that this review is strictly from this perspective. I wanted something reliable and easy to use. I wanted something that allows me to connect remotely to my work computer and where I can surf. This does the trick. It is:

Easy to setup.
Comes preloaded with various programs.
Charges quickly.
A convenient size. Not too big or too small.
Touch screen. The screen is super clear and bright.
It has face recognition which offers extra security.
Has a long (charging) cord.
Can install additional programs easily. *I was able to add the programs needed to connect virtually to my work computer.
It is lightweight and fits easily in a large purse or laptop bag.
It has additional ports (i.e., C-port, USB, headphone, etc.).
It comes with a microphone and speakers.
I know some have complained but my fan is quiet/silent.

In conclusion, for the price and what I needed it for (I’m NOT a tech person), this laptop is perfect. I’d recommend it. 4 stars

title: Abstract and pretty.
text: This Huasori case for my Fire HD (10th generation) is gorgeous. The colors are orange, cranberry, white and yellow. The design is cool – flowers, swirls and the sun. Very abstract.  My Kindle Fire snapped into the case easily. The cut-outs or holes for the camera, power cord and volume, are correct. This case closes with a magnetic snap which stays closed securely. There are two things that I wish this case had that my current one does. On my other one, there is a little area that you can fold the cover and prop my device open. This particular feature lets you prop the device open easily and view videos. Secondly, you have to slide and Velcro my Kindle in, which seems more secure. While it has never happened, I wonder if my Kindle if dropped will pop out? It just seems like the Velcro secures the device better, but I will see.  However, even with these two criticisms, I would recommend this case and definitely plan to alternate between the two that I have.

title: Let the binge-watching begin!
text: Easy to set up. Perfect to use when traveling. Provides hours of entertainment. Perfect to use when binge watching your favorite shows, movies or series.

title: Beware prying eyes.
text: I have a Microsoft Surface Pro 6 that I use for work and felt that I needed a little privacy from prying eyes. I ordered this privacy filter and installation was simple/easy. There are four steps to install the screen. It comes with a microfiber cloth, alcohol pad and installation board. Simply clean your computer screen, peel off the installation board and place the privacy filter on your device. It is very clear when sitting in front of my computer but once you move to a certain angle on the side it becomes more difficult to see. So someone peeking at your monitor from the side, will not be able to see what you are working on. It will appear dark. In conclusion, this filter does what it is suppose to do so I give it five stars.

title: Perfect for the office.
text: The Augsopa Tote is stylish, sleek and professional looking. It is perfect for the office. It is a neutral color, grey (faux leather) with chrome/silver accents. You can carry it by the thin handles or a shoulder strap. There are a lot of pockets (zippered and open) that makes organizing easy.  There is a large area where you can store a small tablet or Kindle (10in HD). And finally if you travel, you will find this tote useful. There is a large open pocket on the rear of the tote which allows you to slip it on your luggage, which means you don’t have to keep adjusting it. I’d recommend it.

title: Want privacy? You've got it. 4-4.5 stars
text: Initially I thought this was one of those anti-glare screens (I guess reading is fundamental) not a privacy screen. So imagine my surprise when I received the AmazonBasics Privacy Screen Filter. While I didn’t think I would like it, I do and am glad I made the mistake. It is easy to assemble. All you have to do is use one of the options of attaching provided, tabs or tape and you are good to go. All you have to do is affix it to the monitor (along the perimeter). Mine attached easily and fits well. I can even slide the screen in and out (to switch between matte and glossy). I like that there is some flexibility in the finish.  I used option 1 (the tabs) and have had no problem with it staying put. From the side, no one can see what is on your screen (or what you are working on), but as you move to the front of the monitor it becomes more visible. And finally it does minimize some of the harsh blue light. I’d recommend this.

title: A lot of storage in a small space.
text: The Lacie Portable SSD 500GB External Drive is a great storage device. It is extremely thin. This drive is small enough to fit in your hand and is very light in weight. It is easy to setup. It comes with a startup guide and pairs well with Mac or Windows based systems. It comes with two cords: USB 3.0 and USB-C.  if you are clumsy, this is also the drive for you. It is drop resistant up to 2 meters.  Overall, a great and convenient device that can be taken anywhere without taking up much space.

title: No outside noise + Big Sound = Evolve 65t.
text: The Jabra Evolve 65t EarBuds are pretty sweet. They come with a convenient zip case (with handle), charging case (USB cable included), Bluetooth adapter (dongle) and three sets of ear pads (so you can size them to fit comfortably in your ear). The directions for connecting to a device are pretty simple. For the computer, plug in the Bluetooth adapter and download the Jabra Direct app, and for your telephone just hold down the button until your earbuds turn blue and connect.  No matter the device, once you follow the directions, your device is operable within a few minutes. Placing the Jabra Earbud into the ear is simple, just insert into your ear (once you pick the appropriate set of pads) and rotate into place. In my opinion, the sound quality is fantastic, with both music and phone calls. You can work the controls (i.e., pause, play, hold and mute) with a tap on the device. A charge on the earbuds are believed to last up to 5 hours, and you are able to get two full battery charges from the rechargeable case.  While these are a little expensive, they are in my top five earbuds that I have owned. Overall, when I consider the sound quality, functionality and appearance, I give these five out of five stars, hands down.

title: Inexpensive but useful.
text: These Tomot speakers are inexpensive and pretty decent. They are attractive, black with red accents. They aren’t super large.  To me they seem to be about 4x6. They are small enough to fit on a shelf, or by a laptop. They are easy to use. There are no directions, but right out of the box, you can plug them in the computer (via USB or audio jack). The sound quality is good. Jazz, classic, rock and R&B all sound great. These are relatively inexpensive.  They work with a variety of devices. Only drawback, when not playing music, but still plugged in, these speakers make a slight noise. So for a very small investment, you get a decent pair of speakers.

title: A decent amount of bang for your buck.
text: The Acer Aspire 5 is a nice little laptop. I think it is perfect for the average student (high school or college) or for the home. Set-up is really easy. It is lightweight and fits into the average laptop bag. This makes it convenient and easy to carry or travel with. The screen size (15.6) is nice and the resolution clear (1060 HD). There are several ports: USB, Type C and HDMI. There is no CD reader, which is fine because most laptops don’t come with that anymore anyway. Most people just use a USB. There is 8GB of memory. Once charged, the battery life is decent. The sound quality from the built-in speakers is decent, so listening to videos or music is great. There is also one feature of this computer that I really like. It has fingerprint technology which adds an extra layer of security. Now, the two things that I would change about this computer: additional memory and make it a touch screen.  First, why not have more memory out of the box versus having to add some later. AND don’t most screens today come with touch technology? I think that would be an awesome feature.  However, for the cost, this computer has a decent amount of bang for the buck. It is affordable, lightweight and can do a lot, especially for students. And since my son will be entering his freshman year this fall, I will probably let him take this laptop.

title: Instant fun. Start capturing your memories.
text: My youngest son graduated from high school this past weekend. I wanted him to be able to capture memories. Kids today use their cameras, but never go on to print out the photos. Of course, I am from a generation where we use to print out photos and scrapbook or place them in a photobook. Instead kids today Instagram or Snapchat, simply posting a memory that will be gone if those platforms crash. So, I instead am trying to get my son to capture some moments on film. The Polaroid Original One Step 2 provided gives him that option. Simply point and shoot. Instant fun, instant prints, instant memories captured.  I remember begging for a Polaroid when I was younger.  My parents said that they were expensive, and it seemed to take some time before “Santa” gave me one. But once I did, I enjoyed snapping photos and waiting those few minutes until the photo came to life before my eyes. So really, this is more nostalgic than practical. I wanted my son to know the wonder of a Polaroid. So of course, this review is from that prospective. The One Step 2 is easy to load. There is a built-in flash and other great features. Unlike the old Polaroids, this one has a built-in rechargeable battery. That’s a very nice feature. The only thing is that this camera DOES NOT come with film, but that was pretty easy to rectify. I simply ordered mine on Amazon. While some would say that the film is kind of expensive, 8 pics for about $18.00 which equals a little over $2 a photo, it is FUN and the exciting thing is now you can get black & white film. How much fun is that? Start capturing your memories. 4 stars.

title: Endless possibilities.
text: I have owned a few surround sound systems in the past, but this one is one of the more advanced systems by far. Not only does it look great but sounds great too! While the Yamaha RX-A880 seems bulky and large, it will fit in most cabinets. It is sleek looking with a digital display. It is very simple to set up AND has the ability to give you a full surround sound experience. It is capable of running up to a total of seven speakers along with a subwoofer. It comes with seven HDMI inputs which can accommodate multiple devices. The Bluetooth wireless connection gives you the ability to connect the device to a smartphone, tablet or computer. All you have to do is download the free Yamaha Musiccast app from Google Pay Store or iTunes.  You can play music through most of the popular sound apps (i.e., Spodify, Pandora, Apple Music, etc). The Sound quality is great and gives you the ability to choose different surround sound options (i.e., sports, action games, music video, standard, adventure, drama, mono, etc). The system also has the multi-room capability and the ability to make adjustments on your television screen. Power is not a problem and gives you 100 watts of power per channel. Overall this is a great receiver (for the amateur music enthusiast) and gets 4 stars.

title: Camo chic.
text: The Under Armour Sportstyle Backpack is fashionable and perfect for the high school and college student. It has a popular camo pattern. The material (100% polyester) is water resistant. Conveniently located on the front is a zippered pocket, that you can keep stuff in (i.e., cell phone, wallet, ID, etc.). The back and inside pockets are padded, and there is an additional pocket on the front.  There is also a zippered inside pocket. The shoulder straps are comfortable and adjustable. The drawback in purchasing this bag is that I don’t think it can support a heavy laptop. I think this bag is perfect for thinner tablets or small laptops. Or if you are going on a vacation and need something to throw all of your electronics in it. But, I am not so sure this would be a great bag if you want to carry a lot of stuff. Overall, I think this is a great bag that you hipsters (high school and college) will use. I would recommend it.

title: Ready, Set, Go.
text: The Pelican Go G10 Case is a unique product. It is designed to keep your valuables secure and away from the elements (i.e., water or dust).  This plastic case appears to be well made and is attractive. There is a latch that closes securely.  I really like the colors, grey and teal. [This case does come in other colors (i.e., pink, white, yellow, blue, black and lime green)]. It is watertight and convenient to use while traveling, or engaging in outside activities (i.e., beach, hiking or fishing). You can just place your essentials, like your DL, credit card, cash, some headphones, a USB charger, or SD cards (if you are a photographer) inside. For short activities like walking your dog in the park or doing a short bike ride, you can use this case to secure an ID and some money if needed. Or you can attach it to a backpack or throw inside your bag. Now the issue that I have with this product. In my opinion the designers of this case did not take into account wanting to secure a cell phone. To be honest, that is the main reason that I ordered the Pelican Go, so that I can leave my purse at home and secure my personal items inside of it while doing stuff. For example, we have an annual race in Atlanta known as the Peachtree Road Race. This would have been perfect to secure my items while I participated. I can fit some (flat) items and maybe a lip gloss inside of it, but not a cell phone. I own a One Plus 6T, and it doesn't. Out of curiosity I tried my husband’s work cell (a Samsung) and it does not. I even tried my son's, which is an older model of the iPhone and it doesn't. So unless you have a very tiny cell, this case isn't going to work. However, if having your cell phone isn't an issue, you should be good to go. And finally, Pelican offers a lifetime guarantee on this product, which I assume means that any issues you might have should be resolved by contacting the company.

title: Sleek and professional looking.
text: The Bopai is a very sleek and professional looking backpack which comes in a cute storage/cover case. It can be carried in the traditional way (as a backpack), or it can be used as a briefcase (held by a handle located on the right side of the bag). Inside, a laptop is secured with a velcro strap in a faux suede compartment, which not only keeps your secured, but prevents it from getting scratches. Inside the front flap is a zipper pocket for storing small items and another compartment that can hold larger items like a cell phone, calculator or chargers. This bag is expandable and has a zipper that goes around the back of the bag. There are also two other storage compartments located on the front of the bag that can hold books or tablets. Located on the back, is a hidden zipper compartment. You can also connect a cell phone via USB port which connects to an internal battery that is not included. You also get a universal charging cable (USB 2.0) that is compatible with most USB devices. And finally, this bag is aesthetically pleasing to the eye. The straps and zippers have synthetic leather and metal attachments which give it a nice appearance. I give this backpack 5 stars.

title: Perfect for scrapbooking.
text: My son loves his Instax mini 70 Instant Camera. It's like an old school polaroid, but smaller. It creates the perfect sized photos for scrapbooks and  wallets. You can use it anywhere and at anytime. I have found that Amazon offers the perfect bundle (3 twin packs or 60 photos) for a reasonable price. I'd highly recommend it.

title: Protection and Style.
text: This Fintie Folio case is very pretty. It is a soft blue leather case with trees and blossoms covering. It fits the Fire HD 10 well. Your device is secure. You slip the Fire into the secured latch that velcros. There is an opening for the speakers, headphones, volume control, and power button. The cover doesn't muffle sound or block the built-in camera. You can still hear clearly. You can either hold the cover or prop it on the stand on the back. There is a place on the side for a stylus, if you want to.  So for protection and style, you can't go wrong with this cover. I'd highly recommend it.

title: A much needed upgrade.
text: I have owned two Kindles and loved them both. The first was a paper-white and the second was a Kindle HD 7. But this Christmas, I said “I am going to buy something just for me. Something that I will enjoy. Guess what, I bought myself a Fire, HD 10 and I love it. It is user friendly. I love the large screen and clear graphics (great for watching videos). I have a ton of space to download more books and read, read and read until my heart is content. I can surf the web and play my favorite games (i.e, words with friends, candy crush and others). Overall, this upgrade was much needed and is being appreciated. I highly recommend the Fire HD 10 (7th generation).

title: Does just what it is supposed to!
text: The Morelecs Nylon braided ethernet cable is great for connecting things to the internet without using wifi (or connect to a router). The length is pretty good, 25 feet, and since it is flat, it can go along the base of the wall without being seen (especially if the carpet is dark). It comes with convenient anchors which secure it in place. And finally, it looks nice too (gray and black braided nylon). Overall, I am satisfied with this product and highly recommend it.

title: Another Acer hit!
text:
Setting up the Acer Chromebook Spin 13 was very easy. The only thing you may need to do is create a Gmail account, but once that is done, everything else is pretty simple. And since I already had a Gmail account, everything synced with my existing account. One feature that I liked was that most of the popular Google apps appear at the bottom of the screen (ie. Google Chrome, Gmail, YouTube and the Playstore) but you have the ability to customize your display.

The Spin 13 is pretty sleek. Although the body of the laptop is aluminum, it is very light (per Acer 3.5 pounds). The laptop comes with wireless bluetooth 4.2, three USB 3.0 ports (2 - USB Type-C ports USB 3.1 Gen 1 (up to 5 Gbps) DisplayPort over USB Type-C & USB Charging).

The screen of this device is very clear which makes videos and movies exciting to watch. The screen is 2256 * 1504 pixels which is very good compared to some of the other high-end laptops on the market that may use different operating systems. It has the Corning Gorilla Glass NBT IPS with 10-point multi touch screen.

The battery life of the Spin 13 is very good when fully charged. When fully charged the device indicates that I had at least 9 hours of battery life. Therefore, it seems to use about 9% of the battery for every hour used (give or take a percent or two.)

The keyboard is easy to use although it is a little different than the standard keyboard, which has the functions keys across the top. Another cool feature is that it comes with a backlight which allows you to use it at night.

The Spin 13 also comes with a Walcom Stylus Pen. It is located on the front bottom right of the keyboard. The stylus can be used in various apps which can downloaded from Google App store. This feature is very convenient when taking notes or making drawings.

In conclusion, the Spin 13 definitely deserves 5 stars. It is easy to set-up and easy to use. I’d highly recommend it.

title: Love, Love, Love the color.
text: The WXY Bluetooth headphones are pretty. They are rose gold (a metallic pink) and white inside the earmuffs and along the inside of the headband. They are lightweight and comfortable. They are wireless but can be wired as well. You can use these with most electronics, meaning anything that is Bluetooth enabled or via USB/audio cord. You can charge the headphones with the USB. They are fashionable and stylish. Very feminine. They have a decent battery life. The WXY’s fold up nicely and fit into a carrying case. These are affordable and will be great as a stocking stuffer or gift.

title: Cool but I'm still not sure if gamers will really like it.
text: The ChonChow gaming keyboard/wired mouse and mousepad is pretty cool, especially for youngsters. The colorful lights (seven colors: purple, red, green, blue, white, orange and dark blue) that create the background of the keyboard are great.  The lights make it fun and adds a new flavor to your gaming experience. You can adjust the brightness pretty easily. The keys are soft yet firm. The mouse moves smoothly over the mousepad, but I do wish it was wireless. So for a pretty inexpensive price, you get a cool set (i.e., keyboard, mouse and mousepad). Only time will tell how durable this set is or how well it holds up to various stages of gaming. And although there are some cool features to this keyboard set, I am not sure “real gamers” will be as excited by these features as youngsters who are really just fooling around with the computer.

title: Mount up!
text: The Sabrent tripod is aluminum with a black finish. It comes with a nice carrying case, which can be used for storage and travel. Conveniently located Inside the bag is an inside zippered pocket that houses a shoulder strap and Allen wrenches (which helps to remove of the monopod leg). It extends up to 56 inches in height and comes with a 360-degree full motion camera mount which allows you to lock the position in with a turn of the knob. There are also three bubble levels which allows for centering on uneven foundations.  The camera mount also comes with a quick release which allows for quick removal of your camera.  It can be placed back on the tripod with just a slight push and again it is locked (back) in place. The legs can be adjusted and locked into three different positions. Or the legs can be extended to adjust to different terrains. And finally, the center column can be removed and used as a monopod, which is useful for stabilizing the camera for close-up photos or steadying your shot.  Overall, this is a nice tripod for traveling and for using in different applications. 5 stars but only gave 4 stars for durability, only time will tell if that is true.

title: Wireless and fast.
text: Amazonbasics wireless mouse is easy to set up. It is comfortable in your hand and allows you to navigate quickly. There is an indention om the side that allows you to grip the mouse. It comes with a dongle that you must insert into a laptop or desktop. The dongle is stored on the inside of the mouse beside the batteries. Two AA batteries are included. Over all, this is a great wireless mouse. I’d recommend it.

title: Boom Boom Pow
text: The VModa Crossfade 2 Wireless Headphones are great! I love the color (matte white and chrome), which I consider to be neutral or unisex. They look sleek and modern. The packaging is a lot smaller than another pair that I have.  They fold up nicely which makes them small and compact. They fit nicely into a carrying case. They are easy to set-up, wireless (although they come with an aux cord) and Bluetooth enabled. Charging the headphones is pretty easy (usb cord), and the battery life is great. More importantly, the sound quality is good. You can control the volume easily on the ears of the headset. The mic picks up sound well. The ear muffs are comfortable, not too loose or too tight. The sound is clear, sharp and does not bleed out. They are not too bass heavy.  And while some may frown at the price, I think the quality of these are better than Beats and Bose, but comparable to Sennheiser. My kids and husband each have an older pair of VModa’s, so I can attest to the quality and durability of this brand. They are made to last, so I expect several years of quality listening and enjoyment. I’d definitely recommend these.

title: Handsfree Baby!
text:
The Jabra Talk 35 Bluetooth Headset is great.
The instructions are simple and easy to follow.
This headset is comparable with an android or iPhone.
It fits comfortably in your ear. There are extra ear attachments that allow you to wear over the back of the ear or just inside.
The quality is clear.
The battery life is decent.
If you live in a handsfree state like I do (Georgia), this is the perfect little investment, especially if you drive an older model car that is not Bluetooth enabled. And I especially like this option better than some of those other cellphone accessories (that you mount on the dash or on the window).

title: Calling made easy!
text:
Jabra Talk 25 Bluetooth earpiece is easy to set up.
The actual earpiece is not large and fits comfortably in the ear.
It connects quickly to an android or iPhone.
It charges quickly and the battery life is decent.
For those who live in a handsfree state, these are perfect.
You can control these via voice command.
And finally, because these aren’t a huge investment (they are reasonably priced), you can’t go wrong trying these. Because they are inexpensive, you can give them to high school or college students and not worry about them losing them. They would even make decent stocking stuffers.

title: Old School.
text: Old school photography returns. Who doesn’t remember when the in thing was a polaroid camera. It allows you to instantly see what you took a photo of…instant gratification. The Polaroid Originals Black & White 600 film allows you to take black and white photos with a colorful border (i.e., pink, yellow, green and purple/blue). So in under 10 minutes, you get a cute photo. But like most instant photos, be careful of the light and positioning because what you print is what you will get. This 8 pack of film will cost you about $19, which is a little pricey (a little over $2 per photo) especially in the digital age. But for those who enjoy instant photos, this might be a small sacrifice. Overall, while trendy, I think polaroids are fun and will allow friends to instantly have memories of special moments. Imagine having these on tables during a family reunion, weddings, birthday parties and graduation parties.  Imagine the candid photos that you will have. So much fun. I give these 3 stars.

title: Looks better than it sounds. 2.5-3
text:
My first thought when I initially saw the Motorola Sphere 2-in-1Bluetooth Speaker with Over-Ear Headphones was, wow. It is extremely attractive and would definitely appeal to the young folks. Ironically, our house is full of loud, music playing teenagers who have very clear ideas about what sounds good and which products they prefer to use. They like speakers and headphones that offer clear sound quality with bass. We have a Bose Soundlink speaker, and VModa or Sennheiser earphones. So unfortunately when I reviewed these, I was comparing them with others that I have used. While this product might look good (definitely a 5), it needs to sound good. And this is where I am disappointed – in the sound quality.
In a nutshell:

Attractiveness – The Motorola Sphere is attractive. It is black and looks like a head with headphones.The system looks nice on a bookshelf, desk or dresser in a dorm room, bedroom, etc.. I do love the look.

Set up – The directions for setting up the device are easy to follow. Once you pair the headphones and the sphere (separately) to your phone (via Bluetooth), it is pretty easy to use. There is sometimes a lag when you disconnect or switch between the sphere and the headphones. You might have to press the button on the headphones to make the sound switch between the two devices.

Headphones – They are adjustable and the sound quality is good via the headphones.

Sound Quality – The sound quality is not good thru the speaker. I’d give it 2.5 at the most. To me the frequency response seemed a little high, which is why the sound thru the speaker is hollow or missing something, no matter the genre (i.e., classic, jazz, rap, rock) played. But a plus is that the quality of the sound thru the headphones is better, it is more balanced and therefore rates 3.5-4 (although the bass is still not heavy).

In conclusion, while I love the look and concept (2 in 1 – speaker and headphones) of the Motorola, I wouldn’t recommend it. I would instead suggest investing a little more money and getting a better more quality speaker.

title: A satisfied customer.
text: My son is a junior in high school and wanted something a little different this year. So I let him select this roomy, camo bag with black and tan accents. There are tons of pockets/compartments, zippers and an area in the back for an average sized laptop. The straps are adjustable. He said that it is comfortable to wear and doesn't hurt his back. Guess what, he loves this backpack and gets a ton of compliments from his friends. He is satisfied. And any mom will tell you, a happy son makes a happy mom.

title: Perfect.
text: Our new puppy chewed thru my son's laptop (Acer) cord. This was the perfect replacement, not to mention affordable.

title: Perfect for home and office.
text: This cable charges my android phone quickly. And while some may consider the length of this cord to be too long, I beg to differ. It is perfect for the home or office. For me, I appreciate the long cord when charging my phone while it sits on my dresser or nightstand. The cord attaches easily to the plug in the wall, I can sit it on top of either piece of furniture and not have to worry about having to leave it on the floor. The same at work. I can leave it plugged under/behind my desk, and still have plenty of cord. I can also attach this cord to my computer and charge my device or do other functions that require a USB cable. It's reasonably priced and convenient. I highly recommend it.

title: VModa doesn't disappoint.
text:
Reviewed by a very satisfied college student.
These headphones are to be used in with the iPhone, iPad or iPod.
VModa always encloses their products in very insulated packaging, which prevents damage.
They come with a convenient carrying case. There are a variety of extra ear cushions (sports fins, earhooks, etc) included.
Volume and play controls are located on the re-enforced cable/cord. They are easy to reach and adjust.
These headphones are a nice color (orange)....which makes them easy to see and keep up with. I especially like the fact that they aren't the traditional white or black.
These headphones are extremely lightweight and don't weigh down the ear.
These headphones are comfortable in the ear and can be used while exercising or just walking back and forth to class.
These earbuds are sweat and water resistant, which are perfect for runners or cross country lovers.
These headphones are affordable (i.e., comparably priced).
They are noise canceling and the sound quality is out of this world. From bass heavy music to classical, the sound is out of sight.
Outstanding quality, not to mention a decent manufacturer's warranty.
I would highly recommend these headphones. 5 stars

title: Reviewed by the Hubby....
text:
These are a great set of headphones. Sennheiser is a brand that you know and trust. I have purchased this brand before.

Aesthetically: The look and feel of the Sennheiser HD 4.30G is very streamline. They are black and sleek. The cushions that comprise the ear cups are comfortable and fit over the entire ear. They do not leak sound, like some other headsets I have used, when the volume is loud. This feature allows the user to play music and not disturb others while listening in public.

Packaging: While some may feel that these earphones should be stored in a hard case, they are not, so keep that in mind if you are worried about protection. These Sennheisers fold up which makes them convenient for travel and storage. They fit into a small draw string storage bag with a detachable cable. The detachable cable allows the user to control the volume, pause, forward and play songs. The cable also allows the user to stop and answer phone calls. The clarity is very clear. I have an android phone, but I am sure that they are compatable with the Iphone as well.

Sound Quality: These headsets have a frequency response of 18000- 22000 hz which allows the listener to hear those deep bass lows and high notes that are popular today in a large genre of music. Again, the sound quality is very good and great clarity.
Overall, these headphones are 5 out of 5.

title: Cool, cute and functional.
text:
In a time when people want instant everything, the Fuji Instax Mini 26 fits the bill. Actual photos in a few seconds. Couple this with the fact that people no longer want to develop photos, they merely rely on cell phones to post, instagram, or tweet. But for those who are “old school” and want something tangible to send hold or send, the Fuji Instax Mini 26 is perfect.

This small camera is: (1) easy to hold; (2) easy to use; (3) affordable, the camera -under $70; the film – under $20 depending on the pack you select; (4) it’s lightweight/portable; and (5) MORE IMPORTANTLY, CUTE (it comes in a variety of colors).

Now I have some suggestions about what can you do with this small camera: Let me give you a few options: (1) You can capture candid moments at a wedding. Just imagine all of the moments you will capture if you place one of these delightful gems on each table, at the reception. This is the perfect opportunity to capture those candid shots and moments of your guest, ones that will probably not be captured by a wedding photographer. You could then create a pin board for guest to post photos and make comments, or use the photos for a scrapbook. (2) You could make your own Photo Booth for graduation parties, birthday parties - Sweet 16 Birthday Party, Football tailgating parties; etc, without having to print out tons of photos. Again capturing all of those moments that you normally wouldn’t get but that you can cherish for a lifetime. (3) This is a perfect gift. Young teens or kids can use this camera to do school projects, selfies or just have fun.

Overall, while this camera will not appeal to “real” photographers, I think there is a real market for people who want to have fun. However, not that while this camera is fun, it is a tad bit pricey. I highly recommend it.

title: It’s hard getting fit, but this little gadget might motivate. 4 stars
text:
My husband and several of my friends have a Fitbit and they swear by it. So when offered the opportunity to try the Samsung Gear Fit2, I thought why not? Maybe this will motivate me to get in shape. I always have good intentions when it comes to getting fit and in shape, but I don’t always stay on task or follow-through. So maybe this gadget will be just the thing I need to motivate me and hold me accountable. This review is based on the novice exercise enthusiast. So keep this in mind when reading this review. It really depends on what you are looking for in a fitness gadget.

Now for the review.

Downloading the program: I have an android (LG) phone. The program was easy to download. I didn’t have any problems. You can do everything from the app from locating the Gear Fit2 to sending music to it.

Appearance: In appearance, it’s like a traditional fitness tracker. I love the color (blue). It's a unisex color. I wouldn't describe the color as either royal or navy, but a muted blue that matches most items of clothing. Nice option instead of the traditional black. The band is adjustable and comfortable. In terms of size, in my opinion, the face itself is slightly wider than my husband’s Fitbit. The default face is a traditional clock, but you can change the look/appearance pretty easily (under settings) and there are some cool options. I really like that you can change the font and the size of the device as well. This is a great feature us middle agers who have trouble reading small print. Everything that can be done on this device is at a “touch”. You simply swipe back and forth, and select. It is super easy.
Charging: You charge this device via a wall charger that connects to the Gear magnetically. I probably would have preferred to connect into the device versus via magnets, but it isn’t a deal breaker. I haven’t had any trouble and it appears to keep a decent charge (remember I am a novice, so for those hardcore fit people, you may want to read other reviews).

Features: (1) When connected to Bluetooth, when you receive a call, you will get a notification (i.e., the name of the person that is calling you) on the screen. You can set the notifications to buzz, vibrate, etc.
(2) You can also connect to your music via Bluetooth.
(3) You can set your profile (under settings) quickly from the device. This information includes: gender, age, height or weight. I like this feature because this allows me to share the device with my teenage sons. When they use it, they can simply change the profile (information) from me to them and enjoy it too.
(4) You can monitor your heart rate, as well as your calories burned.
(5) There is a cool exercise log. It breaks it down by day and tells you the total number of steps, etc. This allows you to monitor the number of steps and or floors that you take per day.
(6) It can monitor your caffeine intake. You merely enter the cups.
(7) There is a stopwatch and timer feature. So if you are doing some kind of specialized training….let’s say an hour of cardio or walking, you won’t have to keep looking at your watch for the time, you simply set the timer.
(8) You can set the individual activity (i.e., running, walking, hiking, pilates, yoga, squats, elliptical, exercise bike etc.). I was pretty impressed with this feature. I think that it is helpful to compare the exact exercise with the amount of energy you are exerting. There was such a wide variety of exercises available that you surely will find one that suits your needs. When I asked my husband, he said that his fitbit only monitors walking or running. So for those hardcore fitness folks, this might be a plus for purchasing this product.
(9) You can monitor your target time, distance or number of calories burned easily.
(10) There is a 24 hour activity log that breaks down when you’re active or resting/sleep. It divides it by date, day and number of calories. This is helpful when trying to determine where you need to pick up the pace.
(11) There is also an indication of the temperature outside as well as your general location (i.e., city).

My husband says that some of the features that I have on my device, he cannot see unless his Fitbit is connected to the computer. I like that Samsung has made certain features convenient for the consumer. And he said some of the detailed features he doesn’t even have.

Overall, I am satisfied with the limited stuff that I have done with the Samsung Gear Fit2. It’s a cool little gadget. But I like I tried to explain in the beginning, it depends on what you are looking for in a fitness monitoring device. While slightly more expensive than the Fitbit Charge, you will have to decide if the differences in features warrant the price. And finally, only time will tell if it provides me the motivation to really dig deep and work out consistently. But it won’t be because I don’t have the tools to do it.

title: Sleek, chic and fast. 4.5
text:
This Acer computer (Aspire V17 Nitro-Black Edition) is extremely attractive (ok, that shouldn’t be the most important thing but it helps). The aesthetics of this computer are great. It came in a sleek black box that if you are giving it as a gift, would make quite the statement.

The computer itself is black (almost a matte finish) and when on, the keyboard lights up neon red. The keyboard feels comfortable and is surrounded by a rubbery type material. The monitor/screen is 17.3 inches. It is clear, shows videos and photos in HD. I haven’t noticed any bleeding or distortion. The keyboard is comfortable, but I am a girl with fingernails that aren’t too long. My husband and teenage sons did not complain about the shape and size of the keys, but that is an attribute that may depend on your personal preference.

The computer was pretty easy to set up. It came preloaded with Windows 10 and Cortana (Microsoft’s version of Siri). You can cut that feature on and off. It has a camera and the other basic features of a laptop. The sound quality is sharp and clear. The charge seems to be appropriate for the use.

When you read this review, you must first understand I’m not a techy, so for me this laptop is perfect. I can surf, watch movies and do the basics. I haven’t noticed any issues but will update this review if I do. Overall, I give it 4.5 stars.

title: V-Moda has done it again.
text:
I have purchased and received several headphones over the years. To name a few - V-Moda, Bose, Sony, Sennheiser, Beats, Skullcandy. They have varied in style and price. I have never considered seriously purchasing earbuds and generally use those that came with my Ipod, or I’ll just grab some that belong to my kids, who are always plugged in or listening to music. But one thing that I have learned is that there is a big difference in audio equipment. You basically get what you pay for. The cheaper ones, the cord crimps or shorts and the more expensive, the longer they last. And when you compare these, the V-Moda ZN In-Ear Audiophile Headphones to those you realize that you haven’t really been hearing at all.
Of all the brands I have tied, V-Moda are among my top two, especially when you compare them to some of the popular “bass heavy” ones that are so popular and all the rage these days. Anyway, I have purchased the wired V-Moda headsets for my sons, and recently acquired the wireless ones via Vine. So when I saw these, I got pretty excited. I was going to have versatility. The wireless ones while providing perfect sound are large, cover the entire ear (over the ear style), but in my opinion they are a little too large to wear while exercising (i.e., walking or running). You can do it, but I prefer something lighter and less bulky.
These headphones are pretty versatile. I have used them with my phone (I have an android but I know that they are compatible with Apple), my computer and my Ipod.
They are attractive, or as attractive as earbuds can be.
The buds are comfortable and come with a variety of accents (sizes) and styles (active flex sport ear hooks).
They are black, with silver and gray accents.
You can control the volume and pause music easy enough with a handy controller on the cord. The controller is close to the ear.
These also have a mic.
The “diamond back cable/cord” seems durable and heavy duty. It is black with a gray crisscross design.
There is a nice carrying case…about the size of a small change purse or ID carrier, which fits easily in a wallet, purse, backpack or even pocket.

The only drawback to purchasing these buds is the price. They are $180, which is a little pricey…but if you consider the quality and the possibility of never buying another pair, it is well worth it. I give them 5 stars.

title: Boom Boom Pow!
text:
I have owned/purchased several different types of headphones in the past ….Beats, Koss, Sony, Sennheiser, even wired V-moda’s, and I would say these are in my top two.

These headphones are attractive...I received these in gunmetal black. If you’d like to customize your look, you can order different colored metal shields and ear cushions.

The earmuffs have soft cushions and surround the entire ear. More importantly, these muffs allow for several hours of comfort if worn for extended periods of time. The volume control and mic are integrated on the right side of the headset. And while these can be worn for several activities, I wouldn’t really suggest working out in them, they are too nice (or expensive), but it can be done.

The headset comes with their own case, a USB charging cord, a 3.5mm 45’ degree plug with 24k gold tips and a clip to hang them from your bag or jeans. Bluetooth connection is fairly easy, there is a switch that you push on the back of the right earpiece. Once activated it gives a tone that lets you know it is trying to connect. Once you activate bluetooth on your device, it is ready.That’s right, these headphones provide great sound and are WIRELESS. What a fantastic feature. And you even have the option of not using the wireless feature by connecting to various portable devices (i.e., smartphone, laptop, tablets, etc) with the provided “mic 1 speakeasy cable”.

And finally, when I listened to different genres of music (i.e., jazz, rock, rap, classical) , the sound was clear and the quality is among the best. The frequency response listed is 5Hz-30kHz and that appears to be accurate. The sound wasn’t muted or distorted.

Overall, I would give these headsets 5 stars. These are definitely worth the money.

title: Game on!
text:
Lenovo has made a great gaming headset. You can connect to a computer or gaming console with a USB, and for those who would prefer to use their telephone (android or Apple) there is a 3.5mm connector. When connected to your computer you can go to the Lenovo's website - http://www.lenovo.com/gamingheadset, download the software and make adjustments to the headset. For example, one feature is a delay in the mic. It allows a two or six second delay, or will stay on continuously. There is also an equalizer, that you can manually adjust that allows you to enjoy different genres of music (ie., jazz, dance, rap, classical, etc). There is a Movie/Surround sound setting/adjustment that allows for music and gaming. The Audio Brilliant sound adjustment and Dynamic Bass Selection gives you deeper bass sound through different levels. There is Smart Volume setting which allows for high dynamic sound with music and Low Dynamic sound for voice. There is also a Voice Clarity setting where the decibel level can be changed for clarity over the mic and surround max. The other settings (Voice Control and Magic Voice) are for the microphone and changes the sound of your voice.

This headset is attractive and comfortable. It is black with red accents. There is adequate cushioning around the ears and the headband is adjustable. Lenovo folds up neatly for storage. The only negative (while I didn't deduct for) is that it doesn't come with a carrying case, and it would be nice even if it was a drawstring bag. The external mic is removable and attaches about six inches off of the right side of the headset. A feature that I like is that the mic can be moved forward and backwards, which is different from previous headsets that I have owned which only move up and down.

Overall, I would give these headset five stars when I consider all of the options provided, sound quality and comfort.

title: Just what you need when you are on the go…a LowePro for your GoPro!
text:
Reviewed by my husband, a photography enthusiast.

Over the last 20 years, my husband has purchased several LowePro camera bags/backpacks (i.e., Mini Trekker & Micro-Trekker 100). He has found that they have been some of the best he has ever owned. He prefers backpacks because they are easy to carry and keep up with, especially if you are on the go. Backpacks also allow for easy storage and are super convenient. They give you freedom of movement and your hands are free to capture those special moments that you may not otherwise get if you were holding a bag in your hand. The Viewpoint (LowePro) BP 250 is the perfect addition to his bag collection especially since it is specially designed for small video equipment.

Here’s what he liked:

• This bag is attractive. The design is smart, functional and full of surprises. The Viewpoint BP250 is well-made with plenty of room for your Go Pro and accompanying equipment. There is a ton of storage (inside and out). There are several compartments where you can store your accessories, cords, lenses and other equipment. On the outside of the main bag, there is a zipper pocket (which allows for small items like a memory stick/card or thumbdrive). There is a pocket on the other side of the bag which will fit a small tripod or other item (like an umbrella). The entire bag can be zippered so you won’t lose any of your accessories.

• It is ideal for those who use (small) video and other digital equipment. There is a space dedicated to a small computer. While this backpack will not allow you to carry one of the larger sized laptops (our 17” didn’t fit), it has adequate space for the smaller ones (about 15”), a SurfacePro, iPad or other small notebook or tablet. He finds that the option of carrying a computer is great because it will allow you to quickly upload and edit your videos wherever you are. There is no reason to wait….just review, edit (if needed), and upload!

• The straps are unlike the traditional ones that come straight down the shoulders. The BP250 LowePro’s straps are curved which he found to be less stress on his shoulders. After some adjustments (he’s 6’1, average sized with average shoulders), it was a good fit. The straps are slightly padded and comfortable. There are small snaps that lock the straps in place to ensure that they don’t fall down when walking or hiking.

• There is a small (lunch box sized bag) that can be removed and can hold your GoPro camera and equipment. Once closed, it fits directly into your main LowePro Bag. It is padded and once inside, will protect your camera and smaller lenses. Or if you want, this smaller bag can be used instead of taking the large one.

• This bag comes with a rain cover. Not sure how much you will use this feature, but if you are ever caught in a drizzle or rain storm, there is a plastic cover that can be removed (unzipped) from the bottom and cover your bag. This is perfect for keeping your bag and equipment dry.

• The price. While this bag may seem a little pricey (about $130) it’s worth it. The craftsmanship and functionality will prove invaluable for the amateur or professional photographer. It’s a small investment with some heavy returns. You’ve got protection and functionality.

Overall, my husband gives this bag 5 stars. He finds that it is not only good to use for a GoPro, but other small video and photography equipment. Backpacks are useful for photographers because they allow your hands to be free to capture those moments or events as they unfold. In the past he has purchased Lowepro equipment and found them to be sturdy and durable, and the Viewpoint BP250 is not different. It looks good and he won’t leave home without it.

title: Impressed.
text:
I really like this laptop. It is versatile and has tons of features that make this a great purchase.

1. It has a large easy to read screen (about 17”). Wonderful for watching movies or surfing.
2. It has the regular features of a laptop but the added feature of being touch sensitive. Therefore, you can navigate between screens and tasks by using your fingers.
3. The keyboard is located in the center of the laptop but is surrounded by a rubbery filling casing that allows the palms of your hand to comfortably rest while typing.
4. You can use either the mouse or the touch feature.
5. This computer has several USB ports, an Ethernet, hdmi, SD card, and DVD/CD drive.
6. A nice long cord for charging.
7. This laptop is large enough for a dorm room or home office.
8. It has a built in camera.
9. The keyboard lights up when you are typing which helps if you are working in dim light. (Ok, now I am telling my age.)
10. It comes preloaded with Windows 8.1 and a free upgrade to Windows 10 when it is available.
11. The battery life is decent.
12. You can decide how you’d like to sign-in on the laptop, either a password or face recognition.
13. This laptop is comparably priced to others on the market and has the touch screen feature.

The only warning that I will give anyone considering purchasing this laptop is the size. It is large (which is great to use at home or in a dorm room), but a little too large and heavy (5 to 7 lbs) to be portable or carry around…..unless you have great arm strength or a large backpack.

Overall, this product warrants 5 stars and I would recommend it to anyone in the market for a great laptop.

title: The perfect groomsmen gift. 3 to 3.5 stars
text: For under $50, a groom could purchase this portable iHome speaker for his groomsmen. Of course there are other occasions that you could purchase this item, but that is what came to mind when I first saw the masculine design. It's cute and the sound quality isn't bad. There are some other benefits to buying this item. This speaker is portable, about the size of an actual flask. It fits in my hand easily. It is Bluetooth enabled or you can attach a cord and play your music. I was able to connect both my phone (android) and ipod easily. It comes with both USB and aux cords that fit along with the speaker in a small leather like pouch that you can attach to anything. The controls are on the top of the speaker and easy to access. Overall, I think this is a great novelty item that would make a great gift. 3 to 3.5 stars

title: All you'd want and more. Not to mention you can't beat the price.
text:
This product is inexpensive. Under $6.
My nano fits snugly and securely in the case.
I can adjust the sound and skip songs easily.
There is an adjustable armband (adjust for any size).
It is made from a comfortable material. It doesn't stay damp long and dries quickly so that sweat doesn't cause an odor (but I don't really sweat, I get sticky or as my mom likes to say, I glisten).
There is an optional clip for waistband or belt.
When your device is in this case, the controls are each to reach and make adjustments.
The Headphones/Ear bud jack is accessible. The cords fit securely without having to adjust them.
For a small, really small investment, you have a great product.
Would highly recommend it.

title: Not worth the money.....2.5-3 stars
text:
When I was reading about this product, I was intrigued. The Belkin charging dock duo can charge two devices: an IPAD (4th generation), IPAD Mini/AIR, Nano (7th generation), IPOD Touch (5th generation) or an Iphone (5 or up), at the same time. Surely this is a useful item to own. Well, I was mistaken.

Usefulness: While you would think that this product is useful....because it can charge multiple devices at once... it is also a little burdensome. It's bulky, so I would not recommend this product while traveling. On the other hand, if you use the charging cables/cords that come with the devices, you can wrap them up and store them in a small compartment in your bag. This docking station would take up space in a travel bag, briefcase or suitcase. However, I would recommend this product for those who want to charge multiple "I" devices on their nightstand or dressers. I do like that they can be charged standing up, which makes them neater and more orderly. On a positive note, you can use your device while it is charging. Why you would want to I don't know, but it is an option.

Functionality: There is a handy, dandy ball that you can roll with your finger that allows you to raise and lower the adapter (front compartment and back), in order to accommodate a phone with a cover. The instructions suggest that you remove the cover to charge, but for the average consumer that would be inconvenient to remove the cover every time you want to dock it. Regardless, if you have a thick cover (i.e., Otterbox or Reiko) it will not fit on the docking station no matter how much you adjust it. So you must remove the thicker covers (like Otterbox) before you can dock it. My son complained that this was a hassle/extremely inconvenient, especially when he can leave his cover on and simply plug it into the wall. He didn't think that removing the cover to charge outweighed the inconvenience of removing it. However, a slimmer case (less protective ones), like those decorative/fashion ones (i.e., Kate Spade, etc) will fit on the Belkin.

Cost: $82 is very expensive for a product that isn't a must have or at least one that is useful. I am not sure that this product would be a good investment.

Overall, I give the Belkin Power House Dual Charge and Sync Docking station 2.5 out of 5 stars.

title: A lot of bang for your buck.
text:
KOSS has created the perfect headphones for the amateur artist or the casual listener. They have put a great deal of work into both the functionality and aesthetics of this product. There are several things that I noticed at first glance:
(1) Aesthetics: The carrying case for the headphones is attractive. It is thin and practical. It fits well in a book bag, purse or travel bag.
