title: Screws longer than the board, bottom protectors wouldn’t screw in…
text:
I bought this with the hopes of getting my laptop up higher off my desk so my 1 year old could not undock it while I’m working. I did use my electric screw driver and as others pointed out there was no instructions or place to say where the screws would go. I wasn’t too worried about that, just line it up and screw it in right?

Sure… but the screws where longer than the board and went through the other side scraping my finger that was where the screw went through the wood on the other side. I was thinking I can live with that for now…

Then I tried to screw in the protectors that screw into the only holes in the metal on the bottom… they wouldn’t screw in all the way. I even tried using a knife in the notch but the plastic just started to come off.

I don’t think I’ve ever had this bad of luck, but maybe I should have read the reviews better! So I will be sending it back and they can send it back out together.

title: Good quality and great for commuters!

title: Printer/ computer stand
text:
This item didnt come with instructions, but i was able to figure out how to assemble from the picture of the item. There are four pieces: the top, middle shelf, and 2 sides. You attach one of the sides to the top and middle shelf with the screws and tool provided. then attach the other side and it's done. I used this for my printer and paperwork on the shelves and it works great. My printer is about 15-16" wide and fits on it perfectly. It's bigger than the top but
I have it kiddy corner on my desk and up against the wall to provide that additional support.

title: Projector
text: I tested this projector in my room, on an empty wall and for sound, hooked it to my soundbar. It was pretty simple to setup, just plug in and put batteries in the remote. It was also easy to connect it to the internet. I was able to log into my amazon prime accound and attempt to watch some shows/ movies on there. However, the picture quality does not stay crips. The connection to the internet must not be the best because it will start off good then eventually get blurry. Also the app store that is installed is very limited. The known apps that I seen were netflix and prime. Overall, I wouldnt recommend this item.

title: Smart watch
text: I set this watch up with my Galaxy S10+. I have another MK smart watch so I was familiar with setting it up. Even if you aren't, it is very simple. Just follow the directions on the watch and it should be quick. The watch itself is beautiful and as shown. It was a bit big for me so I'll end up taking a link out for it to fit. Notifications come through fine, if you choose that feature. I would recommend this item.

title: apple pencil pouch
text:
-great for apple pencil
-attached easily and was secured
-snug fit for pencil, even fit with cover over pencil
-highly recommend

title: Lap tray
text:
-durable and quality material
-not the most sturdy, it kind of rocks back and forth with pressure when it is flat on the ground (I think from the cushions on the legs or the shape of the legs)
-the cup holder isnt deep enough to actually hold a cup in place. It's only about 1/4 inch deep and it is small so any coffee mugs or tumblers wouldnt fit
-it does have ample space on the surface
-i like the handle, makes it easy to carry

title: Speaker
text: This speaker works great. I mostly use it for listening to music on my phone through the bluetooth function. I sometimes use it to charge phones too. It didnt work well with an S10 (it charged it slowly), but works well with an iphone XR for charging. I like the docking station for the phone, it's convenient. The sound quality is great, clear, and just the right amount of bass. It's not too heavy either and it's slim so it fits in small places.

title: Projector
text: I gave this item two stars because the picture quality is not good. I had to move the projector very close to the wall, about 5 feet from the wall in order for the picture to be clear. However, it made the size of the picture pretty small. I wouldn't recommend this item based on picture quality.

title: Printer
text: Printer was easy to setup. I set it up with my chromebook and my phone and that took about 10 minutes for each. Easy to connect to home wifi for use. Takes standard white paper. Colors are vibrant. Item is sturdy. Overall, a very simple home printer and I would recommend because of the ease of use and ease of setup.

title: Headphones
text:
-very easy to pair to my phone (have a S10+)
-the fit is a little weird, but it's something you may have to get used to
-i like the fact that the case shows you the battery level
-the sound quality is impeccable
-i turned the volume all the way up and they were very loud and the sound was clear
-would recommend

title: Bluetooth transmitter
text:
-Item works well
-easy to connect phone to (both iphone xr and iphone 11)
-easily connects when coming back into the car (if you leave your bluetooth setting on on your phone)
-sturdy
-good quality
-quality sound
-would recommend

title: Lights
text: I use these lights to capture pictures of my art and craft products. I mostly use one because I dont necessarily need more than that for the size of the items I'm picturing. It would be nice if they could plug into one another so that you dont have to plug them all in separately. Also, there are no adapters included with the lights, just the usb cable. The lights are very bright, but on the brightest setting the lighting looks unnatural. I usually use it on the lowest setting or one to 2 notches up from there. There are plastic pieces that are different colors that can go over the lights, such as blue, yellow, white. I think those would look nice when photographing a person, but not an item. Overall, they work well.

title: Laptop stand
text: This item was easy to assemble. Assembly just requires screwing the small poles into the slots on the stand. All you need to do is figure out how much space you need for each device and make sure you make enough slots for all your devices. The only thing I dont like is that there is no way to make sure the poles on each side are even; you just kind of have to eye it. The stand is very sturdy and made of good quality. I currently have my samsung chromebook and my samsung tablet on this stand, and that's really all I need it for. So far, it is sturdy and reliable and gives me more space on my desk since I dont have to have these items laying around. Helps to expand space on your desk or whatever area you're putting it.

title: Ear phones
text: Instructions for this item were really clear and it was easy to setup. All I had to do was remove the plastic strips from the under the ear buds then they pair with the case. Then I turned my bluetooth on and found the item and they paired to my phone without any problem (I have a Samsung Galaxy S10+). I would have given 5 stars but the tap functions dont work so well. You are supposed to tap twice to pause or play music. This usually worked about 3 out of 5 when I tested on both ear buds. I tapped faster and slower to see if that would change the results, but it didnt. When it came to the three taps for previous/next song, the ear buds seemed confused and began pausing and playing the music at times. Again, I couldn't tell if I was tapping too fast or slow. This functions worked about 1-2 times out of 5 tries. The range is great though. I was able to leave my phone on my bed and walk out my front door (about 20 ft away) then outside to my front door and there was no static or insidication that the connection was fading. The volume is great as well with both or one ear bud in.

title: Shoulder fan
text:
-travel item
-great for cooling yourself outdoors
-Easy to use
-multiple settings for fan speed
-flexible and comfortable on neck

title: Base stand
text: I planned on using this base for my camera, but ended up trying it out on (and keeping it for) my projector. Instead of a tv, I have a projector in my room. The projector is a normal size... the dimensions are 8.6 x 6.2 x 3.7 inches and it is 4.7lbs. I like this stand because it looks nice on my night stand, makes a good looking setup. The item definitely has some weight to it and is bigger than I expected it to be. It does a pretty good job keeping my projector in the same position and not tipping or falling over or moving. I notice a slight change in the display about every other day, but I think that's because the screw hole for my projector is right in the front (rather than middle) so it will kind of lean to one side or the other. However, if that hole were right in the middle I dont think this item would have issue with keeping it in the position I select. Overall good quality and would recommend.

title: Camera
text: The camera is kind of bulky, but thats to be expected when you have to put paper in it to print. The picture quality is decent, what you would expect from this type of item. Has a variety of frames to put on the pictures. I thought the pictures printed as you took them, but you select the picture then print it. Pictures print in black and white. Certain pictures come out better looking than others. The frames dont print out well at all. Comes with 3 rolls of paper, which is plenty. Comes with very short charging cable. Overall, I think this is a fun camera for kids.

title: Light
text: Works well. Can be kind of heavy depending on the size of your camera. Easy to install and use. Has number settings on back for brightness and white/yellow color so if you find your favorite/best light setting you can continue to set it to those numbers and use continuously. I've used it to photography myself and some random items and have had to play with settings each time for best lighting in particular environments. Overall good quality and would recommend.

title: Light box
text:
-very small
-easy to assemble
-comes with different colors like green, blue, white, black for the background
-The box is made of some material like a thick white plastic
-easy to construct, just have to put slots on side panels into slots on top and bottom panels
-stays up well enough
-However, due to folding it when not in use this kind of causes it to droop some
-overall, the lighting is good
-the size of the box is a downside because even with the smallest items, you would have to do some major cropping and editing to edit the side and top panels out

title: Dash cam
text:
-Very easy to install
-straight forwards directions
-I mounted mine in front of the rearview mirror and had the cord go down the passenger side of the dash to my lighter (for powering the item)
-Comes with memory card. Easy to retrieve videos from on a computer
-image is very crisp and clear
-records and shows in real time, no lagging
-lightweight, can transfer vehicles easily or to a rental, if needed
-highly recommend

title: Soundbar
text:
-sound quality not the best
-can barely hear the bass/ sound amplification from the speaker
-Easy to use/ connect
-no optical cord included
-better for playing music through bluetooth or amplifying sounds from a laptop or computer
-Get what you pay for as far as sound

title: Laptop stand
text:
-everything feels very flimsy
-looks like it should be a sturdy metal, but is just this black thin plastic like material
-came with no instructions
-there are legs that form a z shape and have dials in the middle of them. I could not figure out how to operate this thing because I was turning the dial, pulling the leg and nothing was happening then I pushed the dial in and it worked
-you push the dial in and rotate it to the angle you want that part of the leg to sit at then do so for both sides
-it sat up well, but the top is not too sturdy. With just my hand on it, it was weighing down (and I was sitting down doing this)
-I'm not even sure how the mouse pad goes on because the pieces they sent to attach it to the stand is too big on one end to screw it in
-overall i dont recommend this item

title: Camera
text:
-This camera is definitely for beginners and I am an amateur at photography so this is perfect for me
-Portrait shots are beautiful on this camera and I find they provide the best quality of them all
-Other images seem to be closer to the quality of a newer smartphone
-Sports shots are pretty good at capturing movement. I took some pictures of my son on a trampoline and got some good shots of him in the air while he was just playing around and not trying to pose
-A sports video, however, was not that good. The camera didnt capture the movement too well (this was also for movement on the trampoline)
-I also did a video of toy train going along a track and that looked much better than the trampoline video, so I guess it depends on the type and speed of the movement
-The battery life is probably my least favorite part. It seems the battery allows about 30 minutes of use because no matter how long I charge it, it always says 29 minutes remaining and nothing more. Although, I dont plan on using it too long, if I happen to then it will be a con for me
-I like the use of the filters as you are shooting or even after right on the camera
-You can use the large view or the small view, I happen to like the small view best, it allows me to focus and see what I'm shooting more clearly
-The flash provides good lighting. I used it for portraits and taking pictures of my art
-The video sound isnt the best from the camera itself. It sounds a little better viewing it from another device, but still sounds a bit muffled. I wouldnt suggest it for vlogs or anything like that, but instead, to use a mic for something like that
-The screen is touch screen, but when going into the full menu, it can be hard to press exactly what you want because of the size, although it is a great feature to have
-You can take a picture by pressing the button or pressing the area on the screen that you want the camera to focus on. This has actually caused me to take quite a few accidental shots, but I still like that feature
-the camera is not lightweight, it is more mid weight

title: Soundbar
text: Steup is simple. Just need to plug it in and use whatever connection you desire (I used the optical connection for a tc that the sound went out on). It does not come with an optical cord, which surprised me because most do and they provided a cord for connection to a dvd player, which I found useless. Then you choose the type of connection and there are different colors for the type: blue for bluetooth, purple for optical, and two more other colors and types of connections. I gave it two stars because the sound is no different than if the tv volume were turned all the way up. I feel like it's more like a speaker than a soundbar. It would be good for a kids room or my situation, where the sound went out on a tv and I dont want to buy another tv.

title: SD card
text:
-comes with two 32GB micro SD cards and a card reader
-blue camoflauge and green, which is cool because I havent seen this design before on micro SD cards. Makes them easy to distinguish from others
-Easy to use right out of the box
-actual storage size is 30GB

title: Projector
text: The projector works as expected. The picture is clear and the brightness was sufficient for viewing. It's very easy to use, there is no setup required. I just plugged it in and connected my fire stick and it worked. The only problem (and I noticed this with any projector I've used) is that the sound on netflix does not come through--I havent found a resolution for this issue either. The sound quality is good, doesn't sound totally localized like some other devices I've used. The control works well with the item too. I would recommend this item.

title: Ear phones
text: Easy to connect. The sound is clear when using to talk on the phone. Range is good as well, can walk about 20-30 feet away and is still connected. They are somewhat comfortable; the longer you wear them, the less comfortable they are. After about 5 hours is when they begin to become uncomfortable. However, they do stay in place in your ear. The sound isnt too loud. The battery life is good. The longest they have run for me was 7 hours straight, my experience with other ear buds is an average of 4 hours. However, the charging case doesn’t stay charged for too long and needs more frequent charging than the ear buds.

title: Snapchat glasses
text: The picture quality on these is decent. It's not the absolute best, like the quality of some of the newest phones and cameras, but it's not bad or grainy either. The video is actually much clearer and looks better than the pictures. The sound is very clear and defined as well. I had problems with connecting them to my snapchat. I ended up having to update the app to get them to connect. You connect them by bluetooth but also have to have your location on, which is a negative for me because I dont have my location on on my phone unless I'm using maps. Even though the pictures arent top quality, the glasses do provide cool 3D pictures and videos, which move around when you view them and rotate your phone at the same time. The biggest downside is that they are uncomfortable. They feel really small and while I had them on, it felt like they were pinching my head, as if the legs were shaped inward rather than straight back. I think it's a cool idea, but they need to be more comfortable and the picture quality could be better for the price.

title: Keypad
text: I had a corded numeric keypad for my Samsung chromebook plus, but this one works better for me. I didnt like having to string the cord across the back of laptop and when I was done with it, I would unplug and ravel it up. However, with this one, I can just keep the usb part plugged into the laptop and use when needed. There kepad requires a AAA battery. However, you cant turn the keypad off and I'm not sure if it "turns off" when it isnt in use (like when you shut down the computer). So, I'm not sure how long the battery life will last. I use it very seldomly so I imagine it will last a while for me. Setup was very easy, you just plug and it's reaady to use.

title: Laptop stand
text: I used this stand for my 13" samsung chrome book. The chromebook is very lightweight and the laptop stand holds the laptop up well. The stand itself is lightweight as well. I'm sure it coudl fit about a 15" laptop on it, at the most, if you want it the equivalent size of the laptop stand. If you dont mind a bit hanging over, then you could fit something bigger than 15". There is a grey "bumper" on it to help hold the laptop up; to stop it from sliding. There are cushions on the vertical stand to support and protect the laptop from the metal frame. I like it because you get to position your hands upwards , rather than flat and it feels more natural.

title: Laptop case
text: This item is a cloth like case with thin foam padding so I gave it one star for durability. It's good to put your laptop inside to put into another bag for traveling, but will not protect your item from falls or drops. It will protect your phone from liquid damage though. The marble looks a bit purple-ish, but I find that with most grey white marble designs, that is the case, but it still looks nice. The inside of the big case measures 13".

title: Ear buds
text: These ear buds fit comfortably in my ear; it feels like I dont have anything in. The color is this pretty bubblegum pink, maybe a little darker, but has a metallic tone to it. It was easy to pair with my phone (I hsve a Samsung galaxy s10 plus). They fit perfectly into their case. They come on once you pull them out of the case and turn on when you put them back in. I've been using them for a few weeks now and haven't had to charge them yet. The sound quality is good with both ear buds in, but with one, it's hard to focus on whatever you're listening to.

title: Tripod
text: I originally ordered this tripod because I wanted to use it with my video camera. Unfortunately, it was very complicated to understand how to use the attachment for items with a screw hole in them for mounting. There were no instructions to help, only a booklet adertising the company's other items. It took me about 15-20 minutes to figure out how the piece goes on. When I finally figured it out and put the video camera up, the tripod was not sturdy. There was a pole that kept sliding up and down from the bottom of the tripod and there was nothing to secure it. It worked well for holding my phone. Overall, I would not recommend this item.

title: external cd drive
text: I used this item with a dell laptop. "Installation" is so easy. There is really nothing to set up at all, you just plug it in and your device detects it and it's ready for use. I put in a cd with pictures and the device read it and displayed it on my computer within about a minute. It is very lightweight. The cord isn't too long, but long enough to use right at the computer. I would highly recommend this item.

title: Camera
text: This camera comes with all the accessories listed. I think the best of them is the light, the mic, the remote, and the two batteries. Battery power is actually pretty good. I don't have to charge after every video. The quality is okay, definitely not the most crisp and clear, but it works for a beginner camera. It all comes inside a carry case, which is convenient for tavel purposes. The night vision worked fine, the color was balanced well. It is simple to connect to a computer. I connected it to a windows computer. Overall, it's a decent camera for the price and for beginners.

title: Camera dash mount
text: This dash mount fit my camera perfectly, it seems to have the universal size screw on it. The camera screwed in tightly and my camera was secured. The mount rotates smoothly and gives you a lot of different angles. The quality is good as well. The suction power was okay... my camera is a little heavier so I have to keep it at a certain angle or it flops. Otherwise, I recommend this item.

title: Camcorder
text: Picture quality is okay, but the color isn't balanced well, the videos have sort of a grey tone to them. The listing said the item was gold or either had a gold case and that was not the case. The actual camera was black and grey and the case was black so I'm not sure what was supposed to be black. It is easy to operate as far as making a video. You press the large power button then the button with the red dot to start and stop a recording. The display flips around so you can see if you're recording yourself. The attachments slide into either the insert on the top or the screw hole on the bottom. The screw hole on the bottom seems to be a universal size because I had a tripod that I used with it that is not the same brand nor came with the camera. The lighting panel that comes with it is okay as well, the light goes from a sort of orange color to white. It does provide some decent balance to the grey color the camera has going on. The biggest fail of this camera is the battery life. I charged 1 of the 2 included batteries all the way up, used the camera to make a 10 minute video and already lost one of the three bars on the battery life. Then after another video the camera was on one bar. You couldn't possibly use this thing for videos for too long if all it takes is 20 minutes for the battery to deplete. This camera comes with a lot of accessories, but because of the picture quality and battery life, I don't think the item is worth it.

title: Camcorder
text: This is a pretty basic and easy to use camcorder. The quality of the camera is nice, it doesn't feel cheap, has some weight to it. However, the picture quality is not good... it's grainy, so the videos really arent clear. It kind of looks like there's static on the screen. I wouldn't recommend this item because even though the quality is there, the quality of the video is not good at all.

title: Projection Screen
text: This projection screen is large. It really just feels like a white sheet. The cloth is white, but transparent. It has a black border at the top with holes in it, like a shower curtain. The set comes with hooks that easily attach and detach from any surface and can be used to hang the projection screen. The set also comes with black rope. However, I think this screen is more suitable for outside use than inside use. I have a projector in my son's room and use it on a plain white wall and the picture is clear. When I used this screen (thinking it would be even more clear) there was no difference in picture quality. Although, it would be great for outdoor movie nights.

title: Item finder
text: This item was easy to use. It came with the remote, 6 item locators, and 7 small circular batteries. It also came with some round sticky pieces, key rings, stickers for labeling things that you put the item locator on. You have to install a battery into the item locators and the remote. Once that is done, you can press the button on the remote and the coordinating item locator will beep. They are kind of bulky though. I could see them working for keys, placing them in a person/luggage, or hanging on your pet.

title: Projector
text: The picture quality on this projector is great. You can make it small or big and either way, the picture will be clear. There is a turn style on the top to adjust the focus and another to tilt the image more forward or backward. I decided to put this in my son's room on his entire wall and it's like he has a 100" tv. Also, you can see the picture whether it's dark or the middle of the day. I was worried that during the middle of the day, he wouldn't be able to watch it, but this works fine at all time.... obviously the picture wont be so clear if there is light shining directly on the surface where the image is displayed. The power cord is a decent length, not too short. It has a hdmi port, usb, vga, sd slot. You can use it to play a video game on as well, like an xbox or playstation. It's really just like having a huge tv.

title: Portable storage
text: This item is flat and smooth. Once I plugged it into my dell laptop, it was easily recognized and popped up right away. I transferred files from my laptop to the device and it went pretty quickly, no matter the file type. I transferred documents, videos, and pictures. I was able to transferred 40gb of pictures and videos in under 4 minutes. However, it got hot after the large file transfer. Overall, I think it's a great item because it's easy to use and has a lot of space. The shape of it makes it easily portable.

title: Headphones
text: I really like the look and color of these headphones. There is a large letter "L" and "R" on the inside of the headphones. They adjust about an inch on each side. The top and the ear piece are padded and very comfortable. The ear pieces rotate about 90 degrees, and they can be folded in. There is an audio jack, a mini usb port, a volume increase and decrease button, pause button, noise cancelling activation button, and power button. The volume button controls the volume on the device you have it connected to. When you press the volume button, for some reason the media stops for a second then adjusts. When you turn it on, it makes a noise and tells you the status of the battery. The headphones are pretty loud; I was able to hear what was playing clearly while holding the headphones in my hand. The sound is good too, all the bass from my sons came through and sound the same as if I was in a car. The noise cancellation comes on automatically when you turn them on. I feel like when the music is all the way up, it is noise cancelling and I cant even hear myself yelling what (not at the top of my lungs). As I turned the music down, I could begin to hear myself a little more, but I couldn't hear things outside of that (this is with the volume at about 80%). The true test was turning on my tv with my sound bar on (and it's a really good one) and I kept turning it up and didn't hear a thing. I took these headphones off and my tv was blaring, so much so that my sub woofer was vibrating the bed, but I didn't hear a thing. So, these are DEFINITELY noice cancelling.

title: Ergonomic mouse
text: This mouse was very easy to setup, technically there really wasn't any setup. The only thing I had to do was insert the included batteries into the mouse, put the usb insert into the computer, an turn the mouse on and it was ready to use. At first, it felt bulky and a little too tall, but as I began using it, the feel of it became more natural. I found myself using the mouse without even thinking about how different it was than what I'm used to. Although, I still think it could lose a little bit of height, but other than that, it's perfect. Definitely ergonomic!

title: Laptop case
text: This laptop case is made nicely... the quality is good. The top straps aren't too big, but provide support when using them to hold the bag with a laptop and other items in it. The zipper is "hidden" with a closure that goes over the zipper so it doesn't stick out.... and the zipper runs smoothly. There is a zip pocket on the front as well. It comes with a shoulder strap that is really thick and has big buckles, which will help keep the strap attached to the bag. The strap also has a shoulder pad. Overall, this is a nicely made bag and I would recommend it.

title: Sondbar
text: This soundbar was easy to setup. Once out of the box, I plugged it in, hooked the HDMI cord up and the audio cord and it was ready to use. The subwoofer only has to be plugged in and it's already connected with the soundbar. The sound can get extremely loud. I used this on my roku tv because my sound doesn't seem to get that loud even on 100, but this soundbar provides theatre like, surround sound. I placed the bar in front of the tv and the subwoofer on the floor next to the stand. I also used it to play music and it was really easy to connect to my phone (galaxy s9). I like that the power cords are the same for the subwoofer and the soundbar so you cant get them mixed up. You do have to mute your television or the sound will echo.

title: Bag
text: The bag is a little lighter than advertised. In person, it is burgundy and the picture looks plum. I was perfectly fine with this because I love the burgundy color. It is a nice size that can be used as a purse or carry on. There are pearl/ stud details that provide nice detail to the bag. The zipper pulls are gold and pretty large, but it works for the bag. The zippers run smoothly most of the time; they only got caught on the flaps to cover them a few times. The zippers are "invisible" because of those flaps covering them. There is a handle at the top and one in the back. The straps are comfortable, but only adjust a certain amount. It is not like a normal backpack with the flap hanging to pull the strap all the way, these are on a loop and can only be adjusted as far as the loop allows. The inside is divided a bit, there is a larger pocket in the front and then a middle pocket with a zipper and behind that there is more room. There are also two pockets on the inside as many purses have.

title: Flash drive
text: This flash drive did transfer files quickly. I moved video files from my chrombook to it and each file transferred within a matter of seconds and ranged from 1-4 minutes long. The item is durable and the price is fair for the amount of storage provided. I had no problems with my computer recognizing the item either. I would recommend it.

title: Chromebook
text: I like the color of the laptop... I received a silver one. It's shiny and smooth to the touch. It is slim and wide, and I mention this because the dimensions make that aspect very noticeable. I'm not sure why this is advertised as 14" when I measured it, it came to 12.5 inches and 8 inches wide. The laptop does have some weight to it, but its not too heavy. The bottom of it is thicker than the top. The back of keyboard lights up and dims after sometime of no activity. It was easy to setup with my google account and took less than 10 minutes. The volum is loud. The computer runs fast and smooth. Startup takes a few seconds. I also used it to transfer a video file to a flash drive and it did that quickly. There is a micro sd card reader, 2 usb-c ports, a regular usb port, and a mic jack. The mouse on the keyboard is smooth and manuevers well. I have not had any problems with it lagging or freezing either.

title: Headphones
text: These headphones can get really loud. If you turn the music on and place them over you neck, you can hear the music from at least 4 feet away. They do charge quickly... it has taken no more than 20 minutes to fully charge them. They have a bass button which is nice to get a better quality of music, as artists intent for their music to be heard. The volume button can be used to change the music. They were easy to connect to an iphone XR. You can also talk on the phone with them and hear well on both ends. They fit well, but did make the ears a little hot, which may be from the cushioning. These also have great range. I placed my phone (that was connected to them) in my room and went out of my apartment and down to the first floor, outside and the connection did not mess up at all.

title: Works as advertised
text: This item was easy to use. After removing it from the packaging, I went to the app store and downloaded the app and followed the directions. Within 5-8 minutes, the device was ready to use. I had no problems with it working. Each test I performed worked as it should. I used this item in my work bag and had no problems with locating it through the location service. I would recommend this item if you are someone who usually misplaces things or just want to keep track of certain things.

title: Sturdy
text: Included in this item is the stand, screws, and keys for the mount. I like that it is durable and sturdy. Once everything is locked into place, the tablet is not going anywhere. I placed my 8" galaxy tablet in and it fit well. There is a  turn style locking mechanism near the pad that gets screwed into the wall and near the middle of the mount. These allow you to adjust and move the mount in the position that you want. I understand why those mechanisms had to be put in (because it helps with stability when they are locked), but it's a little inconvenient if you need to move your tablet around, unless you're keeping it in the same position. I like the key-lock detail because you don't have to worry about anyone stealing your tablet, especially if you're using this outside of the home.

title: Noise cancelling
text: These headphones adjust about an inch up on both sides. They are comfortable, they are padded on the ears and at the top. They have good sound control for kids. On the highest level, you cannot hear anyone else speaking so they are noise cancelling, and the volume is not deafening. They are durable also and have nice graphics. The cord is about 3.5 feet long. This item has a year warranty that covers any defects in material or workmanship.

title: Volume control
text: I gave these headphones a 2 because something about the shape of them is off. It is as though there are leaning forward. You can feel and see it when you put them on. Which makes them slightly uncomfortable. The kids safe volume is working, I could fully hear another person that I was talking to or talking to me, even on the highest volume. Therefore, it is not noise cancelling. the cord is about 4 feet long. The graphics on it are nice. It seems to be easily scratched or scuffed becaused when I received mine, it has scuffs and scratches in it already. The ears and top of them are padded and it has a limited warranty covering defects in material or workmanship.

title: Did not work
text: This item did not work for me, rather the setup failed the four times that I tried it on the app. The first time I tried it with my own ethernet cable to stretch to my room from the living room (where my modem is) and the light went blue and when I reached the part where it was to connect, I got a message that it could not and to restart the device. So the second time I restarted the device and waited for the setup to finish and got the same message. So I went into my living room and plugged the device up right next to my modem with the included ethernet cable. This time I got a message that my ethernet cable was not plugged into my modem. So for the fourth try, I plugged the ethernet cable into different spots on the device and my modem and still got the message that my ethernet cable was not plugged into my modem. From that point, I just gave up. There is an option to contact customer service for further assistance. I also don't like that you have to have your location and bluetooth on for use of the device especially because I only use those two options as needed and they can drain your battery.

title: Ready to use out of the box
text:
One of the pluses of this item is that they are pre-charged and ready to use. I received AAA and AA batteries and the charger. I have not had to use the charger yet because the batteries are still holding up after almost a week of use. It's great that they are ideal for high draining items because I find that a lot of batteries that I come across are for low draining items. I used these batteries in motorized toy trains, remote controls, and gaming remotes. So far, I've had no problems with them.

Update: the charge on these batteries have lasted quite a while. When I first received them, I put just about all of them into an item like a remote, a toy, a PS4 controller, and haven't had to recharge them. I had 3 AAA batteries in a toy train for a few weeks then moved them to a motion sensor light and they died with in a few days--so this was my first chance to charge them. Unfortunately, the charger isn't the best. You can only charge 2 AAA batteries at a time and they took a day and a half to charge 3/4 of the way. I only know how far they charged because I put them in about battery charger when the included one seemed to stop working. A red light displays when they are charging. After the day and a half, the red light went away so I assumed they were ready. I placed the third one in and it did nothing. So I used a battery charger that I already had and it worked fine. I changed my review from 5 stars to 3 because of this.

title: Works great
text: The cable comes with clips and straps which is convenient because the length of the cord indicates that you would be using this cord for a great distance from the router to whatever your desired location is. It is also flat which makes is easier to align or flush it against the wall or floor. It's compatible with any device that has a regular ethernet cable. I was able to plug it into my xfinity router. I used it with my playstation and did notice the speed was a little faster than usual, but I can't tell if that's just attributed to the fact that internet speed is more reliable with a cord than through wifi. Overall, it's a good purchase.

title: Flexible
text: This laptop case is very flexible. My first impression of taking it out of the box was that it wasn't sturdy enough to hold a laptop. This case measures for a 13.3" laptop, I placed my 12.3" laptop inside and surprisingly it was sturdy. The inside of the case is very soft. The outside is soft as well, but with a different texture than the inside. The zipper isn't revealed on the outside, when you zip it up, it's covered by the flaps. The handle is sturdy enough so that the case holds up well.

title: Couldn't work all the features
text: I tried to connect the headphones with my tcl roku smart tv, but could not get it to work. I then plugged it into my galaxy S9 with the audio to audio cord and it did work. It was very loud, which I liked. The directions seemed complicated to me, I did give it a few tries trying to connect it to different things, but it hasn't worked out for me. I really don't see the difference between these and any wired/ bluetooth headphones. Although, the portable charger that comes along with it is very nice and convenient.

title: Very loud
text: These headphones were used on an iphone XR. The volume goes up really loud, which is good. They are really comfortable too. When you place them in your ears, you don't have to adjust them to fit, they seem to just sit in place perfectly. Overall, I would recommend these headphones solely off of comfort.

title: Very easy to use
text:
I like this hub/adapter because it is so easy to plug it in and use. I used this item on a Samsung 12.3 inch touch screen chromebook plus. I was able to plug it in and insert my items and they popped up right away on my screen. Every port worked fine with the item right out of the box. I can't use it to charge my device because it has its own charger for that (its a usb-c end, but looks more like a laptop charger) so I tried it on my galaxy S9 and it worked. I also tried the hub/adapter with my phone and every feature worked fine.

The micro sd card does go in a little far and took a few tried for me to get out.

I did try to transfer items from a 4gb flash drive to the chromebook and from a 16bg flash drive to the 4gb flash drive (both plugged in the hub/adapter) and it was not at a "superspeed" rate.

Overall, I would recommend this item because of its ease of use.

title: Works as advertised
text: This item is very easy to use and works as it is advertised. I tested this item on a Samsung Chromebook Plus 12.3". When I plugged it in, the usb ports lit up blue. I insierted a micro sd card adapter and the folder immediately popped up. I then inserted a micro sd card and that folder popped up immediately as well. I then tried a flash drive and the same thing happened. After that I plugged in my HDMI cable to my hisense smart tv and the image came up immediately. The only con about is was that the mirrored image was not as high quality as I thought it would be.

title: Easy to hook up
text: Very simple hook up, just plug and go. Only had it for a day so I'm not sure about the battery life yet. But so far, so good.

title: Love it
text: I absolutely love this laptop. The versatility of it is great. It's very lightweight. The pen is awesome too. If I could rate this above 5 then I would. I purchased it as a refurbished item and I can't even tell.

title: Short lifespan, malfunctions
text: Had this for 3 months total before it started malfunctioning! This flash drive frequently disconnects from any computer it plugs into, for no reason whatsoever, and has major problems when files are copy-pasted off of it. Midway through most copy-paste processes, it will just stop working and need to be plugged in again. Do not recommend at all.

title: Works well
text: I use it for sleeping. I am a side sleeper, and it is very comfortable. Great sound. Occasionally it’s too loud, even on lowest setting, but great overall, I recommend it

title: Beautiful Case
text:
The sage green case was beautiful and completely protected the tablet. The case comes with a built in screen protector. The corners and sides seem to be protected well by this case from possible accidental falls. I was very surprised that I was able to wireless charge the tablet with this case on, using my Anker wireless charger! I personally feel that this case would work best for children or expected heavy use.

I ultimately returned the case because the case makes the tablet too heavy to hold for longer periods of time while reading, it was bothering my wrist too much. If you plan to use the tablet more for entertainment versus reading purposes, then this tablet would be perfect for you. The plastic screen protector does have a glare, but it is manageable.

title: Fits the Fire 8 HD tablet perfectly!
text: This sleeve is the perfect size for the Fire 8 HD tablet secured in a case. The sleeve looks just like the picture, and I would recommend this brand to friends.

title: Looks exactly like the picture!
text:
I really can't complain for the price that I paid for this case. The color is a little lighter than the product shown. It fits the tablet perfectly and the buttons on the case line up well with the buttons on the tablet. The clear back collects fingerprints easily, but thats doesn't bother me. This does come with a plastic screen protector that can easily be removed, if you don't like it. This case is easy to clean and protects the case well. And the case doesn't interfere with the wireless charging function.

Looking at some of the reviews, I think I know why people had issues with their screen protectors being missed shaped or warped. The reason why this screen protector is a good price is because resources weren't wasted on the packaging. This screen protector is only packaged in a plastic cover. Depending on the shipping package and handling, it may affect the way the case fits on your tablet. This is the reason why I only gave it 4 stars.

title: Fits Perfectly
text: This fits the Microsoft Surface Pro perfectly. The flat bottom of this case let's you hold the tablet with the keyboard attached in one arm. Which gives the ability to work in any environment sitting or standing up! I love this case!

title: Great replacement accessory!
text: I broke the original ear piece, and bought this pack for a replacement piece. It fit perfectly with my Samsung bluetooth.

title: Perfect!
text:
1st - Please Please Please! Follow the instructions and just watch the very short installation video on YouTube. It is worth it!!! (I did it wrong the 1st time.)

If you follow the instructions, this is truly a bubble free screen protector! I love it! It fits my Microsoft Surface Pro screen perfectly! If you find a lint free bubble on the edge, rub your finger nail over it because it might be lifted a little, and just needs to be smoothed out a little. I am attaching a picture to show you guys that it is truly bubble free!!!

I also bought a pen and it writes well over this screen protector!

title: This works with the Fitbit Blaze
text: All you have to do it change the inside pens from 22s to 23s, and the Blaze becomes secure and it will fit. It is cute & I love it. My only problem is that it absorbs the blue ink from my jeans.

title: Five Stars
text: Beautiful, fits perfectly, and I love it!

title: Great picture and quality.
text: Great picture seen on TV screen with this cord.

title: Great for senstive skin users!
text: The band is on the long side, but my arm did not break out. It truly keeps the moisture out that you get sometimes from the regular fitbit wrist band. It is cute and comfortable on my wrist. I highly recommend that you buy this, if you find that your wrist gets a small reddened rash with the regular wrist band.

title: These little things are great.  Especially with the pan and tilt base Blink sells.
text:
Picture quality is great, they work great, and they are cheap. My only compliant is the motion detection.

It seems to start recording after a few seconds and stops recording a bit too quickly too.

title: It worked pretty well, it's tiny, solid, and well made.  But mine stopped working after a year
text:
Overall, I love the look and feel of it physically and the interface is pretty nice too.

For the price though, I was hoping it would last many years. It died after about a dozen times of use.

title: It worked great!! Also though it doesn't look it, it does have a status light.
text: I used it to reformat an old drive and copy about a terabyte to it.  Went fast and smoothly.

title: Excellent headphone!  Two gripes: constantly says MUTED, UNMUTED, and the on and off switch
text:
These headsets are light, comfortable, and do a great job with noise cancellation.

They do NOT have a longer range than my 10 year old Logitechs though, so don't expect the range to be much greater than your basic Bluetooth.

My biggest gripes are:

. When you click on mute in Zoom or Teams with your mouse, you hear a loud MUTED. When you click again, UNMUTED. Every single time. It's super annoying.

. The On and off switch is a tiny slider that you can only really move with your nails, and it has 3 positions, Off, Dongle, Bluetooth. It's easy to pass up the middle position and all together it's not easy and comfortable to turn on and off. And not something you can easily feel for while on your head.

. Finally it doesn't have USB C. In this day and age, why not?

title: It works great, just plug and play on Windows 10, magnification is great, pictures is clear
text:
Remember to remove the cap (there is a cap).

Exactly what I was expecting and hoping for.

title: This monitor is light, and works perfectly off a single USB C cable for power and video.
text:
Connected this with my Dell laptop within a single cable and it worked immediately and beautifully.

Also bought one of these and put it on it as a stand, which has worked great:
https://smile.amazon.com/dp/B094YFLWVL?psc=1&ref=ppx_yo2ov_dt_b_product_details

Along with one of these so I could have it in portrait with a cable on top and not have the cable sticking up:
https://smile.amazon.com/dp/B09GN3JGRW?ref=ppx_yo2ov_dt_b_product_details&th=1

Very happy with the results.

title: This is heavy, and solid, and works perfectly holding up a 17.3" portable monitor!
text:
It's holding a https://smile.amazon.com/dp/B0925RMK9H?psc=1&ref=ppx_yo2ov_dt_b_product_details in portrait mode perfectly fine.

I am very impressed with how heavy and solid it is.

title: It died after a couple of hours of use.  Looked great before it died.
text: Was plugged into my work laptop and all seemed fine, used it for a couple of hours... and it suddenly died, showing a few blinking white lines only after that.

title: If you want a BOOMbox, this isn't it for a thumping party, this isn't it. Brunch gathering? Sure.
text:
My 40w JVC Kaboom box is SO much louder, clearer, and has so much better bass.

This is loud, sure. It has some bass, sure. Great for a a party where music is not the center of attention. But if you have a dance party or want to feel the music, this is just not it.

This isn't a boom box. It's a bluetooth speaker. A large one, but still.

On the positives, it's MUCH lighter than it looks (but that means it doesn't feel solid), like a light rigid plastic.

I am wholly disappointed, wish I had bought the JBL instead on Prime day. I fell for the good reviews, the 80W, and all "Boom" words. No boom here.

title: Works GREAT!  Fan noise though, while tolerable if consistent, keeps kicking in & out every second
text:
This thing works great but sounds like someone that's a really soud breather, asleep, and borderline snoring by breathing loudly.

If the fan would just stay on that would be just fine, but man is the on and off annoying.

title: This cable is fantastic.  Best cable I have... and I'm often accused of having a cable fetish
text:
This thing really works, and works great!

It's got some weight and diameter too it. Not too much to make it not be flexible, but definitely a thicker cable, which hopefully means more durable and probably what's needed for that 100W x 2.

title: First one wasn't working right, second one worked great, slowly degrading.
text:
Edit 2: Well, the second workED great, now it's starting to have issue with walking and chewing: If you click and hold, then drag, the dragging is erratic. This is a big issue when dragging windows, trying to select a piece of text, or in games.

I positively LOVE the hotkey idea though that none of the others seem to have. It seems worth the problems. As long as it remains usable.

EDIT1: returned the 1st, second one works great.

This only worked, and worked great (for the 2 minutes that I tested it) when both computers were on.

I did immediately get worried that the Ctr Ctr 1 could happen during some games, but didn't get that far.

When I turned PC 2 off, PC 1 went haywire with 20 "found USB device" sounds but never actually connected. I tried this with having that PC selected on the KVM first or not.

Then I thought maybe I should put the PC 2 connecting on the one one that gets turned off more often. No difference.

ONLY works when both PCs are on. I have NO mouse or keyboard if one is off.

title: Works and fits everything perfectly.
text: If you have the right kind (I have a Nebula II), everything fits and it feels nice and solid and protective.

title: Has no corner or drop support at all, flimsy material, not as strong magnets folding in on itself.
text:
This has no corners. Your iPad sticks to it from it's own magnets, nothing else is holding it in place. So there is zero protection from falls on three sides. Zero protection for the corners.

I use my covers like a folded magazine to hold the tablet. After a couple of years the material usually start to sag, this one is doing it right now from the start, the very first time I've used it.

It's own magnets, which help stick to itself to create a triangle when folded, aren't very strong compared to others.

title: We have 8 of these. Older model was fantastic.  The ones I got at the end of 2021 are just okay.
text:
I ordered several this Cyber Monday since we all loved ours from last year.

But these aren't the same. Feels cheaper, smaller, lighter, less substantial, more jagged.

Sleep Functionality had also changed: old ones used to wake up and reconnect by moving them around, these require a button click. Once a button is clicked, it will connect in about a second...

But then it sends the click through to your PC!! Clicking wherever the previously none existent pointer happens to be.

So you click, and a second later something is clicked. Fortunately this works well enough for streaming services, as this acts as a pause/unpause.

title: Picture is gorgeous, but losses wifi connection often while other devices in the same room don't.
text:
Having it show your own pictures is a bit of a pain. Also it doesn't fit the picture, only shows original resolution.

The network disconnect that happens CONTINUALLY, every single night, though makes it pretty worthless.

As I write this, for example, it has no connection, while five other devices, even right next to it, have great signal.

title: This beast is ROCKING now (Dec 21) as my gaming center & server
text:
You have to download the graphics drivers from Intel or you will only get the motherboard builtin graphics which aren't good.

With the drivers, it runs power hungry games like Ark smoothly.

I have two Sumsung SSDs and 32gb of RAM in it and it is a beast of a machine. Multitasking, working as my home and remote game server, my gaming console attached to my TV, and more.

There are no fans though or much airflow. So super quiet, but can't put this anywhere that heat can't easily work its way around the box.

I bought mine for half of this price, but otherwise excellent machine!

title: Nothing here says this item would be used.  But it is

title: ARLO Q: Setup is  easy. No direct/local interface or web-page directly over your home network.  Horrible/useless motion sensors.
text:
These ARLO Q (no base, wired version) cameras get IP addresses from your home network and have their own MAC addresses, and yet, you can't use common software that you can use to view most other IP cameras.

According to their technical support, that's because these IP & MAC address wielding cameras, aren't IP cameras.

You basically don't interact with the cameras, AT ALL. Cameras call their servers, you setup an account on Netgear's servers, and you view what the camera sees Netgear's servers from a website and configure everything on Netgear's website, not the camera's website or interface.

Because of this back and forth ALL "LIVE" VIDEO IS A GOOD 10 SECONDS LAGGING!!!

My roommate, for example, was standing in front of me, before the live feed showed her walking up to the door, getting her keys, and unlocking the door and coming in. And I have 160kbps uploads with Comcast!

What's worse is the motion detection (attached video). Both from front porch or backyard get some leaf shadow at SOME point of the day. And that sets these cameras off constantly. Set at MINIMUM motion detection sensitivity. So I basically can't use them for Motion Detection at ALL since they have dozens of false alarms every single day. Worse yet? At nights, the headlights from every car passing by, sets off the motion detection. AT MINIMUM setting. On both cameras.

A couple of days before I bought these, I also ordered a FOSCAM R4 from Amazon for half the price of one of these cameras. It has tilt, pan, and four times the resolution. You can talk to the camera. You can configure the camera on it's own site. You can interface to it using common IP camera software, OR you can treat them like these, have them call home to their servers, and do everything there. The option is super nice.

Also the FOSCAM's motion detection does not get set off with all the false positives mentioned above.

Their tech support is your generic out of the country, going through unrelated scripts of steps rather than someone knowledgable.

title: Requires an awful lot of access & Plugins. Motion detection stopped working. No exchange option.

The Camera plugin works only in IE, while the MyFoscam.com plugin works only in Edge. It's armature hour, get a wired or wireless Arlo Q, or a Blink. They have their flaws too, but not as bad as this one (I have all three).

FOSCAM forwards you to AmcrestCloud.com for their cloud service. AmcrestCloud will not accept R4 information. Their tech support says they only recommend their own cameras. It keeps thinking my username/password is not the admin one, but it is, and the previous page VERIFIES it, so there is noway to get here if it wasn't (see picture). Their support agrees, they have no clue what's wrong.

You can view the camera (not setup monitoring/alarms ect) on their own site. I tried setting things up through their cloud support, and it wants access to everything, including your admin password on your camera, which in turn has your email username & password (in order to send you emails) and your home network wifi SID and password. Not to mention access to everything the camera is seeing and hearing. And even then it can't fully configure you cam, and the picture it receives for live viewing is horrible (cloud view gets the subset/low res).

Both their viewing, or Amcrest's non-functioning cloud recording/remote-viewing REQUIRE the administrative username and password, despite being able to setup Viewer and Operator accounts. The Admin account of course in turn has access to all your other passwords for email and wifi and such.

Edit: after about three weeks this thing went nuts, while mounted in the same place, so deducting the final point from two to one star. It suddenly started having a grainy picture after dusk, and those grains move, so it CONSTANTLY goes off every few seconds. I also tried reducing the detection areas and setting the sensitivity to minimum. This morning I have thousands of email alerts.

Tried to exchange it, but guess they don't allow it since I bought it as a lightning deal and they would want the full price now. So just returning this to Amazon.
