The flap is magnetic and covers the 3 sided zipper opening.

FRONT STORAGE
There is a slim front pocket for flatter items like a case with memory or other similar things. It has a divider in it so you have two narrow sections.

INSIDE
The inside of the case has two dividers which can be attached with a huge velcro like strip across both front and back. That allows for adjustments of sizes.

BACK POCKET
The back pocket is flat and zips shut. Again for flatter things.

TRIPOD STRAPS
This does have straps on the bottom for tripod, so that is one reason I might still use it for my cameras.

STRAPS
There is a handle set for carrying or a shoulder strap if you prefer.

DO I LIKE IT?
I am not fond of the fabric, but it is roomy and I can bring my tripod with me and tripod accessories so if I need to travel for photos, that would be useful. For my daily use around the house to take photos of jewelry and pottery, this is a bit on the large side. I was hoping for something a little smaller.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This case is nice if you have larger cameras with lenses etc. The fabric is water resistant but it feels tacky and I am not sure how long it will last without peeling and cracking. I am not overly fond of it.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. The tacky feel takes off a star for me. Despite it being a bit large for my needs, I will use it when I need to take a tripod. Otherwise, I will still look for a case that is a little smaller.

title: PERFECT Case For My Small Portable DVD Player
text:
I got this really small portable DVD player. That way if we lose the internet again (like we have so much this year already for days at a time) I can put in a DVD of some of my art classes and carry it on site where I want to paint or draw my lessons. The problem is it had no case.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes in a plastic cellophane sleeve.

STRAP
There is a strap inside with a little padding on it for the shoulder. It is adjustable.

HANDLES
The handles are easy to carry if you don't want to use the strap.

POCKET
There is a zipper pocket on the front which is perfect for the charging plug and cord.

INSIDE
The inside is padded and larger enough to include the plastic folder where the DVD is so that I can easily carry both to my location and they are protected.

DESIGN
The pencil design is bright, colorful, and not overly blurry so it looks pretty and not muddy.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is the perfect case to help protect my portable rechargeable DVD player when I want to use art classes in my shed or when we lose the internet.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. Although this is not hard and does not protect a lot, it is perfect for what I need at this time for my player and DVD cases.

title: Nice Case But Just A Bit Too Small
text:
I got this for a tablet that we have which measured in line with the specs given in the description.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes in a plastic cello bag. That is important if you receive this in a box they leave out in the rain.

SIZE
This measures within the size as described, but it is based on the outside measurements. The padding and construction made this a little too small and the tablet will not fit in it. It suggest you leave yourself an extra inch in measurements if you get this.

QUALITY
The picture is nice, colors decent, and the materials in this are good. It will make a nice case for a smaller device that I have.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This runs a bit tight, so allow extra room when you measure.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. This is a nice padded case. It would be great for kids especially or artists. I wish it was just a tiny bit bigger.

title: Okay, My Bad, I Guess But These Are HUGE For Table Top Use
text:
I have been wanting some decent backdrops for my daughter to use as she trains in graphic arts and web design. She is going to be doing photography for our jewelry and pottery business we have been planning to start the last few years. I saw that mentioned in the description of these and figured table top size would be perfect for us.

HOW THESE COME
This thing is HUGE. I mean HUGE. I was planning to put these in a portfolio that I use for full sheets of watercolor, but these come in such a huge flat box (with foam stiffening). It is way too huge to put in the porfolio.

THE STAND
The stand is okay, but needs some ingenuity to make it stable and work well.

SIZE
I have to say that these are too big for any table top we have in our house and work room. We thought they would be a bit smaller and more manageable for pottery and jewelry but as they are we are debating trimming them down.

QUALITY
Size aside, the quality of these backdrops is excellent. With a decent camera, this looks professional and nice. My daughter loves these, but has a hard time finding a way to use them now that outside is too cold and wet. Some great photos come from these.

THE BOTTOM LINE
I am not sure if we will cut these down or not, but if we had a larger place to use these they would be nice. Plan on taking some time to work out the stand to be a bit more sturdy.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. Even though I guess I did not read the dimensions with a realistic perspective, thinking this being used with pottery and jewelry, I did not expect these to be this big. The quality is great. If you have a larger table top and work area, you will love these.

title: Great Set Up For Daughter To Work With Jewelry And Small Pottery
text:
My daughter is working on web design and photography training so that she can work on our business for jewelry and pottery. Due to dorm rooms being small, she needed a small photography light box to play with photos and learn to do web worthy business photos.

SIZE
This is small, but she needs that. It is perfect for her small photos and what she needs to do and is easy to store and travel with if necessary.

LIGHT
She said that the light in this is adequate but found that she either has to use light from a window or add an additional light to get the best photos.

BACKGROUNDS
She said that the backgrounds can be a bit tricky to work with as they are kind of prone to curl, but she said that they are adequate when she works with them.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This light box allows my daughter to take decent photos and learn how to hone them for online business purposes in a business we are opening in the future. It is portable and handy.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. Despite the weak light and curling backgrounds, the size and set up is perfect for my daughter in a dorm situation. With some minor modifications she has managed to do some good work.

PHOTOS
If I can ever get her to send me some photos, I will post for you. She is away at school so for now, I am just posting this review and hope to add photos eventually.

title: If The Cord Was A Bit Longer, It Would Be Perfect
text:
I have a room on my property which gets cold and damp. I was looking for a power strip that I could use in that room without having to worry about the dampness. After using it, I am considering another one to use under one of my fish tanks.

HOW THIS IS SET UP
This is set up beautifully for indoor or outdoor use. The outlets make it easy to use all six plugs with transformer plugs if necessary. The plug goes at an angle and is flush with the outlet instead of sticking out.

IS IT WATERPROOF?
This does seem to withstand the brief time I had it outside with rain and other windy weather. As I said, I wanted this to use for a damp room instead of outside, but it performed well outside through some rain storms. I am not considering a second one of these for under one of my fish aquariums.

CORD
I only wish that the cord was a bit longer. For use outside, longer cords help to set things up better. This one is very short for that. For my use, the room I wanted it for, it just fits, and if I get one for my fish aquarium area, it will just fit there as well.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Depending on what you use this for, it seems to handle well outside or inside . If the cord was longer, it would be perfect.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. It does perform well so far, but I just wish the cord was longer if I wanted to use it outside.

title: GREAT Way to Watch DVDs In Bed When I Want to Have Fun- Sound Weak
text:
Recently, I have wished that I had the ability to watch DVDs in bed without having to watch on the big TV. I also would like to take it to my shed with no electricity so that I can play art classes without having to rely on internet at all.

HOW THIS CHARGES
This charges using the type C cord in a few hours.

PICTURE
The picture is decent. It is not like watching an expensive bluray or TV screen, but it is fine for close up watching.

OPERATION
I have had no issues operating this. It is pretty easy and the set up is not difficult to adjust.

SOUND
That is where we lose a star. Even at the highest setting of 20 this is so quiet that if I run fans in the summer, it is hard to hear with the player right in front of me. Headphones would solve that, but I don't always want to wear them.

THE BOTTOM LINE
I like this set. It is fun to play with and allows me to watch my English tribute of nightly Hyacinth Bucket episodes where no one else has to listen to it and complain because I play it too much.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. If the sound was a little bit louder and better, I would like this more. As it is it is still okay.

title: So Far The Best Tablet Yet For Our Daughter Studying Graphic Design
text:
Our daughter is studying graphic design. She needs to have various equipment which works well, but won't be tempting to others to steal it. We look for more off brand items while she is learning.

PERFORMANCE
Our daughter showed me how this works very well on all levels of pressure. It is not top of the line, but it does perform very well for the types of graphics work that my daughter is doing. I would not put it quite up with the performance with the Wacom professional pad I have used over time. I did find that it did everything I tried with it pretty well so I am impressed.

QUALITY
For what this is, it is decent quality. It works great for graphic design and has all of the features that my daughter was interested in and even more features she was not expecting.

PEN AND STAND
She also likes the pen and stand. They are easy to work and hold.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This graphics pad is an excellent entry level pad. It performs well at a reasonable price point and has worked well for some months now.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is just what was needed for pursuing graphics design classes in school. I will update if anything changes with this tablet as our daughter uses it.

title: First Erogonomic Keyboard I Like In Ages- A Few Caveats, But Love It
text:
I have been using a very OLD PC Concepts nsplit keyboard for some time now. I have tried several new ones and they are okay, but most of them are just not as nice as I would like. I really wish they would have a mouse pad built into the pad under the numerical keys- THAT is what I REALLY want. But, this is still worth a look.

KEYBOARD SET UP
The key set up is perfect. I did not have to reorient myself at all to using this keyboard.

KEY RESPONSE
The keys respond perfectly. The size is perfect. The spring back again very nice. I can type quickly on these and not have a lot of errors which is very unusual for a new keyboard.

ON DESKTOP
If I try to use this on a desktop, I don't like it as well. The reason? The soft pad at the bottom of the keyboard is sticky and abrasive on my skin. I don't have the ability to move around without chafing. The different height options help a lot though and make it easy to adapt.

ON LAP
That is where this SHINES for me. I can sit back on my chair at my desktop and hold this at a 45 degree downward angle on my lap and type very comfortably. At that point the wrist pillow takes longer to bother my skin.

MOUSE
The mouse houses the USB dongle that you need to have this work. I am using this on an old Windows 7 computer and the driver and USB dongle work PERFECTLY. No problems. The mouse works great and responds well. I still prefer a mousepad built into the keyboard, but this is still a decent alternative. The door of the mouse is magnetic that holds in the USB.

MULTIPLE
I also like that I can use this with multiple devices.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a fantastic split keyboard. If I could change anything to make it absolutely perfect, it would be to have the wrist pad not be abrasive and the mouse built into the keyboard as a mouse pad.

MY RATING
I still give this FIVE STARS. I love how I can use this at a downward angle on my lap and type just as fast or faster than on a desktop. I will probably be using this for my laptop as well as my desktop.

THIS REVIEW
I typed this entire review on this keyboard tilted on my lap at the downward angle I described in the review. It went perfectly and as fast as my old keyboard which has been the fastest keyboard I have ever used.

title: Great For A Boost Of Happy Girly Touch in a Laptop Case
text:
Our daughter has a friend who is going through some tough times. She has a little boy and is trying to go to school full time as well as being a single mom. To boost her up, my daughter requested we get this laptop case for her new school laptop she has to tote around with her toddler.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes sealed in a plastic bag so if your package is delivered in the rain, it will be protected reasonably well.

QUALITY
This laptop case is well made and the way it is designed, it has plenty of room for laptop, notebooks, papers, writing tools, and anything else you might need to take with you to school or business including a place for the phone.

STRAP
The shoulder strap has a pad on it for easier carrying.

HANDLES
The handles are a bit narrow but they are not uncomfortable to hold if needed. They also snap together for easier carrying so they are not always flopping around.

ZIPPERS
The zippers are metal and they will need to be lubricated from time to time. A simple piece of wax will do the trick, or you can buy zipper lube if you prefer. That will keep them running smoothly.

DOES SHE LIKE IT?
Let's just say that this is EXACTLY what our daughters friend needed to boost her spirits. She LOVES the color and design. It fits her 15 inch laptop perfectly and she has plenty of other room for items she needs too.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a great laptop case if you love having something feminine and you are not into the usual black, grey, and brown that always seems to be plentiful in laptop cases.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This case is much nicer than I thought it would be. It really is girly and very attractive. It is the perfect gift for yourself or like in our case, a family friend who needed a boost.

title: I Am VERY Frustrated With This- You NEED A USB Port/Outlet To Use It
text:
Our antenna rotor broke and for 3 years we have been waiting for new chips to come through so we could get another one. It has taken WAY too long. I got this to help with the problem in the meanwhile. What I got was MORE problems.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes in a blister pack. It has a long cord and a double tail plug on it. The idea is that you put the plug into the antenna spot on the TV and the other is a USB port that you put into your TV. There is a sticker to put this on the wall and instructions.

HOW THIS WORKS
I have had no end of frustration with this thing. We do not have an OLD TV but we do not have any USB ports in this that work with the antenna. The outlets are such that I can not fit ANY adapters into the plug to use an adapter for the USB. The cord from the USB to the intersection where the antenna cord is is very short- only 13 inches. Put that together with the other cord for the antenna which is also about 13 inches and you can not spread them tightly so you only have about 22 to 24 inches tops to get from the TV on the wall down to a USB outlet if you don't have USB on your TV.

I TRIED TO MAKE THIS WORK
I have tried many different USB adapters to get this to work and none of them will work with this unit. I am frustrated and have spent so much time on this, I am giving up. I really wanted this to work, but despite this being an HDTV, it just isn't working out with this unit. I guess we will have to go without antenna TV on that TV longer.

THE BOTTOM LINE
If you have USB available on your TV and an antenna hook up, this might work for you. If you don't have a USB port that will work with this unit, you will have to have an available plug that has USB conversion in it, or USB on a power strip that is not more than 24 inches away from the antenna jack on the TV to make it work. You can also use an extension cord and adapter, but honestly, it is a lot of expense for a unit that might or might not work as you like.

MY RATING
THREE STARS. I can not give this a terrible rating like I want to in my frustration. To be fair, three stars is about right. I do not like that it does not come with adapters or alternatives for TVs. Most people who watch antenna TV do not always have the newest equipment. We happen to have this TV that needs the hookup. We have another TV which is newer but the picture is not that great and we already have it set up with another antenna hookup.

I would like this a LOT better if it came with a streamlined USB plug adapter for the power outlets.

UPDATES
If by some miracle, I can find a USB adapter that will fit in this situation and actually WORK, I will update this review and reconsider the rating. For now, it stays as it is. I have put enough time and resources into trying to make this work.

title: A Bit Frustrating To Set Up At Times, But Nice Light
text:
I have been trying to get a decent set up for taking photos of jewelry and pottery for a business I am trying to get going. The smaller lights that I had were just not doing the trick. I got this one to help.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes with the tripod base separately packed in a box. The rest of the pieces come jammed in a foam tray. You have to put the cord together with the two pieces and the transformer box.

CONTROLS
This works great when it comes to changing the light brightness or the temperature. I have to say that the different lights respond very well.

CORD
The cord seems plenty long enough, but in some locations, you might need an extension cord.

ARMS
The arms and swivels are a bit frustrating at times to figure out. They can easily get turned too far one way and you have to undo them to get them to work right. It is not that big of a deal if you get the hang of it. It is handy to have the lights in one direction or two different ones too.

PERFORMANCE
The light is great for taking photos. I have tried it in many directions with different temperatures. I have to say this is one of the nicest lights I have used so far. It really gives precise lighting if you need it in a variety of directions.

STURDY
This tripod is very sturdy. It stands up well and does not wobble or seem unsteady at all. I am very happy with this.

HEAVY
This is a heavy light, no doubt.

CASE?
There is no case with this. I have to say I wish this came with a case. It would be a lot easier to tote around and protect if it had a case.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This light is a nice light. It works well and has a wide variety of settings and directions it can go. I find it sturdy and easy to work with, although I wish it had a case.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. This really needs a case to protect it and carry it around. Other than that (which is why I removed a star) I think this light performs very well and I love it. Now I just need a better camera than the one I wasted hundreds of dollars on that is lousy.

title: Perfect For My Two Smaller Cameras And Batteries/Chargers
text:
I have had some issues because I have two Canon cameras- a G12 and a G7X Mark ii. These are not large cameras, but they do need some protection. All of the camera cases I found were either WAY too big or way too small. This was perfect.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes sealed in a plastic bag.

ODOR
I have to say this smells like it was dipped in a vat of bug spray. It is very strong and obnoxious. It has taken weeks and the smell is still there. When the weather gets nice with no rain, I plan to leave it out until the smell is gone.

FIT
The cameras both fit on the one side of the case which has the elastic strap in it. That keeps them in place along with their straps- one of which is a stiffer leather strap I don't like taking on and off of the camera constantly. The mesh bag size holds the chargers and batteries perfectly too. I also keep a microfiber cloth in there.

CARRY STRAP
I like that this has a carry strap for the shoulder or you can carry with your hands.

ZIPPER
The zipper is a two way zipper and is tight and closes well.

OUTSIDE POCKET
The outside pocket is slim and has no closure on it but is handy for papers, or other items, perhaps even SD cards in the case.

IS THIS STURDY?
This is a hard cover case so it does protect the cameras well.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For me, this is the perfect solution to a frustrating problem. It fits my cameras just right and is not too difficult to open and close either when I want to take them out.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS for me. This smell is really awful- it gives everyone a headache when they are near it, so I have to keep it apart from all of us until I can air it out and finally use it as the case for my cameras without gagging when I get near it.

title: Great Case, Kind Of Clumsy For Quick Access- Excellent For Travel (Great Travel Art Bag Too)
text:
I have a couple of smaller cameras that have batteries and rechargers and I thought it would be nice to have a case to carry all of them so that I could save space.

FABRIC
This is made of very robust fabric. It is tough and will last through some rough times.

PADDING
This has plenty of padding and walls that you can move slightly if you need to.

POCKETS
There is an inner pocket where you can slip thin things like memory cards, etc, even manual if it is not too big. There are several outer pockets. One has velcro closure and is best for things that you don't want a lot of protection on in case rain slips in the top. The other outer pockets are under the flap and are well protected. There is a zipper and several layers to the pockets.

LINING
This case is lined as are the pockets.

STRAP
The strap is nice and pliable and has a great shoulder pad on it. The strap clips off if you like and you can store the handle in the back velcro pocket.

HANDLE
There is a carry handle on the back if you don't want to use the strap for whatever reason.

ZIPPERS
The zipper is strong around the top of the case. It is protected under the flap.

STURDY?
This is a VERY sturdy case. It has plenty of padding and the flap and zipper work to protect the contents VERY well.

CONVENIENT
This is a GREAT case for travel. It is highly protective and is well made. For carrying with you so that you can pull out your camera quickly to take shots- not so much. The flap is a tight velcro and then you have to unzip the top in addition to that. It is not easy to get into quickly, but again, for transport- great.

THE BOTTOM LINE
I wanted this to carry with me and then take photos for my small cameras and extra batteries etc. This is okay, but it is not easy to get into quickly and is more for those who have planned photography trips. It is a great case for that.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS only for the accessibility factor for me. If you are into high level photography and want to plan your trips and take the camera and lenses with you protected, this is FIVE STARS for sure.

I plan to use this for my artists supplies instead. I plan to turn this into my travel art kit for portable watercolor palette, pencils, pens and some smaller books and tablets for watercolor painting out and about.

title: Works Great, No Complaints
text:
I recently wanted to put in an android unit on my TV which only has a few HDMI hook ups. I have a PS3 that I still use, but it does not really use internet that much, so I wanted to be able to use a switch to go back and forth between them.

PERFORMANCE
I put the HDMI that I had (high performance) on the out side, and then inserted both the HDMI from the devices on the in side. The button works fine and the switch seems to be clean and operates well.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This switch does what it is supposed to. I have not seen any lag or issues since using it.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS so far. If I have any issues pop up, I will update. For now, it is working great.

title: Perfect To Increase Power Outlets In Bedroom
text:
I have a situation in a small bedroom where the outlets are blocked by shelving units so it is difficult to get in and unplug things often. Having an outlet strip to screw onto the wooden headboard (which has lights and small shelving in it) was what I was looking for. This was perfect.

CORD
The cord is nice and strong and is 6 ft long which is plenty of length to go from behind the shelves to the side of the headboard unit.

PLUGS
The plugs work well and the USB is great to have handy for recharging items or running items that need USB plugs instead of conventional plugs.

LIGHTS
I had another strip but the light was so bright on it, it was annoying in the bedroom. This one has tiny lights on it to show it is working. If I really want to, I can put a non residue sticker over top of it for the light and then remove it if I need to check it.

SCREW SLOTS
There are two slots to put screws into and slide the unit into place. I am also using some double stick tape to give extra security to make it stay put.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This outlet strip is perfect for the bedroom in a location where I need access to plugs vs having the outlets inaccessible behind shelving units.

title: Perfect Set Up For Fish Aquarium Center
text:
I had the bright idea a while back to set up all of my many fish tanks so that all of them plugged into a few UPS bricks which would give me an additional 30 minutes or more of power during outages. That would give me time to set up the generator and transfer power over to that. The problem is that it does not work well at all. Now one by one my bricks are malfunctioning and have to be replaced. This was to help replace one of my bricks.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes in a box.

CORD
The cord is 6 feet long and has ability to rotate from left to right in a 180 degree swing.

BACK MOUNT
There are several spots to mount this on screws on the back.

PLUG
The plug is polarized 3 prong. It plugs into the outlet at a 45 degree angle to the right.

LIGHT SWITCH
My problem that I have a lot is that I get an outlet strip and forget to look for a light. When using one of these in a bedroom, I don't want to big bright light to be on the strip. This has a tiny light. That means if I really want, I can block off the light with a sticker, and remove if necessary.

OUTLETS
The outlets are great. The center strip has the ability to have plugs put in next to each other. The other six outlets are big enough to allow for a transformer type plug to be used in each one of them.

USB
The usb outlets work fine for recharging and operating items.

PERFORMANCE
This has a great outlet strip. I am going to be able to use this under one of my tanks, but I might put it on the wall to allow the cords to have a drip loop.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a nice outlet strip. It has plenty of room for all sorts of cords and is quite flexible to give you the best options to install it where you need it.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is a nice strip and I would buy another so far. I will update of anything changes.

title: Originally Got For Bedroom (Forgot About Red Light) But Use For Other Areas
text:
I originally got this to put on the other side of our headboard so that our hidden outlet is more accessible once I put up our new storage shelves in the bedroom.

HOW THIS COMES
This came in a box. It has basic information in it.

CORD
The cord is actually 6.6 ft long. I needed the extra length for the place I had set aside for it.

LAYOUT
The layout of this outlet strip is excellent I can put any type of plug in there and it works. The USB cords are also laid out well.

PERFORMANCE
I found this to be excellent. It has a small footprint on it so does not take up much space. I side mounted it on the side of our headboard on my husband's side of the bed. It is nice to be able to recharge things or have USB cords handy as well as electrical outlets.

LIGHT
Unfortunately after I put it up, I remembered that there was that bright red light on the switch. In a bedroom that is a problem so I took it out of there. Our other side has a similar outlet strip without a light on it so I did not give it a thought like I should have.

WHAT I USE IT FOR NOW
I use this as a wall mount to plug in my aquarium pumps, lights, etc. into. The small footprint makes it great to use.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a nice compact little outlet strip/box. It is set up well and works well. It does have a light on it, though, so if planning to use in a bedroom keep that in mind.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is a great unit. I am going to get this when my UPS units finally fail in my sewing room so that I can have a small outlet to use out of the way instead of the big UPS one that has given me issues anyway.

title: Nice Card, Packaging Needs Improvement- Gets Lost Easily In Packages (Let Me Explain)
text:
I needed an additional SD micro card to put in my tablet and later in my outdoor camera which I use to take small videos. This seemed perfect.

HOW THIS IS SHIPPED
This packaging is awful. It comes in a tiny case which is then put in a cello bag. The problem is that it is SMALL. I got this slipped into a very large box with a larger item. It got stuck in the folds of the paper it shipped with. As a result it was thrown away.

It took 2 people 30 minutes to find it because the paper it was stuck to was opaque. There should be a cardboard involved that it is stapled to or something to alert you that it is inside the package.

PERFORMANCE
Frustrations aside with the packaging, the card itself performs well. It takes video well and it also works for photos and other storage. I am going to transfer it to my outdoor camera soon which I will need it on.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This card works fine in my tablet, but the packaging makes it very easy to get lost in the box if shipped with other items.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. This is not a cheap cart. It needs to be shipped in packaging that calls attention to it so it does not get lost. The performance is FIVE stars. Packaging is ONE star, so the average is about THREE AND A HALF STARS so I am giving it FOUR.

title: Great For Basic Photography, But Not A Pure Daylight White
text:
There are various reasons why everyone wants to have lighting for camera work. My daughter and I have had a jewelry and pottery business we wanted to start but with everything going berserk two years ago, we put a hold on it all.

In the meanwhile, my perfect light that I love which goes on my camera shorted out. That made me frustrated. This light is larger, but I figured I can set it up on a tripod.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes in a box with a foam liner. There is a Type C connector for charging , a cord, and a screw on adapter for a tripod or on top of a camera if your camera can handle it.

CHARGING
This took me a while to charge it. After I left it in overnight, this was fully charged.

BATTERY
I purposely charged this up and did not use it for a few months. This battery was still up near 10 hours at 10% lighting on 5600K when I started it up. That is a great power retention. Using it, I get a few hours out of it before I recharge and I use it at less than 50% usually.

LIGHT COLOR
For all of the colors provided by this light, they are great. What I got it for, however, was jewelry and pottery photos so I am not going to be using the RGB lights very much except for advertising photos perhaps.

WHITE LIGHT COLOR
The white light color is kind of frustrating for me. I like to have natural lighting that does not add color to the photos. That means that in my situation, anything above 50% is too bright. This light only goes to 5600K in cool tones, but when I use it under 50% it still has some green/yellow to it. Yes, I can edit it out with color adjustments in my software, but it is a bit frustrating.

Some photos work out well, but others not so much. I do like a bit of yellow in my photos, so I will pull it down a little bit toward lower K value if I want warmer tones (aka sunlight type)

CONTROLS
The controls are easy to use and I like that it is mechanical and not software driven. The battery left is shown clearly and the settings are also lit up well.

WEIGHT
This is a heavy light. It is twice the size and weight of my other light so I can not put it on my camera. I use a tripod instead.

CASE
This does not come with a hard case which disappoints me. It has a cheap velveteen bag with no padding. It is nice, but you will need a case to keep this in for protection along with your camera.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This light is not bad. It give me some settings to work with on my jewelry. I would like it better if it was just a bit cooler in capability (higher K). As it is, I use it, but sometimes I find myself adding other lights to balance out the tint of this one.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. This is nice, has nice battery capacity and retention of charge, but the light white color is not quite as nice as I was hoping for. It still is decent and I use it.

title: Solid Strap- Easy To Store Strap In Case With Camera- Fits Tiny Holes
text:
My favorite camera (Canon Powershot G12) has been giving me a lot of trouble this year. I decided to look into another one. I decided to try out the Canon Powershot G7x Mark ii as it is comparable in some ways. Although I am not as fond of it, the one thing that has annoyed me is the tiny rings provided to attache straps. They are ridiculously small and squished almost flat. Most straps will not fit this camera.

I was looking for a good strap and found one from this company, but it is leather. It is great to use when I need a sturdy strap, but for storing in my case, the strap is too stiff. I got this one as an alternative.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes wrapped in a cardboard stuck in a tube. I took photos to show you so you can get an idea. It is quite smart because you always know where it is.

COLOR
This is a really attractive light gray color.

HOW TO ATTACH
This has a great loop system which loops into the camera rings. The cord loops are attached to a snap on piece which locks into place on the strap. The strap comes with two of these so you can swap it between cameras.

PERFORMANCE
I really love to use my leather strap, but for storage, I prefer to have the nylon strap on the camera. If I need a quick change I can, but both straps easily interchange because they are from the same company.

BACK OF STRAP
The strap has silicone bars on the neck area to keep it from sliding around. Sometimes I like it and sometimes I am not as fond of it. It is great for use around the house as I take a lot of photos of products and jewelry.

IS IT ADJUSTABLE?
This is adjustable which is another feature I like. I am not locked into one length like with the leather one.

SECURE CONNECTION?
I find that so far the connectors snap in well and are secure. Over time, I am not sure how they will wear, but for now they are working well.

PLASTIC OR METAL?
When I looked at the photos for this listing, I thought the connectors were metal, but they are gray metallic colored plastic/nylon.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This neck strap fits my camera and I am glad to have it. It stores well in my camera case and is easy to disconnect and swap with my other strap from the same company.

MY RATING
I am giving this FOUR STARS. I think it is a bit pricey for what you get. The strap is nice, but I don't think it is worth quite as much as the price listed. I still prefer my leather strap as it has a wider neck band, but this is a good one to quickly use when I have to store my camera in the case and don't have time to swap.

title: An Answer To A Big Problem In My House
text:
I have an area in my kitchen dining area that has a set of hooks on the wall. We hang all of the important cords on there for charging and recharging our appliances that need cords. Over time this has gotten WAY out of hand. I wanted to have a place to put the cords away and still have access to them.

ZIPPERS
The zippers are two way and work great.

COMPARTMENTS
The compartments hold quite a few cords. I know that this is for travel, but for me, I keep this near the hooks in the cord area and it is small and easy to store. The elastics hold quite a few sets of cords and the pockets hold even more. The small cases are great for ear buds and the other cases are good for extra cards, etc.

ROOM FOR TABLET?
This does have a nice spot for a tablet. Having it in a sleeve would not be a bad idea though due to the other items in the case.

DOES IT HOLD A LOT?
I have been able to put every cord in this that I need to with more room for a few more cords. I have to say that this is really helpful for me and it has completely cleaned up my cord rack.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is just what I needed to store extra cords I don't use as often but still have them handy.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is a great case. It is good for my purposes of storage in my home, but in travel, it would also be a great case to take with you.

title: Cord Is Short For Some Locations, But Good Performance
text:
I have an issue in my bedroom where there is furniture around the walls so it is nearly impossible to reach any outlets. We have a large headboard so we have decided to screw down an outlet strip on either side of the headboard so we don't have to worry about outlets anymore.

PLUG
This plug is flat to the wall with is great.

CORD
The cord is 6 ft long which is a bit short, but works in one of our spots well enough. It is a thick cord.

PERFORMANCE
These outlets all worked and the USB and Type C work as well. The switch is nice to have, but it does light up so the bedroom might not be as good of a place for this as I originally though. It is great for alternatives in my computer and aquarium rooms when my UPS outlet bricks finally stop working. I will replace it with one of these.

THE BOTTOM LINE
The cord is a bit shorter than I would like but this outlet strip is helpful for making outlets accessible in a room where they are hard to get to.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. The outlets are nice. The button with the bright red is not nice in the bedroom, but it does work in other rooms just fine.

title: Perfect Temporary Case For Canon Powershot G7X Mark ii Camera and Strap
text:
I recently had my very favorite camera start to break on me. That meant I had to get another camera to use in the meanwhile. The camera I had did not have a case at all, so I had to find something quickly to protect it.

SIZE
This case is the perfect size for my camera. It is a Canon Powershow G7X Mark ii Camera. It has a leather composite strap which is a bit bulky, but folded up it fits too.

POCKET
Due to the camera taking up most of the space, the pocket does not hold the recharge unit for the batteries without smashing the camera unless I really work with it.

PROTECTION
This is good enough for basic protection, but not over the top. It is better than not having a case and it helps the camera stay safe.

STICKERS AND HANDLE
This has a carabiner hook for carrying it and a pack of stickers included. Nothing extravagant, but fun if you have young kids who like stickers to play with.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For my camera, this is the perfect case for now. It is basic protection with a handle and soft insides. It is protective enough for now and I am glad to have it.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. I wish this had just a little bit more room for the recharging unit and extra batteries. Other than that, it is a decent basic case for now.

title: WOW, I Didn't Expect This To Be THIS Good!
text:
I recently came across some tapes that I had kicking around which I really wanted to hear. They were books on tape which they no longer have available in digital format. I decided it was worth getting a tape recorder to hear them. I was not expecting much. So many tape recorders in the past were awful, but I tried anyway.

PLUG
This has a tranformer style plug which means you will need room on a power strip or outlet bar for a larger plug. It has a jack that goes into the tape recorder and the cord is thin but several feet long and it works for me.

TAPE
This even comes with a blank tape you can use to record with.

MICROPHONE
The microphone is not bad for a small cheap mic. It works fine for basic recording.

SOUND
This machine is AWESOME! Seriously. I can not believe how loud it is even on halfway volume. There was no buzzing, distortion, or problems at all that I have had in the past with other machines. This one played the tapes beautifully and I had no issues hearing at all.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This machine exceeded my expectations greatly. It not only is easy to use, but the sound quality is fantastic. I am very happy with this tape recorder and will finally be able to use some of the tapes that no longer are available in digital format.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This was a pleasant surprise. I highly recommend this tape recorder if you want to hear some tapes clearly that you can not get in digital format for whatever reason. For recording, it seems more cumbersome than using a digital voice recorder, but maybe a walk down memory lane would be worth using this instead if you want to have some fun.

title: Nice Strap, But Very Stiff, Hard To Store, Doesn't Smell Like Leather
text:
I have a camera that is very hard to find a decent strap for. The loops on it are squished oblong loops and almost no rings of straps will fit through them. (Canon Powershot G7X Mark ii). I was looking for a strap so I could use my camera, and finally found this one. It was any port in a storm for me, so let's see how it is working out.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes folded up on a round tube package. It is rather creative and distinctive. The price is very high ($75 at the time of this review) so this is appropriate looking for a classy gift.

HOW IT WORKS
I simply threaded the loops through the camera holes and the attached the round snaps to the strap on each side. Thankfully they work hard, so they stay in place. I don't plan to take it off often so that should not be an issue over time.

LENGTH
I got the regular length and it is perfect for my use.

PERFORMANCE
I like this strap in that it is soft near the neck and sturdy in use. I am not fond of the fact that it is so STIFF with no easy way to wrap it around the camera or fold it for storage in a small case. It is kind of cumbersome actually.

IS IT LEATHER?
I am not sure if this is full grain leather or bonded leather. It does not smell like leather so it might be bonded leather which many technically call leather. It is lined with soft synthetic fiber lining though, so it will not scratch the neck or skin

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a nice strap, sturdy and nice looking. It is very stiff, however to work with and that makes it cumbersome when moving my camera around or storing it.

MY RATING
THREE STARS. This is nice, but it is nowhere near worth $75. I would say perhaps $40 or so would be a good price. It is a nice strap and it works for my camera, but it is also frustrating at times to work with.

title: For Now Photos Turn Out Great, Until I Get A New Camera
text:
I got this originally to do some video work and high quality photos with, but then my camera began to short out on me. So, I am using this in a G12 Canon Powershot (which is also shorting out on me).

HOW THIS COMES
This comes on a card.

WHY I GOT THIS
I originally got this, hoping maybe my storage card was causing the problems with my cameras, but it was not the problem.

PERFORMANCE
Although my camera was not ultra high end, it would have been good to test this with. For now, it performs very well in my older camera so far. I am waiting to be able to replace my failed camera so I can test the video aspect of this card with it.

As far as photos go, this takes great photos and even on the higher speed continuous shots it seems to work well. Then again, this is not a new camera, so that is not really saying much as this card was designed for ultra video shooting and DSLR cameras.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Since my camera quit, I have only been able to test this on older cameras. It works fine, but I have not got anything better to test it on right now.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I am pretty frustrated at my cameras breaking down right now, but this will work as a good huge storage for photos for now on my older one. I hope to get a new one in the not too distant future. If I can get a friend to test this on his video camera, I will update.

title: Handy To Have When Outlets Unreachable
text:
We have had to revamp our entire small home. That means that some of the outlets are going to be covered over by furniture or other things which make them harder to access. This outlet extender is for one of those rooms.

HOW IT COMES
This comes in a box well wrapped and protected. It has an instructional pamphlet in it.

PLUGS
The plugs are 3 prong, but they have no room for the larger plugs which have transformers on them. The USB and TYPE C ports are very handy for recharging many items we have around the house.

CORD/PLUG
The plug fits tight against the wall and the cord being 5 ft is a good length for our use.

BACK
The back panel is really cool. You pull it up if you want to use it to hang the outlet from, or you leave it down if you just want to rest the strip on a table top.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This outlet strip has been very handy in a room that I can not reach the outlets very easily. It has expanded my use in the room and allows me to use USB at the same time.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is good for my basic room that I need it for. If you need to use cords with a transformer box style plug, this might not work well for you if you plan to use all three outlets.

title: Handy For Basic Plugs, But No Room For Transformer Types- Hanger Very Nice
text:
We have had to revamp our entire small home. That means that some of the outlets are going to be covered over by furniture or other things which make them harder to access. This outlet extender is for one of those rooms.

This comes in a box well wrapped and protected. It has an instructional pamphlet in it.

PLUGS

title: Perfect Way To Route Power Outlet In Crowded Bedroom
text:
Our bedroom is very tiny. It is so crowded that it is impossible to fit much of anything in there. I have had to remodel the room with wire shelving and small storage shelves as regular furniture won't fit. This outlet strip is perfect to help re-route the outlet.

CORD
The cord is about five or six feet and reaches where we need it to be perfectly. I can not access it right now and forgot to measure exactly.

WHAT I AM USING THIS FOR
I am using this to put the outlet on the back of our headboard unit (it is a big one) so that I can plug in items there instead of trying to get at the wall. This expands my ability to recharge phone, tablet, or USB lights in the bedroom.

INSTALLATION
There are two holes for screws on the ends. These worked perfectly to install the outlet strip on the headboard.

DOES IT WORK?
This has been GREAT. I love that I can access the plugs easily now as well as have some USB plugs too.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This little unit plugs into the wall FLAT allows for me to access outlets again and works great.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I love this unit. It is great. The flat plug is also perfect.

title: Great Extra Tripod For Travel
text:
My daughter and I were working on some business projects so we could start a jewelry business. When the whole hoopla of the last two years kicked in, she ended up at school far away so we were unable to finish setting the business up. She wanted to try to work from her location, so asked me for a tripod so we could leave the other one here.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes with a really nice carry case and in a box.

PERFORMANCE
I tested this out before giving it to her and it really did well with my small camera. I did not get this to use with a phone, there are plenty of cheaper tripods out there for that. I got this to use with a Canon G12 and then a Fuji camera that is quite a bit bigger.

With both cameras, this tripod worked very well indoors and outdoors. It balanced, set up sturdy with adjustments and also took some nice photos in odd positions.

PORTABLE
This is very portable which is what I needed to be able to send to our daughter to use. She also needs something smaller and light to store in her small space.

DOES IT HOLD THE CAMERAS WELL?
I have had no issues with the cameras moving or not staying put on this tripod.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This has worked very well for me and now my daughter who will be using this to start working on our website photos from her remote location. It is portable, easy to set up and stays put nicely for the photos we have taken.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I am not a professional so I do not understand the high demands of all of the different types of photos you might want to take. For product photos, painting reference photos, and basic nature photos, this has been great. I like that it fits in the carry case well too.

title: Perfect For Our Power Tool Charging Center
text:
We have acquired a lot of charging units for power tools. My husband has his own business so he has his, then our kids have their tools, and I have mine. This was becoming a problem because our only outlet had only a few places to plug in things. This solves that.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes in a long box. It has a great heavy duty cord.

CORD AND PLUG
This cord is heavy duty. The plug is 3 pronged, but is flat and at an angle for easy plugging into an outlet behind furniture.

WHAT WE USE IT FOR
We have this hanging on the wall behind our shelf that holds the recharging units for power tools including our snow blower. This allows us to keep the ones we want plugged in without having to worry about being unplugged by someone else. We just use the switches to turn on what we want when we want.

WHAT ABOUT TRANSFORMERS?
We have a few larger transformers that do take up more than one spot, but there are so many outlets on this, it is not a big problem.

LENGTH
This is about 2 feet long. Be sure you have the room for it before you order it.

THE BOTTOM LINE
THIS solves our problems with our power tool recharging center. It is really long, has lots of room and allows for individual controls for each charger when we want to use them.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I kind of wish this was half as long and twice as wide, but as it is, it still works for us. I am really glad it has a flat plug on it.

title: I Love Having The Camera For Basic Videos, But Details Blurry Too Often
text:
[[VIDEOID:175be88220b97e4026648594f363a662]] I have a great camera- Canon G12. It does amazing photos, and it has the ability to get some amazing macro photos. I also had the ability to do videos, but for some reason it will only do formats no longer supported in most places. So, I got this to do videos.

HOW DOES THIS COME?
This comes in a box that has foam insert. The parts are in boxes and wrapped lightly.

PERFORMANCE OF VIDEO
I used this for both photos and video. For basic overall video taking for reviews, it is okay. For close up macro videos to get any kind of detail, this is disappointing. The camera has a hard time focusing on items I want to get detail on even if I really work with it.

PHOTOS
The photos are not bad. They are adequate for doing some basic photos. They don't compare with my G12 though. The detail is pretty good and the color capture is good too. With some photo editing, it can be altered to get an okay photo.

MACRO LENS
The lens I thought would make close ups easier, but it really didn't seem to help as much as I would like.

TRANSFER PHOTOS
You can either plug in the camera with the micro SD card in it, or take the card out and put it into an adapter to use it in the computer or laptop right from the card. Either way works.

SAMPLES
The first post I put up for you is a video with the macro lens to capture the details of Moissanite earrings. As you can see, it is not the greatest video and it is hard to capture the details of the earrings. This was the best of all of the videos that I have to show you.

The next few photos are as follows. The first photo is without the macro lens and the last 2 are with the macro lens. They are okay, but not as good as I had hoped for.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For basic photos and videos of larger objects without fine detail this is a great camera for basic videos. For detail high quality photos, this is not the best but it will get acceptable photos and some videos with some detail.

MY RATING
THREE STARS. This camera is okay, and I am glad to be able to take video for reviews, but as for high quality and something worth raving about, it is not as nice as I had hoped it would be. I can not use my phone for a lot of video work, so this is acceptable for what I wanted it for.

title: Originally Got This For Dual Purpose, But Now Just Use For Camera
text:
I originally got this tripod a step up from where I was going to buy one because I wanted to use it for a dual purpose. The SOHO easel I got was supposed to be used on a tripod or table top. I figured this tripod was strong enough so I got it, as my camera does not need a really heavy duty tripod.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes with two plates you can interchange and it is easy to put on and off of the tripod. It comes with tools for tightening (allen keys) and it has a case too. There is a pretty good manual although not spectacular.

PERFORMANCE
For the easel, it did hold it well, but I just felt that the design of the easel didn't work out. I felt it put too much strain on a really nice tripod.

For camera use, it works great. There is a lot of flexibility for what I need indoors and outdoors, so I have many options. We have two cameras in the house- one is pretty heavy, so this is a great tripod to have.

PORTABLE
This case is easy to carry. It has a nice strap on it for shoulder carry and it fits the tripod without much struggle too.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Although I got this for a dual purpose, I am glad I have it for just our cameras anyway. The easel is not a good idea (too much strain on the tripod) but the cameras work out very well. So far I have had good experiences with this tripod.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is portable and stable for me so far and I am happy to have it. I hope to get a lot of use out of it this upcoming winter and spring.

title: Adds Great Depth To My Dining Room Table
text:
I have a small dining room table with a granite top. In the winter we have candles we use as well as during power outages. The problem is that the table top looks cluttered as we have to put a few things in a small area. I didn't get this for monitors, but to give a 2nd level to my table and it looks PERFECT.

IS THIS HEAVY?
This is not overly heavy. It will hold quite a bit of weight though.

IS THIS ADJUSTABLE?
This is a set length.

WHAT I USE THIS FOR
I use this to put the produce dish (Italian Handmade Glass) and the flower vase, the pencil/pen holder, and the other items that we use from either side of the table on to raise it up. The front of this riser has my decorative candle holders. The nice part is that our crystal tealight holders slide under the riser so you can see them, but they are easy to reach when they want to be used. They no longer take up table space.

DOES THIS STAY PUT?
This stays put nicely.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This riser is not being used for monitors, but it is perfect on my granite dining area table. It really adds some nice dimension to our table and we all love it.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. Although this would work great for dual monitors, I love it for my use as well. It can easily be decorated with a doily or other things if you like to make it look less industrial.

title: Fantastic Sound, Pretty Great Reception, AM/WB a little weak.
text:
I am always on the lookout for radios to use in an emergency. Having lived through an extended outage during severe weather emergency for several weeks, not having any way to find out what was going on was difficult.

SIZE
This radio is a nice small size. Picture two juice boxes standing next to each other side by side. It fits just about anywhere. If you want to take it on a trip or camping, it has a very small footprint for packing.

CHARGING
Charging this is either micro USB, crank, or solar. I would say solar is more of a way to keep the radio trickle charged. I would not use that as my primary source as it takes a long time.

SOUND
The sound is really really nice. I am shocked at how nice this little unit sounds. It has great bass and midtones without sounding tinny or far away.

FLASHLIGHT
In an emergency having this as a flashlight is handy, although I would not use it unless no other options were there.

CHARGING PHONES?
I have not used it for charging phones. I keep power banks for that.

ALARM CLOCK/CLOCK
This is a great feature if you are camping or if you have to be up at a certain time during a power outage due to expected weather, checking on sump pumps, etc. It works well if you follow the instructions.

SD CARD
This plays music from an SD card and I have to say the sound is great.

CHARGING TIME
This took a few hours to charge up for us. Between 3 and 4.

PERFORMANCE
When running the radio, we got several days. We did not have it full volume, and we only played it a few hours at a time, not continually.

LOW BATTERY LIGHT
This has a low battery light which is a great feature. It helps you not let it run dry in power.

RECEPTION
The reception is excellent for FM, Very good for AM (some stations don't come in as well), and WB is also hit and miss, but still way nicer than most radios of this type that I have had.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a fantastic little radio. The sound is way nicer than expected and performance is great. Lots of great features make this handy to have.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is one of my favorite radios so far. It is really nice to work with and all of the power sources work well.

title: Not Nearly As Good As Having A Rotor (We Usually Get OVER A HUNDRED Channels)
text:
We have had the best time with our antenna. The rotor on top of the roof made it so that we could pick up literally HUNDREDS of stations from the US and Canada. It was delightful. Then the rotor broke. Then Covid wiped out all businesses and we have not been able to get a new rotor since.

HOW THIS WORKS
This antenna is very thin like a piece of paper almost (not quite). You attach it to the TV where you would put the antenna plug in. The app shows you were to put the antenna and you have 18 ft cord to move around to do it. Once up, you set the channels and you are good to go.

HOW THIS REALLY WORKS
For us this was frustrating. The app was meh, but we are pretty limited in our choices of where to put the antenna anyway. We put this antenna in the best place we could find. At first we got lots of channels. Okay, well nowhere near 100, but about 45. It beats the 10 channels we were getting with the broken rotor and the antenna freely spinning in the wind.

The problem comes later. We would sit down to watch a channel we liked, it was gone. I mean GONE. Then we would rescan and were down to only 15 channels. Some of them were in and out. We relocated the antenna and got channels for a while, but then they were gone again.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This will bring in lots of channels, but only at certain times. We have the antenna in almost the same location as our roof antenna (just slightly lower) and we can not pull in channels nearly as well as with the antenna when it is working. Day by day channels we NEVER lose don't come in anymore.

MY RATING
THREE STARS. This brings in some, but not nearly what we are used to. We live in a VERY high hill. there should not be this kind of difficulty in bringing in channels and having them come in consistently. I am referring to channels we get with our spinning antenna on the roof. They don't even come in consistently with this thing. We were hoping this could help until we can get a new rotor.

After several month of irregular channels pulling in and having to struggle, we are putting it back on our spinning roof antenna I think. We don't get quite as many but we at least got the local channels consistently.

title: Way Nicer Than Expected!  Books on Tape And Vintage CD Anniversary Fun!
text:
Because life has been so full of curves, my husband and I were trying to re-create our anniversary at home this year. One of our happiest times was at a little bed and breakfast that had a tiny CD player next to the bed. When I saw this, I could not believe it. I knew we had to have it.

HOW WE USE THIS
We did not opt to hang this on the wall. Since most of our CD players have long bit the dust, I wanted something I can move from room to room. We use this on the enclosed stand. It is perfect.

HOW WELL DOES IT PLAY CDs?
This plays CDs really well. It has played our CDs for music as well as books on tape. You can not save your place to go back to, however, so it is up to you to either endure the entire thing over again til you finish or try to listen to a whole CD at once. Some of the books I have are not marked on the CD in chapters so it won't forward to them.

SOUND QUALITY
The sound quality is rustic. It is not a really great speaker, but it is good for what we want. If you really want amazing sound, then I would suggest you just use MP3 or phone/tablet and a nice bluetooth speaker. For a good vintage sound with just enough to give you a nice song or book, this is actually refreshing.

DOES IT PLAY SD CARDS?
This does play the cards well too, but I prefer to use those with my phone or tablet and a nice bluethooth speaker.

REMOTE
The remote is really nice- it is white so it is easy to read. The only problem is that it does cross over to LED rope lights sometimes so in addition to changing a song, I change the color of my lights and have to get the light remote out again to set them back. The remote takes two AAA batteries.

CONTROLS
The controls are on the top of this unit, that is why having it on the wall seems to be counterproductive. You can turn it on or off using one of the buttons pressed for 3 seconds. The color coding on the lights to show you mode is helpful. I like the simplicity of this.

ALARM
I don't use the alarm or sleep mode on this.

CAN YOU USE THIS FOR BLUETOOTH SPEAKERS?
This can not be used with bluetooth speakers or headphones. It is an input only not output.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a nice little CD player for books on tape and also for vintage type CDs as they sound more like the past. It can not be used with a bluetooth speaker or headphones but still is nice to have handy to play in various rooms.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is a nice player, is portable and has a cover on it. Controls are easy to use and the remote is nice. Honestly, my husband and I had so much fun re-creating our favorite get away anniversary at home and this CD player was an important part.

title: I Use This Thing CONSTANTLY
text:
When I try to use my tablet in bed, it is difficult to use. There is not a stand or handle to hold, so I find it a bit large and heavy. Finding this pillow was a godsend.

FABRIC
This is a flocked fabric and is very soft.

This stays in shape REALLY well.

DOES IT WORK WITH PHONES TOO?
I have used this with 3 different sizes of tablets from large to small and then for phones too.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This pillow is fantastic. I can use it with any of my devices and it helps a lot.

title: Perfect Research Bag
text:
I have a bunch of books that I use for a research group that I am the head of. I have various books, notebooks, and other items that I need to keep handy when an impromptu meeting is called of this group. My other leather satchel was clumsy. Let's take a look at this one.

COLOR
The color is gorgeous denim blue color like stone washed denim.

LEATHER QUALITY
This is very heavy duty leather. This is a very high quality bag

WORKMANSHIP
This bag is very well made. It is heavy duty and the construction seems to be sturdy and like it will last if not abused badly.

DESIGN
This is designed for a laptop, but in my case, I can put in a laptop along with plenty of notebooks, books, and smaller papers and documents. The front pockets are a bit of a hassle to get in and out of, but they are good for small items that you want to take with you but keep secure.

HANDLES
The handles on this are sturdy and easy to hold, although if the bag is really heavy, they could bite into your hand a bit as there is not cushioning. I don't see it as a big problem in most cases.

INSIDE
The inside is lined out of decent fabric. It is not top of the line, but it is pretty decent.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This has been the perfect bag for me for my research. It keeps all of my items handy, has shoulder strap or handles, and is tough and high quality.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This bag is just what I have been looking for. It really helps me to keep all of my research materials in one place and even has room for my laptop or tablet if I want to add it to bring with me outside the home.

title: GREAT SOUND!  Nice Bass Balance Too
text:
I try to keep a variety of blue tooth speakers around the house so that any of us can listen to whatever we want as we do things in different areas. Sometimes pod casts are easier if I can move from one room to another, pause the pod cast and then start it up again when relocated in the house.

CHARGING
This speaker has a TYPE C port. I used the same port I use to charge my Samsung TAB S6 and it worked fine.

BLUE TOOTH CONNECTION
This speaker was very fast to hook up with my devices. I had no issues at all with any of my devices.

SOUND
The sound was AMAZING. I had on a recording of someone that used the same recording of the war drumming that I have heard before. When I turned on this speaker to redirect the signal, I almost flew out of my chair. It was really good sound. The sound was divided out nicely too. It was clear and balanced well, depending on the recording of course.

NOISE?
I didn't hear any hissing or other annoying noise with the things I have listened too. It depends on the recording too, of course.

MODES
This goes from Blue Tooth to microSD card to aux-in mode. The first two worked great, but I could not test the Aux, because I dropped my MP3 player and now it wont work - at all.

SONGS/VOLUME
Once in a while I go to increase or decrease volume and end up changing the song, so it is not always fool proof, but most of the time it works well.

LIGHTS
You do not have to run the lights on this. If you choose to, you can have them change in different patterns from very gradual to fast.

TWS SYSTEM
I did not try to set up the TWS system yet because I am not sure what other speaker I have will work with this. For now, I am not able to do it. If that changes, I will try to update.

PHONE
I have only used this once with the phone feature. It seemed to work fine unless walking too far away from the speaker then the person calling could not hear as well.

BATTERY LIFE
I have gotten a lot of use out of this and have not had to recharge the battery yet. There are not any indicators on this which show how much life is left though, and that is one thing I wish it had. I have another speaker with that feature and I prefer that.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This speaker is a great little speaker. It has fantastic sound, good features, and connections worked well.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This speaker is one of my current favorites. It is not tiny, so you have to carry it carefully, but it is really packed with sound and does it well.

title: Depends On Your Intended Use- Ours Was To Replace OLD DVD Player
text:
We have an old DVD player in our basement that tries to up convert but it is not always that great. It has some nice features that were great when we got it, but we wanted another one to replace it that did not take up so much room.

WHAT THIS WAS USED TO REPLACE
The DVD machine this replaced was a really old Philips. It played all regions. No fancy settings, except a sleep timer setting that shut it off after so long. The menu was ancient and very clumsy to navigate.

DID THIS PLAY AS WELL AS THE OLDER ONE?
This DVD player played DVDs as well as the older one. So far we have not had any issues with it. It was only hooked up to the HDMI and the used a mini USB to USB cord the plugged into the outlet. We made sure that it was powerful enough to run the player.

PICTURE
The picture was comparable to the old DVD player- perhaps a bit nicer in some cases. I am actually surprised that it has performed as well as it has.

TRAVEL
I have to say that traveling to a cabin we go to occasionally was nice. We are able to bring this DVD player with us to plug into any TV and watch some DVDs if we want to. It is without TV service so DVD is the only way to really have entertainment if we want it.

DOES IT PLAY BLURAY?
This is not designed to play BluRay.

ANY ISSUES?
This is not a top of the line DVD player with super high definition. If you are looking for that, this isn't it. Is it good DVD quality? Yes. I think so. If you have the right set up, it is a great way to take up little room and still be able to play DVDs. I am not sure I would have this as my permanent player in my bedroom or anything. But it is great to use once in a while at home or travel.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Although this is not fancy or super high quality, it plays DVDs as well or better than our old player so we are happy with it. The footprint is small and it is portable.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. This is a decent player and so far has been good in a pinch to use for playing DVDs. I like the small footprint and portability especially when we have to go somewhere for a while. It is nice to be able to tuck it into our luggage/bags to take with us. The remote is a bonus.

title: Great Unless You Are Dealing With Larger Plugs, Then Have To Skip Oulets
text:
I got this to put under my fish tanks. Having it waterproof/resistant is a huge plus after having issues in the past.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes in a simple cardboard box. Be aware of that if it is raining when they deliver because my box was sopping wet. Thankfully this is waterproof/water resistant.

DOES IT WORK?
This outlet works fine. The light has to be switched on, of course, and it lights up making it easier to see under the storage area where it is darker.

ANY PROBLEMS?
The only problem I have is that if I have to deal with a larger plug, I might have to not use a few other outlets to make them fit.

HANGS UP?
You can also hang this up which I plan to do in the future, making it harder yet for water to migrate into it.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a nice basic waterproof/resistant outlet strip. I am not sure I would use it outside just yet, but near my fish tanks it has been great.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. If they allowed a bit more space between outlets it would be better.

title: Excellent Sound, Frustrating At Times For Certain Devices
text:
Some of my devices lack really nice speakers, so I like to have a speaker handy so that I can listen to music or presentations as I go about my day. Let's take a look at this one.

HOW THIS COMES
This speaker comes in a foam liner inside a sturdy gift appropriate box. It has an audio 3.5 cord as well as a Type C charging cord with USB at the other end. It has a carry handle on it too. There is a basic instruction manual in a variety of languages.

BLUETOOTH
The connections are usually pretty stable, but once in a while depending on the device, we have to remove the speaker and reboot the device and speaker to get it to line up again even if it has already been connected previously with no issues.

SOUND
The sound of this speaker is surprisingly fantastic. It depends on the source recording, of course, but in most cases, I have to say that the sound of this little guy is really great. The top however, does move in and out so you can not block it or put anything on top of it or it can break the speaker.

MICRO SD CARD SLOT
I have to be honest here. I can not get the Micro SD slot to work correctly. I have tried many times to get it to play, but it won't. The directions say that you can hit the mode button and it will get to the micro SD card mode but it just sits and goes back to blutooth mode again. I am not sure why this is happening. The same card plays on other devices just fine so I know it is not the card.

AUDIO
I have also not been able to get my audio cord to work but I think that is because my old MP3 player I was testing it with was not working correctly and that is the only device I would use with that feature of this speaker.

CALLS
I don't use this with my phone so I don't answer calls with it.

CHARGE
A charge generally lasts me about 10 hours or so, depending on usage periods and how spread out they are. It takes between 1 and 2 hours to recharge.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a great small speaker. It is waterproof (I did not test that aspect at this point) and sounds great. The MicroSD slot has not worked for me yet, but otherwise it is a good speaker.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. I like this but wish that the other features worked a bit more easily. I will update if I find solutions to the issues I have been having.

title: Short on Space- This Works Great For CHARGING- Not Data
text:
I got this for charging a phone or device next to my laptop when I am working when not home.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes in a box which is housed in a plastic tray.

HOW THIS WORKS
This works great. C to C plugs in tight, and it charges fast.

ANY PROBLEMS?

For fast charging from a device or C outlet on a power pack or wall outlet. this short cord will do the trick

title: Fantastic Keyboard- If Only It Had Integrated Mouse Pad, It Would Be PERFECT.  I am SERIOUS
text:
I have been using an ergonomic keyboard since Windows first came out. That is a long time now. The keyboard that I love is the PC Concepts because it has a mousepad incorporated into it which makes it much faster to use. I was disappointed that this keyboard does not have one of those, but let's take a look at the keyboard itself.

HOW THIS COMES
This comes in a box which has a bag that this is wrapped in. That is important in case your package is left out in the rain at least it is a bit protected before you open it. It comes ready to plug in and has a very simple instruction paper with it.

HOW HARD IS THIS TO GET USED TO?
I purposely did not use this until I was ready to do this review. I wanted to be sure and get a true feel for how quickly I could adjust to this new keyboard. I must say I am really amazed. This is a fast keyboard and I am typing as fast as I do with the other one that I have used so long that the keys are worn off. The split space bar is fabulous. I do not have one of those with my other one.

KEY RESPONSE
The key response is excellent. This has a quite clicking but it does have excellent spring to it. It is very easy to type on so far. The only issue I have is that I am used to having to reach over with my right thumb to access the spacebar on the other keyboard, but this one is split so it takes a while to get used to not reaching.

CUSHION
The wrist cushion is also excellent. It is very comfortable and I actually benefit from it. Most of them are off on me and I don't like them. This one is the exception. It is fantastic.

LEGS
The legs on this only apply to the back. There are no elevations on the front. With this keyboard, I prefer to have it flat with no elevation. If the back is elevated it bothers my wrists.

ANY PROBLEMS?
Honestly, if this keyboard had a mousepad integrated with it, it would be the most perfect ergonomic keyboard I have ever used. They could easily put one under the right hand side in where the wrist pad is.

THE BOTTOM LINE
I love this keyboard. If it had a mouse pad in it, I would shriek with joy over it. I have been looking for a long time for a keyboard like this with a mouse pad in it. But for now, I can tolerate this one for typing. It is that good.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS despite the missing mouse pad that I would prefer to see in this. It did not advertise having one, so it is just a preference I have and not a disappointing surprise. I knew that this didn't have one. I sure hope the company is willing to consider one with a mouse pad in it. It really does speed up productivity a lot.

title: Perfect For My Work Chromebook Micro SD With No Adapter!
text:
I am working on a website which requires my partner and I to work on taking photos and posting them of our work. This requires a variety of different media access to upload our photos to our chromebook to post them online. I got this to help.

PROBLEMS?

This is perfect for me. I love having the SD and Micro SD card slots handy. It is small, fits in my work bag with my chromebook and works very well.
