title: My Purpose Was Makeup Classes In Person, Drawbacks For Other Uses
text:
I originally wanted this mirror as an inexpensive way to hold makeup classes. I was planning to do in person training as a makeup artist. Having mirrors with lights on them for proper lighting enables me to go wherever I need to go and I don't have to worry about proper lighting as I am bringing it with me. I also wanted to have a mirror with lighting for clients on location if necessary in places without adequate lighting. Let's take a look.

HOW THIS COMES
This light comes folded up in a really ingenious package. It is in a box with the cord attached. There is a clip and a phone holder also that comes with this. Lastly there is a very scant instruction paper.

LIGHT
The light is perfect. It allows me to test out makeup in various lighting to demonstrate how makeup changes based upon where you plan to spend your time that day. The different temperatures and different levels work out quite well for doing a variety of makeup.

MIRROR
The mirror is small, but adequate for doing makeup when teaching tricks and techniques in person. There is a peel off clear protector that will make the mirror look odd so check to see if you forgot that if you think it looks off.

BASE
The base of this is not my favorite. I LOVE that it has places to put my tools and makeup for teaching. This allows me to put what I need for the client in the bins for simple applications so they are not distracted. What I don't like about it is that this mirror is top heavy when fully extended. The base should be a bit heavier and wider.

STEM
This stem extends to a little over two feet. There are 3 stages of extension. The first and second levels are balanced, but the third makes the mirror tip easily. The bottom has to be weighted if you want to use the third level.

PHONE HOLDER
I tried to use this for tutorials and I didn't like the angles. It just did not do what I needed it to do. I was too frustrated with the top heavy tendencies of the full extension and then the lower extension made it harder to record. I prefer other set ups for recording.

AS A MAKEUP MIRROR
This works well as a simple makeup mirror. I also suggest it as a travel makeup mirror, especially if you are an entertainer or need to do makeup on the go. The choices of lighting and the small footprint for packing make it handy to bring with you without taking up too much room.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This mirror is fine for doing in person makeup or personal makeup as I originally got it for. For doing tutorials and recording, I am not fond of the angles, the holder, the top heavy tendencies of the mirror and the lower settings for accuracy in tutorials.

MY RATING
THREE STARS for this over all. I like it for personal and in person making training, but for filming which is what most will want this for, I am not fond of it. The lighting is great, just the design is a bit lacking. For the price, however, it is a decent beginners mirror and light set up.

title: ABSOLUTELY PERFECT.  Just What I Was Looking For
text:
I have a Chromebook that I use for business. That means that I have a few small spiral notebooks I need to keep with it and some paperwork. The problem is that I store it in a small area. When I saw this, I was hoping for the best. I got it!

FABRIC
The fabric on this bag is fantastic. It is very heavy duty and repels water too. the gray color makes it much easier to find than black.

INSIDE
The inside has two padded sections- one for the Chromebook and one for the pad. Both fit perfectly. These pockets have a tab that closes on them to hold the pieces in place. They are well padded too. My Chromebook is a 14 inch one and it fits perfectly.

OTHER STORAGE
In between the two side areas of the inside which holds the tablet and the Chromebook, there is a storage area that I can put my spiral notebook and papers on.

FRONT POCKET
The front pocket has pleats in it so it will hold cords, etc. It also has two small compartments that will hold a cell phone and pens, pencils, etc.

FOOTPRINT
What I love about this is that it is slim in profile. I can fit what I need in it, but it will slide onto a bookshelf, or in a slim spot that I need to put it into. This is perfect for me. My other bag was too bulky.

SHOULDER STRAP
The shoulder strap is nicely padded and adjustable.

HANDLES
The handles are covered in faux leather and are easy to grip and comfortable too. The bright tan color is a plus- it helps me find the bag when I need it quickly in a pile of things!

PHOTOS
I have included three photos for you- the front view, inside center, and front pocket in that order from left to right.

title: FANTASTIC For Sewing Machines And Electronics Equipment
text:
I do a lot of work on sewing machines and electronics that need to be sprayed with air often. I was having a hard time with canned air working right or stopping working before it was gone. Then I saw this. I am never going back!

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This is a combo vacuum/blower. It has a clear blue top on it for catching dust and dirt, and then it is removable so that you can blow air on things with a simple switch on the side. There is a small hose extension for focused air flow.

CORD
This charges with a USB /micro USB cord.

VACUUM BRUSHES
This comes with two brushes. One fits on the extension bar and the other fits in the top of the clear blue catcher container.

HOW DOES THIS PERFORM?
VACUUM
Honestly it is okay as a vacuum, but I have other vacuums that are cordless that I prefer. The only thing that this excels at for me is keyboard and other very fine cleaning. I don't find the suction as great as I would like and the blowing air from the vents is so heavy it blows things around as I move with the vacuum.

AIR BLOWING
For blowing, that is another story. This little gem is fabulous. I take the blue top off and put the switch at the blowing and it empties out my sewing machine bobbin area beautifully. It also blows out keyboard and other areas of the laptop that need cleaning.

CHARGES
I have used this since I got it for several weeks and it has not needed to be charged again. I only use it as needed, so it is probably going to stay charged for a while. It only took a little over and hour to charge when I got it.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Nice to have as a little vacuum, this excels at blowing air. It is rechargeable so no need to buy any more cans of air that don't work or end up breaking. This is something I have wanted for a long time. I am thrilled to have it.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is fantastic. I absolutely love it. My husband is going to get one for his business too. He ain't touchin' mine! (grins)

title: PERFECT LYRE Case -  Very Difficult To Find Perfect Case For Lyre Before This

title: Not Sure It Really Helps All That Much, But It Works
text:
We had a Channel Master Amp installed with our antenna set up. The rotor broke and then the antenna would not bring in anything at all. When we tried to figure out why it just seemed like the amp died too.

HOW IS THIS TO PUT IN?
The instructions are pretty straight forward. This needs to be as close to the antenna as possible and then the plug goes into the house protected. It was not hard to do on a nice day.

WHAT THE PROBLEM WAS
There was a cord and a jack that was broken which my husband had to fix before hooking this up.

HOW DID IT WORK THEN?
This works well (about like before it stopped working). It does bring in stations, but not any more than before. We live on a location that pulls in stations from all over the place usually.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This works. It is not earth shattering, but it brings us to the same place our other Channel Master was, so that is good. It is not hard to install and the directions are easy to follow.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. I was hoping for a little more improvement due to our location which is very high up. It is really not any different than the other amp we had which is 10 years old now. In fact, the other amp might have been a little better.

Some day when we can find a decent new rotor, maybe I can get a better idea. Right now, it only pulls in a few stations (we used to get about 70 of them before the rotor went)

title: Nice Ring, Decent Lighting For Various Style Photos
text:
WARNING- SOMEWHAT IN DEPTH REVIEW- If you prefer a short summary, see section marked THE BOTTOM LINE
------------------------------
I have been working with photos for a business situation, so I have managed to acquire some equipment for different uses for products. When I saw this, my partner wanted to put this to good use, so we decided to try it out. This review will be somewhat in depth.

RING SIZE
The ring itself is large sized which makes it nice for doing personal videos like makeup, and even just discussions and research, but it also is nice for doing larger product photos.

RING ROCKER SWITCH
The controls are a bit finicky. The on off rocker switch is kind of temperamental which is why it took me so long to get this review out. When turning on the rocker switch, the light sometimes will turn on and then off quickly. It takes a few times to get it to stay on which is frustrating.

PLUG
The plug insert is just under the switch. It goes in pretty solid.

CORD
The cord is about 10 ft long- I measured it. The plug is 2 prong. It has a pretty good fit into an outlet and is not loose.

DIALS
The two dials determine the brightness of the light and also the temperature. They are infinite settings so you can fine tune them pretty well.

LIGHT QUALITY
The light quality of this ring is solid. It does provide a lot of light and it does help to get a nice atmosphere for photos or video. The brightness can go pretty high and you can get it lower but one problem is that it will flicker as you get it on the lower settings.

CAMERA
The other issue I have with this is the camera. There is a screw that you can supposedly put a camera on, but that will not allow me to screw on the camera tightly so that it faces the same direction as the light. Then there is the issue of the camera holder. So, when I screw the camera onto that- it is a ball joint holder- I can screw it into the ring, but for some reason, once the attachment is in place, the ball won't tighten completely and the camera has some play in it.

I can tighten it and it stays put off the tripod,, but when the weight of the camera is on the ball joint, it does not like to lock tight for some reason.

WHAT TYPE OF CAMERA DO I HAVE?
I have a Canon G12 camera which is not that heavy or large, so this issue is not due to me trying to use a camera that is way too big.

PHONE
There is a phone holder so you can use your phone on this ring as well.

TRIPOD
The quality of the tripod seems solid. It can be set up to compensate for uneven ground and does seem to perform reasonably well when I have used it. I think it is fair to say that I do most of my photos indoors on even floors, so I have not put it to tough testing in that department. I love how it folds away to fit in the case.

CAN YOU USE THIS RING WITH OTHER TRIPODS?
I was able to screw this into a taller tripod that I have to use it if I wanted to, which I don't.

CASE
The case is part of the charm of this light. It is padded and fits the ring nicely. The tripod folds up perfectly compact into the back holder and pocket, and the front pocket with a zipper holds the attachments. It is fabulously designed.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This light ring is nice. It has great light, nice temperature settings, and is easy to use once you get it set up. Problems with attaching the camera and getting it stable, and occasional blinking of the light make this four instead of five stars, but I still work with it until I can figure out a solution.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. I like this set. It is perfect for taking on location filming or shooting photos, and it works well when I work past the frustrations.

MY PHOTOS
I took 3 photos for you of the exact same thing at the same time so you can see the difference in lighting and color perception. They are labeled for ease of understanding which is which.

title: Fantastic Shelves For Putting Essential Oil Cases On, Other Shelf For Lamp/Magazines
text:
I have some heavy wooden cases for my essential oils. I needed to put them on top of a bookcase, but I still needed storage for other smaller items as well. These shelves fit the bill!

ARE THEY EASY TO PUT TOGETHER?
These are very quick and easy to put together. You just screw on the 4 legs, then raise them to the right level and the shelf is good to go.

ARE THEY STURDY?
I have a heavy essential oil case on top of one of the shelves. It stays well and is sturdy on the highest setting. I also was able to put small bottles of paint and alcohol ink under the shelf so I could have more storage space. That works great. They shelf stays sturdy and only wobbles a tiny bit, but does not move enough to be worried at all.

GRIPS
The rubber grips keep the legs from sliding around, especially if you have a printer on top which will vibrate
some.

OTHER SHELF
I am going to use the other shelf to put on a lower end table next to my couch. The underneath will allow for magazines and the top will allow for a lamp and other knick knacks on the table.

THE BOTTOM LINE
These shelves are great. They serve a more unusual function for me, but I am happy to have them.

title: Have To Work With It, But It Works For Jewelry
text:
We have a few photo boxes in our house. I got this one so that we could set up a small one just for earrings or small jewelry. My partner had to take a year or so off, so I have had to struggle with working with this by myself.

CONSTRUCTION
This goes up quickly, but to be honest with you, I need to support the edges with some clear tape sometimes. They don't always want to stay put even if I have to move it here or there.

LIGHTING
The light works, thankfully. I am thankful also that I have a USB port in my outlet board too. The lighting looks really bright at first, but when you photograph it, it can look a bit muted. I had to do some photo editing to get decent photos.

EASE OF USE
This is not too hard to use, but it does take some work to set it up and make it stay put for jewelry. A little tape helps, and also working with the backgrounds. They don't always look smooth, so I make my own too. The jewelry I am photographing works pretty well, but higher displays will put this near the logo on the back wall. That is fine unless there is daylight hitting the box from behind, then it can show through.

QUALITY OF PHOTOS
The photos I take with this seem a bit muted, but with some photo editing, they are acceptable. I am still not at the point where I have the right combo of settings for me that I am happy with. However, I can use this and get decent photos until I find the combination of lighting and background that works well for me as a formula.

CASE
The case is nice to carry this set around and keep it in one place. It is simple, not padded, just a drawstring, but it works.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a decent little photo box. It allows me to take photos of jewelry which I want to sell, and it also provides decent light so far. I am not fond of the USB plug (without outlet) but I made it work.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS for this. It is a decent little box and I like it. I just have not found the right combination of settings that thrill me yet.

PHOTOS
I have included three photos - 1 at each lighting temperature. They are marked so you can clearly see how the color is affected by the lighting.

title: It WORKS Even Comes With A Battery To Put In It! (Plus Simple Warning)
text:
I have a few wonky remotes. They suddenly stop working and then make me think they need new batteries. I replace the batteries but in a day or two they are acting up again. Then I get confused as to what batteries are weak and which are okay. This solves the problem!

HOW DOES THIS WORK?
This battery reader has to have a battery in it to work. You put a battery in it (spaces are marked) and then it will register how strong the battery is.

PERFORMANCE?
This thing is great. I have tried it on batteries with surface gauges on the side so I am able to see if they are accurate. This shows me that they are. So far, I have found many batteries I would have thrown away were perfectly good. It was the remote that was not working right.

SIZE
This is small and pretty easy to store.

SUGGESTION
I highly suggest if you are not going to use this constantly that you store it with the battery in a separate plastic bag. That way if it bursts, your reader is protected.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This has made my life a lot easier. I can test button AND tube batteries to see if they are charged up and I am saving a lot of wasted batteries.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I like this and am glad to have it. I especially love the ability to check BUTTON batteries.

title: If This Came With A Sleep Timer Button, I Would Like It Better
text:
We can not find the remote for our Roku or downstairs TV which is a Samsung since we had to remodel over a long period of time due to a flood which started it all. I thought this would be perfect.

BUTTONS
The layout and buttons of this remote are pretty small. They are not difficult to use, however. The explanation in the instructions is pretty good.

USING WITH SAMSUNG AND ROKU
I have an older Samsung TV and a Roku Premiere hooked up to it. At first this worked fine with the TV, but the Roku it just would not work. Finally, I hit the SET UP button and held it until it blinked. I used the S button (next to the TV button) and suddenly instead of having to program the Roku, it just started to work. I did not have to enter roku codes at all.

DOES IT WORK WITH BOTH WELL?
Both of those things work well. I might try to set up DVD later, but for now, all I really wanted was to have the Roku and TV to work. I have a separate satellite remote that I use for DISH so I am not that interested in using this for that as it is upstairs. I would love a Sleep button like my other Samsung remote has, but really that is not a big deal for this particular TV.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For me, once I put in the two AAA batteries, this remote took almost no time to set up for my older Samsung TV and Roku Premiere.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I wish this had a sleep setting to it, but that is minor. It does what I want it to and runs both Roku and Samsung TV nicely.

title: Great For CD/DVD Drive For Laptops New With Type C Or Older Ones Without
text:
Laptops don't come with drives in them anymore, so if I want to play a DVD or CD or move files back and forth between, it is nice to have this drive.

SLIM?
This is a nice slim drive. It fits well in my laptop bag.

DOES IT WORK ON BOTH TYPES OF USB PORT?
This will fit a Type C port which is why I bought it, but it also will fit older USB ports all without an adapter which I am very thankful for.

DRAWER
This one has a pop out drawer instead of the auto drive which grabs the disc and pulls it in.

DOES IT WORK WITHOUT DRIVERS?
This has no problem with Win10 which is what I got it for. I have not had the chance to try it with older OS yet.

PERFORMANCE?
This performs well without lag and for uploading files off of the CDRoms or to play DVDs when I want to do art classes with my larger screen on the laptop which is why I wanted this.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a nice basic DVD/CDROM drive which will fit Type C or previous USB versions without having to have an additional adapter. It plays as it should and is a solid performer.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. No problems yet. I have not had the need to write files on blank discs as I ran out, but I will update in the future if there is any problem or anything you need to know.

title: Works Great With My 4K TV To Replace Older Cables
text:
I had to get some HDMI cables for two reasons. I wanted to operate a laptop on my older TV in another room on occasion, and I also needed to replace older HDMI cable on my 4K TV.

WHAT QUALITY ARE THESE?
These seem to be great quality. The connection is solid, and the cord is well made and flexible.

DO THEY WORK WELL?
The signals have been good to this point. I have had no issues and performance has been solid so far.

DOES THIS WORK FOR LAPTOP?
Because of the long cord, I wanted this so that my laptop could sit on the bed while playing it on the TV so we could watch a few videos together. So far the length is good and no problems.

THE BOTTOM LINE
A great set of two cords, this has been helpful to update my HDMI cord set up in my house. Performance is solid, and I am glad to have these.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. No problems at this point. I will update if anything changes that I need to add.

title: Just Like The Picture, Great Case- I mis-Measured But Will Use Any6way
text:
I got this for my small Chromebook, but I did not measure correctly. It was just a bit too small. Still, it is a GREAT case.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
PADDING
The padding is very thick and durable. It is nicely done.

LINING
The lining is a soft fleece fabric. It is excellent for protecting against scratches.

OUTSIDE POCKET
This is a curved pocket well blended so it does not stand out, and it zips shut. Perfect for small cords, ear buds, or other accessories. A phone will fit too.

HANDLES
The carry handles are really nice and sturdy, and the shoulder strap is also well made and works great with padding on the shoulder area.

DESIGN
The design is really gorgeous. I love it. It is just like the photo that comes with the listing shows it to be.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Although this is too small for my Chromebook by an inch, I will still use this carrier for my smaller tablet. It is well made, very protective, soft, and well designed.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is a winner. I only wish it was an inch bigger. Also makes a good project bag for knitting or crocheting or needlework, or other things that need moderate protection.

title: VERY Handy- Fits In My Hand, Yet Protects Cards Well
text:
I have a problem. I have a big collection of SD cards. They are in boxes, on shelves, and quite frankly I don't know where some of them are. I have been wanting a place to keep them handy and labeled so I know what is on them. This is PERFECT.

CASE
The case size is perfect. It is about 4 1/2 by 4 1/4 inches in size. There is a nice zipper on it and the construction is very well done.

PAGES
There is a front and back page with sleeves of 1 1/2 by 1 3/4 inches. There are a total of 8 of those. The other six pages have six sleeves which are 1 1/8 by 1 3/8 inches in size. The cards fit on horizontally so as you thumb through the pages, the will be sideways instead of up and down.

DO THEY STAY IN PLACE?
I am very cautious and careful when I use cases like this, an so far the cards stay in the sleeves. I can see over time where some might loosen up a bit, so it is wise to be careful when using this. So far, they are staying in place well.

LABELS
There are 32 labels that came with mine- you can stick them on the outside sleeve to show where to put the cards.

CLOTH
There is also a cleaning cloth that comes with this.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a great way to keep track of my SD cards. I love that they are in 1 place and that they are protected from damage.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I would buy this again so far. It has been a great help for me.

title: One of My Daughter's Favorite Tools
text:
I have used a graphics pen and pad for a long time now, and my daughter wanted one. She has had this for quite a while and I finally got it back long enough to review it for her.

HOW EASY TO SET UP?
This was very easy to set up. She used it on a Windows 8 laptop. The pen set up well and the software worked very well for her.

WHAT DID SHE USE IT FOR?
She used this for CorelDraw, and Painter 7 Essentials software.

DID IT WORK FOR HER?
This pen tablet worked very well for her in both of these applications as well as DRAW too.

PERFORMANCE
As a whole she is very pleased with the performance of this pen and tablet. IT comes with the extra tips and remover tool as well as settings you can mess with and she loves all of them. The pressure points were just enough for her needs and they worked well with the programs she wanted to use them for.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This pen and tablet went through hard use for quite a few months. They worked with with graphics software and Windows 8 laptop computer.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. My daughter raves about this a lot. She is a very artistic person who has used this for a lot of things and has done a tremendous amount of graphics work on her system with it. She says she highly recommends it especially for beginners who want performance but not huge price tag.

title: FINALLY!  A Faraday Bag The WORKS!
text:
I have been wanting a Faraday bag for a while, but every time I try one out, it does not work- I still get calls or texts. Let's take a look at this one.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This has an accurate photo with the listing. It zips across the top, has a lightweight nylon divider if you wanted to put two tablets in it, or even a couple of phones, and then it folds over with a tight velcro grip.

HOW DID IT TEST?
We used this while traveling and tried to put all sorts of texts and calls into phones while in the bags and every time they did not ring or receive anything at all until they were taken out.

IS IT STICKY?
This is not sticky, but it does have a slightly tacky feel from the fireproofing.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a great Faraday bag that is also fireproof (we did not test that for obvious reasons) this is a good choice. It kept a tablet and two smart phones inside without a problem. Calls were blocked and it held while the entire time they were inside, no matter how close the phone was to them that sent to the ones in the bag.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I like this and will use it. I recommend.

title: Great And Not So Great At The Same Time
text:
I have waited a while to review this because I got it for my daughter who was very interested to have it, but after a while, she lost interest so it was back to me. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This comes in a box with a cord for recharging. It has a type C connector. There are also earbuds in the box. Insturctions? Well, not so much.

TOUCHSCREEN
That is kind of deceptive. This has a touch screen on bottom, but the top is not - where you see the photo of the album playing, the play button or other information.

MUSIC QUALITY
The music quality of this is fabulous. It is better using bluetooth headphones than the speaker or the cheap buds that come with this.

EAR BUD JACK
The problem with this player is that the jack is very touchy. If you move just right it will disconnect either ear and that is totally annoying when using this.

MUSIC SEQUENCE
That is another odd feature of this player. This will play in order when I have albums in it and so far they play in alphabetical order which is rather strange. I can not get it to play any other way than this way, so if you are using this and want to hear what YOU want to hear in a certain order, plan to play around with this a lot.

RECORDING BUTTON
This has some storage on it, so you can record with the little red recording button. That can come in handy if you need it, but I don't use it much. It works.

SPEAKER
This has its own little speaker on it which is handy for using the auto alarm function if you are camping or something and don't want to use your phone for that.

AUTO ALARM FUNCTION
This will wake you up if you want it to.

FM RADIO
This works pretty good, but again, the jack is toast, which is part of the antenna grounding the signal, so in my case, it is good but not WOW.

INSTRUCTIONS
This really is frustrating. This should have extensive instructions in it. This thing is really frustrating despite it being almost user friendly in some ways. In others it is downright frustrating.

BATTERY LIFE
The battery life on this is great. If not in use for a long period, it will keep the charge nicely, a feature I appreciate.

TOUCHY TOUCH SCREEN
This bottom half with the touch screen is very touchy. If I have it in my pocket and it hits my body just right, it will change to another song. Sometimes it will go to another direction if I put my hand in my pocket which is frustrating. That part is also difficult.

BLUETOOTH
This is a great feature. I had no problems hooking this up to my bluetooth headphones at all. It was easy and stayed connected, but I am at home when I use this and not around other wireless items, so I am not sure how well this would work when around other devices.

WHO MIGHT LIKE THIS?
If you are in need of some music and don't want your phone handy and feel like it does not matter what songs you hear in what order, then this might be a good mindless device for running, or working around cleaning, etc. It also might be nice for a young person who is not supposed to be using their phone and you want to give them something else to play music with.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For the price, the music quality is fantastic, the bluetooth connection is also very easy and one of the best I have used. As for other things like the music order, lack of instructions, and super touchy controls, this takes the fun out of using it.

MY RATING
I am between 3 and 4 stars for this. I am going with FOUR STARS. It is BARELY four stars though. The bluetooth and music quality are excellent. The screen is also decent too. The price is right. However, the other frustrations and lack of instructions frustrate me a bit. I am sure there are ways to put the music on there, but I just don't have the time to mess with it. Kids would probably have a lot of fun messing with this and making it do all sorts of amazing things.

For me, it is good when I need a quick set of music to drag along with me (I refuse to wear my phone out by overuse for music), so I put up with it.

title: Looks And Works Just Like Original Catridges Of Labels That Came With It
text:
I have a Brother PT-M(% label maker. I don't tend to use it that often, well to be honest because I also have an Epson label maker that is COMPLETELY AWESOME so I tend to reach for that more often. However, when I need simple labels to mark things, I get out my Brother. Let's see how these labels worked.

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
These cartridges of labels look just like the ones that came with My Brother label maker. They go in the same and they come in a woven cloth bag to keep them in until you need them, which I LOVE.

HOW DO THESE PERFORM?
I did a side by side test of these cartridges, and I could not tell the difference in printing quality and performance SHORT TERM. Now, over time, if anything changes, I hope to remember to update.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This pack of cartridges for the Brother PT-M95 look and perform just like the ones that came with the machine.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. These are handy to have around and I think I might reach for this more often now that I have plenty of labels to choose from. I really do like the cloth bag though. It is better than another box kicking around and I can tuck it in with the label maker.

title: PERFECT To Replace Horrid Belkin Outlet Extender
text:
I have had this awful Belkin extender which has driven me nuts for quite some time. It is long, has no back brace on it and it is hard to use as it is unstable. At the time I purchased it, it was the only one with USB outlets in it that I could get. Now, we have this. Let's take a look.

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
These are interesting outlets. They only take one plug up (bottom one) but they have a screw and a stablizing stem that goes into the round hole of the upper outlet.

SURGE PROTECTOR?
There is a little circle at the top of the box which is green to show that it is working. There are no instructions about this, however, so that is all I can tell you. If you are looking for high tech surge protection, you might not want to go with this one.

DOES IT COVER BOTH?
Yes, this does cover both outlets. For the most stable installation, I would recomment it.

ARE THE OUTLETS CLOSE TOGETHER?
If you have any plugs that are larger, you will probably only be able to use four of the six outlets. These are close together and if there is a large lip or transformer involved, well you are going to use up more than one outlet.

USB and TYPE C CONNECTIOINS
So far I have used all of the above outlets and they work quite well.

CAN YOU REALLY STAND A PHONE ON THERE?
We can stand a phone on the top of this to charge it, but honestly, it is close to a pathway in a small house so it is easy to knock off the stand. If this is higher on a wall, it would be better for that. It is doable, but in a high traffic area, with caution.

IS IT HARD TO INSTALL
The plate was removed from the outlet. The screw on the extender went in perfectly. It does turn a LOT so don't worry. It is a long screw. The other plastic prong goes into the upper outlet hole and that holds it in place very well. That was it. Only took a few moments.

THE BOTTOM LINE
I really like this extender. Our previous one was horrible. This is very streamlined, works well, and is thought out nicely. If you plan to use larger plugs, count on only four outlets instead of six.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I love this so far. I will update if I need to let you know of any changes. So far, I am thrilled to have this instead of that other awful extender.

title: Once Your Internet Is Stable, This Is Great- Let Me Explain
text:
WARNING- This is an in depth review to help readers make an informed buying decision. If you prefer a quick summary, see the section marked THE BOTTOM LINE
---------------------------------------------------------------------
When I got this, I was so excited to put it in. Right after I got it, our internet went NUTS and was hardly working. There is no point in extending a signal that is barely there. It has gone on back and forth for a while now, but finally we have had enough of a signal so I could try this out. Let's take a look..

WHAT IS OUR SITUATION?
We have a situation where we have a lower level of DSL service at our house. We have not only the modem from our provider, but we also have fed this through our Netgear router. I have a shed in the back of our property which is about 150 ft away or so from our router. I wanted to be able to do online classes in my project shed. That is why we got this unit.

WHAT KIND OF ROUTER DO WE HAVE?
We have a high powered gaming router Netgear R28. It has quite a few antenna and is pretty good at directing signals around to various devices.

WHERE IS THE LOCATION OF THE EXTENDER?
The extender is currently in the house but up against the closest corner of the house up against the outside wall to transmit the signal to the shed.

WHAT DO YOU NEED?
A screwdriver (Phillips)
Password to Router Security
Location of your IP address
A laptop or computer to access the WiFi controls and set it up
The devices you want to set up to interpret the signal of the extender
Password for your router to get in for your address for the extender once it is set up

WHAT DOES THIS COME WITH?
This comes with the brace to slide the unit on, a brace to hold it in place, a stand if you choose to use that instead, and screws for all of it- including the walls. There is a long plug which is close to six feet long. About a foot from the plug, there is a box that has holes in it so that you can screw that into place, holding the cord up out of the way. Then you can twist the rest of the cord (if it is too long) up out of the way keeping it safe.

WHAT COMPUTER DID I USE TO SET THIS UP?
I used a laptop running Windows 10. I also have set this up to work with Android- see farther below to find out how.

HOW EASY IS THIS TO SET UP?
I do not have an ORBI router, so I had to set it up for a generic router. The instructions are very clear and by pressing the sync button, holding it down, and then pressing power, releasing the power button, still holding sync, it leaves me with a blue signal. Then I let the button up.

The extender does some various things with the lights and syncs with the router.

Once the light is solid blue, then you have to get into your laptop or computer (not android netbook or tablet) and go to the wifi set up. Once you go to the devices available, when you see the extender, press on it and it is easy to follow the prompts from there.

DID IT WORK WITHOUT PROBLEMS?
If you compile the list of what I told you have handy when you start this, it will be a breeze if nothing goes wrong. Since I have the Netgear router, it synced quickly and without a problem.

WHAT TO DO WHEN IT IS SET UP- PRINT IT OUT
Once I set everything up, there is a list of how to set up each device to run with the extender. You will have to print out the paper that is being posted so you can figure out how to connect with your extender.

DOES IT WORK WITH ANDROID?
This has instructions for setting up Apple, Android, and Windows devices. Each one has to be set up individually.

To set it up with Android, you will need the address of the extender which you will have to go into your IP address and router settings, so be sure you have your password handy. Once in there, you have to find the devices (clue it has EXT at the end) and then you can enter the IP address into your android set up. The instructions are very well written out.

WAYS YOU CAN MOUNT IT UP
You can set this up a couple of ways...

WALL MOUNT
This will screw into the wall as it is with pretty long screws. Once you slide the unit down onto the hooks, you screw on a top brace to keep it in place.

STAND MOUNT
You can put this on a stand if you prefer, and again the method is similar to the wall mount, just on the stand instead.

IS THIS SET UP INSIDE OR OUTSIDE?
I am currently setting this up inside only because we have not worked out the right place on the outside of the house. It says it is weather resistant, but we prefer to have it in a protected area since we are on a hill where the weather can be rough. Once we find the outside spot that is best, we will be putting it there.

DOES THIS COME WITH THE SCREWS?
This comes with screws for the frame as well as to put it in the wall.

HOW DOES THIS PERFORM?
Once I set up the unit with the few devices I plan to use it with, I have had pretty good results. Usually the signal to my shed is so weak, I can not get much performance at all. With the extender in the house, it boosts it enough so I can get a signal to do some simple videos and websites which is what I wanted it for.

I expect it to have better results once we move it outside in its permanent location.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a great set. It is helping me to get a signal in a shed on my property which I wanted to access for classes and instruction. It works great from my house inside, but will work best when outside protected from the elements.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I was impressed with how easily this set up. It was very well laid out, instructions were well written, and performance has been good so far.

title: Daughter Feels Much Safer Now
text:
Our daughter works at night often and has been wanting to have some devices to help in case of a problem with unwanted approach of animals or people. This seemed like a perfect solution. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This is about the size of small cell phone. It is a bright pink color so easy to find. It comes with a holster

WHAT IS THE HOLSTER LIKE?
The holster clips onto pants waistband or belt with a heavy metal clip. It does not have a slot to feed it onto a belt, however. It is a black holster and has a velcro closure. The pink will still show when this is in the holster.

HOW DOES IT WORK?
There is an on/off button. This turned on still needs for you to press and hold a button to make it work. If you leave the button on, then there is a possibility of accidental noise if you hit the other button just right. If you leave it off, you will have to push the button to the on side then press the other button. Not hard to do, as the buttons are close together.

WHAT DOES IT SOUND LIKE?
This sounds like a VERY LOUD taser gun. It is NOT a taser, but it sounds like one. At the same time the sound goes off, a light flashes. It does hurt the ears, and it does scare off animals or people at first.

RECHARGABLE?
This took a couple of hours to charge and it was ready. Since our daughter has not used it regularly as she does not like to throw the general population into cardiac arrest, it is hard to tell how much use you get out of it prior to needing it recharged. I can say it has not needed to be recharged after several months of being charged but barely used.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a handy device for either animals while hiking, or if you happen to need to work at night and want some protection to scare off attackers. It is only noise, however, so you need to think fast in addition to using it.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. It is handy to have and seems to work well every time our daughter has had to use it which has only been a couple of times (wild dogs).

title: VERY Sturdy High Quality Performance
text:
I needed to have some C cords since some of our devices have now changed for our phones and other items. These cords seemed like a good choice. Let's take a look.

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
These cords all measure what they say they will measure. They are made from very sturdy cording with woven covering on it which is purple, making it easy to find quickly.

CONNECTORS
The connectors are reinforced with a flexible neck so that the cords do not easily pull out. They connect well and are bright purple, again, easy to see. I had no issues with loose connections.

CORD TIES
I LOVE that these come with their own velcro style cord ties. They really work well to keep the cords in a bundle until I am ready for them to be longer.

HIGH SPEED
I am using one of these cords with my Quick Charge phone charger for my car and it works great.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This package of cords was a great choice. I love the tough construction, bright color which is easy to see and identify and great performance, even with my rapid charger for my phone in the car.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I would buy these again. I really like them a lot. I love that they are easy to find in a hurry too.

title: FABULOUS Design Features-Kind Of Muffled- Not The Best.  The Oyes Are Better Quality
text:
Our family goes through headphones like no one's business. I got these for my daughter who is kind of rough on headphones. LEt's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
BUTTONS
The buttons on this are beautifully designed. They are on the actual outside of the headphone instead of the edge. They are easy to press and locate while they are on or off.

FOLDING
These will fold up for easier storage. Be aware that they click rather loudly. At first my daughter thought she broke them and was panicked, but we realized that is a feature of the heaphones.

SOUND
The sound is pretty muffled on these headphones. It is not as clear as the Oye model from Santana.

BATTERY LIFE
They are pretty good with the life. A charge will last about six hours or so before you have to charge again. If you use them on SD card they last the six to seven hours, but blue tooth gives shorter life of around five hours.

SD CARD
My daughter loves the SD card feature. She loves to use it to listen to music. She uses the card she used to us on her phone. It is 16 GB size. When you first power on, it will go to card mode if you have the card in it. If you want to listen via blue tooth, without taking the card out, you press the power button once, and it will go to blue tooth, but it will KEEP YOUR PLACE ON THE SD card- she loves that feature.

FUNCTION BUTTONS
All of the function buttons work well. Taking calls is not as good as with other devices, but it does work and it is sufficient for making a quick call.

BASS MIDS HIGHS and VOLUME
These are very loud headphones requiring a low volume on the phone to use. (Oye requires a halfway volume on phone, Zebop only requires 1/4 volume to play at the same level of volume)

COMFORT
These are a little heavier (as comapred to Oye), AT the top of the head where the cushion is, it has silicone on it, which can catch on your hair, but it does keep them in place. The ear cups will sweat which is not uncommon with headphones.

THE BOTTOM LINE
These are well designed headphones with great features. The comfort is good, but the sound is kind of mediocre.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. Great design, nice features, these are headphones our daughter uses a lot when she is doing things that she does not want to use more expensive headphones while doing. They have good performance but not great. These are a good mid-range set of headphones and have lasted much better than other brands which were similar price range and had similar performance.

title: PERFECT COMPANION For Traveling With Laptop
text:
One of the frustrations I have had is that the DVD/CDROM drives I have had all take a box to protect them and they are bulky too. They have to have cords, etc. This, however, is a whole new ball game. Let me tell you why.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This is a fabulous drive. It comes in a very heavily padded and protective zipper case. the drive itself is very slim and easy to carry. It has cords built into the back which tuck into place when you are done- no more struggling with long cords in my case.

HOW DOES IT WORK?
I piugged this in and BAM it was working. You put the disc in the drive and it works very quickly and well. I am not sure how well it would work for programs that need to access the disc constantly as it has no external power cord so all power has to come from the laptop/computer. I suppose having laptops plugged in would help, but not sure.

WHAT DOES IT WORK WITH AS FAR AS OPERATING SYSTEMS?
We tried it with Windows 10, 8 and 7 and it worked with all of them.

CASE ZIPPER
This case has a DOUBLE ZIPPER on it so it has two way zipping which I love.

OUTSIDE POCKET
The case even has an outside pocket on it which is perfect for thumb drives, SD cards, or the small USB C drives that are really tiny.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a fabulous set. It is easy to use, easy to take with you and VERY well protected. the drive worked well on several versions of Windows. It has no extra power supply, only runs off of USB. I used it on USB 3.0 without any issues.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I used this for installation, or making changes only. I did not do gaming off of the disc that depends on the disc to run. I am not sure how applications that need to use the drive a lot would fare since all power comes from the laptop/computer. I guess keeping the laptop plugged in would take care of that though.

title: Helps With The New Phones
text:
We recently got new phones which means that our old charging cords were not going to work anymore. Having this cord means I can use my charger in other areas.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This cord is pretty straightforward. It has a type C end and a USB A 2.0 end to it.

HOW DOES IT PERFORM?
I have an old charger for my car which has a USB 2.0 port to it. This works perfectly. It also allows me to tuck the phone away out of sight while charging, something our our area that is essential to do in the car.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This cord allows me to use my old USB adapters to charge my newer phones. It works well and is plenty long enough.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. It is important to check our charger adapter if you got new phones to be sure it can handle the new phone, but this cord helps if the charger is the right power.

title: Quite Surprising Sound For This Price Range Of Headphones With A Few Disappointments
text:
I was looking for some replacement headphones for two sets in my family when I had the opportunity to try out some of the new Carlos Santana line of headphones. Let's see what happened.

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
These headphones come in a great box which will appeal to fans of Carlose. It is well decorated and presentation is done so well, it would make a great gift. These are the black ones, and there is also another set available in white under a different listing.

ARE THESE REAL LEATHER?
According to the case,t these are leather padded ear cups and the lower half of the headband. I am still not sure about this. It is possibly bonded leather. Bonded leather is made from leather scraps chopped up and blended with binders. Sheets made of this mixture are printed with leather look imprinting. Technically it can be called leather, but it really is not leather as I define it..

EAR CUSHIONS AND HEADBAND
These black headphones are comfortable. I can wear these headphones longer than many others I have used. My daughter who ended up with these, uses them constantly and raves about them. These can be worn for several hours without a problem. She has sweaty ears and these are not nearly as frustrating for her as many others.

CORD FOR CORDED LISTENING
This comes with a cord which is only 38 inches long. That is a bit short for me. I find it is annoying and not quite as long as I would prefer, but my daughter does not use it so I guess it is not a problem for her or if you are like her, you won't mind either.

HOW DO THESE SOUND?
We are all surprised at how really good these sound. The bass is well defined and clear/strong, and the mids and highs are definitely clear and not muddy. The bass is not overwhelming either, which is a problem with some headphones.

HEADPHONE CONTROLS
The controls can be a bit difficult to read, but once you know where they are, you can figure it out pretty quickly. The +/- and play/pause buttons are separated by the noise cancellation button which is good.

HOW ARE THESE ADJUSTABLE?
These adapt to all sorts of comfortable positions.. They go longer, tilt in and out and rotate from side to side.

ARE THESE ABLE TO FOLD TO BE COMPACT?
These do fold flat and compact if you need to travel with them or store them in a smaller storage area.

CASE?
This did not come with a case.

SOUND CANCELLATION PERFORMANCE
The noise cancellation is awful. It hardly works. When noise cancellation is turned on, the sound gets pretty compromised. It becomes almost muffled in a way and the base definitely goes down.

OTHER FEATURES WITH THESE HEADPHONES
The ability to know how much power is left on the headphones while using the phone is nice, but it does not help if you are using these some other bluetooth device and not a phone. During phone calls, people hear just fine and we can hear them too (several of us tried this feature with our phones)

THE BOTTOM LINE
At this price point, these headphones are a step up from what I usually get when getting headphones for this price range. The sound is well defined and well balanced. Compactness for storage is great, and the comfort is also very good. The only disappointments are noise cancellation, short cord for corded listening, and buttons being a bit difficult to read.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. With better performance from noise cancellation, these would be really really good. As they are, they are still pretty great. They are a great gift to yourself or someone else and are some of the nicer headphones I have used in my journey through headphones of all sorts as well as those the family has obtained. They are not B&O or Turtle Beach, but they still are pretty good.

title: For The Price, These Are Great Quality With A Few Exceptions
text:
Two members of the family just told me that they had broken their headphones with this product came up to get. I decided it was worth a try, despite some previous experiences not being too great with cheaper headphones. Let's see what happened.

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
These headphones make some claims. They come in a great box who for Carlos fans will be a thrill. It is well decorated and presentation is fabulous. That means they would be a nice gift in that respect.

LEATHER?
The case says that these are leather padded ear cups and underneath headband. I am still not sure about this. Perhaps it is that bonded leather that is made from leather residue chopped up and blended with binders to remake it into sheets which are printed with leather look imprinting. Technically that can be called leather, but it really is not as much leather as I would like.

EAR CUPS AND HEADBAND
Having said that, these white headphones are comfortable. I can wear them longer than some others that I have had which are a bit rough after only an hour. These can be worn for several hours without a problem.

CORD
This comes with a cord which is only 38 inches long. That is a bit short for me. I find it is annoying and not quite as long as I would prefer.

SOUND
The sound of these is surprisingly great. The bass is really good, and the mids and highs are definitely clear and not muddy.

CONTROLS
The controls on the white pair are awful in that they are nearly impossible to read. The buttons are white and the markings are just very thin raised white on the buttons. It should really be colored with marker- which I took care of. Using a very fine permanent marker I colored just the raised areas. The up/down and play pause buttons are separated by the noise cancellation button which is good.

ADJUSTABILITY
These are very adjustable. They go longer, tilt in and out and rotate from side to side.

COMPACT?
These do fold flat and compact if you need to travel with them or store them in a smaller place.

SOUND CANCELLATION
THAT is where we part ways with these headphones. The noise cancellation is awful. It barely works. When it is turned on, the sound gets really compromised too. It becomes almost muffled in a way.

OTHER FEATURES
The ability to know how much power is left on the headphones while using the phone is nice, but it does not help if you are not using it with a phone and some other bluetooth device. Calling, people hear just fine and we can hear them too (several of us tried this feature with our phones)

THE BOTTOM LINE
For the price, these headphones are a step up from what I usually get when I try them. The sound is very good and well balanced, the folding up for storage is great, and the comfort is also on the upper level. The only disappointments are noise cancellation, short cord for corded listening, and the hard to read buttons.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. If the noise cancellation worked better, these would be over the top amazing. As they are, they are still pretty great. I love the white color- it stands out from the rest, despite getting dirty faster. They are a great gift to yourself or someone else and are some of the nicer headphones I have used.

title: Cord A Bit Stiff, But Works With My Newer Laptop And Older Devices
text:
I have a new laptop which has a couple of USB-C ports. The problem is that I need to have some more USB 3.1 ports for hard drives that I move around, thumb drives, and some other devices. This hub really brings some help in that area.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This device is a hub that sits on the table top (you will be hard pressed to balance on your lap). It has enough from for 3 USB devices, as well as another USB-C port so that you are not losing the USB-C port you use to hook it up to.

HOW DOES IT WORK?
The operation is simple. You plug this hub into the USB-C port and then add the other devices as you need them. The transfer rate is decent- not SUPER fast, but it is comparable to my older desktop so I am not that concerned with it anyway. The ports all seem to work well.

ANY PROBLEMS?
The cord that comes with this attached to the unit already is very stiff. It makes it so that the hub does not even want to sit flat on the table top which can be frustrating at times. Other than that, it works pretty well.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For expansion on a newer laptop that uses mostly USB-C ports but you want to use older USB type A 3;1 devices, this is a perfect solution. It enables me to use hard drives, flash drives, and even a DVD-CDROM player as well on it. Transfer rates are good and solid.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This does what i needed it to do and I am satisfied with it. I did wish the cord was a little less stiff, but at least it is not cracked or broken, so I can not complain.

title: FABULOUS Sound, Even Better After Break In Period- It ROCKS (But In A CLEAR BALANCED Way)
text:
Our family is a bunch of speaker and ear phone fanatics. Everyone has different likes and I tend to like a well balanced music. Muffled really bugs me.

I wanted to have a nice balanced speaker that no one will take so I decided to get this one for ME. It has a nice solid housing and I figured it was worth getting since my favorite speaker seems to get misplaced a lot. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This is a very solid speaker. It is heavy duty and it has metal housing. The sides are not as fragile as others I have used which sound this good. It comes in a beautiful gift box which has cushioning and the typical Santana design to it. The speaker itself is pretty heavy so it is not something you toss in your backpack and run off with. It needs a bit more care than that.

CHARGING
This has a USB charger that will take about 4 hours to charge it up with. There is also a connection where you can get a FAST charger from the company, but you have to contact them for it. The charging cable comes with it just need a USB outlet. The directions warn to only use the original cable that comes with this to charge or there might be damage to the speaker. The voltage must be 5V with current rated at 115A.

CAN THIS RUN WHILE CHARGING?
I do not see in the instructions warnings against this, and it does work while plugged in.

PLAY TIME
This speaker runs out of juice pretty quickly. If you want it to last the entire time of 10 hours, I highly suggest you not put the volume up past 30%. Any higher and the battery time runs down pretty quickly. At 60% you are at the edge of running this down pretty quickly- as in 4 or 5 hours play time only.

PAIRING
I have had no issues pairing this with tablets or phones using Android. Just like when you turn the power on, it says PAIRING in a very loud voice so you will know when it is in pairing mode.

VOLUME
The volume button on this is tricky. If you are not thinking and just quickly press the volume once, instead of it getting slightly louder, you will skip a track. You have to press the volume down and not let up if you want the sound to go up or down depending on the button you press meaning +/-.

CARD SLOT
This speaker can also work off of a TF card (also known as a microSD card). You just have to change from bluetooth mode to card mode using the MODE button.

IS THERE AUX CAPABILITY?
I have an old MP3 player that has higher quality recordings than anything new I have. That only uses AUX and it works great with this.

PAUSE / PLAY
You can pause or play music with this using the MFB button

HOW DOES THIS PERFORM?
Let me tell you, this thing ROCKS. I mean it. This speaker is fabulous. Not only does it work great out of the box (after being fully charged) but it sounds better and better as you break it in. It fills the house with music that is great quality and does not have interference or any lag issues either.

WHAT ABOUT BASS, MIDS AND HIGHS?
I have to say that this speaker is one of the few that I have used which does a beautiful job of intense bass, balanced clear highs but the mids are not muffled at all. It is impressive and what I thought a speaker always should be.

CAN YOU USE TWO TOGETHER?
This allows you to add one other speaker to the system so you can have them in two places. I do not have another Europa speaker at the moment I can test that with.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Although this blows any other wireless speaker I have had out of the water, it does blow through power rather quickly unless the volume is pretty low. It is not only amazing out of the box (After charging) but it gets better with more use. This baby ROCKS.

MY RATING
Finding a speaker which does not overwhelm you with out of whack bass, piercing highs, or muffled middles is not always easy. This speaker seems to divide it all out very well. It is one of the nicest speakers I have used (wireless) to date. FIVE STARS!

Not only do I love this, but would definitely consider a second one along with the fast charger in the future to round out the whole system.

ANOTHER THING
This product has a notification on it that some of the proceeds from this product will go to help underprivileged children through the MILAGRO foundation (miracle) that Carlos Santana and his family started in 1998.

title: I Am Very Surprised At the Clarity Of This Radio Just Not Fond of Battery Size
text:
When it comes to radios, so many of them just don't have the reception that they used to. I came across this one and decided it was worth the try. Unfortunately, the battery choice is annoying, but let's take a look at the radio..

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This is a pretty straightforward radio. It has AM and FM. Each band has a horizontal dial on it. The volume button is large and turns the radio on and off as well. You can adjust the tone from high to low which will either focus on voice or on base tones for what you are listening to.

HANDLE
The handle on this is sturdy and easy to carry.

ANTENNA
The antenna on this is sturdy and easy to pull out and push in.

JACK
There is a standard headphone jack.

HOW DOES THIS PERFORM?
This performs beautifully. The reception is exceptional and I can pull in stations that most other newer radios do not pull in any more. The sound is fabulous with a lot of depth to it.

BATTERIES
I really dislike that this takes 4 D batteries. Those batteries are expensive and tend to run out quickly. I don't normally carry them in the house for emergencies, but it would be worth having some since this radio is great and easy to hear.

WHO MIGHT LIKE THIS RADIO?
Anyone who loves to listen to AM still would love this radio. Many of them don't have it anymore which is frustrating. I also found that it is great for older people to have one of these. I know an older gentleman who has been bed ridden and home bound and he loves this radio. It is easy to operate, see, and great sound.

THE BOTTOM LINE
I like this radio. It is good to have on hand for emergencies or for good listening when internet is down or I just am tired of the internet radio channels and prefer to be local. The sound is great and operation easy. Fabulous reception.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is a perfect gift for older people or those who really enjoy local radio and prefer an easy to use radio that has great reception. Just be sure to have D batteries for emergencies. If it had rechargeable features, it would be perfect!

title: Great For Certain Uses, Not If You Plan To Carry It A Lot Unless You Have A Case
text:
I have had a need for an additional storage solution for my laptop which will enable me to back up files, and transfer between desktop (my workstation) and my laptop when necessary. My goal is to have it as an alternative mini hard drive, so to speak. Let's take a Look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This is a tiny Jumpdrive, for those who have never used one, it is similar in appearance to a dongle that you use for wireless keyboard or mouse in the USB port. It does not have a case and the packaging is rather difficult to open.

WHAT IS THIS FOR?
This is designed not to carry with you all of the time like some of the flash drives, but to use almost as a mini hard drive and keep it in your laptop or even desktop if desired. It will keep your files handy, has a pretty fast transfer rate, and has a decent amount of storage, depending on what kind of files you plan to store on it.

WHAT ELSE CAN YOU USE THESE FOR?
This can also be theoretically used to keep in the car as a way to play music on your sound system via USB port. I have not been able to do that yet as I have had some issues setting up the right format. I am not sure how security will interact with that..

DOES THIS HAVE SECURITY ON IT?
This drive has a program called ENCDataVault Lite. That will allow you to encrypt your files and have them accessed with a password you set up in case you lose your drive at least your files will be somewhat protected unless it is a hacker who finds it.

HOW IS TRANSFER RATE?
I have used this in a USB3.0 as well as USB2.0 port and both worked well.

DOES THIS FIT TYPE C CONNECTION?
You can not use this in a type C port so please check your laptop or desktop prior to purchase to be sure you have an actual USB port to use this in that is not already being used.

WHAT I DON'T LIKE ABOUT THIS
This drive should come with a tiny case on a keychain or with at least a loop handle on it so that you can put it somewhere safe and not lose it. It does not come with that. Something this small needs to have a colorful case to make it harder to lose. I know that the idea is to have it stay in the unit you use it on mostly, but sometimes you have to take it out and it needs a case.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a tiny drive. It is meant to use in either a car sound system (USB port), on a laptop or desktop that you plan to use it on regularly, and not be moved around constantly. It does not come with any kind of case at all to store it in when not in a port. It does have encryption which is a big plus to theoretically protect files in case of loss.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. The performance is top notch. The fact that this does not come with a case is worth removing a star. Ideally it would not be a problem most of the time, but I still think that it needs protective COLORFUl case for those times you need to remove it from a port and take it from one place to another.

title: The Daughter Who Was Not Impressed Changed Her Mind When She Saw It
text:
Recently one of our kids got a new laptop. It is a gorgeous rose gold color and I suggested instead of throwing it around that she get a good slip case for it. She rolled her eyes and when I showed her this, her response was, "Yeah, I guess, whatever". Then she saw it..

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This is a tough outside fabric. It is rather cute and the cats are not as weird looking as we thought they would be. The colors are bright as in the photo and the rose color matches her laptop perfectly.

LINING
The inside of this slip case is GORGEOUS. I am talking very plush and thick soft fabric in what I would call an intense camel color. The pockets are also lined as is the divider/wall.

POCKETS
There are two pockets in this and way more than either of us was expecting. They hold quite a bit.

ZIPPER
The zipper works very smoothly and does not catch.

ANY COMPLAINTS?
Her 14 inch laptop fits in here with plenty of room to spare. I asked her (as she clutched it to her chest) if she had any complaints she wanted me to tell you about. Her comment was, "If only this had small handles on it, it would be PERFECT"

Not bad for rolling her eyes when I said I wanted to get this for her, eh?

THE BOTTOM LINE
This laptop sleeve is WAY nicer than expected. It is one of the most highly padded and luxuriously lined sleeves I have come across yet and I have tried quite a few of them. This is well worth the investment especially if you have an expensive laptop that needs more robust protection.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I only wish I had one of these now. It is really amazing. But then again, I don't have a rose gold laptop to match it anyway. Poor me. LOL *rolls eyes* Whatever. HAHA

title: Expensive To Get Paper, But Worth It For Some Applications
text:
We have had Polaroid cameras in the past when they resurrected them for a while, and they were okay, but you wasted a lot of pictures that did not turn out too great. Let's take a look at this.

WHAT IS THIS SMARTPHONE PRINTER LIKE?
This printer is really handy. It is small, easy to carry, recharges well, and is easy to work. It comes with a USB charging cord, instruction book, and a small roll of paper/film. 10 is the number that came with the one I got.

WHAT IS THE ADVANTAGE OF THIS PRINTER?
Although this is a similar idea to the old Polaroid cameras, the difference with this one is that you get to choose the pictures that you want to print, instead of having to print whatever you take.

DOES IT WORK WELL?
This printer worked great. It is not hard at all to print with and we had no trouble with it.

INSTRUCTION BOOK
The instruction book is easy to follow and use.

QUALITY OF PHOTOS
I am enclosing a photo we took and printed with this printer. It is small and easy to keep handy, but still a great photo to put in a tiny frame as a magnet on the refrigerator, or framed for a small desk area. There are plenty of other things we can do with it, but those are just a few ideas.

WHAT DID WE USE IT FOR?
Our kids went to a pretty big march/event not too long ago and they were able to take a quick photo of them and their friends and print everyone a small copy as a memory to hang on to (especially since 1 of them was not too into tech stuff).

IS IT WORTH IT?
The replacement paper is not cheap, but it is doable if you make sure to keep it handy and only use it for special photos. This only comes with 10 so it is easy to blow through that in one sitting. It is nice to have handy, but only if you use it wisely.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a good quality instant print photo to help quickly capture a photo you take with your phone in print, this is a nice little printer. It is easy to carry and store, but it does take expense to keep printer paper handy.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS although it is more like four and a half. I would think this would come with a bit more paper to get you started with it, but not enough of a pain to take a star off at this point.

title: PERFECT!  Just What We Wanted
text:
My daughter got a new laptop recently and she was asking me if I had a cheap alternative to a fan stand. I saw these, and we tried them. Let's talk about it..

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
This is very simple. There are two sides to the ball. The twist apart and become two stands - one for each back corner of the laptop. There is enough for two laptops.

HOW DOES THIS WORK?
This is great. It is simple, but they stay put. My daughter has been raving about these and is happy to have them. They store well in the case to carry with her and help to keep the laptop tilted and cooler than sitting flat.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For an easy solution that is easy to carry with you, these stands have been great. We all like them, but especially the daughter that was asking for them.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. Such a simple solution to the problem is refreshing! I would buy these again if I needed them.

title: This Thing Is Brilliantly Designed.  I Am In AWE OF This
text:
When I wanted to get this suitcase, my family thought I was nuts. We all are doing some traveling from one time to another, and my kids are planning to do some serious traveling sometime in the future. This is perfect. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This is a fabulous suitcase. You can see from all of the photos, and the video what this is like, so I won't go into great detail describing what you already can see from the photos and video. I will give a rundown of what I am most impressed with about this.

STRAP ON THE BACK
I know this is going to sound silly, but one of my biggest concerns was if I wanted to put this on my back and suddenly decided I had to carry it like luggage, would the straps trip me from the backpack? Well, much to my surprise, the one thing I did not see mentioned was that there is a strap on the back of the case which hooks into place. If you want to keep the backpack straps out of the way, you unhook the strap and rehook it over the backpack straps. It works GREAT.

When it is time to backpack it again, it is easy to restore it to that mode.

BACK PADDING
Not only was the back strap a pleasant surprise, but the padding on the back was too. There is padding on the back where the shoulder blades hit the bag and there is padding over the secret zipper pocket that would rest near the lower back when you wear this too. Both carry handles are padded nicely as well as the backpack straps too.

TSA FRIENDLY OPENING
That is a wonderful feature too. It is nice to be able to zip open the bag without all of my stuff coming out to check for electronics, etc.

NETTED POUCH ON THE SIDE
I also love the little feature that has the netted pouch on the side for a can of drink or bottle of water that can be used, but when you are NOT using it, it zips shut tight to the case. Beautifully creative.

BACK PANEL
I also love the back panel where you zip it open (this is the top part that faces out if you wear it backpack style). It has great places for pencils, papers, small stuff you might want to store but it is easy to access without going through the entire suitcase full of packed stuff.

DOES IT HOLD A LOT OF STUFF?
I am also very amazed at how much stuff I can pack in this for clothing and use on a weekend, and if planned well, an entire week. This really DOES hold a lot of stuff, and if you practice the ROLLING form of packing where you roll your clothes like a sleeping bag idea, you can definitely fit in all you would need for a weekend or week, except if it was winter where you will be, then it will be probably too small. You will need additional packing room most likely unless you have very thin warm clothing you can wear repeatedly.

DOES IT FIT UNDER A PLANE SEAT?
I have not taken this on a flight yet. I hope to remember to update in the future if one of us ends up doing that to let you know about the seat thing.

THE BOTTOM LINE
All in all the features described in the listing, in other reviews and some of the highlights I am especially impressed with all make this one of my favorite pieces of luggage we have. It enables me to get rid of a piece of small luggage which really has not been that convenient and substitute this instead. I really love this thing.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is brilliantly designed, is completely handy to have, and adapts to any sort of travel or transport you might need to do with it from backpack to sliding on with larger luggage on a carrier handle. I really do love this and despite the price, I really do think it is worth it.

title: FINALLY I Can Use A Mouse Again!!
text:
i have avoided using mice for years now because I could not hold my hand in the position required for working a mouse. It really bothered my wrists. I saw this one and grabbed it hoping perhaps I could use this one. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS MOUSE LIKE?
Like in the photo, this mouse is upright. It has the ability to go forward and backward using the thumb and two buttons. It has the usual buttons where the finger tips rest. In between the fingertip buttons (right and left mouse buttons) there is a scroll bar.

RECHARGEABLE
This is rechargeable. It comes with a USB to mini USB port cord for charging. Once charged, I get many hours of use before it has to be charged again. It does not run down really fast.

DONGLE
This has a dongle which stores in the mouse. THAT is handy. It plugs into the USB port of whatever computer I want to use it with- desktop or laptop- and it works well on just about any surface within reason.

IS IT COMFORTABLE?
I have been so long without using a mouse, it feels weird to be able to use one without issues. I can use this for a while without discomfort, although i am so used to a touch pad, it is still an adjustment. It is WAY more comfortable than using a traditional mouse, however.

GAMING?
I do not play action games with this mouse. It is mostly for either working, or adventure style gaming. For those things it has worked fine for me. Action gaming might be another story.

DOES IT TRACK WELL?
For me it has tracked well so far. The scroll wheel works pretty well and the response of the mouse is good.

THE BOTTOM LINE
If you have trouble with your wrists like I have in using traditional computer mice, this might be a solution for you. I really like this. It is comfortable, so far has tracked well, and is easy to use in a variety of places/surfaces with laptop or desktop.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS so far. I will update if anything changes. It is hard to get a mouse to discharge fast, but if it starts to give me issues, I hope to remember to update this review.

title: Excellent Performance, VERY EASY TO LOSE THIS
text:
With everything becoming smaller, more streamlined, and less footprint to its size, there is a two edged sword. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This is a pretty straightforward drive. It plugs into the USB port, has fabulous transfer time and I have had no issues with errors. It is quite small, very slick metal, and no color or markings on it other than very tiny etched writing on it.

IS THIS BACKWARD COMPATIBLE?
Yes, this has worked in all of my USB ports from very old to very new - all speeds.

DOES IT READ ON VARIOUS DEVICES
I have had no issues moving this between desktop to laptops.

DOES THIS WORK WITH WINDOWS 7?
I have had no issues with Windows 7 and this drive.

ONE PROBLEM..
The one issue I have with this drive is that there is no case at all for it. That means that it is very easy to lose. It does have a hole where you can attach a lanyard to it or some kind of ribbon. As silly as it sounds, that is the only way I can find it half the time. It is just to gray and insignificant looking to leave it without something on it to indicate that it is not some part you just toss in a drawer.

I have had to rescue this twice from the drawer from people thinking it was junk and throwing it in there. That is when I put the colored ribbon on it.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Great performance, streamlined appearance, but make sure to put something colorful and big on it or it might get lost easily. If it is like my house- someone will think it is junk and either toss it in a drawer, or throw it away.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. I think this should have come with a colored cap on it to protect it or a colored strap of some sort. It is not a deal breaker and perhaps I would rate this more like four and a half, but I can't so four it is.

title: Great Little Radio For Power Outages/Emergencies (Some Bizarre Instructions Though)
text:
Despite the current trend to listen to all radio via internet, people who live in rural areas know the value of having radios that pick up stations and emergency lighting in times of power outages, and even internet outages which are not as uncommon as you might think. Let's take a look at this radio.

WHAT IS IT LIKE?
First of all this radio is quite small. That means it is easy to store and put in small places to listen to. It has the ability to listen to AM/FM/NOAA stations so if you need to know what is going on during times of outages, you can. There are various methods of charging this. The radio has a nice feel to it- it is not rubbery, nor is it slick. Somewhere in between is what I would say with this, which means it is easy to hold on to.

AAA BATTERIES
This can take 3 AAA batteries which is great if you have them on hand. Remember to take them out when you don't plan to use the radio over a period of time in case they explode.

HAND CRANK (AND WEIRD INSTRUCTIONS)
This enables you to turn the crank for 1 minute for 10-15 minute increments of radio listening or 20 minutes of light if you are using the light. The instructions have a rather hilarious recommendation that if you turn the crank at 130-150 MPH it will be charged in 4 hours. I don't know about you, but I don't know anyone with a bionic arm that could even turn the crank that fast, or bicycle, or .. Well you get it.

SOLAR
If you put this in direct sunlight, you can get a charge as well. I have left this on the window and it works some, but I did this with another item that has a similar plastic finish, and the sun disintegrated the finish leaving it sticky.
