This radio has a similar rubbery plastic finish, so I don't tend to leave it in the light more than when I am using it.

DOES THIS CHARGE THE BATTERY WELL BY HAND OR SOLAR?
Well, it does charge the battery, but the times vary as to how much listening time I get from it. It can go from the said 15 minutes to a half hour at times for one minute of hand cranking.

SOUND
The AM sound is like an old radio from back in the day called transistors. It is not a full round sound, but it is not that bad to listen to. FM is a bit nicer, but again, this is not for luxury listening, it is for occasional use when other radios etc are not practical or possible to use. WARNING- if you happen to use a TV remote or other devices near this, it will interfere with the sound a bit. It is no big deal though.

READING LIGHT
This has a really cool reading light on it if you wanted to use it in power outages. It pulls out and bends over so you can see.

FLASHLIGHT
This flashlight is very bright and will enable some nice usage during power outages.

CHARGING PORT
You can even use this with a USB charging unit to charge it up instead of batteries or cranking, etc. It takes over 4 hours to full charge the battery. You can also use this to charge up a cell phone, but only for emergencies, not as a power bank.

QUALITY
This radio is of decent quality but again, it is not luxurious listening or using- it is for those times when you don't have other options. The reading light is great if you have to read the phone instructions for reporting outages, or other things when the power goes out. It is VERY handy to have both a reading and flashlight handy.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Despite this being okay quality of listening, there are SO many options with this radio that I am really liking having it handy. We have used it quite a bit and it has worked so far. I really love the options and that it seems to run dependably so far. I love that it has USB options to charge it with too. The size makes it perfect to keep on hand. It does not take up much room but has decent sound.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I love this. The size is perfect and versatility is fantastic.

title: FINALLY I Get To Use My Foreign Language Course!
text:
Boy, talk about a frustration. I got a foreign language course and then realized that that microphone integrated with my headphones would not work with my computer no matter what I did. I had to try to find a mic. Let's see what happened.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This microphone comes in a nice box which is great for gift giving as well as storing this in when not in use. It is a nice base that has a connector for the microphone to snap into. There is an off and on button the lights up red when it turns on and when you want to turn it off the light goes off. You plug this into a USB port.

HOW DOES THIS PERFORM?
Because this has its own sound card, this microphone works much better than previous ones I have had. It is strong and seems to be clear when I use it for my sound feedback for the language practice. The software I am using it with allows me to turn it up and down.

STURDY?
The base of this is pretty heavy metal which keeps it from tipping over very easily when you adjust it.

ADJUSTABLE?
This bends down and adjusts back and forth at the bendable sections near the base and just under the top area too, so I can move it closer to my mouth or away.

FOAM COVER
The foam cover helps block background noise.

ANY PROBLEMS?
So far, I have used this for my foreign language course mostly as I don't have skype hooked up to this desktop. It works fantastic and I like it.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This works very well for programs that require response for accurate sound such as foreign language courses. It is adjustable and the sound card inside seems to really boost sound well without problems.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I hope to use this online some time for live broadcasting and if I do, I will update this review to let you know if any problems arise.

title: Out Of All Of The Headsets We Are Buying Another So We Don't Fight
text:
I got this set of headphones to go with our panasonic phone system in your house for our landline. Many times we get power failures so we still keep a landline. But when the power is not out, I like to use our landline for calls. Our system uses bluetooth for headsets so this is where these came in handy.

HOW ARE THESE?
These headphones are red. I love the color. they seem sturdier than expected, There is a slot in the headphones which you can insert a MicroSD card so you don't HAVE to use a player with the headphones (like phone or MP3, etc). These are bluetooth as well and have a volume button.

HOW DO THESE PERFORM?
My family is a bunch of ear phone addicted fanatics. We have some of the best and some of the worst and everything in between. When I started to try these out, I really liked them and was surprised at how loud they were. One of our kids, a daughter, grabbed the headphones to try them and loved them so much, she is getting a pair for her pottery studio to listen to her own music.

ARE THEY TOO LOUD?
I did not think these were too loud. They were controlled easily through the volume control on the headphones.

ARE THEY COMFORTABLE?
I use these mainly to talk on the phone so I don't have to cradle the phone to my head when working while talking. These are comfortable and as long as I am not SUPER active with these on, they seem to stay on fairly well. They are comfortable and my ears last about a half hour before I want to remove them. Sometimes longer.

CHARGING
These do not take long at all to charge. Within a few hours they were ready to go.

ADJUSTABLE?
These are not hard to adjust and they seem to adapt well to all of our heads.

SOUND QUALITY
The sound quality is surprisingly good with these. There is good definition and it is not muffled or out of proportion to the point that you prefer them not to be on. Let me just say that the daughter that is going to buy these is so impressed she is very excited for this price to get her own pair. She is very picky about her ear buds or headphones.

DO THEY BLOCK NOISE?
These do block outside noise well which is another great feature of these.

VOICE?
So far the voice works well with these when I use them on the phone.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a decent set of headphones that are comfortable, block outside noise well, and do well on the phone for both listening and voice as well as music, these are a great choice. I love the red color too.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. These are great, affordable and work well so far. I will update if anything changes.

title: For Smaller Flash Drive Needs, Perfect
text:
When it comes to video or other smaller needs for groups of files or back ups, I like to have a variety of different Flash Drives. It is sometimes hard to keep them separated, but this package solves that!

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
These flash drives come just as shown in the photo. They are a variety of colors, come with small labels, and wrist loops you can put on them for easy carry or attaching.

HOW DO THESE WORK?
When I want to do video, photo collections of files for business or artwork, these are perfect. They are color coded so it is easy for me to visually pick the one that I want and go to work. I also love these for giving too. Sometimes when I am making a compilation of files, or even music for my car stereo, I want a smaller drive that I won't lose much if something happens to it. Again, these work GREAT. No problems so far.

DO THEY RUN WELL?
I have used them with Win 7, 8, and 10 with no problems so far. No lags or other problems at this point.

THE BOTTOM LINE
To have a collection of color coded flash drives is really helpful. I use them for a variety of things, and this set is perfect for visual people like me who want to quickly identify and move on. Having the different colors is perfect. Performance is good so far, and I am happy with them.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I love the color variety and so far no problems. I will update of anything changes. I also like the straps to have on them- it is handy to attach them to things or wear on the wrist or neck cord.

title: Works As It Says It Will Don't Expect Perfect Quality
text:
I needed this stand for something a little bit different than what it is for. I needed to have this for my essential oil cases. I have two of them with drawers and a wood panel that shuts over them when not in use. I was moving them to a top of a bookcase, but still needed a place for a phone book, or other small items. This case was PERFECT. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This case comes in parts. There are pre-cut particle board covered with a vinyl type wood grain. I have the dark wood color. The pieces are well marked and there is plenty of cushioning in the box to help it not get scratched or broken up. There is also a bag of metal components.

HOW ARE THE INSTRUCTIONS?
The instructions for this stand are great. Everything is VERY well marked, very well laid out and if you are a visual learner, this will work beautifully for you. Everything is well illustrated too.

HOW DOES THIS GO TOGETHER?
I have to say that this went together quickly and easily. I was amazed at how fast it did go together.

IS IT STURDY?
This is plenty sturdy to hold my two cases of essential oils.

ANY PROBLEMS?
The only issue I had with this is that the screw caps that have to tighten around the metal posts to hold this together have to be turned. The problem is that the shelf is very narrow and it was hard to get my hand in there. It took some doing, but it eventually worked.

DOES THE TOOL COME WITH THIS?
Yes, this comes with a philips head allen key wrench.

QUALITY?
The edges of this show that the covering is not on perfectly. It is not going to be a flawless job, but once put together, it looks fine.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Whether for a monitor or another function like I chose with my essential oil cases, this stand is nice. It is compact, yet has space for thin books, workbooks or packs of papers- only thin ones though.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. The instructions and included tool pushed this up to five stars. I am IMPRESSED with how they went out of their way to be sure it went together well and easily.

title: PERFECT For My Laptop- Handles And Pocket Perfect Additions
text:
I have had a sleeve for my laptop, but honestly it was frustrating when I needed to quickly grab the sleeve. I found myself having to try a few times before I could do it with one hand, often having to stop and use two. Let's see how this worked out..

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This sleeve is the perfect bridge between sleeve and case. It has the cushioning in it with soft interior that a sleeve has with padding, but it also has two handles and a curved pocket in the front to slip the recharging cord or other items in so they don't ruin the laptop.

HOW DOES THIS PERFORM?
This sleeve/case is great. It is lightweight so it is not bulky like some of the cases I have. It fits my 15.5 inch laptop perfectly. It is easy to keep handy in the house so I can recharge in it or just leave it protected until I have to use it again. I have found that although it is not overly thick, it is enough protection to be sure that in the house it is not banged up easily. When I want to travel, I slip the entire thing in my carry bag and it fits perfectly.

POCKET AND STRAP
The pocket in the front houses my recharge cord nicely. It also is a nice place to keep the shoulder strap when I am not using it. The strap attaches to the sleeve at two nylon loops at either end of the zipper.

KITTY PRINT
The cat print looks just like our cat. And yes, it is on BOTH SIDES of the sleeve. It is accurate as what is in the photo. I really love this as does everyone in the family.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a really cool looking sleeve that has handles and a zipper pocket, I could not ask for more. It is lightweight and perfect for storage in the home or office, and slips nicely into larger cases for travel.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. Even though I got shipped the wrong item at first, it was corrected and I love this sleeve with the handles and pocket. It is really nice and the print is very realistic.

title: PERFECT Sleeve For My ASUS C434T Chromebook
text:
I have this great little chromebook, but it is too small for most of my sleeves and cases, or the cases are too bulky. I wanted something easy to keep it protected but have it easy access to slip it in and out of for quick use. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This sleeve is pretty simple. It has a two way zipper on it which has great pull tabs on each side. They are easy to grip. There are no pockets, and the inside is soft slippery knit with padding in it. The outside is printed on both sides with a cassette tape graphic which is really kind of fun. It is sturdy and the Chromebook fits perfectly in it.

HOW DOES IT PERFORM?
This is just what I needed. I can slide the Chromebook in and out of it, and it stays protected, is soft, and stands upright. There is room inside so it is not tight, but it is not sloppy either.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a really fun graphically enhanced laptop sleeve, this is a great choice. It is simple, no frills, but is just what I needed to protect and have easy access too in the house. I can always put it inside a larger case for travel and more protection.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I like this a lot.

title: Works But Not As Well As Hoped
text:
I have a lot of call to use a gentle vacuum on things like keyboards, etc. I was very excited to get this. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This comes with a USB charging cable, a nozzle attachment and the vacuum.

CHARGING
The charging took a few hours, but it might have been done earlier than I thought.

PERFORMANCE
Although this idea is good, I found that this did not have the suction I had hoped for on the keyboard. Let me give you an example. My husband was playing Tim the Toolman when he decided to vacuum a huge pile of crumbs and dust off of the couch.

I was sitting at my computer trying to do some Amazon reviews, minding my own business, when I found myself WEARING all of the dust and crumbs. They had spit out the back of the shop vac ALL OVER ME.

I quickly pulled out my little handy keyboard vacuum. To my disappointment it hardly picked up any of the stuff all over the keyboard. I tried the attachment and again, not nearly as much as I had hoped it would.

EMPTYING
You just screw off the cover and empty what is inside.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Although this helps pick up some items from the keyboard, it really does not do as good of a job as I had hoped.

MY RATING
THREE STARS. IF it was just a bit stronger, I would love it.

title: I Am VERY Surprised At The Quality Of These GORGEOUS Headphones- LOVE THEM!
text:
I found that in order to use my foreign language program, I needed a new set of plug in headphones due to the older unit I needed to use for the program. I saw these and fell in love with the colors. Is the performance just as nice? Let's take a look.

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
These are the most gorgeous mint green and neon violet color. The ear phones are quite small and sit on top of the ears. The top is padded, and so are the earphones.

CORD
The cord is about 55 inches long or so. The jack is the small type meaning 3.5.

CONTROLS
The controls are in the line. There is a plus and minus for sound level and a phone button for answering. You can forward and go backwards through song lists.

ADJUSTMENTS
This is where these shine. You can not only pull the earphones down to make them longer, but they also swivel from left to right to better accommodate the face and ear placement on the head.

FOLDING
There are two ways you can store these. You can fold them flat, by rotating the ear phones to be flat with the rest of the headset, or you can fold the earphones up into the headset making them have a smaller footprint.

COMFORT
These are VERY comfortable. I am amazed that I don't even know they are on.

NOISE CANCELING
I am amazed at how well these work to keep me focused on the lessons as I do them.

QUALITY
WOW. The quality of these is WAY better than I expected. The sound is clear with no muffling at all. I am very happy with how these have performed so far. Music is amazing and my foreign language lessons are also fantastic.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Not only are these GORGEOUS in color, but they work beautifully. For the price, they are amazing. They work well with my old desktop as well as my tablet and old MP3 player.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I am very happy with these. Honestly they shocked me at how nice they are for the price.

PHOTOS
I would take a photo, but honestly they look JUST LIKE the photo with this listing.

title: These Are So Good They Appeal to Ear Bud Thieves.. A LOT
text:
I have gotten so many pair of earbuds that have disappeared in the house, that I finally decided to get a pair I could use for me. I got these and was very excited to test them out. The problem is, they were stolen, like A BAZILLION TIMES.

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
These ear buds are easy to wear. There is a wire band that you wear around the neck and make sure that they controls are on the right side. The ear buds are marked R and L but it can be hard to see. It took me some time to find, although when you only have five seconds to look before you have to visit the restroom only to find them missing when you return, well, you can imagine how hard it is to do.

HOW DO THESE COME?
These come in a great box that is perfect for gift giving.

CONTROLS
The controls for these are very easy to use. They work well, are simple, and pretty easy to catch on to.

PHONE QUALITY
My daughter talks to me all of the time with these on, and they are almost impossible to know that she is using. Otherwise I would have known that she STOLE MY EARBUDS AGAIN AND WOULD HOLLER AT HER. Sorry, I am venting here. Let;s just say that the phone quality is so good that I can not tell when she is using them or not.

MUSIC QUALITY
The music quality is really good. It is not completely noise blocking, so you can still hear things going on around. There is a good separation of bass and treble and the sound is not mushy but way more clear than other earbuds I have used.

CUSHIONS
The rubberized cushions fit okay, but we have had to use different ones for the best fit- well the fifteen seconds at a time I get to use them before the earbud thief strikes again.

ANY PROBLEMS?
The only problem that happens is that if we are using these long enough and are moving around cleaning or doing things, your ears can get sweaty and they will start to slip out a bit. Wiping them off helps though. Other than that, they are really nice.

THE BOTTOM LINE
These earbuds are really nice. I would love to have them more often, but they always go missing. In fact, I had these out yesterday to write the review, and had a problem connecting them to my MP3 player, so I put them down. When I came back- gone again. From that fact alone I can say these are some of the best ear buds we have had so far. Everyone wants them.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I might have to break down and buy myself another pair. As soon as I take these off when I am done, they will be gone again, I can count on it.

title: Very Sturdy Backpack, Looks Great, Somewhat Convenient, But I Can Not Reset Lock
text:
WARNING: This is an in depth review for those who want to make an informed buying decision concerning this backpack. If you prefer a quick summary, see section marked THE BOTTOM LINE
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This backpack and I have had many go-arounds. I was waiting to write this review until I could get it figured out, but in exasperation, I finally decided to just write this review, feeling a bit defeated. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS BACKPACK LIKE?
This is a very padded, cushioned backpack. I am going to break down each feature as we go along.

ZIPPER
The zipper that opens this is near the back. The front (part that faces out when you walk with it on) is very padded, and has no zippers or pockets accessible to people walking behind you. The zipper that opens up has two pulls on it.

REFLECTIVE
There is a small strip of reflective paint on the front of the bag (that faces away from you when you wear it) that is about 4 inches by 1/4 inch wide. There is also a reflective strip on the shoulder strap that will face out from YOU as you wear this to call attention to you as cars approach your front when walking with this on.

HOOK AND CARRY STRAP
There is a thin hook for hanging this. It is pretty thin and is more like grosgrain ribbon in weight. The handle, however, is very padded and industrial in construction.

SHOULDER STRAPS
The shoulder straps are very padded and cut very well. They are comfortable to wear. they have a strap to hook them together to keep them in place while walking.

PADDED BACK
On the back which will be up against your back while you walk is a padded area which is a large loop for you to slip something through it like something that you want to carry with you but be close to your back.

INSIDE
POUCH
There is a pouch that is in a little zippered pocket near the bottom back of the backpack which houses a drawstring pouch that also has a key ring on a strap, and a hook on an elastic band. I would say the pouch houses a water bottle or other item similar outside the backpack, but if you are not using it, you tuck it away. It also has a drawstring on it in case you want to put a smaller item inside.

The key ring snaps off so you can use your keys and then put it back on the bag again. If you are not using them, you can zip them up in the bag even while using the pouch. None of us can figure out what the elastic strap with the hook on the end is for as there are no loops or rings anywhere to hook it on.

FRONT FLAP INSIDE
This is a perfect area to keep your laptop and tablet. The dual pocket is padded well and fits up to 17 inch laptop and an 11 inch tablet. A thick elastic band shuts with loop tape (think velcro).

There is also another pocket to slip things into with two size pockets for pens, even a screwdriver if necessary.

BACK INSIDE
The part of the pack inside that is next to the back is loaded with pockets and zippered case. There is a waterproof cover in one of the pockets that folds up very small. Another pencil/pen sized pocket and MP3 player or phone pocket is near the USB charging area where you can keep a power pack for charging.

There is a mesh pocket with a zipper that is about the size of a pencil case that goes inside three ring binders for school, and another zippered pocket that is padded for more items. The mesh pocket is great for storage of damp things or things that need to breathe.

GLASSES
There is even a case at the top of the backpack for glasses. It is marked with a picture of GLASSES on it.

IS THIS EASY TO USE?
This backpack can be easy to use, or it can be difficult. If you are going to be needing access constantly into your backpack, this is not overly easy to get into. If you are going to the library, classes, and you plan to sit in place, take out what you want and then put the backpack nearby you, then this is a great backpack. It also is great for long walks if you need to go.

LOCK
This is my most frustrating thing with this backpack. It says in the instructions on the site to reset the combination for the lock for the zipper. I tried and tried (as did my kids) to reset this combination and nothing works. It stays at three zeros- 000

The lock WORKS but it won't reset to a different number combination.

THE BOTTOM LINE
A VERY well made backpack that has plenty of storage space, is well made, and is geared to make your backpack hard to steal from while you are wearing it this is a nice choice. The lock won't seem to reset, and the backpack is not very easy to get into quickly, so it might be frustrating if you want quick access.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. I would like better instructions for setting the lock, and better explanation of what each feature of the pack comes with ON AN INSERT WITH THE BAG.

title: REALLY PRETTY Basic SLEEVE Case For Laptop
text:
I have a few laptops which I wanted to get a simple sleeve for around the house. The cases that I use to carry them outside are a bit bulky around the house, so a sleeve was more in line for protection yet quick storage too. Let's take a look at this one.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
First of all, the photo of this item is exactly what it looks like. The nebula is bright, beautiful, and very well printed onto BOTH SIDES of this sleeve.

HANDLES
The handles on this are just for ease in carrying. If your laptop is not large enough to fit perfectly in this sleeve, it might fold a bit when carrying but it is not bad, unless of course we are talking a small tablet. *chuckles*

ZIPPERS
The zippers are nylon but pretty sturdy. The two way zipper has pull tabs which are easy to grab and pull on without slipping.

POCKETS?
There are no pockets on this.

MEASUREMENTS
15.5 inches by 11 inches is what this measures.

THE BOTTOM LINE
If you are looking for a simple sleeve for protection of your laptop that has handles and a pretty design, this is it. Just be aware, there are no pockets for cord storage.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. It is a nice sleeve, and I love the addition of the handles. The design is GORGEOUS.

title: RIDICULOUS
text:
I waited some time to review these because I tried on various occasions to install them. It was a total bust.

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
These covers come in a plastic bag with a little clear plastic box attached to a card. Inside there are three covers. Each is covered with a clear blue plastic sheet.

HOW ARE THEY SUPPOSED TO WORK?
You clean off the spot you are supposed to put it on.
You remove the plastic back
Press into place
Wait 24 hours
Slide door back and forth when you want to use the camera.

HOW DOES THIS PERFORM
OMG what a frustration! First of all, these do not stay together long enough to press them to the laptop! Before I can even press them into place, the "slide" cover pops out. If I stick the back to the laptop, the door won't go in. If I have the door in place, when I stick the back to the laptop, the door won't slide AT ALL and ends up popping out.

If I get frustrated and try to take it off, it pops off the laptop.

I am back to paper with tape.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Great in theory, but horrible in practice, this set was nothing but frustrating. I waited, tried again many times, and none of these worked as promised.

MY RATING
ONE STAR. I rarely give this bad of a rating, but these were a horrible experience. Useless is more of what comes to mind.

title: I Wish It Was Just A Half Inch Bigger But Still Handy
text:
I got this for my daughter who is involved in a business situation where a camera, laptop, and tripod (plus accessories) are required for product photos, posting, and keeping track of inventory. She is always misplacing things. I wanted this to be in one place for her. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This is true to the photos with the listing. The case is padded, has a velcro flap on it which has a zipper in the front flap for flat things like our flat flash which we keep in a padded box, or cords, etc. The case itself has plenty of padding in it and non-abrasive soft fabrics.

CAMERA CASE
The camera storage has two adjustable velcro type walls in it so that you can make it bigger or smaller. The other two compartments are for storing lenses etc, and one of them has a flap, but the flap is not something you can fasten down. The camera that goes in here is a Fuji Finepix S1. The front lens sticks out quite a bit but it is stored on its back and is plenty protected by all of the padding.

ZIPPER ACCESS
There is a top zipper access so that if you have the flap down but need a quick access, you can quickly zip open the top and remove the camera.

LAPTOP POCKET
We have a laptop that I was sure would fit in there, but it is just about a 1/4 inch too long for the pocket. I thought it was a 14 inch, but it turned out to be 15 inch instead. A 14 inch laptop or tablet will fit in here perfectly. A 15 will not.

STRAPS
The straps on the bottom are adjustable to hold a tripod which is great to help keep all of this in order. When I want to make it easier to store, I remove the tripod and stand it next to this bag until it is time to use again.

SIDE MESH POCKET
This has a side pocket appropriate for a water bottle or can of coconut water, etc.

HANDLES
There is a single carry handle and a shoulder strap. The carry handle makes this a bit awkward, so we tend to use the shoulder strap except when we need to move the bag quickly.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Even though I wish this were slightly bigger to fit the laptop, it is my error, not the bag company, so I have to say other than that, this bag is well designed and does the job. It is a great way to keep all of the camera gear handy for the jewelry business it is needed for.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. It is not fair to remove a star for the misunderstood measurement, but this is not as handy for my needs as I had hoped. I am leaving this at five stars, because it is still handy to keep everything together for taking photos for the business it is intended for.

title: Good Cleaning Kit With Nice Small Tripod
text:
My daughter and I do a lot of photography of jewelry. We have had a variety of tripods and camera aids. This kit seemed like a good one for us. I got it.

WHAT IS THIS KIT LIKE?
CASE
This has a hard case that zips around the edge. It has a pocket in it to hold things in place and a cupped side to allow for the tripod storage.

LENS BAGS
There are bags in here which fit small medium or large lenses. I don't have any lenses yet, but I do have a small light that fits in one.

CLEANING CLOTH
These come in a zip topped plastic bag. This is pretty nice and works well as is expected with microfiber cloth for cleaning glass.

QUICK RELEASE CAMERA STRAP
This comes in a nice package with good instructions in it. The idea is that this helps stabilize the camera when you are taking a lot of photos. You can not have to grip the camera so hard so your hand does not get tired too. If you accidentally slip your grip, it does not crash to the ground.

This had a learning curve to it, but I finally figured out how to use it for me where it was helpful.

LENS PAPER
This paper allows you to clean the lens off gently wet or dry. The wet means that you use the Altura cleaning solution for greasy heavier prints.

PUFFER CLEANER
This is a rubberized ball that when you squeeze it, there will be a blast of air that will blow things off of the lenses. This works quite well when I get a particle on the lens so I don't have to touch it.

BRUSH
This is when the dust won't blow off the lens or other glass you can gently brush it and then blow it away with the puffer cleaner.

EMPTY BOTTLE
This is for alcohol or lens cleaner.

TRIPOD
This is why I wanted this kit the most. It has an ingenious design to it. It folds up flat and quite small, yet when you take it apart and tilt it, you can stand it up for close photos, or use it in your hand. It has rubber on the bottom to keep it put, and it also has a rubberized grip if you want to hold it. The camera platform tilts, but it locks into place which I love. This is working great for us taking close up photos of some of the small jewelry we are photographing. It has come in really handy.

What I love is that we can pick it up and use it by hand if we need another angle than the table top one.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This kit is a nice kit. I got it mostly for the tripod, but the cleaning accessories and the wrist strap make it really nice. The puffer ball is one of those things that you don't realize you need until you have it.- at least for me. The case is protective and easy to travel with.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I am happy with this kit. It has worked better for us than I expected. We will be using this a lot in the future too.

title: Great Place To Store Batteries, One Small Problems
text:
I have a lot of batteries and having them in plastic bags is annoying. I decided to get this case to keep them orderly, protected and more easily figure out when it is time to replenish.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This case is really nice. It comes in a simple plastic bag but the case itself is sturdy and holds up well. Inside is plenty of foam to keep batteries secure and in place. There is also a battery tester to test for dead ones. There are plenty of holes for most batteries.

HOW DOES THIS PERFORM?
I love that I can have my batteries in such an organized manner. I put AA and AAA batteries in extra C holes that I had as well as 9 volt holes. You can easily adapt this if you have more than one type and not enough of another.

PROBLEMS?
The only problem was that there are only two D holes. Most things that take D batteries take more than two. You can always put other sizes packed in there if you don't have any, but that is the only problem.

TESTER
So far the tester seems to be working well. I even tried a dead battery and it only showed a tiny spark left.

THE BOTTOM LINE
A great case, sturdy, and tough, this is a nice way to organize and keep track of batteries so you don't end up short when you really need them.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I am really happy with this. If I have anything to add in the future, I will. I am curious if a battery ruptures if it will eat away at the foam. Hopefully I will never have to find out.

title: I LOVE THIS THING!  Perfect For Our Product Photos
text:
We do jewelry photos which are very difficult to shoot, especially when iridescence is involved. We have big lights to set up and get good shots, but then we have been having issues with some of the light leaving things looking a bit dead. Enter this light. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This a light that is about the size of a smart phone- well the slightly larger ones. It comes with a case that has an elastic band on one side and a net bag with elastic top on the opposite side. The kit comes with a square slide to put on the camera along with screws to hold the discs in place to stop wobble. There is a charge outlet,, a charge cord (USB on the other end) and an output cord which goes from C to USB.

HOW DOES THIS WORK?
When you turn this on, you press the power button and hold it down. The light goes on. There is a little window with the information in it.

TIME LEFT FOR USE
This tells you how many hours are left before you need to recharge so you can plan your sessions.

BATTERY
There is a battery indicator

BRIGHTNESS
From 5% to 100%

TEMPERATURE
Coolest temp being 5600K down to 3200K which is like candlelight.

DIAL
The dial on the side allows you to go up or down

POWER BUTTON DUAL MENU BUTTON
You use the power button to turn on the light, but once it is on, then if you touch it once quickly, it changes from brightness to temperature so you can set what you like. An arrow is very obvious so you know where it is set.

HOW TO ATTACH TO CAMERA
I have a Canon Poweshot G12 and this attaches up where a flash usually goes. You can screw this into the lamp either horizontally or vertically. You slide in the metal plate with the screw on it, then you screw the light onto that and use the discs to tighten up the light so it does not move.

HOW DOES THIS PERFORM?
I have to say, this little thing is amazing. It has fantastic light, works very well and even though you can use it by itself for video or interviews, etc, for jewelry photos, we need to have additional light to use with this to avoid shadows.

I have gotten some excellent photos which are really nice and with a little adjustments in photo editing turn out to be great in capturing texture, color, and iridescence.

CHARGING
I found that a few hours of charging gave me a complete charge. After using this for about three hours (I turned it off in between set ups) I still have four out of five bars on the battery indicator and about 4 hours left of predicted use time.

WILL I NEED ANOTHER LIGHT?
If you are doing product photos like we are of jewelry or something that is detailed and needs to have very good lighting, then you will probably need another light. I would say a second one of these would be perfect- set it up on a little tripod and it will be great. If you are just doing portraits, or interviews, you might be able to get away with just this light. Shadows at that point don't matter as much- unless they are severe, of course.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is one of the best things I have ever gotten for taking photos. It has really helped me take photos beautifully an I am thrilled with it. The temperature control is beautiful and the brightness controls are also excellent in increments.

MY RATING
FIVE VERY ENTHUSIASTIC STARS. This is a great portable light that goes with you anywhere. The case is great, and the light is the perfect size to toss into my camera bag when traveling.

PHOTOS
When I get some photos that I am not using on my site, I will try to post some for you. It is worth seeing.

title: Nighmare At First But Worked Out Okay- Some Warnings
text:
WARNING- this is an IN DEPTH REVIEW for those who are serious about making a purchase of this laptop. All sections are marked for easier reference to find out information you might be looking for.

If you prefer a simple summary, see section marked THE BOTTOM LINE
----------------------------------------------------------------------
For one of the top new computers out there, this laptop is amazing and frustrating at the same time. Is it worth getting? YES. Are there warnings to be had? YES. This started out as a nightmare, but Dell stepped up to the plate.. Let’s take a closer look.

WHAT IS THIS LAPTOP LIKE?
SCREEN
The screen is large, easy to see, with clean colors and no pixel problems. This screen rivals the IPS screen in appearance. Gaming vid appears smooth. All games have performed well with no lag or problem on the screen.

HARD DRIVE
Start up is very short, and performance is FAST. This loads really quickly and performs well so far.

TOUCHPAD
The touchpad is responsive. The left and right mouse button are built into the bottom of the mousepad instead of individual buttons. It’s not our favorite set up, but it isn’t bad. When playing a game that uses keyboard, we have to turn off the touchpad because it is bigger than many other touchpads in laptops.

KEYBOARD
Not only is the keyboard FUN with the light show it has(as well as being RGB enabled), but the keys are quiet and the touch is good. It is a full keyboard-there have not been any complaints about it. It is easy to type on without fingers slipping off easily. Although this is used primarily for gaming and video editing, it performs fine for typing too.

ALIEN CONTROL CENTER
Using the alien control center, you can independently change all of the key values and colors. You can change the backlighting of the back edge of the spine of the laptop. You can change the color of the alien logo on the cover too which stays lit when in use.

You can also set individual profiles for each game in the Alien Control center including changing color of keys of you have an alien mouse, it will integrate into that setting as well so you can change the mouse and macro for each game. You can also in the profiles add overclocking to specific games. You can launch the games from the command center, or if you don’t, it will still activate the profile.

The only complaint about the control center-needs a simpler layout to change the button configuration on the Alienware mouse. You are supposed to be able to change the coloring of the Alien power button, but that does not work.

OVERCLOCKING AND FAN CONTROLS
The overclocking does work, but it has a tendency to run the CPU extremely hot. Also you can get settings in the command center for fan speed as well as overclocking. By default, they put you on quiet mode. The GPU and CPU have a tendency to run very hot and it has to manually be set to a different setting. We prefer the COOL setting. Anything less than that, it is not enough to keep components cool during overclocking or ANY operation.

ALIEN FUSION
You also have quick settings for power & battery to set them. You can also make adjustments to sound and playback. There is bass boost, treble enhancer, voice clarity, smart loudness, and also reverb. This is particularly handy for games. You can also turn on or off Alienware virtual surround sound.

ALIEN VIRTUAL SURROUND SOUND
The virtual surround sound works very well. Without headphones in, using just the speakers, it is easy to forget that you do not have the headphones on. It is very realistic sounding.

It also has audio profiles to choose from modes like movie, game, music etc.

GPUs AND CPU AND PERFORMANCE
The GPU is a Nvidia GeForce RTX 2070 Max-Q Design. The 2nd one is the Intel UHD Graphics 630. The CPU is an Intel Core i7-9750H@2.60GHz with turbo of 4.6. The GPU has DDR-6GB. Every game we have thrown at it runs smooth without any hitches at all having to do with the GPU, even tested with overclocking and it still worked great.

The CPU handles everything thrown at it, but the number 1 complaint is that while the GPU stays reasonably cool around 70C-80C, the CPU runs very HOT. It is between 90-100C. This is due to the fact that the 9th gen intel chip has a much wider turbo spread than previous generations. This causes it to heat up more than any other chip I have used to date for the i7.

With using a cooling board under the laptop it does help reduce the heat from 3-6degrees C.

CHARGING, BATTERY AND WARNING
This comes with a 180W charging brick. It charges fine, and in normal desktop operation, it runs off of the charger fine. As soon as you enter into anything graphics intensive, it starts not only drawing from the brick, but it also takes power from the battery. It does not matter how old of a game it is, it still draws from the battery, while plugged in.

This computer can not be used on battery alone when playing ANY kind of graphic oriented game. It MUST be used while being attached to charging cable. There is an upgrade option for a 240w brick, which we will try in the future to see if this resolves the situation.

WARNING
I would like to add that this is just under NORMAL operation without ANY devices attached by USB or anything wireless. Adding devices makes it drain even worse, again this is all while plugged in.

BRICK GETS HOT
When running a game on this laptop, one thing that is a bit off putting is that the brick will get very HOT. It would seem that a higher watt brick would be a better choice for this laptop, which is why we are looking into upgrading in the future to see if that will help.

SHUT OFFS
I have not had it shut off on us while gaming yet, but it does require to be charged once you are done gaming because if you intend to use this while gaming, you will need the battery charged AND keep it plugged in. You can not let the battery go dead with this and run it off of plug only.

PORTS
This has a headphone/mic combo jack that works fine. The ethernet jack unlike the problems that others have complained about being stuck gave us no trouble. We just are sure to press completely to remove it. The 3 USB 3.1 jacks has one with a power designation. There is a lightning port on the spine/back edge of the laptop. It works well as it is supposed to.

There is also an HDMI and mini display port on the back. They have worked well.

GAMES TESTED
Two Worlds 2 (CPU heavy game)
Kingdom Come Deliverance (GPU heavy game)
Arma 3 (Balanced draw on both)
Tom Clancy Rainbow Six Seige (CPU and GPU heavy game)
Pixel Junk Monsters (Light Game)
Age of Empires 3 (Light Game)
Various other lighter games..

All games work well. We have heavier hitting games we want to test in the future, such as Metal Gear Solid 5 but we have not had the chance. We will update if anything changes.

TOBII EXPERIENCE
This is where the experience gets frustrating. We started this whole laptop experience with such a horrible frustration that it has left us with a few loose ends that still are not working well. We have used this with Kingdom Come Deliverance which is TOBII enabled. You are supposed to be able to use the TOBII with the camera to be able to navigate and click on things, but for some reason it just won’t work. Due to the horrible beginning with this computer, it seems that this feature still has not worked right since it was wiped clean once already.

OUR NIGHTMARE LAPTOP EXPERIENCE
Now we are going to enter into a place no one wants to go when they get a new laptop. The DYSFUNCTIONAL LAPTOP. Let’s see how DELL handled what we went through.

THE FIRST DAY
I opened our computer I was all excited to get this up and running. I have done a lot of computer building over the years and tend to be pretty good at putting systems together and trouble shooting. I figured it would be an easy experience. BOY was I WRONG. When I opened the laptop, I entered all of the information to get it started up and it was fine until it suddenly started to update itself (without my permission) and then it went nuts.

PANIC!
The computer rebooted itself and then began to re-write the BIOS. I could not intervene and about an hour later, instead of powering down, the laptop was getting hotter and hotter and the system was dark. I was unable to get it to turn off. I unplugged it and tried pressing the power button until my finger was numb. NOTHING would turn this thing off.

We were approaching the hour and a half mark and I called for the technical support line’s help. This was NUTS. I waited and waited, and then suddenly while my finger had become one with the button, the tech support rep got on the phone and BAM it worked.
IS THAT FIRE I SMELL?
I thought all was well. Then the trouble started. The charging cable was not lighting up. There is a light on it. Perhaps it was dead, right? Nope. When trying to start the laptop up with another one of us, it suddenly made a weird noise, and smelled like it was BURNING. It was dead. I mean DEAD.

We called tech support about this and got the nicest person who was very patient, knowledgeable and helpful. Not only did we get an immediate return label, but a box was shipped out to us FAST for us to retun it to Dell.

We had our laptop back within a week and it had been wiped clean. The motherboard had a short in it and the charging cable was fried. They had to wipe out the laptop harddrive to get it to start again so as a result some of the programs which worked well at first for the few hours we had the laptop working have been messed up since.

DOES IT WORK NOW?
This laptop works now very well. It has been running fine. The wiping of the hard drive has led us to some software problems that did not get synced right when trying to replace them again and it is frustrating like the TOBII.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Our beginning experience with this laptop was awful. The nightmare was made better as Dell treated us with respect, importance and took care of us right away. They repaired the system and although some software does not work right yet, the hardware is doing all right and that is a relief. This laptop is a great performer despite some cautions. It is a great gaming system and high performance for graphics too.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS although I will say that with caution. Our initial experience was frustrating and took some serious time to get fixed, but Dell was excellent and treated us very well. We have a system that works except for the software which we have not been able to straighten out yet. I hope we can get it fixed soon and running as it should.

SUGGESTION
DON'T UPDATE THE BIOS UNLESS YOU ARE SURE THERE IS NO PROBLEM WITH IT. Do your research first if the laptop does not do it for you first, of course!

PHOTOS
The first three photos are the 3 benchmark stats for the games, the other 3 are in game screen shots with stats.

title: A Bit Of A Learning Curve, But It Is WORTH It.  Great Sound.
text:
I have been wanting a new MP3 player for a while now. I refuse to waste my phone with cluttered songs and use. I have watched everyone else I know blow through phones from constant use. I wanted to have a dedicated MP3 player. Let's see how this worked out.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This comes in a nice box- great for gift giving. It has a cord with it for charging and attaching to computer if you want to download songs to it. This does NOT have any internal memory, however. All songs have to be stored on a microSD card. There is port for headphones, mini USB, and line out port.

HOW TO OPERATE
ON/OFF
The power button is on the top of the unit. It has to be held in for a moment before it kicks in. There is an issue with the power button being on the top pressed down easily. The design of this has a raised edge of the case so that it is harder to press on the power button accidentally.

MENU
The menu button is easy to operate. It takes you around the menus using the forward and backward arrow buttons.

VOLUME
The volume buttons are on the outside edge on the right as you look at the case. The + and - buttons are separate.

BACK BUTTON
This takes you back through the menu and you can replay songs too.

PLAY PAUSE
Is on the front of the case and it is easy to access and see.

SCREEN
This is not a full color screen. It is simple and easy to read, however, without graphic clutter.

BLUETOOTH?
I had a heck of a time with this at first. I was not having it work well with my bluetooth headphones and it frustrated me to no end. I was about ready to give this an awful review when I suddenly realized- it was not the player, it was both sets of headphones that were not working correctly! Once I got the headphones working, the sound is BEAUTIFUL on this.

I have also used this with a few bluetooth speakers with great results. I like the solid feeling of the body- it stays put but does not take up too much room.

SOUND
You can change the sound quite a bit with this to be what you want. There are presets and fine tuning settings you can use. Once I finally got this figured out, the sound is amazing.

READ OUT
Again, this is NOT TOUCHSCREEN nor does it have fancy full color graphics. It is simple and easy to read and use.

STORAGE
Remember, this stores all of the songs on the microSD card. There is not any internal storage in this otherwise.

AM I GLAD TO HAVE THIS?
Once I got the problems worked out, I have to say I really like this. It is not as intuitive as some items, but it is really nice to have and I love to play it. I like shuffler or single CD artist choices, etc.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a really nice MP3 player. It is a bit more rustic than some might be used to with smart phones, but it really works nicely and the sound is great.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. It does what it says, although I would prefer it to have some internal storage as well as microSD, but that is just me. For what this is- it is very nice. I like it and am pleased with the performance.

title: If You Told Me A Black Briefcase Would Make A Teen Girl Squeal , I Would Not Have Believed You
text:
When I ordered this case, I expected it to be the usual. I would open it, use it, review it and then put it among my other storage bags which I find very handy for my growing collection of electronic devices and other gear that goes along with it. Then my daughter saw it. The squeal was confusing as she snapped it up and ran with it. Why?

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
I have to say, once I pried it out of her grabby hands after she returned from a weekend at a friend's house, I am really impressed by this bag. I think she thought I was going to take it back because she kept hiding it on me!

CONSTRUCTION
This is VERY well made. All edges have reinforcement of cording on them to avoid seams pulling out.

FABRIC
The fabric is very tough nylon. It is sturdy

COMPARTMENTS/POCKETS
There are pockets and storage galore in this thing.

FRONT
It has a flap on it that vecros shut with lining.

NEXT POCKET
Is a half sized compartment with room for pens and pencils and phone pocket.

CENTER
The center is divided by a padded divider. There are pockets for cords, mouse, and other things, as well as padding for laptop and tablet if you choose to put them in there.

FILE POCKET
This is perfect for filing paperwork and manuals, etc. There is a divided section which would be great for invoices and then paid ones, etc.

OUTSIDE POCKET
Another zipper pocket with lots of room for books or papers

HANDLES
The short handles are covered for easy holding so that the straps don't press into your hand.

LONG STRAP
The long strap is perfect for shoulder carrying especially if you have luggage to attend to as well. The long strap does clip off if you choose to do so.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is one of the nicest carry bags I have ever seen. There is SO much room for organizing and running business or study with this bag. It looks professional or would fit with students as well.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is such a nice case, a few other people who saw it have also ordered one. I think I might have to since my daughter is NOT parting with this one!.

title: Does Some Things Very Well, One Frustrating Problem
text:
It is important to have graphics tablets in our house. We have several people in the house who work with graphics so this is a helpful item to have a few of. Let's take a look at this pad.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This tablet is a nice red color. It comes with a red cord that plugs into the computer USB port. It has a propretary end on it that goes into the tablet, so you don't want to lose it. It has a pen with multiple nibs that it comes with. There is not a stand with the pen. There is an adequate very simple instruction manual included.

There are four press button spots on the top of the tablet. One is zoom in and zoom out, and the others are programmable.

PEN PRESSURE
This has a pressure sensitivity to it, so if you are using a painting program that is set up for pressure, it will work with this pen. It says 8000 levels, which is plenty for most projects.

BATTERIES?
There are not any batteries in this pen. It works off of the power in the tablet.

WEIGHT AND FEEL
The weight of it is nice- not too lightweight- feels hefty but not too much.

SIZE
This is excellent for travel. The cost is not too much so if it gets lost or broken, you can easily replace it.

THE PROBLEM
There is one problem with this tablet. The usable area is such that it is marked out on the tablet. That is the only area that the pen will work. Near the upper right hand half of the top edge, however, when you want to use the pen to move or navigate, it goes spastic. Windows shrink, or things go nuts. It is really frustrating.

WHAT PROGRAM DID WE USE IT FOR?
This was used primarily for Krita- a free graphics program.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is an excellent tablet to take with you in your computer tote. It works well with graphics programs, and is easy to handle and carry. If it were not for the one VERY frustrating glitch, it would be almost perfect.

MY RATING
Four stars. The glitch is such that it makes it hard to use this. If it did not give such problems, this would easily be five stars.

title: UPDATED- (Kissed, Made Up) I LOVE This.. And I HATE This..  Let Me Tell You About It..
text:
WARNING- This is a somewhat in depth review. If you prefer a summary, see section marked THE BOTTOM LINE
-------------------------------------
EDITED
Well, sure enough as soon as I posted this review, I made a discovery. The touchpad was driving me crazy but I found a work around. By using two fingers instead of the other settings, I have made peace with my touchpad. I am revising this rating to FIVE STARS because honestly, I love this little Chromebook. The touchpad was my only big frustration with it. Now that I have the work around with two finger scrolling and moving around, I am much happier. It is not what I am used to but it works great now. I just wanted to let you all know BEFORE reading my original review.
----------------------------
HERE IS THE ORIGINAL REVIEW
------------------------
I have always wanted to have a Chromebook. I have laptops, tablets, a screaming desktop for my high powered applications, but sometimes I just want a small laptop touchscreen hybrid just to surf the net now and then without all of the other bells and whistles. Let's take a look..

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
I am going to review this in sections.

SIZE
The size of this is fantastic. I LOVE it. It is sleek, easy to use, and handy.

WEIGHT
This is the perfect weight for what it is. I find it to be just right for what I want.

KEYBOARD
This is a bit hard to see during the day in certain light, but I find that I am a touch typist for the most part, so as long as my hands are in the correct places, I am not too overwhelmed with it. The click and pressure of the keys is surprisingly good with this. I have an easier time typing with this than I do with my laptop which is larger. I typiecally work best on a split keyboard (ergonomic) so the fact that I can type on this so easily surprises me- well SHOCK actually.

TOUCHSCREEN
This is the part that I expected to be frustrated with, but it works BEAUTIFULLY. I have had no problems with it. In fact, if it were not for the touchscreen, this little Chromebook would probably have been thrown right out the window - probably without opening the window first. That leads me to my next section..

TOUCHPAD
OMG. If there was ever a touch pad that would drive a person to insanity, this is it. The touchpad itself is all sealed with the two mouse buttons encased under the covering. That means there is not a separate button, but you have to press on the lower corners of the touchpad to get then to work. That is not the problem.

The touchpad can be set and reset, but OMG, it is so annoying that I have literally almost thrown the thing across the room on several occasions until I remembered it had touchscreen so I could override my choices by pressing right on the screen,, even though the keyboard was still engaged. If it were not for THAT feature, forget it.

The side scroll bars are my biggest annoyance. If you try to get them to surface, then press on them, it takes so long that when you finally get it to engage, you think it will work. It doesn't. The pointer will not seem to engage with the scrolling button and it takes forever. Touching it onscreen works better.

CHARGING
This takes a few hours to charge.

BATTERY LIFE
I get about 4 or 5 hours out of this depending on what I am doing.

POWER BUTTON
You can simply shut the Chromebook to turn it off in pause mode, or you can physically press the power button to turn it OFF. The thing is, however, when you open the book, it turns itself right on with no power button necessary. I rather like that feature.

USB AND JACK
The USB and Jack ports work great. No problems there.

RECHARGE CORD
The cord is plenty long enough and the transformer at the end of the cord is a slim one with a non-polarized plug so you can turn it either way in an outlet.

VOLUME
The volume buttons are wonderful- right on keyboard and easy to use. Volume is decent and no vibrating until it is way too loud anyway.

SCREEN QUALITY
Other than being in love with the touchscreen, I love the quality of the screen images too. The colors are good, and the clarity is nice as well. Is it as nice as the high level Samsung tablet? Not quite, but it is a decent runner up to it.

EASE OF USE
I find that the set up of this Chromebook is really nice. I have had no problems with lag and the set up is intuitive for those who are not great at finding and reading instructions. I have had no problems running basic apps on here, as well as using other browsers. I have not experimented with the Linux side of things at this point.

PURPOSE?
This makes a great notebook to bring to classes, coffee shops. for quick browsing of the web, and in my case to help manage online websites and a small business when I can not access my desktop or laptop and my tablet is not big enough for what I want to do. This is perfect for that.

THE BOTTOM LINE
I have to say that I REALLY love this thing Despite my fury at the ever frustrating touch pad, I love so much more about this Chromebook that I am willing to overlook the touch pad idiocy- well until it acts up again. I love the touchscreen overriding ability and that saves the whole thing for me. This is great to travel with me when I need basic access to internet packed in a perfect sized "laptop".

MY RATING
I want to give this five stars, but honestly, the touchpad is so ridiculous that I had to knock a star off for that. The touchscreen overrides it easily without having to flip the keyboard back and I have to say that placates me every time I get frustrated. This is a great little unit to have and I really like how fast it loads and performs. It is way nicer than I expected and is perfect for what I want to use it for.

title: Works Well On Desk, Don't Try Lap
text:
I know, you are probably thinking- what kind of idiot would try this on their LAP? I can not tell you who, but let's just say I am a witness.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This little stand folds perfectly flat. It comes in a drawstring bag which keeps it from attacking you. You see, this is VERY easy to pinch your fingers in. I have the bruises to prove it. However, once I figured it out, I was able to avoid it any more. Keeping this in the case is a GOOD thing.

HOW TO USE THIS
When I first got this, I was explaining to a certain someone that this was to keep the laptop cooler and hold it at a better angle. It was not until that certain someone was carrying on about what a stupid device it was that I realized that this someone was trying to use it on their lap. Don't do that. You won't like it.

HOW DOES IT PERFORM?
There are silicone pads and 3 settings for this stand. The pads hold the laptop in place and the stand in each setting. It holds a lightweight laptop well and the angles are good. I found using it on the right table top helps. It seems to stay put well, but if you have a really slick top, you can always put a non-skid pad under the whole thing.

THE BOTTOM LINE
As long as you are careful and only use this on the table top and are careful about not pinching your fingers, this is a nice little stand. It holds pretty well and is at a decent angle so far for our lightweight laptop.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. It is hard to use unless you really pay attention because it can suddenly fold down pinching the fingers, so I took a star off for that. It is a nice stand so far, but I will update as we try other laptops on it over time if necessary to let you know if something changes.

title: We Use This CONSTANTLY
text:
With a wide span of ages in our family household, having a central form of communication is essential. We don't want to be obsessed with our cell phones, so having this message system has become invaluable.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This has a tiny screw on door that you have to unscrew to put the battery power in. I had to bring out my eyeglass kit to use those, so be sure you have a tiny screw driver. The board does not light up, but it has a pen that when you write with it brings out a glowing type writing. When you are done, you press the button to erase and start over. There are also magnets you put on the back of it so you can put it on a metal door.

HOW DOES THIS WORK FOR US?
We love this. When it comes to jobs that need to be done, I make a list and then people do the jobs, cross out the ones done and when the list is complete, we erase. We also use it when we plan to go out or need to do something, to leave messages to each other. It also helps when we put the pets out to remind ourselves they are out there in case of rain.

THE BOTTOM LINE
We love this board. We put it on our metal outside door between our screen door so it is not outside or on our refrigerator. We really use it a lot and find it very handy.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. Great item to have.

title: Handy To Have On Long Trips, Or While Camping (Unique Use Of It In Review)
text:
It had been a while since we needed to be able to use a device like this, but finally we had the chance. Here is a brief outline of the experience.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This is a power inverter which uses the power of the car to enable you to power up simple things like a laptop (as long as it does not have too high of a draw), cell phones, tablets, etc. You can also use conventional plugs for something like a mattress inflating device etc. The cord is pretty short that comes with it, so you have to have longer cables if you plan to use this in the back.

There is the option to use the cigarette lighter in the front (if you have one) or the battery itself if you are camping for instance using the black and red clamps that come with this.

HOW DOES IT PERFORM?
This is not a "move your house into your car" type item. It is sufficient to charge phones, tablets, laptop that is not too high of a draw, but it is not going to run a household on a campsite. For us inflating a mattress and using it to recharge phones and a tablet for games is what we purposed it for. It performed very well for the task.

CAMPING
Our son who is a bit of an electronic tinkerer managed to get a car battery that was from a junked car, charge it on a charger at home and then take the inverter with him camping using the car battery as the base to work from for the week that he was camping. He ran Christmas lights at night, MP3 player recharged as well as a speakder and then used it sparingly to keep the phones charged and mattresses filled. The inverter worked beautifully and the campsite was the "home away from home"

NOTE ABOUT INSTRUCTIONS
I found the instructions lacking in this, but if you look around online, or have a tinker guy in the house like our son, you will be just fine and find what you need to run it.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a handy device that works from your car, or as our son rigged up a car batter from a junked car for a camping trip, this is a great little inverter to have. It has short cords, but if you make sure to have longer cords to reach the back seat if traveling, you should be able to make it work.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I like this little thing, and even though it is not overly powerful, it suits our needs just fine.

title: This Keyboard Causes A Lot Of Fights
text:
When I got this keyboard, I figured it would be a nice backup for my very old keyboard. I really prefer a split keyboard, so I figured that one of my kids would get this. Then I used it.and the fights started..

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This keyboard is really cool. It has a brushed metallic background with highly raised keys. The keys have a great spring and are well spaced. You can use it on one color or set various color settings when you are using it. It also comes with a mouse which has the same color capabilities.

HOW IS THE KEYBOARD TO USE?
This keyboard is really nice. It has an excellent spring to it. They keys to make a bit of noise, but not too much. The keys are easy to press and the excellent spring makes it pretty good to type on. If this was a split keyboard, it would be absolutely PERFECT.

GAMING
My kids play with this for gaming and they like it a lot. It has worked well and seems accurate, so all are happy on the gaming front.

MOUSE?
The mouse is surprisingly comfortable. I have used it several times when my regular mouse was acting up. I enjoyed it a lot. It seems to be accurate and works well. I did not find anything I did not like about it.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a really well made keyboard that is easy to use, really cool light up colors, and has accuracy and a nice spring to the keys, this is a great set. Our family loves it and often fights over who will get to use it next.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. Great set. I will probably end up letting the kids have this due to my need for split keyboard/ergonomic keyboard due to wrist issues, but don't tell them that, OK? The COLORS are so FUN!

title: Absolutely PERFECT For Our Business Files, DEFINITELY Worth It For Us
text:
My daughter and I decided to start a small jewelry business. We have a lot of files that we need to keep stored in a place that is easy to get to, easy to use, stands up on its own, yet is not too big. When I saw this satchel bag, I was hoping it would be perfect. Let's take a look..

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This satchel is just like the photo. It is very stiff which means that it stand up on its own. The leather is VERY thick. There are two handles.

HANDLES
The top handle is thick and easy to carry. It is strong and sturdy. It is put on in such a way that the weight of the contents won't pull the handle off the satchel easily. The strap that comes with this has an interesting hook system which allows you to put it quickly on the loops on the sides. That allows for shoulder, or cross body carrying.

CLASP
The clasp is a strong metal clasp which stays shut nicely. There is a piece of leather to help pull the clasp apart when opening.

LINING
The lining is a very sturdy twill fabric. It seems to be extremely sturdy and looks like it will last a long time. The lining is done perfectly. The construction is HIGH QUALITY

POCKETS AND SECTIONS
There is a zipper pocket on the back wall of the satchel. The pocket goes to the bottom of the back piece so it is deep. There are three sections which have a lot of room in there for a laptop, files, and other storage necessary.

CREDIT CARD HOLDER
The front section has four sections which are sewn perfectly for credit cards and other plastic cards. It is sewn so that the cards are all visible in each pocket- very nicely done. Each pocket can hold two or three cards if necessary.

PEN AND PHONE HOLDER
There are two loops for pens and they can hold a pen that is fairly large so they are not too small. They are leather and do not stretch. there is also a phone pocket out of leather which is large enough for a small smart phone, but a larger phone might have to be put into the back pocket.

EASE OF USE
This is a great satchel. We can put all of our bank folders in there, paperwork, laptop to work on the website, our cards we need, as well as paperwork for at least a year or two of business. If it takes off, we will get a larger container. When you put this down, it stands up and does not slouch down or fall down. I LOVE THAT FEATURE.

WIDTH OF BOTTOM PIECE
The bottom piece allows for this satchel to expand at least 3 inches or a bit more.

CARE?
I plan to keep this well oiled with neatsfoot oil- the same stuff they use for baseball mitts.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a very sturdy HEAVY DUTY satchel that stands up, has great storage space and is beautifully made, this is fantastic. I have to say we are both very impressed with it and it will serve us well as we start our fledgling business. The is great for any business person who is hard on items. It will stand up well.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I really love this and am very glad to have it.

title: One Of The Best Designed Backpacks I Have Seen (Looks Like Jeans Too)
text:
My family uses a lot of backpacks. We use them for travel, storage, camping, hiking, and transporting a lot of things wherever we need to go. Let's see how this one measures up..

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This backpack looks like a pair of jeans. It is black canvas with contrast stitching that is beige. It has a lot of tacking stitches and reinforcement stitching on it.

CAPACITY
This has great pockets and storage. It expands a lot to hold many things. The inside back has padding to keep things from poking through to the back. The main compartment is large enough to hold a LOT of books or other things. It has a small zipper compartment to hold keys, change, cards, etc.

FRONT POCKETS/COMPARTMENTS
The front compartments are very nice and large. The first one is quite deep and will hold small notebooks, pads, and other smaller things- but it is fairly deep so it will hold a lot.

The next front compartment has a pleated angled pocket which will hold quite a bit too. There is a small zipper compartment above that (all of these on the outside easily accessed) that holds small items and will even hold a phone.

SIDES
The sides have elastic pockets on them which will hold bottled water or other things you might need to stick in there.

LOOPS
There is a band of loops which you can use to put things through or hook them to.

SIDE BANDS
There are bands on the side which are adjustable that you can use to pull in the backpack if it is not full so it does not stick out so far.

SHOULDER STRAPS
The shoulder straps are padded and comfortable.

WAIST STRAP
The waist strap has pockets on each side which are shaped like fanny packs. They zip shut and hold many things too.

ROLL STRAPS
At the top of the shoulder straps are two straps that are adjustable that you can use to put a bedroll or other similar object. We have also used it for a tripod for camera.

ZIPPER QUALITY
The zippers on this are very nice quality and heavy duty looking.

WATER REPELLANT?
This seems water repellant, but I have not had it out in a pouring rain storm yet, so I can not report on that kind of water. It would not hurt to spray this with water proof spray like you get for camping equipment just to be safe.

OVER ALL PERFORMANCE
Whoever designed this, really thought it out well. I am VERY impressed with the way it is set up and how it works when on my back. We all like this one and it gets a lot of use.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Well designed and thought out, this backpack will give a lot of storage room if you need it, or you can adjust it for lighter loads too. For camping or urban journeys, this is very versatile. I am VERY impressed with it.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. One of the nicest out there and very well set up. I am impressed with this one.

title: Great To Have for Taxes, Business, and School Use
text:
This keyboard is COOL- that was what my teen daughter said to me as soon as she came back with it and her evaluation. I did not even know she had taken it! Let's take a look..

WHAT IS THIS KEYBOARD LIKE?
This numerical keyboard is great if you have a laptop or keyboard with a frustrating numerical option. The keyboard is nice and big- but not so big that you can not fit it anywhere near the laptop or desktop. It has raised keys with excellent spring to them. The keys have a great bright backlight for using in subdued lighting. It also has the ability to change the lighting if you like.

PLUG IN?
This is plug and play. We tried it on laptops and desktops and it worked great on all of them.

EASY TO USE?
You can use the function key to change to a wide variety of options using mathematical symbols and currency too. The keys are very easy to press and the spring it has makes it adaptable to fast figures of lots of numbers.

BRING UP CALCULATOR
There are gray keys which allow you to choose what function at a glance you want to do. Just press the function key and the gray key you want and BAM- there it is. You can even bring up the calculator using this method. It is VERY handy.

DIFFERENT LIGHTING
You can have continual lighting, breathing lighting, responsive lighting, and turn the lighting off. You can also use the NUM key to disable it like you do with your keyboard.

HOW DOES IT PLUG IN?
This uses USB and has a USB to mini USB cord that comes with it for plugging in.

CAN YOU USE THIS AND LEAVE YOUR KEYBOARD PLUGGED IN?
Yes, I can use both simultaneously if I want- although I am not sure why I would want to.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a very handy numerical pad to have. It makes tax time easy! We also found it helpful for schoolwork and also for doing business figures. It is easy to use and the keys are wonderful for fast tallies.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. We all love this and use it often. We especially like it because it enables us to use any laptop or desktop for FAST figures and processing a lot of numbers. The function keys are great too.

title: Durable High Performance Speaker- Even Coworker Has One!
text:
Having outdoor safe speakers is essential for my household. Not only do I have audiophiles who are addicted to headphones and speakers, I have a husband who insists on taking his speakers to outdoor jobs. that is fine except when the job turns out to have a sudden rainstorm or high dust going on. Before giving it to him, I had our daughter put it through the grind at work (food prep) and in town events. Let's see how this speaker performs..

WHAT IS THIS SPEAKER LIKE?
This speaker is gray in color. The housing is very rubbery in consistency. The right side of the speaker has sealed controls under a rubberized pad over top of the buttons. The speaker stays put and is heavier than expected.

ON/OFF BUTTON/PAIRING
Holding down for over a second powers up the speaker. Next to the power button is the PAIRING button. This is not for pairing the speaker to a device but it is for pairing with another speaker just like it. A coworker with my daughter has this speaker and they tested it out- works GREAT so you now get two synced speakers.

CALLS BUTTON
You can send and receive calls with this button. You can also access your voice commands on your phone with this button.

VOLUME BUTTON
This is plus or minus sound controls. You can also skip by holding down- + is forward, - is backward.

PAUSE/PLAY
You can control pausing and playing with this button.

DOCKING
USB for charging, mini USB port (to use to charge a device if need be), and auxiliary outlet for like an old MP3 player or other device that does not have Bluetooth capability.

CHARGING INDICATOR LIGHT
Red when charging and turns white when fully charged. Will indicate when the power is running low so you will know.

SOUND QUALITY
Sound quality with this is very good. My daughter has a coworker with the same speaker so they both have had a chance to experiment with their speakers. So far it has been a great speaker. The balance of the recording of course affects the speaker, but so far it has not been overly muffled, out of balance, etc. Where you put the speaker affects how it sounds too.

When put on the floor, it really does sound better than on, say top of a box, or couch, etc. A very hard surface seems to really make it sound best.

VOLUME
When using the volume controls on the speaker, the sound is better than when you use the volume controls on the device (tablet, phone, etc).

DURABILITY
This speaker was taken to a huge town chicken and biscuit dinner and was dropped and still is working perfectly.

BATTERY
Two 10 hour shifts at full volume, and this speaker kicked through it all before needing to be recharged.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a really nice durable speaker that is dustproof, shock proof, and supposedly water proof, this is a good choice. It is solid, has decent sound , and even can be synced with another speaker if you get two of these for coverage around a room.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is a decent speaker, and I feel more comfortable having my husband use this on his jobs than the other really nice speaker he was beating up.

title: Wonderful Sound Quality, Lady's Voice Creeps Daughter Out
text:
There is always a run on headphones in our house. Not only are they being lost or dying, but everyone is on a constant quest for the best design and sound they can find in a bluetooth headphone. Let's see how these measure up.

WHAT ARE THESE HEADPHONES LIKE?
These headphones have a long sturdy neck band which means they will fit a variety of neck sizes. Each ear piece has a magnet on it so that when you are not using them, they will close in front of you so you won't lose them. The controls are at the end of the neck band on the right side.

ON/OFF BUTTON
Play, pause, on/off, pair can be done with this button.

VOLUME
