I thought this was also a gripping type. I thought all Speck Pixel cases were gripping.

It's a cloth type material that doesn't grip at all. The hard shield is on one side only. They suggest that side be used for the screen side.

Wish it had a velcro type enclosure or zipper. It is a loose flap type enclosure, with no seal.

It's good for placing my naked IPAD in during non use. Also good for travel purposes. Especially if the IPAD is put in a hand carry baggage.

Biggest problem with these is they only work with the naked IPAD. I have to remove the protective case to use it, and that's a pain. Also lessens protection.

I contacted Speck and apparently they don't have any sleeves that fit an IPAD that has a protective case on it. They suggested I buy their 13 inch case. That would shake it around pretty good.

title: An excellent choice for many audio devices.
text:
Great sound. Very attractive. Primary use: For my Grace Internet Tuner.
Easy to connect. Subwoofer is very heavy.

Big negative.

There isn't a wireless remote control.

I ran all my devices through my TV audio out to this system.
Much better sound than my 42 Vizio razor.
With my Vizio, you need to turn the TV speakers off through the menu, for the audio out to work.
This means the TV or Direct TV remote, no longer controls the audio.
Was watching TV and a call came in. No wireless remote means no mute bottom.
You have to get up each time you want to adjust the volume or mute it. That's a big negative.

Not a problem if these are your computer speakers, and to be fair, they are sold as computer speakers.
However they are very nice speakers for a TV, a Blu Ray, wireless internet radio.
Who wants to get up each time you want to change the sound?

Biggest negative of all is no optical.

Definitely recommend. Though-the newer version is more versatile.

title: Very Clear Set for Google Voice Use.  Mac Problem.
text:
I purchased these primarily for Google Voice. GV recommended by Clark Howard.

Very clear phone set. People on the other end have no idea that I'm not on a regular phone.
Now I can call anywhere domestically totally free. Cost of this handset was the only phone cost.

Two issues though.

Intended to use these with my MacBook Pro. However, the USB adapter appears oversized, and will not fit unless I remove the other USB cable. Inconvenient to remove my other USBs each time. So I connected this to my old Dell, which is my backup computer. Worked fine on the Dell. For the Apple Mac Book Pro, I use a two lead logitech, and only plug in the headphone jack. Works fine.

Other issues. My wife says it's too heavy for her to feel comfortable. She uses the $19 logitech instead., The mute button is not labeled. My wife made a call and the other party couldn't hear her. I got out the instructions, and they showed an unmarked mute button. It turns out when my wife picked up the headphones, she touched that button and disabled the mic. A red light indicates the mic is in mute. Tap the earphone, and sound comes back.

Summary. Not for MacBook Pro. Great for PC.

title: Light, VG picture, easy install of base.  Good price
text:
This is my 4th HDTV, and my 3rd Vizio (one returned), so I think I can write a worthwhile review.

This replaces my 4 year old 37 inch Magnavox HDTV. Was very pleased with it. No problems. Still sharp picture. However, the color was no longer vibrant. Moved it to a spare room for Wii play. I think LCD TVs are good for 4 years max - due to color fading. To be clear, color fading is tolerable in the kitchen TV, and bedrooms, but not in my main TV.

I am satisfied with my one year old 32 inch Vizio kitchen LCD HD, and went with Vizio again.

Since I was going from 37 to 42 inches, and have a glass stand, I wanted a light TV. This weighs under 40 pounds, with stand.
Easy to handle. The base had a single screw (directions said 4, not true), which you hand tighten. Easy installation. The Magnavox base was difficult to install. Had to call their tech support for help.

These come with a good instruction manual, and are very easy to setup. Sound is good. Picture, very good in HD, good in standard. Soon, all programs will be in HD. Blu Ray discs look great, as do sports events and movies.

Purchased at my local warehouse club, as their extended contract pricing is very low. I have had surge damage, on several occasions, and buy these warranties to protect against that. Great price for a TV less than 2 inches thin.

title: Private label.  Defective
text:
Latest update.

I filed a complaint with Amazon.

Let me explain what I think the problem is.

First, of course, the correct product is not being shipped.

Secondly, there were no directions on mine. It turned out, the final white tab to be removed is supposed to remove the entire piece of plastic that covers the protector. Since the tab tears off without removing the top layer,we think the top layer is the protector. When I decided to throw the protectors away immediately, I removed the top layer, and didn't realize the remaining layer was the protector. I saw the bubbles and I thought my screen was ruined. Then I thought that maybe, the bubbles are caused by a remaining layer. Again from the bottom, (at the hole), I removed the actual protector. All the bubbles disappeared.

Finally: I guess there is no such thing as "IKROSS Screen Protector." For some reason, comments on this site indicate it's a name brand. I googled. Can't find anything other than these these cheap protectors with various names on them. Amazon should delete the Ikross name since it seems like every vendor ships their own whatever.

Original review.

This is the Blue Harbor private label brand.

There are two tabs on each piece. The inside tab removed easily prior to application.

The outside tab, which is to be removed after application, would not come off.

Now I have a white tab down the upper left corner of the IPOD, which looks lousy.

Would not buy again.

UPDATE. Decided to remove it and throw all 3 out. Not taking a chance on having it damage my screen.

Amazon needs to do something about this.

title: Logitech warranty support was great.
text:
At about the 9 month mark, one of the connectors broke. One of the two you drop the IPOD into two. I called Logitech. I expected to be told that it wouldn't be covered. We are very careful putting the IPOD Touch in the dock, and just two adults. This was the first Logitech item that I ever had fail.

My call was taken quickly, and after explaining the problem, they said it was covered.
A week or so later, got a new one delivered by UPS (or was it FedX?).

Outstanding. Was already a Logitech consumer. This cements it.

Prior comments:

Fixed the dock adapter problem I mentioned below.

I didn't realize it had to be snapped into place.
The white adapter that came with the IPOD works fine now. Left the comment in case anyone else has this issue.

Excellent sound. Like the large volume dial in front. Attractive.

Easy to read the time at night, yet does not light up the room and make it difficult to fall asleep. My wife complained about my Sony clock radio all the time.

The default (already inserted) docking insert is the only one that works with my 3 rd gen IPOD Touch.
The white Apple dock that came with the IPOD doesn't fit properly. The IPOD can't make full contact with the Logitech and so no sound.

Using the larger default dock makes the IPOD a little jiggly, but the sound is excellent, and it doesn't cause any problems.
Would appreciate feedback from others on this issue.

title: Small, attractive, rechargeable, VG sound.  AM Signal has static.
text:
Update. I just reduced my rating from 5 stars to 4 stars.
The FM reception is superb. FM tuning is superb. However, I just don't get a static free signal on AM. At least not indoors. Static on all stations. Yet FM is superb. Don't know enough to explain why. Live within 8 miles of Dayton Ohio, a mid sized city, with many stations. Even the Cincinnati superstation, WLW 700 has static.

Wanted a radio for the house and yard that was easy to carry, had good sound, easy to use, and used inexpensive AA rechargeable batteries. This radio includes an AC plug/charger. Fits the bill. This is a very attractive radio.

I use Sanyo Eneloop batteries, and have used these batteries for several years.
The radio will actually recharge these batteries without removing them from the radio.

I did purchase a clear acrylic radio stand from Amazon for $ 7.99. Highly recommend this.
The manufacturer recommends a stand. Keeps it off grass in the yard, and from tipping over.

This radio will replace two larger radios with poorer sound. It will also replace a large Sony Boombox. The Sony is nice, but too big to carry around, and even for placement in most rooms.

Finally. I was planning to buy a logitech internet capable squeezebox radio. 25% of reviewers rated the logitech 3 stars or less. Considering the ratings,and the fact that the logitech wouldn't let me listen to my AM ball game station, and the cost difference, this radio seemed by far the more sensible buy.

title: Perfect HD PQ on my TV.
text:
I purchased this cable to hook up my Apple laptop to my HDTV. I wanted to keep my laptop on the computer desk, rather than move it back and forth near the TV.

Watched Secret Life of a Teenager. PQ was perfect HD. This HDMI cable has to be good.
This is a good show to test PQ quality on. It really was equal to my HD satellite transmission. I have 8000 kbps download speed.

It did go out once for a few seconds. I may not have had the cable fastened securely.

I'm still amazed that with the computer on the desk, I can point my logitech remote mouse at the HDTV screen, and it works perfectly, as if it were the monitor. These long cables really are useful.

title: MacBook Pro to HDMI.  Late 2009 Mac (new one).
text:
Did not work initially, so I ordered two more cables I didn't need. With Amazon Prime, you can't cancel.

My problem. Hooked up the mini display to the Macbook Pro. Hooked the HDMI side to a 3 ft. HDMI cable. Hooked the audio cable in.

Only an inch of the page was showing, on the HDTV. Bright purple colors on the rest. Tried resetting everything on the TV and computer. Nothing. Then ordered another type adapter. Then went to comments on other sites.

My problem. The default setting on my laptop was set to scan. To fix. Go to the Apple logo, then system preference, then display, click display, click arrangement, click set mirror image. Worked instantly. I'm surprised no one else had this problem, or mentioned it. Glad someone on another site detailed the fix. Watched cable show, ABC family channel in near perfect 720P HD.

The other cables I ordered were the mini display to DVI, and the Dvi to HDMI. My Vizio actually recommends this set up. I'll try it, but there is little room for improvement.

A word on my setup. I placed the Apple under my Kitchen TV, a 32 inch 720P Vizio. This meant a wireless transmission. Hooked the short HDMI and audio cables in place. I used the Apple wireless keyboard and Logitech V220 wireless mouse, on my kitchen table, to do everything without bending. No cables across floor. Despite wireless transmission on G router, approx 40 ft, just a few seconds of buffering.

title: Agree with Consumer Reports Best Buy Rating.
text:
I originally purchased a 26 Vizio VA 10T. I had some initial problems and read the warranty. On TVs less than 32 inches, Vizio requires that you ship the TV to California at your expense. I don't think so. I returned it to Walmart, and then purchased this TV at Sams. In home service on this one.

This TV has much higher quality and workmanship than the 26 inch model. Excellent PQ, VG sound, VG viewing angle, no glare. . The cable hookups go in horizontally, while the 26 inch model had vertical hookups. The vertical hookups would be fine with a wall mount, but were difficult to use on my stand.

Cons. Remote is pretty basic, and the menu is somewhat confusing. Since this is used with Direct TV, I only use the Vizio remote to change some preferences.

Addressing comments on Walmart purchases. Consider this. I initially purchased the 26 inch model. I paid a pre BF price of $ 248, reg. $ 327-348. At $ 248, my 3 year extended warranty was $ 19.99. I wasn't happy withe TV, returned it, and did not have to pay a restocking charge (hello-Best Buy). I had to open the Box, and remove the TV, to get to and read the warranty. Only then did I find out I needed to ship the TV to California, at my expense, for warranty work. Even under the Wally 3 year extended warranty, the mfg terms still applied. So for any warranty work, I needed to ship it at my expense. I think it stinks that companies don't disclose the significant terms of their warranty more prominently, prior to purchase. Their behavior sticks you with restocking fees. Love this 32 inch Vizio. Go for it.

title: Am happy with this item.
text:
I have Direct TV with HD service, but purchased this for a bedroom HDTV that isn't used enough to justify the $ 5 a month added satellite cost.

Purchased this to replace archaic and obtrusive 10 year old rabbit ears. Reception stayed the same. I get High Definition perfectly on 3 local broadcast stations. Get standard definition VG on 5 others that don't broadcast in HD. Gave 3 stars because there was no improvement. However, I am a satisfied customer because I no longer have rabbit ears sticking up. My wife couldn't tolerate that.

It's obvious that old fashioned rabbit ears get High Definition stations as clear as satellite, just not as many.

title: Returned it after 6 days.
text:
I just returned this TV after 6 days.

Pros: Great over the air picture. Great HDMI when it worked.
Cons. Ranged from great picture, to all pink, to no picture at all on HDMI settings. When I changed to over the air, perfect picture. Back to HDMI, no picture.

I kept rebooting, kept checking my connections. I think I had a bad HDMI board. I was disappointed as I paid $ 248 plus $ 20 for the 3 year extended protection package. As Vizio requires you to ship the TV to them in California, at your expense, for all warranty work on TVs under 32 inches, it wasn't worth keeping.

I returned this, and went next door to Sams Club and purchased the Vizio VO 320E for $ 338. This 32 inch size qualifies for in home service. I took Sams extended warranty. The quality is so much better than the 26 inch. Cable inputs are sensibly placed, not like the 26 inch model that requires you to perform acrobatics to hook up. Great picture and sound on this one. A Consumer Reports Best Buy.

Original review on Vizio 26.

I purchased this TV 2 days ago at Walmart, on sale at $248. Paid $ 19.99 to extend the warranty to 3 years. However, the Walmart warranty doesn't kick in until the Vizio warranty ends. Excellent PQ and VG sound. I expect to return the TV this week. Why? Vizio Warranty: With TVs less than 32 inches, Vizio requires the customer to ship the TV-at your expense- to some unidentified location. Not good. If they don't find a warrantied problem, you pay return shipping and probably the diagnostic cost.

On day one, the sound went out, and I had to pull the plug out, to reboot and get the sound back. On day 1, and day 2, the TV sometimes was all pink when turned on. More rebooting. Given the Vizio warranty terms, I don't want to take a chance and keep it. If there was a local authorized service center, I might take a chance.

title: Second update.  Another freeze.
text:
Second update. Played Stone Angel DVD. Froze for 3 minutes at the 1:16 mark. Played the same scene again using my Sony upscaling DVD. Played perfectly. Replayed the same scene again in the BD 60. Again froze at the exact same point. Definitely a BD60 problem. My firmware is current.

Update: Joined Netflix. Two Blue Ray movies so far. Slumdog Millionaire played perfectly. However there was an 11 minute freeze on Benjamin Buttons. Freeze from 1:16-1:27. I rebooted twice and tried different fixes. Nothing worked. I was never able to view these 11 minutes. I have the latest firmware update.

Original review. I came close to a 3 star rating. Contrary to other comments, I think the remote is confusing. I'm still using the manual when I watch TV, and I know my wife will never use it. I have my Sony DVD with upgrade ability on top of my Blue Ray, and plan to use it on regular DVDs. The Sony remote is so easy to use, and so feature packed. This Panasonic has excellent Blue Ray quality, and great sound. Just watched Slumdog Millionaire, played to perfection.

Firmware upgrade was painless, easily downloads You Tube (turned out to be a very enjoyable feature). Watched Neil Diamond in concert, from You Tube, to my TV, in VG quality. However, I just joined Netflix, and am disappointed there is no Netflix capability. I knew this when I ordered, buy I didn't realize how expensive the Amazon VOD program is. I will probably replace this new Panasonic with one that downloads Netflix, and give this to my daughter. Don't want Roku, though I have read mostly good things about it.

My equipment. Maganavox 720 P (not high end, 3 years old, but stunning picture). Hooked Blue Ray using component cables, since TV will only display 720 P. Sony receiver-no HDMI inputs. It's 10 years ago, but was high end. Using Linksys router, Linksys switcher. Roadrunner Cable running at about 6 MB.

title: VHS to DVD.  Worked perfectly the first time out.
text:
I had already transferred all my 8 and super 8 tapes to VHS. I purchased this item to transfer my VHS tapes to DVD. The setup is very easy, and the process was flawless. Make sure you finalize. Everything is clearly explained in the manual. My only problem is that I forgot how poor the quality of VHS tapes is, compared to what we have today. I'm trying to borrow a working Hi 8 camcorder, so I can input via the camcorder, and get better copies. So if you have VHS tapes to turn into DVDs, this is a great item. This item will pay for itself quickly.

The manual makes it clear that most discs are acceptable. I used Maxwell, DVD +R, 4.7, 16X, 2 hrs. It appears that DVD-R DL is not supported. DVD+R DL is also only partially supported. Also, CD-R, CD-RW, and 8-cm DVD are not supported.

I think a cost effective approach will be to purchase a Sony 60 GB, standard definition Hard Drive camcorder, and then use this machine to record everything onto the disc. Probably saves a lot on memory sticks, or whatever. I'll be watching Thanksgiving sales for the camcorder.

title: Adds a great look.  Instant plug and play.
text: I usually replace my computer every 4 years.  This time I'm going to upgrade my 4 year old Dell.  This keyboard is my first step.  Contrary to one review, the lighting can be brightened or lowered easily.  Sound adjustment is nice.  Nothing to be dissapointed about here.  It is a corded model.  My first Logitech product. Glad I made the purchase.

title: Very dissapointed.  Horrible remote.
text:
Have had this for several years. The player actually works okay for both VCR and DVD use.

However, the remote control is so poorly designed, I rarely use the unit. The buttons are small, and as another reviewer commented, pressing menu takes you back to the main setup, and you have to start over. It's too bad, because as I said, I have had no technical issues with the DVD play, VCR play, or memory card. You will regret buying this unit. I use component hookup for my DVD, and have the sound connected to a Sony receiver control center. No technical issues at all. Still only a one. What a horrible remote.

title: Very attractive and functional.
text:
I purchased this 2 years ago for my 37 inch LCD HDTV.

Easy to assemble. Looks fantastic.
Very stable.

Con. The manual didn't give a max weight for a TV. It said accomodates most. What does that mean? I have my TV on top; my Wii, Direct TV DVR, and my combo VCR/DVD player on the middle shelf. I have a large Sony receiver on the bottom shelf, along with the Wii Fit board. Holds a lot of weight. I'd feel comfortable with an LCD of any size. Not sure about Plasma TV sizes.

title: Walmart charges twice as much.  Great with my Garmin 255.
text:
Purchased one at Walmart for $ 27, 2 weeks ago, to go with my new Garmin 255 (purchased from Amazon). Works great with my Garmin. Like it much better than the window mount. Seemed expensive. Then I saw this on Amazon for $ 13.22. Ordered it. It is identical to the Walmart one. Has a different name on the packaging, but is identical. Returning the Walmart one this afternoon. The item is probably worth $ 15 max.

I'm very satisfied with the item.

title: Outstanding HD picture.  VG SD picture.  VG DVD.
text:
One year update. Still works great.

I just hooked up this TV to satellite with HD service. HD picture is outstanding, and SD is very good. DVD player is excellent. Good sound. I wanted a built in DVD, so my grandson can watch his DVDs in the kitchen, rather than the big TV.

Only a 90 day labor warranty, so consider an extended warranty. My only complaint is that I can't get my Direct TV remote to turn the TV on/off. Otherwise, controls the TV and DVD. I'm thinking the DVD feature is confusing the remote. The TV off switch defaults to DVD. Easy to push the on/off button on the tv, so the problem is very minor. Since I can control volume, I know I have the right code.

This is my second HDTV. Have Direct TV DVRs hooked on both, Both are 720 P. Both have outstanding pictures. A+++ on this TV.

title: Wow.  Stunned at how great a GPS is.  My first.
text: Purchased 2 weeks ago, and used to drive from Ohio to Boston.  1600 miles RT.  My first GPS.  I was totally blown away with these fantastic devices. Great voice quality, easy to read graphics. Shows shortest and best routes. Mapquest can't compare. I exited an interstate that didn't have a return ramp.  The GPS saved me.  Back on in 5 minutes. Can't believe how instantaneous the transmission is.  It made one mistake (twice), the entire trip.  Told me to turn right, when it should have been left. Repeated the mistake on the same off ramp turn, on the return trip. It instantly recognized the error and gave accurate directions to get to my hotel. It gave me the exact speed limit of each road I was traveling.  Instantly recognized changes in the speed limit. I passed on the factory Nav on my new Honda Ridgeline, after several friends told me the Garmins are better. One uses a portable Garmin, even though his new BMW has factory Nav. Incredibly easy to program.  Thought they were an extravagance, when you can get a mapquest printout for free.  Boy, was I wrong.

title: Amazing camera for the price
text: In September, based on last year's Consumer Report recommendations, I purchased both this camera and the Canon S3 for a vacation in Japan. This Pentax was to be my back up. I always carry a second camera. Too many horror stories of ruined vacations.  I used this camera for 260 photos and 3 videos. The Canon for 30 photos.  Incredibly, other than the excellent S3 zoom feature, no quality difference between the Optio and Canon S3. I did use primarily the auto focus in both. Excellent videos, longer than the S3.  Took good low light photos in the Tsujki fish market in early dawn hours, and good outside night photos of lighted buildings in Ginza. Some red eye effect. Awesome pet photos.  You can see every strand of hair on my chow chow. This camera is very easy to use, and takes SDHC cards.  It replaces a camcorder, with excellent sound quality, and is an excellent photo camera.  Original pair of AA batteries died quickly.  Lithium replacements are outstanding.  No viewfinder makes it more difficult in sunshine. On my return, I ordered two more as Christmas gifts for my adult children.  A great gift at a silly list price.  Go figure.  Final note.  I purchased a holster pack fitted at my local camera store, to carry my camera on my belt.  Small enough to fit perfectly.  Stayed on my belt during the long flight to/from Tokyo. Hugged the seat belt. Barely knew it was there.

title: Works well, but pricey....
text: Does what it says, seems like it is priced double of what it should be...

title: Worth it!
text: Well made with many pre-drilled/pre-formed mounting holes for keeping out of the elements. The pre-cut out holes for wires make it easy too!  Has locking ability, but I don't use it.  A good deal!

title: Four Stars
text: Good, but had a bit if a problem programming.  The staff was very helpful though.

title: Five Stars

title: Fast and easy install!
text: Fast & easy  install!  Wound up buying 4 after received overwhelming support from neighbors through nextdoor.com.  Took less than 2 hours to install- works like a champ!

title: Great support!
text: 2nd Call in a week for tech support - all my fault -  Walter was VERY helpful getting things right between my Mac,  mini iPad and iPhone.  Great support!

title: Solid, well-built, high quality unit - but doesn't work with 12.9" iPad Pro
text: I just had this delivered and immediately put my 12.9" iPad Pro onto it.  It will hold up the iPad tilted to be mostly vertical.  But if you tap near the top of the tablet, it falls backward.  If you just tilt it to make the iPad more horizontal, it falls backward.  They should not be saying it works with a 12.9" iPad because it does not.  To do that, it would need a bigger base putting more weight in front (so that it doesn't tip back).

title: Works perfectly for "Rechargeable Dual Rockin’ Rabbit"
text: Works perfectly to recharge our "CalExotics SE-1843-20-3 Silicone Rechargeable Dual Rockin’ Rabbit® Enhancer."

title: Best Lightning cable I've ever experienced.  Outlasted every other brand.
text: I am very hard on Lightning cables because I use them in my car where the angle at both ends (USB end and Lightning end) are bent back and forth every day.  I've been satisfied with AmazonBasics, Syncwire, Anker, and other brands.  I always buy braided.  Those others were fine.  Anker lasted 3-4 months which is not great.  Syncwire and AmazonBasics lasted maybe 9 months.  This Fospower one I'm using now has been working for over a year with no sign of breaking down!  I bought a two-pack and just today I am pulling out the second one to put in my suitcase for travel because it appears I will never need to replace the one in my car!

title: Five Stars
text: Works perfectly

title: Excellent customer services makes me trust Anker
text:
The thing looks and feels great. The finish is soft-touch and it feels very high quality. Looks great sitting on the shelf. Button integration is great.

When I had an issue, Anker contacted me, and they made it right. Definitely willing to trust Anker again.

title: Excellent - best Blu-Ray player I've owned
text:
Works perfectly. Have used it quite a bit over the last few months and had no problems.

The remote is excellent. It was important to me to get a remote that had non-uniform buttons so that I could tell the difference in the dark and be able to pause, fast forward, and rewind without turning the lights on. This remote is great. You can differentiate the buttons just by touch, and just in case, the buttons also light up.

Would absolutely buy this again and I will buy it again if it fails.

I bought this refurbished and have had no problems whatsoever.

Only design problem: the touch-sensitive buttons on the actual unit for opening and closing the disc tray. WHY would they use these instead of real buttons? I have no idea. Frustrating because you can't tell if you've hit the button or not. But this problem is not bad enough for me to deduct a star.

title: Perfect
text: Works perfectly.  Wish all my Lightning cables worked this well.  If anything, these are better than the cables manufactured by Apple.

title: Amazing cables! They Are Great. They got me a date and now a long distance GF!
text:
So the obvious first part of this is that the cables are red. My cable theft problem is way way down.

Not many people rock the bright red 6 foot cable and honestly I couldn't be happier.
You would be surprised how often at the airport while charging my phone someone will ask me if I have a "special cable" to which I reply "yes" because it seems like in today's society an adult showing a little flair tends to be a bit unusual.
My most recent interaction was while on a trip to California where my bright red cable struck up a conversation with an intrigued female. We started speaking before boarding the plan and just genuinely hit it off.

We even rearranged our seats on the plane to sit next to each other.
We flew from NYC to SF where I learned many lovely things about her.
She works in tech and was in NYC for a meeting. I work in NYC and was on my way out to Lake Tahoe for a boys trip.
Coincidentally I was staying at a friends place around the corner from her apartment in Oakland.

I flew in on a Thursday and had all day Friday to wait for my friends to get out of work so we could drive to Tahoe.
I asked her out to Rosenblum Cellars around the corner from us and we had an amazing date and are now dating exclusively

Because of our jobs we see each other every two weeks and so far it is working great! Thanks Anker!

Nonetheless the cable works flawlessly.

It charges quick and its very tough. Other cables have the fatigue problem that you cannot touch them while it is in your phone or it will lose the power flipping from charge to no charge like a dub step remix.

I WIll Tell my children about these cables

title: Cheap and works just fine for my seldom used land line.
text: These just don’t hold a charge as long as the original.

title: Spigen is always making great Accessories
text:
Spigen has been making covers, cases, and screen covers for as long as I've needed one.

They are generally inexpensive yet always feel like a good buy.

This case is no different, I like the product and the price is great also.

Yes, I would recommend this to others.

title: These cables are built great!
text:
These cables are excellent.

First thing you notice is the difference in building quality from Apple. These are a bit thicker and feel very heavy duty.

The covers for the ends feel strong and the thickness of the cable gives confidence into the durability of them.

Just started using them a few days ago and they charge quick and I hope will last for a long time.

Will be buying more for sure.

title: Powerful new cube. No more jumpy fire stick
text:
Redundant compared to fire sticks and the rest of the line but this product is powerful and has reduced load and lag time so I’m happy.

This is an upgrade from the fire stick which got very laggy over the past year.

Haven’t used the voice command yet but it looks to be similar functionality to Alexa that I have on my kindle fire.

title: Works great but it’s gigantic!
text:
This router is awesome! Took some time and YouTube videos to hook up but after firmware update and a couple of tries it was ready to rock.

Clocked in my gigabit speeds at 350 download and 500 upload.

So not quite 1000 but I’m sure I’m topping out something in the chain of internet is being pushed to its max. Maybe the fibre has a bend and isn’t performing fully. Maybe it’s my WiFi set up in my laptop.

350 is still 5 times faster than I was ever getting with old routers so I’m sure it will be fine.

title: Update: Doesn’t line up to my 50 inch Samsung
text:
MOUNTED my tv to an exposed beam in my house. No bounce or anything. It’s a very solid hold. It sits level and looks to hold well.

I don’t understand why this says it’s full motion. As of now I can only tilt the screen up an down a tiny bit and it doesn’t really move that many directions. For swinging side to side though it works great.

Limited functionality but wasn’t expecting that much at such a low price.

Build quality is excllent. Dont be worries about that. Tight hinges and all metal construction.

title: Works Great. 100% compatable with my mutiple kindle fire Devices
text:
Put this card into my Kindle fire and it has worked perfectly.

This is the absolute best bang for my buck chip i can find for Micro SD.

Good quality chip that i have bought many of to expand the size of my devices for very cheap.

title: Good product. Works as intended
text:
Good product. Works as intended.

A little on the heavy side. One of the only things I found that I can plug my laptop into.

title: Didn’t work for me. Tried on multiple occasions. ...
text: Didn’t work for me. Tried on multiple occasions. Not sure what went wrong. Using a new Asus Vivo book S

title: Works great. Exactly what amazon promised
text: Cheap. Works great. Exactly what amazon promised.

title: Perfect for Use with an iPhone!
text:
When I talk to my friends for hours on end the last thing I want to do is hold my iPhone in my hand up to my ear or even be on speaker phone. My husband does not like hearing the speaker phone when he's trying to concentrate on his iPhone. It takes too much effort to talk on a speaker phone for hours. So as soon as I answer the phone I switch over to these headphones and talk through the microphone in the headphones. Perfect!

My friend who calls me once a week sounds like a radio DJ, in fact he used to be one but the headphones make him sound that way just naturally. It is really cute. He's always had a nice voice but this makes him come through like rich stereo sound. At first I thought I was talking to a stranger, but got used to his new voice sound.

You just have to hold the button down for a few seconds and an AI voice tells you what the headphones are doing. So if you are finished with the headset you just press the middle button and it tells you the headset is off. So that saves on battery power and makes it easy to know when the power is on or off. I find that I can make these the best volume easily and have it now where I don't need to change it at all.

My friend who calls me every week told me about these headphones and I bought them on his recommendation. I had these years before I got an iPhone because I prepare ahead of time!!!! Now that I have a new iPhone 14 I'm happy as can be with my headset. Since the microphone is built in this is perfect for phone calls but it also works like a regular headphone if you want to listen to audio on your phone. I haven't started listening to music on it yet but will report back when I do. The sound is just superior to any headphones besides my AKG K553s.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Super Easy-To-Use and Cleans Computer Keyboards Well!
text:
This can of compressed air made my husband really happy as he needed to clean his computer keyboard. After looking at all the options I went with this one because it really did seem like the best choice. It is super easy to use and convenient. It looks like this is a large enough can of air that we will get many uses out of it.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Works Great to Extend Headphone Cords!
text:
Here is the conundrum. I got a new pair of AKG K553s and they apparently have shortened the cord to four feet. That's it! Who does that? I need a much longer cord to reach from my stereo boombox to my bed so I can listen to CDs and the radio in comfort and warmth. This extension cord works great to extend the AKG cord. 25 feet is pretty long and so I can walk around the bedroom too without risking damaging my AKGs. Everything sounds perfect. No reduction in sound quality at all. The cord looks very durable and I'm happy.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Affordable Luxury! Nice Headphone Case Too!
text:
If you have ever owned AKGs before you know they need to be well taken care of. My K553 headphones fell apart in my hands the other day and I was so upset. So I decided to go back to buying the K240s as they seem to last longer. These are the most comfortable AKGs I've owned so far. You can wear them over an hour and they don't hurt your ears.

The bass is a little heavier however. I enjoy using these for classical, electronica and other music that does not have a heavy beat. I find the K553s are better at suppressing the heavier beats so am getting another pair of those too. I think you need both for the full range of music choices.

These are an affordable luxury and music sounds great on them. The headphone case is perfect too if you want your headphones to be protected and last a long time!

~The Rebecca Review

title: Extends My Headphone Cord Four More Feet!
text:
My stereo boombox sits on a table heater on the other side of the room so I needed something to extend the headphone cord. Now if I put the boombox on the floor a little further out and use this extension cable I can sit in bed and enjoy music again. The cord works well and seems very durable.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Transfer Files or Upload Programs Easily
text:
When I found my new computer I neglected to figure out if it had a CD/DVD drive or not. Apparently a lot of computers are not made with one these days and you have to get a separate drive. I almost sent the computer back - then I thought I should look for a CD/DVD drive instead. Good choice! This attaches with a USB cord so is convenient and portable. I just plugged it into the computer and was using it in minutes. I was able to install my new printer no problem. I have also used the drive to transfer files from the old computer to the new one easily. So happy that I found this and very pleased with how reliable it is.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Perfect for Organizing Behind Your Desk
text:
This 8-outlet power strip is excellent and has a really, really long cord which makes it perfect for keeping things organized behind your desk. Very happy with this purchase and have always been impressed with AmazonBasics items. Why not buy the best? :)

~The Rebecca Review

title: Best Sound Quality!
text:
This Boombox has the best sound quality I've ever heard in any small stereo I've ever owned. Everything sounds wonderful and I was especially impressed by how beautiful Christmas music sounds. The instruction pamphlet is very detailed, however I found the buttons very intuitive to use.

To be honest, this Boombox has everything you could wish for besides a remote. That is the only thing I miss about my old CD player. But that CD player only lasted less than a year. I'm hoping this one will last a lot longer.

Some of the features this has include:

Cassette Recording and Playing
Two great speakers for stereo sound
Sleep timer (15, 30, 60 or 90 minutes)
3 Favorite Radio Station Buttons
Audio in for connecting Smartphones, Digital Music Player and other audio devices
Battery Powered (6 C batteries) or AC
Mega Bass button (Press this button and you will have rich sound)
Logical placement of on/off button and volume controls
Ability to listen quietly with headphones

I'm enjoying this Boombox and can recommend it highly for the excellent sound quality. CDs play quietly and listening to favorite music is a true comfort.

~The Rebecca Review

P.S. I just ordered a third one. They last exactly a year from purchase every time. It is the CD player that goes after a year of use. I can't find anything better than this so that is how it goes.

title: Great for Food Photography
text:
Ever since I found this Elph camera I have been having way too much fun. My last camera did not focus properly and had issues with blurry photographs. Not this one...it focuses perfectly and the flash makes everything I cook look glossy and delicious.

I recommend this camera for food photography but I've used it to take photos outside or even taken a few selfies. It is good for generally everything you need to take a photo of and it is small and compact so easy to fit in a pocket. Today I made a fruit tart and was so happy I had this camera to take a good photo so I could show all my friends the creation.

I don't actually know very much about the specifics of cameras I just know what works. The less fuss and complexity when it comes to cameras the better. I also learned how to take videos of my cats! That was fun.

So if you are looking for a camera that just takes amazing photos and videos time after time, this is a durable and useful tool to get you being creative and make your life more fun! Enjoy!

~The Rebecca Review

title: Works Great for a Speaker and Cordless Headset
text:
With this splitter I can keep my cordless headphones and mini speaker plugged in at the same time. This saves me a lot of time and hassles. I'm using this with a six foot extension cable and it works great. I'm so happy amazon makes it so easy to get what you need for musical perfection. I'm enjoying to listening to music with a mini speaker half the time and headphones the rest of the time.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Great for an Extension Cable for a Mini Speaker
text:
When looking for an extension cable for a small speaker I wanted to plug into my computer, this looked like the right one. Yes it works perfectly and now I can listen to music flooding my office with sound. The cable came in a nice box so was very protected in shipping. I was impressed it didn't just arrive in a plastic bag. It seems like a good quality cable and was easy to hook up to my computer and speaker. Happy Me! :)

~The Rebecca Review

title: A Magical World of Sound
text:
On this new little speaker music sounds like a magical secret world. The high notes are very crisp and the melody drifts across the mind like a dream. I'm glad I took a chance with this speaker. Only thing is the speaker does not have regular volume control (just has high and low) and needs to be charged with a USB cable. The speaker was however already charged so just plugged it in to my computer and it was good to go.

The color is a little darker than pictured. Online it looks hot pink whereas it is actually a lavender purple. I think for the price and if you listen to music at a medium volume, this is great. I have it plugged into my computer and it works for what I bought it for.

I do recommend you use the extension cord or even get a longer one – I got a six foot extension cord to use it with my computer. I also got a splitter so I can have my headphones and the speaker plugged in at the same time. I can just turn the speaker off when I want to use my Sennheiser headphones.

I have a feeling this little speaker is going to be used a lot. I'm enjoying using it and romantic electronica and classical music like Rachmaninov sounds wonderful on it. It takes up very little space and looks really cute on my desk.

~The Rebecca Review

P.S. The green light may still be on this speaker when it needs to be charged. I thought it was broken after a few uses, but it really just needed to be charged I guess. A few hours later it is working again. Will continue using it to see what happens next...the battery charge may not last as long as my other mini speaker.

title: Replacement Cords for Another Brand that Broke
text:
What do you do when you accidently drop a phone while a charging cable is attached? Well, buy three more so if it happens again you have extras! I bought these as a replacement for another brand of cable that broke by accident. The part that attached to the phone literally broke in half. Oh well. Happily I could get more cables in a matter of days. I love how these cords are braided - what complexity of design. So these cables look great, work great and make it easy to charge your phone.

~The Rebecca Review

title: What a Difference!
text:
For about a month I was dealing with a problem with my computer. I figured I had some annoying virus on it and every single time I clicked on anything it would open windows twice or not show me a pull down menu properly. Finally I decided to buy this keyboard and mouse and wow, it fixed the problem. Apparently the old mouse had become defective. I'd had it for six years or more so it definitely needed to be replaced. And the keyboard works perfectly and it way quieter than my old one. I also feel like I can do everything faster now. The mouse scrolls super fast compared to the HP one I had. So very happy with this purchase and wish I'd taken action sooner.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Cute and Functional with Adjustable Volume and Radio
text:
This is the best little alarm clock I've ever owned. It is cute and functional and has a radio and adjustable volume controls. Two alarms can be set at the same time.

The FM radio comes in great and I have it set on a favorite station. You can program in stations and then you can wake with the radio or listen for a specific time before going to sleep. There is a nap, sleep button which is very useful. I press the radio button, then the sleep button and the radio turns off automatically after a preset time ( 15/30/60/90 minutes).

This also has a nice big snooze button on the top so it is easy to turn off the alarm when you want to sleep a little longer.

What I like is that you can adjust the brightness of the display so it doesn't light up your whole room at night. However if you want it to act as a night light, you can set it on the brightest setting.

Also, I find this useful when charging my little speaker I use with my CD player. This alarm clock has two USB charging ports which is very convenient. I can charge my kindle and the speaker at the same time! If you have a cell phone or iPad you keep by the bed, this is also a good feature as there is also a line-in jack so you can play music from your phone on the alarm clock speaker.

The only negative I'd say is the AM radio which does not seem to work very well.

The instruction book is however great and makes setting this clock up easy. It seems the company who makes this alarm clock really did think of everything. My favorite thing to do is climb into my warm bed, put on the radio with one touch of a button and read to my heart's content.

I think you will love this alarm clock and it doesn't take up a lot of room on your nightstand.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Solves a Pertinent Problem
text:
If you have DSL and you have more than one phone, this DSL filter w/Splitter is a good item to have. We bought a second phone but needed to unplug it anytime we went online or else we could not get an Internet connection. So I plugged this in today and Voila! No more hassles with plugging and unplugging the phone cord. Happy me!

~The Rebecca Review

title: Perfect Solution
text:
Recently I ordered a tiny speaker to use with my portable CD player and the USB cable was too short to use properly. So I got this extension cable and am very happy. It is now easy to recharge the speaker. This was the perfect solution to my problem. Thank you!

~The Rebecca Review

title: Shockingly Good Sound
text:
Who knew such a tiny cute speaker could have shockingly good sound quality. I'm impressed with this speaker and have it hooked up to my small portable CD player. At night I use the CD player to play calming CDs to get to sleep and during the day I listen to favorite artists with the volume a little higher. When I first got this I thought it wasn't working but silly me, I had not turned it on. The little on switch is so tiny it is easy to miss. I do however wish the USB cord was a little longer. I'm plugging this into the wall to charge so maybe I need to get a small extension cable. Otherwise this is perfect. As far as portability goes you could easily take this with you on vacation or wherever you go. It closes down into a little ball for storage. I'm very happy with it and glad I found it.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Crystalline Sound
text:
I was very conflicted before buying these headphones as I read the negatives and questioned whether these were as good as the last Sennheiser headphones that just broke. I will say that these perform differently when not charged fully. It is best not to use them before you've left them overnight on the charger. Then you will have less problems with static. You may hear static when you first put them on but as soon as the music or youtube video has started the sound is crystalline. I'm currently listening to some of my favorite music and it could not sound better. So I'm glad I took the chance even when I expected there to be issues. Sennheiser is really as good as AKGs once tuned in. You can also walk around the house with these on and take your music with you. Just charge them before using for the best results.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Works for the Older Keyboard Kindles
text:
I was nervous about ordering a replacement USB cable for my old keyboard Kindle. I wasn't sure if this would work but it turns out it works great. I also found my Kindle charged a bit faster. The cable is a bit shorter than the original cable but it still works. I have an outlet right next to my bed so I'm able to charge while still reading. This looks well made and hopefully will last a while. Maybe they could make a cable about two feet longer as that would probably work better for most people. But I'm just happy my Kindle will charge and that the cable works.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Portable Entertainment Center - Plays DVDs and CDs.
text:
If you are looking for a portable DVD player that has intuitive controls, a remote control and a case to hold the DVD player so you can view the screen while seated in the back of a vehicle, this is a good choice. The screen swivels around so you can fold this in half "backwards" so only the screen is showing. This is helpful when using the case for use in a vehicle.

Compared to my regular TV this is an enhanced viewing experience. I found this to be a better visual experience. All the colors were vivid and almost velvety. Whether I am watching a favorite movie or a nature DVD, the colors are fantastic. Greens and yellows are super crisp and water looks totally glossy. I can't emphasize enough how beautiful the colors are on the screen.

I found many uses for this DVD player. It literally became my entertainment companion for two days while I tried out every feature. What I loved best was playing my virtual fireplace DVD with a beach fire and ocean waves. The stereo sound on this is excellent, I felt I was really at the beach which made me happy.

The remote control works very well and allows you to do things like turn the subtitles on or off. The audio controls let you choose between various options. You can stop or pause the movie you are watching either from the controls on the DVD player or by using the remote control.

This DVD player also has a screen saver that comes up when you put it on pause or don't turn the screen off. There is a button that says TFT ON/OFF that turns the screen off when you only want to listen to the sound. I found this played CDs too so that made me very happy. You can listen with the stereo speakers or use headphones.

If you are looking to view widescreen movies, this works for that too.

This is perfect to take with you when traveling. The only caution is not to use it for yourself if you are driving. It does have a cigarette charger that will work in cars and RVs.

The only thing I do when taking out a CD or DVD is to turn the DVD player off completely.

Some other uses I found for this DVD player was to play relaxing DVDs before bed to calm the mind. I also watched an underwater DVD with fish swimming by. This DVD player allows you to have entertainment wherever you are. The battery lasts about 4-5 hours, but if it starts to run out you can just plug the unit in and continue watching.

The only thing I noticed that was different than a regular DVD player was when you are halfway through a movie, put it on pause instead of taking out the DVD. This does not seem to have any memory of where you left off so when you put the DVD back in it just starts from the beginning again. This is not a big issue if you just hit the pause button.

I'm very happy with this DVD player and it is fun to go into your own little movie world. This is handy to have when someone else is using the computer or main TV. You can watch movies anywhere you want. I use this mostly when sitting in bed.

~The Rebecca Review

I received one free DVD player for review purposes.

title: Very Impressive - Pristine Clarity
text:
These headphones were a recent gift for my birthday and I must say they are very impressive. At first I didn't realize that the jack had two options so I didn't get to use these the first day. My friend who gave them to me explained that you just twisted off the larger jack to get the smaller jack which then fit into my CD player and computer.

The band that goes across your head also can be a bit uncomfortable but I fixed that problem with a wool headband I wear during the winter. I put it between the metal and my scalp. That was more comfortable and the metal seems to soften a bit with wear. You can also buy a wool cover to make it more comfortable, which my friend is also sending me. The extra effort it takes to make these comfortable is worth it. See photos.

As far as the sound goes, these reveal a pristine clarity in everything you listen to. I especially love how John Lennon's Woman sounds and also I listened to Ulrich Schnauss' Goodbye and Evening Ocean's The Kiss. Wow. Everything sounds new again. I hear additional things in songs I never heard before. I'd say listening to music on these headphones is as close to an out of body experience you will ever have. You will feel like you are floating in an ethereal domain of sounds. Vocals all become more interesting as the sound is softened and each note is crystal clear. The sound does seem to hypnotize you a bit. I feel that these headphones reveal the complexity of music in all its beauty. What you get is an ecstatic experience.

You will fall in love with AKG all over again when you get these headphones. I had the AKG K240 headphones for years and really loved them. In comparison these are sonic bliss. Even my Sennheiser cordless headphones don't sound this good. I have a feeling I'm going to be listening to a lot more music than normal. Once you put these headphones on it is hard to stop listening. I spent probably four or more hours the first day I put these on. I just had to listen to all my favorites one after the other to see how they would sound. I was not disappointed. As I told my friend the fact that I'm thrilled about these headphones is a major understatement. They are worth the investment for the high level of pleasure they produce.

~The Rebecca Review

P.S. It's 2021 and my first AKG K553s fell apart in my hands the other day after six years. So it was time for a new pair. They don't last forever especially if you use them all the time. Get a hard shell case for them and don't wrap the cord around the headphones.

title: Review for Green Rechargable Fan
text:
Cool on the Go is a cooling fan that is highly portable. I'm using it at my desk. You can plug it into your computer and it works instantly or you can charge it (put rechargeable batteries in first) or use 4 AA batteries. The air output can be controlled and it is pretty powerful on the high setting. It is fairly quiet but you can definitely hear the fan. This comes with an armband, a lanyard (to wear it around your neck) and a USB power adaptor. This does not however come with an A/C adaptor or a USB car adaptor. I think this works best as a table top fan which you can keep pretty close to you for maximum cooling. It is also interesting to wear it. So order some batteries to use with this otherwise you'll only be able to use it with the USB cord. I'm also now using this when I walk on my treadmill. It is so cold it is like air conditioned air blowing on you while you walk. I'm upping my review to five stars because I'm starting to really love this.

~The Rebecca Review

I received one free product for review purposes. This review is my honest opinion.

title: For Casual Photographers with Steady Hands
text:
If you are a camera enthusiast this camera may be a little too basic for your needs. It takes OK photographs but sometimes they are blurry in the background. I found it took better pictures outside than inside. It was OK for photographing things for reviewing and surprise surprise it also takes video with sound. All this time I could have been videoing my cats. It is a very inexpensive camera and has some quirks. Setting the time and day was a real issue. I have larger fingers than this is designed for. The touchscreen works best when I use my pinky. So this might be good for kids because it has a lot of fun features they'd use. A kid could easily figure this out. I managed to use it without reading the instructions if that helps. Just don't expect to get super good pictures. This is more for casual use. I'm going to continue using it to post pictures on my reviews. For that it is good enough. You can easily download your pictures right into your pictures file. That was easy to figure out. I had about a year's worth of photographs on this camera before I figured out how to do it. I guess it was easier than I thought.

~The Rebecca Review

title: The Perfect Solution
text:
I bought a great keyboard except the USB cable was very short. So for a week I had to have my computer up on my desk. Fortunately this USB extension cable arrived right on time and within minutes I had my computer back on the floor and my keyboard worked like a charm. I'm very happy with this extension cable. Hopefully it will last a long time.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Stealth Keyboard
text:
If you don't like the sound of your keyboard to reach the rest of the house (like if people are sleeping and you are up surfing around or talking at forums) then you might like this keyboard a lot. It is quieter than my old HP keyboard. If you type slowly it is quieter than if you type fast. The only thing I was disappointed by was the length of the cord. I've ordered a USB extension cord since to use this keyboard I have to have my computer up on the desk. That is the only way the cord will reach. It really is far too short. But I have a big desk so that is probably the problem.

~The Rebecca Review

P.S. The letters on the keys are wearing off really fast. Maybe I just type too much!!!

title: Good if you want a Permanent Solution
text:
If you want to watch movies at your desk or other locations where you have a flat surface to put your iPad this tripod works great to keep your iPad upright. It is a permanent solution since one part of the unit is permanently glued to your iPad with a permanent adhesive pad. The "ratcheting belt clip" does however remove from the smart mount section which makes it easy to mount and dismount the iPad. The tripod has telescoping legs which allows you to change the height. A good choice if you want a permanent solution.

~The Rebecca Review

I received this free from the inventor. This review is my honest opinion.

title: The New Life My Old Phone Needed
text:
I had given up on my old phone and purchased a new one. Unfortunately the new phone was awful so I went looking for a new battery for my old phone. Someone at a forum helped me find this battery and for that I am eternally grateful. This battery provided the new life my old phone needed. I had thought they were not making the battery for my old phone but I'm glad they still are. With my old battery I could only talk for an hour at most and then the phone would beep constantly. It was very annoying. Now with the new battery I can talk for hours.

~The Rebecca Review

title: A Warm Up and Firming Exercises with Weights
text:
If you want a walking workout then this might disappoint you. This only has a walking warm-up and then Leslie focuses on total body toning with weights. You will need at least two weights and some ankle weights or other special equipment you can buy from Leslie's site. I did the workout with just hand weights and it was fine. I felt that the pace of this workout was good for beginners. Intermediate exercisers and advanced exercisers may become frustrated with all the instructions.

I did feel that this workout was great for the upper body and abs. I could really feel the burn doing sit ups and arm exercises. The workout is done to jazzy instrumental music alternated with classic hymns so this is for a Christian audience.

One thing I'd like to say about the ab workout is that you may want to support your head with your hands otherwise your neck will be very store.

Also my best advice is that you count the repetitions of each exercise yourself. Leslie gets so chatty that she doesn't count what she is doing. I counted all the exercises and found that at some times she was doing a whole lot more on one side than the other, as many as ten more repetitions on a side. During one exercise she did thirteen on one side and twenty three on the other. I think if you count fifteen repetitions on a side that would be better.

But otherwise I felt this workout was pretty good. Just I was expecting way more walking.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Reliable Alarm Clock
text:
Do you fear that your alarm clock will not work if the power goes off sometimes at night? This Dream Machine has a battery back up so you never have to worry about the alarm not going off at the right time. Well you may have to replace the battery at some point but otherwise it seems very reliable. The instructions for setting up this clock radio are simple and easy to understand. There are two alarms and of course a nice snooze button. I feel it is nicer to wake up with the radio playing than a buzzer but this alarm clock has that option too. The speaker is not very high quality so don't expect stereo sound. For the price I feel that I got lots of good features. I'm happy with my purchase.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Dreamy Bliss
text:
I'm a fan of the GR07s but these GR01s impressed me with their pristine clarity. There are also 15 eartips so I was able to get a perfect fit. Although these go a little deeper into the ear canal. If you don't get the right fit they tend to fall out of your ears so you might have to try a few eartips to get the right ones. Then they stay in place quite nicely. What I noticed about these earbuds is that vocals shimmer and the bass is smooth and silky instead of jarring. Dancy pop is bright and sparkly. I especially like listening to Owl City with these earphones. Electronica really sounds incredible. I hear more details than when wearing Sennheiser or AKG headphones and that is really saying something. So is spending a little more for the GR01s worth it? Yes definitely. Go for it and you will be happy you did.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Great for Walking or Jogging
text:
I was looking for a way to listen to my CDs while walking on my treadmill and without disturbing anyone else. This CD carrier works well for walking but I also found it is great while jogging. The fabric is very comfortable and stretchy so it moves with you and doesn't feel restrictive. You can also get a [[ASIN:B003FO0GAW Tune Belt SW Belt Extender]] and then adjust the belt tighter for a perfect fit. I did have a problem with my CD player turning off the minute I put it in the pocket but someone else said you can just select "hold" on your CD player and it won't turn the player off. I also had some issues with the volume changing the minute I put it in the pocket. But other than those issues it seems fine.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Great lightweight headphones for iPads, iPods and Portable CD Players
text:
I have Sennheiser cordless headphones so I was aware of the high quality of Sennheiser products. I was looking for a pair of headphones that I could use while walking outside and these are perfect. They do cancel out a lot of noise giving you a more intimate listening experience. The first time I wore these my husband scared the heck out of me. He had to tap on my shoulder to get my attention because I was so involved in listening to a CD I made. So you really can get a bit lost in the bliss of music.

~The Rebecca Review

title: A Rare Treat
text:
Tupelo Honey is smooth and buttery with a luxurious texture and silky sweet lemony finish. I've tasted quite a few types of honey in my lifetime but nothing comes close to this perfection. Whether you put this in a floral tea or eat it straight on a warm scone, you will experience a heavenly and rare treat. It was worth the price and I'll definitely order this honey again.

~The Rebecca Review

title: Perfect Solution
text:
The Sony extension cord for headphones works especially well and makes my husband happy when I'm watching movies late at night. This works with my computer, DVD player and stereo. This cord also works with the AKG headphones and the K240 version makes everything sound amazing. The cord is lightweight and the nine feet extension makes it much easier to enjoy music a little further from the source. Now I can sit on the other side of the room and watch a movie on my computer or enjoy late night movies without disturbing my husband.

~The Rebecca Review

title: They should continue making this stereo...
text:
First, I must thank the amazing friend who bought me this stereo one lovely Christmas. Not only does he tell me about the best music in the world, he sent me a stereo that plays music in the way I always dreamed music could sound. Normally my ears are too sensitive to listen to Bass and this stereo has a little button on the front that turns the X-BASS on or off. You can also do this from the remote control to customize your listening experience.

Features:

High Quality Remote Control - you can change CDs with the touch of one button, change to tape or play random selections from 5 CDs. You can use the Timer/sleep option and fall asleep to your most relaxing CDs.

Quick Start Guide - Very easy to set up the stereo, but I can promise you, you won't want to leave home for hours after you start playing CDs.

5 Disc Trays with disc number selections buttons and direct play button. Easy to change what you are listening to at the stereo or from the remote.

Two Impressive Speakers - Total 240 watts.

Recording Capabilities - Record from the radio even if you are away or sleeping, from tape to tape or even from several CDs continuously.

Extras:

Front Game Terminal - You can listen to the playback sounds of Games or hook up your VCR or DVD player. I plug in my cordless headphones when I want to take music anywhere in the house.

I rarely take this stereo above volume 7 but there are definite possibilities. The sleep function is so comforting. I fall asleep with a blue glow floating over me as I go to sleep. The only funny thing that happened is I unplugged the stereo, which seems to have changed the sleep setting. I was woken up in the early hours of the morning by Bono singing Vertigo. Now, that will get you out of bed fast.

Once I had this all set up I was in musical bliss. Definitely recommended for the stereo features. To listen to the radio, you may have to hook this up to an outdoor FM antenna. I get a few stations, but mostly listen to CDs.

title: The Best, Skip the Rest
text:
After purchasing a variety of wireless headphones and not having much success, I happened upon this wonderful adjustable headphone that uses rechargeable nickel-cadmium batteries (included).

You can actually enjoy watching TV, use your VCR/DVD player or listen to your stereo without disturbing a single soul.

The headphones rest on a transmitter that recharges the headphones after you plug them back in. They are always ready for use and the batteries must last forever because so far, I've not had to worry about the batteries wearing out.

You can walk 125 feet away from the transmitter and still hear music. Unlike other headphones I tried, this one only seems to pick up the sounds from the TV or Stereo. Which is a good thing unless you want to hear conversations from who knows where. It was very annoying with other brands I have tried in the past.

The headphones have soft earpads which allow for hours of comfortable listening. You can even be in bed and lean back on a pillow and they are comfortable.

All you do is connect this system to your CD, TV, VCR/DVD player or HI-Fi or radio.

Occasionally while watching a movie, I did have to readjust the tuning, which is right on the headset. There is a volume control and a place where you can plug it back into the charge unit.

Strangely, you can also use this as a speaker if the volume is up high enough. That might defeat the purpose, but if you TV is close to a wall shared by someone who is trying to sleep, this can be helpful.

Listening Freedom! Even late into the night when you want to watch movies. Now, the only problem is remembering not to laugh too loudly when watching comedies.

~The Rebecca Review

title: A bombastic flop
text:
After looking for a new power -yet compact- laptop I decided to get the Asus Transformer T300LA. Specs looked solid and the possibility of separating the screen and transforming it into a tablet was a nice plus.
I have other Asus products and I know they produce good parts. Building a whole device is a complete different game though and it shows in this display of utter system design disaster. I have heard about complaints regarding Asus poor customer support (which I had experienced myself with a mobo I bought recently and could not get in months any response about a question I posted). It all boiled down to an exercise on probabilities: chances were the laptop would work fine, if not I would have to return it, not counting on Asus for anything.
Initially everything looked fine indeed. Unfortunately soon I realized the button on the pad was making a loud, clanky noise, not the usual muffled, smooth sound you could expect of a $1,350 ultrabook. After that I have another big surprise: the hinge that keeps together keyboard and screen does not have a connector (they are connected wiressly) which leaves the problem of charging the smaller battery on the keyboard part. Well, apparently some genius decided that a 3-ft USB cable would suffice. So you have to use the only available USB port to connect that cable and be able to re-charge the keyboard. Of course you will have to travel with that cable too (or a second charger, not included). Bad. A third, odd thing was that the speakers (which sounded awful, BTW) are located on one side of the screen.
I ended up returning it and buying instead a Lenovo Yoga 2 Pro for $1,200. Cheaper, with the same CPU, memory and HDD, and with a better-that-Retina 3200x1800 screen (instead of the FullHD 1080). Plus, it is designed properly.

title: Poorest sound quality
text:
The level of intermodulation distortion exhibited by the tiny speakers in the bar is so high that it is painful to hear them. This system gets particularly upset with flute and piano sounds (do not try to watch Cosmos with this!). Finally, the system's weak power output requires the volume to be max out, which degrades the sound beyond redemption.

A low quality product that perform worse than the built-in TV speakers.

Connected through digital output.

title: Awful cable connectors!
text:
We bought two RM450 to build two new machines we needed in the office. I am an experienced engineer who has built some 30+ machines in my life. I never had so many problems with a connector like I had with these. The 24-pin that goes into the motherboard just does not click in. As another customer had said I was fearing breaking the mobo because of the force I had to exert. Still it did not click. It was so bad that the machine did not start up the first time. I tried the cable of the second unit and had the same problem. And the motherboard is a good ASUS, with quality connectors. Not only that, the connectors can barely click into their pair in the RM450 itself!
Avoid this as the plague. A connector that cannot stay properly in place is a sure source of problems for the PC.

title: Improved through endless firmware patches.  Amazon video streaming interface still lacking
text:
UPDATE 03/2014: A firmware update released by 10/2013 corrected the problems with fast movement transitions, my rate now goes to 2 stars (from just one). Their implementation of the Amazon video interface, although improved too, still freezes and requires the TV to be turned off and on again.

ORIGINAL POST:
I have this TV for 1 year now. The first thing I noticed was that the factory setup for the picture was quite off and required a lot of tweaking. The remote control with its featured pointer is rather inaccurate, although after a while you got accustomed to it and your brain compensates for the aiming by itself. Another issue is the GUI; it is really slow to respond and during the transitions.
But the most important and really terrible thing about this HDTV is its *AWFUL* DSP that gets lost with fast movements. When watching a basketball game you see the image becomes chopped every 15 seconds or so, as the processing cannot cope with the movement. HORRIBLE!. And believe me I have tried many different setups with and without "True Motion", etc.
LG has been providing several firmware updates through the year but it seems that the problem has somewhat aggravated.
I am really disappointed with this TV (I miss my old 720P LCD Sony VEGA that broke down after 7~8 years of impeccable performance).
I would definitely not recommend this TV to anybody watching sports.

title: Does not count laps properly
text:
My wife bought for me this Garmin Swim watch at Amazon as a present. I am returning it after having tried it for three swimming sessions.
The problem with it is that it does not count the laps properly: sometimes misses one and sometimes increases the count by two, very erratically.
I found myself paying more attention to the watch than to my swimming (I am sure the other swimmers may have found amusing how I tried to get a missed lap counted by shaking frantically my hand!)

Another thing that you may want to know is that to see and graph your data you do have to create an online account. The only thing that is installed in your machine is the driver for the USB transceiver that wirelessly retrieves the data from the watch.

I do not like either what the manual says about "avoid operating the watch's buttons under the water". So, what happens if the watch has a leak? Are they going to blame you for using it in the water?

Finally, Linux users be aware that only Windows and Mac are supported. The driver for the USB transceiver does not work neither with Wine nor with WindowsXP running in VirtualBox.
