text: After reading so many bad reviews I almost decided to not buy it.  But for the very low price I gave it a try.  So glad I did.  Set up was plug and play.  About 3 minutes from opening box to up and running.  The range seems fine on both units.  At least 15 ft.  That is all the farther I tested.  It probably goes more.  I like the feel of the keyboard and the mouse.  Granted I do not know how these will hold up over time, but for now I am very pleased with this purchase.

title: Not recommended
text: Range is very limited.  Would not work on some games.

title: Worth the price
text: I have been using an older Philips 28" soundbar with a wired passive sub woofer.  When I saw this unit on sale at Amazon I decided to give it a try.  It is also 28" wide, but includes a wireless powered sub woofer allowing me to place the sub anywhere in the room were I could access a power socket.  Set up is really easy.  Took only a few minutes.  Had to spend a little time understand the leds that display the various sound settings.  The sub connect automatically.  After I was sure everything was working as it should, I programmed my Harmony remote to control it and everything else connected to the TV.  No problems doing that.  So all in all I am very happy with the performance of this unit when compared to the one it replaced.

title: Worth every penny!
text: This is a great item.  Does away with the messy cord and keeps the dot off the table or counter top.  Super easy to install.  The reason I chose this design over the competitors is the fact that a wall charger is included in the price that fits directly in the holder.  Most, if not all, of the other designs use the original dot power supply which is not as compact and the one supplied with this unit.  All in all a great product at a great price, especially if you realize you are getting a new power supply with the unit.

title: Cannot recommend....
text: Like so many have stated in their review, the range is terrible.  Anything beyond a couple of feet and the signal will be lost, causing the remote to stop working until it regains the signal.  I used a USP extension cable I had and attached the transmitter to the side of my desk.  Now the distance is only 2 feet from the gamepad.  As a result everything works fine.  However, this gamepad would be useless for anyone wanting to use it more than 2 feet from the transmitter.

title: Works Well
text: Have always used CyberPower UPS systems, so I knew this would be a good product.  Everything works as advertised.  Nice small size.  The power cord is really overkill.  Very heavy duty, but does have a right angle flat power plug..  Holds my phone well.

title: Does the job.
text: Works pretty well.  Deducted one star because the price is high, in my opinion.

title: Just ok
text: Fun to build,  However, I could really never get it too work properly so I threw it away.  At such a low price, I really can't complain too much.  No instructions included for proper use.  Just not one of my better builds.

title: Fun project.
text: Interesting little kit.  However, you will need a fine tipped soldering iron to attach two small SMD chips.  Worth the price, if you are into electronic kit building.  Instruction are adequate.

title: Just what I needed.
text: Nice thin extension cord.  A must have, because most power adapters have very short cords. Works as advertised.

title: Nice!
text: Need a 3 volt supply to replace two AA cells in a framed LED canvas.  Worked well for that purpose, however I had to buy an extension to reach the power  outlet, as the cord on this supply is pretty short.  But, all in all this was perfect for my application and was priced right..

title: Nice for the price
text:
Based on all the good reviews I gave this a try. Sadly I was disappointed. Yes, they look good but just sound fair in my opinion. I find the bass response lacking when compared to a Lapai amp driving Micca Club speakers. Don't get me wrong, they don't sound terrible, but just not the sound I was expecting. I realize that everyone has different tastes, so this is only one mans opinion....
UPDATE: I have changed my original 2 star rating to 4 stars. Reason being I was originally not happy when connected to my computer. But I purchased an Amazon Dot and now I am pleased with the bass response of these units. However, I must admit that still prefer the Bose Companion 2 speakers to these which are priced the same. Again, this is only my humble opinion.....

title: A little Echo....
text: Already owned an Echo, but really did not like the lackluster sound when playing music.  So I bought a Dot (at Bed, Bath and Beyond) because the black units where on backorder at Amazon.com.  Hooked the unit up to a pair of Bose Companion 2 powered speakers via the 3.5 mm output jack on the Dot.  Really sounds so much better than the echo.  My only problem is that the output jack on the Dot is a little touchy, but once locked in everything is fine.  Not worth a trip to exchange.  I still use the echo in my bedroom.  I live in a small house, and only the unit closest to my location responds.  Very impressive.....

title: Does the job
text: Exactly what I was looking for.  I do wish it was 3 wire, but for the low price this was a great buy.

title: Usual good deal
text: As with all Monoprice items, works just as advertised at a low price.  Can't go wrong with this cable

title: Disappointed....
text:
Had high hopes for this little sub, but it did not live up to my expectations. I bought it to use with my SMSL Q5 amp and Micca Club 3 speakers, used for PC listening. The sub did sound good and was just the size I was looking for. However, two major flaws soon became apparent.
1. The Auto on/off threshold was set to high, and as a result the sub would automatically turn off at a normal volume level in the near field setup with the computer.
2. There was a constant 60 cycle hum from the unit. Tried different cables, different power sockets, different room locations. Hum would not go away..
For these reasons this sub will not work for me. Luckily for me the Micca 3 Club speakers do put out enough bass for my application. A sub would have just been a little frosting on the cake. Oh well.....

title: Not very good....
text: Like so many others reported, I found these difficult to work with, and unable to hold the wire tight.  Just an all around poor design.  I ordered a more expensive design, and expect a better product.  I cannot recommend these...

title: Nice Wire
text: Nice all around speaker wire at a very fair price.  Like the red/black combination.  Also very flexible.  Good buy...

title: Wonderful Small PC
text: I was lucky enough to get two of these computers a couple of months ago at a great price.  Both machines have worked flawlessly.  They are fast and quiet.  I wanted windows 7 because I am old and did not want to have to learn a new operating system.  7 will not be supported after Jan. 2020,  So I have lots of time left on these before I have to upgrade or buy new computers.  Anyway, I am very pleased with these PCs.

title: No problems...
text: Worked well and was easy to install in my Nano computer.  I saw a boost in performance after the memory upgrade.

title: Welcome to my library.
text: Thought this would be a great skin for my new echo.  Seemed to fit the whole idea of Alexa becoming my library.  It was easy to install in about 5 minutes.  It looks great.  However, I wish that it was a mat finish rather than gloss.  It appears that it should be easy to remove, but I have no intention of removing it.

title: Not that great.
text: I have built over 300 various electronic kits during the past 50 years.  Heathkits, Knight-Kit, Eico, etc.  So I have a lot of experience building kits and just completed the Akitika  stereo amp and preamp. It is getting harder and harder everyday to find quality kits to build.  Ramsey electronics just this year stopped selling kits.  So when I saw this little radio, I thought I would give it a try.  All the parts where included, however, instructions where just plain terrible.  No step by step.  Even with all my experience, I found the build slow and confusing. Anyway, I never did get the thing to work.  So I threw it away, even without doing too much troubleshooting.  I sure can't recommend this kit.

title: Good cable
text: Not much to say.  It is a nice thin HDMI cable and it works just fine.  Good buy at a nice price.

title: Nice!
text: 6 inch extensions are hard to find.  These are very well made.  Not a whole lot to say, they work well and are worth the price.

title: Need to add wireless to a wired network, this is the one for you.
text:
If I can make this work, anybody can. I am old school and like a wired connection for reliability and security. So I wired my house with Cat5 years ago. Now however, with the popularity of phones and tablets I decided I needed to try and become familiar with the newer wireless technologies. After looking around this device looked to be the best solution for my situation. I must admit I was a little worried after reading the reviews that I may have trouble installing the device because of my limited knowledge of wireless. I am happy to say that this is a very easy to install device even for those of us not familiar with WI-FI. From the time I opened the box to a complete and function setup was less the 30 minutes. The included easy set up disc stepped me thru the process with ease. Everything worked like a charm. No problems what so ever. So if you currently have a wired set-up and want to dabble with wireless this is a good and inexpensive option. I highly recommend the product.
UPDATE 6/14/15: This model has been discontinued, but is still available. They are almost giving these away at the current price, ordered another one, just as a back up...

UPDATE: This access point is being discontinued by the maker. I order a second unit as a spare since the price is now very low. The unit has worked well, without any problems whatsoever. Get one while you still can

title: Simply Amazing for their size!
text:
I have been using the Bose Companion Series 3 speakers with my desktop computer, and was happy with that setup. However, I decided to try something different. I purchased a Lepai amp from Amazon and after reading the reviews of the small speakers on Amazon, decided this was the best deal. These speakers are a steal. Great sound and incredible bass for such small speakers. I could not be more happy with these.
Update: Now that I have been listening to this speakers for a couple of months, I swear they sound even better than before. Even more happy with them.....

title: Pleasantly Surprised!!
text: Call me old school, but I think wired networks are the way to go, for speed, security and reliability.  I have been using a Dynex 4 port wired router which was working fine, but I now need more ports.  I have two computers, and 3 Roku wired set top boxes and plan to add the Ooma Telo VOIP in the near future.  Finding this unit at such a low price surprised me.  But after reading mostly good reviews, I thought it was worth a try.  Glad that I did.  It was simply plug and play.  Up in running in just a few minutes.  The good news it that when running only my main computer my speed increased from 54 mbps to 61 mbps.  While streaming one Roku box speed on the computer dropped to 47 mbps.  I will never be running more that two devices at a time on my network, so I am very happy with this router.  A couple of small things, I wish the unit was not white and black.  I would have preferred all black.  Like most new electronics the LED lights are too bright.  I found a good way to solve that a few years back.  I use a layer or two of static smoked tint window film you can buy at Home Depot or Lowes.  Perfect fix.

title: Works well...
text: Works well.  The price was good, when compared to other cables, and with free shipping by Prime account it was a really good deal.  Not a lot to say, except that the product met or exceeded my expectations.

title: Quick and Easy!
text: Was channel surfing on the TV and saw this item being shown on QVC.  I had not heard of it before, but it looked like a great idea.  I currently use thumb drives to make backups which is time consuming and I always wonder if I got everything copied.  Anyway, after learning about the product I checked the price on Amazon and it was less than the TV price.  I ordered it and it is just as advertised.  Quick and Easy backup of my files.  I could not be happier with this product or the Amazon price.  I recommend this product.....

title: Just like the series 2 with a couple of changes....
text: Have been using the companion 2 series 2 speakers for several years and was very happy with them.  When I saw the series 3 at a local store I decided to see if they were any better than the series 2.  They are exactly the same size.  They are now black, rather than gray. I like the black more than the gray.  The input jacks are now mini jacks rather than the RCA jacks on the series 2, which is an improvement.  The series 3 can be turned off with the volume control, the series 2 had no on/off control.  It was on all the time.  The series 3 draws so little power I leave them on all the time anyway.  NOW THE BIG QUESTION:  DO THEY SOUND BETTER THAN THE SERIES 2?  In my opinion, they sound exactly the same as the series 2 they replaced. So unless you want any of the features new to the series 3, I would recommend saving your money.  The series 2 was a great product, and so is the series 3.  Bose makes outstanding products.

title: Nice for the low price.
text:
This is a pretty nice looking and functioning keyboard/mouse wireless combo. It is plug and play easy set up. Works very well. No problems detected while typing or using the mouse. I do think that the mouse is too flat. It needs to be more rounded at the top, however, I am getting used to it. The box also contained a CD with software that shows caps lock, scroll lock, numbers lock, on screen as there are no lights on the keyboard for that. The software also displays battery state on both the keyboard and the mouse. After installing the software these items are displayed in a box on the right lower portion of the screen. The box containing this information is rather large and in my opinion is not worth the trouble to display it. I also had my computer lock up several times after installing the software, but once I removed the software everything was fine. So I would suggest not using the software, it is not required for normal operation. I was using a Microsoft 800 combo before this unit, and I like the size, looks, and action of this keyboard much more. I recommend this item....

3/5/13 - A problem has developed since I wrote this review. Sometimes the mouse or keyboard will not wake my desktop computer from "sleep". When this happens I am still able to wake the computer from sleep using the computer start button. This problem is happening about 10% of the time. I have used several other wireless keyboards and mice and have never had this problem. Not a deal breaker, but annoying......

title: Does the job at a low price!
text: Needed a long usb cable to connect my computer to my printer.  Hard to find a printer cable longer than 15 feet.  It is said that printer cables running over 15 feet may have problems.  However, after reading the favorable reviews of the product I took a chance and ordered this 20 foot cable.  Now that I have it connected to the printer, it works just fine.  No problems at all.  I recommed this fine, inexpensive 20 foot cable......

title: Works and looks good too......
text: Not a whold lot to say.  This is a very good looking keyboard.  As the others have said the cord is too short.  I had to add an extension USB cable to reach my computer.  The key action is as good as keyboards costing much more.  I like the volume controls on board.  I do wish that it had adjustable feet for height adjustment.  But I do like the feet, becuase they have a rubber coating that really keeps the keyboard from sliding around.  For such a low price I really have no major complaints, and consider this an excellent buy from Amazon.

title: Super Value Amp
text: Using this little amp as an headphone amplifier.  Well built small unit.  Lots of inputs, little heat generation (no fan required).  Treble and Bass controls work very well.  This is a very nice amp at a very low price.  Most happy with this purchase!

title: Great for the hard of hearing....
text: Bought these for my hard of hearing 96 year old father.  Most headphones produce so much bass that it makes it impossible for the hearing impaired to hear the dialog in movies and other TV broadcasts that have music in the background.  I had tried all types of headphones for him, but none worked until now.  These headphones do not produce an overwhelming amount of bass as all the others do.  It does have base, but not too much.  The headphones are comfortable,the in line volume control is a must have feature.  I cannot say enough good things about these.  I also purchase a small Pyle 40 watt amp to boost the output from the TV and to give him control of the bass and treble.  The combination of these headphones and the Amp (from Amazon) have made watching TV so much more enjoyable for him.

title: Low Price Wonder!!
text: Bought this unit a few weeks ago at Target when it was cheaper than Amazon. Now the prices are virually the same at the two stores.  I read the good reviews and decided to give this a try.  It looks better than the pictures.  It is small enough to fit in front of the TV without blocking controls or remote sensor.  The sub is small and easy to place out of the way.  I have a 5.1 system from Pioneer and love it.  But I must admit the sound from the Philips is just about as good, just no surround.  I know of no other sound bar at any price that gives you so many input choices and they all cost way more than this little wonder.  I think you will be happy with your purchase.

title: So Far So Good
text: Still can't believe how small this thing is.  As the other reviews stated it is very, very quiet.  It did have some bloatware that took a little time to remove.  Updates to windows and other programs took about an hour.  Not too long.  Documentation is pretty much non existant, however, the unit is basically plug and play.  THE ONLY ISSUE:  as others have stated, this unit WILL NOT PLAY NETFLIX HD!  I hope this problem gets resolved in an update from somewhere.  I would have given this computer 5 stars except for this one issue.  It is a little slower than my small form eMachines desktop.  But is does better than I expected.  Recommended for anyone looking for a nice little HTPC.

title: No Good!
text: Noticed both good and bad reviews for this product.  I add my experience to the bad.  I could not get this unit to work.  Windows 7 said it could not find the drivers for the unit.  Media center said no channels found.  However, it did find the analog cable channels but not the QAM channels.  The channels it did display froze every couple of seconds.  But after about 10 minutes of use it dropped my cable connection.  This, I am sure had something to do with the fact that I was splitting the cable (yes, I was using a quality splitter).  That was enough for me.  Disconnected the unit, but everything back the way it was and got back on line.  I cannot recommend this product based on my experience.  I am keeping it, and may try it again on another computer in the future.  I don't know if any other USB tuners are any better than this one, but I won't waste anymore money on any of them.

title: Good Unit - Low Price
text:
When I had a power outage right in the middle of a Windows Update I deceided I had to get a UPS. I spend a lot of time researching my options. This unit seemed like the best deal providing an LCD readout and the ability to easily turn of all alarms.

Unit is well built. Documentation is adequate. Easy to set up. I did not install the provided computer software, as the LCD screen on the unit gives me plenty of information.

When connections were complete and everything powered on (HP slimline desktop Computer, Modem, Router and 23" LED Monitor to the batttery outlets) the readout indicated I was only using 40% of the UPS output and that I could expect a battery back-up of 22 minutes. More than I had expected. I unpluged the unit and everything worked perfectly. All conected units stayed on, as if the power was still plugged in. Pluged the UPS back in and the unit went back to the household current. PERFECT...

I highly recommend this unit. For the price, it cannot be beat!
UPDATE 8/22/14: Unit continues to perform well. I have installed the software, and find it very good. I don't know how long the battery will last before it will need to be replaced, but this was money well spent. I hope they produce this product for many more years.

UPDATE 7/9/16: The unit finally needed a battery replacement. So I got 5 and a half years life out of the battery. Not bad.....

One of them the screen shattered somehow and they only ever have them when they are sitting in the car, otherwise I take them and put them on a shelf inside. title: Should I or Shouldn't I go with the cheaper lamp.
text:
Did not fit my TV, the plugs are a different shape and don't mate. I removed the new lamp from it's housing to install in the old housing, but now (my second time doing this) the one of the lead wires in a stationary wire the leads directly into the rear of the bulb, there used to be a nut that held it like the other lead wire. So I had to clip the new wire off and solder it to the loop of the older lead wire... Not a big deal, but probably would have been better off just paying the extra $100.00 from my neighborhood TV repair shop. And... I think these lamps may mess with the lamp ballast... I still have no picture, the last time we replaced the bulb (after market from Amazon) we had the same issue, I had to call a TV repairman to come and get the TV working again. I don't really know if the after market bulb caused the lamp ballast to fail or it was just its time to go. It's kind of suspicion because, the TV is 10-years old this month, and it played night and day with 3-children in the house and I estimate I replaced the lamp 4-times prior with the Philips OEM lamp before one of my son's said hey dad try Amazon.
That's my story, I hope it helps.
P.S. if anyone out there has replaced the Mitsubishi 939P978020 Lamp Ballast for 52"-62" WD series televisions, can you let me know how difficult it was. I'm thinking about just scrapping this old DLP and going with a new smart TV.
Make note! Lamp works fine if I would have put the Lamp enclosure door on first, it has a safety switch that I was completely clueless about. DOH!
If you don't mind a little fiddling, the lamp works fine now

title: Major flaw in functionality
text:
So I’m glad that I started with the single camera, because this would have been a huge disappointment. The system that allows remote viewing is unable to reboot itself when power is restored, so if your home loses power for some reason while you are not home, the sync Module does not automatically reconnect when the power comes back on. This ultimately renders the whole system useless since it can’t be relied upon when you are not home.

My original system, Zmodo does air reconnect so if my home loses power, the cameras reconnect as soon as they have power again. In fact the cameras were what alerted us to the return of power to our home during the 2016 fires in Napa. I will stick with them, despite the wiring issue. They are just more reliable.

title: A bit like Windows 95... Crashes constantly, constant rebooting.
text: If you enjoyed watching shows on computer in 1997, you'll love this TV. It crashes constantly, resets whenever it wants, and even the remote is buggy sometimes not being detected at all, sometimes being overly sensitive, and sometimes just going absolutely nuts and continually scrolling with no way to stop it. Also, just like Windows 95, you have to reboot the TV several times a day. If this was a theater, it would be out of business because you'll be sitting there watching something and, all of a sudden, the screen is black for two or three minutes, it goes to the reset screen, then you're back at the home screen waiting a couple of more minutes to load properly. The TV is definitely not worth almost 200 bucks and you could likely get something far better, that works better with Alexa, for the same price or a little more.

title: Stopped connecting to ALL smart lights and plugs
text: After less than a year, my entire smart set up is no longer supported through my Echo device or any Alexa device. Since I'm not going to replace my entire smart home setup every year, I'm done with anything connected to Amazon. My Echo just becomes a useless hockey puck that can function as a timer and tell stupid jokes. Glad I never bought the microwave and other appliances. It's not like it ever actually understands anything you ask it anyway or does what you ask it. Half of the time I'm standing in the bathroom in the dark screaming for it to turn the bathroom on over and over and it does, but nothing actually turns on. The other half of the time, my TV sets it off and it either interrupts what I'm watching or just randomly starts spewing nonsense it found on Wikipedia or playing music because it doesn't actually recognize voices at all but thinks someone on the TV is asking for something. The worst is when the TV sets off the Echo, which then says something about Alexa, which sets off EVERY OTHER DEVICE, or when an Amazon commercial is on and they deliberately say Alexa, which stops everything for it to listen. Most videos go back a couple of seconds when the last one happens, so, the commercial plays again, sticking me in an endless loop until I just stop watching the video completely. I also just love it when it gives me a notification and it's literally just trying to sell me stuff. Amazon products like this one are intrusive, frustrating, and useless.

title: Awesome cable, so far, but still made in China.
text:
This is the fastest charging cable I've ever purchased. I've purchased several from Amazon in the last few months and they always end up returned because, not only are they not fast charging as they claim to be, my device DISCHARGES while plugged in. Not this one. It's fast.
It arrives in a small box, nicely rolled with a built in cable tie, instead of folded, twisted and bent like every other one. It weighs a little more than others and the ends seem very durable. It's also obviously thicker overall. The reinforcement around the plug is very thick and has both a depression for grip and actual grips on either side so that you don't have to wiggle and pull. It's very easy to plug in and remove.
The plug fits perfectly into the jack with no play at all and is very obviously made of stainless rather than jacketed aluminum. We'll see how long it lasts. If it fails quickly, I'll update.
The only reason I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 is that, although it's designed and sold by a Swedish company, it's still made in China. I'm so sick of the poor quality, misrepresented, and near fraudulent merchandise that I buy on Amazon, and then have to return or eat the cost, that comes from China, that it disappoints me to see that this is made there. It makes me nervous to buy electronics, clothing, and the like on Amazon because about half the time, I end up with garbage that I have to return or throw out in a couple of months, and a whole lot of wasted time, money, and frustration. And Amazon, of course, won't list the country of origin. The number one reason I bought this was because it's a Swedish and not Chinese company. At least they have adequate quality control and standards.

Update: 2 1/2 months later and the cable is starting to fail.

title: Just buy it.
text:
If you're looking for an inexpensive but very good radio \Bluetooth speaker, this is it. The sound quality isn't perfect but it's very good. If you're looking for speakers for dubstep or heavy bass, you'll need to spend more but it does have good bass for everything else. Additionally, the bass level is adjustable with the tone knob. It's loud, not house rocking loud, but loud enough to hear well outdoors from my living room.
I was surprised to see that this is not rechargeable but connects to the wall, so, not portable. This, however, was exactly what I wanted because every BT speaker I've had breaks down at the charger port. I bought and returned the SEVIZ "40 watt" (actually 4 ten watt speakers) in less than a month for exactly that reason.
I'm not surprised by all the complaints about the radio adjustment given that we live in a time that people have gotten used to everything being automatic, but if you're old enough to know how to use a radio like one from the 80s on back, it's not a problem. It is, after all, a "vintage", non digital, speaker. If you want more precise radio adjustment, buy one with digital tuning.
I get so many stations it's ridiculous and I live at 6000 feet, rural, at least a half hour away from all but two stations, so, if you're not getting stations you must really be in the boonies. I get stations from Mexico and I'm 45 minutes away. The stations also come in very clearly with no interference at all.
I have had a slight issue with the BT competing for a connection with my other speaker and then having a connection with no media or no phone and having to manually reset the connection, but this only happens if both speakers are on.
It's also very solidly built, although, it is manufactured in China. It's MDF, not wood, but it looks great. It's also not one of those vintage speakers you get and end up surprised at how dinky it is and how much it looks like a kid's toy. It's big for a BT speaker.
For the price, this is a great speaker. For the price, you're not getting a Kenwood, an automatic tuner, or tons of bells and whistles. If you want a good speaker for YouTube, TV, or other generalized use, this is it. I definitely recommend it. I'll update if anything untoward happens down the road.

As a result, it wiggles around and you have to put it in a very particular position to charge. The cord literally has to be pulled forward across the screen to work. Unfortunately, even when it's actually working, my device is still discharging. I can only think that the wires inside are too small and low quality to push a charge, even on my 9W charger. They're basically nice looking, sturdy, garbage from China.

title: Made to break as soon as the warranty is up... Don't buy
text: I have had two Fires and in both cases, about a month after the warranty is up, it starts having trouble charging. Even plugged in it discharges. They will tell you " hold button for 40 seconds then plug it in " but that works only about half the time. Every time there's an update it happens again, then there will be another one a couple of weeks later and it suddenly works right again. I have a a laptop that I got in 2009 and the hard drive quit last week. A year for your device is completely unacceptable and wasteful, not to mention pricey. I had been thinking about purchasing a Fire 10, but with the problems I have had with Fires and my brand new Echo, I think I may just ditch Amazon electronics altogether and get Android. Do not buy unless you're prepared for constant frustration over Fire's unreliability.

title: Bluetooth connectivity is terrible, look elsewhere for a speaker.
text:
Great sound quality once you get into the Alexa app and increase the bass. The microphone picks up me saying the wake word all the way across my home, even in separate rooms. Features and skills are great. The Bluetooth connectivity, however, is dismal. I have owned it for less than 24 hours and have had to reset the Bluetooth connection dozens of times, and it doesn't just drop the connection, it just loses audio and you actually have to disconnect and reconnect to get it back. My $5 Family Dollar speaker is 100 times more stable and has only ever lost the connection once in 4 months. I only bought this because it was on sale and I needed a new Bluetooth speaker and thought that the additional features would be a benefit. I really regret it. Unless Amazon can fix this, you're better off buying something else if you're looking for a Bluetooth speaker. I'm beyond disappointed and I hope Amazon can address this issue, otherwise I'll be returning it. Alexa features are not worth it if the rest of its performance is shoddy and unusable.

Update 8/8/19: Amazon replaced the first one and the second one does exactly the same thing. There is still no resolution and every time I call, they try to make me call in the 2 year warranty I purchased on a brand new product that has never worked properly. At least they gave me a partial refund.

title: Great Sensor and no issues so far
text:
Quick review:

We just had an alarm system upgrade and the whole system was replaced. I told the installer and company installing the alarm I didn't want any false alarms via motion sensor!! Well 3 false alerts later all via the motion sensor I looked into a replacement motion sensor myself and I found this model with dual detect.

My installer came out swap out his garbage with the Optex MX40PI and now we just had to wait and see if this motion sensor would trigger any false alarms..... 3 months later no issues, no false alarms and works like a champ. We have cats and 2 of them are larger size and like to run around like crazy in the house and no issues, so we are very happy with this unit !!

So if your having the same issue I was with the cheap motion sensors installed, replace them with these Optex MX40PI and you will be happy campers. No more false alarms :)

title: Great extra bedroom TV
text:
I scored this TV on the black Friday gold box deal and I have to admit I really wasn't sure how the quality of this tv would be. I ordered this for an extra bedroom and thought for the price it would work.

The good:
- The TV was well packaged and protected and Amazon had it to my door a few days after I ordered it
- Nothing was missing from the box
- When my wall mount kit came in after a few mods to the kit ( nothing to do with the TV ) I had it on the wall and up and running with no issues and the TV turned on to the setup wizard.
- The TV was directly connected to cable without a box, auto scan found a bunch of channels and bang TV was ready
- The TV is not to heavy
- The ports are at the bottom of the TV and easy access
- The Remote is OK, not to high tech but not to generic looking and works well
- The picture was great and it's viewing angles no issues - Very clean picture I have to say

The Not so Good:
- The TV thickness is is between thin and thick ( so for wall mounting it stick out a tad )
- The TV power cable has to have a little bit of a bend in it ( no big deal )
- The frame / Plastic is OK, but not as heavy duty feeling as your used to with higher end TV's
- Channel numbers are not standard or maybe I am missing something... I get stations like 2.0, 2.1, 3.0 so on

Over All:
- I was very impressed by the picture quality and general quality of the tv and for the black Friday price it was a Killer deal. If you looking for a extra tv set for the bedrooms, or family room this is a perfect low cost set with a great picture. Thanks Amazon

title: Incredible TV
text:
I spent a LOT of time looking for an LED/LCD tv to go in my bedroom. I had planned to go smaller than 46'' but in the end I chose this TV because of the stellar reviews and the incredible feature list.

The TV came packaged well and setup was a breeze. I'm not using the stand that came with the tv, it is mounted on a floor stand so I can not speak to the previous comments having to do with the "creakiness" of the stand. The tv is amazingly beautiful. It has clean lines and a very minimalist look. I have always been impressed with sony's aesthetic qualities and this is no exception.

I decided to purchase this with the 3d bundle and ps3 even though I currently already own one. I have been watching 3d content and also playing Gran Turismo 5 in 3d. It's very addicting and I can see myself spending way too much time lying in bed watching movies with my dorky 3d glasses on :)

I have since ordered the sony ht-ct150 to accompany this set and provide more depth to the sound stage. The speakers on the tv as suspected aren't really great, but I didn't buy the tv for that reason. I bought the tv for the incredible picture, the gorgeous design and the amazing reputation that sony is known for. And for all those requirements this TV does not disappoint.

title: Really works well!! I can definitely recommend this portable satellite antenna
text:
This has been an awesome addition to my camper. I use it with the portable tripod stand and anchor it down up on the roof. I was putting it all on the ground but I was worried that it would grow legs and run off :)

It works as it should, automatically searching the sky for the DISH network satellites. The software to do that is on the VIP 211z receiver that I also purchased at the same time as this antenna. The antenna is powered by the receiver. I have it connected with a 25 foot coax cable that came with the receiver. I have very little issues with storms interfering with reception, maybe only once did this happen. One time someone walked in front of it, when I had it set up on the ground, and it lost the picture for a few seconds, I guess you could say that that is sort of like a burglar alarm :)

I have not been able to see if it picks up the east coast satellites like it is suppose to and I won't be able to until next year when we venture out to Maine. Also, I have not bought a HDD to hook up to the receiver and use as a DVR. This antenna is suppose to be able to have 2 receivers hookup to it but I think the ability to watch 2 different shows on the 2 different receivers. I will report back when I know more or if I experience any problems.

title: Good but not great.
text:
Bought two Play 5's directly from Sonos and have been testing them out for over a week now.

First the good —to my knowledge —there isn't better multi-room home audio setup out there, not at this price point. But if you're reading this you probably already knew that. Setup is fast and easy, you can join / separate "rooms" on the fly and guests can add songs seamlessly (once they know how to use the controller app).

But here's what you need to know about the revamped Play 5 — the audio quality just isn't that great, not for $500 / speaker. The new Play 5 sounds airy, flat and lacks definition throughout. I'm disappointed because it's been 6 years since the Play 5 (named the ZonePlayer S5 in 2009) first launched and while the 2015 update improves audio quality it doesn't compare to wireless offerings from B&W. Are my standards high? Absolutely. But so are Sonos's.

I really wanted to like the Play 5’s, for most listeners it will be a great addition to a Sonos household (most people who buy Sonos already own at least 1 speaker). Today many people are perfectly happy with compressed audio and disposable ear buds – the Play 5 reinforces this trend. It comes down to a tradeoff do you need multi-room home audio? If so, you’ll probably be better off with Sonos if you don’t mind sacrificing audio quality. If audio quality is higher up on your list look elsewhere – B&W is a great place to start, or ditch wireless all together.

title: Great portable flash for any indoor photographer
text:
This is must-have add-on for any one with a Nikon DSLR who takes pictures inside. Period. And it's portable.

Why? The on-camera flash will work but don't expect stellar results, the SB-400 will allow you to direct the flash up to 90 degrees -- straight up. I'm only just learning how to use bounce flash effectively but after a weekend of heavy shooting with the SB-400 it has already paid for itself.

Skip the newer SB-300, it's smaller, less powerful and uses AAA instead of the AA's on the SB-400. I'd recommended picking up some NiMH AA's -- they provide more stable and generally longer lasting power than alkaline.

The only only downside I can see is it only has one axis, up or down -- when you shoot in portrait mode bounce flash will be coming from the side.

title: The best of the best N900
text:
After searching review after review for a router with solid performance and features I ended up with the N66. I am not a networking professional but I can tell you there is an enormous difference between a good N900 router and an N300 router you may have gotten from your ISP. I would take any review that is not written by a professional with a grain of salt but here's my 2 cents.

I live in a densely populated area with 20+ Wi-Fi networks with decent strength AND I live in a brick building. I have 50 Mps/down from my ISP and with this router I am able maintain at least 50 Mps throughout my ~900 ft2 apartment with one exception, the back porch. Speeds dip to about 15 Mps on the back porch on both the 2.4 & 5 Ghz bands, as I understand it Wi-Fi doesn't get along with brick. There is a brick wall in between my the rest my house and and finally my router. Understandable.

The takeaway, if you need a fast router, I think you will be hard pressed to find a better one. I haven't even touched on USB support for printers, USB applications & external storage, VPN, iOS applications, etc.

title: OK Performance, Bad Build Quality
text:
Good performing lights but a pain in the rear to assemble/disassemble

Lighting is always difficult for video but for nearly $300 you should be able to get lights that are easier to set-up. It would have been nice to have some even rudimentary instructions too -- it would have made MUCH easier

1. I wanted to burn the soft boxes after I put them together -- it took about 10 min / each. We keep the soft boxes 90% assembled.
2. The tripods have decent build quality but the mount for the lights is made out of plastic and was so shoddily constructed it took a rubber mallet to get 2/3 lights into place.
3. The styrofoam packaging that the lights came in were impossible to get the lights back into -- you are going to need a 3rd party case if you want to transport these suckers.
4. One of the door springs on the barn-door spot did not have enough resistance to stay open and just follows gravity.

Once we got it setup it provided ample light but they could be brighter. Time is money, invest in a better lighting kit if you can.

title: Still not sure about this camera
text:
This camera is very easy to set up and understand how to use it and he app.
We have several cameras from this brand for inside our house. So we decided to buy one for the outside. We buy the SD cards for all our cameras so we don’t have to pay a monthly fee for cloud storage. That’s a HUGE turnoff and not anything we want. We have enough monthly bills as it is.
It’s still a little early to tell the quality of this camera. It’s been about 6 weeks since we set it up outside. Unfortunately right after the return window closed, the camera stopped working or the solar panel. The camera no longer charges. In the beginning it worked really well but not anymore.
I contacted netvue customer service when it stopped working. It wasn’t the greatest experience. I felt like they were giving me the run around and Kept asking me for information I had already provided to them. Then they needed the camera ID number. Which I thought was odd. Hopefully they can’t just connect to it and be creepers, watching us outside. Anyways, after emailing back and forth for about a week I demanded them to just send us a new solar panel to check if that’s the issue or camera itself. Eventually they sent a new one about 3 days after that. Hopefully that’s all that it is. Otherwise it’s the camera and if it was that much of a hassle to just get the solar panel, who knows what trouble we’ll have to go through. Anyways I didn’t appreciate the hassle.
Now, there is an option that you can take the camera down and charge it inside the house, BUT it’s not always that easy to access it depending on where it’s located, and if you’re like myself and are disabled and can’t keep climbing a ladder. So this option is good for some people. Anyways, we just switched it out just now so hopefully that’s all that is wrong with it.
I’ll come back to update my review if anything changes.

title: After 2-3 weeks it stopped charging
text:
EDIT 2/12/23. These owners are JERKS! Before sending this back for a refund I had canceled my subscription so when the two month free trial ran out we wouldn’t be charged a fee. Well now that the trial is over, we’re being charged! I’m not sure how it’s possible when the it was canceled and subscription has expired. I have proof of screen shots and from the settings in my phone. Since it was canceled I can’t log into the account because it no longer exists!! This makes no sense at all!! Now we have to go to the bank and show them proof to get out money back and cancel the card they have on file. What they’re doing is ILLEGAL! And we will be reporting them to BBB and filing a complaint with Amazon. This is such BS! It’s sad we have to worry about scammers on Amazon. Do not trust this business. I should’ve googled this company before buying from them. When I researched them, this exact problem came up without actually searching the situation. Please trust me when I tell you there’s so many red flags and not to buy from them.
*************************************************

Edit-12/10/22
We decided to return everything. We didn’t bother trying out the camera we got as a replacement? Just the solar panel we swapped to see if it was that or camera. It was definitely the camera . The app was very confusing. And I’m someone who is tech savvy and have had several diff brands and types of cameras for outside and inside our homes. Once I figured out how to use it, it constantly crashed and camera malfunctioned. It always went off line. The wifi connection was perfect and was never an issue. Just way too many issues in such a short time period. We bought the SD card and subscriptions. It would pick up stuff that wasn’t even there. It say a car was detected when there was clearly no car. The settings were set so it shouldn’t had picked up anything 2-3 streets over. So it wasn’t because of how it was set. At first it would pick up when someone pulled into our driveway then suddenly stopped. Nothing was changed on the app or the camera had not been adjusted.
One feature that we absolutely hated was that we could not go back through the footage.
IT ONLY RECORDS WHEN THERE IS MOVEMENT. so if you want to go back to look at footage throughout the day, this is not for you! Go with something else.
Needless to say this just didn’t work out for us as planned. We’ve been buying NETVUE for inside the house and have been happy with them. We should’ve just got that brand from the start but I like to try new brands and features time to time. So anyways we bought an outside camera from that company and will put it up this weekend.
One thing we liked about this camera was that it’s very light and was easy to set up and position. Some cameras are heavy but this one wasn’t. Too bad it didn’t stand up to our expectations and positive reviews.
***************************************************
EDIT-11/26/22
Shortly after my review our camera stopped charging and the battery continues to stay at zero %. This is why I don’t like writing reviews too early. Seems when I do, there’s an issue soon after when it comes to certain things like electronics. Anyways we’re not 100% sure it’s the solar panel. I contacted Amazon to exchange the solar panel and camera to figure out which one is the issue. We will first start with the panel and go from there. I’ll come back again to update my review.

*********************************************

We bought this solar panel for our new “Wyze Cam Outdoor Starter Bundle v2 (Includes Base Station and 1 Cam), 1080p HD Indoor/Outdoor Wireless Smart Home Camera with Color Night Vision, 2-Way Audio, Works with Alexa & Google - 1 Camera Kit”
I’m going to talk a little bit about the camera as well as the solar panel since they go hand in hand. We’ve only had the solar panel and camera up just a little over two weeks( Halloween 2022) it’s now November 14th 2022. So far so good. It keeps our camera charged at 100% at all times. Haven’t had to take camera down to charge it which is the point of the solar panel. The solar panel is in an area where there’s nothing blocking it from the sun. No trees or anything are in the way. We slanted it hoping if snow or ice get into in during winter months that they’ll slide right off and not build up. Time will tell as we’re getting into winter here in Western Massachusetts. It was Very easy to install and connect. The cord to the solar panel is very long, at least 2-3 feet I’d say. We didn’t need the extra cord so we wrapped it up and used a zip tie to secure it and stuck it in the gutter. But I’m glad they give the option as you never know how far away they’ll need to be from each other. And we won’t have to worry about length or anything if we need to move it elsewhere in the future.
Keep in mind you’ll need to buy a mount if you plan on putting it on your gutters. There are mounting kits on Amazon that’s is a 2 in 1. Meaning it holds the camera and solar panel. Originally that’s what we bought. Then decided to relocate the camera because we couldn’t adjust the camera in a way to get a full view due to the design of the mount, we were limited to aiming it upward.this may not be a factor for all, it depends on where you want to see. We also decided it be better to put the camera underneath the roof where the vents are to prevent ice dams (please see picture I provided) so it’s not directly in the sun, rain and snow. I would think that would prolong the life of the camera and preventing the lense from getting blocked so we can see everything that’s going on. Anyways So we bolted the camera to to that. Keep in mind that even though the camera is installed like that, someone could easily grab it down since it’s held together with magnets. Just Make sure it’s high enough. You’d need a ladder where we have it.
I read some reviews that stated the plug wasn’t secured into the camera from the solar panel. We did not have any issues with it staying in. Maybe the company fixed the issue and redesigned it? Or maybe they received a defected item?
Since this is an early review, I’ll come back after a few months to update if my opinion changes in any way. I hope this was helpful. I tried to include information that I was looking for before buying this camera and solar panel.

title: Love this!

title: More cons then pros. Stick with the original halo brand strap.
text:

So now I’m not getting an accurate reading on my sleep progress. If I wear it during the day it stays on most of the times HOWEVER has popped off a few times if I hit it just right. If o end up losing my halo I’m going to be very upset. They’re not cheap. During the last month or so I realized there’s more cons then pros. Therefor I will no longer be using this band and go back to the original until I can afford the actual halo brand. I guess $25-$35 isn’t too bad considering it now has more pros then cons when comparing to this kind I’m reviewing. It may be past the window for returning. It is what it is.
**********************************************
UPDATE 3/5/22. You get what you paid for. These get awfully dirty and won’t become clean. I do not play sports or go to the gym where these would get dirty faster. I mostly wear it at night to track my sleeping. I take it off in the mornings and leave it night stand. Sometimes I wear it during the day a few times a week to check my pulse/blood pressure and my steps.
Anyways I’ve tried to wipe it down, and soak them. I Still can’t get cleaned. I will not wear it looking like this. Not even to bed bc it makes me feel dirty especially after a shower. It’s just looks disgusting! I highly suggest buying it only in black if it’s offered. But I’m pretty sure it’s sold as a 3 pack of mixed colors.

*****************************************
UPDATE- 2/13/22 these don’t allow the halo to charge. You have to take it out of the band and pop it in the charger on its own.
******************************************
This is a very early review. I just got these this morning. I switched my band to my halo ( 1st generation, faceless) right after they got delivered. Just by wearing it for the last 13 hours it’s wicked comfortable compared to the original fabric band that came with my halo. I’ve had it for about a year. The fabric was soft for the first 5-6 months or so but then started to get itchy and scratchy. I hated when it got wet from washing the dishes or if I forgot to remove it before a shower. It took forever to dry and made it uncomfortable to wear while wet.
With these you don’t have to worry about that since it doesn’t absorb water. I also like the way it fits and feels. Looks and feels like great quality. Time will tell. I love the variety in colors. These were also wicked cheap in price compared to the actual cloth material by the halo brand. I refused to pay $25-45 for just one band. These were 3 for $10.50. It’s about time someone else came out with them. Maybe there was a patent on the halo, so they couldn’t sell them until after some time passed and that’s what took so long? That’s just my guess. Anyways I’ll update my review as time goes on.
I gave it 4 stars instead 5 only bc I just got these and like mentioned, it’s a very early review.

High quality pictures - some reviews stated problems with MMS messages on unlocked Samsungs...I was also worried it wouldn't  work with my Straight Talk service - bought a SIM kit from Straight  Talk (at Walmart  or online with 2 day FedEx  shipping); used the AT&T compatible SIM and voila! Phone works great; no MMS issues!!  Very happy!!!

title: Very sturdy cords!
text: Very quick shipping! Very well made product, the ends feel reinforced so they won’t break. Very quick to charge & works great with all of my products. Highly recommend these charging cords!!

title: replacement printer - love it
text: does all I wanted and easy to understand

title: Good Product
text: regular buyer of these; never issues

text: no issues; low cost without fancy packaging

text: I can only write a review on half the product. Only half of it works. one earbud works, the other constantly connects and disconnects. Very disappointed as it was a Christmas present and they are less than three weeks old. I would recommend you spend the extra money and get a decent pair.

title: Nice and well made

Moved it to a different Wi-Fi because I had to have my modem Replaced and now suddenly it doesn't recognize my password which I know it's correct to my internet and I have spent over 3 hours on the phone with no help .
