Now, the tonearm is another factor. As we all know, too much pressure on the record (or too little) can affect the quality of the sound, not to mention the wear on the vinyl. And, vinyl is a fragile medium, revered as one of the best sources of true stereophonic sound. We vinyl fans collect the best recordings and do everything we can to preserve that quality. When we play our records, we do so with love and care. The tonearm on this turntable is built just for us. It's counterweight is perfect, allowing us to adjust the balance to a microgram. I've not found a tonearm with a more accurate adjustment as this one.

The ability to switch between input types is a nice feature. Some of us prefer to provide our own preamps, allowing us further tweaking of the sound quality. I do. Thank you.

The dust cover is great for those that have their turntable out on top. I have mine contained within my entertainment center and opted to leave it off.

I am VERY happy with my Angel's Horn turntable and very happy to give it five stars.

title: Exact replacement.
text: Really easy to sync, install and use. Exact replacement for the original. Great purchase. Now, if I can just keep my wife from losing it. Five stars.

title: Great everyday tablet for work or play.
text:
First, I should say that I am a Google fan. I use the app across all of my devices. One of the great features of that app is that it will establish your account and all of the apps that you use on a new device, hassle free. Now, I have ONE HUNDRED AND THIRTY THREE apps on my Android phone. They all installed on this new DUODUOGO tablet from the AOYODKG Store, quickly and completely, with no problems whatsoever! And, I can open and use every one of them.

A problem that I have encountered with some tablets is that there was a problem with the touchscreen. It either didn't respond very well to the touch or the area of the screen that actually worked was mostly in the center. If you needed to scroll or select something close to the edge of the screen, you were in trouble. That is not the case with this one from DUODUOGO. The touchscreen works perfectly, from edge to edge. I have my favorite stylus that I use with my tablets and my laptop. It works very well with this tablet.

The quadcore processor works super fast. And, even though the ROM is expandable to another 128gb, I haven't had any trouble with the memory that came with it. It holds all of my apps and a lot of data, just fine.

The WiFi and Bluetooth connections are fast. And, if you add a SIM card, you have all of the connectivity you can get from your cell service provider.

Both the front and rear facing cameras work great. The images captured are nice and clear, and with good resolution and true to life color.

The included folio type cover is durable and protects your tablet very well.

I am very pleased with my choice in this tablet and can honestly say that it is very much worth the money and is a five star product.

title: Very solidly built and perfectly responsive keyboard.
text: [[VIDEOID:41fea5a9ec600804c0de0f68ca8eec81]] Honestly, this keyboard is as well made as the one built into my $1600 laptop. The metal case is the first thing that got my attention. Wow! There is no chance of this keyboard getting warped, bent or cracked with this kind of support (during normal use or transport). I mean, you can stuff this in your backpack, without worrying that it's going to break. It's tough. Next, is the touch and response of the keys. I used this one and my laptop's built in one at the same time. I could not tell any difference. The Bluetooth connection was instant and the communications between the two devices was fast and flawless. It has an automatic sleep mode. After a few minutes of no activity, it sleeps. Only needs a touch to wake it up again. This makes the battery last for several days. It comes with a charging cord and, depending on your adapter, charges very quickly. I use a full 5 watt rapid charger with no issues. I got this keyboard by Cimetech to accompany my tablet. I have a folio cover for it that has a built in keyboard. But, it was too small for me to work on. This one is a full size keyboard and makes using my tablet so much easier. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: Excellent mic for Vloggers and bloggers.
text: [[VIDEOID:4e13cfd07de4866500f84b1db064ea0f]] I will be the first to admit that I don't know a lot about omnidirectional or other definitions of microphones. But, I do recognize quality. I do quite a bit of recording at my desk, where I discuss the different things that I found helpful, when dealing with quadcopters and drones. I, like many others like to share my experience and ideas. One of the things that's VERY important, when doing informative or instructive videos is to have good quality sound.  I have a great laptop. But, the camera and microphone kind of have their limitations. So, I use a camcorder and a desk mic. This RALENO is an excellent mic. The mic itself is extremely well built. The body is very solid, heavy and durable. The screen guard is SUPER heavy duty woven wire that won't be crunched, compressed or damaged very easily. (I think you'd have to beat it with a hammer to damage it.) The volume control on the top of the mic is very handy, allowing you to tweak the input without going to your computer. The USB connections are NOT typical, and much better than most USB connections for USB microphones. The connection at the mic is a mini-USB, like used for most printers and other durable peripherals. Not a micro, mini or C like many lower quality models. The cable itself is heavy duty with a degaussing magnet inline, to prevent electronic noise in the recording.  The mic stand is light weight, composition material with rubber nonskid feet and a tension clamp for best positioning. The mic is definitely directional, as you can see in my video. This is a good thing. As, the sound field is narrow enough to pick up what's directly in front and nothing else. Most background noise will NOT come through in your recordings. I'm very pleased with this mic and happy to give it five stars.

title: Great 1080p camcorder
text: [[VIDEOID:b07e2e0fdb82254279ec877bd10f3748]] The VideoSky 1080p video camcorder has everything you need, from 4K with EIS to 48mp images and a stereo microphone for a broader audio field with your recordings. It comes with a great package of accessories, including TWO batteries and a wall outlet adapter for charging. (The adapters used to be a very common accessory. But, they have become pretty rare as a lot of companies have gotten cheap and make you go buy your own.) I go over all of the other accessories in my video. But, the big story is the quality of the video itself. You be the judge. How good does it look to you? I think it's pretty freakin' awesome. I use this camcorder out in the field, A LOT. And, the video I get outside in the bright sun is just as clear, no washout, no blur.  And, with all of the built in features, you don't need to do a whole lot of post editing. I am very pleased with this camcorder and very happy to give it five stars.

title: Good all around camcorder
text: [[VIDEOID:8452376e58baf2673c81d50931dcdba1]] This digital video camcorder by Vafoton is a great device for capturing video in all kinds of settings. I use it for getting documentary video of all my drone missions and RC offroad buggy exploits, as well as shooting video for family holiday adventures and such. The stereo microphone is good for adding depth to the sound field. The built in digital image stabilization is great for getting smooth action shots. The camera has all the settings and adjustments that you could possibly want, for getting the best video possible, without buying that expensive video editing software. I use it for my YouTube videos all the time. My only complaint, however minor, is that the carrying case is only big enough for the camera itself, none of the accessories. But, actually, I have several camera bags. And, most of my drone cases have room enough for extras like this. So, it's really not a problem, for me anyway. But, it would have been nice, for those who just want to carry this set around, without going to purchase another bag. Otherwise, no complaints. This camera does exactly what I need it to do. And, it does so very well. I'm very happy with it. Five stars.

title: New surge protector, new cables.
text: Recently lost some of the functions of my all-in-one, due to an old surge protector. Should have replaced it about a year ago. Lighting storm blew it out. Well, that was an expensive lesson. Anyway, bought a new surge protector with a lifetime warranty and all new connecting cables, including this one for the coax connections. My advice, ALL NEW. Don't leave anything to chance. And, because the signal over coax is conducted only over the fine copper plating over the core conductor, older worn cables can give you connectivity and signal degradation problems. Like I said, go ALL NEW CABLES when replacing any of your equipment. This one is well made and should last a long time. Five stars.

title: Generator crank broke second use!
text:
We just went through the worst winter storm in recorded history, down here in Austin Texas. In fact, it's still not over. Power is still out in a lot of areas. And, they're still doing 'rolling blackouts', even in our neighborhood. One of the things that we really depended on, with no power, no cell service, no internet, no NOTHING, was having this NOAA-AM-FM radio that was rechargeable by either cranking it yourself or solar panel. To be honest, I have THREE of these things. One in my truck, her car, and here at home. Some may say that I'm a worry wart. But, I say, better to have it and not need it....

This one, from the YEZRO Store took me a minute to figure out. It's a little different from the others. But, once I finally got it, it's really easy to operate. The flashlight is just bright enough to light your way in a dark house. (Don't expect it to light your path down a long dark road in the country.) The 'alarm' is more amusing than anything. (Really, I laughed.) The tuning knob is DIRECT on a very small tuner. So, you have to go SLOW when scrolling through the band for the best signal. The speaker is kind of small and tinny sounding. It has a battery level indicator LED that does a decent job of letting you know when it's time to recharge. The band selector switch works very well, as does the volume knob. You should know that the telescoping antenna is another way of getting the strongest signal from your chosen station. Radio signals travel up and down the antenna in a 'sign wave', not just to the tip. So, after you do your best with the tuning knob, you can increase or decrease the length of the radial (as well as change the angle) to fine tune it even more. This radio is NOT water proof. So, protect it from rain. The ability to play music from an SD card or a flash drive is a nice feature. But, I consider that kind of pointless in an 'emergency' radio.

I know that I've picked it apart quite a bit. But, looking at the primary function of this radio, and how well it served me in this winter storm, I can really only give it accolades. It did an admirable job. Especially considering the small investment I made in it. I'm glad I have it. And, now, it's going back in it's box and in my closet until the next storm. it gives me a sense of security, just knowing it's there.

I'm still going to attempt repairs. I think I can build up the collar where it's wide enough to prevent it from popping out again. But, not everyone is as stubborn as I am. Nor does everyone have an electronics work bench or the inclination to fix things like me. For most folks, this thing would have gone in the trash already. One star.

title: VERY nice keyboard folio for your 8" tablet computer.
text: My daughter was issued an 8" Android Tablet computer by the nursing agency that she works for. She is supposed to do ALL of her documentation on that tiny tablet. it's bad enough that the 'charting' requires so much data entry. But, trying to do all of that on the 'virtual keyboard' on an 8" tablet is just NUTS. I have Cooper keyboards for a couple of my 10.1" tablets and really like them. So, why not get her the 'Executive' model for her work? the keyboard responds very well to her input. The backlit design makes it much easier for her to see. She does a LOT of entry either in the patient's home or in her car. The battery life is great. She can go for a couple of days without recharging. And, she does a LOT of data entry, during her 12-16 hour work day. (Poor kid.) The quality of Cooper products is always great. the 'leather' material is always very good. The stitching is always perfect. The keyboards work flawlessly. And, syncing them with your tablet is a snap. I like Cooper. They're good stuff. Five stars.

title: Good sturdy line cord.
text: I needed a good line cord to run from my cable phone modem to my all-in-one printer.  This one is much longer than I needed. But, better to have it and not need it, you know. I can always zip tie the excess to keep it neat. The cord is well made, nice thick jacket and well crimped ends. It came in a two pack, so the other is going to my desk phone. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: Protect your investments!
text: I have been using APC products professionally for years, as part of my job with FEMA. All of our computers, servers, modems, routers and printers are connected through APC UPS units with built in surge protectors, or units like this one,. FEMA goes into areas where storms happen frequently and with great ferocity. Power interruptions and surges are very common. A few months ago, we had an electrical storm in our area, lots of lighting and thunder. We took a pretty good hit somewhere near our house which knocked out power for a pretty large area, and caused some damage to the grid. Unfortunately, the little power strip that I have all my home network gear plugged into didn't stop the surge and it blew out the internal fax modem of my all-in-one printer. (I'm rather disappointed that the house circuit breakers didn't provide enough protection. This is a new home.) Now, we don't fax every day. But, when you need it, you need it and don't want to go to UPS store to fax a simple one page document. We did this for a while. But, finally, I broke down and got a new printer. So, this time, it's going to be well protected. As is everything else in my home network equipment. This APC unit protects ALL of the connections, phone, ethernet, coax AND electrical. It even comes with jumpers for all three data connections. $25 is a small price to pay, to protect over $2,000 worth of equipment. Oh, and just remember that most surge protectors have to be replaced like every three years. This one comes with a LIFETIME warranty with $1000 equipment replacement guarantee. So, good purchase. Five stars.

title: Great camera, but the microphone is very weak.
text: I like the technology in an auto-tracking camera. I think that it's pretty awesome. This one does a great job of that and the picture quality is very good. However, the recorded sound is terrible. I don't know if it's the microphone itself (the small hole in the top is where the mic is) or the processor that handles the audio input. But, either way, the poor sound quality makes this microphone a bad product. I am returning it as defective. One star.

title: The perfect keyboard folio for your tablet.
text: I'm using it right now. I have a new tablet computer that was not the most common of dimensions. It's built more like a reader than the typical tablet. So, I wasn't sure that this keyboard folio by Cooper would work. But, it does, very well. And, the keyboard is just awesome. The key stroke response is great. The battery life is great. The cover is VERY well assembled with quality materials. The stitching is perfect. The PLU leather is beautiful. After doing everything in black for years and years, I opted for the red one. Very happy with that decision. The one thing that I wish that they had done was to include an elastic loop inside the spine to hold a stylus. I have large fingers and find most touch screens rather annoying. I MUST use a stylus to navigate through a maze of touch screens. So, having a stylus handy is required. The detachable keyboard is very handy when I go to Instagram, which always stays in portrait mode. I just detach the keyboard and tilt the tablet. So, all in all, I have to give this keyboard folio a five star rating.

title: Excellent, fast and responsive tablet.
text:
I have tried a lot of tablets, for distribution at a local school. For the money, this is one by TOKECY of the best ones I've tried. It works as well as some costing much more. The octa-core processor can handle multiple tasks simultaneously, plays video flawlessly and responds quickly to input commands. The display is crisp and clear. The sound is nice and clean. It comes pre-loaded with Android and Google. Funny thing, I didn't have to go through a whole lot of set up steps like I have with others. 6 gigs of RAM gives you plenty of operating power and the 64 gigs of ROM means plenty of storage capacity for movies, videos, pictures and apps. That ROM is also expandable with up to 128 additional gigs by onboarding a micro-SD card. (Be sure to use at least a U2 card for speed. U3 is the fastest and is better for running UHD video.) The battery life is great. I charged mine about 4 days ago. I've been playing for a few hours with the tablet every day, without ever shutting it completely down and I still have about 25% battery left. It comes with a USB-C charging cord and AC adapter, and a USB-USB.C adapter. One point where I have a small issue is the instruction manual. it's very small and very poorly written and printed. If this is your first Android tablet, it may take you a bit to sort it all out. But, thankfully, Android OS is very user friendly and quickly learned for most. I'm one that likes to keep a screen protector on my tablet and keep it in a folio cover, sometimes with a Bluetooth keyboard and stylus. I haven't looked for any of those accessories for this tablet yet. But, I can tell you that I have five other tablets and none of the accessories I have for them will fit this one. I'll start that search today, and report back what I have been able to find. But, aside from that, I cannot find a single fault in this tablet and can say that it really is a good deal, worth every penny. Five stars.

Update: Cooper makes a very good keyboard folio cover that works very well with this tablet. The only downside is that it doesn't have a holder for your stylus. I have to figure that one out for myself. Here's the link to the folio:
https://www.amazon.com/gp/product/B00NA1Q80M/ref=ppx_yo_dt_b_asin_title_o03_s00?ie=UTF8&psc=1

title: Great sound from a compact speaker.
text: [[VIDEOID:564842fa221c9d26bfda6afccb1830a8]] Musibaby has a line of speakers, from this little personal compact M88 up to a big guy powerful enough for a major party. I like the M88 for a couple of reasons, the sound quality and battery life. One thing that I wish that they had done was to put another passive cone in the other end of the speaker and set it up to lay on it's side. But, just as it is, it still provides great quality sound. The bass is great for such a compact size and the treble is nice and crisp, even at high volume. The battery life is great. On a single charge, I have been able to listen to my favorite music for several hours for two days and still have battery left. It comes with a lanyard, usb charging cord and a 3.5mm auxiliary cable. The short video will not do it justice, because you're hearing through your laptop speakers. But, trust me, the sound quality is there. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: Works when others don't.
text: I picked up another brand at another store, because they were handy, before I got these. And, even though the WiFi signal in that end of the house is strong enough to run the laptops, TV, Echo+, cell phones, etc., they would not connect. So, I took them back and ordered these. They work perfectly. Now, we can turn the bedside lamps on and off with Alexa. Just what we wanted. Simple to set up and operate. The four pack makes them very economical. Five stars.

title: It has one job. And, it does it well.
text: Nothing complicated about it. It sits on the counter. The Show sits on top. Not a big deal. But, it is well made, solid, stable and looks good. Five stars.

title: Perfect Echo device for our home.
text: I had an Echo+ in the living area of our 'open floor plan' home. And, it's great. But, the one thing that my wife and I were wanting to do, was to make video calls to others, using Alexa. Her sister got a smaller 'Show' and placed it in her kitchen so she could look up recipes and do other Alexa related things. So, we got this Show 8. We still haven't figured out how to do the video calls. But, we are really enjoying all of the other benefits of this device. Since it works with Ring, we can view all of our security cameras with it. And, we can still do all of the other things that we did with the Echo+. Plus, the Show is always popping up with other things for us, like the headlines in the news, new recipes and so many other things. Having the visual display and cues have really made a difference in our home. We all really like it. Five stars.

title: Good product. Worth the money.
text: I liked this stand. With only one exception. The top will tilt. But, it will not swivel. So, if turning the whole stand is okay with you, then this device is a great option. Five stars.

title: Perfect for your Echo Show 8!
text: I had several options for a stand for my new Echo Show 8. Some plastic. Some only tilted. Some only swiveled. I opted for a nice metal one for the ability to remain stationary. Swiveling and tilting to make it easy to reposition without moving the stand. And, this one has stronger magnets to hold the Show in place better, lessening the chance of it becoming dislodged and falling to the floor. YIKES! The flat black color with a little bare metal accent looks really nice on the counter. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: Great Class 10 UHD micro-SD cards.
text: Seems like I never have enough of these things. I have to keep buying more, for all of the cameras and drones that use them. So, I thought I would try these from Gigastone. I did good. These cards work great. I tested each one, to make sure that it was a good card before I packed it with a camera or a drone. Every single card was trouble free. If you need high speed Class 10 cards, and want an economical price, I can honestly recommend Gigastone to you.

title: Perfect for data transfer.
text: I bought these heavy duty, braided jacket, high speed cables for just one purpose, to transfer videos and images from my phone to my laptop. They work extremely well, with no latency, and trouble free. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: At the risk of sounding like a commercial.....AMAZING!
text: This xdobo speaker IS amazing! It was almost fully charged when I got it. So, I didn't have to wait long to try it out. Maybe about 20 minutes. it paired with my phone perfectly, instantly. Now, I'm sitting here, listening to it while I write the review on it. I am truly impressed and surprised by the quality of the sound coming from this speaker. Usually, when I get a Bluetooth speaker, I have to use an app on my phone to richen the bass and clear up the treble. I was already planning on opening up the app to test this speaker. I was blown away, when I started playing my favorite Pandora station and was actually FEELING the bass thumping through the table. You don't have to turn the volume up very much. The richness of the sound is even better than my JBL Charge 3. (No. Really. It is.) I don't miss a thing. It's all perfectly reproduced, from the highest trebles to the deepest bass and everything in between. I can't speak on the waterproof qualities. I'm not going to test it. I'm sure you can splash it by the pool and it will be fine. It's rated to withstand a good drenching. The twin cones are great. Much better at producing stereo than a single. The true wireless stereo means I can connect it to any other speaker that has that capability. That's gonna come in handy at the pending Christmas party. Fantastic purchase. Five extremely happy stars.

title: Easy data transfer
text: I have a Samsung phone. I take a lot of pics and videos with it. The easiest way that I have found to transfer all of that data is this SD card reader. Plug in a card (either SD or micro-SD) attach it to your phone. Download the data to the card. Then, switch to my laptop to upload. This is especially helpful with videos. Videos are too large to send over wireless networks or data plans. The attached dust covers for the adapters are nice. Keeping the covers handy and the adapters free of debris. I like this device. Five stars.

title: Well made does-it-all backpack
text: I've been looking at this backpack for months, comparing it to others, price checking. I finally pulled the trigger on this one by WITZMAN and I'm glad I did. It is so well built that I know I'll be using it for years. Not just a backpack, it's also a satchel, computer bag and even a weekender bag. It's nice and roomy, with plenty of separate pockets for sorting and easy access. The shoulder and body straps adjust very easily and are very comfortable. The only thing I would have liked would be a bit of that 'weathered leather' panel finish here and there. Otherwise, I can't find a single thing to complain about. This is a great backpack. Five stars.

title: Can't download the activation key!
text: It looks good. I'm sure it would be great, if you could get it to work. The instruction manual is smaller than a book of postage stamps. I could cover it with my thumb! There are no clear instructions on how to orient the arms, or how to hold it. Then, there's a QR code that you're supposed to scan, to get the activation key. The device won't work, without it. And, after three failed attempts to get it, I gave up. So, no key, no activation, no gimbal function. I don't care how good the technology is. If you can't turn it on, it's junk. One star.

title: The most lifelike reproduction from a USB microphone.
text: I have to attend virtual meetings three times a day. I have a very good speaking voice. I was actually a DJ in a past life. But, with the microphone built into our laptops, I noticed that recordings of the meetings had pretty poor quality. So, I bought this USB mic from VIMVIP. As luck would have it, I made a great selection. The quality of the recordings is now very lifelike, almost like real time in person. It's super easy to set up. The pop screen is a big help. The background noise cancellation helps a lot too, eliminating background conversations and office racket. I am very pleased with this purchase. Five stars.

title: Well made and durable.
text: These auxiliary cords work very well. They are well designed and manufactured with quality materials. I move around a lot and need cables this good for my travels. These are going with me everywhere. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: Nice having a tablet that is also a laptop.
text: [[VIDEOID:7ae975dde0e13eb7fa2312200aa2ccc7]] Not everyone can afford a 'Surface'. Not everyone NEEDS a surface. I have a work computer, a personal computer and a tablet. My personal laptop is BIG. I don't like lugging it around all the time, because of it's size and weight. But, I do like having that technology with me for all the same reasons I have the laptop. So, a nice lightweight tablet with a detachable keyboard folio cover is the answer. And, EOSO has the best one at the best price. The keyboard is almost as big as the one on my Dell Latitude 7490 (the work computer) and just as easy to use. the keystroke is very comfortable. The ABS keys are very durable. It's a full function keyboard. Not the basic type that is so common. It works with iOS, Windows and Android. It's super easy to pair. Will work with ANY tablet from 9 to 10.5 inches. The tablet is held securely in place. The keyboard is easily removed for comfort. The battery life is phenomenal. This device makes life so much easier. I could not be happier. The only problem I have found, as I continue to work with this keyboard / folio is that the keyboard does NOT have a standby or sleep mode, where it will automatically 'hibernate' after so many minutes of NOT being used. So, after a day or so of being idle, the battery dies. Not really a deal breaker. I can just charge it or remember to shut it off, when I'm not using it. But, seeing that there ARE keyboards out there that DO have a 'hibernation' mode for about the same price, I had to delete one star for this particular product.

title: Reliable record of our driving encounters.
text:
Everyone in my family has a dash cam (thanks to me). I got one for myself first. Then, thinking about how my daughter spends so much time on the road, being a traveling nurse for a home health agency, I got one for her. Then, my wife started driving back and forth to her mother's several times a week. So, I got one for her. To start with, I tried some cheaper ones. But, they all crapped out within a few weeks, malfunctioning in one way or another. So, I took all of that as a costly lesson learned and spent a little more for quality. This one has proven to be very reliable and trouble free. It shuts off automatically when we park the car in the garage. It starts up automatically when we start the car and begins recording. The quality of the recording is great. I pulled the card and reviewed some of the video. The images are crystal clear. The features are very easy to set using the controls on the side. The one complaint that I would have is how elongated the windshield mounting system is. It protrudes quite a distance and is not really easy to tuck into a non-obtrusive location. But, my wife, on the other hand, likes it exactly the way it is. It doesn't bother her at all. Well, it's in her car. So, if she's happy, I'm happy. So, YAY! Great purchase. Five stars.

Update, 6 months after my first purchase of this great dash cam. It continues to work perfectly, without fail. My wife transferred it to her new car and it still continues to amaze me with how well it works. It's plugged into a power port that shuts off, when the car does. So, there is no 'parking monitor' function. But, every time she starts the car, it comes on and starts recording. I won't repeat all the points of the original review. But, I will say this; I just bought another one of the exact same cams for my truck. So, I give it yet, another five stars. Gee, that makes 10 stars! ;)

Update, 3 months later. Mine decided to crap out. It started doing strange things and no matter what I did, it only got worse. So, I contacted DEEWAZ. After a few emails back and forth, going through all of the trouble shooting steps, they finally agreed with me that, the cam was defective. They sent me a new one. I've been using it since. Including on this nice long vacation road trip to Florida. Very happy with it. And, with their customer service.

title: Very nice, and at a nice price.
text: The Duterid USB condenser microphone is a modest, compact, simple microphone designed to get you the best quality sound with the least amount of hassle. Plug it into a USB port, go to your settings on your laptop and select this mic as your audio input device and you're good to go. I am very impressed with the quality of the audio recording I got with it. It eliminates most background noise as the pick up is omni-directional (toward the user). And, the sound is reproduced faithfully in the playback. I know that part of this is determined by the quality of the playback equipment. But, you also need to have a good recording to start with. I like the Duterid microphone and am very pleased to give it five stars.

title: Great softbox light, great value.
text: I really like GVM photography studio lighting products. In fact, for nearly all my indoor photo and video projects (and sometimes outdoors too) I use GVM lighting. This was my most recent acquisition, a 'softbox'. If there's only one lighting tool in your 'tool kit' this should probably be it. The soft box is used more often than any other light, because it's the most versatile. For it's size, it has brighter light than many panels, and can be adjusted for sharpness as well as intensity. In your studio, you will probably want to leave this one assembled and standing in the corner or somewhere out of the way. The 'dish' or the umbrella looking part is NOT easy to assemble and it takes a little time. Each rib must be fed through the fabric and stopped in the pocket. At first, the ribs might keep falling out of the hub (very loose fit). But, at the end, you will be straining to get them in place. The fabric is very taught and those fiberglass ribs are very stiff. The light is really bright at the high end. There are two diffuser panels. The large one that covers the entire reflective dish. And, a smaller one that just covers the lamp and still allows SOME brighter lighting from the dish. Then, using both of them together would soften the light much more. The electronics could get very warm. But, the lamp has it's own excellent, super quiet, built in cooling fan that prevents overheating. (Very nice!) The set comes with a carrying bag that is big enough for the cords, power pack, fabrics and ribs. And, the boxes are good enough to use for storage and even carrying to a remote location. I think that a carrying bag or case big enough to carry the whole kit would have been nice. The boxes WERE NOT DESIGNED for constant use like a bag or case would be.  But, over all, I'd say that GVM has yet another great product to their line up, and my studio. I'm very pleased. Five stars.

title: Great light box for your photography studio.
text: I really like this Fositan light box. I don't have enough room to keep a light box this size open all the time. But, when I'm in need of some close up photography of something related to my hobbies (I share a lot), I want to take the best pictures possible. The Fositan light box is simple to stand up or take down. It stores easily, has a carrying strap and looks like a poster folio when folded. The LED lights are great, with a clean white light that is dimmable. There's a diffuser panel that goes inside and softens the light, eliminating reflections. It has three ports that are closed with velcro. One on top and two in the front. Each port cover can be completely removed or adjusted to your liking. The backdrop panels are nice, heavy matte sheets of plastic. With a good enough range of colors to suit just about any requirements. They are held in place by straps, one at the very front of the bottom and one at the very top of the back. And, of course, if you want, you can always make your own 'custom' backdrops out of nearly any sheet material that you can trim to fit. With some objects, like the 4WD RC car I have in the pics, I am planning on getting some kind of poster that either has an outdoor theme or maybe a race track. Because most posters are glossy, you will need to go to the art store and get some clear matte spray to reduce the glare and reflections.  In those pics of the RC, you can see how well the Fositan box works. No bright glare. No shadows. Just a very cool looking RC. I am very happy with my Fositan light box. I know I will be using it for a LONG time, and getting a LOT of great pics with it. Five stars.

title: Ear popping  bass!
text: I am really hooked on bluetooth speakers and am always looking for the next big thing or the next real bargain. I also really like to give this kind of thing as a gift to family and friends. So, I was very pleasantly surprised to find this gem by Daykit. I have had similar appearing speakers and given them to co-workers as gifts. But, appearance is all they had in common with this one. I was actually stunned when I heard how deep and rich the bass was, coming from this compact speaker. I mean, it rivals speakers twice it's size. I did some testing with my favorite rock group from the 80's, the Electric Light Orchestra. Because they are a rock group that employs the full range of orchestral arrangements, their sound is really hard to reproduce with less quality products. I can tell you, with all sincerity, this speaker got it all and the sound is magnificent. There is one area that I think that could use some improvement. The speaker has no obvious front, back, top or bottom. Only the location of the 'control panel' gives you any indication of how to position it. It turns out that the control panel is on the bottom side, not the back. So, charging it requires that you have the top facing you, which isn't all bad. That's where the midrange and treble are coming from. The best bass is being resonated from the ends, where the passive diaphragms are. So, standing this thing on one end or the other is going to negatively impact your listening experience. In my opinion, they need to put some bumps, stubs, nubs or something in that silicone strip that covers the control panel to indicate that it is also the proper bottom of the device. This would give you the best listening experience and also prevent the thing from rolling over (annoying). I have been able to use the attached cord to prop it in the best position. But, feet would still be better. Anyway, it still gets five thumping stars for both the sound quality and the battery life. You can listen to your tunes for many hours on this speaker without going back for a recharge.  Good purchase. Five stars.

title: Not just toys!
text: [[VIDEOID:acdf4e3eeba5db6935b5794352d29f3b]] These walkie-talkies are PERFECT for just about any activity where you need to talk to someone while you're out on some adventure. (We even use them when we go shopping. I get half the shopping list and she gets the other half. We go opposite directions in the giant stores and keep in touch with these wonderful little guys.) Super easy to operate. Just turn them on and push to talk. Or set it to VOX (voice activated transmit) and just keep them somewhere on your front, upper body and you don't even have to push the button, the sound of your voice will be enough to activate it. There are more features to these walkie-talkies than I can list here, that make them perfect for nearly any environment, including professional work in the field, including squelch, CTCSS and 'roger tones'. You can even keep things quiet by plugging in an earphone. They have a small flashlight built in. But, I would not depend on it to light my way on a dark night, just for digging around in your tent or backpack.  In my video, I was down at a friends house, three blocks away, and talking to my wife, who was still at home. The price for this four unit set was crazy cheap, for the quality and function built into it. Great purchase. Five stars.

title: Surprisingly awesome sound!
text: I like bluetooth speakers. I have a few. I'm always carrying one in my backpack, with my laptop, or tablet computer. I looked at the specs on this one. Then, after careful consideration and comparison, I decided to get this one. I'm glad I did. First, it came with nearly a full charge, so I didn't have to wait to start using it. Next, the ruggedized body really protects the device. The weight of it is impressive. The shape is sensible. Round ones, cylindrical ones tend to roll away. This one stays put. The battery life is amazing. I played my tunes on this guy for hours, three days straight, before I had to recharge. Finally, and not the least important, is the sound. I was actually surprised to hear such rich bass coming out of this compact speaker. It was THUMPING. The midtones were great and the treble was crisp and clear. But, it was the bass that really got my attention. I'd include a video with sound. But, replaying it with your laptop speakers CANNOT do it justice. This MuGo bluetooth speaker is well worth the investment. Good purchase. Five fantastic sounding stars.

title: Great professional set up for your BLOG studio.
text: [[VIDEOID:f860621c3051d81a898f0e15eb53a17f]] Whether your doing blogs, vlogs, voice overs, or any other kind of recording, you need a good mic. This is the one. It comes complete with everything you need to set up your studio, including a splitter so you can check your audio while your recording. Very professional. Very budget conscious. Very good buy. Five stars.

title: Much needed accessories for your laptop (or desktop) computer.
text: [[VIDEOID:be6b064b9e1b350ae018ba9994bb2852]] The first thing I said, when I pulled this keyboard of the box was ‘Wow!’ This is a very nice keyboard and mouse combination. The keyboard has perfect response to touch and has all of the functions that the OEM built in keyboard of the laptop has, including a full 10 calculator keyboard on the side. The mouse does exactly what you expect a mouse to do, it glides easily, clicks smoothly and feels good in my hand. I really like that it is all wireless, so I can use it anywhere. I can even project my computer screen to my tv and use the keyboard and mouse from the couch (or in bed). The range is excellent. I really like this combo. It even includes a mouse pad. In fact, I’m writing this review with it, right now. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: Best I've tried yet!
text: I like having a dash cam. It's good to know that I can have a record of anything that happens while I'm on the road. I have had more than one in the past. I guess that the old adage is true. You get what you pay for. My previous purchases of dash cams wound up in the trash. None of them lasted more than a few weeks, before they started malfunctioning. I don't know if it's the Texas heat or what. But, they just didn't last. I've been using this 360 dash cam for a couple of weeks now. It's still doing exactly what it's supposed to. I've found some features of this camera to be very interesting and likable. First, the 360 thing is great. The camera does a great job of giving you an all around view. Now, the touch screen is awesome. You can make any kind of adjustments, without pushing buttons and scrolling through countless menus. And, finally, the views (and recordings) are really easy to change. You can go from a wide view of in front to a four view display or front and back view. Then (and this is what blew me away) you can adjust the angle of each view by simply touching it on the display! Incredible! I drive a big pick up truck and was able to adjust my four way split screen EXACTLY to what I needed, to see out front, in the cabin and out each side window! Wow. So cool. Very happy with this purchase. Five stars.

title: Great camcorder for the money.
text: This camcorder has all the features of the 'big brand' models, without the big brand price. It all works very well, the included accessories are very helpful. I set it up on a tripod, to capture the action of me setting up and flying my drones, for videos I post on YouTube. I am very pleased with this camcorder. Five stars.

title: Perfect security, super simple.
text: I now have security cameras all the way around my house. This Yeskamo security camera was a super simple answer to a really complicated issue. How do you get 100% security for an area WITHOUT spending a fortune and doing a lot of expensive wiring? Once I got this camera installed, I haven't given it a second thought. I get instant notifications on my smartphone, with every movement in the protected area. The daytime pics are high resolution and crystal clear. The night time pics are almost as clear, with the IR lighting provided by the camera. You can record both locally to your phone AND the camera (with a micro-SD card inserted) as well as cloud storage (for a fee). The pic I included shows how sharp the detail is. You can even see across the street, with perfect clarity! The camera is really easy to set up, with the solar panel (no external power source required). The app works perfectly and gives you plenty of customization options. I'm VERY happy with this camera and the component system. Five stars.

title: Always have 'eyes on' in your home.
text: Set up is simple. Set up the camera, download the app. See everything. This camera is very good. You have HD color view during the day and IR full view at night. The wide angle lens allows you to see the entire room, when you put it in a corner and a clear view for up to about 75 feet in any direction. And, if that's not enough, you can control the view from your smartphone, tilting and panning the camera as you need to, to focus more in any direction. It comes with it's own USB power supply. Because it requires plugging in somewhere, it's best to place it somewhere inconspicuous, like I did on top of the glass eterge. The WiFi connection is quick and easy. The app receives notifications regarding movement and records them both on the SD card and your phone. Excellent purchase. Five stars.

title: Great portable tunes, with no wifi or data plan required.
text: If you think about it, we have made ourselves slaves to the phone companies and internet providers. We have to stream or download everything. It has to be live. Well, sometimes, it's just not possible. And, after you start using a device like this MyMahdi MP3 player, you will find that your anxiety levels get a LOT lower. No more stressing over how good your signal is or how much of your plan you're burning up. This little gem can hold a ton of music or movies, even more when you expand the memory with a micro-SD card. The touch screen is great. And, at 3.5 inches, it's actually big enough that you can enjoy a movie, while your stuck at the airport waiting for your departure. The sound quality from the included hardwired earbuds is great. But, it also has bluetooth. So, you can hook up your JBL's or Beats over the ear headphones and get a theater like experience. The way this little guy was built is pretty impressive. Solid metal case, nice and hefty. Reliable physical switches. Very durable. Should last for years. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: Perfect little tablet.
text: This Y88X Pro 7" tablet is very, very good. Small enough to fit in most handbags, notebooks, folios, etc., it really is very well thought out and designed. The screen is crystal clear. The touch functions are very precise and fast. The Android operating system is seamlessly integrated with their firmware. Everything works exactly as it should. With Google, you can take all of your programs and features with you, across all your devices, including this tablet. The memory is expandable with a micro-SD card upto an additional 128gb. Plenty of memory for whatever your needs are. The processor is extremely fast for a tablet this size and price point. If a 7" tablet is what you need, the Y88X Pro is what you want. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: A lot of bang for your buck!
text: [[VIDEOID:75a2991be925fe0d18bebf5174743aab]] In the accompanying video (shot with this camera at 1080p, standard HD, I could not go into all of the features of this Kenuo digital camcorder. It would have taken too long. But, for less than $100, I don't think you will find a better camcorder. Please watch the video for all of the details. I can sum up the review here. This digital camcorder has everything you could imagine useful in this kind of device. Whether you are taking pics and shooting video for professional purposes, or just for fun, the Kenuo USA digital camcorder is what you need. Five stars.

title: Reliable Motorola quality.
text: [[VIDEOID:571a38012f4389ea2c6a60c0d56833ce]] The best thing about Motorola is their reliability. I'm an ex-cop. And, I'm still involved with first response teams with my current occupation. I have seen Motorola products used by professionals for as long as I can remember. Motorola has been around for a looooong time. These headphones cannot be beat by any other in this price range. The sound quality is comparatively equal to any other in this range. The treble is slightly muted and the bass is slightly flat. But, the midrange is crisp and clear. The quality of the sound is unaffected by the volume. It's just as clear at full volume as it is at 10%. The earcovers are very comfortable, and do a decent job at the 'passive' noise cancelling. I opened up my Pandora and tuned into Santana radio. All I heard was music. Even though the TV was going in the same room at normal volume. Bluetooth connection couldn't be easier, turn them on, select them on your phone and select okay. If you're looking for a solid, reliable, durable and long lasting set of quality over the ear headphones, you found them. Five stars.

title: It is SOOOO good!
text: [[VIDEOID:a5128c033ceec958822c811238a72798]] First, I'm not a V-logger or blogger. I don't do Podcasts or self-centric Youtube videos. But, I DO videos about drones and quadcopters. Some of which, I narrate. I've always wanted to have a better audio experience for my viewers. Now, I have it. This Eivotor professional microphone is exactly what it says in the name, PROFESSIONAL. The quality of the sound recorded (to my ears) couldn't be better if it was done in an actual studio. Part by part... The mic itself is so well made, I couldn't think of a single criticism. It's just, simply stated, a professional quality mic. The stand is super sturdy, solid and easy. The cage is the perfect example of how to isolate 'telegraphed' noise from your desk or table, preventing unwanted noise in your recording. The mic has an open cell foam wind screen, like any pro mic would have. The 'pop' screen is great for those of us that over enunciate our consonants. I don't do that! (roll eyes) The connections are standard, the three prong mic connection can be swapped out for any length you happen to have around. The other end is a standard 3.5mm 4 c jack (designed for splitting the signal between your recording device and headphones). But, it can be used without the splitter pigtail, in case you don't need the feedback. You can tell from my brief video, the recorded sound is very good. Great purchase, five stars.

title: Great camera, proprietary app is clunky
text: This camera is great. Good picture quality, good sound. But, it requires downloading an app that is proprietary and not very user friendly.

title: Versatile mount!
text: I'm doing two things, helping my daughter with her e-commerce business and setting up a little studio for videos about my hobby, drones. I do videos about flying them, and some about unboxing, tests, evaluations,repairs, maintenance and upgrades. All of these 'work bench' videos need a good stable camera mount that is also easy to adjust. This one is it. It will hold your phone, an action camera, a regular digital camera and even my digital camcorder. It's easy to use and very stable. The one thing that I would have done differently would be to add some cushioned non-skid feet to the base. Those cushioned feet would help prevent any vibration of the table from affecting the video or audio of your recording. I can find some and add them myself. So, I still give this camera mount five stars.

title: Great compact hub for traveling.
text:
At home, I have a nice big docking station for my work laptop. But, it's big, clunky and weighs more than the laptop does. Having this nice compact Ikling dock sure makes traveling a lot lighter and simpler. It connects to the USB-C port on the laptop and everything else plugs into it. I have my ethernet, USB cables, speakers and HDMI monitor all connected and can load my standard and micro-SD cards for data transfer.

I can even use this hub with my Samsung Galaxy Note 9! Plugging this hub into it, I can actually use it like a desktop computer, plugging in all the peripherals directly into the dock. It's pretty cool to have an HDMI monitor displaying what's on the phone.

Data transfer is super fast, connectivity is awesome. The dock stays nice and cool. No overheating. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: Handsome, durable and protective.
text: I recently got this new tablet, the Dragon Touch Max10. It's a really great tablet for the money. I like it so much that two days after I started using it, I knew it was a keeper and ordered this folio, some screen protectors and a stylus. I really like this folio cover. It looks and feels like the finest leather. It's design is so well executed in it's making. Every stitch is perfect. Fantastic purchase! Five stars!

title: Good screen protector.
text: I'm glad it's a three pack, it took me one failed install to finally get all the crap of the screen so there weren't any bubbles.  it's exactly the right size, shape, etc. The adhesion is perfect. Made exactly right for the Dragon Touch Max10. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: Great mini-projector for the kids.
text: [[VIDEOID:31c0baac202ec9459a67e0db40c729c]] First, I have to say that this projector reminds me of the character 'Eva' from the movie Wall-e'. Next, It's simple enough for kids to set up and use. It doesn't require any special changes in your laptops settings, it will automatically select the HDMI port for display (at least mine did). The LED projection looks just a little pixelated if you're real close to it. But, from a regular viewing distance it looks just fine. The built in speaker has good quality sound. The clip that I included with my review is from one of my own videos. The projection was on an off white wall, about 8 feet away. That should give you some kind of idea of what the projection will look like for you. Also the room was not very dark. So, the picture (as bright as it was) will be brighter in a better (darker) venue. I know my daughter is going to love this, to add to her video workshop, where she's shooting videos and pictures for her lingerie business.

title: Complete 'scene effects' lighting kit for your studio
text: [[VIDEOID:2fa19e42eb2500b1384eeb567e0fface]] My daughter is building her e-commerce business, sleepwear and lingerie. She is building her own online catalogue with pics and vids using her own models. I have to say that, from what I've seen so far, I think she will do well. I've been helping as I can. One thing is creating her photography and videography studio here a home. We now have the two piece ambient lighting kit, the camera slider and now the three piece 'scene setting' lighting set. This three light set is so cool. All three lights can be controlled by the app, independently or any combination of 'master and slave' settings. They have a nice variety of lighting effects; disco, party, cops, lighting, paparazzi, candles, TV glow, flickering bad bulbs with any degree of intensity from 0 - 100% and removable diffuser panels. Super easy to set up with tripod stands that adjust to up to 8 feet tall. The whole set comes in a well designed carrying case and individual velour bags for each component and stand.  The app is easy to operate and makes controlling the lights a breeze. Great purchase. Thanks GVM. Five stars.

title: And, THAT is how it's done!
text: [[VIDEOID:d634919420a7ac8d27e4195e7912f780]] In my hobbies, I often like to share pictures and videos with my friends on several different social media, blogs, forums, etc. We trade ideas, solve each others problems, etc. There's even some competition between us for the best videos, especially from our drones. I have a collection of action cameras, drones with cameras, special studio lighting, etc. I've always wanted to do some Point Of Interest shots that don't involve flying in the house (kind of dangerous). I already have some very nice studio lighting from Great Video Maker. I saw this camera slider by them, back when I was looking at the studio lighting. I have a new project going, a 1/350 scale model of the Titanic and want to show progress at different stages. This slider is going to add a lot of dimension and interest to my videos. The short demo video above was my very first with this machine. It's not that hard to set up. The cables and connections are pretty straight forward. The camera mount is universal. The track even has a built in leveling system to get the most from your slider. It has enough different shutter controls that it probably has the one for your camera. I really like my newest addition to my studio. Five stars.

title: Great for extending 2.4g range.
text: This device was super easy to set up and install. However, I have a dual band router (2.4g and 5g). The TP-Link WiFi range extender does not give you the option to boost one or the other. It automatically latches on to the 2.4g. Which is fine. But, it would have been nice if I had the option to boost the 5g, which would have helped the streaming channels on the TV in the garage, where I put the extender. Still, it works well, so its worth four stars.

title: Wow.... Just.... Wow! These lights are GREAT!
text: [[VIDEOID:5bf57d89411f42c28b22d217c2a46327]] My step daughter has decided to enter the e-commerce business. She wants to start marketing ladies lingerie, nighties, PJ's and such. She is lining up some models and I'm helping her set up her studio for pictures and videos. I saw this set of studio lights and figured, why not? I am so glad that I did. I don't think I could have gotten a better deal. These lights are as professional as they get. I am super impressed with the lights themselves. They have great physical controls, where you can adjust the hue from sunset to bright white and the intensity from soft and warm to blinding bright. There is a white diffuser panel that can be removed with ease, to increase the intensity even more. With the digital readout, you can adjust the lights precisely and consistently. the stands can elevate the lights to a full EIGHT FEET.  The visors are large enough that you can focus the light nearly any way you want. The whole set comes very well packaged and with a very nice carrying case. Each lamp and each stand has it's own inner protective velvet drawstring bag. The carrying case is compartmentalized to protect the contents. The phone app for the controls work very well with Android phones. It lets you be in front of the lights and seeing the hue and brightness, while you're adjusting them. The lights have receptacles on the back for proprietary Lithium batteries (not included). They use a Sony NP-F990 type, with plenty of aftermarket types available. So, if you planned on doing some outdoor shots, you wouldn't have to worry about power. I am very impressed with the quality of these photography / videography studio lights.  I highly recommend them. Five stars.

title: Very Close and perfectly clear!
text: That's the way things look to me, using these binoculars. I am a drone enthusiast. I have a lot of them. Some of them have automatic return to home. Some don't. And, according to FAA regulations, you must maintain Line Of Sight as you fly. So, either my 'spotter' or I need to keep an eye on the drone at all times. These binoculars are perfect for drone spotting. The adjustment to my optical needs was smooth, the focus to keep the image was smooth, the optics are crystal clear. They are very well made and have a quality feel and heft to them. They do NOT have a special 'shooters' tint or coatings on the lenses. Everything appears exactly as it would to the naked eye, just a LOT closer. The lens caps and carrying case are very well made. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: Great quality TWS earbuds!
text: First, the quality of the buds themselves is great. I really noticed how good the sound quality is, the rich bass and crisp treble. Then, how simple the touch controls are. Nice! But, one of the best features of this set is the 12 recharges I got out of the carrying case, before it had to be recharged. The case has a translucent lid, so you can see what's going on inside. The charge level readout of the case and whether the buds are charged or not is clearly visible without opening the lid. They paired with my phone the first try. No problems. And all functions, music, calls, pause, play, etc. work perfectly. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: Best price for this capacity and speed.
text: I fly drones. I have many of them. Each has their own pack of micro-SD cards. This is the best deal I've seen on the Sandisk Extreme 32gb card. I just bought five of them.

title: Must have for most turntable addons
text: Got this to pre-amp turntable. Works perfectly.

title: Too broad of a 'fits most' range.
text: I have ordered so many of these darned things that it makes me ill. So many vendors are making three or four sizes and say that it will fit any one of a hundred different tablets. But, they're either too tight or too loose. This one fits better than any of the others that I've tried. But, it's STILL NOT A GOOD FIT for my Samsung Galaxy Tab A 8". It's too loose. I give up.

title: Some built in RCA cables are too short.
text: This RCA extension cable is the answer to those installations where the turntable (or other component) is too far from the receiver, in your home entertainment center to connect with it's built in cable. The connectors are actually gold plated for a more reliable connection (less resistance equals better conduction and cooler component electronics). You would think that this cable would be easier to find than it is. I'm glad that Vrllinking has this one. It's reasonably priced and well made with quality materials. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: Enhance images captured with your Mini
text: I have a visor like this, for all of my drones. Even those that have aftermarket cameras. I was very glad to see that RCGeek had this one for the DJI Mavic Mini. At certain angles, sunlight can cause all kinds of interference with getting quality images. I've seen a lot of videos where there are bands of light scrolling through, or sidelight glare. This is the remedy. I like the way this one fits, the way it's angled to not interfere with the panning while in C mode. It's very well designed, snaps on easily and securely. Comes off only when you take it off. Great accessory. Five stars.

title: Now I can talk to Alexa while I'm in the garage.
text: i already had an Echo in the living room, and an Echo Dot in the master bedroom. I spend a lot of time in the garage. So, why not have an Echo Dot in there? Done. Now, I have access to Alexa and all of my smart home features from the garage, while I'm detailing my motorcycle or rebuilding one of my drones.  Good purchase. Five stars.

title: Great way to carry your DJI Ryze Tello
text: This Tello carrying case by HIJIAO is perfect for carrying your DJI Ryze Tello fly more combo. The bottom is form fitted to hold the quadcopter, three batteries, the charger and a game controller. The top half is a zippered compartment that will hold all of the other accessories you need to get a good day's worth of flying in. The shell is a nice stiff design providing protection for you precious little aircraft.  The double zipper design is nice and the handle is well formed and comfortable to your hand. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: Great sound, no noise.
text: I really like this new set of B350 noise cancelling earbuds from Tranya. They are as close to perfect as I have found in this type of earbud. The dual mics have active background noise cancellation for clearer phone conversations. Then, the buds have passive noise cancellation from the ear cups to help eliminate other background noise for your end, also making calls clearer and improving the quality of your music listening experience. And, the quality of sound coming from the buds is also great, nice rich bass and crisp clear treble. Pairing with my phone was practically automatic. The charging / storage case is nice and compact. I'm very pleased with these buds. Five stars.

title: Does NOT fit the Samsung Galaxy Tab A 8".
text: Too short on the long side. Too long on the short side. Bands just flop. The listing is misleading and just wrong. DO NOT EXPECT THIS TO FIT.

title: Needed for your Tab A monitor
text: If you are using any micro-USB adapted device, you will need this or similar cable to go between your controller and monitor. This one is long enough to be flexible and short enough to be practical. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: Why can't they say what it fits and be CORRECT?
text: This was the second monitor hood that I purchased that was supposed to fit my Samsung Galaxy Tab A 8". But, it did not. So, returned it is. And, I will try another one. (Sigh....)

title: Great product... bad fit.
text: IF PGYTech had provided better ordering information, I would have ordered the right size in the first place. IF they had referenced the Samsung Galaxy Tab A 8" in their item description, maybe I would have found the right one to order from them. I like PGYTech products. But, they didn't. And, I ordered the wrong one. Now, I'm returning it and getting one from the competition, because it IS the right size.

title: Very, very nice folio case!
text: I got a new Samsung Tab A. So, I had to get some accessories for it. I REALLY like this folio case from CasePro. It's an exact fit, with the nice rich feel of lambskin leatherette. It has the three stop easel for viewing, velcro closure on the tab sleeve, natural leather color lining, perfect stitching, and overall top quality construction. It even comes with a stylus pen! Great purchase. Five stars.

title: Good quality, exact fit screen protectors.
text: Crystal clear, polished edges, exact fit, super adhesion, simple installation. THREE PACK! Highly recommend. Five stars.

title: Amazing digital microscope!
text: I got this digital microscope for the school where my sister-in-law works. It's a school for troubled boys. The school is not well funded and I donate a lot to them. But, I just had to try it out, before I gave it to them. It's great! I'm not sure on how to increase or decrease the magnification. I haven't figured that part out yet. But, the lighting and focus are easy to adjust. The resolution, too. It has an onboard micro-SD card memory and can record pics or videos of your object. It also has it's own battery, so it's very portable. The big LCD screen makes things really easy to see. In my pic, you can see how well it magnifies a very fine single twist thread. I really like this lab quality instrument. Five stars.

title: Great streaming webcam!
text: [[VIDEOID:8d83e66df1ba842cbf6c199e182723c4]] This webcam is great for many uses, including streaming. If you want to do photo booth projects, Skype with folks, video blogs, etc. this is the webcam for you. It works with a wide number of operating systems and applications. You can even set up background replacements, to make it appear that you are anywhere in the world (and the universe?). The pictures and videos are HD quality with 1080p at 30fps for the video.. You have manual adjustment to the focus. The sound quality is great, thanks to the dual, noise cancelling microphones. The camera can be tripod mounted. With a USB extension, you can easily set up your own picture or video studio, controlling everything from your laptop.  I like this webcam. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: More professional images, just like the big guys!
text: I have Skyreat filters for all my DJI birds, now, including my Mavic Mini. These lens filters are professional grade, perfectly designed for the Mini. The design is such that they do NOT interfere with gimbal operation, don't change the balance, ventilation or function. But, they do provide the same quality images that you would expect from any professional camera. They fit perfectly, go on easily and remove just as easily. They come in a great storage case that is compact enough to fit in my 'fly more' combo bag. Great purchase. Five stars.

title: Perfect sound from these and NOISE CANCELLING!
text: I really like this set of NOISE CANCELLING earbuds! I was kind of leary about the noise cancelling part. But, turns out, they work really well at eliminating most background noise. I have over the ear headphones that do it. But, it's not something I've not experienced in buds before. And, the quality of sound coming from the buds is great, rich bass, crystal clear treble. Super easy to pair. Simple touches on the left or right bud to control all functions. Phone conversation is great. Music is wonderful. Recharging is simple. Just drop them back in the little box. Magnets hold them in place and they're recharged quickly. Great purchase. Five stars.

title: Great sound quality, long battery life and fast easy pairing!
text: This newest true wireless stereo set of bluetooth earbuds by Octing have about the best quality sound I have heard in this class and price range. They are great. The bass booms, the midrange is clear and the treble is crisp. Super easy to pair, and they last all day, for the way I listen to music and use my phone. Super easy to control with just a touch. They recharge quickly in the case, which is compact enough to keep in my pocket. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: Good cable, low price.
text: Great accessory cable for your DJI square plug to micro-USB plug connections. These cables have OEM type connectors and do a great job for my tablet adapted monitor.

title: Simple, quick connections for your 12V systems.
text: These Daykit 12V quick disconnect ends are great for adding accessories to your car, truck, boat or motorcycle. They really simplify the wiring connections, as you do your wiring first, attach your accessory, then just plug it in. Note: These are NOT waterproof connections and should be placed in areas that will not be exposed to the elements (or you can waterproof them with some 'spray on electrical tape'). 12V systems do funny things when they get wet. They don't always blow a fuse. So, insulation is important. I like these connectors. I am using them on my motorcycle for adding halogen driving lights, a power port, an electronic tuning device, LED lighting and more. This is a good purchase. Five stars.

title: It's a great camera, but has a few bugs.
text: I like the quality of the video and pictures from this camera. All crystal clear. The field of view is good, allowing you to see  a full 90* very clearly. The mic picks up audio very well. The app works well, too, for my purposes on my Samsung phone. The only issue that I have is with the claim that it will work with Alexa. It turns out that this claim is unsupported. No instructions on how to make that happen.

title: Compact but powerful!
text: The fit and finish of this Mix Hero waterproof TWS blue tooth speaker (sold by DGNight)  is very good. It has the feel and heft of quality construction. The passive bass diaphragm at the top provides a nice rich and deep bass. The grilles underneath provide crisp clear treble and reflect the sound off the surface, enhancing the listening experience. The charging port is sealed with a gasketed plug. All the controls are sealed as well. Two of these together will produce true stereo. The battery life is exceptionally long, at normal listening levels. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: Great universal tripod!
text: This tripod from Toazoe should be in your camera bag or backpack.  Complete with adaptors for your phone, regular camera or action camera, this tripod can be manipulated to adapt to nearly any situation. I particularly like the phone clamp, it actually screws down like a real clamp, instead of being spring loaded. That, to me is a nice touch of pro gear.

title: Not 'show tunes' but 'SHOWER tunes'!
text: [[VIDEOID:b1f113b6c94591ccd4624fc2b197b5a6]] This little speaker is great anywhere, but best in the shower, where you can just stick it on the wall and let it thump. Which it does, very well. The bass out of this little guy is great. But, stick him on the shower wall (now a passive bass resonator) and it REALLY thumps. Great purchase. Five stars.

title: Very dressy, very business, very nice!
text: My wife really likes this Osoce laptop handbag. It holds her laptop very well and all of her daily needs. It's very well made, using top quality materials. The stitching is perfect. The lining is beautiful. The finish is awesome. It feels and looks like a very popular high fashion brand (GG mean anything to you?). Great purchase. Five stars.

title: Quality video for all of you podcasters and YouTubers!
text: [[VIDEOID:655dd41741dd5cb1839f0f1df42ba6fd]] If you're not satisfied with the quality of the video that you get from your computers built in camera, (or if it just doesn't work) here's your solution. This streaming webcam from Unzano is loaded with features, has it's own downloadable drivers and software (not needed, but very useful). And, it works perfectly as soon as you plug it in. Just open your camera app and select the rear facing camera and WALA! You're ready to go. Recording is one click. Or with Skype, your image is jitter free and clear as a bell. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: Fantastic security camera!
text: [[VIDEOID:33b557a93fdedcf8e5e9189c5a1bf80b]] This CCTV, WiFi, IP, Solar powered security camera by UBell is fantastic! I never would have believed that adding this level of security to our home would be so easy! The app for your phone is a snap to download and install. The camera itself is wonderful. The attached video shows the quality of the recordings. You can store the pics and video on your phone as well as on the micro-SD card you install on the camera. I used a Class 10 (required) 64gb card, for it's large capacity. The camera automatically senses motion and starts recording directly to the cloud in 8 second bites. You can download or delete the recordings at your leisure. You can also just click a button on your phone to have a two way conversation with the person, start and stop recordings or take pictures to your phone. The solar panels keep the battery well charged. The IR lights on the camera do a great job of illuminating at night, without a glaring flood light. I'm very happy with this camera. Great purchase! Five stars!

title: Great value on a great alarm clock
text: This is the perfect dual alarm night stand clock. First, I like the oversize snooze button that also serves as the adjustment nob for so many settings. Then, you can set the back light brightness to your preference (not something you see very often). The alarm has three different options, radio, pre-programmed sounds (my favorite) or buzzer. It has a battery back up, in case of power failures and two USB ports for charging your phones on your nightstand. It's just great, all the way around. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: Need to keep a set in your electronics cables box.
text: quickly adapt your RCA L/R out jacks to a 3.5mm stereo in. Like, how many times have you wanted to do that??? This two pack is just what you need. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: DragonTouch camera for your action videos!
text: [[VIDEOID:b954bae953941c24c1f122c057d51d36]] Okay, I have a thing for good action cameras. Mostly because I add them to my quadcopters for great aerial pics and videos. I now have two DragonTouch cameras. They keep improving the cameras. So, I keep improving my projects. This one, the Vista5 is by far the best that DragonTouch has produced, and the best in my arsenal of cameras that did NOT cost a fortune like some other big brands might. The Vista5 has 4 field of view settings. I go for the 70*, for the most realistic first person view. This camera also has native 4K at 30fps all the way down to 720p for general recording and lowest data consumption. It also has all of your other popular camera and camcorder settings, making it your most 'go to' camera. BTW, the clip I included is at 1080p at 60fps and I forgot to remove the protective film over the lens. Still, you can see some excellent definition in the clip. I am very pleased with this camera. Five stars.

title: Good TWS bluetooth earbuds!
text: Fits in my ear better than any others I have tried. They don't fall out like others do. The sound quality is great. The functions are simple touches to go up/down volume, pause/play music, answer/hang up/initiate calls. True wireless stereo. The compact case is also the charging station. And it will recharge the buds 3 times before you have to recharge it. Instructions are well written. They work with Google Assistant and Alexa. Great buy. Five stars.

title: Best collar type bluetooth you can get for your money.
text: Absolutely the best wireless bluetooth you can get for your money. Great quality sound for you. Two noise filtering mics mean better sound for your phone conversations. Long battery life. One touch calling. Works with Google Assistant and Alexa. This is the fourth one of these sets that I have purchased. They last a loong time. But, my wife is very good at either breaking or losing hers. I still have the one I purchased for myself, three years ago. Still works great, even on my third new phone since I got it. Awesome. Five stars.

title: Great corded set for your new iPhone.
text: Great quality corded headset for your iPhone iOS 10 and above. Newer iPhones no longer have the traditional 3.5mm stereo jack for your earbuds or phone set. You must use the firewire port. This set is perfect. It provides great sound to the earphones, calls are nice and clear on both ends. The inline controls work perfectly for volume up and down, pause, play, answer/hang up and even initiate calls. The buds have optional size cups, so they stay in your ears, even while doing vigorous exercises. Good Purchase. Five stars.

title: Exactly what we needed.
text: My wife is now the official curator of the TE King family history, she is using this recorder to capture stories and narrations about her mother's life, her father's life, stories about their ancestors and stories about her fathers work in the ministry. This recorder has great features, like date and time stamping each recording, excellent speaker, simple search functions, etc. With the ability to download the data from the recorder directly to our laptops, it will make is so much easier to transcribe this information later. Great purchase. Five stars.

title: Very comfortable, great sound, easy controls.
text: This wired headset is great for those who don't like to depend on BlueTooth. Plugs right in, with full function, volume up and down, pause and play, answer and hang up. The sound quality is as good as it gets for in the ear buds, good bass and crisp treble. Very well made ear pieces, strong silicone jacketed braided cord over the wiring, with strong strain relief at the plug and the controls conveniently placed at collar level on the right side. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: Great replacement charger for ANY compatible USB-C device.
text: I was impressed, when I unplugged the OEM charger from my wifes new HP laptop and plugged this Akmac USB-C charger into the USB-C port. It was compatible and actually charged her laptop FASTER than the OEM charger! It also works for my Samsung Note 9. So, if you need to replace a missing or malfunctioning charger and your device is USB-C compatible, this could very well be your best bet on a new one. Great purchase. Five stars.

title: Just.......WOW!
text:
When I first opened the box, I kind of doubted that this compact bluetooth speaker was worth $50. But, after I got it fully charged (which didn't take long) and connected to my phone (super easy), I opened my graphic equalizer app and then started my favorite Pandora station.
