I cannot say enough about how surprised and pleased I am about the sound quality! The bass is thumping! The treble is crisp and clear! I have other BT speakers this size and none of them even come close to the quality! This Miatone TWS BT speaker is awesome!

Note: because the sound comes out both sides and both ends, you need to keep the control panel at the top (or the bottom). Otherwise, you lose some of the sound quality. So, propping it up in the right position is essential to getting the best quality sound.

I had to knock off one star on the portability factor for one thing; it's a perfect cylinder with no flat edge to keep it from rolling away. And, placing it on end will muffle part of the bass, as both ends have that wonderful bass speaker in them. I guess you can make sure that you place it either on a perfectly flat surface or if it's on a slope, that the included cord is underneath like a 'wheel chock'. But, overall, that's just a minor oversight. I still have to give this amazing little BOOMBOX five stars, because of the quality of construction and the amazing sound. I have JBL's this size that don't sound as good. Super happy with this purchase. Highly recommend.

title: Stock mounting for optional action camera
text: This mount allows you to utilize a better anti-vibration mounting system than the stock version, with the four rubber shocks that can be tensioned with zip ties (instead of the anti-drop pins that come with it) to adjust for the vibration of the quad and the weight of the camera. This further reduces the vibration of the camera and thereby the amount of 'jello' in your video or blur in your pictures. It also allows you to upgrade from the OEM camera to nearly any GoPro knock off, with much better features.

title: Nothing spectacular, but it should work.
text: I bought these adaptors, just for the female Dean's T end, which I cut off and soldered to some batteries that I needed to adapt over. It worked fine. I notice that the conductors were kind of small. But, we're only talking 7.4 volts on these batteries. So, it should be okay.

title: Convert your USB-C smart phone into a full feature desk top computer.
text: I had one similar to this, but somehow lost it, jumping around the country with my work. Looking for a replacement, I upgraded to this one, with TWO HDMI PORTS. Connected to my Samsung Galaxy Note 9, I can actually do some pretty hot gaming, as well as very productive time at my desk. I can hook up to my LAN, add a keyboard, mouse, two monitors, add a C power adapter, and STILL have room for external memory devices. I like the reaction I get, when someone walks up to my desk and sees all of the peripherals, but no laptop. They're always confused until I point out the phone. Then, they're just amazed I can do all of that, through this hub. Great purchase. Five stars.

title: A real weekender!
text: This item is more of a soft sided suitcase with shoulder straps than it is a backpack. The way it opens up and the way the interior is laid out is more like a standard piece of luggage. The three things that make it stand out from other soft sided luggage are 1) exterior pockets 2) a compartment dedicated to your laptop 3) shoulder straps. So, this really is a hybrid. And, it's a very good and functional hybrid at that. With room (and dedicated inner bags) to hold everything you might want or need for a weekend getaway, it's also super easy to load, unload and carry. I packed everything I could think of, enough for a three day excursion, and still had room. This really is a great purchase. Five stars.

title: Nice little bud case
text: I could imagine a few other ways to utilize this little zippered case, designed for earbuds. But, it works very well for it's intended purpose. Even for some styles that have the 'wrap around' type support, as shown in my pics. It was a little snug, but they fit. The standard buds (either wired or wireless) fit much better. The case itself is nice 'pleather', good zipper and nicely appointed swivel snap to attach it to whatever you want to hang it on. My wife chose the natural leather color to go with one particular purse. She hangs it on the outside of the purse, like a 'bling' effect. Looks great. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: Your favorite 'wired' earbuds or headphones are now 'wireless'.
text: This device actually has two functions, 1) adapt wired devices with bluetooth capability for your phone or laptop connection. Note: this device does NOT plug into your laptop to transmit signal to your bluetooth headset. If your laptop is not bluetooth capable, it's old. Get a new laptop. You can try getting a bluetooth adapter. But, most laptops that are 'Native Windows 10' are already bluetooth ready. And, any laptop that is 'pre-Windows 10' will have problems with the adapter working properly. The other function of this little device is: 2) A micro SD adapter for your phone or car, to play music you might have stored on that media. This adapter works very well for both applications. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: Junk. Wasted money and time.,
text: The software (driver package) was easy to install from the website. Everything showed up in my computer, exactly where it was supposed to. But, my laptop would still not recognize the dongle and nothing would connect. So, this was a total waste of time and money.

title: Great TWS ear buds!
text: I like these earbuds a lot. First, the sound quality is SUPERB! I added an equalizer app to my phone that really punches up the bass. These buds handle the extra bass at even the highest volume settings with absolutely crystal clear sound quality! I am super impressed by that fact alone. Now, when I connected them to my phone, it was so fast and easy I kept looking at my phone, wondering to myself, 'Is that it?' Yep! Awesome! The charging case is compact. The buds pop in and stay in place with magnets and start charging automatically. When you pull them out of the case, they sync with your phone automatically, no buttons to push. Making or cancelling a call is as simple as touching one of the buds. Pausing or playing your Pandora is just as easy. I guess you can tell, I really like these Tranya TWS earbuds. Good Purchase. Five Stars!

title: Fantastic tablet for the price! Very happy!
text: If I were to say that I was not totally thrilled with any one thing about this tablet, it would be the resolution of the display. But, in all honesty, it's display is so good for a tablet that costs so little, I really can't complain. It's that good. I have been using this tablet for a few days now. It's touch screen, responsiveness, memory, processing speed, sound quality and ability to connect with peripheral devices is excellent. I am very, very happy with this tablet. One of the best purchases I've made on Amazon. Five stars!

title: Excellent light hood for the Mavic 2 Pro.
text: Attaches very easily. Provides excellent protection from direct sunlight in most angle shots. Combined with the right filters, gives perfect video results.

title: Comfortable with great sound.
text: My wife likes them so much, she took them from me. (Well, l let her have them.) The audio both directions is great. They paired to the phone very easily. The standby battery time is longer than two days. The talk time is about 5-6 hours. That's great for such a light weight headset. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: Good price for a dual camera system.
text: The cameras work well. The connection for the rear camera require an electrical connector that is not included. And, you need to know a little about automotive wiring in order to make a good connection. Good instructions for that are not included. And, the little mounting bracket that is included for the rear camera is designed more for inside the rear window, not at the license plate as indicated by the illustrations. But, all of the camera functions are correct and work very well.

title: Great value for these two flash drives.
text: $10 is cheap for two 16gig flash drives of any kind. These two are well made, with the little lanyard to attach them to your key chain or ID lanyard. They have a very bright LED that tells you when the data on the drive is being accessed. The protective cap fits snugly and won't pop off accidentally.  They are already formatted to FAT32 and have the correct OS installed for Windows. Amount of usable space is over 14.5 gigs. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: Great for data transfer and controller to monitor connection.
text: This four pack allows me to put one in each carrying case for my DJI drones that require USB connections to my smart phone, where the phone is the monitor. They work very well.

title: FAST charging for multiple USB devices, including the new C type!
text: The size of this charger can be deceptive. But, if you feel the heft of it in your hand, you will know that it packs a punch. I can charge both my cell phones, my blue tooth headset, my blue tooth desktop speaker and my Samsung Tab all at the same time and STILL charge faster than with the OEM chargers. The EUASOO charger also comes with some heavy duty mounting tape. So, you can attach it permanently to your desk. I just throw mine in my backpack with all of my electronic gizmos and I'm good to go. Good purchase. Five stars.

title: Great sound quality on both ends of the call.
text: Most earbuds will suffer some kind of sound weakness on one end of the call or the other. Either you can't hear the caller very well, or they can't hear you. These work very well, both ways! The noise cancelling dual mics on these provide crisp clear sound for your caller, cancelling nearly all background racket. The speakers give great bass and treble, so your music is very enjoyable. After you've paired these with your phone the first time, they pair automatically when you pull them out of the case. No buttons. Just touch the buds to pause, play, call, hang up, etc. The charger case is compact, and has plenty of battery power. I'm very pleased with this set. Good Purchase. Five stars.

title: Let your new smart device do more for you!
text: First, I tested this hub on older tech, that use the micro-USB connector. No connection. Not even with a micro-USB to USB-C adaptor. So, forget about using this for anything except the latest tech (USB-C). Now, I connected it to my Note9 and it works GREAT! In fact, the Note9 is already set up for this tech. I was able to cast my display to a tv with the HDMI cable connected to the hub, and use my Note like a remote, access my Prime video or Netflix account and watch movies, hook up a USB keyboard and now my Note is a desktop computer! Plug in an ethernet cable and now I have LAN into my Note! Wow! I really like this hub. FIVE STARS!

title: Perfect fit for my Simbans 10.5" tablet
text: I bought this, after I tried making one myself and failed miserably. I should have gotten this thing to begin with. For less than $20, you can't go wrong. My only issue is how close the rubber strap is to the on/off switch of the tablet. But, I got it on well enough that it doesn't touch. The hood material has a flat finish to it, not totally non-reflective. But, close enough to it that no sunlight is reflected back to the monitor. The sides are high enough that only the most direct overhead sun will cause problems for you. I am pleased with this purchase. Five stars.

title: More of a 'docking station' than just a hub. very powerful accessory.
text: I use my Galaxy Note 9 for a lot of things. With this new Totu hub and it's ethernet port, I can actually use it like a desktop computer. Using the HDMI port for the monitor, and one of the USB 2.0 ports for the wireless keyboard and mouse combo, I actually still have connections for a speaker system, external hard drive, thumb drive, and micro or standard SD cards ALL AT THE SAME TIME! I have a hub similar to this, for my government issued laptop. Now, I have one for my personal machine (or my Galaxy Note 9) as well. This is a great tool, at a great price. I recommend it. Five stars.

title: Works great as an everyday tablet, and even better as a display for my Mavic 2 Pro controller.
text: I needed a tablet that met some very particular specifications, for my purposes. This one met them all, at the best price. I'm impressed with the company's moral compass and am very pleased with their product. This tablet performs perfectly as a display for my DJI Mavic 2 Pro controller, giving me a crystal clear image of what the quadcopter sees, with excellent touchscreen response to commands, with no processor related transmission lag time (latency). Coupled with the Skyreat tablet mount, I have the ideal combo. The only other thing I might add will be a 'sun hood' to minimize glare when flying in bright daylight. This tablet's display is bright. But, any device will be clearer with some protection.

title: Excellent quality equipment with superb video!
text: [[VIDEOID:32bfba98895848a903cf464db1bb0f49]] I tested this thing several times. The quality of the unit itself is great. Very well constructed from superior materials, it connects to my laptop quickly and works perfectly, the first time, with no issues. The images captured by the camera are great. The 1080p video is beautiful. The autofocus and auto exposure adjustment is great, always keeping the subject image clear as a bell. I did not test the background replacement, as this is not as important to me as just being able to have good Skype. And, I can say that I've never had a better Skype. Very happy with this purchase.

title: Compact, lightweight, functional tablet adapter for your Mavic controller.
text: If you want to use something larger than your iPhone or Galaxy Note for your Mavic controller, I recommend this product.  The way the neck is split in half and folds flat against the adapter plate is genius. The aircraft grade aluminum is lightweight, but extremely sturdy. The flat black powder coat paint job is tough and scratch resistant. It fits multiple devices I have, including my Samsung Galaxy Tab 2 10.1" with GPS. The clamp has holes in either end that allow you to make your USB connections, through the clamp and keep your smart device centered. This is probably one of the best accessory investments I've made for my Mavic 2 Pro.

title: May work for some. But, not for me.
text: I give this device two stars for innovation and design. And, from what I've read, some others have had great success with it. It took me several tries to finally get the device paired with my phone. Then, after several failed attempts to complete the test, I gave up. It also never sent a successful SOS message to any other phones that I had set up as contacts. So, I can't really recommend this device.

title: Well constructed, fits most phones and tablets.
text:
I purchased this tablet mount, just because it was stated that it will fit all sizes of smart phones and tablets. I probably had an oddball size tablet, with my nextbook Ares 8A. Just a tad too narrow to fit one way, and too long to fit the other. I tested it with my smartphone, it's fine. But, really didn't want to use my Note9 for this purpose.

The two parts of this mount are well constructed. The base is a perfect fit in the phone holder of the Mavic controller. The smart device clamp is well designed and constructed, too. Assembly is simple and the overall attachment and fit to the controller is good, giving you a practical viewing screen of the FPV or map display of the drone's flight, while still giving you full access to the controller.

The nomenclature in the listing, and on the box itself, are slightly off, as far as the versatility of the clamp is concerned. However, as I said earlier, this should still work well with most smart phones or tablets.

Freewell stands behind their product and their customer service department will do whatever they can to ensure your satisfaction with your purchase. I'm comfortable with recommending this product.

title: Well built laptop backpack has a POWERful bonus.
text: This Gemeer laptop backpack is great, just as it is, for transporting and protecting your laptop. I carry my HP Pavilion 17 confidently, as it fits easily into the well padded backpack, leaving plenty of room for peripherals and other goodies. But, while some backpacks may sport a hole, through which you can run your earbud cord through, this backpack actually has a USB patch cord built in! This allows you to connect your cell phone power pack on the inside ( and tuck it into one of the many convenient pockets) and then recharge your phone, at your convenience, without digging around inside to make the connection! Definitely a POWERful bonus. I'm happy with this purchase and highly recommend.

title: Wow! Really, yeah. I love this video camera!
text: [[VIDEOID:828690a76e43addc2818c46f4f29e523]] This compact video camera is probably the most complete set up I've ever seen, in this price range. Plus the quality of materials, workmanship are top notch. The videos I've recorded are crystal clear and worthy of posting to any social media. I'm really impressed with all of it's features and the accessories that come with it. The only thing it doesn't come with is a tripod. But, being an avid video and still photographer, I have plenty of those around. I really recommend this video camera and suggest you get some 16 gig class 10 micro-SD cards and at least a table top tripod to go with this camera. Watch the video I've included. I think you'll agree about this camera.

title: Much better than the built in camera and works very, very well.
text: Great webcam. Works well with YouCam and Skype. Takes good quality pictures and the video is nice and crisp.  The cord is long enough for most situations. The laptop mount is rock steady. Excellent Purchase. I highly recommend.

title: We use this web cam a lot! It's a great camera, great tool and a great price.
text: We ordered this web cam (and a 15 foot long USB extension) for use with our wedding photo booth. It served that purpose very well. Then, after that, we've been using it to shoot video for my daughter's skills demonstration videos, as required in her pursuit of her degree. It's working very well, with excellent picture and sound. I know that this webcam will continue to come in handy, time after time. It is proving to be a great purchase.

title: A truly awesome action camera.
text: The Akaso Brave 4 action camera is truly one of the top cameras out there, at a really good price. It's so packed with features, you can't think of anything else you could possibly add. Any resolution, any image size, any field of view, any exposure rate, any image enhancement, gyro, anti-vibration..... you get the idea. And, this kit includes the most popular mounting options and even an extra battery! I have quite a few cameras. One for each of my drones that didn't already come equipped with a quality camera. The Akaso performs as well as the stock camera on my Phantom 3 Professional. And, that's saying a LOT. I'm super happy with this camera.

title: Great protection for transporting your Charge 3.
text: I have two of the JBL Charge 3 bluetooth speakers. They are just sooo good! Especially when they are paired. Fantastic sound with a 'thumpin' base. I installed a graphic equalizer app on my phone and Galaxy tab, which makes it even better. But, as far as this case is concerned, I highly recommend that anyone who carries their Charge 3 around a lot, get one of these cases. It's well built, out of top quality materials, and protects the speaker very well, with storage for the charger, cord and users manual. Great purchase.

title: Perfect for extending your webcam connecting USB line.
text: We have been using our webcam for taking multiple videos, with the webcam mounted to a tripod. This USB extension has been exactly what we needed to have the camera in one location, with the laptop ( for control purposes) up to 12 feet away.

title: Great protection for your headphones!
text: I ordered this hard case for my JBL E55BT Quincy Jones edition headphones. It's a perfect fit, great for travel. It has an elasticized mesh pocket in the top half of the clam shell case that holds the sound cord, USB charger cord and even the user's guide. Very nice design, very sturdy. Good purchase!

title: Absolutely perfect solution for an 'eye witness' requirement!
text: This car camera is awesome. I am fairly new to this. But, have tried a couple. The versatility of this camera is amazing for the price. Not only does it have motion sensor (it will start recording automatically when there is activity within view of it's 170* FOV lens), motion sensor (it automatically starts recording when it senses movement) and auto-shut off after 2 minutes of inactivity, you can adjust the resolution from 420 all the way to 1080pHD, AND zoom in from standard magnification and 170 FOV all the way to 1.5 power and 90 FOV. You can also change the length of the clips from 1 minute all the way up to 5 minutes. I leave mine at standard and 170 for the greatest range and event capture.  And, in 1 minute clips, so I don't have to edit to have just what I need. Even with it's nice big monitor (which I really like), the camera fits very nicely beside my rearview mirror, without obstructing my view. The power cord is long enough that I can tuck it in along the windshield and bring it back around to the power outlet on the dash. It is possible to have the power cord professionally installed to your auxiliary outlet on the fuse block, to free up your power port and clean up your console.  I recommend this camera to anyone who is on the road a lot or has to deal with heavy traffic and inconsiderate drivers. You never know when you may need an 'eye witness'. This camera will provide you with undisputable testimony! I'm very happy with my purchase.

title: Great value on a must have for data storage.
text: 16 gigs is ample storage for most document purposes. I use flash drives like these to give my clients videos shot from my drones. These drives are well built, formatted correctly and travel well. The swing away cover has a convenient loop for lanyards. The orange LED lights up whenever the drive is accessed by your computer. In a 10-pak, these drives only cost 3.36 each. It doesn't get any more economical than that, for the quality you get. I'm very pleased with my purchase.

title: Nicely made 'bling' for your FitBit.
text: Nice 'bling' for my wife's FitBit. She wanted to be able to dress it up a little and wear it more often. This did the trick.

title: Awesome sound, very comfortable, easy to connect, loooong battery life.
text: I have purchased three JBL headphones now. This set was for me. I really like the quality of the workmanship and materials. JBL is known for the quality of the sound they produce. This Quincy Jones Edition cost a little more, and I really don't know if they're actually any better than the 'non' QJ headphones. But, they sure do have a nice look. I'm very happy with these JBL's.

title: A must for any RC enthusiasts work shop.
text: There's not anything to dislike about these connectors. This is probably the most common two wire power connector in RC. And, most of them are made by the same two or three companies and marketed by numerous vendors. This version is the most popular, with the nice long wires that will accommodate most applications. These provide good quality conductors, good insulation, good male and female connectors that provide worry free connectivity.

title: For 'jello' free video and clear pictures from your quadcopter!
text: If you already have the complete Speedy Prop Balancer for the 9450-S propellers (for the DJI Phantom 4) but also have quadcopters that use the regular 9450 props, no need to buy a whole new set. Just this rod, along with the base from the other kit, will allow you to balance your 9450 props perfectly. The Speedy Prop Balancer is the simplest and easiest way to ensure you have as close to perfect balanced propellers as you can get. You will get the quick start guide with the kit. But, make sure to go to RCPilotsupply.com for full instructions.

title: Good for re-routing your micro-USB power cord to a mini-USB device. NOT FOR DATA OR VIDEO.
text: Okay for offsetting your power connections. But, no good for data or video. They fit snugly and keep a good connection.

title: It has the RIGHT connector for Syma X8 series quadcopters.
text: If you like to fly your Syma X8 series quadcopter for more than 15 minutes, you will be looking for more batteries. These are designed specifically for that quadcopter, with the correct battery plug. Syma and BayangToys are the only quads that I know of that have this type of connector. No other type will work.

title: Upgrade your power!
text: I bought these batteries as upgrades from the 2200 mAh batteries that come with the BayangToys (JJRC) X-16 and X-21 quadcopter. These are the same length and width, and just 2.5 mm taller. Just a slight modification of the battery bay will allow you to use these batteries, getting longer flight time with the stock configuration, or more power with a modified set up ( brushless 2D gimbal and better camera). You will have to change out the quadcopter's battery connector. (update) If you don't mind a snug fit, you won't have to modify the X-16 or X-221 to accept this battery. It will fit. But,this battery has the XT-60 type connector. You will have to either get an adapter (if you can find one) or change the connector on the quadcopter.

title: Digital Image Stabilization, a must have feature at a reasonable price.
text: I now have two of these cameras. Excellent image quality, plenty of settings options. Most valuable feature is digital image stabilization at 1080p and 60 fps. This, along with a brushless gimbal on my quadcopter provides video that nears the quality of the most expensive drones.

title: You only THOUGHT you wouldn't need one of these....
text: Okay, first of all, the display on the Phantom 4 Professional + is super bright. Brighter than any smart device display I've ever seen. But, there's still reflection to think about. Unless you put a matte finish film over your screen, you're still going to get glare and reflected light. So, this little sun hood is perfect. It stores flat, uses elastic straps and quick release buckles to hold it on. It's edges are bound in soft material to protect your screen. It fit's the monitor exactly right, not blocking any of the screen and still sits neatly on the monitor. There's a hole at the bottom so you can reach in and utilize the touch screen. The flat black interior is totally non-reflective. It's deep enough to obscure light from nearly any angle you can view it from, but not so deep as to make it hard to align your eyes to. The little pockets on the side are handy for spare micro-SD cards. But, I still don't know what good the plastic D rings are for. ?? I recommend this product.

title: Perfect for trekking your Phantom 4 into those remote locations.
text: Perfect compliment to the OEM carrying case of your DJI Phantom 4, 4 Pro or 4 Pro+. The OEM case fits snugly inside the main compartment of this backpack, with simple closures for accessing the case and its contents. The OEM case will hold two batteries, plus the one in the quad. That leaves up to four size adjustable compartments in the top portion of the backpack for additional batteries or other accessories. (The panels dividing the compartments are held in position by Velcro and can be moved or taken out completely.) There are zippered side pockets deep enough to hold extra props and elastic mesh pockets outside of those to hold just about anything the size of a 10 water bottle or smaller. There's another pocket on the front of the main compartment (big enough for one of those collapsible fabric landing pads) that has a sheltered zipper closure to keep out the rain. The back of this backpack is well padded with a breathable mesh cover, making it very comfortable for long hikes to your launch site.The whole backpack shell is made of strong Cordura nylon fabric, water repellent and very durable. I highly recommend this product.

title: Nearly perfect transport for your Phantom 4, 4 Pro or 4 Pro+.
text: Perfect for transporting your Phantom 4, Pro or Pro+ aerial camera under the harshest of conditions. The case is super rugged, water proof and tamper proof with the dual locks on the front latches. ( You will still have to take in on board the airlines as a carry on, due to the LiPo batteries.) The inner foam cutouts are precisely fit to the quad, cradling it quite snugly, to prevent  jostling about, with enough give to absorb hard impact. The battery, charger, controller and propeller compartments are the same. The only complaint that I have (and why it didn't get 5 stars) is that they have room for six batteries (seven if you have one in the quad) and no room for accessories, like a lens filter kit, or lens cleaning kit, monitor sun hood, etc. Personally, I think room for three batteries (plus one in the quad) would have been enough. That would have left space for other things. I will probably do some cutting and trimming with my case, just for that reason. I highly recommend this product. Just be ready to carry your accessories in another bag.

title: A must have for the DJI Phantom 4 Pro and Pro+ aerial camera.
text: The camera on the Phantom 4 Pro and Pro+ is an excellent camera, with many adjustments that can be made from the controller, even while you're in the air. However, any good photographer has a filter kit at his disposal, for getting optimum results in any conditions. This is a very good basic kit that will serve to provide the best video or pictures under any lighting condition. The only addition that I would make would be gradiated filters, that go from darker to lighter. But, those filters are for the more professional photogs, that also commonly use special software to achieve the desired enhancements to their pics. Not something I'm into, just yet. And, those gradiated filters are available as a separate kit. I highly recommend this product. It's well made out of top quality materials, comes in a convenient organizer that keeps them secure and protected. The whole thing fits very easily into my Phantom 4 Pro+ backpack accessory side pocket.

title: The best video streaming device on the market!
text: This is my second Roku. My first was just a Roku 2. I travel a LOT, and having my Roku in my suitcase really helps. I don't have to miss any of my programming. And, this Roku Ultra is packed with some great features, has awesome picture quality and enough memory to store so many channels and listings that you'll never have to wait for them to load. The processor time is rocket fast, too.

title: Best feature was the lowest price for 5 cards. Otherwise, they do the job.
text: The best price for 5 class 10 64g micro-SD cards. No problems with the cards. Work as expected.

title: Great part, great price. Get a pro to install it.
text: Perfect replacement part for your Pavilion. But, don't expect to be able to replace it yourself, unless you are a computer hardware technician. This fan is buried deep underneath in the machine. It takes a pro to get to it and replace it. As far as this cooling fan goes, it's just like OEM and works very well.

title: Mount your GoPro ANYWHERE!
text: This is the most comprehensive accessory kit for your GoPro or similar camera you will ever find. You have rigging in this kit for nearly every imaginable scenario.

title: Perfect accessory for your 3DR Solo.
text: The perfect pair to upgrade your 3DR Solo transmitter, it will give you a much stronger link with your drone, allowing greater distance to fly and better control / FPV in your normal flying range.

title: Great new model of a trusted brand. I like my Garmin!
text: I've been using Garmin for years. I depend on Garmin to always get me to my destination. This model has some great added features. My only complaints with Garmin are 1) when you view a destination, it tells you the distance 'as the crow flies' or how many miles in a straight line between points. Then, when you set it to take you there, it shows exact driving distance. The two are never the same. And, 2) I'm sure that this is common with all personal navigation devices, it doesn't always give you the most logical route.

title: Good for connecting your micro USB cord to a mini USB device in a tight space, NO VIDEO.
text: These adapters are great for connecting your micro USB to a mini USB device, for data transfer or charging. DO NOT depend on them for video. They do not contain the required circuits or connections for that.

title: When you REALLY want to know what's going on with your battery!
text: Can't believe I haven't had one of these things until now. Why settle for just one of those little voltage checkers that only gives you half the story? You also need to know what the spread is between the strongest and weakest cells in the battery. (Is one cell going bad?, Can you count on that battery to get you out there AND BACK?) You also need to know, is that battery full to capacity? What is it? 80% 90%? Is your charger not doing the job?

title: The best of performance and affordability, a great camera at a great price.
text: I have purchased a LOT of action cameras. I think I've finally decided what I want to seen in a camera that I plan to install on my drones: 90 degree field of view (no distortion), 1080p60fps (the best of the most commonly used ratio and speeds) and image stabilization. This camera has all of these features, is built very well, very easy to set up and use and is the most economical of the comparable cameras.

title: To bridge the gap between telemetry receiver and smart device
text: Among it's probable many uses, it's required to connect your FPV / Telemetry receiver to your smart device connected to your quadcopter controller. For that, it works very well.

title: Protect your gimbal and camera, for DJI and BayangToys X21 quadcopters.
text: Designed for the DJI Phantom 3 family, this gimbal guard also works very well on my Bayang X21, which has DJI type landing gear. It provides that extra protection for the gimbal, preventing the legs from spreading in a hard landing, and keeps objects from hitting the gimbal. It's also very lightweight and sturdy.

title: Very clever, very well made, very inexpensive.
text: This clever device can switch from a phone size holder to a small tablet size holder in an instant. So, you have the versatility of multiple smart devices on your controller.

title: Extend your control and FPV range with this set!
text: The perfect antenna set to extend both the control range and FPV range of your quad. But, be warned, you will need good soldering skills.

title: A good upgrade from your stock props.
text: These carbon fiber props are much more durable than the stock props, about the same weight and slightly better balanced. They fit a multitude of brushless motor quads. They look good too!

title: Must have for sunny day flying.
text: Designed specifically for the Hubsan TX, this shade really helps in bright daylight.

title: Increase your transmitter range with this kit.
text: A simple modification to your transmitter, to increase the control range. But, be warned, your soldering skills have to be really good.

title: A very good headset.
text: I have two of these. The connection range with your phone is great. You can leave your phone on the charger and feel free to move about, within a reasonable range, and still talk. the sound quality is very good.

title: Great accessory cable
text: Well designed and constructed, very durable, good solid connections.

title: Great extra batteries, good low price.
text: Extra batteries for my BayangToys X16 Typhoon. Work even better than stock.

title: Great for 4K cameras.
text: In the video business, you can never have too much memory on hand. There are faster cards out there. But, I find that the image quality with these is as good as I will ever need. They support the 4K cameras just fine.

title: Hey, it works, its cheap I needed it. I'm good.
text: Really not a whole lot to say about a EU-US plug adaptor. It works. Plug your EU ended device into this and this into your US wall outlet. There are some things you order that are imported directly from the east that don't come with US plugs. So....

title: Great Sound! Simple installation! Good price! Really, what else do you want?
text: I recently added a home theater system, with in-the-ceiling mounted speakers. The guy that ran the wiring failed to run one for the subwoofer that I have sitting in the corner by the couch. I originally purchased a set similar to this from Best Buy. But, below a particular signal strength, the sub would go THUMP and stop producing any sound at all. So, I took them back and ordered these. This set works perfectly! No signal weakness drop off and THUMP any more. Just constant subwoofer performance, throughout the entire movie. I'm happy!

title: For many quadcopters, that don't have their own camera, this is the one to get.
text: I needed a GoPro, to mount on my Solo 3DR. Then most current release from GoPro, the Hero 5, will NOT work. It mounts differently and lacks the required connections. The Hero 4, on the other hand, is exactly what Solo built their quad to use for video and photo. It works very well. I like the versatility of the GoPro. There are many knockoffs out there, at much lower prices. (I have more than a few, for my other quads that don't have interfaces for the camera.) But, this camera really can't be beat for it's purpose and versatility.

title: Most comprehensive, all-in-one rigging kit for your GoPro or similar camera.
text: If you're ordering this kit, you already have a GoPro action camera or something similar. And, typically, you already have the basic holder and probably the waterproof case as well. Then, this kit has just about everything else you need, for any kind of mounting. And, just in case you want to use your smart phone, instead of your camera, it has a holder for that too! I already have a pretty good set, that came with my DBPower action camera (a pretty decent GoPro knockoff). But, when GogoLook offered me a promotional discount to test and review this kit, I looked at it on line and saw that it had some accessories that I've been wanting. So, I got it and have been very impressed and very happy with it. Some components are very similar to others offered through Amazon. But, there are some significant improvements with this kit. For example, the head / helmet / hat mount is made with better quality elastic, with better adjustment and has a great silicone 'grippy' surface on the inside to keep it from slipping off.The sturdy little wrench is a nice touch. And, the floating handle is one piece and will not leak, like some others on the market. All in all, I'm 100% happy with this set up. Someone else mentioned that it didn't come with instructions. Well, as I said, if you're looking at this set, you already have a camera, and probably don't need instructions on how to use it.

title: Not for the Syma X-11
text: This battery pack is great, for those quads that the batteries actually fit. I have several different makes and models. I was offered a promotional discount to test this set. Seeing that i had a Syma X11, I thought 'Okay, I can always use extra batteries and these are higher amperage than the stock ones, so I'll try it out.' I can't tell you how well it works for any ot the other makes or models. I can tell you that these batteries are well constructed and should work well for any quad that has this type of connecter and the battery actually fits in the battery compartment. BUT, THEY WILL NOT FIT THE SYMA X-11. The battery is too thick. You have to force it in the compartment. Then, the only way you can get them out is to either pull hard on the wires (not good), use needle nose pliers ( also, not good) or modify the battery compartment. That last alternative is not bad, if you're really looking for extended flight time. But, for the vendor to say that these will work with the Syma X-11, could be construed as misleading.

title: Perfect cushioned, anti-vibration mount for nearly any quadcopter.
text: Okay, first, I wouldn't call this a gimbal. It's a cushioned, anti-vibration, adjustable camera mount.The word 'gimbal' leads one to believe that it has the ability to tilt and dip, to keep the camera steady. This one has no movement at all. It's fixed in one position during flight. You can adjust the downward tilt of the camera, before you take off. Which is good for getting more than just the straight ahead shots that most stock cameras get. I knew what this was when I ordered it. It's exactly what I wanted. And, it works perfectly. It comes with plenty of nuts and bolts. But, you will have to figure out how to mount it to your quad with your own hardware. None of the hardware that comes with it is appropriate for mounting. I suppose that's because there are so many different ways to mount it, they couldn't include hardware for every possible scenario. This camera mount is well designed and well built out of quality materials. I'm very pleased with this purchase.

title: Such a great aerial videography platform!
text: This set up is fantastic! It's taken me seven months to get to the point where I felt I could actually write an intelligent review of this quadcopter. I have several quads. This is the ONLY one (that I have) that I can say is actually a professional aerial photography and videography platform. I bought it in January (with my income tax refund) and have been learning how to operate it ever since. Which, by the way, you never finish. You will be learning more and more about this quad, every time you fly. I wonder if there's a DJI school? Someone could make a fortune teaching others how to operate this thing. But, anyway, I love this aircraft. If you're reading these reviews, I probably don't need to go into details. You've already looked at all the features and benefits. The only 'con' about DJI is their service centers. They are impossible to communicate with. Period. They will take care of your machine. They will fix whatever's wrong with it. They do a great job of that. You just can't talk to them.

title: Good quality flash drive, low price.
text: I use this flash drive every day as part of my 'tool kit' in my daily work as an IT specialist. It has never let me down.

title: Great concept. But, could have been made with more durable materials.
text: I like some Plantronics products. But, not these. The flexible neck cord does not stay flexible, eventually stiffens and breaks. The soft rubber over-the-ear pieces do the same thing.

title: Great tablet, many uses, including FPV for DJI.
text: Of all the tablet computers out there, I have yet to come across one that, for the money, is as practical, useful, fun and easy to use as the Samsung Galaxy Tab. I bought this one for my girlfriend. Then, turned around and got another for myself. I use mine as a ground station monitor for my DJI Phantom 3 Professional. The size of the screen makes all the controls easy to see. The DJI GO app runs perfectly on this Tab. And, the tab is powerful enough to run all the telemetry without any lag time.

title: Can't imagine NOT having this with my Tab.
text: Perfect companion to the Tab, makes it a mini-laptop and works VERY well. Good sturdy construction, long lasting battery, great accessory.

title: No scratches. No worries.
text: Added this to my Galaxy Tab. You'd never know it was there. But, it sure is good protection.

title: Great upgrade for your quadcopters.
text: I can't testify how these replace the OEM gear on the DJI F450 or F550. I used these to replace the stock landing gear on my Syma X8C, X8G and X16 quadcopters. You will have to do some drilling on either the quadcopter or on these legs to make them fit. But, they are tall, sturdy and extend the foot print to underneath the rotor arms, making the quadcopter much more stable, on the ground as well as in the air. The difference in weight is insignificant. The benefit of this modification is VERY significant, avoiding tip-overs on less than perfect landings.

title: Very happy with this case!
text: This was purchased as a gift for a friend. They are thrilled with it. It's a good fit, works very well, quality of materials and workmanship are fine. The flag design is very eye-catching.

title: It's an okay little camera. Just don't expect what you get from the higher priced models.
text: The cheaper of the GoPro knock offs, it's programming capabilities aren't as vast as some others, it's features are fewer. No micro-HDMI port. But, as a secondary device, where your just after some backup footage or where you're not really going after anything other than a visual record of the event, this is a good little camera. It has the same accessories as some higher priced models, allowing mounting on nearly any surface at any angle. It even comes with an extra back for the water proof case (I found that to be an unexpected but nice little extra). It will not record while on charge. Sometimes, you want to load a 64g card, set it to the minimum resolution, or smallest picture size and time lapse, and record for extended periods of time. Running on battery alone will not work and not being able to run on external power and record at the same time is a minus.

title: Helps prevent low power crashes!
text: Unless your controller has telemetry that can warn you when your quadcopter's battery is low, you should have one of these attached to the battery (and a timer with you on the ground). This little gadget can give you an immediate and accurate reading of how much voltage is in the battery and can be programmed to a minimum reserve warning of your choosing, depending on the battery size (from 7.4V - up). It will emit a warning BEEP-BEEP-BEEP when you reach that low voltage threshold that's loud enough to hear as long as you're flying within recommended control range with minimum background noise. It's simple to set up and simple to use. I have one for each of my quadcopters. They are good quality and very inexpensive. Why would you NOT have this accessory?

title: Makes your connections more universal.
text: Common type of connector for lipo batteries used in many RC models. Very easy to swap out other connectors, with solder, soldering pencil and heat shrink tubing.

title: Good cap.
text: Good cap, made out of nice flexible rubber, slips on and off with no trouble. the gold DJI logo is a nice touch. I was immediately satisfied when I put in on the P3P camera.

title: AJVRGSD's or Anti-Jello, Vibration Reducing, Gimbal Suspension Devices aka little rubber balls
text: OEM replacement part. I don't know how long it will take before the original part wears out. But, I'll have these handy, just in case.

title: Look! It's an SD card!
text: Not much you can say about an SD card, unless it just didn't work.  This one works............

title: Go for metal.
text: Being made out of plastic, it's lightweight. But, it's fragile. The first hard landing will break it. You can get a replacement parts kit. But, you can't get the original gimbal disassembled. The set screws are too tight. We've tried this on two gimbals that broke. Both wound up being trashed.

title: Fly all day..........
text: Nice add on for your Syma X-11 Hornet quadcopter. Slightly longer and heavier than the stock battery, it hangs out a little further. Taking the rubber pad out of the front of the battery compartment minimizes this. The Hornet flies a little more sluggishly, but still pretty nimble. And, you nearly double your flight time. With six batteries and a multi-charger, you will practically fly all day, pretty much non-stop.

title: If you have a smart device or tablet bigger than an iPad, you need this.
text: Simple fix for your smart device holder on your Phantom 3 or Inspire controller, to accommodate larger devices, up to a 10.1 Samsung Galaxy Tab. It's a piece of extruded hard foam plastic material, light weight and strong. It slides on from one side and has a 'stop' to keep it centered.  It fits perfectly and stays put. I cut a notch in the center of mine, so I could mount my Tab upside down and have a place for the USB cord to attach through. It works perfectly.

title: A little extra insurance. Well worth the money.
text: Fits perfectly between the skids. Carbon fiber material is stiff, light and strong. Crossmember will NOT be in camera view. I used velcro wraps instead of the included zip ties to secure it in place. That makes it easier to remove it, when putting the Phantom back in the hardshell backpack with the special cutout foam insert.

title: Great technology, terrible product.
text:
The electronics and features of this blue-tooth headset can't be beat. The sound quality is second to none. Now, the bad news. The materials and construction of this headset couldn't be worse. It was just a matter of weeks before the plastic neckband starts to crack. The soft rubber skin on the inside of the neck band and ear pieces is glued on with some type of adhesive that starts to break down pretty quickly, turning into some kind of goo that releases the skin and leaves a slimy sticky mess.

I have actually purchased two of these. With the first one, I thought maybe I was too 'rough' with it and caused it to crack. But, when the second one did the same thing, I gave up, understanding that it was just an inferior product. My advice, don't spend your money on this one. Get one of those that remains around your neck with the 'ear buds' on flexible leads that dangle when not in your ears.

title: Beautiul sound!
text: This turntable was the center piece of a new audio system I built for my girlfriend. You will need an amplifier and speakers. It would be nice if Amazon could give you recommendations of components that were COMPATIBLE. She ordered those components that were suggested, and they didn't work together. But, Radio Shack helped us out. I will say that Amazon's customer service department went above and beyond the call of duty in making things right though. She's happy.

title: Worth the money
text:
This was the lowest priced unit I could find, that I was comfortable with, when ordering. It's kind of big and bulky. The suction cup mount for my Garmin barely clears the 'donut'. But, I do some fancy high speed driving. This unit doesn't slide around on the dash, like some others do.

It was worth the investment.

title: Not very user friendly
text: If I had known how proprietary everything about Apple is, I wouldn't have bought this thing. It does the same thing any other unit, but you can't do anything with it without accessing your 'apple store'. Sometime after I bought this thing, I bought a couple of Sony Walkman units. I like them better.

title: good vlaue
text: boosting your pc's ram is easy, and improves performance, making it run faster, multitasking more efficiently. this ram is sort of the minimum I would use for this upgrade. It works just fine, and is well worth the money.

title: keep it handy
text:
If you have any 'netbook' computer, and want to install any new software from cd/dvd rom, you NEED this thing. So, it has it's purpose. This one, purchased specifically for aa ASUS eeee pc, works great. It's left at home most of the time, but goes with the netbook on long journeys. the compact design makes it perfect for your computer bag. It's also very rugged. The included stand is kind of pointless, unless you're planning on leaving this set up on your office desk and plugged into a hub or something.

Very satisfied.

title: Does just what it's supposed to do.
text: First, I thought my delivery was late. But, it turns out that UPS just dropped it on the steps at the front door and left. I never use that door. The package sat out there in the sun and rain for two days, during the hottest part of the summer, in Georgia. I installed this wireless adapter in a 4 year old tower, to eliminate the need to run network wiring as I moved my home office to another room. It works just fine. That says something about the tolerances of the unit. There's not much else to say about it. But, I'm satisfied.

title: good camera for the occasional photog.
text: This unit was purchased as a gift for a friend that seldom uses cameras, let alone one with a lot of bells and whistles. Once I showed her how to navigate through the basic menu on this thing, she took off with it and is having a blast. Taking really good pics, too. I can't talk a whole lot about the features, but what I saw as I demonstrated them to her, I was really pleased with. I consider it a good value on a good camera.

title: typical antenna for typical price
text:
Nothing special about this unit. I would have liked the insulating base to be of better material. I'm afraid that the thin silicon membrane will tear easily, and was better secured to the magnetic base. Removing the unit from your vehicle to clean or wax the vehicle, causes the membrane to detatch, and it's so thin, tearing may be an issue.

Also, basic instructions on how to tune your antenna to your radio, using a SWR meter would have been good.

It should be noted that you can pick up this exact antenna for the same price at any truck stop.

title: Great quality videos
text: Switched from some older GoPros and these are a lot better.  Touch screen is an added bonus too.

title: Great quality videos

text: During the installation of new energy efficient windows throughout my home, I realized that 3/4 of my ADT window alarms were the old wired ones and would no longer work.  ADT wanted to charge me over $400, reduced to $150 after my squawking, for 6 window alarms.  They would also be charging me an additional $18 a month to monitor these new alarms.  No thanks.  I went on Amazon and found these.  They are extremely easy to install and are not visible from the outside.  They have two settings, chime and alarm, and boy are they loud.  really loud.  The noise alone will deter any further intrusion from a a would be burglar, and it will definitely alert you to some one opening that window or even that door that you might want to chime.  They are battery operated so I set an reminder on my phone to check them once a year since I won’t be opening these particular windows all that much.  Other reviewers have said they have gone 2-3 years with the original batteries.  Great price for what I got,  and saves me the $216 in yearly monitoring from ADT and that supposed discount of $150 to buy their alarms.

title: I like these better than my airpod pros!
text:
Long story short I lost my airpod pros. Saw these on major discount ($90 for Black Friday), and couldn't resist. So here's my take in four parts. Sound Quality. Noise Cancelling. Ambient pass through. Features.

Sound quality -- versus the airpod pros, these are almost identical in sound. The only difference is the beats buds are a touch bass heavy. It's good, punchy bass, but noticeably more than the pros which were more balanced with its lows. So if you're a bass head, or hip-hop enthusiast, the beats win hands down.

Noise cancelling -- now this could have to do with the shape of my ear, but I found the beats to actually be a step ABOVE in noise cancelling. My gf still has her airpods and I compared. The seal the beat creates, paired with its noise cancelling makes it seem like the world doesn't exist. Beats win for me in NC.

Ambient pass-through -- this is where the beats lose out. Their noise cancelling is too good. So even when you have transparency turned on the world sound a little muddied out, while with the airpods, if I had transparency on it was almost like I wasn't wearing them. I miss that alot. So if you are in an environment where you need to hear what people are saying without removing your buds then airpods might be your pick. It's not to say that beats mak you deaf or anything but things are just noticeably quieter in transparance vs airpods with its full clarity.

Features -- another loss for the beats. They don't work with the beats app so no equalizer function... why beats???? WHY?? So you'll have to go third party if you want to equalize. The beats also won't stop the music or video you're watching if one falls out. No biggy for me as I like that but some people might not. Other than that it has similar functionality to airpods. One click to pause, two to skip, etc. It doesn't auto switch between devices but does actually switch pretty similarly. Takes maybe two clicks to switch it to my mac. The pairing is a breeze with iphones. Just open the case next to your iphone and voila. It's paired.

title: Incredible Sound

These headphones are perfect for me. I'm not a huge basshead, love my boom bap songs and all but I've always preferred ACCURACY over something that'll make my brain tingle. That's the h.ear on 2's. If you want an experience that shows you what the song is suppose to sound like then these are for you. Don't get me wrong, they definitely serve well on the bass end, perfectly so in my opinion. For those that prefer the bass, along with other EQ's, is adjustable via the sony app.

Noise cancelling is good. It's not the best-of-the-best but when my music is playing I can't hear anything around me which is all that matters to me.

title: Worked only one day  -- so disappointed!
text:
I was so excited to find this product - exactly what I needed for laptop with crappy sound - super affordable - does not take up precious desk space. But mine only worked one day!!

I tried it on different devices (ipad, iphone) to see if it was just the computer - but it's not. (Reattached my other speakers and they work with the same computer and the devices). I tried it attached and unattached to usb - I unplugged and re-plugged everything - the light is blue, but no sound. And yes, it is turned on. And yes, my volume is on max. Like I said, it worked fine the first day right out of the package. (So good in fact I had to dig through the wastebasket to find the packaging I threw away thinking I wouldn't need it). I'm really disappointed.

For the day it worked, tho, it was awesome. Good sound and plenty loud enough. Sits nicely on the top of the laptop screen and can be moved where you want it. Does not cover up webcam. (Note: it isn't firmly attached in any way - very loose fit but secure enough unless you move the computer. I would take them off for that. You also have to remove it to close the laptop). Only complaint I had (on the first day at least) was a jack cord that was almost too short. I had to move the speaker from the center top to the left end of the screen so the cord would reach the jack. Not a dealbreaker, though.

But not working at all - well that's obviously a dealbreaker. Sadly returning this.

title: Over priced. Warranty is basically a scam.
text:
TL;DR— not worth the extra cost, it will break and the lifetime warranty is a scam (website doesn’t work, always out of stock), just order a cheaper one and replace— IF you can somehow get Zagg to honor the warranty they will charge you at least $7 to send you a new one when this breaks (and it will def. break)

This was a great screen protector for the several months it lasted before cracking. That partially justifies the steep price tag compared to other screen protectors— but not really.

After I purchased this from amazon I registered this product on the Zagg website, which is necessary to potentially claim a replacement through the “lifetime” warranty program. When it broke, I logged back into their website to order a replacement. The first thing that was annoying was they had a message saying any product ordered within a several years long period would need to be re-registered after they had redesigned their website— my screen protector did not fall into this category, but I assume many people were out of luck on their warranties since they probably no longer had their receipts from screen protectors they had already registered. There was no email or anything warning consumers of this issue, although it’s possible it went out to only the affected people.

When I tried to order a replacement for my broken screen protector I got an error message telling me to try again later. Then the screen protector was out of stock. Then the website is down for maintenance. Then it was out of stock again. The Zagg screen protector on my phone is also broken and also had a warranty. Between the two I have been unable to order a replacement despite trying many, many times. I‘m not a computer engineer or anything, but my computer literacy is usually sufficient to navigate consumer websites. I’m pretty sure the issue is not with me, and if I am doing something wrong it’s because they have intentionally made their website impossible to navigate.

Eventually I gave up and just replaced the screen protector on my phone with a cheaper one. I was able to buy 2 new screen protectors for the same price as the SHIPPING for what the warranty replacement for the Zagg screen protector would have been if it was ever in stock when their website was working, and the difference in quality is negligible.

I don’t appreciate paying extra for a warranty that is not honored and having my time wasted trying to order a replacement when it’s clearly designed to be impossible. I also ended up keeping a broken screen protector on my phone and iPad for months while trying over and over again to order my replacement since it was under warranty.

title: No tech support, horrific customer service
text:
I’m sure my bad review is a drop in the bucket of good reviews and overwhelming popularity of these products, but I had a horrible experience with both the echo and amazon’s lack of anything resembling customer service when I had a problem.

I purchased 3 echo devices and an echo connect for my mother as a gift using my amazon account. A few months later I decided to buy myself an echo. When I first set it up I immediately had a problem because all of her information was completely mixed up with mine since I added her to my prime household I wasn’t able to separate any of my information from hers, so if I asked “Alexa” what was on my schedule it gave me everything on my calendar and hers without distinguishing between the two at all. I seriously doubt anyone wants this to happen. That was bad enough, but then I started getting all of her phone calls too. Amazon said there was no way to share a prime household and not have this happen. So, just to experiment, despite the fact that most of the reason I purchased the echos for my mother was to listen to audiobooks which I also purchase through my audible account so she has to stay in my household or the whole thing was a waste, I temporarily removed her from my prime household to see if that fixed the problem... but I could still call my mother’s phone number and the call would come through on my echo. I relayed this to customer services and they said, literally, “no sarah.” Nothing else. During my first interaction I was switched between representatives 5 times and the majority of the conversation was them repeating that they were catching up and thanking me for being a prime member, then saying: “if you want to use your mom’s prime membership then...” despite the fact that I purchased all the devices in question and the entire problem, which I explained over and over again, was that it’s my membership that she’s using.

If you enjoy the barely adequate yet glitchy performance of these devices enough that you decide to buy them for your family members, be prepared to get their notifications and receive horrible customer service and no technical support. Even after returning the device and deleting the app I sometimes get random calendar notifications from my mother’s calendar, and I get daily emails about “what’s new with the echo” to which I cannot unsubscribe. The whole thing was absolutely ridiculous, but amazon is way too big to be concerned about individual customers and they’ve stopped faking it.

title: Charges!
text:
The Skyque USB Fitbit Flex Charger Cable works very much like the original charger that came with the Fitbit Flex. There is no difference in function or basic appearance; you plug the Flex tracker into it the same way, the cable is the same length, and it has no fewer or added features. It charges the Flex just as efficiently as the charger I received in the box with my Fitbit, although it charges very fast so a couple of minutes faster or slower would be hard to notice unless I were really timing it carefully, and I’ve also lost my original charger anyway.

Make SURE YOU ORDER THE RIGHT CHARGER FOR THE TYPE OF FITBIT YOU HAVE. They are not interchangeable. I know that’s very obvious, but still, just triple check before you pay for something you can’t use. It’s not Prime shipping so I don’t know what their return policy is.

This charger does not come with a reset button. I do have a second charger that replaced my original but that one also doesn’t have a reset button, and I never used it with the manufacturer’s charger (fortunately I never needed it). Apparently it is actually a pinhole (good thing so you don’t push it by accident), so it’s easy to miss noticing that you actually have it.

It is not clear by the product heading, but I think it is only the Fitbit Charge cable that is meant to have the “quite a longer length.” Either way the charger I received was identical to the other replacement charger I received from a different company, and apart from this lack of a reset pinhole that may or may not be on all OEM Fitbit charging cables it is also identical to that one in both length and otherwise.

I actually got the Skyque USB Fitbit Flex Charger Cable so that I would have a second charger for my Fitbit Flex, not to replace a lost or damaged one. I am actually on my second charger though, since I lost the original one, so this is not a scenario that is out of the question. I really like my Fitbit, but since it runs for about a week between charges I rarely think about charging it until it is pretty dead, and when I do charge it I forget to put it back on. For these reasons I thought getting a second charger to keep in my purse or in my car would be a good idea, because that way I could charge my Flex while I am driving if I forget to charge it at home (which has the added bonus of not risking leaving the Fitbit at home after I charge it).

There is nothing overly special about this charger, but there is also nothing bad to say about it; it does what it is supposed to do, is easy to use, and arrived quickly. If you need a replacement charger or extra travel charger for a Fitbit there is no reason not to consider a Skyque charger.

I received this product for a discounted price in exchange for my honest review. The discount is not contingent upon a positive review, and my reviews are an honest account of my experiences with and opinions of the products I receive.

title: It doesn't not work.
text:
It seems to be water proof and it does play music, but I can't really say anything else good about it.

The quality of the sound is not good and the volume doesn't get loud enough, which are things you'd maybe expect from a cheap device. What's infuriating is the multifunction buttons don't work properly. Every single button on the thing just changes the track sort of at random, so you can't adjust the volume (or predictably change the track if you're actually going to try to do that). I haven't even been able to get it to stop or pause songs reliably. However, I have been able to listen to music and (weird maybe) the occasional audiobook while bathing, so it's not a total waste.

The battery actually does seem to be pretty decent, although I would trade better function and sound for having to charge it more.

title: I haven't missed a spontaneous shot since I got my Mymiggo Grip Travel Camera Case
text:
I received a expensive digital camera for Christmas and then promptly freaked everyone out as I don't like straps. After dropping it a couple of times, I started looking for straps I could live with and came across This grip camera case. That's all I use now and I leave the cumbersome camera bag in the car while I am taking photographs. It adapts to any DSLR camera as there is a grid of holes that you screw the main piece onto. Once you have done that the whole piece fits and closes your camera to the elements and it's made of a neoprene material that takes some pretty good shock if you do drop it. However, once you slid it off your lens, there is a cuff that you slide onto your wrist, adjust the stretch drawstring to securing fasten. You are now free to drop your camera and it ends up hanging off your wrist. I have a telephoto lense and this works with both.
The feature I really like is the fact that you can slide your lense cover into the front which houses your lense. I have not lost a lense cover since. It comes in a series of different designs to fit both men's and women's tastes.

title: You Mileage May Vary
text: I was all set to return this because it would not recognize my Seagate 4TB SSHD. In disk management it showed up as GPT protective partition. After googling, I found that the only way to get past this was to use Diskpart and Clean the drive--that meant wiping out everything on the drive. Since I had already cloned it, I went ahead and used the Clean command and wiped it out. Still couldn't do anything with the drive in disk management. So using Diskpart again, I used the command, Create Partition Primary. At this point, Diskpart couldn't do anything else. It would not create a volume to format, so I had to use Disk Management to create the volume and format it to exFat. I should state that the drive was recognized by my computer internally when it was connected to a Sata port, but once it was put into the Sabrent, it's drive information was changed and made unusable until I performed the procedure above. Not sure why this happened, maybe because it's a SSHD, but I kinda doubt it since I had no problems with the drive when connected to a Sata Port.

title: It was unrecognized and It came unallocated
text:
This is my second SSD, my first being a Kingston (with the Taiwan firmware thank God) so I thought install was going to be fairly easy; it was not. My system (Win7) did not recognize the drive, but the included software, Samsung Magician, said the drive was there, operating properly, but was "frozen". I googled the malfunction and found out that the drive had no partitions.

So first step was to get in Disk Management, find the drive, click on the 113+gb unallocated space and create a partition.

Step two, reboot and change my boot sequence because Samsung Magician felt it was necessary to change it for me and made this new SSD my boot drive, even though it had no OS on it to boot.

Step three, change my power management plan back to what I had before because Samsung Magician felt it was better to change it to hibernate instead of what I wanted. I hate Hibernate.

After that it worked great. I use this SSD for games only because it's so damn fast, but I wish the included software and instructions were better, hence the 4 stars and not 5.

title: Glitchy.  Crap.  Buy an old one - 3rd gen
text:
The early generations of Apple TV still operate faster and work more smoothly today. Wish they would take it back so I could go back to my Apple TV 3.

Cons:
The new navigation is clunky.
The device and remote are very very glitchy

I have to shut the whole thing down and restart daily - especially when it freezes like my old PC laptops used to do in 2005.

The remote is overly sensitive when you need to be accurate, and unresponsive way too often - like 50% of the time. For a top shelf device you should not feel the need to swear at it daily. The old remote was awesome - perfect performance.

What designer thought it would be good to ad more click throughs? It should be easier than ever not the opposite.

The automatic preview playing is very invasive. I know all the companies are doing this but the nice differentiator from traditional tv/cable was that you had total control and didn't have to listen to drivel you didn't want to listen to. It's almost like a cable company took over the design.

The "TV" app doesn't work - it is supposed to track your activity across all the apps and allow you to easily pick up where you left off watching on any app/station.

One has to wonder if Apple has made the hulu, netflix, and amazon apps work poorly on purpose - they have been busted for several such activities in the past. Like all those articles say, when these companies war, we all lose. And now Apple, we don't trust you. Finance that reputation recovery, right?

Pros:
It is somewhat faster loading a movie than the 3rd gen.
The addition of apps is neat
The voice recognition of the remote is shockingly great considering the failure of Apple's Siri
Higher definition

title: The best earbuds, for the money I've ever purchased from Amazon or Best Buy
text:
I just got the TOZO T6 waterproof headphones tonight. One of the main reasons I picked them is because they were same day delivery for me. Since my skullcandy wireless earbuds had ticked me off for the last time I was ready to find something new. I am so happy to say that so far I am not disappointed.

First of all, the packaging was immaculate. The unboxing experience felt like I was unboxing a new phone. Everything was packaged so neatly and purposefully.

Fit - There is a wider availability of earbud sizes than any other headphones I have ever gotten. Not just in girth, but also depth, so there is an option for people who may have a more shallow ear canal. Very thoughtful. As soon as I paired the earbuds and picked the appropriate sized silicone earbud tip I put them in. They were lighter and fit more ergonomically than my skullcandy did. They are smaller and fit my ear more comfortably.

Pairing - the process as simple as pulling the earbuds out of the box, taking the plastic tabs off, putting them in the charging case, taking them out of the charging case and waiting for the colored lights to begin flashing blue and red (took about 6 seconds). Then I scanned for TOZO 6 under "bluetooth settings" on my phone. It was literally the simplest pairing experience I've ever had. Especially considering I nearly returned my skullcandy earbuds after over an hour and them not showing up on my phone when I scanned. This was pleasantly simple and the directions given actually worked as they were supposed to.

The sound - I didn't do any adjustments to the sound on my phone, other than volume and the sound was crisp, it was full bodied, clearly hearing bass, and even the highest notes in clarity. I had the volume of the song I was listening to at a bit less than 50% and full sound that didn't allow normal room noises to infiltrate. I even knocked quite hard on my wooden nightstand to test this and I could not hear the knocking.

There is the option to alternate which earbud is first or secondary. Just turn off the one you want to be secondary and the other will remain primary when you turn the other back on again. I appreciate that either earbud can be primary or secondary or that can be used one at a time as well.

Phone call clarity. I was able to hear crisp clear sound while on the phone and the person I talked to said I sounded crisp and clear as well.

Charge - the earbud case is able to charge on a charging platform or with a micro-USB charging cable (included.) This was the only disappointment I encountered as I would have liked the T6 case to a accept the same USB C cable that my Galaxy Note phone uses. That is a minor thing that would not make me not want to use these earbuds.

There were several colors to choose from, black, white, light blue, mint green, purple and pink. I chose the light blue since it matches my current phone case. However, if ever after your purchase you tire of the color of your case, there are silicone charger cases available on Amazon for purchase specifically for the TOZO T6 charger case. This can allow your earbud case to be conveniently hooked to a bag or belt loop.

title: Ok with some glitches
text: I ordered and received the echo 5  in charcoal color. However, when I open the box I discovered the power cord was bright white. Thought it was a mistake, however I was informed by Amazon that all units come with a white cord now. And was advised if I had read the specifications more closely, I would have seen that the cord color is indicated as glacier white. They were correct, however I must have missed that when placing my order.  I learned  that apparently it is an effort to be more efficient and environmentally conscious. Not exactly sure how white cords meet that goal, but whatever. It looked like something I had purchased secondhand at a garage sale. Very bush league and tacky in my opinion.  When I tried to set the unit up, I consistently got a message that my Amazon account was not valid. I contacted the folks in the echo department at Amazon who advised me that the unit was locked. Made me think that I might have received a unit that had been purchased and returned by someone else. They were able to unlock it for me while on the call and then I proceeded to set the unit up with no issues. The echo 5 seems to work well, however I was really disappointed with it’s appearance and with having to jump through hoops to register it. Perhaps a white cord with a charcoal unit is not an issue for most people, but it looked very out of place for me in the location where I intended on placing the unit. Also know that there is no stand included with the unit. Stands can be purchased separately but are not essential for the unit to work properly.
